name: Easy Beef Ribs Sinigang Recipe
description: This one-pot dish combines the rich and flavorful taste of beef, mixed with the fresh garden vegetables, cooked in the tamarind based soup.
tips: When boiling the beef, remember to remove the scum that accumulates on the top of the surface. This process will make that soup clear and prevent it from becoming cloudy and visually unpleasant.

ingredients.item: pack Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Original

instructions: With this one pot easy dish, you will have less preparation in the kitchen and more time spent in the family table for conversations. You just need to put together the beef ribs, tomatoes, onions and 1 liter of water into a heavy pot. Let this boil over high heat and without a cover. Remember to remove the scum that accumulates on the top of the surface, make that soup clear and prevent it from becoming cloudy and visually unpleasant.

Once it boils, cover the pot and bring down the heat. You can now relax as this would cook for 1 hour or more. If the meat is fork tender, you know that it is done. At this point, pour the Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Original 20g.
Throw in the radish slices and let this cook for 5 minutes before adding the eggplant. Once the eggplant is cooked through, add the sili and kangkong leaves and stems.
Get your plates and fork ready because this Beef Ribs Sinigang is ready to be thoroughly enjoyed by your family!

name: Sinigang na Grilled Liempo Recipe
description: This dish combines the flavorful taste of inihaw na liempo mixed with the tangy and rich texture of Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok with gabi and fresh vegetables.
tips: Remember to remove the scum from the surface of the water when you initially boil the pork liempo, to remove any impurities and dirt from the raw pork. This will ensure your soup will be nice and clear. This process is called skimming.

ingredients.item: grilled liempo, cut into serving-size pieces
(40 g) pack Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix

instructions: Let’s begin by boiling the “hugas bigas” and then throw in the onions, tomatoes, gabi and grilled liempo. You may then bring this to a simmer over low heat until pork is tender.
When the gabi is tender, mash half of it to thicken the soup. Now, throw in the sili, radish and okra and let this simmer.
The next step is to pour the Knorr Sinigang Mix. After pouring, you can now add the sitaw and kangkong last. Stir these well and cook for another minute and this dish is done!
Make sure you have enough space in your stomach because this Sinigang na Grilled Liempo Recipe will make you want to eat more. Enjoy it best with family and good conversations at the table.

name: Ginataang Hipon Recipe
description: This simple dish uses the rich seafood taste of shrimp sautéed in the sweet and creamy Knorr Ginataang Gulay flavors, topped with garlic bits.
tips: Remember to monitor the heat and lower to simmer after adding the coconut milk, to prevent the liquids to curdle. Set it to low or medium heat, just enough to let the dish simmer.

ingredients.item: (33 g) pack Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe

instructions: Get your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and sautè leeks until fragrant. Add shrimp next and sautè for another minute or until it turns bright red in color.
In goes the water and Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe. Mix well and bring this to a boil, then immediately lower the heat to simmer.
Simmer until the shrimps are cooked through. And that's our dish! Serve Ginataang Hipon with garlic bits on top and see how it will disappear right before your eyes. Yummy!

name: Spicy Monggo with Tinapa Recipe
description: This Filipino classic vegetable dish combines the fresh flavor of Mung beans slowly simmered in Knorr Pork broth, mixed with tinapa flakes and malunggay leaves
tips: When boiling the monggo beans, make sure to remove the froth and beans floating on top to keep the soup clear of impurities and dirt.

ingredients.item: medium -sized tinapang galunggong, fried, filleted and shredded

instructions: Since monggo beans are seeds, they may have acquired and collected dirt. So, you need to clean and pick them over then wash in several changes of water before draining thoroughly. Monggo beans also need to be soaked in water to soften them. For this recipe, use 4 cups of water then give it a gentle stir. Make sure to remove the floating particles on top. You don’t want any dirt on your dish.
Once your beans are soft enough, get a large pot, and make it nice and warm over medium-hight heat. Then you can start sautéing the garlic, onions and tomatoes in a pot for about 2 minutes or more.

You may now pour in the softened monggo beans with their own liquid before adding the Knorr Pork Cubes. You need to simmer this by turning the fire to low, cover the pot then leave it to cook for 1 hour or until the monggo beans are tender. Stir once in a while to avoid the monggo from clumping together.
Once monggo beans are tender, throw in the tinapa flakes and siling labuyo. Stir gently and simmer this for about 1- 2 minutes.
One more step then we are done! You just need to top the malunggay leaves on the monggo and turn off the heat.
What a reward this dish brings to the table! You can now enjoy this healthy and delicious meal with the family.

name: Filipino Classic Pancit Molo Recipe
description: The comforting flavors of pork and shrimp mix together to create a depth of flavor that stands out in this humble and heart healthy soup dish.
tips: When making your individual molo dumplings, remember not to overfill the wrappers. You need to leave space for you to close the wrapper properly from all side to prevent them from breaking apart while cooking.
instructions: There are 2 parts in making this dish. Let's start by making the dumplings. Combine pork, egg (dissolve 1 Knorr Shrimp Broth Cube in beaten egg), cornstarch and singkamas into a bowl. mix until all ingredients are well incorporated.
Wrap a teaspoon of mixture into the molo wrapper and seal by brushing the edges with water.
Next, we start making the broth. Get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and sauté onion and garlic.
Add water and the remaining Knorr Shrimp Broth Cube and just bring this to a boil. Mix until the cube is dissolved. Lower the heat then drop in the molo dumplings and simmer for 2 minutes.
Add strips of molo wrappers and adjust according to taste. After simmering for another minute, this dish is done. Serve with a sprinkle of spring onions and fried garlic on top.
Pancit Molo will remind you of home. Comforting, filling and will definitely warm your belly.

name: Lumpiang Hubad Recipe
description: This Filipino classic heart healthy dish uses the fresh taste of ubod combined with carrots, sinkamas and peanuts, topped with a sweet-soy garlic peanut sauce
tips: Ubod or Hearts of palm are a good source of protein and fiber, and high in vitamin C and vitamin B6, calcium, niacin, phosphorous and zinc.
instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and sauté onions and garlic, then add Knorr Shrimp Cubes. Dissolve cube and continue to sauté for another minute. Turn the heat up to high to cook the vegetables to a crisp. Remove the vegetables and transfer to a plate to avoid overcooking.

Now let's get ready to make the sauce. Get another pot and combine the brown sugar, water and soy sauce together. Just bring to a boil before thickening with ground peanut and cornstarch diluted with water (slurry).
Throw in half of the garlic and peanuts to the vegetables and mix well. While leaving some for toppings.
Lumpiang Hubad is now ready to be enjoyed by the whole family. Simple yet full of flavour. What are you waiting for, let's eat!

name: Chicken and Corn with Secret Siomai Recipe
description: This Asian soup dish combines the creamy and sweet flavor of Knorr Chicken and Corn Real Chinese Soup mixed with homemade pork siomai dumplings.
tips: In Chinese medicine, shiitake mushrooms are thought to boost health and longevity, as well as improve circulation.

ingredients.item: dried shiitake mushrooms, soaked, drained and minced
dozen quail eggs, boiled and peeled
Knorr Chicken and Corn Real Chinese Soup

instructions: Let’s begin by making the siomai filling. Mix the sesame oil, cornstarch, pork and mushrooms in a bowl and season this well with salt and pepper.
Using three siomai wrappers, wrap one teaspoon of the mixture and one quail egg in. Sprinkle with spring onions before sealing.
Transfer the prepared siomai in a steamer and cook for about 30 minutes.

Now, we work on the soup. Let's prepare a saucepan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Cook the Knorr Chicken and Corn Soup according to the instructions on the sachet. Slowly mix in an egg while cooking the soup.

Once strings from the egg have formed, add the cooked siomai and remove from heat and that’s our dish. This dish will definitely make your family’s day. Siomai and hot soup in one! What more can you ask for?

name: Kaldereta Cream Pasta Recipe
description: This simple and delicious pasta recipe combines the Italian pasta textures with the flavors of the Filipino Classic Kalderata.

ingredients.item: pack Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Kaldereta, dissolved in 2½ cups water

instructions: Saute onion, garlic and bell peppers in oil add potato and carrot.
Add the dissolved knorr complete recipe mix, liver spread, chili, green peas, and olives, simmer until vegetables are cooked and sauce is thick add cream and stir well.
Just with cooked pasta. ( you can top this with beef flakes if preffered).

name: Sinigang na Lechon Recipe
description: This dish uses the rich and thick flavor of lechon meat, cooked in a tamarind based soup mixed with gabi and fresh vegetables served in a tamarind broth soup
tips: Taro (Gabi) is a great source of our dietary fiber. It has more than twice the amount of fiber as potatoes.

ingredients.item: lechon meat (lean) cut into serving portions
(1 pack) Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Original Mix

instructions: Just like any simple sinigang dish, start by using the water from when you washed your rice and pour this into the pot together with the onions, tomatoes, gabi and lechon. Bring this to a boil then lower the heat to simmer and cook until the meat is fork tender.
The addition of gabi mashed into the soup will make this sinigang rich and thick and definitely more delicious.
Throw in the sili, radish and okra and let this simmer before adding the Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Original Mix, sitaw and kangkong. Stir well and cook this further for about a minute.
Enjoy lechon and sinigang in one, you will definitely see big smiles greeting you at the dining table.

name: Sinigang Buko at Manok Recipe
description: This dish uses the sweet taste of coconut juice combined with the tangy flavors of Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok, mixed with the rich taste of chicken.
tips: Tamarind (sampaloc) is a great source of vitamins and antioxidants that help control and reduce inflammation in the body.

ingredients.item: (20 g) pack Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalaok Original Mix

instructions: Start a new tradition by serving Sinigang Buko at Manok to your family. It’s not only easy to cook, but it’s also so delicious too. Start by getting a large pot, make it nice and warm over medium-hight heat, then add the onions, tomatoes, tanglad, ginger, followed by the buko juice and buko meat. Add the Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Original Mix then let it dissolve in the liquids. Add the chicken pieces then let the soup boil.
Once it boils, reduce the heat to a simmer until chicken is cooked through.
Add tamarind leaves last and season according to taste. See the reaction on your family’s faces when you serve this hot dish to them. They will simply love you for it!

name: Onion Rings Recipe
description: This perfect snack time dish uses the fresh and sweet flavor of fresh onions, lightly coated in breading served with garlic mayo dipping sauce
tips: To reduce the strong aroma and sting of fresh onions, you can soak the onion slices in cold water to dilute the sulfur content, turning them sweet and mild.

ingredients.item: large white onions, sliced into 3/4-inch thick rings

instructions: First, prepare 3 trays with the flour, egg and breadcrumbs mix. Dip the onion slices in flour first, then in egg, and lastly in the breadcrumbs. Repeat with the rest of the rings.
Next, Pre-heat oil then deep-fry breaded onions until brown and crisp. Strain to remove excess oil.

For the dip: Combine mayonnaise, garlic, and Knorr Liquid Seasoning and mix until smooth. Over game board nights , movie marathon at home or simply entertaining guest. Onion Rings will never fail to put a smile on your face.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup Recipe
description: What more can you ask for? With Knorr Chicken Noodle Soup, you can feel the warmth of your mom’s care. Perfect for rainy days!
instructions: Use a pack of Knorr Chicken Noodle Soup and allow it to boil in a liter (4 cups) of water for just 5 minutes. Make sure you keep your saucepan partially covered. Stir the soup from time to time.
Serve hot and enjoy with family. You can truly say that the simplest dishes are the most special.

name: Pork Chops Oriental Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich taste of pork chops marinated in the asian flavors of garlic, ginger, soy sauce and pineapple infused with Knorr cream of mushroom.
tips: Bring your pork chops to room temp from refrigeration before frying, to ensure even cooking and to retain as much moisture during the cooking process.
instructions: Begin by dissolving ½ pouch of Knorr Cream of Mushroom in water then set this aside.
Next, marinate the pork chops in soy sauce, garlic, ginger, pineapple juice, and the remaining Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup Mix for about 3 minutes.
Get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and pan fry the pork chops then set aside.
Get another pan ready and place the remaining marinade and the dissolved Knorr Cream of Mushroom in. Bring this to a boil. before adding the pork chops.
Reduce the heat and simmer for 10 to 12 minutes. And that's our dish.
Feast your eyes when you see a nice serving of Pork Chops Oriental with your favorite mixed vegetables. It's delicious!

name: Sinampalukang Manok Recipe
description: Give fried chicken and tinola a rest and brighten up your dining table by learning how to cook sinampalukang manok!
tips: This fresh dish is sure to make mealtime exciting again! What’s even better is most of the sinampalukang manok ingredients are already in your pantry already.

ingredients.item: (22g) pack Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix with Gabi
sampalok leaves (usbong ng sampalok), removed from stem

instructions: Get your pot nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and sauté garlic, onions, and ginger.
Add the chicken pieces next and sauté until the chicken skin is nicely brown and a bit dry.
Pour the water and add the Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix with Gabi and Knorr Chicken Broth Cubes.

Simmer until chicken is tender. Add the sampalok leaves, and leave for a minute just before serving. With a big serving of hot rice, you can't help but eat more than usual. With a big serving of hot rice, you can't help but eat more than usual.

name: Tasty Tilapia Oriental Recipe
description: This simple dish uses the fresh seafood flavors of steamed Tilapia seasoned with Knorr Liquid Seasoning flavors, topped with the Chinese oriental style sauce.
tips: When steaming fish, the best way to tell if your fish is done is by testing it with a fork at an angle, at the thickest point, and twist gently. The fish will flake easily when it's done and it will lose its translucent or raw appearance.

ingredients.item: (37 g) Knorr Nido Oriental Style Real Chinese Soup

instructions: Begin by preparing Knorr Nido Oriental Style Real Chinese Soup according to package instructions (do not add egg). Set aside.
Give tilapia a nice seasoning of with salt and pepper and transfer to a heatproof dish. Steam the fish until cooked through.

Remove the fish from the steamer and arrange the fish on a platter and top it with the Knorr Nido Oriental Style Real Chinese Soup mix. Drizzle with Knorr Liquid Seasoning Original flavor and garnish with toasted garlic on top.
Now who says something as pretty looking and delicious as this can't be made at home. Try this recipe and see what we mean.

name: Star Sopas with Garlic Chicken Recipe
description: This Filipino classic dish combines the flavors of fresh garlic and chicken, paired with milk and a light Knorr chicken broth. Its the perfect comfort food.
tips: Throughout ancient history, the main use of garlic was for its health and medicinal properties. Garlic has a significant impact on reducing blood pressure in people with high blood pressure.
instructions: Let’s begin by marinating the chicken with salt and a teaspoon of garlic. Rub into the meat and let it marinate for at least 10 minutes.

Now, grab a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion and garlic. Gently mix the chicken in. Sauté until the chicken is cooked through before adding the Knorr Chicken Cubes. Mix and dissolve the cube until all ingredients are well incorporated.

In goes the 5 cups of water and bring this to a boil before adding the carrot, sayote, and cooked macaroni. Once the noodles are already cooked, lower the heat and gently pour the evaporated milk, and with a few more minutes to simmer, that’s our dish.
Here’s a feel good soup that you can cook any day, any time of the week. Whatever the weather, it will surely put a smile on your face.

name: Spaghetti with Ham and Corn Recipe
description: This quick and easy pasta dish uses the creamy taste of Knorr Chicken and Corn Real Chinese Soup mix combined with sautéed mushrooms, topped in spaghetti.
tips: Mushrooms are not only rich in flavors, but they are also good sources of protein and antioxidants. It helps maintain a healthy immune system, boost your bone health and helps reduce the risk of neurological illness in the future.

ingredients.item: Knorr Chicken and Corn Real Chinese Soup 60 g

instructions: Begin by dissolving Knorr Chicken and Corn Real Chinese Soup in 1 cup water then set this aside.
Bring fresh milk into a gentle boil and pour dissolved soup mix into the boiling milk while stirring. Give this a good 5 minutes to simmer then set aside.
Now, get another saucepan and over medium heat, melt butter with a little bit of oil. Throw in the garlic and onion.

Add the mushrooms and just sauté for 3 minutes before pouring in the soup mix. Just give this a few minutes to simmer until the sauce thickens. Now that our sauce is done, its time to plate our pasta.
Arrange the spaghetti on a platter, pour the sauce on top and sprinkle the parmesan cheese over. With chopped parsley on top, that’s our dish!
categories: KNORR CHICKEN AND CORN REAL CHINESE SOUP

name: Grilled Pork Chops with Sinigang Rub Recipe
description: This simple grilled dish uses the rich flavors of pork seasoned with flavorful taste of Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok, coated with sesame oil and fresh herbs
tips: Before placing the pork in the rub, you can soak the pork chops in milk for about 1 hour, to tenderize the meat. The milk enzymes will help break the protein, making the fibers and meat more tender.

ingredients.item: (20 g) Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original

instructions: This recipe is so easy and quick to make. Just rub the combined seasoning of Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original and ground black pepper to both sides of the pork chops. You may also add freshly chopped herbs to add dynamic flavors to the seasoning.
Next, drizzle sesame oil over both sides of the pork chops, to give it that Asian flavor and aroma.
Get your grill nice and hot and brush it with some oil. Grill pork chops for 3 minutes per side then flip. Do this until pork chops are cooked through.
Serve with ranch dressing. You will definitely eat more than usual especially with a side of grilled tomatoes, onions, and mushrooms, it's a winner!

name: Hot and Sour Chicken Wings Recipe
description: This ideal snack recipe uses the rich taste of chicken wings marinated in the sweet and tangy taste of Knorr Sinigang, coated in tabasco, butter and honey.
tips: When choosing honey, choose the ones that are a bit darker in shade. Darker honey varieties tend to offer more antioxidants than lighter varieties.

ingredients.item: Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original

instructions: For a more flavourful and juicy chicken, begin by poaching the chicken wings – which has been seasoned with salt and garlic - in water. When done, remove the chicken from the liquid and allow it to drain. Then, pat it dry with a paper towel.

It’s now time to add the flavouring by rubbing Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original unto the chicken. Coat this with flour, shaking off any excess, then dip in beaten eggs before finally coating in breadcrumbs. The chicken is not yet done because this will be tossed with another layer of coating made by combining the following ingredients: butter, Tabasco sauce, sesame oil and honey.
It’s now time to deep-fry the chicken wings until they are nice and crispy.
Finally, the wings are ready to be shared and enjoyed by everyone. They will truly not disappoint especially when you serve them with your favorite dipping sauce.
categories: KNORR SINIGANG SA SAMPALOK MIX ORIGINAL

name: Sukiyaki Recipe
description: With beef, vegetables, and noodles cooked in a flavourful broth made with Knorr Beef Cubes, Japanese food is served at the comfort of your home.
tips: Vermicelli noodles (rice noodles) are a good gluten-free option for those who have celiac disease or are gluten sensitivity.

ingredients.item: vermicelli noodles, soaked in hot water then drained
tofu, cut into cubes then browned on a pan or grill

instructions: Get a pot large enough to put together slices of beef, onion, spring onions, mushrooms, noodles, tofu, and bok choy.
Now, in a separate pot, combine water, Knorr Beef Cubes, soy sauce, sake, sugar, and mirin. Over high heat, bring the mixture to a boil then reduce heat and just simmer for 2 minutes.

Just before serving, pour the broth into the pot and let the rest of the ingredients simmer in the broth until cooked through. Nothing will beat mom's cooking, especially when she serves Sukiyaki for dinner. It's soooo good!

name: Fish with Corn and Egg Sauce Recipe
description: This simple healthy dish combines the rich flavor and texture of deep fried fish fillet marinated in calamansi, topped with creamy corn with egg sauce.
tips: Corn is rich in vitamin C, an antioxidant that helps protect your cells from damage and wards off diseases like cancer and heart disease.

ingredients.item: fish fillet, cut into about 50 g each

instructions: Let's begin by dissolving Knorr Cream of Corn in 2 cups water then just set this aside.
Next, season the fish fillet with calamansi juice, salt and pepper.

Prepare 2 trays, one for the flour and the 2nd for the beaten eggs. Now, gently coat the fish with flour then dip it in the beaten egg mix. Make sure you have a pre-heated pan ready, with oil, for deep frying the fish. Cook until golden brown and just drain on a plate lined with paper towels,
Get another pan ready and pour the Knorr Cream of Corn Soup mix in and bring to a boil.
Stir in the slightly beaten egg whites then reduce the heat to a simmer. Just give this leave this for 5 minutes.
Get a nice platter ready. Place the fish in and just pour the sauce over. And that's it! Serve Fish with Corn and Egg Sauce with hot rice and know for sure, it's going to be a hit on the table.

name: Lamb Stew
description: This traditional Lamb recipe uses the rich and flavorful taste of lamb slowly cooked in a tomato-beef broth until tender, mixed with carrots and fried potatoes.
tips: "Compared to most meat, lamb has a much higher omega-3 content.

ingredients.item: boneless lamb shoulder, cut into cubes
flour, dissolved in ¼ cup water

instructions: Begin by getting a pan nice and hot over high heat. Pour some oil and just cook the lamb until evenly brown. Do not overcrowd the pan to avoid juices from coming out of the meat. Cook by batches if necessary. This will cook about 3 -5 minutes.
Remove and transfer the lamb and remove any excess oil. Now, using the same pan, throw in the garlic, onions and tomatoes.
Add tomato paste and return the lamb to the pan.
Pour water and bay leaf. When the water boils, add Knorr Beef Cube and cook this for an hour. Add the carrots and fried potatoes.
When the lamb, carrots and potatoes are tender, add the flour dissolved in water to thicken the sauce. And that’s our dish!
Serve this to your family and see their reaction when they try the dish. It’s delicious!

name: Nido Misua Delight Recipe
description: This heart healthy dish uses the rich flavor of Knorr Nido Oriental Real Chinese Soup combined with lightly marinated chicken breast and misua noodles.
tips: Misua, or Wheat Vemicelli, is highly beneficial for a healthy living as it improves body metabolism, controls obesity and high blood sugar levels. It also lowers the risks of heart diseases.

ingredients.item: chicken breast fillet, cut into cubes
Knorr Nido Oriental Real Chinese Soup dissolved in 4 cups water

instructions: Have a more flavourful soup by first marinating the chicken breast in Knorr Liquid Seasoning for 30 minutes.
Get your pan and make sure it’s nice and hot then throw in the marinated chicken and give this a quick sauté together with some garlic.
Pour dissolved Knorr Nido Oriental Real Chinese Soup in water in pan. Then, drop in the egg, making sure to whisk well with a fork. Let this simmer for 3 minutes.
Add misua and cook this further for a few seconds.
Giving this dish a good sprinkle of chopped spring onions will make it look more enticing and appetizing to eat. So, what are you waiting for? Enjoy with the family while it’s hot.
categories: KNORR NIDO ORIENTAL REAL CHINESE SOUP

name: Pesang Isda Pleasures Recipe
description: This heart healthy dish combines the fresh flavors of the ginger broth, mixed with fresh vegetables and healthy taste of seafood.
tips: Ginger is full of medicinal properties that help reduce and fight flu and common cold, aids in digestion and reduces nausea.

ingredients.item: large dalag or hito, cleaned and cut into serving portions

instructions: Get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and saute garlic, ginger, and onions.
Add fish,“hugas bigas”, and Knorr Fish Cubes. Bring to a boil until the fish is cooked through.
When fish is cooked, add pechay tagalog, green onions, and pepper.
Serve once the vegetables are cooked. See how simple dishes becomes a pleasure especially when you eat with the whole family.

name: Poached Fish in Asparagus Sauce Recipe
description: This dish uses the fresh seafood taste of poached fish topped with the creamy and flavorful Knorr Cream of Asparagus sauce.
tips: An advantage of poaching is that the food you cook will turn out succulent and tender, which is how we want our fish to come out, which usually dry out using another method of cooking.
instructions: Begin by dissolving Knorr Cream of Asparagus in 2 cups water and set aside.

Now, get a pot and fill it with 8 cups water (or 2 liters) with salt, pepper and half of the calamansi juice. Let the liquid boil, then lower the heat, then gently add the fish steaks in and for 10 minutes only or until cooked through.
Get another pan and just pour the Knorr Cream of Asparagus soup Mix in and bring to a boil while continuous stirring. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
Arrange the fish on a platter laced with the soup mix on top. Sprinkle with the remaining calamansi juice and that's our dish.
With a serving of sautéed sayote and carrots, you will definitely eat more than usual. It's delicious!

name: Pork Adobo Recipe
description: Craving comfort today? This pork adobo recipe is the perfect choice! Learn how to make it with Knorr in three simple steps.
tips: Do not stir vinegar till it has fully cooked. You need to wait for the vinegar to evaporate while simmering.
instructions: Get a pot and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and sauté garlic and onions. Add pork and continue sautéing until cooked.

Pour Knorr Liquid Seasoning, water, vinegar, laurel leaves, sugar, and pepper. Add 1pc Knorr Pork Cubes. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to a simmer, make sure that you don't cover the pan to evaporate the vinegar. Cook for 10 more minutes.
Remove the meat from the sauce and fry, to add extra crispiness and color to the meat. Return the fried meat in sauce. Reheat and simmer until sauce thickens.

name: Sinigang na Salmon Recipe
description: This dish is made from Tamarind sour soup with a blend of Miso, or fermented soybean. The taste of the soup compliments flavors of the Salmon and vegetables
tips: Miso is packed my nutrients that makes it very healthy and can make you look more beautiful.

ingredients.item: salmon, cut into 1-1 ½-inch thick pcs.
(22 g) pack Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix na may Miso

instructions: All it takes is a few simple steps to bring this heart-warming Sinigang na Salmon to your family’s table.
Start by sauteing the onions and tomatoes in hot oil until the tomatoes are very soft. Add the salmon pieces and gently saute. Pour in the water and allow to boil gently.
Next, throw in the chili and pour the sinigang mix before adding the kangkong. Stir and simmer. It should be done in a minute. You may season according to your preference.
With enough rice, patis, calamansi or chili, Sinigang na Salmon is going to make you the hero of your home.
categories: KNORR SINIGANG NA MAY MISO MIX

name: Seafood and Lime Sinigang
description: This dish combines the sweet and sour taste of the tamarind vegetable soup with the rich sea flavors of the shrimp, shellfish, mussels and squid.
tips: Tamarind (Sampalok) is a good source of antioxidants and it also has anti-inflammatory properties that are highly beneficial to our body.

ingredients.item: pcs. squid, small, cleaned, cut into rings

instructions: Begin by boiling rice washing (hugas bigas) with onions, tomatoes and chilli in a pot.

Throw in the mussels, shrimp, and squid next and just bring to a boil before lowering to a simmer. Make sure to check once in a while because shrimp cooks fast. As soon as the shrimp changes color and the mussels open, it’s done!
Now, add the lime juice and Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok 2-in-1 Mix. Then, add the remaining vegetables and allow to simmer for just a minute. Give this a nice seasoning and that’s our dish!
Make sure you prepare a big serving of rice because you will simply eat more than usual!

name: Sinigang na Baka Recipe
description: This Filipino Classic dish uses the rich and flavorful taste of beef shark, simmered and marinated in the tangy flavors of Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok.
tips: Remember to remove the scum from the surface of the water every now and then, to ensure your soup will be nice and clear. This process is called skimming.

ingredients.item: kg. beef shank, cut into serving pcs.
(20g) pack Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Original Mix
pc. radish, sliced into ½-inch thick rounds

instructions: Get a large pot and fill it with water, then add the beef. Make sure the water is enough to cover the beef. Bring to a boil then discard liquid.

Add rice washing to beef, then add onions, tomatoes, and chili. Bring to a boil then simmer slowly, covered, until beef is tender. Remember to skim the top of the liquid to keep the soup clear and to remove impurities. Add more rice washing if needed.
Add Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Original Mix, radish and for simmer for 2-3 minutes. Add kangkong and simmer for another. Season according to taste.
A feel good soup deserves a big serving of rice. Prepare to eat more than usual.

name: Sinigang na Lapu-lapu Recipe
description: This Filipino classic fish recipe combines the rich seafood flavor of Lapu-lapu with the "asim-kilig" flavors of Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok.
tips: Remember to reduce the heat to simmer before adding the fish to keep the water to a gentle boil, this will protect the fish from over cooking and crumbling.

ingredients.item: pc. radish, sliced into ½-inch thick rounds
(20g) pack Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original

instructions: Begin by getting a big pot and placing your onions, tomatoes and rice washing (hugas bigas) in. Let this boil then reduce the heat to simmer for 8 minutes before gently placing the fish inside.
Add the chilli, okra, radish, and Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original next. Simmer until the fish is cooked through.
Finally, you just need to add the kangkong leaves on top, simmer for a minute and that’s our dish! Just adjust the seasoning if it still needs more salt.
When you come home from a tiring day of school or work, Sinigang na Lapu Lapu will definitely make you feel better because it’s a feel-good soup!

name: Sinigang na Pork Chops Recipe
description: This classic dish uses the rich taste of Knorr marinated pork chops combined with the tangy and "asim kilig" flavors of Knorr Sinigang Mix.
tips: Tamarind (Sampalok) contains lots of antioxidants and anti-inflammatory properties that help reduce the risks of heart disease, cancer and diabetes.

ingredients.item: (20g) pack Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original
pc. radish, cut into ½-inch thick rounds

instructions: You can begin by flavoring the pork chops with Knorr Liquid Seasoning and black pepper. Let the pork marinate for at least 10 mins to infuse all the rich flavor.
Now, grab a pan and make it nice and hot over high heat. Pour some oil and cook the pork chops until brown.
In another pot, bring the rice washing or the “hugas bigas” into a boil together with the onions and tomatoes. Adding the pork chops. Then, bring this to a simmer until the pork is tender.

For the next step, drop in the chilli, Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original, radish and okra and give this another 2 minutes. Now, top the sinigang with the kangkong and leave it for another minute to cook. Finally, you are done!
This recipe gives you a new way to enjoy your sinigang without being too overly adventurous. Truly, it gets better and better every time!

name: Crispy Ribs Sinigang Recipe
description: This dish uses the rich flavor of pork ribs marinated in fresh herbs and Knorr seasoning, served paired with a savory and tangy Knorr Sinigang soup.
tips: Remember to remove the scum from the surface of the water when boiling the ribs, to ensure your soup will be nice and clear. This process is called skimming.

ingredients.item: 1⁄2 kg. pork or beef ribs, cut into serving pcs.
Whole egg, beaten as needed flour as needed
(20g) pack Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original
1⁄2 pc. radish, cut into 1⁄2-inch thick rounds

instructions: Begin by getting a pot and fill it with rice washing (hugas bigas). In goes the onions and tomatoes. Let this boil then reduce the heat to simmer then add the ribs. Let this simmer until ribs are tender. Remove the ribs from the pot then pat it dry. Keep the broth for the soup preparations.
Season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning before dipping in egg and coating with flour. Deep-fry in a preheated saucepan filled with oil and cook until crispy.
Starting with 1 cup of ribs broth (where the ribs were tenderized), add chili, Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original, and radish and bring this to a boil then simmer for 2 minutes.
Gently add kangkong and simmer for a minute more.

Season broth according to taste and with a serving of crispy ribs on the side, that’s our dish. Imagine hot steaming rice swimming in sinigang broth and crispy ribs to match it, truly a glimpse of heaven!

name: Sinigang na Lechon Kawali Recipe
description: This dish combines the sour and tangy flavors of tamarind soup mixed with fresh vegetables and the crispy texture of the Pork Belly.
tips: Tamarind contains a lot of antioxidants and anti-inflammatory properties that help protect against diseases such as heart disease, cancer and diabetes. Studies show that it can also lower blood pressure and help in losing body weight.

ingredients.item: rice washing (add more if needed) (hugas bigas)
Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original
radish, cut into ½-inch thick rounds

instructions: In a large pot, we start by combining the rice waching ("hugas bigas”), onions and tomatoes. Bring this slowly to a boil and then lower the heat to a simmer for 8 minutes to release the aroma and flavors.
For the next step, throw in the chilli, Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original, radish, and okra. Bring these to a boil, then you may lower the temp to continue simmer for 2 minutes.
Finally, add the cooked cubed lechon kawali and kangkong go in to the pot. Give this a good minute to simmer and it’s done! Taste and season with additional salt and pepper if needed.
This is another winning dish you need to try at home. All you need is a platter full of rice! Yum!

name: Surf and Turf Sinigang Recipe
description: This dish combines the flavors of seafood and meat mixed with the fresh flavors of vegetables, combined in a sour soup broth.
tips: You can add Malunggay leaves to the soup to give it more freshness and boost the nutrients of the dish.

ingredients.item: rice washing (hugas bigas) or plain water

instructions: Begin by boiling rice washing (hugas bigas) in a pot filled with onions, tomatoes, green chilli and gabi. Cook until gabi is tender.
Gently add the shrimp, maya-maya and Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Original. Let this simmer until cooked through.
Now drop in the radish, okra, and long beans. Let these simmer for a minute then add pork sukiyaki and kangkong last. Cover for a minute and that’s our dish!
Surf and Turf Sinigang is for everybody who wants either seafood or meat or both combined. Whatever the preference is, this is home!

name: Roasted Apple Chicken with Cinnamon Glaze Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Roasted Apple Chicken with Cinnamon Glaze | Knorr
instructions: Begin by preparing the glaze. First, combine the butter, honey, cinnamon, lemon zest, cane vinegar and apple juice in a saucepan. Bring this to a boil over high heat before cooking it to a simmer over low heat, until the sauce is thick. Brush the apples with this mixture and set this aside. Reserve the remaining cinnamon glaze for later use.
Now, it’s time to flavour the chicken by rubbing it with the mashed Knorr Chicken Broth Cubes together with the pepper, rosemary, and thyme.

In a baking dish, arrange the chicken pieces and glazed apples with a drizzle of oil on top. Bake this in a 375F oven until the chicken is cooked through. Transfer to a serving plate with more cinnamon glaze on top.
Your family will surely be delighted and will definitely thank you for it when they see something as fancy as this being prepared for them with love.

name: Corned Beef Sisig Salad Recipe
description: This unique salad topping recipe uses the flavorful taste of corned beef, fried until crisp; mixed with mayo salad dressing infused with Knorr Seasoning.
tips: Corned beef is an excellent source of protein, vitamin B12, and iron, but it also contains a high percentage of sodium.

ingredients.item: corned beef, flaked and drained from liquid
as needed preferred salad vegetables, sliced

instructions: Get a pan and make it nice and hot over low heat. Cook corned beef in hot oil and mix from time to time until dry and crispy (you may also cook this in an oven until dry and flaky).
Get another pan and sauté onions and garlic for a minute. Add corned beef flakes and stir well.
Now let's prepare the dressing. All you have to do is combine mayonnaise, sesame oil and Knorr Liquid Seasoning.

Toss greens and vegetables with the dressing, arrange on plate with the crispy corned beef on top. And that's it! Serve this with your favorite soup or sandwich or eat it as a snack. You will feel great the entire day!. Serve this with your favourite soup or sandwich or eat it as a snack. You will feel great the entire day!.

name: Herb Baked Fish Fillet with Creamy Corn Sauce
description: This recipe uses the fresh seafood taste of Dory fillet coated in spices and herbs, baked with butter and garlic, served topped with creamy corn sauce.
tips: Dory Fillet is a good source of Omega-3 fatty acids and anti-inflammatory nutrients. One of the main benefits of eating Dory, are the benefits of maintaining healthy eyes.

ingredients.item: g. young corn pre- cooked and sliced into two
(80g) Knorr Cream of Corn Soup (prepared according to package directions: simmered until thick - sauce consistency)

instructions: Begin by seasoning the fish fillet in a combination of thyme and oregano. Transfer to a baking dish and set aside.

Next, get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Melt some butter and throw in the garlic. Sauté until the garlic is brown. Pour the sautéed garlic butter sauce on top of the fish and bake this in a preheated oven of 375F until the fish is cooked through.

Let’s proceed by getting those side dishes ready. Start by getting another pan and making it nice and hot. Over medium heat, pour some oil and throw in the beans, young corn, and bell pepper and sauté until cooked through. Sprinkle some seasoning over.

Here’s a fancy way to present your dish to your family! Place some of the sautéed vegetables on a platter and place the baked fish fillets on top. Pour Knorr Cream of Corn Soup over it and that’s our dish! When you see something as appetizing and fancy as this, you will definitely thank your mom for it! This dish is simply made with love!When you see something as appetizing and fancy as this, you will definitely thank your mom for it! This dish is simply made with love!

name: Pan-Grilled Porkchops Recipe
description: This simple dish uses the rich taste of pork chops marinated in the oregano, thyme, pepper and the flavors of Knorr Seasoning; pan grilled to perfection.
tips: In pan-grilling your meat, make sure that the pan you’re using has a heavy bottom base. If your pan is too thin, your meat will burn easily.

ingredients.item: kg. pork chops ½ inch thick slices
tsp. fresh oregano, chopped (optional) or ¼ tsp dried oregano leaves
tsp. fresh thyme, chopped (optional) or 1/4tsp dried thyme leaves

instructions: To bring out the best flavor out of pork chops, carefully place the meat in a ziplock or a heavy duty food-grade plastic bag, add in the Knorr Liquid Seasoning, black pepper, and herbs. Make sure the plastic bag where you put the meat in is compressed and sealed like a vacuum to remove the air bubbles. Massage the meat in the plastic bag and watch as it begins to become fully coated with the ingredients you’ve mixed in. This technique allows you to save on the amount of marinade and also saves storage space.

Now, you can preheat your grill pan. Brush the pan’s surface gently with a little bit of oil to help prevent the meat from sticking to the pan. Then, lay the meat slice on the pan. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes per side or until the meat is firm in the center.
That’s it! So simple and oh so delicious! You may also serve this with a dipping sauce of Knorr Liquid Seasoning, vinegar, diced white onions and chopped chilli. And don’t forget the rice!

name: Char Siu Ribs Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich taste of pork marinated in Char Siu sauce and Knorr Liquid Seasoning, slowly roasted topped with butter and herbs.
tips: The recommended way to make sure that your ribs are fall off the bone tender is to bake them, covered, at a low temperature in your oven. Baking low and slow is our secret to fall off the bone oven-baked ribs.
instructions: This no fuss barbecue recipe cooks in an instant. All you have to do is to season the pork ribs with Knorr Liquid seasoning and add the Char Siu sauce, herbs and pepper in. Let this stand for an hour in the chiller or best marinate it overnight.

Just when you’re about to bake the ribs, drizzle melted butter and sesame oil on top. Then, you may proceed in slow cooking the ribs in a pre-heated 250 F oven for 2 hours or until the meat falls off the bone.
Your family will truly fall in love with this fall-off-the-bone goodness. So simple to do and tastes very delicious too!

name: Chicken Pepper Stir-Fry Recipe
description: This quick Asian Chicken recipe uses the rich flavors of chicken breast fillet combined with the fresh flavors of bell peppers and onions, and Knorr seasoning.
tips: Sesame oil contains sesamol and sesaminol, two antioxidants that may have powerful effects on your health and heart health.

ingredients.item: kg. chicken breast fillet, cut into cubes

instructions: Begin by firing up your stove into high and heat up your skillet. Throw in the onions and garlic and sauté in oil for a few minutes. Drop in the peppers and cook until you can smell the aroma from the cooked vegetables.

Toss the chicken breast fillet into the pan and cook until half cooked. Flavor the chicken and peppers with Knorr Liquid Seasoning and black pepper. Taste after cooking it some more to check the seasoned meat.
Finish by pouring in sesame oil over the dish. This will give it a nice aroma and nutty flavour.
Please your family by adding one last touch to the dish. With an extra sprinkle of toasted sesame seeds, your family will know for sure that it was a labor of love.

name: Stuffed Tempura with Wasabi Mayo Dip Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich seafood flavors of shrimp with crab fat stuffing infused with Knorr shrimp flavors, coated and fried, served with Wasabi Mayo dip.
tips: You can easily devein a shrimp using a toothpick or a pairing knife. Insert the toothpick or skewer between the shell gaps through the back of the shrimp, then at an angle, try to remove the back vein by lifting it out.

ingredients.item: pcs. tiger prawns, shelled with tail intact
pc. Knorr Shrimp Broth Cubes, mashed

instructions: First, let's prepare the shrimp by deveining it and making a slit along the bottom side of the prawns to create pockets.
Next, combine pesto sauce, mashed Knorr Shrimp Cube and crabmeat in a bowl and mix well. Spoon the mixture into the prawn pockets and press well.
For the next step, coat the prawns with flour, shaking off any excess. Place in the ref for at least 15 minutes to set.

Now that we have the stuffed prawn ready, let’s make the tempura batter. Just mix together flour, cold water and egg until smooth. Dip the stuffed prawns in the batter and deep-fry in a preheat oil until they are crisp and brown. Remove the prawns and just place on top of a plate lined with paper towels.

Tempura won’t be complete without the dipping sauce. Combine all the ingredients for the dipping sauce, mix well and that’s our dish! Serve Stuffed Tempura with Mayo Wasabi Dip as an appetizer, salad, sandwich or main dish. The possibilities are endless because this dish is truly addicting!

name: Crispy Tofu Sisig Recipe
description: A very healthy and heart friendly dish. It combines health benefits of Tofu and spicy tastes of chilis, mixed with the creamy texture of the added Mayonnaise.
tips: Tofu is a great source of protein, animo acids, iron and calcium. Tofu is derived from Soya proteins, and is said to help lower levels of bad cholesterol.

ingredients.item: tofu cut into small cubes, (1/2 inch)

instructions: Begin by getting a shallow pan and fill it with cooking oil. Place your heat to high and when small bubbles appear, deep fry the tofu cubes until brown and crisp.
Get a separate pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Sauté onion and garlic in oil and drop the fried tofu and chilies next. Toss and mix well.
Add Knorr Liquid Seasoning according to your taste. Turn off the heat and add Lady's Choice Mayonnaise and mix well.
Serve with calamansi and egg (optional) and that’s our dish! All you need is a big serving of rice because you will definitely eat more than usual.

name: Spiced Pumpkin Cream Soup Recipe
description: This heart healthy dish uses the sweet taste of pumkin, infused with Knorr Beef flavros, simmered in the creamy Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay.
tips: A pumpkin soup recipe doesn’t need to be complicated. In fact, you can quickly prepare a bowl of creamy pumpkin soup with only three key ingredients. And the best part? You can do this in under thirty minutes!

ingredients.item: pc. pumpkin, small, cut into cubes
(33g) pack Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay

instructions: Heat a medium-sized pot over medium heat. Pour in oil and sauté onions and garlic until fragrant.
Add the pumpkin and let it sweat for one minute over high heat. Pour just enough water to submerge the pumpkin into the pot and bring to a boil.
Add Knorr Beef Cubes, and let simmer for about 20 minutes until the pumpkin is tender.
Using an immersion blender, puree the mixture until smooth. Alternatively, you transfer the mixture into a heatproof blender to puree until smooth. Then, put the mixture back into the pot.
Add Knorr Cream of Pumpkin Soup and stir well. Simmer for one minute.
Turn the heat off and pour the cream into the soup. Season with cinnamon and pepper to taste and stir.

name: Pesto Crusted Lamb Chops Recipe
description: This quick and simple dish uses the rich and deep flavor of lamb chops marinated with Knorr Beef flavors, coated and covered with the fresh pesto crumbles.
tips: Pesto is packed with antioxidants thanks to the ingredients like basil and garlic. These help you reduce chronic illnesses and help normalize your blood pressure.
instructions: Would you believe that something as classy and sophisticated as this dish is so easy to prepare? Begin by just rubbing the lamb chops with Knorr Beef Cubes and Knorr Liquid Seasoning evenly. Give this a nice seasoning of salt and pepper.

Prepare 3 shallow trays containing flour, egg and breadcrumbs with pesto sauce that has been mixed well. Now, dip the lamb chops in flour first. Shake off the excess then dip in beaten egg. Lastly, coat the lamb with the breadcrumbs mixture then place in a baking pan.
Bake in a preheated 450 F oven for 6-8 minutes or until done. And that’s our dish. With a glass of wine, bread, potatoes and some salad on the side, eat in style!

name: Paella Marinara Recipe
description: This Spanish traditional rice dish uses the sweet flavors of sautéed vegetables, combined with the rich seafood flavors of shrimps, mussels and squid.
tips: Saffron is the world's most expensive spice because each saffron flower is hand-picked to collect just three stigmas per flower, so be very careful in using this ingredient in your recipe.
instructions: First, prepare a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion and garlic and just sauté until the vegetables give off a nice aroma. Add the tomato paste next then the Knorr Shrimp Cubes. Mash and stir well.

Toss in the green and red bell pepper then allow these to sweat for a minute before adding the rice. Stir well then gradually pour the water and saffron. Just stir and bring this to boil then reduce heat to simmer.

At this point, you need to cover your pan with foil to trap the steam inside and allow the rice to cook evenly without reducing the liquid or drying out the liquid. Your rice should be done in 15 to 20 minutes.
Once the rice is almost done, arrange the seafood on top together with the peas. Cover the pan with the foil and cook until done. Check after 5 - 10 minutes more.

Serve Paella Marinara with quartered egg and lemon wedges and that’s our dish! How can anyone not love Paella especially when it’s topped with different seafood meats? Your family will definitely insist that you cook this more often!

name: Chicken Arroz Caldo Recipe
description: No matter the weather, enjoy the comfort of a good chicken arroz caldo recipe. Learn to infuse the flavor of chicken with ginger and other aromatics.
tips: The name of the dish is derived from Spanish "arroz"" (rice) and "caldo" (broth). Arroz Caldo is a specific type of Lugaw which uses a lot of ginger and chicken.Arroz Caldo typically uses Malagkit rice, but you can still prepare this dish using regular rice just add more water in the recipe.The yellowish color of the dish can be attained by adding Kasubha (safflower) to the dish. "

ingredients.item: uncooked Malagkit rice, washed 2x and drained well

instructions: Begin by preparing a large pot that’s big enough to cook the rice. Turn up the heat, add oil and throw in the garlic and sauté until lightly toasted. Add the onions and ginger and continue sautéing.

Add the shredded chicken breast. Toss the mixture and wait until you smell the lovely aroma from the cooked vegetables and chicken. At this stage, you can take out the large pieces of chicken and shred them to smaller pieces to release more flavour, and create a different texture to the dish.
Add the Malagkit rice to the mix and sauté until rice is covered with oil. When the mixture begins to sizzle, pour the water and bring this to a boil before adding the Knorr Chicken Broth Cubes.
Cook the malagkit rice slowly over low fire while stirring frequently to avoid the rice from clumping together.
Topping your arroz caldo with fried garlic and spring onions does not only give it a lovely presentation but it also adds depth of flavour.
Serve this hot in a big bowl. A small cup filled with patis and some calamansi in another plate are just some extra touches you can add to make this dish a favourite in the family.
Chicken Arroz Caldo is best served with Lumpiang Togue.

name: Baked Chicken Sinigang Recipe
description: This dish infuses the sinigang flavor with the Knorr seasoning marinate into chicken, mixing it with fresh herbs, potatoes and tomatoes, baked to perfection
tips: To boost the flavor of the chicken, keep it marinate chilled overnight before baking.

ingredients.item: (1 pack) Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original, as needed
pc. lemon, sliced into rounds or wedges
medium-sized potatoes, cut into wedges, seasoned

instructions: To bring out the best flavour out of the chicken, carefully place the chicken cut ups in a heavy duty food-grade plastic bag. Add in the Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original, pepper, and Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Make sure the plastic bag where you put the meat in is compressed and sealed like a vacuum to remove the air bubbles. Massage the chicken in the plastic bag and watch as it begins to become fully coated with the ingredients you’ve mixed in. This technique allows you to save on the amount of marinade and also saves storage space. Let this stand in the chiller for an hour.

The next step is to arrange the marinated chicken with the potatoes, tomatoes, and lemongrass in a baking dish. Sprinkle and squeeze a bit of lemon juice on top of the chicken and vegetables and throw in the rind in the baking dish. To give this dish more flavour, sprinkle evenly with chopped fresh oregano. If no fresh oregano is available, you may use 1/2 teaspoon of dried oregano.
Bake this in a 350 F pre-heated oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.
With baked chicken served as a weeknight dinner or as a lunch meal, mom surely knows how to take care of her family.

name: Chicken Teriyaki Recipe
description: This dish is combines the rich flavor of chicken combined with the ginger infused soy based sauce which gives it a balanced taste of salty and sweetness.
tips: Teriyaki is a Japanese cooking technique which refer to food being broiled or grilled topped with a glaze of soy sauce, mirin and sugar.
instructions: This no fuss teriyaki dish can be easily made with only a few simple steps. You just need to combine the Knorr Chicken Cube, ginger, soy sauce, rice wine, brown sugar and sesame oil. Mix everything thoroughly before adding the chicken pieces. Leave this for 30 minutes to infuse the flavour.
Fire up your pan to high and pour a little amount of oil before frying the chicken. When the chicken turns brown, pour the marinade mixture and cook slowly in low heat.
Remove the chicken from the sauce once it is cooked through and transfer to a serving plate.
Remember the sauce and just keep on cooking it until the mixture becomes thick. Pour this on top of your chicken and finish with a sprinkle of toasted sesame seeds on top.
Enjoy this “go to” take out meal anytime at home.

name: Lemon Chicken Recipe
description: The secret to this dish is having the right flavors and blends in the marinade. It contains the rich flavors of Sesame oil, Lemon, Honey and fresh spices.
tips: You can add that "Asian" twist to this dish by using Sesame Oil. Sesame oil is very fragrant and flavourful so make sure that you don't add to much to your chicken marinade.

ingredients.item: kg. chicken leg and thigh, cut into serving pcs.

instructions: To prepare a more flavourful dish, you must first break the Knorr Chicken cubes until you achieve a sand-like texture using either your hands or a fork. Then, rub this evenly unto the chicken pieces.
For the next step, you’ve got to pour in the lemon juice, garlic, lemon zest, chives, sesame oil, honey and pepper. Let this stand to marinate for an hour and then drain. Reserve the marinade.

Transfer the chicken into a greased baking pan with a drizzle of canola or olive oil on top. Sprinkle the lemon rind before baking in a 425 F oven. Cook this until the juices from the chicken come out clear.
Transfer to a platter with some chopped chives on top. Now, the wait is over because the chicken wings are done! Truly refreshing and addicting!

name: Chap Chae
description: This dish will have a perfect balance of sweet and savory flavors, mixed with the bouncy texture of its glass noodles combined with stir fried vegetables.
tips: Korean noodles are naturally fat free and low in calories, yet they are full in flavor and can create nice textures to your dish.

ingredients.item: g. sweet potato or mung bean noodles, soaked in hot water until al dente and drained

instructions: Get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and saute onion and garlic until aromatic. Add light soy sauce, sesame oil, brown sugar, and Knorr Beef Cubes. Mix well.
Add carrots, beef, and mushroom. Saute for half a minute.

Add noodles and spinach. Stir well. Adjust seasonings if desired. Serve on a platter and top with toasted sesame seeds. No need to spend and go to a resto to enjoy this famous Korean dish. Cook and serve ChapChae anytime you please. It's easy and delicious! No need to spend and go to a resto to enjoy this famous Korean dish. Cook and serve ChapChae anytime you please. It's easy and delicious!

name: Chicken Tinola Recipe (Filipino Tinolang Manok)
description: Tinolang manok is a staple in Filipino homes and reflects the country’s love for simple, nourishing food. It relies on affordable ingredients yet delivers deep comfort in every spoonful. Follow this chicken tinola recipe to prepare a warm, nourishing meal your family will love.
instructions: Sauté the Aromatics Heat a pot over medium heat, then add oil. Add onions, garlic, and ginger. Sauté for about 2 minutes or until fragrant and slightly softened.
Brown the Chicken Add chicken pieces to the pot and sear on all sides until the skin is lightly browned. Work in batches if needed to avoid overcrowding.

Simmer the Broth Pour in the water and add the Knorr Chicken Broth cubes. Stir to dissolve, then bring to a gentle simmer until the chicken becomes tender and fully cooked. Tip: Skim off any foam that rises to the surface to keep the broth clear.
Cook the Vegetables Add the sayote or green papaya and cook until tender but not mushy. Tip: The vegetables are ready when you can easily pierce them with a fork.

Finish with the Greens Add the malunggay leaves and simmer for 1 minute or just until wilted. Serve hot. Tip: Malunggay is rich in vitamins and minerals and is often enjoyed by nursing moms and children; you can also use dahon ng sili as an alternative.

name: Paella Tinola Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich flavor of chicken infused with fresh flavors of ginger and garlic cooked in a Spanish-style paella dish.
tips: If you don’t have a paellera pan, you may use an ordinary skillet that’s big enough to hold 2 cups of rice and 4 cups of water. Monitor the heat so you get an even cooking at the bottom of the large pan.

ingredients.item: kg. whole chicken, cut into serving pcs.
water or as needed (you may also use rice washing)
pc. small green papaya, cut into wedges

instructions: Set your paellera pan into medium high heat and brush it with a little oil. Drop in the onions, garlic and half of the ginger and sauté slowly for about 2 minutes or until you can smell the lovely aroma of the thoroughly cooked vegetables.
Sprinkle patis over the chicken then massage well to coat the meat. Add this to the hot paellera and cook until the chicken is light brown in color.

Add the rice and let is sauté with the chicken. To make sure that your paella won’t come out soggy or mushy, ensure that the rice that you have added is being fully coated with the hot oil as you continue stirring and sautéing it.

Next, prepare the broth liquid by boiling 5 cups of water with 2 pieces of Knorr Chicken Cubes. Allow this to cool down before measuring and using the right amount of liquid for your paella. Pour in the chicken broth and allow this to boil before adding half of the ginger. Give this a good stir. This method will allow your rice to be cooked al dente.
Monitor the heat so the entire pan cooks evenly. You know that you have cooked a good paella when a crust is formed at the bottom (this is called “socarrat.”)

Paella is not complete without those lovely and delicious toppings. Spread the rice evenly as they are cooked and then arrange the chicken pieces, papaya and sili leaves on top. Bring the broth to a boil then lower the heat.

To fully cook the paella, it is best to cover the pan with aluminium foil and continue to cook for about 15-20 minutes over low-medium heat. Your family will surely be delighted and will definitely thank you for it when they see something as fancy as this being prepared for them with love.

name: Fish Tinola with Lemongrass Recipe
description: This delicious and relaxing dish uses the rich seafood taste of fish combined with the refreshing ginger and lemongrass broth soup.
tips: Lemongrass is packed with a lot of vitamins and minerals, and it is a great source of antioxidants, which help reduce diseases.

ingredients.item: tanglad, white ends only, washed properly

instructions: Begin by getting a pot and then filling it with water. Throw in the tomatoes, ginger, tanglad, sili, onion and Knorr Fish Broth Cubes. Let this simmer for at least 3 – 5 minutes before gently adding the fish. Fish cooks quickly so make sure you do not over-cook. Check after 8 minutes if the fish is already done.
Add pechay next followed by the spring onions. Adjust seasoning if needed. Finally, that’s our dish!
Here’s a dish that will remind you of how your mom likes to serve you only the best. It’s good for the soul, warms the heart and soothes your stomach. This is home!

name: Baked Macaroni Recipe
description: This kiddie favorite dish combines the rich flavor of beef, vegetable aromatics and the creamy tomato sauce, topped with a generous amounts of cheese.
tips: You can add flavor and texture to this dish by adding mushrooms, herbs or some bacon bits. You can also add a little parmesan cheese on top of each serving to add more cheese flavor to each plate.
instructions: Get your pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion and garlic. Add ground beef, cook until color changes before dropping the Knorr Beef Broth Cube. Once beef is cooked, add liver spread.
Pour the spaghetti sauce and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer until the sauce is thick.
You may now add the cheese at this point and simmer until the cheese melts and stir in the all-purpose cream for that creamy goodness.
Toss in the cooked macaroni, mix well with the sauce and just adjust the seasonings if necessary.
Transfer the pasta into a baking dish, top with grated mozzarella and bake in an oven or oven toaster until the cheese melts.
This classic merienda dish will make your family crave for it more often once they try it! Be the hero of your home with this recipe for it sure is a winner!

name: Baked Potatoes--Made Easy Recipe
description: This simple recipe will surely be a crowd favorite. It uses the rich flavor of potatoes combined with the cream and cheese, topped with bacon bits.
tips: To prevent the potatoes skin from getting soggy, after cleaning and rinsing the potatoes, make sure that you dry them up properly before baking.

ingredients.item: pcs. large potatoes, skin on, washed and scrubbed water, as needed

instructions: Get a pot and fill it with water. Add the potatoes whole and cook until very tender. Drain from liquid and place on paper towels.
Slice potatoes into half lengthwise. Using a spoon, carefully scoop the potatoes making cup-shaped potato skins, around 1/2 inch thick.
Place the scooped portions in a bowl and mash it well.
Add Knorr Beef Cubes, cream and, butter. Mix well.
Adjust seasonings and add the mixture to the cups topped with cheese and bacon bits (optional).
Bake this in an oven or oven toaster until cheese melts. See how your guests or family get excited when you serve Baked Potatoes Made Easy! It's delicious!

name: Beef and Broccoli Recipe
description: This dish balances the rich flavors of beef combined with the fresh flavors of broccoli, served in a thick and savory sauce.
tips: Broccoli is considered a super food due to the fact that it's a good source of cancer fighting compounds.
instructions: Get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and saute onion and garlic until aromatic. Add beef and cook this on high heat for 2-3 minutes. Take out beef from pan to avoid overcooking. .
Add water into pan and bring to a boil before adding the Knorr Beef Cubes, oyster sauce and broccoli. Stir well and simmer for a minute.

Pour in slurry (cornstarch dissolved in water) and let simmer until sauce is thick then toss cooked beef back into pan. Adjust seasonings according to taste. No need to go for Chinese take out to enjoy Beef and Broccoli, for at the comforts of your home, you can serve this anytime you please.

name: Beef Salpicao Recipe
description: This classic Spanish tapas dish combines the rich flavor of beef cutlets with the strong aromatic taste of garlic and chili. Best served with Beef Steak rice.
tips: This dish is best served with a lot of garlic, both as marinate and as toppings. Garlic is often referred as a wonder drug due to it's medicinal properties, which include the prevention of a range of illnesses from common colds to heart attacks.

ingredients.item: beef sirloin, fat trimmed, cut into cubes (cut fat into small cubes and set aside)
cooked rice (cold day old rice is best)

instructions: Here’s something that you will never get tired of eating and cooking. It’s easy and very delicious too. All you need to do is marinate the beef in garlic, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, and pepper for 10 to 15 minutes.
Get your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some canola oil or butter and sauté the garlic until toasted.
Drain beef from marinade then add into hot pan. Reserve marinade. Cook beef for 2-3 minutes.
Pour marinade in pan. Toss in the chilli next then sauté for another minute. Transfer beef into a plate.

In the same pan, toast beef fat until brown and crisp. Add butter and toss in cooked rice and season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning and ground black pepper. Serve with beef salpicao while warm. You can never have enough of Beef Salpicao. It brings comfort any time and any day of the week.

name: Callos Recipe
description: This traditional Spanish dish combines the rich taste of beef tripe mixed with flavorful chorizo cooked in tomato sauce with garbanzos, potatoes and carrots.
tips: When boiling and cleaning the tripe, you can consider adding a dash of lime or calamansi to further reduce the tripe's smell to make it more manageable.

ingredients.item: Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Kaldereta, dissolved in
black pepper, chili flakes or paprika, to taste

instructions: Let’s begin by first removing the foul smell/impurities from tripe by soaking it in water with baking soda for 2 hours then boiling it in water with vinegar or calamansi. After this, you can discard the liquid.

After removing the impurities, pour in 4 to 8 cups of water and Knorr Beef Cube. Just bring this to a boil and let this simmer until the meat is very tender (You may also add fresh garlic and black peppercorns to the boiling water). Once tender, remove the meat and set aside.

In a separate pot, throw in the onions and sauté until translucent. Gently place the tripe in and the chorizo de bilbao. Sauté the meats for a minute before adding the dissolved Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Kaldereta. You’ve got to bring this to a boil and simmer slowly until the sauce is thick.
You may now add the garbanzos or your other vegetables, adjust the seasoning, and then that’s our dish!
You ‘ll keep coming back for more Callos especially when you serve it with bread or rice. It’s delicious!

name: Chicken Inasal
description: Craving a taste of Bacolod? This nutri-sarap chicken inasal recipe will take you on a gastronomic adventure. Try it now!
tips: Basting refers to the process of pouring melted fat or the meat juices over the meat during cooking to prevent the dish from drying and seal its moisture.

ingredients.item: 1⁄2 kg chicken, cut into serving pcs.
lemongrass (tanglad), pounded and sliced 4 tbsp brown sugar

instructions: It is true that the simplest of dishes are the most delicious. For example, we have this Chicken Inasal recipe which can be made with only 2 steps. Place the chicken pieces in a food grade plastic container along with the cane vinegar, garlic, ginger, lemongrass, sugar, anatto oil, and Knorr Chicken Cube. Mix this well and leave in the chiller to develop the flavours overnight.
This Inasal recipe is not only easy to make but it is also flexible. You have the option of grilling this over hot coal or pan-frying it over stove top while basting it in its own sauce.
Make your family’s hearts sing and smile when you cook this no fuss Chicken Inasal meal at the comfort of your own home.

name: Chicken Lemongrass Skewers Recipe
description: This dish uses the rich flavor of chicken infused with garlic, pepper and Knorr cubes, grilled in lemongrass skewers; paired with Knorr peanut sauce.
tips: To prevent the lemongrass stalks from burning from the grill, you can soak them in cold water 30 minutes before using, so it can absorb moisture before grilling.

ingredients.item: kg. chicken breast, skin removed cut into serving pcs.
Achuete oil (2 tbsp oil with 1 tbsp achuete seeds), as needed
Lemongrass stalks (use the bottom white part, around 5-6 inches in length)

instructions: First, you need to prepare the achuete oil by extracting the color of atsuete. Begin by combining 2 tablespoons of oil with 1 tablespoon of atsuete in a sauté pan. Turn the heat to low-medium and leave the seeds to cook. Discard the seeds once it turns dark in color.

In a heavy duty food-grade plastic bag, place the chicken pieces together with the mashed Knorr Chicken Cubes, achuete oil, garlic and pepper. Massage the chicken in the plastic and seal it well, making sure that no air bubbles go inside.

Next, prepare the peanut dip. Get a saucepan and pour the Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Kare-Kare and add water. Stir using a whisk or fork to make sure it’s free of lumps. When fully dissolved, cook this on high heat until the liquid begins to boil. Turn the heat to low and continue to simmer until the mixture is very thick. Transfer and pour the sauce into a condiment bowl and garnish with chopped peanuts on top.

Time to complete and assemble the dish. Skew the chicken pieces into the lemongrass stalks by piercing a hole through the meat with the use of the knife’s tip. Place on top of a grill and cook until chicken is tender and done.
Going the extra mile for your family will bring you more happy memories around the table. Chicken in Lemongrass Skewers is definitely best served with peanut sauce on the side.
categories: KNORR COMPLETE RECIPE MIX KARE KARE

name: Crispy Pompano Recipe with 3 Sauces
description: This simple yet delicious dish uses the fresh taste of Pompano fish infused with the great flavor of Knorr seasoning served with three types of unique sauces.
tips: Before frying the fish, pat dry the fish to remove the excess water and moisture from the fish to prevent the hot oil from splattering.

ingredients.item: diced ripe mango mixed with 1 tsp chopped coriander
Knorr Liquid Seasoning with calamansi and siling labuyo (optional)

instructions: Do you know how easy this dish is that you can actually cook this weekly at home? You just need to season the fish with a mixture of Knorr Liquid Seasoning, calamansi juice and black pepper and that’s it! Pan-fry in hot oil until cooked through and serve with your choice of sauce.

Serve all three condiments and decide later on which one is your favourite. Mango coriander, sweet chili sauce, or Knorr Liquid Seasoning! This dish will definitely put a smile on your face! And here’s another secret: our bet for best sauce is Knorr Liquid Seasoning!

name: Crispy Tinapa Rolls Recipe
description: This dish uses the rich and salty flavor of tinapa flakes mixed with diced vegetables infused with Knorr seasoning, wrapped and fried for that crispy texture.
tips: After cooking the tinapa stuffing, you can place the fish in your chiller to cool down the meat. It will be easier for you to scoop and shape the meat before placing them in the lumpia wrapper.

ingredients.item: Knorr Liquid Seasoning ground black pepper

instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion and garlic and just sauté until toasted. Gently add the carrots and tinapa flakes in and give this a minute to cook.
Pour in the Knorr Liquid Seasoning and mix this well. Remove from heat and set aside to cool down.
Now, place a spoonful of the mixture in the lumpia wrapper, roll into a log and seal with a flour-water mixture or beaten egg.

Deep-fry in hot oil until brown and crisp. Drain on a plate lined with paper towels and that’s our dish! You will definitely eat more than usual when your mom serves you Crispy Tinapa Rolls. This recipe will surely keep you coming back for more!

name: Dinakdakan Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Dinakdakan made special with Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Prepare a perfect healthy meal for your family.
tips: When boiling the pork belly, remember to skim the top of the liquid to remove the scum and impurities.

ingredients.item: pork belly (traditionally, Ilocanos use pig’s mask, nape, liver and intestines for this recipe. You may also use lean parts of pork)
mayonnaise, as needed (pork’s brain is traditionally used to mix with the meat)

instructions: Let’s begin by combining the pork belly with garlic and black peppercorns in a pot filled with water enough to cover the meat. Now, bring this to a boil over high heat then to a simmer over low heat until the pork is tender. Remember to skim the top of the liquid to remove the scum. Once the meat is tender, take the meat out and allow it to drain in a strainer.
Flavor the pork with fish sauce before frying or grilling (baking is another option) until crisp. Slice the pork into bite-sized strips.

Next, grab a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion, garlic and ginger. Add the pork strips and chilis, and season well with Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Cook until brown and crispy. For the final touch, mix the pork with mayonnaise.
You will surely be amazed at how delicious this Dinakdakan Recipe is. In fact, this might become your family’s favourite

name: Double Cheese Lasagna Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Double Cheese Lasagna made extra special with Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Kaldereta.
tips: For the noodles, its best to half cook the lasagna noodles before you lay them on the baking sheet. This will make the easier to form, and it will prevent it from overcooking after baking.

ingredients.item: Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Kaldereta dissolved in 2 cups of water
cheddar or mozzarella cheese or cheese sauce for topping

instructions: Get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and sauté onion and garlic before adding the liver spread. Stir well then add the ground beef next. Sauté until cooked through.
Add Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Kaldereta dissolved in water, cheese, and pepper.
Bring to boil then cover and simmer until sauce is thick. Add cream and mix well. Set aside.

Coat the bottom of a baking dish with the red sauce. Lay lasagna sheets then top with the red sauce. Repeat this process leaving roughly 2 inches of space on top. Top with grated cheese, and bake or toast until the top is browned and cheese is melted.
Double Cheese Lasagna! What a treat! It will make you sing the happy song.

name: Eggplant Lasagna Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich flavor and crispy texture of fried eggplant mixed with the rich taste of ground beef in tomato sauce topped with melted cheese.
tips: Eggplants are good source of in fiber which help lower blood sugar by slowing the rate of digestion and absorption of sugar in the body.

ingredients.item: Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Kaldereta, dissolved in 2 cups of water
pcs. eggplant, halved lengthwise then sliced into 3-inch lengths
beaten egg, flour and breadcrumbs, as needed
cheddar or mozzarella cheese or cheese sauce for topping

instructions: First, you need to make the sauce. Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion and garlic before adding the liver spread. Now, gently stir and add the ground beef and just sauté until cooked through.
Next, add Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Kaldereta dissolved in water, cheese, and pepper last. Let this boil and bring down the heat to a simmer then cover until the sauce thickens. Then set this aside.

We can now work on the eggplant lasagna. Prepare 3 shallow trays with the flour, egg and breadcrumbs on each tray. Coat the eggplant first with the flour mix, dip it in the beaten egg, then finally rolling it in the breadcrumbs. Once everything has been coated, allow this to rest in the chiller for at least 30 minutes just to allow the breading to set.

Prepare a deep saucepan and fill it with oil. Turn your heat to medium high and deep fry the eggplant until brown. Remove it from the oil and place it on top of a plate lined with paper towels. Now that our sauce and eggplant lasagna is done, we can start assembling.

Coat the bottom of a baking dish with the red sauce then layer the eggplants alternately with the red sauce and all purpose cream. Repeat this process with the rest of the eggplants. Finish off with grated cheese on top and just bake or toast until the top is browned and cheese is melted.
Now you can eat without the guilt because Eggplant Lasagna is not only good for you, it’s delicious too! You will surely have a party in your tummy with this truly rich and tasty recipe.

name: Grilled Liempo Recipe
description: This Filipino classic grilled recipe uses the rich taste and flavors of pork marinated and seasoned with Knorr Liquid seasoning.
