tips: When grilling meat, do not move the food around too much in the grill and try not to squeeze or flatten the meats to prevent the moisture and flavor from escaping.
instructions: To give this liempo a power punch of flavor, all you need to do is combine the pork slices in a mixture of barbecue sauce, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, calamansi juice, oil and pepper in a bowl. Now, leave this to marinate overnight.
Now, make sure you get your grill nice and hot and cook the liempo until tender.

Enjoy and share a full platter of this Grilled Liempo with Barbecue Sauce Recipe with your whole family. Pair this with your favorite condiments and you’ll surely find yourself eating even more than usual. It’s just so yummy!

name: Hainanese Chicken Recipe
description: A Hainanese chicken recipe marries the light yet delicious flavor of braised chicken with the strong taste of ginger. Learn how to create that balance.
tips: You need to cook the chicken in the ginger broth for a long period at a low temperature to make sure to keep the chicken moist and to infuse all refreshing flavors into the meat. Keep the heat to a simmer.

ingredients.item: kg. whole chicken, excess fat trimmed

instructions: Let's begin by preparing the components to flavour the chicken. In a blender, combine half of the rice wine, light soy sauce, half of the ginger and spring onions. Process this into a puree and rub this inside the cavity of the chicken. If you don’t have a blender, you may use a mortar and pestle. You just need to pound and mash well until all the mixture is well combined. Leave this in the chiller to infuse the flavour.

Prepare a large pot filled with 8 cups of water and bring this to a boil. Throw in Knorr Chicken Cubes and the remaining half of the ginger and spring onions and bring this to a boil until the cubes dissolve. Stir well, turn off the heat, and gently slide the chicken into the pot. Let this stand for 30 - 45 minutes while covered.

After 30- 45 minutes, remove the chicken and then bring the stock to a boil again. Turn off the heat then add the chicken back. Let this stand for another 30 minutes while covered. Remove the chicken and allow it to cool. Reserve the stock and set it aside.

For that added flavour, you need to prepare a rub made with a combination of sesame oil and the remaining light soy sauce. Spread this around the chicken before slicing it into serving pieces. Pour some of the reserved stock to make it more moist.

Bragging rights begin now when you serve this with a side of Bango Kecap Manis, chili sauce, and ginger sauce. It’s a trophy dish waiting to be devoured by your family, especially when you go that extra mile by serving it with chicken rice.

name: Hamburger Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Hamburger. A filipino family favorite merienda made extra special with Knorr Beef Cubes. Serve it today.
tips: When cooking the burger patties, try not to press down or squeeze the patties too much to prevent the flavors and juices from the meat to escape.

ingredients.item: Optional: Burger sandwich components: Sauteed Enoki Mushrooms, Sauteed spinach cheese slices red cabbage coleslaw

instructions: Do you know how easy it is to make these patties? You must simply combine all the ingredients in a bowl, adding more flour if you want, then shaping them into balls. Flatten into 1 1⁄2-inch thick patties and smoothen the surface with the use of a spoon.
Now that your burger patties are done, you can store them in the chiller overnight, use it for another occasion or pan-fry right away over medium heat until cooked through.
With your choice of buns, vegetables, condiments and other components, these Hamburger Patties are ready to be enjoyed by the whole family.
Whip up a sweet & sour taste when you use Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Sweet & Sour as another condiment option!

name: Inihaw na Pusit Recipe
description: Maximize the flavor of inihaw na pusit with tomatoes, garlic, and onions. Make this grilled Filipino dish everyone's favorite with this quick recipe.
tips: A tip in grilling squid is to make sure that you remove any excess water and moisture from the outside skin of the squid before grilling. You can use a tissue and pat dry the outside skin to dry out the squid, then cover it oil. Also make sure that the heat from the grill is high and intense to prevent the squid from becoming rubbery and undercooked.
instructions: All you need to do is combine the onions, tomatoes, garlic, calamansi juice, and Knorr Fish Cubes in a bowl.
Mix this well and stuff it inside the squid. Score, or make slices on the squid body crosswise to cook the filling evenly.
Grill on hot charcoal or over stove top and that’s our dish!

name: Inihaw na Tokwa't Bangus Recipe
description: This classic dish combines the fresh seafood taste coming from the bangus stuffed with tofu cubes and fresh vegetables, grilled in banana leaf.
tips: Banana leaf wrapping will add flavor and aroma to the grilled fish. You can also use aluminum foil to cover the fish before grilling, instead of wrapping the fish in banana leaf.

ingredients.item: whole bangus (milkfish) cleaned and sliced along the back for stuffing

instructions: Begin by marinating the fish with Knorr Liquid Seasoning by rubbing it evenly well from the inside and out.

In a bowl, combine the rest of the ingredients, fried tofu cubes, diced onions, tomatoes, Knorr Liquid Seasoning and calamansi juice, brown sugar and pepper; then stuff the fish with the tofu mixture.
Secure the fish with twine or wrap it with banana leaves. Grill over hot coals and serve. All you need now is a big serving of rice to enjoy Inihaw na Tokwa't Bangus. It's delicious!

name: Kaldereta Pizza Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich taste of beef mixed with the flavors of Knorr kalderata served on a pizza dough topped with pepperoni and bell peppers.
tips: When cooking with store bought pizza dough, you can start by heating the dough in the oven for a couple of minutes, to get a nice bottom crust, before adding the sauce and toppings.

ingredients.item: Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Kaldereta, dissolved in 2 cups water water

instructions: First, get your pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and sauté the ground meat until toasted.
Add the dissolved Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Kaldereta and liver spread and bring this to a boil then lowering the heat to a simmer until sauce is thick.
Simply spread the sauce on top of the crust. Follow this up next by arranging the bell peppers, pepperoni, and cheese. Bake or toast until the cheese melts in a toaster or using an oven.
You will surely crave for more Kaldereta Pizza because it’s simply that addicting.

name: Nachos Recipe
description: This simple merienda dish uses the rich taste of beef mixed with the spices cumin flavor, tangy tomato sauce, and crispy nacho chips topped with grated cheese.
tips: Dry frying your spices will release the oils from the spices and allow the flavors to deepen and develop when combined with your main ingredient.
instructions: First, let’s bring out the essential oil of the cumin by toasting it in a hot pan. Toasting your spice will allow the flavours to deepen and develop when combined with your main ingredient. Remove and set this aside.

Let’s continue by cooking our ground beef topping. Get your pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion and sauté them until translucent and aromatic. Drop in the Knorr Beef Cube and tomato paste and just sauté for a minute.
Next, add the ground beef and place cumin back into the pan. Sauté until the meat is toasted and that’s it! Our topping is done.

We just need to assemble nacho chips on a platter, top with the cooked beef mixture, cheese, and your choice of toppings. See how Nachos make the perfect bonding snack with the family. Serve this anytime, any day of the week!

name: Salisbury Steak Recipe
description: This simple and delicious dish uses the rich taste of beef mixed with onions and garlic, topped with the creamy mushroom sauce.
tips: You can add more flavor and a deeper texture to the mushroom sauce by adding butter to the mix.
instructions: Prepare Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup according to package directions. You may opt to lessen the water a bit so the soup is a little thick. Set this aside.
Let’s begin by making a patty by combining ground beef with minced onions and garlic, mashed Knorr Beef Cube, flour, beaten eggs and Worcestershire sauce. Add more flour if you wish.
The next step would be to shape the ground beef into balls then flatten them into 1 1⁄2-inch thick patties.
Get your pan nice and hot and with a little bit of oil, pan-fry the beef patties over medium heat until cooked through.
Get ready to serve your patty with your sauce on top and a big bowl of rice because you will definitely eat more than usual.

name: Sinigang na Fried Bangus
description: This dish combines the fresh flavor of bangus mixed with the sour and savory taste of the tamarind based broth mixed with fresh vegetables.
tips: Bangus (or Milkfish) is rich in Omega 3 fatty acids that help in development of the brain and memory of children, prevents heart disease and can control cholesterol levels.

ingredients.item: bangus, cut cut into 1½–inch thick pcs
(20g) pack Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original

instructions: Let’s begin by just seasoning the bangus in salt and pepper. Fry until brown in color. Once cooked, set aside.
Get a pot and place the rice washing (hugas bigas), onions and tomatoes in. Bring this to a boil before simmering for 8 minutes.

Gently add the fried bangus with the Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original, chili, radish, okra, and sigrilyas. Just allow to simmer until the vegetables are cooked through. Taste and see if you need to adjust the seasoning.
Ta-da! Now, you have a wonderful dish to present to the family! This Sinigang na Fried Bangus will bring smiles to their faces.

name: Sinigang sa Pakwan Recipe
description: This classic dish combines rich taste of pork mixed with fruity flavor of watermelon served with garden fresh vegetables cooked in a clear tamarind broth.
tips: When boiling the pork, remember to skim the top of the liquid to remove the impurities and scum coming from the pork. Skimming will also prevent the broth from being cloudy and help it become clear.

ingredients.item: kg. pork spareribs, cut into 2-inch cubes
kg. watermelon, peeled, seeded, cut into chunks
(40g) Knorr Sinigang sa Sampaloc Mix Original

instructions: Get a pot and combine the pork, onions, tomatoes and water. Bring to a boil and reduce the heat to a simmer and cook until the pork is fork-tender, about 30 mins.

Next, Add in the watermelon and gabi to the pot. Continue to simmer until the gabi is tender and the watermelon is starting to blend into the soup. This will take about 30 more minutes to make sure your meat is tender and flavorful.

Add Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Original and vegetables starting with the chilies and sitaw as these cook longer followed by the kangkong. Stir well and simmer until vegetables are cooked through. Adjust seasonings according to taste. And that's it. Serve hot and enjoy.

name: Sinuglaw Cups Recipe
description: This simple dish uses the rich taste of grilled marinated pork combined with the sour and tangy fish ceviche served in a crispy bite sized wanton cups.
tips: Fish ceviche is a technique of marinating raw fish in vinegar or acid combined with onions, pepper and spices.

ingredients.item: inihaw na liempo (pork belly seasoned with Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original then grilled), cut into cubes

instructions: This recipe may seem long but we assure you that it’ll be worth it. So, let’s begin by making the sinuglaw. First, place the tanique in a bowl with ¼ cup vinegar and leave it for 2-3 minutes only.
The next step is to combine the tanique with the cucumber, onion, ginger, chillis, grilled pork belly, calamansi juice and the remaining vinegar.
Throw in the mashed Knorr Pork Cube and mix this well. Then, cover the mixture and let it stand in the chiller for at least 10 minutes.
Since our Sinuglaw is done, we need to make a container for it by cooking the wonton wrappers and making them into cups.

Get a pot used for deep-frying and fill it with oil. Get it nice and hot over medium high heat. Press one wonton wrapper into a medium-sized ladle using a smaller ladle. While holding the two ladles, gently deep-fry the wrapper in oil until crisp, forming a cup. Place on top of a tray lined with paper towels. Do the same with the rest of the wrappers.
All you need to do is to spoon Sinuglaw into the wonton cups, top it with chopped cilantro and there you go! This dish is done!
categories: KNORR SINIGANG SA SAMPALOK MIX ORIGINAL

name: Sizzling Pepper Steak Recipe
description: This resto-style dish is simple to make and yet is so delicious. It combines the rich flavor of seasoned beef steak mixed with corn and pepper sauce.
tips: Surprise your family by giving your dish some restaurant appeal. It would be nice if you can serve this on a cast iron skillet or hot plate to achieve that restaurant feel in your home.

ingredients.item: lean beef, sliced thinly, marinated in 1 pc. Knorr Beef Cubes, mashed in 2 tbsp oil
sweet corn kernels, drained from liquid
freshly cracked black pepper, as needed

instructions: Before we get to the dish, we need to make the sauce. Pour all the ingredients in a small saucepan and bring this to a small simmer until it becomes thick. Set this aside.

Place your cast iron skillet over high heat and pour the oil once you see that it’s smoking hot. Place one cup of cooked rice in the center with a tablespoon of butter on top and then turn off the heat, this makes 1 serving. This recipe is good for 2-3 servings.
Arrange the beef slices, corn kernels and spring onions around the skillet then sprinkle generously with fresh cracked black pepper.
Pour the prepared sauce over the rice and voila! Enjoy a restaurant style feast with your family.

name: Turn Up The Heat With This Fresh & Spicy Bulalo Noodle Recipe
description:
There are very few better combinations than bulalo, rice, and cold weather. While we love a classic, this fresh and spicy spin to bulalo will have you wondering why you’ve never had bulalo this way before. The classic flavorful broth is infused with a hint of spice and served with noodles for an oriental take on this Filipino classic. 
               
               
               
              This spicy bulalo noodles recipe uses two Knorr Beef Cubes for an extra meaty and flavorful broth.
tips: Your patience in simmering the beef for hours will result in the most tender beef for your bulalo. Make sure to not rush and keep an eye on it, being careful to skim off the scum that rises to the surface.
instructions: The first step to making delicious spicy bulalo noodles is tenderizing the meat. This step is the longest out of all the steps but it’s generally hands-off. Grab a pot and add the bulalo, onions, garlic, and pepper into it.

Add enough water to cover the bulalo. Bring to a boil over high heat and then lower the heat to a simmer. Let this simmer until the beef is very tender. Make sure to watch the pot to see if you need to add more water.
Scum will naturally rise to the top of the water. Skim it off every now and then to keep the broth clear.

Once the bulalo is tender, remove the meat from the broth and add in Knorr Beef Cubes, siling labuyo or hot sauce, and potatoes. Bring this back to a simmer and let it simmer until the potatoes are cooked.
Take the pot off the heat and add the pechay. Cover the pot to make sure the pechay is cooked with the warm broth.

The spicy bulalo noodles are ready for assembly! Simply grab a large bowl and place the cooked noodles inside. Next, add the bulalo and the rest of the ingredients into the bowl. This is the part where you let your creativity shine with plating.
Finish the spicy bulalo noodles by pouring the hot broth into the bowl. Serve warm and enjoy!

name: Tapsilog Recipe
description: This Filipino classic beef dish combines the rich flavor of beef, marinated with Knorr beef flavors, tangy vinegar and crushed garlic taste.
tips: Marinating the meat overnight will not only infuse flavor to meat but it will also make the meat tender because of the inclusion of vinegar into the marinate.

ingredients.item: (Tip: You may pound the meat for a thinner and more tender result.)

instructions: Make a marinade for your tapa by combining the oil, garlic, Knorr Beef Cubes, brown sugar and vinegar in a bowl. Mix this well until the ingredients are dissolved and free of lumps. Gently place the beef slices in and just leave it in the chiller to marinate overnight.
The following day, drain the beef and let it dry because you don’t want any of those excess liquid when you fry the tapa.
Fry the tapa in medium high heat with a little bit of oil. And that’s about it! Finally, this dish is done!
With a serving of garlic rice and egg or salted egg mixed with tomatoes and onions, you simply will want to have this any day any time of the week. Tapsilog is home!

name: Yang Chow Fried Rice Recipe
description: This Chinese resto style rice recipe combines the light and fresh flavors of garlic, carrots, green peas and egg with the shrimp-flavor infused fried rice.
tips: Make sure to make your wok or pan nice and hot, and use enough oil, to ensure that the ingredients don't stick to the bottom of the pan. Making the pan hot before adding the vegetables will also add the smoky flavor to the rice.

ingredients.item: chopped spring onion and toasted garlic

instructions: Begin by getting your wok or big shallow pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and sauté garlic until you can smell the nice aroma from the cooked vegetable.
Drop in the Knorr Shrimp Cube and mix well. Add chorizo next and sauté for a minute.

Gently add the day old rice, vegetables, and Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Stir for 2 minutes before adding the cooked egg. Mix and serve the rice topped with spring onions and toasted garlic. And that’s our dish!

name: Inihaw na Salmon Recipe
description: This simple dish uses the fresh seafood flavors of salmon infused with black pepper spices and calamansi marination to give it a hint of spiced tangy flavor.
tips: Try not to flip the salmon steak cuts too much in the grill or on the pan to avoid the meat from falling apart. Let each side cook for at least 2 minutes before gently lifting it from the grill.
instructions: All you need to do is to marinate the salmon steaks in a mixture of Knorr Liquid Seasoning, calamansi juice, and pepper for at least 10 minutes before cooking.

Grill over hot coals or pan-fry the fish until the fish is cooked through. An inch of salmon will cook for about 8 – 10 minutes, around 3 - 4 minutes per side. Make sure to monitor well to avoid overcooking it. You will know if the Salmon is ready if you see a white substance, similar to cooked egg whites, coming out of the fish.
Serve with your preferred sautéed vegetables, rice, and condiment of choice. Serve to your family and see how they will crave for more of this dish!

name: Pancit Lucban Recipe
description: This Filipino classic comfort food, Pancit Lucban uses the fresh flavors from garlic and onions, mixed with pork flavors, soy sauce and pepper.
tips: Pancit Lucban is usually served over a piece of banana leaf and is oftne eaten without any utensils.

ingredients.item: Other ingredients that can be added: chicharo, carrots, sayote, shrimp vinegar, as needed

instructions: First, get your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion, garlic and the Knorr Pork Cube. Just cook this for 2 minutes until the vegetables give off a nice aroma.
Next, add the pork strips and sauté until brown in color.
Add soy sauce and water and just bring to a boil before adding the noodles.
Finally, just add the vegetables in until all the ingredients are cooked through and that’s our dish!

What’s Pancit Lucban without the vinegar on the side? Surely, you will crave for more of this dish once you’ve tried it! This is a tried and tested recipe you’ll remember for a long time and will want to cook again.

name: Pasta Puttanesca Recipe
description: This dish is simple to make and very nutritious. It combines the rich taste of tomatoes and garlic with the strong flavors of olives and anchovies.
tips: Puttanesca is very nutritious and delicious. Eating tomatoes along with the garlic is a good source of antioxidants, and the anchovies provide protein and the good omega-3 fatty acids.

ingredients.item: (1 pack) Royal Spaghetti, cooked accdg. to pack directions freshly ground pepper, to taste
chopped bird’s eye chili or chili flakes, as needed

instructions: Begin by pre-heating your pan with a little bit of olive oil over medium heat. Throw in the garlic and just sauté this until lightly toasted. Drop in the mashed Knorr Beef Cubes next with the anchovies, olives, and capers as well. Sauté this for a good 1 minute.
Gently place the tomato chunks and stir and simmer for about 15 – 20 minutes.
Now that our sauce is done, toss with cooked Royal Spaghetti with pepper, chili, parsley and a topping of cheese. Finally, that’s our dish!
Pasta Puttanesca will surely make your day. It’s just one of those simple pleasures in life that everyone is just deserving of.

name: Pasta Vongole Recipe
description: This classic Italian pasta dish combines the rich seafood taste of clams mixed with the fresh flavors of garlic and chili cooked in wine and shrimp flavors.
tips: Clams are rich in vitamins and minerals and a good source of protein minus the fat.

ingredients.item: (400 g.) pack spaghetti, cooked accdg. to pack directions

instructions: First, get your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the garlic and sauté lightly until toasted. Toss in the chili and add the mashed Knorr Shrimp Cubes.
Add the wine to deglaze the pan, if ever you decide to use some. then add the clams. Sauté until shells open, and the alcohol smell evaporates.

Our topping is done now so just toss in the cooked spaghetti and top with some parsley. For the next step, stir until all the ingredients are well-mixed. Now, taste to check if additional seasoning is needed. Squeeze a bit of lemon juice just before serving and this dish is done!
Your family will be so delighted and happy when you serve Pasta Vongole to them. It’s a dish that you will always look for every single time! Delicious!

name: Roast Pork Loin Recipe with Almond-Pesto Stuffing
description: This ideal holiday dish combines the earth and nutty flavors of almond and pesto sauce stuffed in a well-seasoned roasted pork loin coated with pesto crust.
tips: Cook pork, roasts, and chops to 145 ºF internal temperature as measured with a food thermometer in the thickest part of the meat, then allow the meat to rest for 3-5 minutes before carving or consuming.

ingredients.item: kg. pork loin, cut morcon-style (you may ask your butcher to do this for you)

instructions: First, you need to season the pork loin with Knorr Liquid Seasoning and pepper. Next, lay the pork loin on a chopping board and spread half of the pesto sauce evenly on one side and then sprinkle the top with chopped almonds.
You now have to gently roll the loin into a log, then seal and secure it with butcher’s twine by tying knots on both ends.
Give the loin a nice breading layer by first coating it in flour. After, dip it in beaten eggs and finally roll it in a mixture of half pesto and breadcrumbs.
Cook the pork roll by deep frying it in oil set at low-medium heat or bake in a 375 F oven for 30-45 minutes. Wait for it to cook and then you are done!
Something as beautiful and delicious as this dish should not just be reserved for special occasions. As long as you’re with family, no matter what the time, there’s always something to celebrate.

name: The Only Chinese-Style Lapu-Lapu Recipe You'll Ever Need
description: Skip the frying and get steaming. This delicious and easy Chinese-style lapu-lapu recipe comes together in less than an hour with little hands-on time. Simple yet oh-so-delectible, this dish gets its umami flavor from a generous portion of Knorr Liquid Seasoning Original.
tips: Use fresh lapu-lapu for the best tasting Chinese-style fish.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together Knorr Liquid Seasoning Original, pepper, and sesame oil.
Place lapu-lapu in a large container that fits into your steam basket and season with the mixture.
Top the lapu-lapu with the onions, leeks, and carrots.
Place the container inside the steam basket and let it cook for 8-10 minutes or longer depending on the size of your fish.
Once cooked, transfer lapu-lapu into a serving platter. Set aside.
In a small pot, mix water, light soy sauce, sugar, and cornstarch. Bring to a boil over medium heat and set aside.
Drizzle the steamed lapu-lapu with the sauce right before serving and enjoy!

name: Bibingka Recipe
description: It combines the sweet and buttery flavors from the batter, mixed with the salty egg and fresh coconut shavings.
tips: You can also make this bibingka recipe using the oven. Place the batter in individual molds, arrange them in a baking sheet, then bake them initially for 10 minutes at 200C / 390F. Remove from oven, then cover the bibingka molds with banana leaf and butter. Bake for another 5 minutes.

ingredients.item: (33g) pack Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay

instructions: Let's begin by sifting and combining rice flour and baking powder together. Set aside. Whisk sugar and butter until well mixed.
Bring Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay dissolved in water to a boil then bring down to a simmer until thick. Let this cool.
In a bowl, beat egg until light before adding the milk and cooled gata. Combine all dry and liquid ingredients together.
Pour mixture in a greased round baking pan lined with banana leaf then cook in between coals or in an oven. When bibingka is halfway set, top it with salted eggs and cheese.
Cook until inserted toothpick at the center comes out clean.
Serve topped with margarine, sugar, and niyog. What can be more fun than enjoying a warm and nice serving of Bibingka with family and friends.

name: Crab Cakes with Curry Sauce Recipe
description: This unique dish combines the rich seafood flavor of crabs mixed with bell peppers and mayonnaise to give it a little sweetness, topped with thick curry sauce.
tips: Crab is packed with protein, which is important for building and maintaining muscle. Crab also contains high levels of Omega-3 fatty acids and vitamin B12 which help fight chronic diseases.

ingredients.item: (1 pack) Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay

instructions: In a bowl, combine crab meat, breadcrumbs, onion, garlic, bell pepper, mayonnaise, egg, Knorr Liquid Seasoning and calamansi juice. Mix well. Scoop half a cup of the mixture, shape into a ball then flatten to create a patty. Repeat with the rest of the mixture.
Pre-heat oil then pan-fry crab cakes over medium heat, for around 3-4 minutes per side.
In a another pot, combine water, curry powder and Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay. Bring to a boil then simmer until thick. Add cream, mix well, and turn off heat.
Pour the sauce over crab cakes just before serving.

name: Cream Dory Fillets with Sofrito Recipe
description: Highlight the lightness of fish with a Spanish-style tomato-based sauce. This recipe for cream dory fillets with sofrito adds a twist to a beloved seafood.
tips: Sofrito is a traditional Spanish tomato-based sauce made up of a mix of onions, peppers, garlic, and tomatoes. It is mainly used to boost flavors and enhance texture to the dish.

ingredients.item: kg. Cream Dory fillet, cut into serving pcs.
33g (1 pack) Knorr Ginataang Gulay Complete Recipe Mix

instructions: Begin by preparing 3 shallow pans for your egg, flour and breadcrumbs mixtures. Before coating the fish, season it well with salt and pepper. Dust the fish with flour then dip it in the beaten egg. Next, dredge the fish in breadcrumbs and transfer to a food grade container so you can set this aside in the chiller to allow the coating to set firm.

While the fish is in the chiller, get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion, garlic and tomatoes. Cook them until the vegetables give off a nice aroma. Add the basil next and stir well before seasoning it with more salt and pepper. Set this aside for your topping. This is what you call a sofrito – a mixture of sautéed chopped aromatics (onion, garlic and tomatoes).

Next, mix Knorr Ginataang Gulay Complete Recipe Mix and water and just bring this to a boil before letting it simmer. When the sauce is thick, stir in the cream followed by the cheese. Stir well until cheese is melted.
Now that the sauce is ready, start deep frying the fish fillet in hot oil until brown and crisp. Remove and just allow the fish to drain over a plate lined with paper towels to blot off excess oil.

Pour the cream sauce first on a platter then gently place the breaded fish at the center then top it with the sofrito last. When your family sees the effort you placed into this dish, they will truly adore you for it!

name: Laksa Recipe
description: Do you love laksa, a spicy and spice-filled Asian noodle soup? Cook this stew with ease thanks to this Knorr recipe. You might be tempted to have it daily.
tips: INCOMPLETE PRODUCT DISPLAY

ingredients.item: 1(29g) pack Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix

instructions: Just follow these simple steps and you’ll have homemade Laksa to be enjoyed at the comforts of your home.

Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and sauté the curry paste first followed by the shrimp and tofu next. Add Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay dissolved in water and bring to a boil before allowing to simmer.
When the sauce is thick, pour in the milk, Knorr Shrimp cube, lemongrass and kaffir lime leaves and let this simmer for 2-3 minutes only.

Now that our soup is done, let’s plate our Laksa dish! In a serving bowl, place your noodles in and pour the hot broth over. Top with egg, beansprout, tofu, shrimp and fresh cilantro and that’s our dish!
When you serve Laksa to your family, they will surely thank you for it! So, what are you waiting for? Try this recipe today!
categories: KNORR COMPLETE RECIPE MIX GINATAANG GULAY

name: Garlic Crabs in Coconut Milk and Crispy Noodles Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich flavors of crabs mixed with the sweet and creamy flavors of the coconut milk and garlic served on top of asian crispy noodles.
tips: Crabs are a good source of Omega-3 Fatty Acids that helps prevent heart disease and aids in brain development.

ingredients.item: Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay

instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the garlic and sauté until brown. Dissolve Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay in water then add to the pot.
Into the pot goes the fresh crabs. Let the sauce simmer until thick and crabs are cooked through. This will take about 15 minutes depending on the size of the crab.
Get another shallow pan for deep frying and pour enough oil. Turn the heat to medium high and gently add the noodles. Remove from the pot once it puffs and drain on paper towels.

Place the noodles on a nice platter with the crabs on top. Pour the sauce over and sprinkle fried garlic and spring onions on top. Who says you need to go to a Chinese restaurant to enjoy something as beautiful as this dish! Prepare to get hugs and kisses from your family when you serve Garlic Crabs in Coconut Milk and Crispy Noodles!

name: Seafood Chowder Recipe
description: This simple and elegant creamy seafood dish uses the the fresh flavors from shrimp, mussels and fish fillet served in a creamy and delicious soup
tips: Since cream breaks easily, it is not wise to boil the cream once it is added to the soup. You just want to heat this at a bare simmer.

ingredients.item: shrimp, shelled and deveined ¼ kg squid, cut into rings
potatoes, cut into small cubes 1⁄2 cup cream

instructions: Pre-heat a large pot and throw in the onions and garlic. Cook the vegetables until they are soft and give off a wonderful aroma. Toss in the seafood and cook this for half a minute.
Dissolve Knorr Cream of Corn Soup in water then pour this into the pot.
Throw the potatoes in and cook this until the soup is thick and the potatoes are fork tender.
Flavor the soup with the addition of pepper then give it one last stir.
The soup is ready and is best enjoyed with a serving of toasted bread. Truly, you will be hailed a hero of your household for treating your family to this comforting dish.

name: Bringhe Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Bringhe | Knorr
tips: You may pour more liquid if needed. Just like paella, garnish your rice with slices of cooked hard boiled eggs on top.

ingredients.item: kg. chicken, cut into serving pcs.
Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay

instructions: Bringhe is the Filipino version of Paella. It is made with glutinous rice, chicken and vegetables. The preparation may take long but we can guarantee you that it’s worth the wait.

The first step is to get an appropriate pan to cook the Bringhe with. Choose a shallow pan that can cook and hold 3 cups of rice with more than 8 cups of water. The next step is to get your pan nice and hot over high heat and pour oil. Throw in the onions and garlic and cook until you can smell the lovely aroma from the cooked vegetables.
Gently place the chicken and sprinkle the turmeric powder over. Mix this well before adding the glutinous rice.

Pour the Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay dissolved in water then throw in the raisins and bell peppers next. Stir this well then bring to a boil. Cover the pan and lower the heat and simmer to cook until all the ingredients are tender. You may pour more liquid if needed. Just like paella, garnish your rice with slices of cooked hard boiled eggs on top.
You don’t need to wait for a special occasion to enjoy Bringhe because eating together as a family is enough reason to celebrate.
categories: KNORR COMPLETE RECIPE MIX GINATAANG GULAY

name: Ampalaya Con Carne Recipe
description: This dish combines the slightly bitter taste Ampalaya with the rich taste of beef, sautéed and mixed with tausi cooked in soy-based thick sauce.
tips: To reduce the bitterness of Ampalaya, try soaking the sliced Ampalaya in salted water for 30 minutes, then wash it in cold water before adding to your dish.
instructions: Ampalaya may have a bitter reputation but if prepared properly, it could be very addicting and delicious. You can eat as much without the guilt because it’s very nutritious.

Let’s begin by slicing the ampalaya lengthwise. Remove the inner white parts then slice into 1/4-inch thick pieces crosswise. By soaking it in salted water for 30 minutes, you can reduce the bitter taste of the ampalaya. After 30 minutes, discard the water and drain the vegetable.
Meanwhile, get another medium pan nice and hot and turn it up to medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion and garlic and sauté them until the vegetables give off a nice aroma.
Gently place the beef loin and sauté for a minute over high heat. Remove the meat and set aside.

Next, in the same pan, add the ampalaya and sauté for a minute. Add the tausi next followed by the soy sauce, Knorr Liquid Seasoning and cornstarch dissolved in 1 ½ cups of water (add more if needed), and pepper.
Finally, add the beef back and allow the sauce to simmer for a minute and that’s our dish!
Now, taste and adjust the seasoning before serving to your hungry and waiting family. You will simply enjoy eating this Ampalaya Con Carne Recipe. Nutritious and tasty, after all, is our specialty!

name: Beef and Sigarilyas Recipe
description: This simple dish uses the rich flavor of beef combined with the fresh and crunchy taste of sigarilyas cooked in the thick soy spiced sauce.
tips: Adding slurry, water with cornstarch, is a way to thickens the sauce. Just remember that you shouldn’t allow this to boil too long because there is a tendency for it to become thin.
instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the garlic and sauté this until lightly brown.
Into the pan, toss the beef and sauté a good 1 minute over high heat, continue cooking until meat turns brown. Remove the meat and set this aside.
Using the same pan, add the water next and bring this to a boil before adding the Knorr Beef Cube and sigarilyas. Simmer until the vegetable is cooked.

Return the beef back and just give this a nice sprinkle of Knorr Liquid Seasoning, sugar, and pepper. Mix well before adding the cornstarch dissolved in water (slurry). Continue to cook until sauce thickens and that’s our dish! Just taste and adjust the seasoning.

name: Chicken Karaage Recipe
description: This traditional Japanese recipe uses the flavors of chicken marinated in the rich flavor of Knorr seasoning, sake and ginger, fried until brown and crispy.
tips: Ginger has a long history of use in various forms of traditional medicine. It has been used to aid digestion, reduce nausea, and help fight the flu and common cold.

ingredients.item: kg. chicken breast fillet, cut into 3-inch lengths

instructions: Give this Chicken Karaage a jam-packed kick full of flavour by combining the sake, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, garlic, and ginger in a bowl and then placing the chicken meat in this mixture. Mix this well and leave this in the chiller for 1 hour.
The next step is to drain the chicken before coating them in the flour-starch mixture.

Finally, you can start preparing the chicken for deep frying. Get a big pot and fill it with cooking oil. Set the heat on high until hot then slowly slide the chicken pieces away from you to avoid the oil from splattering. At this point, you will be able to smell the inviting aroma from the cooked chicken. When you see the coating crisp and brown, lift it up with a slotted spoon or tongs then drain it on top of a tray lined with paper towel to remove excess oil.
No need for take-out because this Chicken Karaage is a simple and delicious meal that can be enjoyed by the family any time of the week.
Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Mix well. Serve on the side.
Melt butter in a pot then stir in flour. Cook until mixture resembles a paste. Whisk in chicken stock. Season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning and pepper. Let simmer until slightly thickened.

name: Chicken Mushroom Soup Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Chicken Mushroom Soup. Satisfy your cravings with this creamy and healthy Mushroom Soup any time of the day.
tips: Mushrooms are not only delicious but they are also a good source of fiber, protein, and antioxidants. They may also reduce the risk of developing serious health conditions, such as Alzheimer's, heart disease, cancer, and diabetes.

ingredients.item: kg. chicken breast fillet, cut into cubes
pc. red bell pepper, cut into small cubes
green bell pepper, cut into small cubes

instructions: You can create this fast and easy, delicious soup in an instant. First you need to pour Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup into a pot filled with 4 cups water and allow to boil while stirring. Drop the chicken fillet cubes slowly and bring to a simmer for 2 minutes before adding the rest of the ingredients.
Make sure to check if the chicken and all the vegetables are cooked through. Then you can serve this comforting and filling dish to your whole family.

name: Chorizo Croquetas Recipe
description: This Spanish inspired dish uses the rich flavor and textures of mashed potatoes combined with chorizo and cream, enhanced with Knorr seasoning.
tips: You can make the mash potatoes a bit smoother in texture by passing it through a strainer after boiling. It will also remove the patches of skin from the final mash potatoes.
instructions: Let’s begin by making the mashed potatoes. You can start by simply boiling together the potatoes, water and Knorr Beef Cubes in a pot. Cook them until tender, and then drain and mash until they are smooth.
Next, let’s make the croquettas. While the potatoes are still warm, mix it together with the chorizo, cream and margarine.
Give this a punch of flavour and some good seasoning by adding a few drops of Knorr Liquid Seasoning and pepper. Now, shape the mixture into a ball or log by using a spoon.
Since you want to achieve a crispy coating, dip the balls in flour and then in beaten egg. Finally, roll them in breadcrumbs before deep frying to a crisp.
You will definitely comeback for more servings of Chorizo Croquettas especially when you serve it with your favourite dipping sauce. With or without rice, it’s definitely addicting!

name: Chorizo Pasta Recipe
description: This Spanish pasta dish uses the rich flavor of chorizo combined with carrot and garlic, cooked in Extra virgin olive oil, infused with Knorr seasoning.
tips: Extra Virgin Olive oil contains large amounts of antioxidants that are heart healthy and reduce the risk of chronic disease.

ingredients.item: g. any type of pasta, cooked al dente
pcs. chorizo de bilbao, sliced thinly

instructions: First, you need to grab a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Next, you may pour in the olive oil and throw in the garlic and cook them until brown.
Then, you have to add the chorizo and carrots and cook them for a good 2 minutes.
At this point, you need to toss the mixture into the cooked pasta. Finally, with a sprinkle of Knorr Liquid Seasoning, this dish is done!
Just by smelling the aromatic flavors of garlic and the enticing appeal of chorizo, you will never get tired of eating this Chorizo Pasta recipe. It was definitely made to satisfy!

name: Mushroom Cream Penne Recipe
description: This simple pasta dish uses the rich and flavorful taste of mushrooms mixed with garlic and olive oil, combined with creamy Knorr Ginataang Mix pasta sauce.
tips: Mushrooms are not only delicious but they are also a good source of fiber, protein, and antioxidants. They may also reduce the risk of developing serious health conditions, such as Alzheimer's, heart disease, cancer, and diabetes.

ingredients.item: (45g) packs Knorr Ginataang Gulay Complete Recipe Mix

instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some olive oil and sauté garlic until slightly toasted but not brown. Add mushroom and sauté for a minute.
Add Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay dissolved in water. Bring to the boil then lower the heat to simmer until thick.

Stir in cream and toss with the pasta. Serve with grated cheese topped with parsley and toasted garlic and that's it! Serve Mushroom Cream Penne anytime of the week. It will satisfy your craving for pasta. Mmmm, it's delicious!

name: Easy-to-Make Pancit Bihon Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Pancit Bihon | Knorr

ingredients.item: pc. Knorr Pork or Shrimp Cube
Serve with: calamansi chopped spring onions (optional)

instructions: Get a wok and bring it up to medium heat. Pour a small amount of oil and cook the onions and garlic until you get a fragrant aroma. TIP: If you don’t have a wok, you may use a kawa (kawali) that you’ll find in your everyday kitchen.
Throw in the sliced pork and sauté until it becomes light brown in color before adding the shrimp. Toss the shrimp in the hot pan for about a few seconds so as not to overcook it.
Pour in the water, soy sauce, and Knorr Pork Cube or Knorr Shrimp Cube. Bring this to a simmer for about 2 minutes.
You can now add the green beans and carrots before finally adding the bihon. Gently stir the mixture and simmer until the broth is absorbed by the noodles. This will only take about 5 minutes.
Only one more step is needed before you can enjoy this delicious platter of pancit with your family. You just need to add the cabbage and mix well until all the ingredients are cooked through.

It’s always a treat to have a bowl of calamansi and spring onions ready when eating a serving of pancit. Let this dish unite you with your loved ones in good conversation, good company and even better food!

name: Pinaputok na Isda Recipe
description: This classic dish uses the rich seafood taste of fish marinated in Knorr seasoning, stuffed with the tomatoes and onions; grilled for added smoked flavor.
tips: Make sure to thoroughly clean the banana leaves that will be used for wrapping by using cold water. Pat dry using a paper tower after cleaning to remove excess moisture before using.

ingredients.item: large pompano, cleaned and slitted to create a pocket for stuffing
banana leaves (enough to cover the fish)

instructions: First, you need to marinate the fish with a mixture of Knorr Liquid Seasoning, calamansi juice, and pepper. Rub it well to evenly coat the fish.
Next, stuff the fish with onion, tomatoes, and wansuy filling before wrapping in banana leaves.

Make sure you have some pre-heated hot coal ready and grill the fish until cooked through. Serve with your favourite condiment and that’s our dish! You need not go to the province to experience Pinaputok na Isda. Recreate and make this at home and see how your family will insist you cook this for them more often.

name: Pinatisang Manok Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich and fresh flavor of chicken infused with ginger spice cooked in fish sauce based broth served with chili leaves.
tips: When boiling the chicken, remember to skim the top of the liquid to remove the impurities and scum that rise up to keep the broth and sauce clear and clean.

ingredients.item: kg. chicken breast fillet, cut into large cubes

instructions: Get a medium pot nice and warm over high heat. Add water, ginger sticks, Knorr Chicken cubes, fish sauce and chicken breast cubes. Bring this to a boil then lower the heat to a simmer. Add the hardboiled eggs and continue to simmer until chicken is tender.
With just a topping of dahon ng sili and cooking it a minute longer, this dish is done. So simple and easy to make yet there is so much joy that this Pinatisang Manok brings to the family.

name: How to Cook Nilaga: Pork Nilaga Recipe | Recipedia
description: The right pork nilaga ingredients make the perfect sabaw, so load yours with repolyo, pork belly, pechay, and Knorr Pork Cubes. Here’s how to cook pork nilaga!
tips: Fork Tender refers to the process where we check if the ingredient is cooked or tender enough that it can be pierced or cut easily by a fork.

ingredients.item: kg. pork belly, sliced into serving pcs.

instructions: With just 3 simple steps, you can enjoy a hassle-free Pork Nilaga dish. And this means, more bonding time with the family.

For the first step, combine the pork, water, peppercorns and onions in a big pot. First, you must bring the water to a boil uncovered, then once it’s boiling, turn the heat to low and cover your pot. Leave the mixture simmering until the meat is fork tender.
You may now throw in your Knorr Pork Cubes and potatoes. Cover your pot again and cook until the potatoes are fork tender.
We have finally reached our last stage. Add the cabbage and pechay and let these simmer for a good 2 minutes before finally serving to your loved ones.

name: Pork Paksiw Recipe
description: This classic dish combines the rich taste of pork mixed with tangy taste of cooking in vinegar, infused with a mixed combination of spices and sweets flavors.
tips: Don't rush the Monitor the heat when you are cooking this dish. Keep the heat to simmer at a low-medium setting to prevent the pork from being hard and dry.

ingredients.item: lean pork, cut into serving pcs.

instructions: Another reason why you should make this dish often is because it’s so easy and delicious. You just need to combine all the ingredients in a pot and bring it all to a boil. Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook until the pork is fork tender and the sauce is nice and thick.
Next, you just need to taste the seasoning and adjust if necessary.
Something as delicious as this is best enjoyed with the company of family and friends, so bring this dish to your next gathering and everybody will surely ask for the recipe.

name: Seafood Curry Spaghetti Recipe
description: This simple and delicious pasta dish combines the fresh seafood taste of seafood from shrimps, mussels and fish mixed with the sweet and creamy curry sauce.
tips: In choosing mussels, it should smell like the ocean and sea air, a little briny and fresh. They should not smell overly fishy. The shells should be closed tightly.

ingredients.item: assorted seafood (shrimp, mussels, or fish) of choice
(33g) packs of Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix

instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and saute garlic until slightly toasted. Add seafood and saute for a minute.
Pour in the Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix dissolved in water. Bring to the boil and simmer until thick. Add curry powder and mix well.
Stir in the cream and toss with the pasta. And that's our dish. You will definitely fall in love when you first bite into this Seafood Curry Spaghetti. It's so yummy!

name: Spaghetti Bolognese Recipe
description: This classic pasta dish uses the rich flavor of beef combined with the tangy taste of tomato based sauce mixed with cream and textures from celery and carrots
tips: Remember to add salt to the pasta boiling water to add flavor to the noodles and boost the overall flavor of the pasta dish.

ingredients.item: (45g) pack Knorr Kaldereta Recipe Mix dissolved in 2 cups water

instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion and garlic. Sauté them until you can smell the lovely aroma from the cooked vegetables. Gently place the ground beef next and just sauté them until slightly toasted.
Toss in the carrots and celery and just sauté for 2 minutes.
Add the Knorr Kaldereta Recipe Mix dissolved in water and liver spread and just bring to a boil and simmer until sauce is thick.
Stir in the cream next and just toss with the cooked pasta, top with cheese and that’s our dish!
Bend the rules a little and see how creative this dish is. Your family will be impressed with Knorr’s version of Spaghetti Bolognese.

name: Tomato Cream Penne Recipe
description: This simple and delicious pasta dish combines the rich flavor of beef mixed with the creamy and flavorful tomato based sauce topped with cheese.
tips: When cooking pasta, always remember to add salt to flavor the pasta noodles and cook the pasta until al dente, cooked and tender but still firm to the bite.

ingredients.item: g. penne pasta (cook according to package directions)

instructions: Let’s begin by getting a pan and making it nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion and garlic and just sauté until the vegetables give off a nice aroma.
Gently add the ground beef next and continue to sauté until you see that it’s lightly toasted.
Here’s where all the flavour will come from, just add the Knorr Kaldereta Recipe Mix dissolved in water and the liver spread. Give this a quick boil before simmering to thicken the sauce.
Stir in the cream next then toss with the cooked pasta and place in a baking dish. Sprinkle a generous serving of melting cheese on top then bake or toast until the cheese melts and that’s our dish!

name: Vigan Longganisa Pasta Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich, garlicky, spicy and salty flavors of your vigan longganisa with the sweet and creamy sauce and coconut milk.
tips: When cooking the longganisa, you can add a little water to the pan then let it dry out, this makes the longganisa cook more evenly and to help release all the flavors and oils from the longganisa.

ingredients.item: (29 g) pack Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix

instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion until soft and it gives off a nice aroma.
Add longganisa next and sauté them until brown and slightly toasted. Remove and set this aside.
Now in the same pan, pour the Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix dissolved in 1 cup water. Let this slowly boil then bring to a simmer over low heat until thick before stirring in the cream.
Now that the topping and sauce are done all you need to do is just pour the sauce onto the pasta and give it a nice toss with the Vigan longganisa in.
This Vigan Longganisa Pasta Recipe is another reason to have family bonding any time of the week.

name: Garlic Tuna Pasta Recipe
description: This dish uses the rich flavors of tuna mixed with the spiced flavors of garlic and pepper, infused in olive oil.
tips: Remember to add salt in the water when you are cooking pasta, or else it will not have any flavor.
instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour in the olive oil and throw in the garlic. Cook this until you can smell the lovely aroma from the cooked garlic.

Toss in the tuna flakes next and just sauté for 2 minutes. Now, here’s how you’ll get those good flavours. Sprinkle the Knorr Liquid Seasoning in and the pepper and that’s it! You just need to combine this sauce with the pasta and serve it with lemon wedges on the side and that’s our dish!

Who says you can’t have everything in one plate? Garlic Tuna Pasta is all you need to make your day! Share this wonderful eating experience with those whom you love and see their hearts overflow with gratitude for you.
categories: PH COVID EASY PANTRY HACK DINNER

name: Grilled Chicken Pesto Recipe
description: This heart healthy recipe uses the rich taste of Knorr marinated chicken breast seasoned with pesto sauce, simmered in sweet and creamy coconut milk sauce.
tips: When cooking with coconut milk, do not let the liquid boil for a long time to prevent the coconut milk from curdling or breaking up. Monitor the heat and let the dish cook at a simmer temp.
instructions: In order to maximize the flavour of chicken, marinate this with a few drops of Knorr Liquid Seasoning and evenly coat this in pesto sauce.

Get your grill or stove top pan nice and warm over high heat. Add a small amount of oil, then add the chicken and give it a 3 minutes to grill for each side. Once cooked, strain excess oil and set aside.

Now, using the same pan, pour the Knorr Ginataang Recipe Mix that has been dissolved in water. Bring this to a boil over high heat then lower the heat to simmer. Gently stir in the cream and place the chicken back onto the pan, allowing this to simmer for 6 minutes.
Parties, merienda or whatever the occasion, this Grilled Chicken Pesto will truly be the center of attention.

name: Kansi Recipe
description: This Ilonggo soup dish uses the rich flavors beef shank mixed with the fresh and sweet taste of lemongrass and jackfruit, combined in a tangy tamarind soup.
tips: Remember to skim the boiling liquid or to remove the scum from the surface of the water every now and then, to ensure your soup will be nice and clear.

ingredients.item: kg. beef shank, cut into serving pcs.
Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original

instructions: Kansi is easy to do and does not require much preparation. All you need to do is combine the beef shank, water, lemongrass, ginger and onion in a pot. Let this boil before bringing it to a simmer. Cook until the beef is fork tender. Remember to skim the boiling liquid to keep the soup clear.

Throw in the jackfruit, finger chili, and annatto powder and mix well. Next, simmer for a few minutes before adding the Knorr Beef Cube and Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original. Give this another 10-12 minutes and this dish is done!
You will be excited to come home to the flavours of Kansi. We are sure you’ll be dreaming about this dish after dinner. It’s just that delicious!
categories: KNORR SINIGANG SA SAMPALOK MIX ORIGINAL

name: Katsu Curry Recipe
description: This Japanese style recipe uses the rich flavors of seasoned lean pork slices topped with a creamy curry sauce infused with flavors of Knorr Ginataang Gulay.
tips: Curry powders usually consist of turmeric, cumin, ginger, and black pepper. Turmeric contains curcumin, a substance with powerful anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.

ingredients.item: (29g) pack Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix
carrot, cut into cubes, boiled and drained
potato, cut into cubes, boiled and drained

instructions: Let’s begin by dividing this recipe into 2 parts. First, make the sauce. Second, the breaded meat.

Bring the Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix and water to a boil over high heat before reducing it to a simmer. Now, cook until the sauce is thick before adding in the curry powder. Give this another minute to maximize the flavour of the curry. There, the sauce is done!

Let’s proceed to making the breaded pork. You need 3 trays or bowls where the flour, eggs, and breadcrumbs will be. Season the pork well with salt and pepper, and then dredge it in the flour mixture. Dip them next in egg before finally rolling it in breadcrumbs, deep-fry it in hot oil until crisp and golden brown. Don’t forget to drain the breaded pork on a tray lined with paper towels.

You now have the breaded pork and sauce ready. It’s now time to plate. To give this Katsu Curry that resto look, pour the sauce onto a plate and top it with the breaded pork. On the side, add the cooked potatoes and carrots.
This is a dish that will definitely be beloved by your whole family. Keep it forever in your recipe book or box so you can serve it again from time to time.

name: Kadyos, Baboy, Langka Recipe
description: This popular Ilonggo dish uses the earth taste of Kadyos, mixed with the smoky pork flavors combined with fresh langka leaves.
tips: Kadyos (Pigeon Peas) are great source of potassium which helps the body reduces blood pressure and helps maintain cardiovascular health.

ingredients.item: kg. pork hocks, cut into serving pcs.
Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Original Mix

instructions: This dish is easy to prepare and this means you have more time to bond with the family.
Begin by tenderizing the pork hocks in water with the lemongrass, ginger and pepper in. Bring this to a boil over high heat and reduce the heat to low and simmer until the pork is fork tender.
Place the kadyos and jackfruit in before adding the Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original and Knorr Pork Cube. Now, let the broth simmer for another 10-12 minutes and this dish is done.
This recipe just leaves us speechless. Go ahead and serve this to your family and we are sure they will have the same reaction.

name: Kimchi Rice Recipe
description: This Korean-inspired fried rice dish uses the rich flavor of Kimchi or fermented chili cabbage mixed with sauté onions and garlic infused with Knorr Seasoning
tips: Kimchi passes through a method of fermentation which creates an environment for friendly bacteria such as probiotics that offer health benefits like preventing cancer, heart disease, and common colds.
instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and saute onion and garlic.
Add kimchi and saute for 2 minutes.
Add cooked rice next and saute for 5 more minutes.
Season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning and chili powder. If you're in a diet, you have to stay away from this dish. For you will find yourself eating more Kimchi Rice.

name: Lao'Ya Recipe
description: This Ilokano classic dish uses the rich taste of beef shank cooked in a flavorful beef broth mixed with onions, potatoes, cabbage and saba.
tips: To make sure that the beef becomes tender and flavorful, keep the heat at a low-medium setting to the boiling liquid at a simmer. The slow and low heat will break down the tough portions of the beef.

ingredients.item: kg. beef shank, cut into serving pcs

instructions: In a large pot, gently place the beef with the Knorr Beef Cube, onions, peppercorns, and water. Bring this to a boil then simmer over low-medium heat until beef is fork tender.
Add the potatoes next with the finger chili and saba. Just simmer until potatoes are tender before adding the cabbage. Give this another 2 minutes and this dish is done!
What better way to enjoy Lao’ya than with the company of family? This dish will truly bring comfort and delight. Good memories will surely come out of your meal thanks to this recipe.

name: Lechon Kawali Recipe
description: Crispy and flavorful Lechon Kawali recipe made more delicious with Knorr Pork Cube.
tips: Deep Frying Tip: Always check the temperature of your oil when cooking. The ideal temp range for deep frying is between 325F - 400F. If the oil is getting too hot, the food will easily burn, and the pot can ignite. On the other hand, if the oil is too cold, your final dish will be soggy and greasy. Constantly check the temp of your oil using a thermometer gauge.
instructions: To make a really juicy and flavourful Lechon kawali, begin by tenderizing the pork in a pot filled with water, garlic and Knorr Pork Cube. Cook this at low heat and until the pork is fork tender.
Next, remove the pork from the broth and drain it well before giving this a good sprinkle of Knorr Liquid Seasoning.
Now that we have a well flavoured chunk of pork, deep fry it in some pre-heated oil and cook until the pork is brown and crisp.
Your family will surely do the happy dance when you serve this Lechon Kawali to them. Imagine if you serve this with their favourite condiments! More rice please!

name: Pesto Penne Recipe
description: This heart healthy dish combines the taste of Knorr beef flavor infused penne pasta with the fresh taste of basil and nuts from the herb pesto sauce.
tips: Pesto is packed with antioxidants thanks to the ingredients like basil and garlic. These help you reduce chronic illnesses and help normalize your blood pressure.
instructions: To make a tasty penne pasta, bring a pot of water to a boil and drop the Knorr Beef Cube. Let this simmer for a minute until dissolved. Add the pasta in boiling broth and cook just until al dente. Drain the pasta but don’t wash with water.
Grab a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Add the pesto sauce and just throw in the cooked penne. Swirl and toss to fully coat. Serve with a topping of cheese and that’s our dish!

Pesto Penne will surely brighten anyone’s day. Imagine the joy you’ll get if you share this with friends and family as well. Something this good isn’t just a one-person dining experience type of dish.

name: Sinacugan Recipe
description: This Samar dish combines the flavors and textures of red rice, white rice and glutinous rice (malagkit) cooked in coconut milk, served with hot chocolate
tips: You can also add black rice (pirurutong or tapol) to the dish to make get that more authentic Samar taste.

ingredients.item: (45g) pack Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix

instructions: Dissolve Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix in water. Mix well. Combine it with malagkit rice in a pot and let this cook for approximately 30 minutes.
In a separate pot, saute red rice in oil. Add water and let this cook for approximately 40 minutes.
Combine malagkit and red rice. You don't need to go to Samar to taste Sinacugan. Enjoy with a serving of hot chocolate, it's pure bliss!

name: Mac 'N Cheese Recipe
description: This dish is simple to make and very delicious. It combines the creamy smooth texture of cheese sauce mixed with elbow macaroni topped with bacon bits.
tips: You can add a little Parmesan cheese on top to add texture and flavor.You can also serve this dish baked.

ingredients.item: g. elbow macaroni, cooked al dente
Optional: 1 cup frozen or fresh spinach

instructions: This is a no fuss dish that you can cook any time of the day. In a medium pot, bring fresh milk and Knorr Pork Cubes to a simmer until the cubes are fully dissolved; then, remove from heat.
In a separate pan, melt butter, and sauté spinach (optional). Gently add the flour gradually mixing and stirring them until the flour becomes slightly brown and has that nutty aroma.
Slowly add the milk mixture into the flour mixture while mixing well over medium heat. Throw in the cheese and stir until it melts and the sauce is thick and smooth.
Now comes the exciting part, lets add the cooked macaroni to the cheese mixture and that’s our dish!
categories: HOW TO MAKE MACARONI AND CHEESE

name: Mechado Recipe
description: This Filipino classic dish uses the rich taste of beef combined with garlic and onions, served in the flavorful tomato sauce mixed with carrots and potatoes.
tips: To get a tender and more flavorful beef, make sure that you sear and brown the meat properly and keep the heat at a medium-low setting when simmering to fully infuse the flavors into the beef.

ingredients.item: pcs. carrots, cut into large cubes
pcs. potatoes, cut into large cubes

instructions: Let’s begin by getting our pan nice and hot over high heat. Pour some oil and fry the beef until brown then set this aside.

In the same pot, throw in the onion and garlic, then add the tomato paste. Sauté until the vegetables give off a nice aroma and the tomato paste turns dark in color. Pour the tomato sauce next with the peppercorns, bay leaf, and water.
Return the beef into the pan and let the sauce simmer until beef is fork tender.

Now, throw in the Knorr Beef Cubes and bring the sauce to a boil before adding the carrots and potatoes. Just let this simmer until all ingredients are cooked. Don’t forget to taste and check if the dish needs to be adjusted. Otherwise, this dish is done! You can never have enough of Mechado at home! Make sure you’ve prepared enough rice for you will definitely eat more than usual.

name: Mixed Veg Tri-Color Pasta Recipe
description: Try this healthy yet filling recipe using grilled eggplant, zucchini, tomatoes, and colorful pasta. Enjoy a vegetarian dish that doesn't scrimp on flavor.
tips: Zucchini is high in antioxidants and it helps prevent and reduce chronic diseases like cancer and cardiovascular diseases.

ingredients.item: assorted fresh herbs of your choice, roughly chopped
g. tri-color pasta, cooked al dente

instructions: First, marinate the sliced vegetables in a mixture of Knorr Liquid Seasoning, oil, and fresh herbs.
For the next step, grill the vegetables over stove top or pan-fry in hot oil.
Now, you may toss the cooked vegetables with the tri-color pasta and check if it still needs additional seasoning. Finally, that’s our dish!

name: Paklay Recipe
description: This Visayan classic stew dish uses the rich flavors and textures of pork belly and pork innards combined with sweet and sour taste of pineapples and calamansi
tips: Pineapples and calamansi are full of vitamin C which supports the immune system and provides antioxidant benefits.
instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion and garlic and cook them until you can smell the lovely aroma from the vegetables.
Place the pork belly, heart, then the liver in and sauté them until half cooked. Pour calamansi juice before adding the water.
You have to bring the liquid to a boil then throw in the Knorr Pork Cube and mix well.

Now, here’s when you have to add the pineapple and bell peppers in. Give it another minute to simmer. Also, you may check the taste of this dish from time to time to make sure it’s just right! Finally, you are done!
Have it as “pulutan” or as a main dish. The more you eat this dish, the more it will grow on you.

name: Paksiw Na Isda Recipe
description: Paksiw na isda is comfort food you can enjoy any time of the week. Whip up a quick meal with this delicious and easy recipe using Knorr Fish Cubes.
tips: You need to remember to cook the vinegar until the sharpness and aroma of the vinegar is almost lost before serving. Let the dish release the vinegar aroma by simmering the dish at a low temp heat for around 15 minutes.

ingredients.item: kg. any type of fish, cleaned

instructions: This is such an easy dish to make that you can have it any time of the week. All you need to do is to combine all the ingredients in a pot and bring the heat to a simmer.
Cook over low heat, uncovered, until the fish is done. And that’s our dish!

name: Pancit Malabon Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Pancit Malabon. Made with our Knorr Pork and Shrimp Cubes to enhance the taste of this filipino comfort food.
tips: You can top your Pancit Malabon with additional chopped spring onions, crispy chicharon, and tinapa flakes to add texture and flavor to the final dish.

ingredients.item: kg. pork belly, sliced into strips
kg. shrimp, shelled and deveined (reserve shrimp heads for sauce base)
Toppings (optional): chopped spring onions, crushed chicharon, tinapa flakes, fried tofu cubes

instructions: Begin by boiling water in a pot then drop the noodles in. Simmer for at least 5 minutes or check if the noodles are al dente. The noodles should still be firm to the touch. Remove the noodles then drain.

Next, grab a pan and place the achuete and oil together. By allowing the seeds and oil to sizzle, you’re extracting the color. Once the seeds turn dark in color, remove and discard them. We now have the achuete oil ready.

Now, in a large pan over medium heat, throwing in the garlic and sauté them until brown. Add the flour then mix it well, cooking it over low heat until you get a thick paste and it gives off a nutty aroma.
Slowly pour the water and shrimp heads. Bring these to a boil before adding the Knorr Shrimp Cube and Knorr Pork Cube. After it has simmered for 6-8 minutes, remove shrimp heads.
Gently place the pork belly, shrimp, and squid and allow to simmer until cooked through. Taste and check the seasoning.

Now comes the exciting part: the plating! Place the noodles in a serving platter, pour the sauce over and arrange the meat and seafood on top. And there you have it! This is cooked with so much love and effort. Your family will adore you for it!

name: Pinangat Recipe
description: Discover the delicious flavors of pinangat, a traditional Filipino dish made with taro leaves and a savory broth. Get the recipe from Knorr.

ingredients.item: lemongrass (8 pcs boiled in water until soft and 2 pcs. pounded)

instructions: Let’s begin by grabbing a pan and getting it nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion, garlic and ginger and cook them until the vegetables give off a nice aroma.
Place the pork and shrimp paste in and sauté them over high heat for about 2 minutes.
For the next step, wrap the pork mixture in the gabi leaves and secure it in with the softened lemongrass.
Now, get another pot and cook the Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix by dissolving it in 2 cups water.
Throw in the siling labuyo and 2 pcs of lemongrass. Gently place the wraps in the pot and bring them to a boil. Reduce the heat and cook while covered until the sauce is thick.
. Get ready to eat without the guilt because Pinangat is one dish your family will truly adore!

name: Shoyu Ramen Recipe
description: This Japanese Classic dish uses the rich flavor of pork combined with the deep flavor of dried Kombu, sake and sesame oil served with ramen noodles
tips: Dried Kombu does not only give a depth of flavor to the broth but it is known for reducing blood cholesterol and hypertension. It is high in iodine, which is good for thyroid functioning; iron, which helps carry oxygen to the cells and calcium, which builds bones and teeth.

ingredients.item: kg. boneless pork shoulder, sliced thinly
g. ramen noodles, boiled and drained
Other toppings (optional): chili sauce/oil, cooked and sliced pork belly, nori, soft-boiled eggs, chopped spring onions

instructions: No need to head to a Japanese resto to try ramen because this Shoyu Ramen recipe is all you need to satisfy your craving. All you need to do is to combine the pork with kombu, water, ginger, garlic, sake and Knorr Pork Cubes in a pot. Bring this to a boil then simmer until the pork is fork tender.
Now, pour in the sesame oil and adjust the seasonings. At this point, you can now smell the nice aroma from the kitchen.
Now, let’s serve the Ramen while it’s still hot. Place the cooked noodles in a bowl and pour the hot broth in, topping it with your favourite ingredients.
Smelling the soup already gives so much comfort, what more if you taste it? This will definitely make your whole week.

name: Crispy Pata with Garlic Bagoong Recipe
description: This recipe combines two classic dishes. It combines the flavors and textures of the Filipino Classic crispy pata stuffed with flavorful garlic bagoong rice
tips: When boiling the pork pata, use a large pot and place it over medium heat. Add enough water to cover the pata and bring this to a boil including the spices and aromatics, then lower the heat to simmer for 1 - 1.5 hours, or until tender and soft.
instructions: Pork knuckles or pata is a tough cut of meat. In order to come up with a crispy pata, you need to tenderize this first in water with Knorr Pork Cube, pepper, onions, garlic and star anise. Bring these to a boil over high heat and then reduce the heat to a simmer until the pork is tender. Drain the pata well and season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning.

Let’s now move on to making the stuffing for the pata. Combine cooked rice, bagoong and toasted garlic and fill the pata with this mixture. Secure the sides with some twine(thick form of sinulid) to properly seal the filling inside.

Now, get a pan that’s big enough to fit the pata and fill it with cooking oil. Get it nice and hot and deep-fry the stuffed pork until brown and crispy. Next, you have to remove it from the oil and place it on top of a tray lined with paper towels.
Celebrate good company, good food, and even greater flavour with this Crispy Pata with Garlic Bagoong recipe. You’ll be talking about it for a long time even after the last bite.

name: Beef Stroganoff Recipe
description: This dish uses well seasoned beef sirloin slices mixed with flavors of the thickened heavy cream infused with flavors of garlic, onions and button mushrooms
tips: When heating milk or cream, avoid heating the cream rapidly to prevent it from boiling. Only use low - med heat, when heating sauces with cream to avoid curdling.

ingredients.item: kg. beef sirloin, sliced into ½-inch thick

instructions: Let’s give this beef a power punch of flavour by marinating it in Knorr Liquid Seasoning for at least an hour. Then, set this aside.

Now, get a pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and melt margarine. Throw in the onions, garlic and mushroom. Sauté them until the vegetables give off a nice aroma before removing them from the pan.

Into the same pan, brown the marinated beef slices over high heat. Slowly pour the cream and drop in the Knorr Beef Cube, and the sautéed onion mixture. Make sure that the heat is low or it will break the cream. Simmer until the beef is cooked through.
For a thick sauce, add a slurry mixture (cornstarch dissolved in water) over low heat and that’s our dish! Don’t forget to check the seasoning by tasting.
Beef Stroganoff is truly a dish to remember. So, take this recipe and keep it in your collection for many more family dinners to come!

name: Tinolang Tahong Recipe
description: This classic heart healthy dish uses the spiced flavors of ginger broth soup infused with Knorr Fish flavor combined with the rich seafood flavor of tahong
tips: When choosing mussels (tahong), it should look wet and smell like the ocean, salty and clean. If they smell a little funky, or many of them appear to be open already, then do not buy them.

ingredients.item: small papaya or sayote, cut into small wedges

instructions: Here’s a one pot dish that will only require less than 15 minutes to cook. All you need to do is combine all the ingredients in a pot and bring everything to a boil. Once the liquid is boiling, bring the heat to low and slowly cook until the mussels have opened and the vegetables are cooked through.
Make sure to mix the dish well and that you taste it from time to time so you can make the necessary flavour adjustments.
Simple yet more than satisfying. This hot bowl of tahong tinola is best enjoyed with family at the table.

name: Meaty Longganisa Spaghetti Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich and intense flavor of Vigan longganisa mixed with flavors from Knorr Kaldereta mix, tossed in spaghetti pasta topped with cheese.
tips: You can use the pasta water, salted water used to boil and cooked the pasta, to adjust the thickness and texture of the final pasta dish. The pasta water contains a lot of flavor and is full of starch that gives it full texture.
instructions: Get your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion and garlic. Sauté until you can smell the lovely aroma from the cooked vegetables.
Now add the Vigan longganisa filling and just sauté this until slightly toasted.

Add the Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Kaldereta dissolved in water and liver spread. Adding both ingredients will make you have a delicious beef flavour. Just give this a boil before bringing it to a simmer.
Once the sauce has thickened, stir in the cream and that’s our sauce. You just need to toss the sauce with cooked pasta, topped with cheese and it’s now ready to be enjoyed by the family.

name: Paksiw na Pata Recipe
description: This classic dish uses the taste and texture of pork hock slowly cooked in vinegar and soy sauce with sugar and garlic, infused with Knorr seasoning.
tips: This one pot dish is simple to prepare and cook, but you need to monitor the liquid and pour additional water if needed, to prevent the meat from sticking to the pot, stir once in a while.

ingredients.item: kg. pork pata, ask your butcher to slice it into serving pcs

instructions: Another reason why you should cook this dish more often is because it’s so easy and delicious. All you need to do is combine all the ingredients in a pot and cover. Turn your heat up to high so you can let it boil.
When the liquid starts boiling, reduce the heat to simmer and slowly cook the pork until it is fork tender and the sauce is syrupy.
Now, it’s really up to you if you want more sauce in your dish. Just add water for a more liquid sauce and add more seasoning according to your taste. That’s it! Our Paksiw na Pata is done!
You will definitely need more rice because when you serve this Paksiw na Pata Recipe to your family, they’ll surely be asking for more!

name: Pork Asado Recipe
description: Knorr Liquid Seasoning gives these juicy pork slices the added magic they need. With this Pork Asado recipe, you’re in for a real Chinese-inspired treat!
tips: Pour enough water to cover the meat when simmering. The liquid will be the base of your sauce, and it will make the meat tender and moist. Let the meat rest before slicing to retain the moisture and juicy texture inside.
instructions: Let’s begin this popular and classic Chinese dish by marinating the pork in a mixture of five spice powder, soy sauce, garlic and Knorr Liquid Seasoning for at least 1 hour.

After an hour, transfer the entire mixture to a pot and add water, bay leaf, star anise and peppercorns. Bring this to a boil at high heat and reduce the heat to simmer to slowly cook the pork until it is tender and syrupy. Adjust the seasoning by tasting the sauce.
To serve the Pork Asado, slice the pork into serving pieces with the sauce on top. For that resto look, sprinkle spring onions on top.
Who says you need to go out for a real good Chinese dining experience? Home cooked Chinese food beats any resto dish especially when it’s cooked by mom.

name: Pata Tim Recipe
