description: This Filipino-chinese dish is made of slow cooked braised pork hock seasoned with just light soy with sugar, and slight licorice taste from the star-anise.
tips: Don't rush in cooking this dish. Let the pork gently simmer in the marinate to make the meat soft and tender, and to infuse the flavors to the insides of the meat.

ingredients.item: pork pata, ask your butcher to slice it into serving pieces

instructions: This is another no fuss dish you should keep on cooking at home. Just combine all the ingredients together in a pot, except for the pechay, and bring these to a boil. Once boiling, turn the heat to low and simmer until the pata is very tender (fork tender) and the sauce is thick. No need to panic, if water reduces too much, just pour more and it’s all good.
Now, add the pechay and simmer again for about a minute. Finally, with a sprinkle of Knorr Liquid Seasoning, your Pata Tim is done!
When you serve this dish to your family, they will have a hard time moving on. It’s just that delicious!

name: Pininyahang Pork Giniling Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Pininyahang Pork Giniling. Made more delicious with Knorr Pork Cubes and Knorr Liquid Seasoning.
tips: Pineapple contains a lot of vitamins and nutrients that are healthy to the body and the immune system. Studies show that eating pineapple may also speed up the recovery of our muscles after exercise, and speed up recovery after surgery, due to its large amounts of anti-inflammatory nutrient.
instructions: This dish is easy and cooks in an instant. Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Throw in the onion and garlic and cook until the vegetables give off a nice aroma.
Next, you need to add the Knorr Pork Cube and mix this well until dissolved before adding the ground pork.

Cook the ground pork until slightly toasted then add the carrots, green peas, raisins, and pineapple tidbits in. Sauté the meat and vegetables over high heat until they are cooked. With a sprinkle of Knorr Liquid Seasoning and black pepper, this dish is done!
It won’t be a surprise if this dish becomes one of your family’s favourites because it’s just that delicious!

name: Pork and Beans Guisado Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich flavors of ground pork and the fresh flavors and textures of sting beans, with the slight shrimp flavored sauce.
tips: Green beans and string beans has a lot of health benefits. It contain nutrients that help prevent cancer, diabetes and cardiovascular diseases.
instructions: This recipe is so simple and cooks in an instant. All you need to do is sauté the onion and garlic in a pre-heated pan with a little bit of oil. Cook them until the vegetables give off a nice aroma.
Throw in the Knorr Pork Cube and mix this well until dissolved before adding the ground pork. Now, sauté until the meat is slightly toasted.
At this point, gently add the vegetables and sauté them over high heat until cooked through. With a sprinkle of Knorr Liquid Seasoning and black pepper, this dish is done!
You will always have a reason to stay home especially when your mom serves you Pork and Beans Guisado. It’s the taste of comfort that makes it really pleasant!

name: Crispy Bicol Express Recipe
description: Ready for an exciting flavor adventure? Cook this crispy Bicol express and savor its rich and creamy flavors. Check out this recipe from Knorr!
tips: Pat dry the tender pork before deep frying to avoid having your oil splattering and sticking to the pan.

ingredients.item: red and green chillies, chopped, as needed
(29 g) pack Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix, dissolved in 240 ml water

instructions: If you want to have really good and crispy pork belly, you need to boil the pork in water with Knorr Pork Cube first. Now, allow this to simmer over low heat until the pork is tender.

Deep-fry the pork belly only when it has been thoroughly drained and surfaces are dry. You can pat dry with paper towels. Otherwise, when you place it in hot oil, you can expect the oil to splatter and it might burn you as well.
For the next step, prepare a plate or tray lined with paper towels so you can place the cooked fried belly on top. The paper towel will absorb the excess oil from the pork.
Now, we can go to preparing our sauce. Get your pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Then, pour some oil and gently sauté the bagoong and chillis for 2 minutes.
You then have to add Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay dissolved in water. Let this simmer until thick.

When your family sees a plate full of fried pork topped with some spicy gata sauce, they will not be able to contain their excitement! Ready the camera because upon their first bites, their smiling faces will be priceless!
categories: KNORR COMPLETE RECIPE MIX GINATAANG GULAY

name: Wonton Noodle Soup Recipe
description: This simple dish uses the rich flavor of Pork broth infused with Knorr flavors, combined with steamed dumplings served with egg noodles.
tips: To prepare frozen siomai and dumplings, you can steam the dumplings in a steamer for 15 -18 minutes to make it soft and tender, before topping it to the noodle soup.

ingredients.item: sesame oil black pepper, to taste

instructions: Here’s a reason why you need to cook this Wonton Noodle Soup Recipe for your family. It’s just so easy to make and comforting as well.
All you need to do is to combine the water with the prepared wontons and Knorr Pork Cube in a pot. Bring this to a boil and simmer over low heat until wontons are half cooked.
Now, add the egg noodles next and let the broth simmer until noodles are soft.
With sesame oil, pepper and spring onions in, this dish is done! You may simply adjust the seasoning by tasting.
When you sip into the warm soup, you will be reminded of the comforts of home.

name: Pork Ala Pobre Recipe
description: The dish combines the delicious flavors of the garlic infused marinated pork, and a buttery garlic flavors from the sauce.
tips: Garlic contains tons of vitamins, mineral and antioxidants that are good for your body and for your heart.
instructions: In order to have delicious Pork Ala Pobre, you need to marinate the pork slices in Knorr Liquid Seasoning for at least an hour.

Now, get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium high heat. With a little amount of oil, throw in the pork slices and cook them until brown. Then, set aside. Make sure to avoid overcrowding the pan by cooking them in batches. If you try and force to cook the meat altogether in one pan, you will cook them in their own juices instead of getting the brown crust you’re looking for in the meat.
So, in the same pan, add the margarine in and throw in the garlic. You have to cook this until the garlic is toasted.
Next, return the pork back into the pan and mix well. You may season with pepper and then this dish is done! Transfer to a plate with a topping of toasted garlic.
Just by smelling the cooked pork with the toasted garlic in margarine, you will know for sure that you can forget about your diet. You simply won’t be able to stop eating!

name: Heart-Healthy Hardinera Recipe
description: This Lucban inspired dish uses the rich flavor of chicken combined with fried tokwa, mixed vegetables and sweet pineapples; infused with Knorr flavors
tips: Once cooked after steaming, let the dish rest for 10-15 minutes to cool down. This process will ensure that the loaf will retain it's shape upon slicing.
instructions: Begin by stir-frying the tofu with a little bit of oil, followed by garlic, onion and bell pepper in a nice big wok or shallow pan over high heat.

Throw in the chicken and sauté this for another 2 minutes before adding the Knorr Chicken Cube, carrots and tomato sauce. Slowly bring this up to a boil then simmer for a few minutes. Set this aside to cool.
Once the cooked meat is cool, it’s time to combine it with the beaten eggs and cornstarch and the remaining ingredients. Give this a gentle stir to incorporate all the ingredients together.

Prepare and grease a llanera and arrange some carrot slices, pineapple and bell peppers at the bottom. Place the meat mixture in and with the use of the back of the spoon or spatula, flatten and smoothen out any of the uneven mixture. Cook this over a double boiler by steaming it for 30 minutes or until cooked through. Slice and serve once it has cooled down for 15 minutes.
No need to take the family on a trip to Lucban, Quezon because this Hardinera dish promises to be healthy, nutritious and delicious.

name: Pork and Sayote Guisado Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for pork and sayote guisado. Made more delicious with Knorr Liquid Seasoning and Knorr Pork Cubes.
tips: The health benefits of Sayote include preventing acne, healthier skin, lowering blood pressure and preventing certain types of cancer.
instructions: Here’s one way of serving vegetables in a non-challenging way. By adding sayote, it makes this humble dish more nutritious.
Begin by sautéing the onions and garlic in a pre-heated pan with a little bit of oil. Cook them until the vegetables give off a nice aroma.
Throw in the Knorr Pork Cube and mix well until dissolved before adding the ground pork.

When the pork is slightly toasted, gently add the sayote, and pour the water. Simmer these over medium heat until cooked through. Now give this a nice sprinkling of Knorr Liquid Seasoning and pepper to taste.
Pork and Sayote Guisado is one of those dishes that can soothe a hungry stomach. Sometimes, it’s simply the answer to a tired person’s work week.

name: Classic Embutido Recipe
description: This Filipino classic dish uses the rich flavor of pork combined with taste of carrots, celery, pickles and raisins stuffed with egg and seasoned with Knorr.
tips: After steaming the Embutido wraps, you need to rest the meat for at least 5 minutes before cutting or slicing, to ensure that the meat will stay firm and hold its shape.

ingredients.item: cling wrap and aluminum foil for wrapping

instructions: Embutido is one of the easiest dishes that can be prepared in an instant. All you need to do is to combine all the ingredients, except the hard boiled egg, in a bowl and mix them well.

To make the embutido roll, prepare a wrap using cling film and aluminium foil and cut them into 4. Divide the ground mixture into 4 equal portions and set these on top of the cling film. For each portion, slightly spread the mixture, placing the hard-boiled egg in the middle then roll and fold both ends of the cling film. Wrap it again with aluminium foil to tighten the embutido roll.
See how simple embutido is. Now, place them in a steamer and cook for 30-40 minutes or until it is firm.

The most versatile dishes are the simplest to do. They happen to be very delicious too. Whether it’s hot or cold, and served with your favourite condiment, this is one of the best comfort dishes of all time.

name: Giniling Guisado Recipe
description: This Filipino Classic dish uses the rich taste of ground pork mixed with carrots, potatoes and green peas, infused with Knorr Pork flavor.
tips: Green peas are a good source of vitamins C and E, zinc, and other antioxidants that strengthen your immune system.
instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion and garlic and cook them until the vegetables give off a nice aroma.
Next, drop the Knorr Pork Cube and mix this well until dissolved before adding the ground pork.
Sauté the ground pork until slightly toasted and then add the vegetables, sautéing them in high heat until cooked through.
With a splash of Knorr Liquid Seasoning and black pepper this dish is done!
Serve Giniling Guisado with quail eggs and see how this dish becomes one of your family’s favourites.

name: Adobong Puti Recipe
description: This Filipino Classic dish uses the rich taste of pork marinated in the flavorful taste of Knorr Liquid Seasoning mixed with vinegar and spices.
tips: Once you’ve added the vinegar, you shouldn’t stir it or else you will taste the raw and metallic flavor it gives. Just let it simmer uncovered over low heat for about 10-15 minutes.

ingredients.item: pork liempo, adobo cut (spareribs can also be used)
Knorr Pork Cube diluted in 1 cup water

instructions: Begin by marinating the pork in Knorr Liquid Seasoning and then place it in a bowl.
Next, grab a pan and make it nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and gently place the pork and fry until brown.
Add the crushed black pepper and the crushed garlic next before pouring the vinegar, do not stir. Let it simmer for 15 mins.

After 15 minutes, just add enough Knorr Pork broth to cover the meat. Next, bring it to a boil then let it simmer over low heat, while it’s covered until the pork is fork tender. Add more Knorr Liquid Seasoning to give Adobong Puti that umami goodness.
When you serve this Adobong Puti Recipe to your family, it will definitely make their entire week.

name: American Burger Recipe
description: This simple and flavorful dish uses the rich taste of ground beef enhanced with Knorr Seasoning, onions and basil, served topped with cheese and tomato slices
tips: When cooking the burger patties, give each side at least 3 minutes to sear on both sides to get an even out crust. After that, you can flip the burgers are often as you want to make sure that the internal meat is cooked through.
instructions: Begin by mixing all the ingredients in a bowl for the burger. The best way to check the flavour is by frying a tablespoon of the mixture in a pan. Then, make the necessary adjustments.

Once the seasoning has been adjusted, form four to six balls from the burger mixture and flatten to make a pattie. You have the option to store them in the chiller for another occasion or you can grill, bake or fry them right away.
It’s now time to sandwich the pattie in between the buns with the cheese, tomato, and lettuce in each.
What are you waiting for? This homemade American Burger is the best! Try it for yourself and even share it with friends and family!

name: Baked Caldereta Mac and Cheese Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Baked Caldereta Mac and Cheese | Knorr
tips: In making Bechamel sauce, you start by heating butter and flour together to make roux. You need to cook the flour for 2-3 minutes in butter for to remove the raw taste of the flour and to give the Bechamel its brown color and thick texture.

ingredients.item: elbow macaroni, cooked according to package directions
Knorr Kaldereta Complete Recipe Mix, dissolved in 2 cups water

instructions: Let’s begin by dividing the recipe into 3 parts. First, you need to make the meat sauce. Second, the béchamel sauce and last, you just need to assemble them.

To make the meat sauce, you just need to pre-heat your pan in medium high heat and pour some oil. Throw in the garlic and onion and sauté them until the garlic is light golden in color and the onion is translucent.

Now, add the chorizo and ground meat together and cook until light brown in color. Bring the bell peppers in and cook this for another 2-3 minutes before adding the dissolved Knorr Kaldereta Complete Recipe Mix, tomato paste, salt and pepper. Let this boil before simmering until thick. Our meat sauce is now done. Let’s continue by preparing our Bechamel sauce.

To make the béchamel, just melt butter in a saucepan over medium low heat then add the flour. Pour the the milk and water next and stir until thick. Add the Cheddar cheese and stir until melted then set this aside.

Since our meat sauce and Bechamel sauce are done, it’s now time to put them together by tossing the cooked elbow macaroni with the caldereta sauce. Transfer to a baking dish then pour the béchamel on top. Bake the Caldereta Mac n Cheese in a 350 F preheated oven for 30 minutes. You might be wondering now where the parmesan cheese will go. You sprinkle this on top of the pasta just before serving.
When you serve this Caldereta Mac and Cheese Recipe to your family, they will surely thank you for it.

name: Vegetable Pasta Salad in Barbecue Dressing
description: This simple dish combines the flavors of fresh vegetables mixed with fusilli pasta and spices tossed in a Knorr flavor infused barbecue salad dressing.
tips: Making the salad dressing separate is more recommended than adding all the components at once to the pasta because you have the liberty to adjust the seasoning.

ingredients.item: large green bell pepper, sliced into strips
large tomato, seeded and sliced into strips
medium red onion, peeled and sliced
Knorr Pork cube, diluted in ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions: Indulge in what’s healthy and delicious with this fast and easy salad dish. Begin by combining the cooked pasta with the rest of the vegetables, ham and spices in a bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix together the barbecue sauce, diluted Knorr Pork Cube and Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Mix well then pour the mixture in the pasta bowl then toss together to fully coat.
For a more refreshing salad, you can sprinkle the juice of ¼ lemon and add some chopped cilantro on top.

name: Beef Tapa Recipe
description: Truly a filipino Classic dish. It uses the rich flavors of the beef, properly marinated to enhance the flavors and kept tender for a better final texture
tips: Tenderizer: You can keep the beef tender and moist by marinating raw beef in baking soda and a little water.

ingredients.item: beef sirloin slices, ¼” thick then pounded

instructions: Most of the time, Beef Tapa is served tough and dry. But with these simple steps, you can enjoy your cuts of beef without sacrificing tenderness. Begin by pounding those sirloin slices thinly. With the addition of baking powder and allowing it to sit for a few minutes in the chiller, you are assured that your beef tapa will come out tender.

To flavour these meat slices, you need to combine the Knorr Beef Cube, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, sugar, oil and the meat slices in a bowl. Massage well and transfer in a food-grade container and allow to marinate for at least 1 hour or overnight in the chiller if you’re not going to use it immediately.
When frying the tapa, make sure you have a hot pan ready with a little bit of cooking oil. Cook this until brown. Remove and transfer the meat into a serving plate and set aside.
In the same pan, add the marinade mixture and thicken this with the cornstarch mixture. You can now pour this onto the tapa.

Beef tapa is also a comfort dish and is best enjoyed with a bowl of hot rice that has been seasoned with Knorr Liquid Seasoning and cooked in a hot wok. With the addition of toasted garlic on top of your rice, you know that you are truly home.

name: Beefy Sopas Recipe
description: This simple comfort food recipe combines the rich taste of mixed vegetables with the creamy beef flavored soup and macaroni noodles.
tips: Kintsay (Celery) is rich in Vitamin C which helps prevent colds and boost the immune system. It is also a good source of potassium and antioxidants that help regulate the processes in the body.
instructions: Get your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion and garlic. Sauté until the onion is translucent and the garlic is golden in color.
Pour in the evaporated milk next with the water, Knorr Beef Cubes, carrots, celery, and cabbage. Mix well until the vegetables are cooked through.
Finally, add the noodles next and just stir until all the ingredients have been fully incorporated. Serve hot!
Like the love of a mother, this Beefy Sopas recipe will soothe and comfort. Serve this dish to your loved ones and see the joy on their faces.

name: Binagoongang Fish sa Gata Recipe
description: This dish combines the crispy texture of fried battered Cream dory marinated in pepper and calamansi topped with creamy bagoong gata sauce.
tips: When cooking with coconut milk (gata), make sure that you don't let the soup to boil after adding the coconut milk, or else it might curdle and breakup during cooking.
instructions: Let’s begin by marinating the fish fillet in calamansi juice and pepper. Leave for at least 15 minutes to infuse flavor.

Combine the ingredients for breading. Coat marinated fish fillets and fry them in a preheated pan with oil and cook until golden brown. Drain on a plate lined with paper towels to blot off excess oil.
Now, get another pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and sauté onion, garlic and ginger until the vegetables give off a nice aroma.
Next, put in the tomatoes then the water and Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix. Mix well until free of lumps.

Gently add the bagoong with the sili sigang, season with pepper and that’s it. Help yourself with a platter full of Binagoongang Fish sa Gata. With a big serving of rice, see how you’ll find it hard to move on from the deliciousness of this dish.

name: Burger with Gravy Recipe
description: This classic recipe combines the rich flavor of beef mixed basil, garlic and onions infused with Knorr seasoning to make patties served with creamy gravy sauce
tips: The best way to check the flavor of the burger mix is by frying a small portion or a tablespoon of the mixture in a pan for tasting.
instructions: Let's begin by preparing the burger patties, by mixing all the burger ingredients in a bowl until fully incorporated. To check the flavor of the mix, try frying a tablespoon of the mixture in a pan, then make the necessary adjustments for salt and pepper.

Once the seasoning has been adjusted, form balls from the burger mixture and flatten to make a patties. You have the option to store in the chiller for another occasion or you can grill, bake or fry them right away.

Now we can work on the a gravy, that will complement your burger. Get your pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Throw in the onion and garlic and sauté them until the onion is translucent and the garlic is golden in color. Pour in the cream, water, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, and Knorr Chicken Cube last. Just mix these well, season with pepper, and that’s it!

Serve the gravy with the burger and see how your family will truly be grateful for you. You will be loved for serving them this wonderful burger recipe and for spending time with them as you eat all together.

name: Cheesy Chili Con Carne Stuffed Bell Peppers Recipe
description: This dish is made of a pinoy-style chili con carne stuffed into fresh bell peppers topped with cheese, baked to perfection.
tips: Before starting your preparations, make sure that you pre heat your oven to 375F.
instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion and garlic. Sauté until you can smell the lovely aroma from the cooked vegetables. Now, gently add the ground beef and cook it until it’s brown in color.

Add the carrots next with the red beans, cayenne pepper, brown sugar and paprika. Now here’s where you’ll get that great flavour. Add in the water, Knorr Kaldereta Recipe Mix and Knorr Beef Cube. And that’s our chilli con version! Just allow this to simmer until the sauce thickens.

Now that we have our stuffing ready, let’s make the container of bell peppers. Cut off the tops of the bell peppers and take out the seeds making them hollow. Stuff the bell peppers with the prepared chilli con beef mixture, top with grated cheese and place in a preheated oven and bake until cheese is bubbly. And that’s our dish!
When you come home and try new dishes your mom cooks, you will truly love her more. Cheese Chili Con Carne Stuffed Bell Peppers is so delicious!

name: Chorizo Rice with Mushroom and Egg Recipe
description: This fried rice recipe combines the flavors of sweet and salty chorizo, fresh flavors of mushroom and egg, infused with garlic, onion and pork aromatics.
tips: For nicer consistency with the fried rice, use cold and leftover rice instead of newly cooked rice. It will be easier to separate and decrease the chances of rice being mushy and lumpy.
instructions: Begin by grabbing a pan and making it nice and hot. Pour some oil and throw in the onion and garlic. Sauté until the onion is translucent and the garlic is golden in color before adding the chorizo.
Next, sauté and break the Knorr Pork Cube into smaller pieces and mix this into the pan with the rice, until well incorporated.
For the last step, mix in the mushrooms and scrambled eggs and this dish is done.
Your family will truly appreciate you for serving them this Chorizo Rice with Mushroom and Egg recipe. It’s just packed with a mighty punch of flavor.
categories: PH COVID EASY PANTRY HACK LUNCH

name: Creamy Pork Adobo Recipe
description: This dish uses the classic taste of traditional adobo infused with the creamy and sweet flavor and texture of milk giving it a totally unique taste.
tips: When cooking adobo, remember that after adding the vinegar, do not cover the pan or stir the mix. Let the dish continue to simmer uncovered so that the metallic taste and aroma coming from the raw vinegar will evaporate.

ingredients.item: hardboiled eggs and toasted garlic, for garnish

instructions: There’s always joy in cooking adobo. Not only because it’s easy to do but also because you know that whatever the variation is, the outcome will always be delicious.

Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion and garlic. Sauté until the onion is translucent and the garlic is golden in color. Now, drop in the sliced liempo and sauté until cooked through.

Pour in the water together with the soy sauce, evaporated milk and Knorr Pork Cube next before adding the vinegar. Let this simmer, without covering and without stirring. If you cover the pan and stir the mixture you will end up tasting the acid and metallic taste of raw vinegar.
After it has simmered for at least 15 minutes, that’s the time you can stir. Season to with salt and pepper to taste. That's it.
With a slice of hardboiled eggs and toasted garlic, you will have a hard time moving on from the deliciousness of this dish.

name: Pinoy-Style Creamy Spaghetti Recipe
description: This Filipino-style spaghetti brings together the sweet, creamy flavors that many Pinoys grow up loving and craving. In this creamy spaghetti recipe, ground pork simmers in a rich tomato sauce enriched with evaporated milk. It’s a comforting favorite that fits just as easily on everyday tables as it does at birthdays and special celebrations.

ingredients.item: chopped fresh basil and grated cheese, for garnish

instructions: Sauté Onion and Garlic Heat a pan over medium-high heat and add oil. Sauté the onion and garlic until the onion turns translucent and the garlic becomes lightly golden and fragrant.
Brown the Ground Pork Add ground pork and cook while breaking it apart with a spoon. Sauté for about 8 minutes or until fully cooked and no longer pink.

Simmer the Creamy Tomato Sauce Pour in the tomato sauce and evaporated milk. Add Knorr Pork Cubes and dried basil. Stir well to dissolve the seasoning and simmer gently until the sauce thickens into a smooth tomato cream sauce. Tip: Keep the heat at a gentle simmer, not a rapid boil, to prevent the milk from curdling and to maintain a smooth, creamy texture.
Combine and Serve Pour the creamy pasta sauce over the cooked spaghetti noodles and toss until evenly coated. Top with grated cheese and fresh basil. Serve hot.

name: Ginisang Monggo with Sotanghon Recipe
description: This simple and delicious dish uses the fresh and earthy taste of monggo beans mixed with clear sotanghon noodles served in a shrimp and fish flavored broth.
tips: When boiling the monggo beans, make sure to remove the froth and beans floating on top to keep the soup clear of impurities and dirt.

ingredients.item: dried munggo (mung beans), washed and drained

instructions: Let's start with the monggo seeds. Prepare a pot that’s big enough to cook the monggo in and fill it with water just to cover them. Bring this to a boil, make sure to remove the froth and beans floating on top. Reduce the heat to low and cook until the beans have softened and skin bursts. Remove from heat and set aside.
Next, we work on the sothanghon soup. Get another medium sized pot and turn your heat into medium before pouring the oil. Toss in the onions and garlic and cook them until they are light in color.

Throw in the tomatoes and cook this for about 3-5 minutes. Once the tomatoes are soft, you may throw in the shrimps but make sure to cook this for about 2 minutes only or once the color turns pink because shrimps cook quickly.

In the soup pot, Add Knorr Fish Cubes and cooked mung bean including liquid. Bring to a boil. Add sotanghon and cook for 3 to 5 minutes or until noodles are softened and translucent. Season with fish sauce and pepper. Turn off heat then add in the dahon ng ampalaya. Season well with salt and pepper.

name: Grilled Pork Skewers with Green Chili Recipe
description: This classic snack recipe uses the flavors of pork marinated in soy sauce, sugar, chili and sweet coconut milk sauce. Grilled for added taste and texture.
tips: Make sure that the bbq sticks have been soaked in water for 1 hour before using them. This will prevent the stick from burning once it touches the hot coal.

ingredients.item: pork kasim, sliced into thin strips / pieces
Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix, dissolved in 1 cup water

instructions: Make this often at home not only on special occasions but as a mainstay on your family table. It’s easy to do and the outcome is just fantastic.

First, you need to make the marinade for your pork. Just bring everything together in a bowl, mix them well until free of lumps before you soak the pork strips in. Now, let the flavors develop by leaving it for 30 minutes only.
When 30 minutes is done, you may start threading the pieces of meat in the soaked bbq sticks.
Get your grill nice and hot using charcoal or you may do stove top grilling. Place the pork slices on top and grill to cook. Serve with grilled chili. Enjoy!

name: Laing Pizza Recipe
description: This dish combines the classic taste of laing with flavor coming from the pork strips, laing leaves, coconut milk and ginger, topped in a pizza style crust.
tips: When adding the toppings to the crust, do not add too much liquid to prevent the crust from being soggy and mushy after baking. Just add enough sauce to give the pizza the rich flavor and added spice.
instructions: Begin by getting a pan and make it nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion, garlic and ginger. Give this a quick sauté until the vegetables give off a nice aroma before adding the pork strips.

When the pork strips are already brown, pour in the water and Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix with the shrimp. At this point, throw in the laing leaves and just allow this to simmer until the sauce is thick. Set this aside first to cool.

Now that our topping is ready, let’s assemble the pizza. Get your pizza tray ready and lay the pizza crust over. Spread a layer of laing on the pizza dough and arrange the shrimp and pork pieces on top. Cover them with a generous amount of grated cheese and scatter the siling sigang around. Now bake the pizza in a pre-heated oven until the cheese starts to bubble and that’s it. Our Laing Pizza is done!
I know you can’t wait to try this dish but just leave it for at least 5 minutes to cool down before slicing them. You will be totally speechless when you finally try this recipe.

name: Longganisa Breakfast Casserole Recipe
description: This Pinoy style casserole uses the rich flavor of pork longganisa combined with the flavors and textures of potatoes, bell pepper and cheese.
tips: Make sure to preheat your oven to 350F before you start preparing for the dish. Preheating your oven and allowing it time to reach the correct temperature before you put anything in it is possibly the single most important thing you can do when you are baking.

ingredients.item: onion halved then sliced 1/4 inch thick
white bread /wheat bread (preferably stale or day old), cut into cubes
medium potatoes, boiled, peeled and diced

instructions: Let’s begin by getting your skillet nice and hot over medium heat. Pour a bit of olive oil and throw the onion in. Cook until the onion is translucent before adding the longganisa meat next. Stir and break the pieces to a crumble and cook until brown in color.
Once that’s done, you may pour in the milk and Knorr Pork/Beef Cube and just allow this to boil once then simmer for 2-3 minutes only. Just leave it in the pan to cool slightly.

Let’s continue by preparing the casserole. In another bowl, whisk together the eggs, mustard, Italian seasoning and half of the grated cheese. Now, drop in the bread with the potatoes, green bell pepper and the longganisa mixture. Just give this a dash of salt and pepper according to your preference.

Our dish is almost done. Just transfer the mixture in a baking dish, cover with the remaining cheese on top and bake in a 350F pre-heated oven for 30-40 minutes. Just add chopped spring onions on top and that’s it! This dish is done!
Taste and see what we mean when you try this Longganisa Breakfast Casserole Recipe. You will definitely crave for more.

name: Paksiw na Salmon sa Gata Recipe
description: This dish combines the fresh seafood flavor of Salmon cooked in a tangy vinegar marinate mixed with the sweet coconut milk based sauce.
tips: Salmon is a great source of protein that helps the promote good bone and muscle health; and it is a good source of Omega-3 fatty acids that keep the heart healthy.

ingredients.item: salmon, cut into 1 inch thick pieces
finger sized luyang dilaw or turmeric, sliced into strips
Knorr Ginataang Gulay Complete Recipe Mix dissolved in 1 cup water

instructions: First, get a medium sized pot and make it nice and warm over medium heat, and gently add and sauté the salmon slices, skin side down.
Throw in the onion, garlic, vinegar, water, sili, salt and pepper. Bring this to a boil.
Let the liquid reduce in half before adding the luyang dilaw and dissolved Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix.
Simmer for 10-15 minutes and that’s our dish. When your mom serves you this simple Paksiw na Salmon sa Gata, you will surely thank her for it! Give her a big warm hug as a sign of gratitude.

name: Pata Beans Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich flavors of pork pata mixed with the textures of white bean, rich flavor of chorizo de bilbao, and tangy tomato sauce.
tips: Be careful when working with the pressure cooker, don't overfill the pressure cooker to prevent it from exploding due to pressure. The steam must have enough space to build and an escape route.

ingredients.item: pata (pressure cooked with onion, garlic, and bay leaf)

instructions: Let's start by tenderizing the pata using the pressure cooker. Place the pork pata in the pressure cooker, add water and salt. Place in the 1 pc onion, 1 head garlic and 1 pc bay leaf). Close the lid and cook for 45-50 minutes, release steam and carefully open the lid.
Now, we can work on the stew. Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Throw in the onion and garlic and sauté them until the onion is translucent and the garlic is golden in color.

Gently place the tenderized pata in together with the broth, Knorr Pork Cube, white beans, tomato paste, and chorizo de bilbao. Let this simmer until the ingredients and flavors are well incorporated. With a dash of pepper this dish is done!
Wait until you see the reaction on your family’s faces when they taste this Pata Beans Recipe. This will surely become one of their favourites.

name: Pinoy Tacos Recipe
description: This dish has the savory rich beef flavors with fresh flavors and textures of vegetables. Ideal for snack time or can be enjoyed through out the day.
tips: For tacos, it is recommended that you use white onion instead of red onions. White onions will have a milder onion flavor and smell, as compared to red onions.

ingredients.item: (45 g) Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Kaldereta dissolved in 1 cup water
small lettuce or red cabbage, shredded

instructions: This dish is easy to do, just follow these simple steps and you’ll find your family members hanging out in the kitchen to look for more.
Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onions and garlic. Sauté until the onion is translucent and the garlic is golden in color.
Gently add the ground beef, Knorr Beef Cube, bell peppers and just sauté until the meat and vegetables are cooked through. Season to taste with Knorr Liquid Seasoning.

Now that our filling is done, let’s assemble these delicious tacos. First, you need to fill the taco shells with the ground beef. Then place equal amounts of onions, lettuce or cabbage, singkamas and cheese into each shell and that’s it!
Pinoy Tacos is just one of those dishes that will bring you more bonding time at the table. Make memories with even more memorable food!

name: Pork and Chorizo Salpicado Recipe
description: This dish combines the flavorful taste of chorizo mixed with the rich taste of Knorr marinated pork liempo cooked with garlic, tomatoes and spices.
instructions: A perfect dish that you can whip up any time of the day or week! It will definitely satisfy. Begin by marinating your pork liempo in Knorr Liquid Seasoning for 10 minutes.
Now, get a skillet or big pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some annatto oil and sauté pork liempo until slightly brown or cooked through but not dry. Set this aside.
Using the same pan, sauté garlic, chorizo and tomatoes. Drop in the pork and season with ground black pepper and finish it off with Knorr Liqiuid Seasoning. And that’s our dish!
A comfort dish on its own! You can eat this every day. It’s just so delicious.

name: Pork and Potato Curry Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich taste of pork mixed with the flavorful coconut milk based thick sauce tossed with potatoes, bell peppers and curry powder.
tips: When cooking with coconut milk, remember to monitor the heat and avoid boiling the sauce or liquid for a long period, keep the heat at a simmer to prevent the coconut milk from breaking.

ingredients.item: pork kasim cut into large cubes
red and green bell peppers, cut into large dice

instructions: Here’s a tip how you can maximize the flavour of your spice. In this case, it’s curry powder. Toast the curry powder for about 1 minute, using in a dry pan, to release its natural oil. Then remove and set aside.

Now, get your pan nice and hot over medium heat and pour some oil. Add the pork cubes and cook for around 5 minutes, or until outer skin turns brown, before adding the water. Throw in the Knorr Pork Cubes and toasted curry powder.

Add the potatoes only when the pork is half done. Next, pour in the Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix and bring this to a simmer for a few minutes before adding the bell peppers. Give this a good 3-4 minutes more and this dish is done!

name: Pork Curry Recipe
description: This dish will play with your senses given the mix of flavors and aroma coming from the savory chicken, roasted aromatics and the creamy spiced sauce.
tips: To bring out the best flavor in your curry spices, you need to dry fry or toast them in a pan without oil to bring out the essential. Once you’re done toasting them, set this aside and proceed to making the curry using the same pan.
instructions: In a pan, over medium heat, throw in the onion and garlic with olive oil. Cook until the onion is translucent and garlic is golden in color. Now, add the liempo next and sauté until cooked through.

Pour the water into the mixture, with the curry powder, evaporated milk, bell pepper, potato, carrot, okra, spinach and siling labuyo. Just stir the mixture and let this simmer until the vegetables are fully cooked. There, this dish is done!
Serve Pork Curry to your family and they will surely insist that you make it more often.

name: Pork Kikiam in Rice Paper with Sweet Chili Sauce Recipe
description: This simple dish uses the rich taste of pork combined with spices and fresh vegetables; wrapped in rich paper; fried and served with sweet chili sauce.
tips: You can chill the pork kikiam mix, for around 10 minutes, before rolling them in the paper rolls to keep firm and prevent it from breaking.

ingredients.item: rice paper (rub/place some water to soften)

instructions: Pork Kikiam is one of those versatile dishes that you can do at home. It’s fast and easy and big on flavour too.
Let’s begin by combining the pork, five spice powder, carrots, onions, peppers, corn starch and Knorr Liquid Seasoning in a large bowl. Mix well until all ingredients are well incorporated.
Next, place about 1 ½ tbsp (20-22g) pork mixture in the rice paper and roll them. And then, just shallow fry them in hot oil.

Now that the kikiam is done, let’s continue in making the sauce. Just mix all the ingredients in a pot and let it simmer for 5 minutes. Pour in the slurry to thicken it then serve this along-side with the fried Pork Kikiam.

name: Pork with Sausage and Cheese Recipe
description: This simple dish uses the rich flavor of Knorr marinated pork strips combined with sausages cooked in a tangy tomato sauce, topped with cheese and pickles.
tips: When marinating, you can place the pork strips in a resealable plastic bag with the calamansi juice and the Knorr liquid seasoning, and keep it in the chiller to 10 -20 minutes to give it a boost of flavor.
instructions: Begin by marinating the pork in calamansi and Knorr Liquid Seasoning and leave this for 5 to minutes.
Meanwhile, get your pot ready and pour the tomato sauce, water and Knorr Pork Cube and turn the heat to medium and allow the mixture to simmer for a few minutes.

Next, get another pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and pan fry the pork by batch then pour in the tomato mixture. Add the vienna sausage, cheese and pickles last then just let this simmer until the pork is fork tender.
Your family will truly appreciate the variety of dishes you cook for them. They will surely love the delicious taste of this Pork with Sausage and Cheese Recipe.

name: Seafood Pasta Recipe
description: This simple pasta dish combines the rich seafood flavor of fish, shrimps and mussels mixed with garlic flavor infused olive oil tossed in spaghetti pasta.
tips: Good mussels should look wet and smell like the ocean, salty and clean. If they smell a little funky, or many of them appear to be open already, they are not fresh.
instructions: First, get your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some olive oil and melt the butter. Throw in the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent and the garlic is golden in color.

Cook the shrimps, mussels and fish one at a time to avoid the seafood from overcooking. You still want that nice texture from the meat. Once, the seafoods are cooked through, set this aside then add the Knorr Fish Cubes in the pan slowly cook it until dissolved. Return some of the seafood meat in the pan and with a quick stir, mix in the sesame oil, green sili, and the noodles. Swirl to fully coat the pasta with the sauce. And that’s our dish!

Top your pasta with the remaining cooked seafood to make it more appetizing. You will definitely fall in love with this pasta dish. It has all the goodness of the sea – and more! You just got to try it and see what we mean.

name: Shrimp Sinigang Salad Recipe
description: This Asian-inspired dish combines the taste and flavors of garden fresh vegetables, mixed with the buttery shrimps tossed in a tamarind spiced dressing.
tips: For the dressing, you can also place all the ingredients it in a glass bottle or a mason jar with lid to make it easier for you to mix and combine the liquids and the oils together. It will also make easier for storage and serving.

ingredients.item: labanos, peeled and sliced paper thin

instructions: Get your skillet nice and hot over medium heat. Melt butter, throw in the garlic and just sauté until light golden.
Throw in the shrimp and continue sautéing until it turns light pink. This will take about 3-4 minutes. Set aside.

Let’s now make our dressing made by just dissolving Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix in boiling water. Then, let it cool to room temperature. Once cooled, slowly whisk in olive oil and the dried oregano. Give this a good seasoning of salt and pepper.

Let’s plate the dish by serving it in a bowl combined with the mixed greens, tomatoes onions, labanos, olives and the sautéed shrimp on top. Now comes the icing on the cake! Drizzle the dressing over, toss to coat and that’s our dish! Totally yummy and oh so healthy! Serve this any time of the day or week.

name: Sizzling Meaty Tofu Steaks Recipe
description: This resto-style dish combines the crispy texture of fried tofu topped with sautéed pork cooked with fresh vegetables, served in a sizzling plate.
tips: Tofu is made from soybean curds and it contains no cholesterol and is an excellent source of iron and calcium.

ingredients.item: slurry (1/3 cup water plus 1 tbsp cornstarch)
tofu block, cut into smaller cubes

instructions: Begin by making crispy tofu. Prepare 3 shallow trays containing flour, egg and breadcrumbs. Now, coat the tofu cubes first in the flour, then dip it in beaten egg before rolling them in breadcrumbs. When the tofu have been breaded, you can now fry them in hot oil until golden brown. Remove the crispy tofu and place them on top of a plate lined with paper towels to drain out excess oil.

Meanwhile, get another pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and drop in the butter. Add the onion and garlic and sauté until the vegetables give off a nice aroma. Add the pork and cook them until brown. Add the carrots, mushrooms and Knorr Liquid Seasoning next.
Pour in the slurry mixture and just stir continuously until the sauce thickens. Give this a nice seasoning of pepper.
Finally, for that added drama, heat a sizzling plate on top of a stove over high heat and place the fried tofu in. Pour the prepared pork-sauce over and garnish with sliced leeks on top.
Why go to a restaurant when you can have this exciting Sizzling Meaty Tofu Steak at the comfort of your own home? It’s just so delicious!

name: Spicy Shrimp and Chorizo Pasta Recipe
description: This simple and delicious oil based pasta dish combines the rich flavor of chorizo mixed with the fresh taste of shrimp tossed with sautéed garlic and chili.
tips: Extra Virgin Olive oil contains large amounts of antioxidants that are heart healthy and reduce the risk of chronic disease.

ingredients.item: chopped parsley and grated parmesan for garnish

instructions: Delicious food doesn’t have to be complicated to make. Take this dish as an example. This pasta recipe is fast and easy to do.

First, grab a pan and get it nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour olive oil and butter and throw in your garlic. Cook this until it is brown before adding the shrimps, chorizo and Knorr Chicken Cube.
When the shrimps and chorizo are cooked through, mix in the mushrooms, siling labuyo, and noodles. Toss this well and top with parsley and parmesan before serving.
When you serve this Spanish-inspired pasta dish to your family, they will surely be left speechless.

name: Stir Fried Ground Pork with Beans Recipe
description: This simple and delicious dish combines the garden fresh flavor of green beans mixed with the rich flavor of beef infused with the taste of Knorr seasoning.
tips: Green beans are a great source of calcium and vitamin K, both nutrients are there to help maintain strong and health bones and teeth.

ingredients.item: ⅛ kg Baguio beans, cut into half

instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Add oil and sauté the garlic until it gives a nice aroma before adding the ground pork. Make sure to season well with Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Now, just cook this for about 5 to 7 minutes before adding the baguio beans.
Cook for an additional 4 minutes once you added the baguio beans. Then, season with pepper and sugar and that’s our dish! You can add some garlic chips on top for that added flavour.
When you serve Stir Fried Ground Pork with Beans, your family will truly be reminded of home.

name: Asian Fried Chicken Wings Recipe
description: This Asian style dish uses the rich flavor of chicken infused with Knorr flavors tossed in an asian sweet sauce topped with sesame seed.
tips: Make sure you are using the appropriate pan. A deep fryer or a deep casserole with a wide lid will suffice. Choose the right cooking oil, or a type of oil that has a high smoke point. Make sure that the chicken has no amount of moisture or water or you will certainly make a splatter.

ingredients.item: slurry (cornstarch dissolved in water), as needed
white sesame seeds, toasted for garnish

instructions: In order to have flavourful chicken wings, you need to first marinate it in Knorr Liquid Seasoning and black pepper and leave this for 10-15 minutes. Dredge the chicken wings with a combination of a flour and cornstarch mixture and store this in the chiller for later use.

The second step is to prepare the glaze by pouring the oyster sauce, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, chilli sauce, white sugar and sesame oil in a saucepan and bring this up to a simmer. Pour the slurry to thicken.
Before deep frying the chicken, pat the chicken wings to remove excess moisture and marinate to prevent it from splattering when adding it to the fryer.

Get a deep pot, add frying oil and preheat the oil and prepare the chicken wings for frying. Gently slide the chicken wings in and cook until the chicken is brown. Drain excess oil and place into a mixing bowl. Pour a little sauce over and toss and swirl the chicken to fully coat it well.
With a sprinkle of sesame seeds and spring onions, you can now enjoy this Asian Fried Chicken Wings with the family.

name: Bacon and Garlic Pasta Recipe
description: This simple dish uses the rich taste of bacon mixed with garlic infused olive oil and butter, tossed in spaghetti noodles, topped with fresh basil.
tips: Remember to cook your pasta "al dente", firm but you are able to into bite into it.
instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour 1/2 tablespoon of olive oil and render oil from the bacon. Set aside when cooked.
Melt the butter and add the rest of the olive oil. Throw in the garlic next and just sauté until golden in color.
Drop in the Knorr Chicken Cube and dissolve. Finally, toss the bacon, basil and noodles in the mix and that’s our dish!
This Bacon and Garlic Pasta recipe is meant to be shared with others. Truly, something as delicious as this should not be kept secret.
categories: PH COVID EASY PANTRY HACK DINNER

name: Baked Mac Chicken and Cheese Recipe
description: This heart healthy baked dish has a right balance of flavors and textures from the savory chicken, melted mozzarella cheese and creamy white sauce.
tips: Mozzarella contains probiotics that are good to your health, fights inflammation, improves your immunity, and good for your digestion.
instructions: This Mac and Cheese version cooks in an instant and will definitely be a crowd pleaser. Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over high heat and pour in the olive oil with two tablespoons of butter. Throw in the garlic and cook until golden in color before adding the chicken breast.
When the chicken breast is cooked through, pour in the cream, spinach, Knorr Chicken Cubes and the cooked macaroni noodles.

Now comes the exciting part, transfer the macaroni in a Pyrex dish or any ovenproof baking dish then top with a combination of mozzarella and cheddar cheese. See what happens to the cheese when you bake this in a preheated oven for 10 minutes.
This Baked Mac Chicken and Cheese is the ultimate comfort food. Treat yourself every once in a while to dish tummy-warming dish!

name: Braised Chicken in Tomato Sauce Recipe
description: This simple dish uses the rich flavor of slow cooked chicken braised in tomato sauce mixed with mushrooms, infused with spices and flavors.
tips: You can cook this dish using a single pot. This dish is simple to make and very delicious.
instructions: Let's start by getting a pan nice and hot and over high heat, then pour the oil. Throw in the onions and sauté for 1-2 minutes.
Adding the chicken and sear until the meat turns light brown in color. Pour the tomato sauce, water and the Knorr Chicken Cube.
Add the garlic powder, pepper, cayenne and dried thyme to infuse more flavors into the dish. Bring this to a simmer until the chicken is tender.
Throw in the mushrooms at the last minute to prevent it from getting mushy. Give this a few minutes to simmer.
Share a priceless moment with your family when together you indulge in this braised chicken in tomato sauce dish. Good times like these will be remembered forever.

name: Butter Chicken Recipe
description: Surprise the whole family with the exotic flavors of India. Butter Chicken becomes easy with the help of Knorr Chicken Cubes! Check out this Knorr recipe here!
tips: When searing the chicken, pour a little bit of oil to prevent the butter from burning.You can also use olive oil when searing to add more flavors to the butter and increase the health benefits of the dish. Olive oil contains large amounts of antioxidants that help reduce diseases.

ingredients.item: boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces

instructions: Begin by seasoning the chicken with salt and pepper. The next step is to prepare a large pan and get it nice and hot. Melt 1 tablespoon of butter and pour a little bit of oil to prevent the butter from burning. Fry the chicken until golden brown or for about 4 minutes. You may do this in batches because overcrowding the pan with the chicken lowers the heat and the chicken bleeds off moisture, thus preventing it from becoming brown. Remove the chicken and set this aside.

In the same pan, throw in the onion and cook this for about 8 minutes, stirring frequently until it becomes tender. Sprinkle the cumin, ginger and garlic and cook until you can smell the lovely aroma from the spices. Give this a good 30 seconds.

Next is to pour tomato sauce and 1/2 cup water and bring this to a boil over medium-high heat before throwing in the Knorr Chicken Cubes. When the sauce is slightly thickened after continuously stirring it for about 5 minutes, it’s now time to stir in the cream and cook for about 3 minutes or until it is slightly reduced.
Gently slide the chicken back to the pan and simmer until cooked through. Stir in kale, if using.

Topping this dish with a good sprinkle of chopped cilantro will surely be a delight. Wait and see the reaction on your family’s faces when they try this mouth-watering Butter Chicken being served at the table.

name: Chicken Breakfast Casserole Recipe
description: This classic dish uses the rich taste of chicken combined with the flavors of bacon, mushrooms and milk, topped with breadcrumbs and extra cheese for texture.
tips: Remember to pre-heat your oven to 350F before starting with any of the preparations. This will ensure that the oven is already at the recommended heating temp when putting in the baking dish.

ingredients.item: chicken thigh, deboned and large diced
button mushroom, cut cut it into half

instructions: Prepare a pan and get this nice and hot over medium high heat. Throw in the butter and pour in some oil to prevent the butter from burning. Throw in the bacon, carrots, potatoes and chicken thigh before adding the Knorr Chicken Cube and button mushrooms. Cook this for a good 5 minutes and then transfer it to a casserole or baking dish.

For that added taste, mix the beaten egg and milk together in a bowl and use this mixture to pour over the chicken in the casserole. For that winning final touch, top the casserole with breadcrumbs and a generous amount of grated cheese.
Bake this for 25-30 minutes until the cheese turns brown. You need not wait for breakfast because this Chicken Breakfast Casserole is perfect any time of the day. Yummy and addicting!

name: Chicken Pesto Zucchini Pasta Recipe
description: This simple and delicious dish combines the fresh flavor of chicken mixed with creamy pesto sauce tossed with cherry tomatoes, served with zucchini pasta.
tips: Zucchini is rich in antioxidants that help protect your body from chronic diseases and gives protection from certain types of diseases.
instructions: Heat oil in pan over medium heat and add the thinly sliced garlic. Cook until just starting to brown and remove from pan. Drain on paper towels. Set aside.
In the same pan, sauté minced garlic and onions until onion is a bit tender and translucent.
Add left over roast chicken and cook for a few minutes until lightly browned. Add pesto, cream, chili sauce, cherry tomatoes and Knorr Chicken Cube. Reduce heat to low and simmer for a few minutes.
Mix the sauce and the zucchini pasta then top with thin garlic slices and slivered almonds.

name: Chicken Rice Balls Recipe
description: This simple and delicious appetizers dish uses the rich taste of chicken flavored rice mixed with sautéed ground chicken with added stuffed cheese.
tips: Remember to place the coated chicken balls in the chiller to at least 10-15 minutes to let the breadcrumbs to set and stick with the chicken balls before frying.

ingredients.item: Knorr Chicken stock (water and ½ pc Knorr Chicken Cube)

instructions: It only takes three steps to cook this easy to follow rice balls recipe. For rice that’s more flavourful, you need to cook your batch of rice in the Knorr Chicken stock. Set aside.

Now, grab a pan and turn the heat to high. Pour a bit of oil and throw in the onions before adding the ground chicken and Knorr Chicken Cube. Sauté until the chicken is cooked through. Remove from heat and set aside to cool.

Get a bowl and place the flavored cooked rice and chicken together. Mix them well and form into a ball. Stuffed the mozzarella cheese inside. Dredge the balls in flour, dip in beaten egg and roll in breadcrumbs. Place in the chiller for 10 mins to set. Deep fry them in hot oil until the outer crust becomes brown and crisp.
Whether it’s a snack or an appetizer, these Chicken Rice balls will be the talk of the whole family all day long.

name: Chicken Roulade Recipe
description: This dish uses the rich flavor of chicken infused with Knorr flavorings, stuffed with the sweet flavor of ham and creamy texture of cheese.
tips: Remember to let the meat rest for at least 5 minutes after baking, this will make it more flavorful and juicy. Resting will force the meat to reabsorb the liquids and flavors from within the meat.
instructions: In order to have really flavourful chicken, you need to first marinate them in garlic, Knorr Liquid Seasoning and black pepper for 15 minutes.

Place ham and cream cheese on the chicken fillets and roll. Tie a string around the chicken and make a knot on each end to prevent the filling from escaping. Now, it’s time to dredge this in flour and brown this over high heat on a very hot pan.
Finally, you can bake this in the oven for 20-25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.

Take note, though, that you should not slice the roulade right away after taking it out from the oven. You need to rest and cool it a little bit to prevent the juices from spilling out. Then, you may remove the tie and carefully slice them diagonally and serve.
There’s always something to celebrate and with Chicken Roulade, it’s bonding and eating with the family.

name: Chili Rice with Sausage Bits Recipe
description: This fried rice dish combines the rich flavors of chili con carne combined with sautéed Hungarian sausage bits flavored topped with cheese for full flavor.
tips: Beans are rich in polyphenols, which are a type of antioxidant, that help the body fight off free radicals which cause cell damage can result in various diseases.
instructions: Let’s begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour in the oil and throw in the onion and garlic. Sauté until the onion is translucent and the garlic is golden in color.
It’s time to add the sausage next with the chili con carne, and Knorr Pork Cube. Just sauté the meat until it is cooked through.
Finally, just gently mix the rice in until well incorporated. See how simple this is! Now with a topping of cheese, it will make your dish more tasty.
When you serve this Chili Rice with Sausage Bits Recipe to your family, we’re pretty sure it will be gone in 5 minutes.

name: Creamy Pasta with Grilled Chicken Recipe
description: The dish uses the sweet taste of caramelized onions and the tangy flavor or tomatoes mixed with the chicken-infused cream sauce, served with linguini noodles.
tips: Remember to save some of the pasta water. Using a little bit of pasta water is the key to making smooth, restaurant-level sauces.
instructions: Get a pan and make sure it’s nice and hot and turn heat to medium. Pour the olive oil and melt the butter. Then, put the onion first and throw in the garlic next. Gently sauté the onion until it is translucent and until the garlic is golden brown.
The next step is to pour the all-purpose cream, Knorr Chicken Cube and the tomato. Stir gently and cook this over low heat.

Place the noodles in the pan and with a tossing and swirling motion, coat the pasta with the sauce. Sprinkle some chopped basil on top and see what happens next when you serve this creamy pasta with a serving of grilled chicken. Your family will surely have a good time eating this tummy-satisfying dish.
categories: PH COVID EASY PANTRY HACK DINNER

name: Creamy Peanut Pasta Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich taste of chicken with the creamy flavor and texture of the peanut butter infused pasta sauce, topped with sesame seeds.
tips: Peanut Butter is a good source of Omega-6 fatty acids which lowers bad cholesterol, and increase the protective cholesterol in the body.

ingredients.item: toasted sesame seeds and chopped leeks for garnish

instructions: This is such an easy dish to prepare. First, you’ve got to get your pan nice and hot over medium heat, then pour in the olive oil and butter. Throw in the garlic and onion and cook until the onion is translucent and the garlic is golden brown.
It’s now time to add the chicken and Knorr Chicken Cube. Then, you can cook this until the meat is done.
Gently stir in the cream, peanut butter, and noodles and give this a good toss.
With some chopped toasted sesame seeds on top and a sprinkle of chopped leeks, you’ll never guess that something as good as this was prepared and cooked at home.

name: Creamy Rice with Chicken and Shrimp Recipe
description: Learn how to cook creamy rice with this easy-to-follow recipe combining chicken, shrimp, bell peppers, onions, and a Knorr Chicken Cube.
tips: It is recommended that you use cold, leftover cooked rice. Rice left in the fridge overnight will be firmer, making it easier to cook and to separate. It will also prevent the fried rice to become mushy and lumpy.
instructions: Make this creamy and delicious dish in an instant. For the first step, you’ve got to get your pan nice and hot over medium heat and throw in the onion and garlic. Then, cook until the onion is translucent and the garlic is golden brown.
The next step is to place the chicken, shrimps and Knorr Chicken Cube into the pan and sauté until cooked through.
Lastly, gently stir in the all-purpose cream, bell pepper and rice. Mix well until all ingredients are fully incorporated.
With a little love and creativity, this simple Creamy Rice Chicken and Shrimp dish will surely impress your family.

name: Ginataang Mais Recipe
description: This simple and heart healthy dessert recipe combines the creamy taste of coconut milk mixed with the sweet and fresh flavors of corn and malunggay.
tips: Coconut Milk aids in strengthening the immune system. It contains lauric acids that assists the body in fighting infections caused by virus and bacteria.
instructions: This dish is so easy to make. You just need to make your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Melt the butter and throw in the onion and garlic.
Next, add in the corn then the 1 cup water with the Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix. Stir well and allow to simmer until it thickens.
Remove from heat and add in dahon ng malunggay, season with pepper and that’s our dish. Usually, it’s the simple dishes that have the most flavour. This dish proves itself worthy and more!

name: Ginataang Manok sa Luyang Dilaw Recipe
description: This classic dish uses the fresh and spiced taste of yellow ginger combined with the rich flavors of chicken, simmered in a sweet coconut milk based soup.
tips: Luyang Dilaw (Trumeric) is full of antioxidants the are proven to improve the immune function. It also has antiviral and antibacterial properties.

ingredients.item: (45g) pack Knorr Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix dissolved in 3 cups water

instructions: It will only take you 3 steps to cook this delicious and simple recipe. Begin by getting a pan and making sure it’s nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the garlic and luyang dilaw. Then, briefly sauté this before adding the chicken thigh. You may cook this for about 5 minutes.
Next, pour the dissolved Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix, Knorr Chicken Cubes and papaya then let this cook to a simmer until almost tender.
Next, add finger chilli and top with chilli leaves once the chicken is cooked through.
You will put more smiles onto your family’s faces when you serve this with a big bowl of rice because Ginataang Manok sa Luyang Dilaw is home!

name: Chicken in Lemongrass Sticks with Chili Peanut Sauce
description: This Thai recipe combines the fresh flavors of chicken infused with Knorr flavors, grilled on lemongrass stick and served with peanut sauce.
tips: Don't move the food around the grill too much. If the meat is stuck to the grills, let it cook a little more. It will naturally release itself once it is ready to be flipped. Remember to have a spray bottle with water handy just in case of any flare-ups when cooking.
instructions: Begin by making a cocktail sized style pattie, about 2” long by combining ground chicken, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, pepper and flour altogether.

Next, make the paste by throwing all the paste ingredients in the blender or food processor until you come up with a smooth paste consistency. Now, divide this paste mixture into 2, adding the first half to the ground chicken while reserving the other half for the sauce.

Mold the ground chicken mixture and the paste together and place them onto the lemon grass sticks. Form and shape the patties into 2 inch logs then store them in the chiller for at least 5 minutes to hold their shape.

Prepare the peanut sauce by cooking the remaining paste in a hot pan with a tablespoon of oil. Pour the water, Knorr Chicken Cubes, and peanut butter in. Lastly, flavour it with Knorr Liquid Seasoning.

Now, it’s time to get your grill pan nice and hot and brush it with a little bit of oil to prevent the chicken from sticking. Cook the chicken over medium heat until you get a nice browning on the outside. Serve this with the peanut sauce.
Bring Thai food straight to your home. With Ground Chicken in Lemongrass Sticks, you can’t help but love your mom for it.

name: Pineapple Curry Fried Rice Recipe
description: This Thai inspired rice dish uses the sweet and tangy flavors of pineapple mixed with the creamy curry and coconut milk, enhanced with Knorr Chicken flavors.
tips: Pineapples are not only full of flavors and is a great source of fiber. It is also rich in antioxidants that help the body fight chronic inflammation and diseases, strengthens the immune system and helps in the digestion.
instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and sauté garlic and onions.
Add sitaw and pineapple (with juice). Cook until sitaw is tender before adding Knorr Chicken Cube. Mix until all ingredients are fully dissolved.
Add the 1/2 pack Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix and curry powder. Mix well to incorporate and let the powders dissolve.
Over low heat, add rice into the pan and mix everything. Eat it as is or with your favourite meat dish, whatever the occasion you will find yourself hungry for more.
Eat it as is or with your favourite meat dish, whatever the occasion you will find yourself hungry for more.

name: Sauteed Spicy Chicken Liver Recipe
description: This simple heart healthy dish uses the rich flavor of chicken liver cooked in sauce infused with Knorr Liquid seasoning and oyster sauce, topped with chili.
tips: To prevent chicken liver from tasting bitter and to make sure they cook properly, it's important to clean them correctly before you cook them. Soaking the livers in cold water and then removing any connective tissue will give you clean livers that are ready to cook.
instructions: This fast and easy dish of spicy chicken liver will cook in less than 10 minutes. First, you need to grab a pan and get it nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the garlic and chicken liver. Give this a good 5-6 minutes to cook.
Then, you may pour in the Knorr Liquid Seasoning, oyster sauce, water and sugar! Then, there you go! This dish is done!
With a bowl of rice and topping it more with red chilli and fried garlic, this dish will send you to the moon and back.

Fried Lumpiang Ubod sa Gata Recipe

Pancit Bihon with Pork in Coconut Sauce Recipe

Easy Ginataang Adobo Recipe
description: This classic dish combines the rich flavor of chicken simmered in vinegar and soy sauce, infused with the sweet and creamy taste of Knorr Ginataang Gulay.
tips: After adding the vinegar, let it slowly simmer and do not cover the pan. This process will slowly remove the strong vinegar aroma and lessen the strong vinegar taste.

ingredients.item: (33 g) pack Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix

instructions: Begin by getting a pan and make it nice and hot over high heat. Pour some oil and sear the chicken pieces in until brown. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, throw in the garlic and pour the vinegar. Allow to simmer for a minute without stirring. Wait for the strong vinegar aroma to evaporate.
Gently return the seared chicken pieces and just saute for 3 minutes.
Pour in the soy sauce, bay leaf, peppercorns and Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix dissolved in 500 ml water.
Finally, cover the pan and allow to simmer until the chicken is cooked through. And that's our dish!
When your family sees a serving of Ginataang Adobo on the table, with matching steamed white rice, you know for sure that there will be non stop eating. Its that good!

name: Grilled Chicken Salad with BBQ Mayo Dressing Recipe
description: This heart healthy dish uses the rich taste of chicken marinated in Knorr seasoning, tossed in a salad of fresh greens, served with a savory bbq-mayo dressing
tips: When grilling meats, don't move the meat / food around too much. Let it stay in the grill a little longer to let the meat cook more. It will be easier to remove it and get it unstuck when it is fully cooked.
instructions: Prepare the chicken for grilling by first marinating the breast fillet with Knorr Liquid Seasoning for at least 30 minutes before cooking. Grill each side for 3-5 minutes. Set aside and let it rest for 5 minutes before cutting into strips.

Make the dressing by combining Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise and the store bought barbecue sauce. Pour the dressing over the mixed greens then toss to combine. Top this with tomatoes, cucumber, egg, walnuts, and the grilled chicken strips.
What a reward this dish brings to the table for this salad is a healthy and delicious meal waiting to be enjoyed by the whole family. Tip: Salad is always an added flair to any pasta or fried dish.

name: Simple Yellow Curry Chicken Recipe
description: One of the staples in Asian cooking is this Simple Yellow Curry Chicken made with fragrant herbs, spices and Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix. Try it now!
tips: You may opt to use chicken breast for a leaner meat.

ingredients.item: inch knob ginger, sliced into thin strips
(40 g) pack Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix dissolved, in 480 ml water
red and green bell peppers, cut into cubes

instructions: To make the most out of your chicken, frying it in a little bit of oil over high heat until they are lightly brown will give you a more desirable crust and taste. You may also brown the potatoes and carrots if you wish. Transfer chicken and vegetables on a plate then saute onions, ginger and garlic until they are fragrant.

Once your aromatics are sauteed, put back pre-fried chicken. Pour in dissolved Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay with your vegetables. Now, bring this to a simmer and continue to cook until the chicken and vegetables are tender.

Stir in the curry paste until fully dissolved in the sauce. Throw in your kale, if using, and bell peppers as well. Simmer until you get that nice thick consistency. Top with slices of leeks just before serving. Simple yet packed full of flavour. Chicken Curry is one of those comfort dishes that you will always look forward to when coming home.

name: Simple Garlic Coconut Shrimp Recipe
description: This dish has a nice balance of creaminess from the coconut milk, savory taste from the garlic butter and the rich flavors of the shrimp.
tips: Never let you sauce with coconut milk boil to prevent it from breaking up or curdling, only let it simmer at a lower temp.

ingredients.item: (1 pack) Knorr Ginataang Gulay Complete Recipe Mix

instructions: Delicious recipes need not take a long time to cook. Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat and melt the butter. Throw in the garlic and sauté until you can smell the lovely aroma from the cooked vegetable.
Pour in the Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix that has been mixed with water and gently add to the pan.
Toss the shrimp next and just allow it to simmer until thick and this dish is done! Make sure you have enough space in your stomach because you will definitely eat more than usual.

name: Tasty Poached Cream Dory in Sour Soup Recipe
description: This heart healthy dish uses the rich seafood flavor of cream dory gently poached in a sweet tamarind broth sour soup, topped with capers, celery and tomatoes
tips: Poaching is a moist heat method of cooking by submerging food in some kind of liquid and heating at a low temperature. This is a technique that is used to cook delicate proteins such as fish, chicken, and eggs, as well as some fruits and vegetables.

ingredients.item: (20 g) Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original

instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the celery and tomatoes. Add the capers next.
In goes the water with the Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Original. Let this boil before reducing the heat to a simmer. Cook for 2 minutes.

Gently place the cream dory fillets and poach until cooked through. You may turn off the heat because of residual cooking or at least remember that the heat source should be at the lowest temperature because fish cooks quickly.

Now give your broth a nice seasoning of fish sauce. And that’s our dish! How healthy can you get with this Tasty Poached Creamy Dory in Sour Soup? All you need now is a bowl of rice and the company of your family. Mmm, how yummy!

name: Simpleng Suam na Tulya at Malunggay Recipe | Recipedia
description: This Kapampangan halaan soup with malunggay recipe is rich in flavor from tulya shells, corn & shrimp broth!
tips: Clean & soak the shell in water to expel impurities.
instructions: Clams contain a lot of sand in their shell. So before cooking with them, you need to soak them in a basin filled with water to allow the clams to spit off any impurities. This will take about an hour or more.

Clams indeed give off a very delicious flavour. Here’s how you can maximize the broth of your clams! Get a pot and fill it with water. Place the clams in and allow the water to boil. Once the shells open, turn off the heat and discard clams that won't open. That means the clam is already dead. It’s important that you buy only fresh and live clams. Don’t throw the stock away.

Get a pot and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onions and garlic. Pour the reserved clam stock in, followed by the corn cob. Now, give this a nice boil and drop the Knorr Shrimp Cubes in.
Add the clams back and reduce the heat to low. Let this simmer for 2 minutes before adding the malunggay leaves last. And that’s our dish!
Simple Suam na Tulya’t Malunggay Recipe will make you feel better whatever the weather. Enjoy with the company of your loved ones! It will truly make your day!

name: Easy Steamed Fish with Chilies and Lime Recipe
description: Looking for a healthy and instant seafood recipe? Enjoy the freshness of steamed fish infused with the taste and aroma of Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok broth.
tips: When steaming, you may use banana leaves or aluminum foil to wrap the fish in, to make it easier to handle them once the fish is done cooking.

ingredients.item: (20 g) pack Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Original

instructions: Begin by scoring the fish with a knife then place it in a bowl.
In a large pot, combine together the dissolved Knorr Sinigang Sa Sampalok Original, water and drop those chilies and pour the lime juice in.

Get a heatproof plate and place transfer the fish on top of the spice mix. Add garlic and spring onions on top of the fish and cook in a steamer until the fish is done. With a sprinkle of soy sauce after the fish is cooked, our dish is done!

name: Simple Crispy Laing Pockets Recipe
description: This simple dish combines the fresh and green textures from the taro leaves, with the crispy outer skin from the fried wrappers.
tips: Taro leaves provide a good source of healthy nutrients which help promote good and healthy blood pressure. It is also excellent source of vitamin C and antioxidants.

ingredients.item: (1 pack) pack Knorr Ginataang Gulay Complete Recipe Mix

instructions: Begin by getting a pot and fill it with 1 ½ cups of water. Boil the dried gabi leaves in until it dries up.

Dissolve Knorr Ginataang Gulay Complete Recipe Mix in 2 cups water. Pour the dissolved gata mix into the gabi leaves and the 3 pcs sili, and boil until the mixture thickens. Turn off the heat and let the laing cool then set this aside.
Cut the lumpia wrapper into 3 or 4 strips. Place a spoonful of laing on one strip and carefully fold and wrap in a triangle shape. Seal the triangle wraps with a mixture of water and flour.

Get a fry pan or wok ready, fill it with oil and turn the heat to high. Fry the laing pockets until golden brown. Remove and place on top of a plate lined with paper towels to remove excess oil. And that’s our dish! You will surely love Simple Crispy Laing Pockets. They are good on their own or with rice. Absolutely delicious!

name: Meatless Sotanghon Soup Recipe
description: Looking for a light soup to pair with grilled or fried dishes? Make this meatless sotanghon recipe with Knorr Chicken Cubes, garlic, and carrots.

ingredients.item: sotanghon, soaked for 5 minutes in warm water

instructions: Begin by getting a pan and gently place the atsuete seeds and cooking oil together. Make it sizzle and cook until the seeds turn dark in color. Discard the seeds and throw in the onions and garlic. Sauté until you can smell the lovely aroma from the cooked vegetables.

In goes the 4 cups of water and drop the Knorr Chicken Cubes and sotanghon noodles. Boil for 5 minutes. Remember to soak the sotanghon noodles in water for 5 minutes before putting it in the soup. Spinkle with pepper to season.
