Add the carrots and pechay baguio and simmer for 2-3 minutes and that’s our dish! Soup this delicious need not have meat in it because Knorr Chicken Cubes is all you need to have that real chicken flavour. It’s superb!

name: Vegetable Misua Recipe
description: Looking for a heart-healthy dish? Enjoy the fresh flavors of patola, garlic, and malunggay in this meaty vegetable misua recipe that's light yet filling.
tips: Patola (Ridge Gourd) is a great source of vitamin A, which help prevent macular degeneration or blurring of eyesight. It also has vitamin B5, which lowers bad cholesterol and triglycerides that are great in keeping the heart healthy.
instructions: Here’s another reason why you should cook this dish more often: it’s simple, healthy and nutritious. Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and just throw in the onions and garlic.
Add patola next and sauté until half cooked.
Pour in the water and Knorr Pork Cubes and just bring this to a boil then reduce to a simmer.
Add misua and malunggay leaves last. Mix well and simmer until patola is cooked through. And that’s our dish. Simple yet satisfying! Thank you mom for always serving us what’s good for us.

name: Tasty Aligue Rice Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Tasty Aligue Rice | Knorr
instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the leeks and aligue. Cook for about 2 minutes.
Add Knorr Ginataang Gulay Complete Recipe Mix (Sitaw at Kalabasa) diluted in 1/2 cup of water. Just allow this to simmer until sauce is thickened.
Add cooked rice next and mix this well.
Drizzle some fish sauce to add flavour and top with kani. And that’s our dish! Here’s a meal on its own or paired with your favourite fried dish! You won’t be able to move on, it’s that good!

name: Delicious Beef Loin Salpicao Recipe
description: This simple dish uses the savory and flavorful beef loin cuts mixed with butter, garlic and spices, cooked with some chili to give that added flavor.
tips: When cooking beef, always monitor your heat. Having the heat at a high setting might cook your beef on the outside, yet undercooked on the inside. Medium-low heat is ideal to keep the beef moist and tender.

ingredients.item: beef tenderloin, cut into 1 inch cubes

instructions: You want to know why you should do this more often at home? It’s so easy to do and so good too!
Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and melt the butter. Throw in the garlic and just sauté them until brown.

Turn the heat up and gently add the tenderloin. Pour the worcestershire sauce, paprika, Knorr Liquid Seasoning and red chilli and just sauté until the desired doneness of beef is achieved. And there you have it!
You will keep coming back for more. Beef Loin Salpicao is that delicious!

name: Delicious Chicken Misua Recipe
description: This Asian soup dish combines the rich taste of sautéed Chicken fillet infused with Knorr Liquid Seasoning, simmered in Knorr Nido Oriental soup with misua.
tips: Eggs are rich in several nutrients that promote heart health, such as betaine and choline. Eggs are also regarded as a ‘complete’ source of protein as they contain all nine essential amino acids, which we must obtain from our diet.

ingredients.item: (60 g) pack Knorr Nido Oriental Real Chinese Soup, dissolved in 4 cups water

instructions: To have a more flavourful meat, Marinate the chicken breast in Knorr Liquid Seasoning for at least 30 minutes.
Get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and sauté the garlic before adding the marinated chicken. Sauté for 2 minutes.
Dissolve Knorr Nido Oriental Real Chinese Soup in water and just pour over to the mixture. Gradually add beaten egg to the dish and stir.
Add the misua then simmer slowly for 3 minutes. And that's our dish.
Just before serving, top the dish with spring onions and get ready to enjoy! Delicious Chicken Misua is like home. Warm, comforting and filling. Have one now.

name: Creamy Binalot na Tilapia sa Pechay (Sinanglay) Recipe
description: This dish uses the fresh seafood taste of tilapia mixed with fresh vegetables, wrapped in pechay leaves, simmered in the creamy Knorr Ginataang Gulay mix.
tips: Coconut Milk aids in strengthening the immune system. It contains lauric acids that assists the body in fighting infections caused by virus and bacteria.

ingredients.item: 41g Knorr Ginataang Gulay Complete Recipe Mix

instructions: Begin by marinating tilapia fillet with calamansi juice, salt and pepper for not more than 15 minutes. Something as delicate as fish or seafood need not be seasoned longer than 15 minutes because it can absorb flavors fast. There is also the danger of overcooking the fish meat that comes from the acid and thereby making the fish rubbery and tough once cooked.
While waiting for your fish to flavour, wash the pechay well with water. Get a paper towel and wipe them dry.
Lay the pechay leaves on a plate and arrange the tilapia fillet on top together with the onions and tomatoes. Wrap the pechay and use the lemongrass to tie.
Get a pot that’s big enough to fit the wrapped tilapia fillet. Use this pot and pour in the dissolved Knorr Ginataang Gulay Complete Recipe Mix in 1 1/2 cups water and bring this to a boil.
One by one, slowly arrange the wrapped fish in the pot and cook this covered for 10 minutes.
Your family will truly love you more when they see and taste the care and effort you put into this delicious fish dish wrapped in pechay.

name: Delicious Bulanglang with Saluyot Recipe | Recipedia
description: This bulanglang recipe with saluyot makes veggies deliciously fun!
tips: Saluyot is rich in fiber that helps control blood pressure and diabetes!
instructions: Begin by getting a pot and fill it with water. Over high heat, allow the water to boil and drop in the Knorr Fish Cubes.
Place the kalabasa next together with the gabi, onion, tomatoes, patola, and sigarillas. Cook until vegetables are almost tender.
Gently add fish and bagoong and allow to simmer until the fish is cooked through.
Lastly, top with saluyot leaves and allow to simmer for 2 minutes more.
Season with enough salt and that's our dish. Pair with your favorite fried or grilled meat or eat as is. Bulanglang is home!

name: Quick Moringga Squash Cream Soup Recipe
description: This heart healthy soup dish uses the rich taste of pureed squash combined with the rich taste of Knorr beef broth mixed with cream for extra texture.
tips: Eating Malunggay (Moringa) helps boosts the immune system and help reduce inflammation. Malunggay contains minerals that aid digestion, ensuring that the body totally absorbs the nutrients in our dish.

ingredients.item: squash, small, cut into small cubes

instructions: Get a pot ready and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onions and garlic. Toss in the squash and just allow these to sweat for a minute.
Pour water and bring to a boil then drop the Knorr Beef Cubes and reduce heat to simmer until squash is cooked.
Sprinkle the oregano and simmer for a minute. Transfer the mixture in a blender and puree until smooth.
Return the pureed vegetable back to the pot then add cream and moringga. Mix well and allow it to simmer. The best part comes next and that is to taste the soup if it still needs adjustments.
Now that our dish is done, you can share with the family and savour the delicious flavour of this Quick Moringga Squash Cream Soup Recipe. Have it any day of the week!

name: Make This Comforting Bowl of Classic Sinigang na Bangus using Simple Sinigang na Bangus Ingredients
description: Get a warm bowl of comfort on rainy days with this delicious asim kilig sinigang na bangus recipe using pantry staples.
tips: For an extra depth of flavor, serve this dish with Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili on the side.

ingredients.item: (22 gram) pack Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original

instructions: With only a few simple steps, and with this one pot dish, this healthy and nutritious Sinigang na Bangus cooks your way into your family’s heart. Start by using the water from where you washed your rice, or just fresh water. Pour this into the pot together with the onions and tomatoes. Bring this slowly to a boil then lower the heat to simmer for a few minutes.

First add your radish and okra. Let these boil for 2 minutes. Since fish cooks easily, carefully add the fish and long green chilli and simmer gently until cooked through before adding the Sinigang sa Sampaloc Mix Original and kangkong. Make sure that the scales have been removed to eliminate that “malansa” taste from the fish. Stir and simmer. It should be done in a minute.
All done and it only took 2 steps to cook this dish. Satisfy everyone’s craving by serving this hot and soothing Sinigang na Bangus with enough rice and surely your family will ask for more.

name: Beef Morcon in Herbed Tomato Sauce Recipe
description: This Filipino classic beef dish uses the rich taste if beef sirloin stuffed with a well flavored pork and vegetable mix and egg, served with herb tomato sauce.
tips: When making this dish, make sure that you get the right cut of beef. Grab either the sirloin or a well-trimmed kalitiran.

ingredients.item: kg. beef sirloin, cut roulade- style

instructions: Let’s begin by marinating the beef sirloin in soy sauce mixed with stock, Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Kaldereta, calamansi juice and pepper for at least 4 hours. After 4 hours, just drain and reserve the marinade.

In a bowl, combine the ground pork, pickles, carrot, sausage, raisins and cheese. Now flatten the beef and spread a generous quantity of ground pork then top it with hard boiled eggs. Roll the beef into a log, wrapping the ground pork mix with the egg, then secure it with some kitchen twine.

Dredge the beef roulade in flour so that when you sear it in hot oil it will not stick to the pan and at the same time you’re adding a nice crust to it. Remember to shake off any excess flour! Then sear the beef in hot oil until all sides are evenly brown. Once done, just set this aside.

Using the same pan, in medium heat, throw in the onions and garlic. Pour in the reserved marinade, bay leaves and herbs. Add the seared beef and bring to a boil before reducing the heat to a simmer. Cover and cook until the beef is tender.
If you think your dish is getting a bit too dry, just pour some additional beef stock. Consistency of the liquid should be thick but not dry.
Now that our beef is done, slice them into 1 1/4 inch thick rounds and top with the sauce.
Once you serve this Beef Morcon in Herbed Tomato Sauce recipe, your family will be rushing to give you hugs of gratitude.

name: Fancy Up Your Reunions With This Chicken Pastel Pie Recipe
description: Surprise your friends and family by making this easy chicken pastel pie recipe for your reunion. This simple yet fancy dish will make it a feast to remember.
tips: Some studies suggest that Coconut milk is good for brain health and may help in keeping you focused mentally.

ingredients.item: (33 g) Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay, dissolved in 240 ml water
store bought puff pastry, rolled into 1/2 inch thick sheet

instructions: Heat oil in a pot over medium heat. Add garlic and onions. Sauté until fragrant.
Add chicken and chorizo in the pot. Sauté for one minute.
Next, add carrots and potatoes. Sauté for another minute.
Add the dissolved Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix along with peas, oregano, and spinach, if using. Simmer until thick. While waiting for the sauce to thicken, preheat the oven to 190C.
Lower the heat and add in the cream. Whisk while adding to avoid curdling.
Transfer chicken pastel mixture into a baking dish. Brush the edges of the baking dish with egg and place the puff pastry on top. Seal the edges using a fork.
Brush the top of the puff pastry with the remaining egg.
Bake the chicken pastel pie in the preheated oven for 20 minutes or until the puff pastry is golden brown. Serve warm and enjoy!

name: Classic Chicken Mami
description: A classic chicken mami recipe requires egg noodles, sliced chicken breast, and a flavorful broth. Prepare this homemade version using Knorr Chicken Cubes.
instructions: Let’s begin by getting our pot nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the garlic. Cook them until brown before adding the chicken breast.
Pour the water next and bring this to a boil.
Drop the Knorr Chicken Broth Cubes and gently place the cabbage and spring onions in. Let this simmer for two minutes and give this a nice seasoning of salt.

Now, serve the cooked noodles in a bowl with a serving of hard-boiled egg and chicken breast. Pour the cooked broth over and with a topping of chopped spring onions and toasted garlic, that’s our dish!
You know you are already home when you can smell chicken being cooked and garlic being toasted in the kitchen. Ahhh, Chicken Mami it is!

name: Corned Beef Nilaga Recipe
description: This simple dish uses the rich flavors of corned beef combined with fresh aromatics and vegetables, simmered in a flavorful Knorr Beef broth.
tips: Corned beef is an excellent source of protein, vitamin B12, and iron, but it also contains a high percentage of sodium.
instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the garlic, tomatoes and onion. Sauté until lightly brown in color.
Stir in the corned beef and just continue to sauté until you smell the nice aroma from the cooked meat and vegetables.
Next, pour in the water and drop in the Knorr Beef Cubes. Stir until fully dissolved.
Add the peppercorns and bring to a vigorous boil before adding the cabbage. Now, bring down the heat and simmer until the vegetables are cooked and that’s it! Our dish is ready!
This Corned Beef Nilaga Recipe is all you’ll really need to make your day. Treat yourself and enjoy!

name: Ginataang Tahong Recipe
description: Here's a dish that's highly recommended. It's the combination of mussels and gata, found in Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay. Simple and easy and oh so yummy!

ingredients.item: (33g) Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay

instructions: Begin by getting your pot nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and saute garlic and leeks. Dissolve Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix in 1 cup water then add to the pot.
Add mussels next and just cook until the shells open and the sauce has thickened.
Serve hot with fried garlic and that's it! This only proves that you don't need a lot of ingredients and too many steps to come up with a really tasty dish. Simply satisfying!
categories: KNORR COMPLETE RECIPE MIX GINATAANG GULAY

name: Lomi Soup Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Lomi Soup. Have the rich flavor of shrimp infused by our Knorr Shrimp Cubes. Devour the goodness of Lomi Now!
tips: The combination of cornstarch and cold water, is also called a cornstarch slurry, and is used as a thickening agent in a lot of Asian sauces and soups.
instructions: First, get a large pot and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the garlic, onion and shrimp. Sauté until you can smell the lovely aroma from the cooked vegetables and seafood.
Drop in the fishballs before adding the water and Knorr Shrimp Cubes. Let the rich flavor of the broth seep into the ingredients before adding the noodles and pechay.
Now, boil until tender and pour the cornstarch mixture while stirring constantly.

One more step and you can finally devour the goodness of Lomi. You just have to finish off by adding the beaten egg in and that’s our dish! Lomi soup will always bring satisfaction and comfort. It’s a feel good soup and makes you proud to be a Filipino!

name: Coconut Cream Fish Gratin Recipe
description: This dish uses the fresh seafood taste of fish fillet combined with the creamy and rich flavors of Knorr Ginataang Gulay, mixed with mushrooms and cheese.
tips: When cooking with coconut milk (gata), make sure that you don't let the liquids boil for a long time after adding the coconut milk, or else it might curdle and breakup during cooking.

ingredients.item: kg. fish fillet cut into cubes
(33g) pack Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay

instructions: Let’s begin by preparing the fish. Dredge fish fillets in flour and shake off excess. Get your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and pan-fry the fish until brown. Strain and set aside.
Combine Knorr Ginataang Gulay Complete Recipe Mix-Sitaw at Kalabasa with water and bring to this to a quick boil, then lower the heat to simmer to prevent it from curdling.
In goes the corn and mushroom and continue to simmer until thick. Add cream and fish fillets and just allow to simmer for 2 minutes.
Pour onto a baking dish. Cover the top with grated cheese and breadcrumbs. Place in a 400F oven until browned on top. And that’s our dish.
Here’s another way of serving fish! Your family will simply adore this Coconut Cream Fish Gratin. It’s best with rice!

name: Potato and Ham Soup Recipe
description: This quick heart healthy soup recipe combines the flavorful taste of Knorr Cream of Asparagus enriched with Knorr Pork broth, mixed with potatoes and ham.
tips: Eating asparagus has a number of potential health benefits, including weight loss, improved digestion, healthy pregnancy outcomes and lower blood pressure.

ingredients.item: potatoes, peeled & cut into small cubes
sachet Knorr Cream of Asparagus Soup 70g, dissolved in 1 cup water

instructions: Begin by getting a saucepan nice and hot over medium heat. Melt some butter and throw in the onions, celery and ham.

Add in the prepared Knorr Cream of Asparagus Soup mixture and Knorr Pork Broth Cube and additional water, followed by the the cubed potatoes. Let this boil, then lower the heat to simmer and continue to cook until the potatoes are tender. And that’s our dish!
When you sip into the Potato and Ham Soup that your mom prepared for you, you will always be reminded of the comforts of home.

name: Seafood Surprise Recipe
description: This dish uses the fresh seafood flavors of tuna, shrimp and squid simmered in the creamy and flavorful taste of Knorr Crab and Corn soup.
tips: Eating seafood like fish and crabs are a great source of long chain Omega-3 Fatty Acids which can help improve cardiovascular health and reduce heart diseases.

ingredients.item: (60g) pack Knorr Crab and Corn Real Chinese Soup
green and red bell pepper, cubed

instructions: Let's begin by preparing Knorr Crab and Corn Real Chinese Soup according to package instructions, but do not add egg. Set aside.
Season tuna with salt and pepper. Then coat the seasoned tuna into the flour and cornstarch mixture. Fry until slightly brown. Set aside.
Next, get a medium pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and sauté garlic and onion and add Knorr Chicken Cube. Stir to dissolve the Knorr Chicken Cube.
Drop in the sliced squid, shrimps, red and green bell peppers, and a dash of black pepper. Continue to sauté at low heat until the squid and shrimps are cooked.

Add the prepared Knorr Crab and Corn Real Chinese Soup with the cooked tuna and sautéed ingredients. Simmer for 2 minutes. Arrange the cooked seafood on a plate and that's it. Something as good as this soup is meant to be shared with the family. This will definitely make your day.

name: Fish Tinola Recipe
description: Upgrade a classic Filipino tinola by adding a seafood twist. Find a new favorite in this fish tinola featuring hasa-hasa and Knorr Fish Cubes.
tips: Lemongrass (Tanglad) is packed with a lot of vitamins and minerals, and it is a great source of antioxidants, which help reduce chronic diseases.

ingredients.item: large Hasa-hasa, cleaned and cut into 2
spring onions, cut into 2 inch segments

instructions: Begin by getting a pot and fill it with water. Place the salt in together with the ginger, tanglad, sili espada, onion and Knorr Fish Broth Cubes.
Close the pot and just allow the ingredients to simmer over medium heat for 8-10 minutes, then lower the heat to simmer.
Now, gently add the fish and cook just until the fish eyes turn white.
Add pechay and spring onions next and just simmer until veggies are cooked. And that's it! Our dish is done and may be enjoyed by the entire family.

name: Batangas Bulalo with Sotanghon Recipe
description: Indulge in our comforting bulalo recipe made with Knorr Beef Broth, sotanghon noodles, potatoes, and pechay. A hearty and flavorful sotanghon recipe!
tips: Remember to remove the scum from the surface of the water every now and then, to ensure your soup will be nice and clear. This process is called skimming.

ingredients.item: kilogram beef bulalo (beef kenchi with bone), cut into serving pieces

instructions: Place beef in a pot and cover with water. Add onions, leeks, laurel leaf, and peppercorns. Remove impurities.
Simmer until beef is tender. Add Knorr Beef Broth Cubes and potatoes. Cook for 10 minutes.
Add sotanghon noodles, pechay, and simmer for 3 more minutes.
Let your creativity shine with Knorr Beef Broth Cubes.
Experience a heartwarming and flavorful soup that will leave you feeling good. Taste it for yourself!
Get a pot and place the beef in. Fill it with water enough to cover the meat. Throw in the onions, leeks, laurel leaf, and peppercorns. Bring to a boil and remove the impurities (scum) as it rises.
Continue to simmer until meat is tender. Drop in the Knorr Beef Broth Cubes and potatoes. Cook for 10 more minutes or until the potato is tender.
Add the sotanghon noodles, followed by the pechay and simmer for 3 minutes more. All you need is a little creativity and Knorr Beef Broth Cubes. It's a feel good soup! Taste and see what we mean!

name: Chicken Binakol Recipe
description: Light and refreshing, this is what's it all about. With Knorr Chicken Cubes and coconut, chicken never tasted this good.

ingredients.item: medium tomato, cut into small wedges

instructions: This is literally a one pot dishes that cooks in an instant. All you need to do is to put all the ingredients in a wok or shallow pan and bring this to a boil. Once boiling, bring to a simmer over low heat and cook for about 45 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through. After you’ve done all of this, you may now finally enjoy this delicious dish. Serve it to your family and you will be a kitchen hero!

name: Laing Recipe
description: Knorr Pork Broth Cubes will compliment the creamy and sweet-spicy kick of this dish. Bring home to the family the flavors of Bicol with this laing recipe.

ingredients.item: dried gabi leaves, shredded into strips

instructions: Before cooking this wonderful laing dish, it is important to wash the dried gabi leaves first in water several times before squeezing out the excess liquid. This is done to remove all impurities or dust particles that might have accumulated from dehydrating the leaves in the process. Set aside.

You can now proceed with the next step. In a big 1 quart or 4 cups pot, pour some oil and bring the heat into medium high. Throw in the onions, garlic and ginger and sauté for about 2 minutes or more. You know it’s time to add the pork when you smell the lovely aroma from the vegetables. Cook the pork only up until it turns light brown in color.
The next step would be to pour the 2nd coconut milk extraction, long green chillies, gabi leaves and Knorr Pork Cube. Bring this to a boil until the liquid is almost dry.

Pour the last coconut extraction and cook this at low heat for about 10 minutes. There are a few rules in cooking with coconut. One: you only cook at a simmer because coconut contains cream and boiling it might break it. Two: cooking at a simmer, with the pot uncovered while stirring once in a while, will help reduce the liquid and thus make it more creamy and thick.
Laing can be paired with any fried food or eaten alone. However many ways you serve this dish, your family will surely thank you for it.

name: Mindanao Balbacoa Recipe
description: A classic and award winning meat dish Balbacoa, from Mindanao, is made more meaty and delicious by using Knorr Beef Cubes.
tips: Remember to remove the scum from the surface of the water every now and then, to ensure your dish will be nice and clear. This process is called skimming.

ingredients.item: thumb -sized ginger, peeled and cut into strips
kilo pork knuckles, cut into serving portions

instructions: Begin by getting your large pot nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and sauté the onions, garlic, and ginger.

Add water, star anise, tausi and Knorr Beef Broth Cubes. Next, gently add the knuckles, and let this boil, then lower the heat to simmer until meat is tender. Remember to remove the scum and impurities that rises to the top of the liquid.
Stir in the peanuts and garnish with chopped spring onions and that's it. It only takes Knorr Pork Broth Cubes to recreate a delicious Balbacoa from Mindanao. It's yummy!

name: Chicken and Corn with Siomai Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich flavors of Knorr Chicken and Corn cream soup infused with egg, mixed with homemade pork and mushroom siomai.
tips: Mushrooms are not only rich in flavors, but they are also good sources of protein and antioxidants. It helps maintain a healthy immune system, boost your bone health and helps reduce the risk of neurological illness in the future.

ingredients.item: dried shitake mushrooms hydrated and chopped
(1 pack) Knorr Chicken and Corn Soup

instructions: Let’s begin by making our filling. In a bowl, combine oil, cornstarch, pork, and mushrooms. Season well with a mixture of salt and pepper.
Place a tablespoon of the mixture on three siomai wrappers and place a quail egg in the middle. Mold into shape. Use water to keep the three wrappers together and seal the siomai.
Garnish the top of the siomai with chopped spring onions. Arrange in a steamer and steam for 25-30 minutes or until siomai is cooked.

In a separate bowl, cook the soup according to package instructions. Once the soup is cooked, add in the cooked siomai and fresh egg and that’s our dish. With a serving of rice, this will truly make you sing the happy song. You can serve this as is on its own as well.

name: Seafood Putanesca Recipe
description: This classic pasta dish uses the rich flavor of shrimp mixed with olives, bell peppers and tomatoes, topped with flavorful mussels and clams.
tips: When choosing mussels (tahong), it should look wet and smell like the ocean, salty and clean. If they smell a little funky, or many of them appear to be open already, then do not buy them.
instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and sauté onions and garlic.
Throw in the shrimps and cook until color changes to bright orange. Set aside.
In the same pan, add the remaining oil and sauté the bell peppers and olives. Add tomatoes, Knorr Shrimp Cubes and capers. Simmer for 20 minutes while stirring constantly.
Return the shrimps back and add the cooked spaghetti noodles. Give this a nice seasoning of salt and pepper and that's it. Serve on a platter topped with the shellfish.
Seafood Puttanesca is such a magical dish. See how it disappears before your eyes the moment you serve this on the table.

name: Sweet Kamote and Kangkong Souprise Recipe
description: This heart healthy soup dish uses the rich flavors of sweet potatoes combined with kangkong mixed with chicken, simmered in the flavorful Knorr Chicken broth
tips: Sweet potatoes are a great source of Vitamin A, which keeps eyes healthy and boosts immune system.

ingredients.item: kilogram chicken breast fillet, cut into bite size cubes
sweet kamote (orange), cut into big cubes
bundles kangkong seperated leaves from stem

instructions: Begin by grabbing a saucepan and place the chicken and sliced onion together. Stir and add a little bit of water to avoid the meat from sticking to the saucepan.
When the chicken meat turns white and onions are soft, add the sweet kamote and gabi. Stir for a minute then add 4 cups of water.

When the water boils, complete the richness of your broth and bring life to the soup by adding Knorr Chicken Cubes. Boil the vegetables in the broth until sweet kamote and gabi become tender (about 15 minutes) and that’s our soup!
Sweet Kamote and Kangkong Souprise is just one of those dishes you will simply adore. It’s filling, delicious and healthy at the same time.

name: Sayote Kalabasa Souprise Recipe
description: This dish has a very refreshing and relaxing taste, coming from the sweet vegetable flavors of pumpkin and sayote mixed with a light clear shrimp broth.
tips: Pumpkin is packed with nutrients and vitamins that canboost your immune system and help the body to fight infection.
instructions: Get a saucepan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Gently place the ground pork and stir together with the sliced onion. When meat turns a little brown and onion softens, place kalabasa and sayote.
Stir the vegetables and meat for 2 minutes. Then, add water. When the water boils, give that broth the flavor as you savor the aroma of fresh pork by adding 2 Knorr Pork Cubes.
Simmer for a few minutes. Then add sayote leaves and boil until just cooked. Enjoy a warm serving of Sayote Kalabasa with rice or eat as is, it will definitely satisfy.

name: Pinangat na Galunggong Recipe
description: This Filipino classic dish uses the fresh seafood taste of Galunggong infused with the flavors of tomatoes and Knorr Fish broth.
tips: Galunggong fish is a great source of calcium and Vitamin D which strengthens the bones and teeth. It is also a good source of Omega 3 and omega 6 which lowers the level of bad cholesterol in the body.

ingredients.item: pcs. small ripe tomatoes, cut into 4

instructions: This is a simple recipe that you should do more often at home. All you need to do is get a pot and fill it with water. Over high heat, bring the water to a boil and place the Knorr Fish Broth Cubes, and tomatoes in. Stir to dissolve Knorr fish cube.
Gently add the galunggong and simmer until the fish is done, and that's it. Make sure you have a big bowl of steaming white rice because you will definitely eat more than usual.

name: Almondigas with Upo in Sotanghon Recipe
description: This heart healthy dish uses the flavorful taste of Knorr Shrimp broth combined with homemade pork and shrimp Almondigas, served mixed with Upo and sothanghon
tips: Upo (Bottle Gourd) is a vegetable that is very heart healthy, and it also reduces liver inflammation and can help to lower blood pressure.

ingredients.item: sotanghon noodles, soaked in water and cut into 6-inch length

instructions: Start by mixing in a bowl, the ground pork, shrimps, green onion and egg. Shape into small balls about the size of a big calamansi. Place in the ref to set.

Get a large pot and make it nice and warm over medium-high heat, then add the oil and start by sautéing garlic and onion until brown in color and aromatic. Gradually add water and Knorr Shrimp Cubes. Stir until the broth is completely seasoned and turns golden for full flavor.
Next, drop the meatballs into the boiling broth. Boil then it simmer for 15 minutes.
Add upo slices, cover and cook until veggies are done. Add sotanghon and remove from fire once done. And that's it.

name: Nilasing na Baka Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich taste of beef simmered in a beer infused broth mixed with spices and aromatics, mixed with sweet and creamy coconut milk sauce
tips: Fork Tender refers to the process where we check if the ingredient is cooked or tender enough that it can be pierced or cut easily by a fork.
instructions: Begin by getting a large pot ready and place the beer, beef, ginger, pandan, Knorr Beef Broth Cubes, and the coconut milk. Bring to a boil over high heat, then immediately reduce the heat to low and simmer while covered until the beef is fork tender.
Add sili, atsuete oil, oregano, basil, bell pepper, and Knorr Liquid Seasoning and let this simmer for an additional 5 minutes.
Finally, stir in the coconut cream and the remaining ingredients and just cook until sauce is thick.

Garnish with spring onions and that’s our dish! Something as good as Nilasing na Baka deserves everyone’s attention. Create your own family tradition by serving this when everybody is complete. It’s best enjoyed with your loved ones.

name: Chicken Mindanao Recipe
description: This dish uses the rich flavor of Chicken simmered in a sweet and creamy coconut milk based sauce infused with Knorr Chicken flavors.
tips: Lower down the heat after adding the coconut milk, and do not let the mix boil because this might curdle and break up the cream.
instructions: Start by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and sauté the garlic, ginger, then add in the chicken. Cook until the chicken becomes light brown.

Now, drop in the Knorr Chicken Cube. Next, add in the coconut milk and soy sauce. Cook in very low heat until the coconut milk is reduced and almost dry and that’s it! Make sure you have enough rice ready because you will definitely eat more than usual.

name: La Paz Batchoy Recipe
description: Create our easy to follow recipe for La Paz Batchoy. This hearty filipino favorite soup is made more delicious with Knorr Pork Broth Cubes.
tips: Remember to remove the scum from the surface of the water every now and then, to ensure your soup will be nice and clear. This process is called skimming.

ingredients.item: kilogram La Paz Batchoy noodles, cooked

instructions: Get a pot and fill it with water. Bring to a boil before dropping in the Knorr Pork Broth Cubes. Stir to dissolve.

Now, add the pork meat and liver slices and let this boil, then turn the heat down to simmer until tender. Remove the meat and liver and reserve the broth. Remove the impurities and scum that appear on the top of the boiling liquid.
Arrange the noodles in a bowl. Top with meat strips, liver, shrimps, eggs, garlic, spring onions, and chicharon.
Pour in the hot broth and enjoy a delicious serving of La Paz Batchoy! Mmmm it's soooo good!

name: Spicy Braised Pork Nilaga Recipe
description: A twist on the classic Filipino Nilaga. This dish combines the rich flavors of Pork nilaga with the creamy texture of coconut milk with a kick of spicy labuyo
tips: Remember to skim the liquid or to remove the scum from the surface of the water every now and then, to ensure your soup will be nice and clear.

ingredients.item: kilogram pork kasim, cut into large cubes
button mushrooms, drained and sliced in half

instructions: Begin by getting your pot nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and sauté onions, ginger, and tomatoes. Cook until tender.
Add in the pork kasim cubes, tanglad, and siling labuyo and continue to sauté until the meat turns light brown in all sides.

Pour in the water and Knorr Pork Cubes. Let this boil, then lower the meat to simmer and continue to cook until the meat is fork tender. Add the sliced mushroom and coconut cream. Reduce the heat to a simmer.
Add wansuy and leeks and that's our dish. Everything you love is in this dish. Warm soup, spicy beef, and that refreshing flavour of tanglad and wansuy! It's time to indulge!

name: Chicken Sotanghon Soup Recipe
description: This chicken sotanghon recipe is a complete meal thanks to vermicelli noodles, chicken, and vegetables. Upgrade this classic merienda with these tips.
tips: You can add Malunggay leaves to the dish to add flavor and to boost the nutrients found in the dish.

ingredients.item: sotanghon, soaked in water for 15 minutes

instructions: Let's begin by getting our pot nice and hot over medium heat. Pour oil and add atsuete seeds. Cook until oil turns orange in color. Strain out seeds. Sauté garlic and onions in atsuete oil.
Add the chicken breast next and sauté.
Drop in the Knorr Chicken Broth Cubes and sotanghon noodles. Stir well and let it simmer. Add pak choi and spinach.

Now that our soup is done, serve in a bowl with a sprinkle of spring onions and crunchy fried garlic on top. Chicken Sotanghon soup is one of those dishes you will not get tired of eating or cooking. It’s just close to home.

name: Seafood Vegetable Soup Recipe
description: This heart healthy comfort food dish uses the rich seafood flavor of mussels and fish fillet, cooked in the flavors of Knorr Shrimp broth.
tips: When choosing mussels (tahong), it should look wet and smell like the ocean, salty and clean. If they smell a little funky, or many of them appear to be open already, then do not buy them.
instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and sauté garlic, onion, celery and carrots.
Gently add fish fillet and tahong before pouring in the water. Drop the Knorr Shrimp Broth Cubes and bring to a boil, then lower the heat to simmer.
Remove or skim foam off the top of soup to remove any impurities. Add in the kasubha and dissolved cornstarch slurry.
Simmer for a few minutes and place seafood in a bowl and be ready to garnish with onion leeks. Seafood Vegetable soup will surely perk up your day, its filling and comforting.

name: Minestrone Soup (Italian Style) Recipe
description: This classic Italian soup dish uses the flavors and textures of beans mixed with the rich flavors of ham and fresh vegetables, simmered in Knorr Beef broth.
tips: Green beans and string beans contains a lot of healthy vitamins and nutrients that help prevent cancer, diabetes and cardiovascular diseases.

ingredients.item: green beans, cut into 1/2 inch length

instructions: Begin by boiling the beans in a pot filled with water until tender. Drain and set this aside.
Get a nice casserole ready and make it hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and sauté garlic and onions.
Add ham (or bacon), carrots and potatoes and cook for 5 minutes before adding the tomatoes, green beans, and celery and cook for another 5 minutes.
Pour about 4 cups of water, tomato sauce, Knorr Beef Broth Cube, and Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Stir then add in the bay leaf and basil leaves. Simmer for about 30 minutes.

Gently add in the beans and macaroni noodles and just simmer for 10 minutes more and that’s our soup. The kitchen smells nice because of the wonderful aroma that Minestrone Soup brings. Wait until you dry this dish! You will definitely ask your mom to cook this more often at home.

name: Creamy Mustard Pasta Recipe
description: This quick pasta dish uses the rich flavor of beef infused with Knorr Beef flavors, combined with sweet taste of cream and a slight kick from mustard.
tips: When cooking with cream, do not let the sauce boil for a long time to prevent the cream from curdling or breaking up. Monitor the heat and let the dish cook at a simmer temp.

ingredients.item: Knorr Royal Pasta noodles, cooked according to package directions

instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and just drop in the ground beef and Knorr Beef Broth Cubes. Now mix this continuously until the meat is golden brown.

Add Knorr Liquid Seasoning and cook for another 2 minutes or until the sauce is absorbed by the beef before adding the all-purpose cream and Dijon mustard. Make sure though that your fire is at low heat because you don’t want to make that cream curdle.
Gently toss the cooked pasta and grated cheese and that’s it!

Creamy Mustard Pasta deserves a place in your stomach! You will definitely feel happy for it’s that good! But don’t keep all that happiness to yourself. Share and serve this recipe to others whom you love dearly and be their hero for the day.

name: Baked Casserole Recipe
description: This classic holiday dish uses the rich taste of beef sirloin combined with fresh vegetables, simmered in mushroom sauce, topped with creamy mashed potatoes.
tips: By adding butter on top of the casserole just before baking, will keep the dish moist and flavorful. It will also help in creating a nice crust on top of the casserole that adds to the texture of the dish.
instructions: Let’s begin this recipe by preparing the mashed potatoes. Cut the peeled potatoes in chunks and boil in a pot filled with water. Cook them until soft or until the potatoes no longer stick when a knife is stuck into them. When soft, mash them using a fork or a potato ricer. Add all-purpose cream, basil, pepper and season to taste. Set aside.
Now, let’s start to make the casserole: Get your pan nice and hot over medium heat and sauté in the onions and garlic, add the beef sirloin then add the Knorr Liquid Seasoning.
When the beef is cooked, add the mushrooms and the Chorizo de Bilbao, and let the oils and flavors release.
Pour in the cream of mushroom soup next then add the Knorr Beef Cubes, all-purpose cream and the Spanish paprika. Let this simmer before dropping in carrots, green bell pepper, and ground pepper.
Continue cooking until veggies are tender then transfer to a baking dish.
Cover the casserole with the mashed potatoes then dot with butter on top. Finally, for that added flavour, sprinkle with mozzarella cheese on top.
Bake in the oven for 10-15 minutes and that’s our dish. Expect hugs and kisses from your family when you serve this wonderful dish to them. It’s made with love.

name: Citrus Adobo Recipe
description: This Asian fusion classic adobo recipe uses the traditional flavors of Adobo of pork and spices, mixed with pineapple and the rich taste of Knorr Seasoning.
tips: Pineapples are not only full of flavors and is a great source of fiber. It is also rich in antioxidants that help the body fight chronic inflammation and diseases, strengthens the immune system and helps in the digestion.
instructions: Get your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Melt the butter and throw in the garlic. Add the pork and continue sautéing until pork is slightly brown.
Pour in the oyster sauce, pineapple juice, and Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Let mixture simmer before adding calamansi extract, soy sauce, water, and peppercorns and allow it to boil.
If the pork is already tender, add the white sugar, bay leaves, and boiled eggs. Allow this to simmer one last time and turn heat off.
For the appetizer: Slice ginger and tomatoes into strips then mix in a bowl. Add fish sauce and Knorr Liquid Seasoning, and toss together.
Serve with your Citrus Adobo and that’s our dish! Whatever the occasion is, Adobo will always be a winner however many ways you serve it.

name: Mexican Macaroni Recipe
description: This Mexican-inspired dish uses the rich taste of beef infused with Knorr flavors, combined with the flavors from tomatoes and cilantro and chili.
tips: Cilantro (wansoy) contains dodecenal, an antimicrobial compound that may help protect your body against infections and illnesses.

ingredients.item: Knorr Royal Elbow Macaroni, cooked according to package directions

instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and sauté the beef until cooked through.
Drop in the Knorr Beef Cubes for that extra meaty flavor and all the other ingredients except macaroni and cheese. Continue sautéing until the veggies are cooked.
Add in the cooked macaroni noodles, mix well and that’s our dish.
Serve Mexican Macaroni with grated cheese on top and nacho chips on the side and see that it’s a magical dish. It will disappear before you know it!

name: Pinoy Tom Yum Goong
description: This dish combines the sour and spicy flavors of lemongrass, ginger and tamarind that make the broth, mixed with the fresh flavors of shrimp and mushrooms.
tips: When cleaning the shrimps, remove the black vein found at the back of the shrimp. You can use a small paring knife to make small slit along the back and lift out the vein using the tip of the knife.

ingredients.item: medium or large raw shrimps, peeled with tails intact, deveined (reserve the peels and head)
lemon grass (tanglad), white parts only pounded to flatten and sliced 1/4 inch thick

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan and add the shrimp shells and heads to the pan and cook for 10 minutes over moderately high heat, tossing frequently.
Pour water into the pan and then add lemon grass and ginger. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. Strain mixture through a sieve into a large saucepan. Discard solids.
Pour Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix and add Knorr Shrimp Broth Cube to strained stock and then bring to a boil.
Add peeled shrimps, mushrooms, and sugar. Cook uncovered until shrimp changes color (about 10 minutes). Serve immediately. Sprinkle with coriander leaves and sliced green onions.

name: Spaghetti Palabok Recipe
description: This dish that uses Spaghetti noodle combined with the thick sauce has a right balance of savory and salty flavors coming from the shrimp and tinapa.
tips: Kitsay (Celery) is rich in Vitamin C which helps prevent colds and boost the immune system. It is also a good source of potassium and antioxidants that help regulate the processes in the body.
instructions: Let’s begin by making a broth from Knorr Shrimp Cubes and water. Bring this to a boil and cook the Knorr Royal Spaghetti for 12 minutes. Remove the noodles and set this aside while reserving the broth.

Palabok will not be Palabok without the orange color. In order to achieve that color you need to cook the atsuete seeds and oil together in a pan until it turns red or orange in color. Discard the atsuete seeds but set aside the atsuete oil.
Plunge the shrimp into the pasta broth and boil until the shrimp turns pink. Take the shrimp out and set aside. Reserve the broth again.
For the next step, transfer the broth in a blender with the atsuete oil, leftover rice, kinchay and blend until thick and smooth.
Next, transfer the mixture in a pot or pan and just keep it heated. Now that the sauce is done, we can start plating our palabok.
Arrange the spaghetti in a platter and spread the sauce on top of the noodles. Garnish with cooked shrimp, tinapa, chicharon and cooked egg slices and that’s our dish!
There’s always something to celebrate when you have Spaghetti Palabok at home. Rejoice in the company of friends, family and fabulously delicious food.

name: Kilawing Tanguigue Recipe
description: Indulge in the zesty and refreshing flavors of kilawing tanigue. Made with the freshest ingredients, this dish is the perfect choice for seafood lovers.
tips: To add a different flavor to your kilawin, you can combine the use of vinegar with citrus fruit juices, like calamansi or lemon.

ingredients.item: fresh long green chili, chopped (as needed)
Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original (to taste)

instructions: Get yourself a nice clean bowl and combine tanguigue with a cup of cane vinegar. Mix well and just discard excess liquid.
Get another bowl and mix the remaining 1 cup of cane vinegar with onion, ginger, and chilies. Just add the tanguigue, 3-5 minutes before serving them, then mix well.

Finally, add the Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original and season well according to your preference. And that's our dish. Top this on bread, eat as is or pair with your favourite meat dish. There's something about that sour and salty taste that will make you fall in love with this dish.

name: Good Old Chicken Macaroni Recipe
description: This dish is combines the creamy taste and flavors of chicken soup mixed with the sweet flavors for the sautéed bell peppers mixed with macaroni noodles.
tips: Bell pepper are rich in Vitamin C and antioxidants, and are excellent addition to a healthy diet. Add hotdog slices to make your sopas more flavorful!
instructions: Dissolve the Knorr Cream of Chicken in 2 cups water and set aside.
Ina medium pot, make it nice and warm over high heat. Add the oil and sauté onions and bell pepper until the soft and aromatic.

Add the chicken pieces and sauté for 2 minutes, pour the Knorr Cream of Chicken soup in mix in the pan and cook until thickened. Add the cooked macaroni noodles and let it simmer for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste then serve.

name: Triple Cheese Canelloni Recipe
description: This resto style dish combines the meaty and savory flavors of ground beef mix, with the rich flavors of tomato based sauce, topped with extra cheese.
tips: To prevent the pasta rolls from burning, you can cover the top of the baking sheet with a foil for the first 30-40 mins of baking, then remove the cover and continue to bake for 10 minutes uncovered to help melt the cheese.

ingredients.item: pcs. lasagna sheets, cooked al dente, cut into half

instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion and garlic and just sauté until the vegetables give off a nice aroma. Add the liver spread and mashed Knorr Beef Cube and tomatoes. Mix this well before adding the ground beef. Saute until the beef is cooked through.
Combine the Knorr Kaldereta Mix and water and add this to the pot. Bring to a boil then allow to simmer until thick.

Throw in the bell peppers, cheese, and basil and simmer until the cheese melts. Taste if the sauce still needs additional seasoning then, with the use of a strainer, drain the meat mixture and reserve the sauce.
Lay the cooked lasagna sheets then add 3 tbsp of the meat filling at the lower part of the sheet then roll into a log.

Prepare and grease a baking dish and pour some of the sauce at the bottom before arranging the filled pasta on it, side by side with the seam side down. Sprinkle with parmesan and mozzarella then bake in an oven until cheese melts and then becomes browned on top.
Once your family tastes this Triple Cheese Canneloni Recipe, they will surely insist you make this more often. It’s something that they will surely look forward to once in a while.

name: Pork Ramen Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Pork Ramen. Enjoy the comforting flavors of pork intensified with Knorr Pork Cubes.
tips: You can also fry the pork belly over high heat until the sides are brown before mixing it this the water to create the broth. This initial frying will give the broth a richer flavor and darker broth color.

ingredients.item: whole head garlic, sliced into half then toasted
ramen noodles, cooked in boiling water until al dente
hard boiled egg, sliced into half

instructions: Begin by cooking the pork and making a broth out of it. Then, get your pot nice and hot over medium high heat and place the garlic, pork belly, water and Knorr Pork Cubes in. Now, bring this to a simmer until the pork belly is tender. Remember to remove the scum that will rise to the top of the broth, to keep the broth clear.
The next step is to flavour the broth with soy sauce and chilli beans before adding the noodles in. Take note that you need to give this 3 minutes to simmer before adding the noodles.

To serve the ramen, here’s what you’ve got to do: place a serving of the noodles in a bowl, pour the broth over it and top everything with some thinly sliced pork belly, eggs, mushrooms and spring onions.
No need to go to a resto to enjoy the comforting taste of Ramen. So instead of eating this all by yourself, try serving this up to family. They’re going to definitely appreciate your thoughtfulness.

name: Seafood Kare-Kare Recipe
description: This dish combines the fresh seafood taste coming from the variety of shellfish and shrimp mixed with garden fresh vegetables cooked in a peanut based sauce.
tips: When choosing mussels (tahong), it should look wet and smell like the ocean, salty and clean. If they smell a little funky, or many of them appear to be open already, then do not buy them.

ingredients.item: puso ng saging, cut into 2-inch lengths
(40g) pack Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Kare Kare
squid, cleaned and cut into rings

instructions: First, we need to blanching the vegetables. Prepare a pot of boiling water. Drop the vegetables in quickly or until the color becomes brighter and darker, then remove them immediately. Reserve the pot of water.

Get another pot and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and sauté onions and garlic. Add the reserved blanching liquid and pour in the Knorr Kare Kare Mix. Simmer until thick, stirring occasionally.

Add squid rings and shrimps and simmer until cooked through. Place back the blanched vegetables and steamed tahong last. You will definitely get hugs and kisses from your family when you serve Seafood Kare kare over dinner.

name: Hearty Beef Bulalo Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Beef Bulalo. This Filipino classic dish uses the rich and deep flavor of beef combined with fresh vegetables.
tips: Remember to remove the scum from the surface of the water every now and then, to ensure your soup will be nice and clear. This process is called skimming.

ingredients.item: beef shank, cut to serving pieces

instructions: Begin by getting a large pot and fill it with water. Let the water boil together with the beef shanks and onions. Let it simmer for 1.5 hours or until beef is tender. Remember to remove the scum from the surface of the water every now and then, to ensure your soup will be nice and clear.
Now drop in the Knorr Beef Cubes, corn and sliced saba.
Mix in Baguio beans and pechay and just simmer for a minute.
Give this soup a nice seasoning of pepper and that's our dish! Just like mom, a big serving of Bulalo is enough to fill your day with good thoughts and warm hugs.

name: Chicken Barbeque Recipe
description: This Filipino classic dish combines the flavorful Knorr marinated chicken mixed with the sweet and tangy banana catsup, grilled for the added smoked taste.
tips: When grilling, avoid moving the chicken too much. The fewer times you flip the chicken, the better. If the chicken is stuck to the grill, let it cook a little more, it will unstick itself from the grill when it’s ready for flipping.
instructions: To bring out the best flavour in this chicken bbq recipe, place the meat in a heavy duty food-grade plastic bag. Pour in the Knorr Liquid Seasoning, soy sauce, banana catsup, brown sugar, calamansi juice and canola oil. Make sure the plastic bag where you put the meat in is compressed and sealed like a vacuum to remove the air bubbles. Massage the meat in the plastic bag and watch as it begins to become fully coated with the ingredients. This technique allows you to save on the amount of marinade and also saves storage space. To maximize the flavour of the marinade, leave the chicken in the chiller to marinate overnight.
Transfer chicken and marinade in a pot. Let simmer for 10 minutes over medium heat. Remove chicken from sauce/marinade. Continue to cook sauce/marinade until it has thickened. Set this aside.
Sprinkle ground black pepper onto the chicken just before grilling over hot coals. Occasionally brush the chicken with the sauce to fully flavor the meat.
All you need now is hot rice and this Chicken BBQ is ready to be shared with the family.

name: Chicken Satay Recipe
description: This heart healthy bbq dish uses the rich flavor of chicken combined with the unique and delicious taste of peanut sauce, marinated and grilled to perfection.
tips: Satay or peanut sauce is a good source of monosaturated fats that are good for maintaining good heart health, and is great in managing blood sugar levels.

ingredients.item: chicken breast, skin removed, cut into cubes
chili powder or ground black pepper

instructions: Begin by placing the chicken pieces in a heavy duty food-grade plastic bag together with the coriander, lemongrass, garlic, onion, curry powder, chilli powder, Bango Kecap Manis and yogurt. Massage and mix the chicken well to fully incorporate the flavours. Leave this in the chiller overnight.

Chicken Satay is best paired with a dip made from peanuts. This easy to do peanut dip made from Knorr Complete Mix Kare-Kare does its trick. You just need to dissolve them in water and cook this over low heat until it becomes thick. Transfer this to a condiment plate and serve topped with chopped peanuts for that extra crunch.
Before skewing the marinated chicken pieces in BBQ sticks, soak the BBQ sticks first in water for at least 1 hour to keep them from burning.

Only a few more steps and tips before you can finally start grilling! Make sure that the grill rack is hot enough and then brush it with a little bit of oil to prevent the meat from sticking. The next step is to place the grill rack at the right distance from the hot coals to prevent the meat from drying and burning. You can now arrange the chicken and grill until it is cooked through.
The last is the easiest because it’s time to taste and enjoy this Chicken satay with your family. Don’t forget that dip you previously made

name: Cheese and Vegetable Gratin Recipe
description: Indulge in the rich and creamy flavors of this cheese and vegetable gratin recipe. Get the recipe from Knorr and satisfy your cravings today!

ingredients.item: 1⁄4 kg. marble potatoes, cooked and halved
1⁄2 cup young corn, cut into half
Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay 1 cup water

instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour olive oil and throw in the vegetables and drop in the fresh thyme.
Pour the Knorr Ginataang Gulay Sitaw at Kalabasa Recipe Mix dissolved in water and just allow to simmer to thicken the sauce.
Stir in the cream and transfer the mixture to a baking pan. Sprinkle the top with mozza cheese and breadcrumbs.
Bake in a pre-heated oven until the cheese melts. And that’s our dish!
What are you waiting for? Enjoy vegetables without the guilt because of this healthy and nutritious recipe! Indulge with no regrets!
categories: KNORR COMPLETE RECIPE MIX GINATAANG GULAY

name: Salmon and Truffle Linguine Recipe
description: This simple and delicious dish uses linguine pasta covered in the sweet coconut milk and cream sauce mixed with truffle oil topped with seared salmon slices.
tips: Salmon is a great source of Omega-3 fatty acids that are essential for good heart health and help maintain skin and joint health.

ingredients.item: Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay
sliced leeks and toasted garlic for garnish

instructions: First, season fish with a little salt and pepper. Next, by using a non stick medium pan, sear the salmon on high heat skin side down for about 30 - 45 seconds then gently flip it over with a spatula.
Let's now work on the pasta. Cook linguine noodles in boiling water, add a little salt and oil, and boil until noodles al dente. Drain and set aside.
Now, let's work on the sauce. Mix together Knorr Complete Recipe mix Ginataang Gulay with water then add to pot. Bring to boil and simmer until think. Set aside.
Next, get a pan and saute onions and garlic in oil. Add prepared gata mix, and in low heat, add the cream and linguine.
Turn off the heat. Add a drop or two of truffle oil. Mix well and arrange on plate topped with salmon fillets, leeks and toasted garlic.

name: Asian Lettuce Cups with Crispy Noodles Recipe
description: This simple dish uses the rich flavor of pork mixed with garlic, onions and bell peppers, served in the crisp lettuce cups topped with mayonnaise.
tips: When serving lettuce or fresh greens, make sure that you clean them properly using cold water to remove any impurities and dirty from each leaf. Pat dry and remove excess water to keep the crips texture of the leaves.
instructions: Using a medium pan, make it nice and warm over high heat. Saute onion, garlic and bell peppers in oil. Add ground pork and saute until cooked. Season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning, hot sauce, and pepper. Set this aside.
In pre-heated oil, deep fry sotanghon noodles until crisp. Remove form pot and place in paper towels at once. Set aside.
Lay lettuce cups on chopping board. Fill each cup with the pork mixture and crispy noodles. Top each cup with the a little mayonnaise, sesame seeds, and cilantro. That’s it.

name: Adobo sa Luyang Dilaw Recipe
description: This dish uses the rich flavors of chicken combined with the peppery spiced flavor of turmeric and ginger, giving the overall dish its unique flavor.
tips: Searing is the process in which the meat surface is cooked at a high temperature until a brown crust forms. Make sure that the pan is hot before adding the chicken to have a nice sear.
instructions: Begin by frying the chicken pieces over high heat with a small amount of oil until they are brown. This process is called searing, and this adds flavour and color to the meat. Make sure that the meat pieces are not wet or you will not achieve the desired color you are looking for. Also, do not overcrowd the pot because the juices from the meat will run out and thus prevent the browning effect of the meat.

The next step would be to drop all the ingredients in the same pot and bring the liquid to a boil. Bring down the heat to a simmer and slowly cook the chicken. Pour more water for a saucy adobo and cook further if you want a drier adobo.
With or without sauce, adobo will always be a comforting dish served any time of day especially when shared with the family.

name: Aligue Rice Recipe
description: This dish uses the rich flavor of crab fat combined with coconut milk sauce, mixed and tossed in cooked rice to create a dynamic dish.
tips: Aligue (Crab Fat) is a good source of Omega-3 Fatty acids that essential for better growth and strengthens the functioning of the brain.

ingredients.item: (1 pack) Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix diluted in 1 cup water
kani or crab sticks, for topping (optional)

instructions: Begin by grabbing a pan and making it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the leeks and add aligue. Sauté for two minutes to cook before adding the Knorr Ginataang Gulay diluted in 1/2 cup water. Allow the sauce to simmer until thick.
Add the cooked rice, mix well and sprinkle with a bit of fish sauce to taste. With an extra topping of kani (crab stick), this dish is done!
Aligue Rice is a dish that will always put a smile on your face. You may eat it as is or served with your meat of choice! It’s simply delicious!

name: Almondigas Oriental Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich flavor of pork meatballs with the creamy oriental-style shrimp egg soup mixed with boiled quail eggs.
tips: You can place the prepared meat balls in the chiller to help it keep its shape. You can also slightly fry the meatballs in a little oil until the outer shell turns light brown before adding them to the soup. This method adds more flavor and texture to the final dish.
instructions: There are actually 2 parts in making this dish. First, you’ve got to make your soup and second, you need to make your meatballs or Almondigas.

To make the soup, begin by getting your pot nice and hot and turn it to medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion before adding 1 cup of water and Knorr Shrimp Cubes. Next, stir this gently until the cubes dissolve and the broth turns golden yellow in color. Bring this to a boil before allow it to simmer.

Let’s now put together the ground pork, egg yolk, salt and pepper in a bowl and form them into meatballs. Mold and shape them into small sized balls then drop them in the boiling stock together with the quail eggs. Now we’re near the step that will make the mixture to make this soup creamier. In another bowl, mix the egg white, evaporated milk, remaining 3 cups of water and pour these to the boiling stock. Over low heat, simmer until the meat is cooked through.
Finally, you are done! You will always come home to this timeless classic because Almondigas Oriental Recipe is truly soothing.

name: Almondigas Soup with Pork Balls Recipe
description: This dish uses the rich taste of pork infused with flavors of Knorr mixed with spring onions and garlic served in a flavorful pork broth with misua noodles.
tips: You can put the prepared meat balls in the chiller (ref) for at least 30 mins to form, this prevents the meatballs from breaking up during cooking.
instructions: There are 2 parts in making this Almondigas Soup with Pork Balls Recipe. First, you need to form the meatballs and second, you need to make the soup.

Let’s begin by putting the ground pork, egg, spring onion, 1 pc crushed Knorr Pork Cubes, white pepper and flour together in a bowl. You must mix these all really well. Now, get a tablespoonful of the mixture and shape it into balls. Set these aside afterwards.

Next, make the soup by first grabbing a pan and getting it nice and hot. Then, pour some oil and drop in the garlic. Pour water then add remaining Knorr Pork Cube. Allow this to boil before adding the pork meat balls. When the pork balls float, they are officially cooked through!

Time to add the misua noodles in. Turn the heat off and this dish is done! Adjust seasoning according to your taste. Savour the goodness of Almondigas Soup with Pork Balls. See the warmth that this recipe will bring to your heart and your home.

name: Arroz Ala Cubana Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Arroz Ala Cubana. This dish combines the rich taste of beef mixed with sautéed vegetables. Oh, what a treat!
tips: Arroz ala Cubana is best served with fried banana (Saba), which adds sweetness and soft texture to the dish, and fried egg.

ingredients.item: 1 cup choice diced vegetables such as potato, carrots, bell peppers
Serve with: fried egg, fried saba, and rice

instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion, garlic and tomato paste. Sauté for at least 2 minutes or until you can smell the nice vegetable aroma.
Into the mixture, drop the Knorr Beef Cube and mash it well with the spices before adding the ground beef. Continue to sauté until the meat is cooked through.
Throw in the vegetables next and simply sauté until they are cooked. And that’s our dish!
See the reaction on your family’s faces when you share this Arroz Ala Cubana with egg, sweet saba slices and a serving of rice. This will truly make their day!

name: Bagnet with KBL Sinigang sa Sampalok Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich flavor of Ilocos style salsa made of kamatis-bagoong-onions with the filipino classic pork bagnet cooked in tamarind broth.
tips: KBL or kamatis-bagoong-lasona/onions is an Ilocos styel Filipino tomato salsa. It is best paired with grilled and fried fish.

ingredients.item: kilo pork belly (ask your butcher to cut 2” thick cubes)
whole onion, peeled and cut into 4
(1/2 pack) of Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok mix
whole onion, peeled and cut thinly (julienned)
litre 1/2 Liter Knorr Pork broth (dissolve ½ pc. Knorr Pork Cube in ½ L of water)

instructions: This recipe is divided into 2 parts. First, you need to make the Bagnet and second, the sauce.

First, you need to thoroughly clean the pork belly and then prepare a deep pot where you can sauté the garlic and onion together. When the garlic is slightly brown and the onion is translucent, place the pork belly in and fill the pot with water covering the meat. Throw in the bay leaf, salt and peppercorn now. Bring this to a boil then lower the heat to a simmer for about 30 minutes. Now, don’t forget to remove the scum floating on top. They are the impurities found on the meat. Now, with the use of a strainer or colander, drain the pork belly and pat it dry with the paper towel after pricking the skin with a fork.
Gently deep-fry the pork belly at a low temperature until slightly browned. Set this aside and leave it to cool down at room temperature before storing in the chiller overnight.
The following day, fry the pork belly at high temperature until golden brown and crispy.

Moving on to the KBL Sinigang sauce, you’ll need a pan where you can briefly sauté the onion and tomatoes. Now, pour in the Knorr Pork broth and Sinigang broth in before adding the bagoong balayan and fish sauce.
Thicken the sauce with cornstarch mix and stir until you get a smooth consistency. Give this a few sprinkle of Knorr Liquid Seasoning, salt and pepper and this dish is done.
Bagnet with KBL Sinigang sa Sampalok Recipe will linger in your stomach and mind once you’ve tried it. It’s simply delicious!

name: Bam-I Recipe
description: This Cebu classic simple and delicious dish uses the rich taste of chicken, sweet chorizo and garden fresh vegetables, tossed with egg noodles.
tips: Bam-i is simple and quick to make so make sure that you have all the ingredients and pans prepared and ready for cooking before starting the dish.

ingredients.item: Serve with: sliced hardboiled egg & calamansi

instructions: Begin by extracting the color of atsuete by combining 2 tablespoons of oil with 1 tablespoon of atsuete in a sautépan. Turn the heat to medium and leave the seeds to cook. Discard the seeds once it turns dark in color.

Throw in the onions, and garlic until you can smell the lovely aroma of the thoroughly cooked vegetables. Continue by dropping the chorizo, chicken breast, and suaje. Saute until the meat and vegetables are cooked through.
Pour in the water and bring this to a boil before adding the Knorr Shrimp Cubes. Give this a quick but gentle stir.
Finally, throw in the noodles and vegetables and toss to fully mix and to cook them evenly. Taste the cooked noodles and adjust the flavour by adding enough salt and pepper.
Decorate the noodles with slices of hard-boiled egg on top and calamansi on the side.
This pancit dish is ready and best shared with the family.

name: Bangus Espesyal Recipe
description: This simple and delicious dish uses the fresh seafood taste of Bangus combined with carrots, potatoes and bell peppers, infused with Knorr seasoning.
tips: Milkfish is a good source of healthy proteins and Omega 3 Fatty acids that helps reduce the risk of high blood pressure and chronic diseases.

ingredients.item: boneless bangus, skinned and sliced into medium cubes

instructions: Let’s begin by marinating the sliced bangus cubes in Knorr Liquid Seasoning and ground pepper for 30 minutes.

Next, get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Melt some margarine and throw in the garlic then sauté until golden brown. Throw in the onions next and cook until translucent. Gently add the bangus cubes including the marinade but do not mix. Just cover and simmer for 1 minute before adding the carrots and potato. Reduce the heat and simmer for 20 more minutes.
Mix in the red and green bell peppers and simmer continuously for 8-10 minutes or until the bangus is cooked and that’s our dish!

All you need is the whole family to enjoy a serving of Bangus Espesyal because something as nutritious and good as this is best shared with your loved ones. What are you waiting for? Taste and be delighted!

name: Beef Kimus Recipe
description: This traditional Maranao dish combines the rich taste of beef mixed with grated coconut meat, carrots and onions, infused with palapa and turmeric.
tips: When steaming the dish, remember that the food should not be directly hitting the boiling liquid, only stem should be in direct contact with the food. Keep the pot covered at all times to keep the steam circulating within the pot.

ingredients.item: (mix and pound all ingredients together in a mortar and pestle)
whole coconut meat, grated (niyog or coconut used for milk and cream)

instructions: Let’s start by preparing the Palapa sauce. Just simply mix and pound all Palapa ingredients together in a mortar and pestle, or in a blender. Add Knorr Liquid Seasoning and salt and pepper to taste. Set aside.
Next, we can work on the Beef Kimus meat. Let’s begin by diluting Knorr Beef Cube in 3 tbsp vegetable oil then set this aside.

Get a large mixing bowl and combine the ground beef, garlic, carrots onion, onion leeks, palapa mixture, grated coconut meat and diluted Knorr Beef cube. Mix and pound thoroughly until the mixture turns yellow in color and has a dough like consistency. While mixing, sprinkle some Knorr Liquid Seasoning, salt and pepper as well.
Take a hand full of the beef mixture and mold it into egg-shaped pieces. Steam the pieces for 20 minutes or until beef is cooked and that’s our dish!
Beef Kimus goes well with bread, rice or on pasta dishes! However many ways you serve them, it’s best enjoyed with your family.

name: Beef Korma Recipe
description: Beef Korma is an Indian dish made of braised beef cooked in coconut milk infused with curry and spices mixed with potatoes and carrots.
tips: Korma is a mild curry made from various spices especially coriander; and often with yoghurt sauce. Instead of adding heat, it focuses more on flavor from cardamom and cinnamon spices.

ingredients.item: kilogram beef chuck (ask your butcher to cut it into cubes)
whole medium onion, peeled and sliced thinly, julienned

instructions: Let’s begin by searing our beef chuck in a deep sauce pan over high heat with a bit of oil. Make sure to get all the sides of the beef evenly browned to give the beef nice texture and flavour.

Next, in the same pan, throw in the garlic and onion. Sauté until the garlic is slightly brown and onions are translucent. Pour 2 tablespoons of the coconut cream into the pan and just allow this to get cooked until hot. Sprinkle the curry powder over and give this another minute to cook.

Return the seared beef chuck back into the pan with the coconut milk, water, Knorr Beef Cube, potatoes, bay leaves, fish sauce and the remaining coconut cream. Just let this simmer until the beef is almost tender.

When the beef is almost cooked and tender, just add the peanut butter and carrots then continue to cook until the meat and vegetables are tender. With a few sprinkle of Knorr Liquid Seasoning, salt and pepper this dish is done!

The aroma from this incredibly tasty Beef Korma recipe will have your family members rushing into the dining table in no time. Get ready because a night of good conversation and praises over the food are up ahead!

name: Beef Lomi Recipe
description: This simple and delicious dish uses the rich taste of beef mixed with bell pepper, onions and garlic, cooked in a savory broth served with lomi noodles.
tips: You can adjust the consistency and thickness of your soup by adding and removing some of the flour mixture, or slurry. Ading more slurry to the soup will eventually make the soup thicker.

ingredients.item: green bell pepper, cut into strips
red bell pepper, cut into strips

instructions: Cooking Lomi can be quite challenging but with these easy to do steps, you’ll have Beef Lomi in no time!
Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion, garlic and half of the bell peppers.
Gently add the rice wine and beef and just stir for a minute.
Add water and Knorr Beef Cube and give this a nice boil then reduce heat and simmer. Using a slotted spoon, skim off any impurities that rise to the surface.

We’re almost there! You just need to add the flavorings like the soy sauce and oyster sauce next before adding the lomi noodles and flour mixture. Finally, stir in the cabbage, spring onions, and sesame oil and that’s it! Our Beef Lomi is ready for the taking. Just top it with chopped spring onions and bell peppers.

name: Beef Nilaga in Tanglad Recipe
description: This dish uses the rich flavor of beef combined with the sweet flavor and aroma of lemongrass infused in the beef broth mixed with fresh vegetables.
tips: When simmering the beef, remember to skim the top of the liquid to remove the scum and impurities that rise up to the top of the liquid to keep our soup nice and clear.

ingredients.item: kilogram beef, cut into small cubes

instructions: Let’s begin by getting our medium pot nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onions, ginger and tanglad. Sauté until you can smell the lovely aroma from the cooked vegetables.

Stir in the beef next then followed by the water and your trusty flavor partner, Knorr Beef Cubes. Just bring to a boil then lower the heat to simmer. When the meat is tender, drop in the carrots and sotanghon noodles. For that Thai flair, use Hofan noodles instead of sotanghon then add siling labuyo, chopped wansuy leaves and Thai basil leaves.
Finally, gently place the cabbage in then simmer for a few minutes before turning off the heat. There you have it! Our dish is done!

With the aroma of Thailand filling your home, you can count on your whole household being very excited. Don’t let them wait any longer. Let them enjoy this Beef Nilaga in Tanglad recipe! They will surely thank you for it.

name: Begucan Babi Recipe
description: This classic Kapampangan dish uses the rich taste of spiced pork cooked in the sweet flavor of bagoong mixed with sour flavors from vinegar to balance.
tips: Annatto oil does not only give the dish a nice color but it is also used for treating heartburn, diarrhea, ulcer and skin issues.
instructions: Let’s begin by making annatto oil. First, heat together 1 tbsp annatto seeds and 2 tbsp vegetable oil in medium heat. Allow this to sizzle and remove the seeds when it turns dark in color. Remove the seeds and keep the oil.
Now, let’s proceed in cooking our dish. In the same pan, drop the garlic, onions, tomatoes and bagoong in the annatto oil.

The next step is to pour in the vinegar. Simmer for a minute to cook before adding Knorr Pork Broth Cube, pork liempo, pepper and green chilli. Bring this to a boil and then simmer until the meat is tender.
That's is. Serve and enjoy! You will surely eat a lot when your mom serves you this kapampangan dish. Manyaman!

name: Bulalong Biyas ng Baka Recipe
description: Bulalong Biyas ng Baka is all you need to make your tiring day soothing and relaxing. And it’s only made possible with Knorr Beef Cubes!

ingredients.item: beef shank, cut into serving pieces
Baguio beans, cut into 1 inch pieces

instructions: Here’s an easy to do soup that you should try cooking more often at home. All you need is a big sauce pot with water, beef shank and onions. Cook the meat until fork tender.
Now, drop in the Knorr Beef Cubes and Baguio beans next. Then, this should be followed by adding the pechay and onion leaks after. Season with patis and pepper and that’s our dish!
You will always be reminded of home when you try this Bulalong Biyas ng Baka Recipe. So yummy!

name: Bulgogi Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Bulgogi | Knorr
instructions: Let’s begin by rubbing sirloin strips with Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Just let this stand in the chiller for 10 minutes.
Next, grab a bowl and combine all the soy sauce ingredients together and mix this well.

After 10 minutes, cook the sirloin strips just roughly 6-8 seconds per side on a hot and well-oiled grill pan. Now, transfer the sirloin to a bowl, pouring the soy sauce mixture over. Just allow the meat to absorb the sauce by letting it sit for a few minutes.
Here’s how you serve the Bulgogi: you need to sprinkle some sesame seeds on top of the meat, wrap the meat with the lettuce leaves and spring onions and that’s it!
No need to go to a Korean restaurant because this home-made Bulgogi Recipe is all you will need to satisfy your cravings!

name: Burgundy Beef Gratin Recipe
description: This French classic dish combines the rich and deep flavor of slow cooked beef mixed with mushrooms and carrots; topped with creamy potato gratin.
tips: Braising is a cooking method that starts by searing the meat using a pan and followed by a slow cooking with liquids usually done in a slow cooker or oven. This cooking method makes meat tender and still retain its moisture.

ingredients.item: kilogram beef, top round, 2 inch cubes

instructions: Begin by getting a nice braising pan hot over medium high heat. Melt butter but make sure to add a bit of oil to prevent the butter from burning. Now, throw in the onions and mushrooms then sauté until soft and tender. Set aside.
