Using the same pan, gently sear the beef until brown on all sides then set this aside as well.
Next, throw in the carrots, sauté for a few minutes before adding the flour. Stir well until the flour is cooked. Slowly add the water and Knorr Beef Cubes then simmer for a minute.
Pour the wine, thyme, parsely, and bayleaf and simmer for another minute.
Gently add the beef back into the pan and braise for 2 to 3 hours in a 350F oven or until the beef is tender.
After 2 hours, place the onions and mushroom in and continue braising for another 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
In a medium pot, place the sliced potatoes in cold water and let it boil and cook until tender. Add cream, mozarella cheese, and cheddar cheese. Simmer until thick and season with salt and pepper.
Add the potato cheese sauce on top of the braised beef and top with chopped parsley.

name: Chicken and Mushroom Soup with Sotanghon Recipe
description: This heart healthy comfort food uses the rich flavor of chicken combined with sautéed mushrooms and garlic mixed with sotanghon noodles in clear soup.
tips: Adding fried garlic no only gives nice aroma to any dish, but it also gives extra sweetness and depth on flavor to the dishes including soups and stews.

ingredients.item: sotanghon (1 pack), soaked in water for 15 minutes

instructions: It’s your turn to impress mom by cooking this intimidating looking dish with these three simple steps. Begin by getting a medium pot and make it nice and warm over high heat. Start by sautéing garlic and onions before throwing in the chicken breast and mushrooms. Let the meat and vegetables sizzle until they are fully cooked.

Next, add the water then drop in the Knorr Chicken Cubes together with the soaked sotanghon noodles. Give this a stir until you can smell the garlic, onions and chicken in your kitchen as well as when you see the color developing in your soup.
Lastly, the addition of spring onions and fried garlic on top does not only make your dish look nice but will also add a whole new level of flavour to your soup once you add it in.
This dish is done and this will truly bring a smile to your family.
NOTE: NO YIELD, NO PREP TIME

name: Chicken Garlic Sopas Recipe
description: This Filipino Classic Comfort Food combines the rich flavors of chicken combined with carrots and bell pepper, served with sweet milk and tasty macaroni.
tips: Chicken Sopas is a rich source of protein and essential fatty acids. This soup is rich in iron and calcuim.
instructions: Make this sopas dish more tasty by first marinating the chicken meat with salt and a tablespoon of garlic. Leave this for about 15 minutes.
In a medium saucepan, sauté the remaining garlic and onions. When you can smell the lovely aroma of the cooked vegetables, drop in the marinated chicken and cook this until slightly brown in color.

Pour in the water and throw in the Knorr Chicken Cube. Bring this to a boil before adding the carrot, bell pepper and cooked macaroni noodles. Check the taste and season with pepper to see if it’s to your liking.
Finally, you may pour the evaporated milk over the dish and top with chopped spring onions to garnish.
Enjoy this light and creamy chicken garlic sopas with the family any time of the day or week.

name: Chicken Lollipop Recipe
description: This dish will surely be an instant hit with the kids. The dish is simple to make and very delicious. Best served with a nice cheese or tomato dip.
tips: It is best to store the chicken lollipops first in a food container and chill for a few hours to allow the breadcrumbs to stick well to the meat before frying.You can also insert some small cubes of melting cheese between the chicken bone and meat before coating them with flour, egg and breadcrumbs. (Once fried, you can expect the cheese to melt inside the lollipop)
instructions: Here’s a kid friendly recipe that can be made ahead of time and will surely engage your kids. First, you need a large pot to fit the water, garlic and Knorr Chicken Cubes. Bring this up to a boil before adding the chicken pieces. Once the chicken changes color, remove from the pot and drain well. Ask your children to use a paper towel to pat the chicken dry.
Now, the fun part comes. Coat the chicken pieces in some seasoned flour, dip in eggs, and then roll in breadcrumbs. Place in a container and chill for at least 1 hour.
When the chicken has set, you can now deep-fry them until golden brown. Make sure that the oil in the fryer is hot enough to avoid greasy food.
Finally, you can enjoy this easy and fun chicken lollipop with the whole family. Serve the chicken lollipops with your favourite dips on the side.

name: Chicken Pesa Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich taste of chicken with the spiced and smooth flavor of the ginger broth, served with fresh vegetables and potatoes.
tips: Ginger is a rich source of nutrients and antioxidants that may help reduce and prevent arthritis, inflammation and other types of infection.
instructions: Let's begin by getting a medium pot and make it nice and hot over high heat. Add the oil and sauté the garlic, onions and ginger until you can smell the nice aroma coming from the vegetables.
Add the chicken pieces and sauté until the skin is brown.
Add rice water, potatoes, peppercorn. Bring this slowly to a boil then lower the heat to simmer until chicken is cooked through.
Once the chicken is soft and tender, add in the Knorr Chicken cubes, repolyo and pechay leaves. Continue to simmer until all the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot! When you sip into this warm and comforting soup, this will remind you of home.

name: Chicken Piaparan Recipe
description: This Maranao dish combines the rich flavors of chicken mixed with spices cooked in a coconut milk based broth with garlic, turmeric and shredded coconut.
tips: Piaparan also means “shredded coconut” in Maranao.

ingredients.item: (mix and pound all ingredients together in a mortar and pestle)
Knorr Chicken broth (dilute ½ piece of Knorr Chicken Cube in ½ cup hot water)

instructions: Let's first prepare the Palapa by mixing the all ingredients together and pounding them in a mortar and pestle until well incorporated and you can smell the spices aroma. Set aside.

Now let's move to the chicken preparation. Fire up your stove to high and heat up your pan. Drop in the garlic and onions and sauté. When the garlic turns light brown in color and onions are translucent, it’s time to throw in the ginger and cook until you can smell the lovely aroma from the vegetables.

Gently place the chicken in the pan and cook it until it is evenly brown. Pour in the coconut milk, Knorr Chicken broth, bay leaves and turmeric powder and cook slowly in low heat until chicken is cooked through and tender.
In a separate pan, throw in the garlic, onion, onion leeks and palapa. Stir well and cook this for a few minutes to release the oils before adding to the coconut turmeric mixture.

For that umami goodness, this recipe isn’t complete without adding Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Check the taste so that you’ll know if additional salt and pepper will be needed to make the flavour suit your preferences.
Transfer to a serving plate and wait for your family’s reaction once they taste this delicious dish inspired by Maranao.

name: Chicken Pochero Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich flavor of chicken with the deep flavors of tomato sauce, sweetened by saba banana and chorizo flavor, mixed with potatoes and tokwa.
tips: Adding garbanzos (chickpeas) to your dish not only adds flavors and texture but it also boosts the nutritional value of your dish. It helps improve digestion and helps reduce the risks of several diseases.

ingredients.item: kilogram chicken, cut into serving pieces
canned garbanzos, drained and skins removed
tokwa, fried and cut into cubes

instructions: Give this Filipino stew a power pack of flavour by first boiling the chicken in water together with Knorr Chicken Cubes.
Throw in the rest of the ingredients while putting in the chorizo last. Cook this slowly over low heat before topping the pechay and fried tofu.
Your family will surely adore you for this simple yet more than satisfying stew of chicken in tomatoes.

name: Corned Beef Soup Recipe
description: This simple and delicious dish combines the rich flavor of corned beef enhanced with Knorr beef flavor mixed with cabbage to create a hearty comforting soup.
tips: When choosing the type of corned beef, choose the type with more chunk and less fat. It make for a more meatier soup.
instructions: Begin by getting your saucepan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the garlic, onion and tomatoes.
Gently add the corned beef and sauté for two minutes. Pour the water and Knorr Beef Cubes next and just let this boil before adding the cabbage. And that’s our dish!
Potatoes cut in small cubes may be added to make this a more hearty meal.

name: Crispy Dinuguan Recipe
description: This classic Filipino dish uses pork belly and innards mixed with slightly sour taste from the vinegar seasoned with garlic, onions and chili.
tips: When cooking with blood, turn the heat to high buut don't cover the pot. Stir the pork blood gently occasionally so it doesn't stick to the bottom of the pot.

ingredients.item: kilogram pork belly (liempo) (ask your butcher to cut your pork belly to 1” strips)
whole white onion, peeled and minced
sukang Iloco (you can use cane vinegar)
Knorr Pork broth (dilute 1 piece Knorr Pork Cube in 2 cups water)

instructions: Let’s begin by boiling the pork heart, pork liver and pork intestine in a stockpot or deep pan filled with water. You then have to cook the meat until they are tender. Remove the pork intestine and discard the stock used for boiling.
Now, slice the pork heart and pork liver into strips. Set this aside after.

Next, grab a pan and pour some oil. Make this nice and hot over medium high heat. Bring the garlic and onion into the pan and sauté. When the garlic turns slightly brown and the onions are translucent, throw in the pork belly followed by the pork heart and liver strips. Sauté briefly before adding the Knorr Pork broth, sukang iloco and bay leaves. Bring this to a simmer uncovered until the pork belly is tender.

Now when the liquid has reduced to ¾, gently add the pork blood in and continue simmering until it thickens (add more Knorr pork broth if sauce is too thick). Then, season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning, salt and pepper.
When you deep fry the pork intestine to a crisp, golden brown color, this dish is done! Be careful, though, because the crispy pork intestine topped on your dinuguan will cause you to eat more!

name: Curried Shrimp Recipe
description: This dish combines the fresh seafood taste from the shrimps mixed with the garlic and toasted curry, combined with the sweet and creamy coconut milk sauce.
tips: The secret to having a flavourful dish when you’re cooking with spices is to first toast the spices in a pan without any additional oil to bring out the essential oil - in this case the curry powder.
instructions: Let's start by getting a medium pan, make it nice and warm over high heat and toast the curry powder for a minute or until you can smell the nice aroma from the toasted curry powder, turn off the heat and set aside.
Using the same pan over medium heat, pour a little oil and throw in the garlic and just sauté until brown.

Throw in the shrimp next and add the curry powder before adding the Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay dissolved in water. Just let this boil and then reduce heat to a simmer until all the ingredients are cooked and the sauce is thick. And that’s our dish!
All you need now is a big serving of rice and the whole family to share this lovely dish. It’s simply amazing!

name: Curry Rice Recipe
description: This simple rice dish combines the flavorful taste of curry mixed with sweet coconut milk flavor combined with the rich flavors of chicken and fresh greens
tips: When cooking with coconut milk, you need to monitor the heat and do not let the liquids reach and keep at a boiling temp to prevent it from breaking. Keep the heat at a low-medium and keep the liquids only at a simmer.

ingredients.item: (1 pack) Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix dissolved in 1 cup water

instructions: First, get a medium sized pan and make it nice and warm over high heat. Add some oil and start to sauté the garlic, leeks, then add the chicken fillet cubes. Cook until the chicken turns brown and aromatic.
Add dissolved Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix then lower the heat to simmer until the sauce thickens. Add curry powder then stir well.
Add cooked rice, mix well, and season to taste with fish sauce. Serve hot.
categories: KNORR GINATAANG GULAY SITAW AT KALABASA MIX

name: Daing na Bangus Recipe
description: This Filipino classic dish is simple to make, delicious and very nutritious. It uses that fresh seafood flavor of bangus, marinated and fried to perfection.
tips: Bangus (Milkfish) is an excellent source of Omega-3 fatty acids that are believed to benefit the heart by reducing the growth rate of plaque that clogs blood vessels, lowering the risk for abnormal heart rhythm and lowering the levels of the bad fats.
instructions: All you need to do is season the fish with Knorr Liquid Seasoning and pepper then rub it with garlic evenly. And that’s it! That’s how simple it is. Let it sit and marinate for at least 15 minutes.
You just need to pre-heat the oil in a pan and fry the bangus until brown, top with toasted garlic and that’s our dish!

name: Fish Calamansi Steak Recipe
description: This dish uses the fresh seafood taste of tuna marinated in a tamarind based seasoning; fried to create a crispy texture served in a slightly tangy sauce.
tips: Tuna is s great source of Omega-3 Fatty acids that is good for the heart and it helps reduce heart related diseases.

ingredients.item: kilo blue marlin or tuna, cut into steak pieces
(1 pack) Knorr Sinigang sa Original Mix, dissolved in 1 cup water
medium sliced onions, sliced into rings

instructions: In a saucepan over medium heat, combine and dissolved Knorr Sinigang Original Mix, Knorr Liquid Seasoning and ginger, then add the fish steak. Let this simmer until fish is cooked. Remove fish from the sauce, and reserve the sauce for later use.
In another pan, sauté onions with a little oil over low heat until onions caramelized. Then add the fish steak and allow to fry. Flip the fish to cook both sides evenly.
Slowly add the marination sauce where fish is cooked, and simmer until sauce is thick. With a big serving of rice, you will definitely eat more than usual!

name: Fish in Sinigang Butter Sauce Recipe
description: This fish recipe combines the fresh seafood taste from the blue marlin infused with tamarind seasoning pan fried in a garlic butter sauce.
tips: Before adding the seasoning to the fish, wash and pat dry the fish slices to remove excess blood and water from the fish. This will also prevent the seasoning from falling off the meat.

ingredients.item: kilo blue marlin or tuna, cut into steak pieces

instructions: Let's begin by rubbing Knorr Sinigang Original Mix on fish slices and set aside to let it penetrate and marinate the fish.
Now get your pan nice and hot over low heat and melt the butter. Throw in the garlic and just sauté until tender. Gently place the fish in and cook until done. And that’s our dish!
When your family sees the plated fish with sauce on top, they will surely race to the dinner table! What a contender this dish is – it both looks and smells so good!

name: Fistek Recipe
description: This dish is simple to make and yet it highly nutritious. This dish uses the fresh seafood taste from the fish, combined with onions and sweetened sauce.
tips: Fish is a great source of Omega3 fatty acids that help reduce the risk of cardiovascular diseases and reduce inflammation.
instructions: First, let’s give this fish a nice seasoning of salt and pepper and dredge it in flour. Shake off any excess and make sure you have already preheated a pan filled with oil for deep frying. Fry the fish until brown and just remove it and place it on a plate lined with paper towels. Set aside.
Get another pan and turn the heat to medium. Throw in the onions and allow for them to sweat or make them tender before adding in the water. Let this simmer then add soy sauce and Knorr Fish Cubes.

Gently place the fish fillets back with the sugar in and reduce the sauce until you get your desired consistency. Add calamansi juice to taste and that’s our dish! Make sure you have a big bowl of rice ready and a big appetite for you will definitely eat more than usual!

name: Fried Pork Mami Recipe
description: This ideal comfort food recipe combines the deep flavor of fried seasoned pork mixed with egg noodles served in a clear pork broth soup.
tips: To add more flavor to the Mami, when cooking the noodles, try add Knorr Chicken cubes in the boiling water with a little sautéed garlic and olive oil, to infuse the chicken flavor in the noodles.

ingredients.item: kilogram pork liempo, cut into strips
hard boiled egg, peeled and sliced

instructions: Let’s begin by giving the pork liempo a good flavouring of Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Rub and massage this on the pork and leave it for 20 minutes before frying them in very hot oil until brown. After, remove the pork liempo from the oil and set it aside.
For the next step, get a saucepan ready and bring the water and Knorr Pork Cubes to a boil. You have to season this with patis and pepper.
Now, divide the cooked egg noodles into 4 separate soup bowls and top each with a generous serving of fried pork pieces, a slice of egg and chopped green onions.
The hot soup is now ready to be served. Just pour some into each soup bowl and then sprinkle fried garlic chips for added flavor.
Mami in itself is pleasurable to eat. Imagine if you add the crunchiness of fried pork! We can assure you that you will never get tired of eating this Fried Pork Mami Recipe.

name: Galbi Jim Recipe
description: Indulge in the mouthwatering flavors of galbi jim, a traditional Korean stew made with succulent beef and savory broth. Get the recipe now from Knorr.

ingredients.item: beaten egg, fried and cut into julienne

instructions: Let’s begin by getting our pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the garlic, ginger and the beef sirloin.

Add the rice wine next followed by the beef stock, soy sauce and the brown sugar. Stir well before adding the slurry made of 1 tbsp cornstarch and 2 tbsp water. Just allow this wonderful sauce to simmer until thick.

Throw in the spring onions, sesame oil and sesame seeds. It sure has a nice smell already but you still need to let this simmer for a minute and that’s our dish! Before serving, don’t forget to top Galbi Jim with egg strips and spring onions.
You will simply fall in love when you taste the delicious goodness of this Galbi Jim Recipe.

name: Gambas Al Ajillo Recipe
description: This simple dish combines the rich seafood flavors of shrimp infused with garlic and chili flavors.
tips: Using beer as a simmering liquid to cook the shrimps can bring out a deeper level of richness in flavor of the shrimps.

ingredients.item: med-large shrimp, peeled with tails intact, deveined

instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the garlic and cook until the vegetable gives off a nice aroma and becomes brown in color. Drop in the Knorr Shrimp Cube, mash then stir.
Pour in the beer and let this simmer until reduced to half (optional).

Gently add the shrimp with the lemon juice and siling labuyo. Just sauté until shrimps are cooked through and then serve with a topping of toasted garlic bread on the side and lemon wedges. Finally, that’s our dish! Whether it’s an appetizer or main, Gambas Al Ajillo will always be a feel good dish!

name: Dinengdeng Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Dinengdeng made special with Knorr Pork Cubes. Prepare a perfect healthy meal for your family.
tips: Since we are using fish bagoong in this recipe, we need to add a little ginger to remove the fishy smell and taste (lansa), and this also adds more nutrients to the soup.

ingredients.item: fried or inihaw na tilapia fillet,cut into 4

instructions: Prepare a pot filled with water and bring this to a boil. Add the onions, ginger and tomatoes. Gently add the fish in and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove the fish and set aside.
In the same pot, dissolve the Knorr Pork cubes and add the fish abogoong.
Place the sitaw in and cook until tender. Then, add the talong, bulaklak ng kalabasa and saluyot and just cook for another 2 minutes.

Return the fish into the pan and season with salt. Turn off the heat and that’s our dish! Everything about this dish is good. You have the protein from fish and the nutritious goodness from the vegetables. What are you waiting for? All you need is the company of your loved ones to share this amazing dish with.

name: Ensaladang Lato Recipe
description: This simple dish combines the rich and deep seafood flavor of from the lato (sea grapes) seaweeds mixed with honey vinaigrette to give it a balance of flavor.
tips: You can also replace the canola oil to olive oil to give it a healthier boost of nutrients and minerals.

ingredients.item: Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original

instructions: This recipe is so easy to make. Make the dressing first by combining the vinegar, garlic, honey, and Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original in a bowl. Mix well until smooth.
Slowly drizzle the canola oil while whisking.

Arrange the salad ingredients on a plate and drizzle the vinaigrette over. Toss well to fully coat the salad. How simple is that but not simple on the flavour. Serve as side to your favourite meat dish or eat as snack, it's healthy on the belly.

name: Garlic Coconut Prawns with Cheese Recipe
description: This resto style recipe combines the fresh seafood taste of shrimps mixed with sweet coconut milk and garlic, baked topped with cheese.
tips: If you wish to have a nice presentation of the dish, remember to devein the shrimps before preparing the mix. The black vein that runs along the back of the shrimp is an intestinal tract of the shrimp, and it can easily be remove by a small knife.
instructions: First, butterfly the prawn by laying it on a chopping board. Remove the prawn meat but keep the head and tail shell intact. Chop prawn meat into half inch pieces and season well. Set this aside.
Blanch prawn shells in boiling water for 30 seconds or until shells turn orange.

Now, get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and saute onions and garlic. Add mushrooms, chopped prawn meat, Knorr Gintaang Gulay Mix and cream. Mix well and let it simmer until sauce slightly thickened.
Fill the prawn shells with the sautéed meat mixture. Top with cheese and breadcrumbs.
Bake in pre heated oven until cheese melts and turns golden brown. Serve.

name: Ginataang Manok at Kalabasa Recipe
description: This simple dish is combines the rich flavor of chicken mixed with kalabasa cooked in sweet coconut milk sauce topped with malunggay leaves for added flavors.
tips: Malunggay is a great source of Vitamin A, higher than the Vitamin A contents of regular carrots. Vitamin A is good for eye sight health and enhancing the skin appearance.

ingredients.item: Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay dissolved in 1 cup water

instructions: In a medium pan over high heat, begin by cooking your chicken breast in oil until lightly brown.
Next, throw in the squash and cook this quickly as you sauté this for a minute.

When pouring the water and Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay, make sure to stir and mix well until the mixture is free of lumps. Now, cook this into a simmer until all the ingredients are cooked through.
Finally, top with malunggay leaves and cook the sauce for another minute.
Enjoy this dish with your family at home! You will definitely bond over how delicious this Ginataang Manok at Kalabasa recipe was.
categories: KNORR COMPLETE RECIPE MIX GINATAANG GULAY

name: Golden Tinola Recipe
description: This Filipino Classic soup dish combines the rich taste of chicken, fresh flavors of malunggay and kalabasa, and the refreshing flavors of ginger broth soup.
tips: "Moringa (Malunggay) has been used for centuries for its medicinal and health benefits. Malunggay is full of vitamins an minerals that help prevent and cure diseases. Malunggay has anti fungal, anti inflammatory and antiviral properties.Malunggay leaves are very for breast-feeding and lactating mothers. "

ingredients.item: kilogram chicken, cut into serving pieces

instructions: You can prepare this fast and easy recipe in an instant. Begin by preparing a large pot, place on high heat then add oil. Cook the garlic, onions and ginger by sautéing until you can smell the nice aroma from the vegetables. Carefully place the chicken pieces, Knorr Chicken Cubes and a tablespoon of fish sauce, then cook this for 10 minutes.
Pour the hugas bigas and bring this to a boil before lowering the heat to a simmer. Allow it to cook for 5 minutes longer before adding the kalabasa. Cook until the kalabasa and chicken are tender.
Place kalabasa flower and malunggay leaves on top of the tinola and let this cook for another minute.
Wait until you see the joy in the eyes of your family when you serve this Golden Tinola. The look will be priceless!

name: Halang Halang Recipe
description: This classic Visayan dish uses the rich flavor of chicken mixed with the sweetness of the coconut milk sauce, combined with the extra spicy flavor of chili.
tips: When cooking / searing with butter, remember to add a little bit of oil in the pan to prevent the butter from burning.

ingredients.item: Knorr Ginataang Gulay Sitaw at Kalabasa Complete Recipe Mix

instructions: Get a medium pan and make it nice and hot over high heat. Toss in the butter with a little bit of oil to prevent the butter from burning then throw in the onions, garlic and ginger. Cook this until you can smell the lovely aroma from the vegetables.

Add the chicken breast and sauté for 2 minutes before pouring in the Knorr Ginataang Gulay Sitaw at Kalabasa Recipe Mix diluted in 1 1/2 cups of water. Bring that to a boil before throwing in the chilis. Cook this to a simmer over low heat until the sauce is thick and the chicken is cooked through.
For that added flavour, sprinkle some patis to taste.
Over hot rice, enjoy this Halang-Halang recipe with the family. It will definitely merit a two thumbs up review for sure!
NOTE: NO YIELD, NO PREP/ NO COOKING TIME
categories: KNORR GINATAANG GULAY SITAW AT KALABASA COMPLETE RECIPE MIX

name: Inihaw na Tambakol Recipe
description: This dish uses the fresh seafood taste of a local tuna variety, Tambakol, stuffed with tomatoes and onions; grilled to give it a charred and smokey flavor.
tips: Tambakol is the Tagalog name for a particular kind of tuna. It is a great source of Omega-3 fatty acids that help reduce heart disease and other chronic diseases.
instructions: Begin by slicing the Tambakol on its belly. Clean and wash to remove excess blood and dirt. Season well with Knorr Liquid Seasoning and half of the Knorr Sinigang Original.
In a bowl combine tomatoes, onions and kinchay and season with the remaining Knorr Sinigang Original and pepper.
Stuff tomato mixture in the fish cavity. Grill over hot charcoal. Let the fish cook for around 3-4 minutes per side before flipping to prevent it from sticking to the grill.
Expect hugs and kisses when you serve Inihaw na Tambakol to your family. It's that good!

name: Insarabsab Recipe
description: This crispy pork Ilokano classic dish combines the flavor of char grilled pork mixed with ginger and onions, infused with chili and tamarind flavors.
tips: When grilling meats, don't move the meat / food around too much. Let it stay in the grill a little longer to let the meat cook more. It will be easier to remove it and get it unstuck when it is fully cooked.

ingredients.item: Knorr Sinigang sa Sampaloc broth (1 tsp. of Knorr Sinigang sa Sampaloc dissolved in ½ cup of hot water)

instructions: Seasoning your pork belly and pork ears with Knorr Liquid Seasoning, salt and pepper is one way of developing good flavour to your meat before grilling. Marinate the pork meat for at least 1 hour to get a more intense flavor.
Next, grill your pork belly until it’s cooked through and crisp. Now, set this aside and make sure that you slice them into 1 inch thick strips.

Let's now wok on the sauce. Grab a pan and make it nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the garlic and onion and cook them until the garlic is slightly brown and the onions are translucent.
You may now add the ginger, the previously crispy sliced pork belly, and pork ears and then briefly sauté them for 2 minutes.
Into the pan, pour Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok broth, calamansi juice, fish sauce and red chili pepper and simmer this for a minute.
Give this a good sprinkle of Knorr Liquid Seasoning and a dash of salt and pepper. Finally, this dish is done!

name: Kalabasa and Malunggay Souprise Recipe
description: This heart healthy vegetable broth recipe combines the garden fresh flavors and textures of kalabasa, sitaw and talong mixed with flavors of malunggay leaves.
tips: Eating Malunggay (Moringa) helps boosts the immune system and help reduce inflammation. Malunggay contains minerals that aid digestion, ensuring that the body totally absorbs the nutrients in our dish.
instructions: Here’s an easy vegetable dish that you can cook over and over without getting tired of it. First, get a pot and fill it with 5 cups water. Over high heat, bring the water to a boil and drop 2 Knorr Pork Cubes.
Throw in the kalabasa and cook until firm but tender. Add sitaw followed by the talong and okra. Boil the vegetables until they're just cooked.
Lastly, add dahon ng malunggay and that’s our dish.
Match Kalabasa and Malunggay with your favourite fried dish or eat as is, you will definitely feel happier and lighter all throughout the day.

name: Lamb Chops Recipe
description: This traditional Greek dish uses the unique flavor of Lamb chops that gives this dish a sweet-grassy-finished flavor, combined with oregano and butter flavors.
tips: Lamb is not only a rich source of high-quality protein, but it is also an outstanding source of many vitamins and minerals, including iron, zinc, and vitamin B12.Lamb is traditionally paired with mint jelly.
instructions: Let's first marinate and season the lamb chops. In a medium bowl, combine Knorr Liquid Seasoning, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano and black pepper together to make the marinate. Coat both side o the lamb and let the meat marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour olive oil and add the butter.
Fry the lamb chops until cooked through. Fry or grill for 3-4 minutes each side, depending on the thickness.
Serve with salad, baked potatoes or rice, this is a true winner!

name: Old-Fashioned Nilagang Baboy Recipe (Filipino Pork Belly Soup)
description: Nilagang baboy is one of those dishes that delivers the familiar taste of traditional Filipino home cooking. It’s a Filipino pork soup made by gently boiling meat until tender, then adding vegetables to create a hearty, all-in-one pot of goodness. Give this easy nilagang baboy recipe a try and serve a warm, comforting bowl the whole family will enjoy.

ingredients.item: spaghetti noodles (cooked according to package directions)

instructions: Build the Broth Place water, onions, pork, and Knorr Pork Cubes in a large pot. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Skim off any scum that rises. Tip: Removing impurities early helps maintain a clean, clear broth.

Simmer Pork Until Tender Lower heat and simmer until the pork becomes fork-tender. Add potatoes halfway through cooking so they soften without breaking apart. Tip: Keep the heat at a gentle simmer, not a rolling boil, to avoid a cloudy broth.
Add the Greens Add pechay and bok choy. Simmer just until the vegetables are tender but still vibrant. Serve hot. Tip: Leafy greens cook quickly, so avoid overcooking to keep their color and texture.

name: Paksiw na Baka Recipe
description: This Filipino classic dish combines the rich flavor of beef mixed with the sweet and slightly sour paksiw sauce infused with spices and seasoning.
tips: To reduce the sour vinegar taste from the sauce, remember to bring the sauce to a boil but keep the pan or pot uncovered so that the aroma and strong flavors of the vinegar evaporates.
instructions: There are 2 things to consider in preparing this dish. First, you need to make a crispy fried beef. Second, you need to make the delicious paksiw sauce.
Begin by seasoning the beef with pepper and Knorr Liquid Seasoning and just marinate this for an hour for that added taste.
After an hour, just fry the beef cubes in hot oil until brown. Drain on top of a plate lined with paper towels then reserve the marinade.
Get a pan, and place the lechon sauce, vinegar, crushed peppercorns, bay leaf and the marinade and bring this to a boil uncovered. Continue to simmer until the strong aroma of vinegar is reduced.

Now, gently add the beef and cook over low heat until tender. You may add more water if the sauce becomes too thick. Let the fat of the beef melt to give the sauce more flavour. Finally, season with enough salt and that’s it!
There’s always something to celebrate when you serve Paksiw na Baka to your family. This dish just brings loved ones together!

name: Papaitan Recipe
description: Enjoy classic Ilocano flavors with papaitan. Follow this recipe and hit the right balance of bitterness and richness with Knorr Beef Cubes.
tips: Remember to remove the scum that accumulate on the top of the initial boiling liquid when cooking the beef innards. Do this constantly before the liquid reaches boiling stage.

ingredients.item: kilo beef innards (tripe, kidney, liver, heart, intestines)
peeled ginger, julienned or cut into thin strips
Knorr Sinigang sa Sampaloc broth (dilute 1 pack Knorr Sinigang sa Sampaloc in 4 cups hot water)

instructions: Let’s begin by cleaning the internal organs. Wash and clean the beef innards then transfer to a deep pan or stock pan. Fill this with water and boil. Drain and cut into small ½ inch cubes and set aside.

Get another pan and get it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the garlic and onion. Sauté until the garlic is slightly brown and the onions are translucent. Now, throw in the ginger and sauté briefly.
Add the cubed internal organs and stir fry for 5 minutes before pouring the Knorr Sinigang broth just enough to cover all the ingredients.

Gently add the beef bile little by little and don’t forget to taste if the bitterness is just right for your taste preference. Add your minced red chili pepper then season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning, fish sauce, salt and pepper. Transfer to a serving bowl, and with a topping of spring onions, that’s our dish!
Papaitan may have an intimidating taste for some but Knorr’s version of this recipe will bring you to the moon and back! Try it and see what we mean.

name: Pasta Vonggole with Vigan Longganisa Recipe
description: This simple dish combines the fresh seafood taste from clams mixed with the garlic flavors of Vigan longganisa served with Linguine pasta.
tips: When you are cooking with clams, never select a clam that is already open or chipped, broken, or damaged. Make sure that before you prepare them, that they are still closed. Clean the shell then soak them in water with a little salt to clean to remove the excess sand and clean the insides of the clams before eating.

ingredients.item: diced Vigan Longanisa (reserve 10 g for clam broth)
white onion, peeled and minced (separate 10 g for clam broth)
Knorr Fish broth (dilute ½ Knorr Fish Cube in 1 cup hot water)

instructions: Begin by getting a small pot and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and lightly sauté garlic and onion. Add the live Manila clams and pour Knorr Fish broth. Cover and steam until clams open their shells. Set the clams aside and reserve the juice.

Get another pan, pour some oil and make it nice and hot. Add the Vigan Longanisa and render until the meat is a little toasted. Then saute garlic and onion until garlic is slightly brown and onions are translucent.
Add clams and pour at least ¼ cup of the clam juice. Slightly reduce the liquid then add freshly cooked pasta.
Add parmesan cheese and finish it off with butter. Season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning, salt and pepper .
When you serve Pasta Vonggole with Vigan Longganisa to your family, they will surely love you for it.

name: Take a Trip to Mindanao with This Chicken Pastil Recipe with Simple Chicken Pastil Ingredients
description: Popular as an affordable dish among Muslim households in Mindanao, Pastil is a packed rice dish wrapped in banana leaves with dry shredded beef, chicken, or fish. Make this classic Mindanaon dish in the comforts of your own home with a few simple ingredients.
tips: Wash and dry the banana leaves well before using. Remove all dirt and white residues on the leaves, then cut into the size and shape needed for the recipe.

ingredients.item: thumb size ginger, peeled and minced
Knorr Chicken Cube, dissolved in 2 cups of water
Knorr Liquid Seasoning Original, to taste

instructions: Heat a large stock pot over medium heat.
Add the quartered chicken, salt, bay leaves, and pepper. Add enough water to cover the chicken.
Bring to a boil until the chicken is tender. Strain and set aside to cool.
Shred the chicken using a fork or your fingers. Set aside.
Heat up a separate pan over medium high heat, add oil, and sauté the onions and garlic until the onions are soft and translucent. Add ginger and continue to sauté until fragrant.
Add the shredded chicken and sauté for a minute before adding the Knorr Chicken Cube dissolved in water and soy sauce.
Season to taste with Knorr Liquid Seasoning Original, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Now we’re ready to assemble the Chicken pastil. Take one banana leaf and place a cup of steamed rice on top followed by half a cup of the seasoned shredded chicken. Wrap to form a parcel or pouch.
Repeat until there’s no more shredded chicken left.
Enjoy with your family!

name: Pesang Isda Recipe
description: This refreshing and calming soup dish uses the fresh seafood taste of fish cooked in a clear ginger-flavored broth soup.
tips: This dish is very nutritious as it combines the nutrients found in fish like protein and Omega 3 fatty acids that helps fight chronic diseases and ginger that has a lot of antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties.

ingredients.item: dalag, cleaned and cut into serving pieces

instructions: Begin by getting a medium pot and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and sauté garlic, ginger and onions.
Gently add the fish, hugas bigas and Knorr Fish Cubes.
Bring to a boil before adding black peppercorns, pechay Tagalog, and green onion. Continue cooking until vegetables are tender.
Serve, and get ready to receive praises from your family. It's so good!

name: Pinakbet Pasta Recipe
description: This dish uses Filipino classic recipe of Pinakbet using a variety of vegetables, fresh shrimps and pork loin, cooked and served with linguini pasta and bread.
tips: To devein the shrimps, lay the shrimp down and run your paring knife along the back try not to cut too deep, and by using the tip of knife, you can easily remove the black vein found at the back of the shrimp.

ingredients.item: fresh green beans, trimmed into 3 inches
eggplant, cut into bite size pieces
Knorr chicken broth (dilute ¼ Knorr Chicken cube in 1 cup hot water)

instructions: Let’s begin by heating up a large deep pan to medium high heat. Pour 2 tbsp of olive oil and fry the pork pieces until they are brown. A good 5-7 minutes will do.
Now, place the shrimp into the mixture and season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning, salt and pepper. Cook the shrimp until it turns pink or give it a good 5 minutes.
Remove the shrimp and pork and place them on top of a tray or plate lined with paper towels. Change the oil from the pan and replace it with a new one.
Throw in the garlic and onion and cook until the garlic is slightly brown and onions are translucent. Gently add the tomato, green beans and eggplant and cook until the vegetables are soft to touch.
Pour Knorr Chicken broth and mashed pumpkin and stir until you can see bubbles from the sauce.

Add the pork and shrimp back to the pan, reduce the heat and stir in the cream. Just give this 5 more minutes at a very low heat to avoid the cream from curdling. At this point, you will see the sauce thickening. Season this with Knorr Liquid Seasoning, salt and pepper.
To get the maximum flavour of your pasta, toss them into the sauce and cook at low heat for about a minute or two.
Now, transfer to a serving plate and serve with toasted bread and parmesan cheese on top.
With creativity and nutrition on your mind, you create this wonderful, healthy and delicious meal in one. Your family will truly be grateful!

name: Pinangat na Sapsap at Tokwa Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich seafood flavor from the Sapsap fish stewed in a tamarind based sour soup mixed with tomatoes and fried tofu.
tips: Sapsap is part of the silver belly fish family and they are a great source of calcium that help increase bone strength and Omega 3 fatty acids that helps reduce chronic diseases.
instructions: Get a medium pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and fry the tokwa until crispy and golden brown in color. Drain excess oil and set aside.
In another pan, heat a little oil then sauté onions and tomatoes until soft and fragrant.
Pour in the water and Knorr Sinigang Original Mix for the right blend of sour and savory tastes. Bring to a boil before adding the fish and sitaw.
Allow to boil for another 3-4 minutes, then Add kangkong tops.
Turn heat off and season with salt and pepper. Just before serving, drop in fried tokwa and serve hot. With warm rice, you will definitely eat more than usual.

name: Pinoy Pochero Recipe
description: This Filipino classic dish uses the rich flavors of beef mixed with the sweet taste of saging na saba and fresh garden flavors from the vegetables.
tips: Remember to remove the scum rising to the top of the liquids when tenderizing the beef. You need to clean out the scum before the water hits boiling point so that the scum doesn't dissolve back into the water.

ingredients.item: saging na saba, cut in half

instructions: First, get a large pan and make it nice and warm over high heat. Add the oil and sauté the garlic and onions until you can smell the nice aroma and slightly brown.

Add the beef and cook until the color turns light brown. Pour in the water and Knorr Beef cubes. and let this boil. Lower the heat to simmer and continue cooking until beef is fork tender. Remember to remove the scum rising to the top of the liquids.

Once beef is tender, pour in the tomato sauce and let it simmer. Then Add the green onions, tomato, repolyo, baguio beans, bok choy and kamote. continue to cook for additional 5 minutes. Add the banana saba halves and continue to cook until the vegetables are soft.
That's it. Time to enjoy Pinoy Pochero and to serve it to the whole family. Something as good as this need not take long, so grab your spoon and fork and enjoy!

name: Pita Pockets Recipe
description: This simple and nutritious recipe combines the rich flavor of chicken mixed with fresh slices of tomatoes, refreshing cucumbers and melted cheese.
tips: Pita bread aside from being a great source of energy giving carbohydrates, it is also good source of protein and fiber.

ingredients.item: kilogram chicken breast fillet, cut into cubes

instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot and then drizzle with a little bit of oil. Throw in the onions and chicken breast and cook them until light brown in color.
Season the meat by adding Knorr Sinigang Original Mix and pepper. Set this aside.

To assemble 1 serving: heat pita bread on both sides on top of a skillet to make it pliable. Next is to make a slit sideways to open into a pocket. Place 2-3 tablespoons of chicken mixture, tomatoes, cucumber, and cheese. You have the option to serve this with mayo.
With a platter full of Pita Pockets, you are surely making memories with your family.

name: Piyanggang Manok Recipe
description: This dish uses rich flavor of chicken combined with the unique flavor of charred coconut meat, mixed with flavorful spices of turmeric, ginger and lemongrass.
tips: Piyanggang Chicken is a traditional Mindanao Tausug tribe dish that is traditionaaly stewed in a flavorful charred coconut sauce, then finished on the grill.
instructions: Combine all ingredients of the pamapa itum in a food processor or in a mortar. Process or pound until mixture comes together in a paste.
Marinate chicken in the prepared pamapa itum for at least 5-10 minutes.
In a pan, heat oil and sauté garlic and onion. Add coconut milk, water, lemongrass, Knorr Chicken Cube and red chilies. Allow to simmer.
Add marinated chicken into the pan. Reduce heat and continue to cook until chicken is fully cooked.
Season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning, salt and pepper according to taste. Continue to simmer until sauce has thickened.
Optional to grill the chicken after braising. Remove chicken pieces from the sauce and grill until charred. Return back to sauce before serving.

name: Pochero Rico Recipe
description: Highlight deliciously tender beef with the classic, sweet flavors of pochero rico. Add mixed vegetables and tomato sauce for an unforgettable meal.
tips: When boiling the beef, remember to skim the top of the liquid and remove all the scum rising to the top of the surface, to keep the broth and sauce clear and flavorful.
instructions: In a pot of water, boil the beef over high heat while uncovered for about 5 minutes. Remember to remove all the scum rising to the top of the surface. Drain the beef and throw the liquid. Set the beef aside.

Grab another pot and return the beef. Pour 4 cups of water and add the aromatic vegetables and spices, half of the sliced onion and a few pieces of pamintang buo. Allow to simmer until the beef is tender. This set will allow some of the flavors to penetrate the inside of the meat. Set this aside after.
Now, get a shallow pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the garlic and one sliced onion. Pour the tomato sauce in with the Knorr Beef Cubes.

Sprinkle the sugar to add sweetness to the dish and pour the reserved broth from the boiled beef. Just let this boil before adding the saging na saba, potatoes, eggplant, baguio beans, small cabbage, and pechay.
This dish is almost done, just add the beef back and simmer for about 10 minutes and that’s our dish!

name: Poqui Poqui Recipe
description: This traditional Ilocos dish uses the rich flavor of char grilled eggplant combined with crushed sautéed onions and tomatoes infused with savory Knorr flavor.
tips: Eggplants are a great source of antioxidants that help reduce the risk of heart disease and other chronic diseases.

ingredients.item: whole white onion, peeled and minced
medium sized tomatoes, chopped into cubes
Knorr Chicken Cube, dissolved in ½ cup hot water

instructions: Begin by grilling the eggplant. Using your gas stove, directly grill the eggplant over the flames until charred. Remove from the heat and place under running water to remove charred skin of egg plant, and chop into small pieces. Set this aside.

Get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and sauté garlic and onion until garlic is slightly brown and onions are translucent. Add tomatoes and eggplant and sauté briefly. Add the Knorr Chicken broth and continue to simmer until the vegetables are soft.
Using a fork, mash all the ingredients until soft. Add lightly beaten eggs and stir until egg has set. Season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning, salt and pepper.
Transfer to a serving plate and enjoy Poqui Poqui with your family. See the smile on their faces when they taste this delicious dish.

name: Poqui Poqui with Quesadillas Recipe
description: This Ilocos inspired dish is a combination of char grilled eggplant combined with onions and tomatoes, served with lots of cheese and chicken bit on a Tortilla.
tips: Poqui poqui is a traditional Filipino dish originating from Ilocos, containing grilled eggplants that are first peeled, then chopped and sautéed with garlic, onions or shallots, and tomatoes.

ingredients.item: whole white onion, peeled and minced
Knorr Chicken broth (dissolve ½ Knorr Chicken Cube in ¼ cup hot water)
kilogram chicken breast, cut into small cubes

instructions: Begin by grilling the eggplants over stove top until charred and black. Transfer to a bowl and cover until moist and cool enough to peel the skin off. Don’t wash the eggplant because it will lose its chargrilled flavour. Once cool, peel of the skin and chop into small pieces. Set aside.

Get a pan and get it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the garlic and onion. Sauté until the garlic is slightly brown and onions are translucent. Now, add the add tomatoes in and eggplant and sauté briefly.
Pour the Knorr Chicken broth next. Using a fork mash all the ingredients together until soft before adding the lightly beaten eggs, stir until set.
Season the mixture with Knorr Liquid Seasoning, salt and pepper for that extra punch of flavour. Set aside.
For Chicken Breast: Season chicken breast with salt and pepper. You can either pan sear in hot oil or char grill over hot coals. Cut into cubes and set aside.

Now, let’s assemble our dish. Get a non-stick sauté pan and heat one whole tortilla. Evenly layer the poqui poqui mixture on half of the tortilla then add at least 2 tbs. of grilled chicken breast cubes on the poqui poqui and sprinkle cheddar cheese over it.

Fold the tortilla into half, toast until golden brown. Do the same for the other side. Poqui Poqui Quesadilla is best served with tomato salsa on the side. Here’s another dish where you can enjoy and bond with the family. It’s best shared with ones over game night, movie marathon day or just hanging out in the living room with the family.

name: Pork Buko Nilaga Recipe
description: This dish balances the sweet and tasty flavor of coconut juice and the rich flavors of pork, mixed with fresh herbs and vegetables.
tips: Coconut water is not only delicious but it is also packed with a lot of essential vitamins and minerals such as potassium, calcium and magnesium, and it is a good source of antioxidants.

ingredients.item: pork kasim, cut into medium size cubes
sweet corn on the cob, sliced into circles
fresh buko meat, sheets or shreds

instructions: Begin by getting your sauce pot nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onions and garlic and cook until the vegetables give off a nice aroma.

Now, pour the fresh buko water in and add the Knorr Pork Cubes. You’re now guaranteed to have that savory pork flavour in your broth. Fresh buko water makes a distinctly sweet broth. So, if you don’t want your soup to be too sweet, replace half of the buko juice with water.
Continue by stirring in the pork kasim then bring to a boil before adding the carrots and corn. Lower heat and simmer until meat and vegetables are tender.
Lastly, you just need to stir in your fresh buko shreds and cabbage. With patis and black pepper in, this dish is done!
Just by sipping into the hot soup of this Pork Buko Nilaga recipe, you will automatically be comforted!

name: Pork Igado Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Pork Igado. This dish uses the rich flavors of pork, mixed with sukang Iloco, chili and flavorful aromatics.
tips: To keep the pork cuts tender, maintain the heat to medium setting so it can slowly cooks the pork cuts.

ingredients.item: pork liver cut into strips (1 pork liver is at least 1/2 kilos)
pork belly (liempo) (ask your butcher to cut your pork belly to 1” strips)
of sukang Iloco (or you can use cane vinegar)
whole white onion, peeled and minced

instructions: Begin by grabbing a pan and making it nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the garlic and onion and cook them until the garlic is slightly brown in color and onions are translucent.
Gently place the pork belly and liver in and stir-fry for at least 5 minutes.
Pour 1 cup water then add 1/2 Knorr Pork Cubes, sukang Iloco and soy sauce together with bay leaf and simmer until meats are tender.
For that punch of flavour, drop in the finger chilli and red chilli pepper in. With a sprinkle of Knorr Liquid Seasoning, salt and pepper, this dish is finally complete!
Taste it and be satisfied with the delicious goodness of Pork Igado. It’s a totally filling meal that your family will surely enjoy!

name: Pork Pata in Monggo Recipe
description: This Filipino Classic dish combines the fresh flavors of monggo and ampalaya leaves with the rich taste of pork.
tips: When cooking monggo seeds, the longer you soak them in water, the less time you need to cook them.

ingredients.item: pork pata front, cut into serving pieces

instructions: Begin by washing the monggo seeds in water to get rid of the unwanted dirt it might have collected. And since monggo is a kind of dried bean, you need to soak them in water to soften them because seeds absorb water. You can soak monggo for a minimum of 1 hour in 5 cups of water and stir. Make sure to remove the floating particles on top.

Now, get a medium saucepan and make it nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the garlic, onions and tomatoes. Just keep on cooking until you see that the tomatoes are soft and tender.
You can now place the pork pata cubes and add in some water until pork cuts are covered. Cook at a simmer until the pork is fork tender.

Pour in the monggo beans then add the Knorr Pork Cubes. Add a water if necessary to prevent the soup from drying. Reduce the heat to low and cover the pot. Let this simmer for an hour or until you see that the monggo is tender.
Once monggo is tender, top it with the ampalaya leaves then turn the heat off and your dish is done.
When you serve Pork Pata in Monggo to your family, your family will surely thank you for it.

name: Pork Pho Nilaga Recipe
description: The aroma from the dish is very refreshing. The dish uses garden fresh herbs and vegetables mixed with pork cutlets, combined in a clear pork-shrimp broth.
tips: If you want to have that Ho Chi Minh experience, use hofan (flat rice) noodles in place of molo wrappers and sprinkle chopped green onions and Vietnamese basil before serving.

ingredients.item: hibe (dried shrimps), toasted and chopped finely
pork (kasim or pigue), cut into small cubes
large carrot, cut into thin strips
molo wrapper, cut into thick strips

instructions: Begin by grabbing a stock pot and making it nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and sauté onions, garlic and hibe. Now, stir in the pork kasim and keep sautéing until the pork is slightly cooked.
Next, pour the water in and for that perfect broth, drop the Knorr Pork and Knorr Shrimp Cubes. Now, you have to bring this to a boil and lower the heat to simmer until the meat is fork tender.
After that, gently add the carrots in together with the kangkong stems and season with patis and ground pepper.

Finally, you just need to stir in molo wrappers, kangkong leaves, togue and wansuy. By bringing this to a boil once, then turning it off right after, this dish is done. Sprinkle that chilli on top and make sure to serve this hot.
No need to go to a restaurant to taste Vietnamese food when you try Pork Pho Nilaga. Welcome this Vietnamese recipe into your home with open arms!

name: Seafood Sinigang Recipe
description: This dish uses the rich and flavorful flavors of shrimps, fish, mussels and clams combined with fresh vegetables, served in a tamarind sour soup.
tips: Shrimps are a good source of vitamins and minerals including Omega3 fatty acids which help promote good heart health and brain development.

ingredients.item: (40g) pack Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original
fish fillet, cut into big chunks
small bundle kangkong leaves with young stalks only

instructions: Scrub and rinse mussels, clams, and shrimps in cold running water. Drain and set aside.
In a big sauce pot, pour rice washing (or water) and add Knorr Sinigang Original Mix. Let it boil over moderate heat.
Reduce heat and add the onions, tomatoes, string beans, and eggplants.
Simmer for 15 minutes or until vegetables are done.
Add the fish chunks and then simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the mussels, clams and shrimps. Continue to cook for another 5 minutes or until mussels and clams have opened and shrimps turned orange in color.
Lastly add the kangkong and simmer for 1 minute. Serve while warm.

name: Sinigang na Bulalo Recipe
description: This dish uses the rich and flavorful taste of beef combined with fresh vegetables, mixed with the sour and tangy tamarind based sour soup.
tips: To keep the beef nice and tender, monitor the heat when boiling the beef. Initially bring the liquids to rapid boil, then cover the pot and lower the heat to simmer, or until gently boil is achieved. Allow the soft and gently boil to tenderize the meat.

ingredients.item: beef bone in shank with meat
salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
fresh red and green cabbage leaves

instructions: First, let's season the beef with salt and pepper. Next, get a pot and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and sear beef on both sides. Once brown, remove seared beef and set it aside.
Using the same pot, throw in the onions then pour the water. Add the seared beef into the pot. Add enough water to cover the meat.
Bring to a boil, then lower the heat to simmer until beef is fork tender. Add water if needed.
Once the beef is tender, add Knorr Sinigang Original Mix then add the finger pepper and calamansi juice.
Using a strainer with the achuete, laddle broth to the strainer until broth turns into orange. Discard used achuete.
Season with fish sauce and pepper before adding the cabbage leaves. Give this another minute or two to simmer. And that's it.
Serve hot and Enjoy!

name: Sinigang Sa Tinapang Bangus Recipe
description: This Filipino classic tamarind based dish combines the sour and tangy flavors of Tamarind with the fresh and smokey flavors of your milkfish.
tips: Milkfish is rich in Omega 3 which is good for pregnant women to increase and provide better quality breast milk.

ingredients.item: (20 g) pack Knorr Sinigang Sa Sampalok mix original
tinapang bangus, cut into serving pcs.

instructions: Begin by getting a pot and then fill it with water, onion and tomatoes. Bring this to a boil and let this simmer until onions and tomatoes are soft.
Add siling haba, radish, and tinapang bangus and simmer for 10 minutes.
Pour Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original and simmer again for 6 minutes.

Add kangkong last, simmer for another minute, taste and adjust seasoning if needed and that’s it! There’s just something about Sinigang na Tinapang Bangus. Its comforting flavors will make you want to eat it every day!

name: Sinuglaw Salmon Recipe
description: This appetizer dish can be enjoyed cold. It uses the rich flavor of salmon cooked in vinegar, combined with grilled pork belly and fresh vegetables.
tips: In preparing this dish, don’t use an aluminium bowl in soaking the salmon in with the vinegar because when aluminium and acid come in contact, it creates a chemical reaction and will make the food toxic.

ingredients.item: whole red onion, peeled and thinly sliced (julienned)
Vegetable oil for the wet rub (you can use olive oil)
Knorr Pork Cubes for the wet rub

instructions: Let’s begin by making a marinade. Start by diluting some Knorr Pork Cubes in olive oil, then rub it all over the pork belly. After 5 minutes, char grill the pork belly until cooked through and cut the belly into thin slices that measure around ½” to 1”. Set these aside.

Next, place the salmon and vinegar in a glass bowl or any food grade bowl, and soak them for 8 minutes. IMPORTANT TIP: Don’t use an aluminium bowl in soaking the salmon in with the vinegar because when aluminium and acid come in contact, it creates a chemical reaction and will make the food toxic.
Now, combine the cucumber, green and red bell peppers, and onion. Add the grilled pork belly in and mix thoroughly.
Give your Sinuglaw a good sprinkle of Knorr Liquid Seasoning and add salt and pepper if preferred.
Enjoy Sinuglaw Salmon cold as an appetizer or as a snack, it will surely refresh your day.

name: Sloppy Joe Pizzetas Recipe
description: This simple dish combines the rich flavors of tomato with the sweet and crunchy textures of bell peppers, and the flavors of cheese, served in pizzalet sizes.
tips: Bell Peppers not only provide good flavor and taste to the dish, but they are an excellent source of Vitamin C, vitamin A and fiber.

ingredients.item: red bell pepper, brunoise (chopped in small pieces)
bell pepper brunoise, (chopped in small pieces)

instructions: This beef topping is simple as pie. Get your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the diced bell peppers, corn kernels and ground beef.
Add the Knorr Liquid Seasoning and tomato sauce then simmer for 8-10 minutes, until sauce thickens and that’s our beef topping!
Let’s now assemble our mini pizza crusts. Add a generous amount of beef toppings and top them with grated cheese. Bake in an oven or oven toaster until the cheese is melted.
Be confident as you present this dish to your family. They will definitely be impressed because it will not only look fun but it will also be tasty. Totally yum!

name: Spicy Humba Recipe
description: This Chinese inspired pork dish combines the rich flavors of pork with the sweet and sour flavors of pineapple mixed with vinegar topped with steamed Bok Choi.
tips: Black beans are a good source of fiber and can help regulate digestion and help you reduce weight.

ingredients.item: Optional: Serve with steamed Bok-Choi or Spinach on the side

instructions: Begin by making your pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion and garlic, then add Knorr Pork Cubes. Add the liempo and black beans and sauté for a minute.

The next step is to pour the vinegar next and let this simmer uncovered to remove the strong vinegar taste, before adding the pineapple juice, water, brown sugar, soy sauce, chilies, and banana blossoms.
Now, cook this while covered until pork is fork tender and sauce thickens. Taste if seasoning needs adjustments.
Make room for this recipe in your stomach because you will definitely eat more rice than usual.

name: Spicy Shrimp Monggo Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Spicy Shrimp Monggo made special with Knorr Shrimp Cubes. Prepare a perfect healthy meal for your family.
tips: You can soak monggo for a minimum of 1 hour but the longer you soak the less time you need to cook them. Make sure to remove the floating particles on top. You don’t want any dirt on your dish.
instructions: Since monggo is a seed, you need to wash them in water to get rid of the unwanted dirt they might have collected. And since monggo is a kind of dried bean, you need to soak them in water to soften them because seeds absorb water. You can soak monggo for a minimum of 1 hour. Make sure to remove the floating particles on top.

Once your beans are soft enough, get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and sauté the garlic, onions and tomatoes in a saucepan for about 2 minutes or more. Pour in the monggo beans and water before adding the Knorr Pork Cubes. Turn the fire to low, cover the pot and just simmer for an hour, or until monggo is tender. Don’t forget to stir occasionally.

When the monggo is tender, drop in the suahe and siling haba, stir then simmer. Finally, top with the sili leaves and turn off the heat and that’s our dish. All you need is a big serving of rice for this Spicy Shrimp Monggo is enough to make your day!

name: Spicy Tinola Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Spicy Tinola made special with Knorr Chicken Cubes. Prepare a perfect healthy meal for your family.
tips: After adding the Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix, don't let the dish reach boiling point, to prevent the liquids from curdling or breaking. Set the temp to simmer at low to medium heat only.

ingredients.item: sayote or ¼ pc. papaya, cut into wedges
(1 pack) Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix, dissolved in 3 cups water

instructions: Begin by setting your fire on high heat and get your pan ready. Pour a little bit of oil and throw the onion and half of the ginger. Cook this for 2 minutes before adding the chicken. Continue to cook the chicken until brown.

Add in the sayote and pour the dissolved Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix and the remaining half of the ginger. Let this simmer for 2 minutes before adding the Knorr Chicken Cubes. Cook this over low heat until the chicken and vegetables are cooked through. Add the siling labuyo.
Top the Tinola with dahon ng sili and allow to cook further for another minute before serving.
Wait until your family tastes this Spicy Tinola. This will definitely awaken their tastebuds.

name: Stuffed Beef Ensaymada Recipe
description: This dish combines the sweet and soft flavors and textures of ensaymada with the deep and rich flavors of thinly sliced beef mixed with honey and soy sauce.
tips: Pre-heating your oven and allowing it to reach the correct temperature before baking or cooking will assure you that your cooking time will be correct and this will prevent the dish from becoming undercooked or overcooked.
instructions: Begin by getting a pot and then placing the beef with soy sauce, honey, sesame oil and Knorr Beef Cubes in it. Cook this over medium heat and bring this to a boil. Add the slurry (cornstarch and water) as needed while mixing to thicken the sauce a bit.
Stuff the beef mixture in the ensaymada then bake in a pre-heated 350F oven until the cheese is melted.
Over hot chocolate, coffee or soda, Stuffed Beef Ensaymada is best enjoyed with the company of loved ones. You won’t regret having seconds. So, make as many batches of this recipe as you can!

name: Three Pearl Crab and Corn Recipe
description: This simple dish combines the rich flavors of crab and corn mixed with various asian flavored condiments such as fish, squid, chicken balls; and crab sticks.
tips: Eating seafood like fish and crabs are a great source of long chain Omega-3 Fatty Acids which can help improve cardiovascular health and reduce heart diseases.

ingredients.item: (60g) (1 pack) Knorr Crab and Corn Real Chinese Soup

instructions: When your family tastes this simple, savoury and filling soup that cooks instantly, they will truly crave for more.

Begin by bringing water to a boil and preparing the Knorr Crab and Corn Real Chinese Soup according to package directions. Once your soup is boiling, you can throw in the squid balls, fish balls and chicken balls.
Finally, throw in the crabstick, then you’re done. Feast with your eyes and make your soup attractive and more inviting by adding a sprinkle of chopped spring onions on top.
categories: KNORR CRAB AND CORN REAL CHINESE SOUP

name: Tinola Ramen Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich flavor of chicken with the sweet and creamy coconut milk based broth mixed with noodles and Japanese style eggs.
tips: Coconut Milk aids in strengthening the immune system. It contains lauric acids that assists the body in fighting infections caused by virus and bacteria.

ingredients.item: hot sauce fish sauce. as needed

instructions: Begin by getting your pot nice and hot over high heat. Pour a little oil and throw in the garlic, onion and half of the ginger. Cook until you can smell the lovely aroma from the vegetables. Place the chicken meat gently and throw in the Knorr Chicken Cubes. You may sauté this for 10 minutes.

Pour the water or rice washing and allow that to boil before bringing it to a simmer for 5 minutes. Pour in your coconut milk and the other half of the ginger and cook this over low heat until the chicken is cooked through.
Drop in the papaya, dahon ng sili and siling labuyo or hot sauce and cook for another minute.

To make a serving, place cooked noodles in a bowl. Now, you can top it with sliced chicken and half an egg. Finally, pour the hot soup over it and feel the warm embrace of your mother at the comforts of your own home.

name: Tinola sa Buko Recipe
description: This dish combines the sweet and light flavors of coconut juice combined with a strong ginger taste mixed with the rich flavors of chicken and vegetables.
tips: Coconut water is a good source of potassium, magnesium and calcium. It is a considered a Miracle Drink due to its health benefits.

ingredients.item: young coconut meat, cut into strips
pc. sayote or ¼ pc. papaya, cut into wedges

instructions: First, get a pot and get it nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion and half of the ginger. Gently add the chicken and sauté for a good 1 minute. Drizzle fish sauce over and mix this well.
Place the sayote and coconut meat before pouring the coconut water and the remaining ginger. Let this simmer for a minute before adding the Knorr Chicken Cubes.
When the Chicken and vegetables are cooked through, top the Tinola with dahon ng sili and simmer for another minute.
This Tinola sa Buko definitely soothes and comforts. Serve this to your family and see their love for you grow immensely.

name: Tinolang Halaan Recipe
description: Give tinolang halaan a tangy twist with Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Original Mix. It's the perfect budget-friendly comfort food to enjoy on cool days.
tips: Make sure that you clean the clams starting from the outside shell and let them soak in water to expel any impurities from the inside. Replace the water several times during the soaking to get the best results.
instructions: First, you need to brush the halaan using a clean toothbrush to remove any impurities and then soak it in lukewarm water for 1 hour to allow the shell to spit out any unwanted sand or dirt. After an hour, discard the water.

Next, get a saucepan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour a little oil and sauté two cloves of crushed garlic, one medium sliced onion and 2 slices of ginger. Cook until you can smell the lovely aroma from the cooked vegetables.
Drop in the halaan and pour 5 cups of water, then add Knorr Sinigang Original Mix next.

Bring to a boil then slowly switch to low fire and simmer only until shells are opened. And that’s our dish! Tinolang Halaan is such a feel good soup that’s why you should cook this more often at home. Your family will cheer for you all the way – from your cooking time in the kitchen to eating time at the dinner table.

name: Tinolang Itim Recipe
description: This soup dish combines the deep flavors of beef infused with charred coconut, turmeric and ginger to give it a unique flavor served in a spiced beef broth.
tips: LACKS PRODUCT DISPLAY

ingredients.item: whole coconut meat (have it taken off the shell in big pieces, not shredded)
Kilos Beef shank, cut to serving pieces

instructions: Let’s begin by creating the charred meat from the coconut. Grill coconut meat over stove top until charred and black in color. Now, transfer this to a mixing bowl together with the turmeric, ginger and ½ portion of the lemon grass. Pound and mix until it forms a thick and heavy paste. Give this a nice seasoning of Knorr Liquid Seasoning and pepper to taste.

Get a deep saucepan nice and hot over high heat. Pour some oil and sear the beef shanks on all sides until evenly brown or until they obtain a nice crust. Throw the onions and sauté until they are slightly translucent together with 1 tbsp of the coconut black paste mixture. Give this a good 6 minutes or until the beef absorbs the mixture.

Pour 4 cups of water and add the remaining lemon grass and red chilli pepper before bringing it to a boil. Reduce the heat to a simmer and drop the Knorr Beef Cube and let it cook until the beef is tender. Remove the scum or the impurities that float on top of the soup. Give this another seasoning of Knorr Liquid Seasoning, salt and pepper.
Transfer to a serving plate then serve hot.
Be more daring and try something out of your comfort zone. This Tinolang Itim recipe is extraordinary for so many reasons. So, serve this to your family and create fun memories together at the table.

name: Tinumis Puti Recipe
description: This traditional Nueva Ecija dish comines the rich and deeep flavor of beef with the fresh vegetables, served in a tamarind based sour soup.
tips: You can also create this dish in the traditional Nueva Ecija Tinumis version with Pork blood. Just add 240 ml of Pork blood after adding the Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix then let the liquid simmer.

ingredients.item: kilogram beef camto, cut into 2-inch cubes
(1 pack) Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original

instructions: Begin by getting a pan and making it nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the garlic, onions and tomatoes. Sauté until the vegetables give off a nice aroma before adding the beef. Cook the beef until it’s light brown in color.
Next, pour the water and bring to a boil and allow to simmer for about 30 minutes. Remember to remove the scum that raises to the top of the liquid to keep the broth clear.
After 30 minutes, add the Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix and continue to simmer until the beef is fork tender.

Radish and sayote cooks easily that’s why you only add them when the beef is tender. Once added, another 5 minutes is good just to cook the vegetables before you can finally enjoy this wonderful dish!
Your family will definitely feel good when you serve Tinumis Puti. It has that wonderful sour taste that is perfect with rice. Try it today!
categories: KNORR SINIGANG SA SAMPALOK MIX ORIGINAL

name: Twice Cooked Chicken Recipe
description: This dish combines the tamarind infused marinated chicken with the sweet and savory thick Indonesian style sauce.
tips: Kecap Manis is an Indonesian dark sweet soy sauce. If you do not have this item, you can replace it with soy sauce mixed it with equal part of brown sugar, or you can also use hoisin sauce as alternative.
instructions: Begin by cooking the chicken in a pot filled with water, Knorr Sinigang Original Mix, spring onions, ginger, garlic, and bay leaf. Bring this to a boil for 1 hour. When the chicken is done, remove it from the pot so it can cool down. Then, slice this into serving pieces before deep frying in hot oil.

What makes this chicken exciting to eat is the sauce that coats it. In order to prepare the sauce, you need to sauté the onions, garlic, ginger, carrots, bell peppers and mushrooms in a hot pan with a little bit of oil.
Now, pour in the Knorr Liquid Seasoning, sesame oil, rice wine, Bango Kecap Manis and chilli powder. Allow the liquid to simmer until you get a rich and thick sauce consistency.
With the sauce nice and hot, pour it over the crispy chicken and eat until you are bursting with happiness! You won’t be able to resist coming back for more.

name: Ulamazing Ginataang Gulay Recipe
description: This heart healthy dish uses the garden fresh flavor of mixed vegetables combined with the sweet and creamy flavor of coconut milk.
tips: When cooking with coconut milk, monitor and lower the heat to simmer to prevent the liquids from boiling to reduce the chance of it breaking up.

ingredients.item: sitaw, cut into about 2 inches in length
(1 pack) Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix dissolved in 1 cup of water

instructions: Begin by getting the pan hot. Add oil then saute onions and garlic.
Next saute the pork until nicely browned. Give the shrimps a quick saute then in goes the kalabasa. Cook this for 5 minutes before adding the sitaw.
Add the dissolved Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix and just simmer for 5 more minutes with cover.
Eat as much as you want for this Ulamazing dish is not only delicious it's also very nutritious.

name: Upo Patola Misua Souprise Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Upo Patola Misua Souprise. A filipino favorite soup made extra special with Knorr Chicken Cubes.
tips: Eating Upo (Bottle Gourd) is healthy for your digestive system. Upo is a common medicine for upset digestion and fiber present in Upo helps keep the digestive track clean and healthy.

ingredients.item: chicken breast fillet, cut into bite sized cubes

instructions: Cook this delightful and pleasing soup in an instant. You just need to grab a pot and with a little bit of oil, over medium high heat, sauté chicken breasts and crushed garlic together. Now, you have to stir this well and pour a little water to prevent the chicken and garlic from sticking to the pan.
Now you will see that the chicken will turn white. Pour 4 cups of water, add Knorr Chicken Cubes and bring this to a boil. You should be able to smell the aroma of the cooked chicken in the broth.
Next, lower the hear to medium-low setting then drop the upo and patola into the pot and let these simmer for another 3 minutes before adding the raw egg.
Finally, add the misua and bring to a boil until cooked.
Go that extra mile when you serve this dish to your family by topping your soup with boiled eggs just before serving. A little love goes a long way.

name: Vegetable Kare Kare Recipe
description: This classic Filipino dish uses the healthy combination of fresh vegetables such as eggplant and string beans, mixed with the savory peanut kare-kare sauce.
tips: To make the sauce thicker, you can add 1-2 tbsp of Peanut butter to the sauce and gently simmer the dish until it dissolves completely.

ingredients.item: banana heart, cut into 2 inch thick
eggplant, ¾ inch thick, cut diagonally
Knorr Kare Kare Recipe Mix, dissolved in 2 cups water
roasted and unsalted peanuts, as needed

instructions: Let’s begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the banana heart, eggplant and sitaw.
Pour dissolved Knorr Kare Kare Recipe Mix and peanuts. Allow to simmer until thick and vegetables are cooked.
Add pechay, then simmer for a minute and that’s our dish! You will surely change your mind when you try this Vegetable Kare-Kare. Serve with bagoong, it’s a true winner!

name: Chicken Tinola Recipe with a Delicious White Twist!
description: Experience comfort in a bowl with Tinola - Filipino recipe made with chicken, ginger, papaya & fish sauce, served with rice. Our twist ingredient: creamy milk!
tips: Ginger contains a lot of medicinal properties that help the body fight the flu and common colds, aids in digestions and relives nausea.

ingredients.item: g. sayote or ¼ pc. papaya, cut into wedges

instructions: Heat pot on medium-high, sauté onion & ginger, add chicken, sprinkle fish sauce.
Add sayote, evaporated milk, water, ginger. Simmer, add Knorr Chicken Cubes.
Finish by topping with dahon ng sili.
Enjoy the warm, comforting hug of mom with each sip of White Tinola.

Begin by bringing your pot nice and hot to medium high heat. With a little bit of oil, sauté the onion and half of the ginger before adding in the chicken. Cook them well for a minute and give these a sprinkle of fish sauce.
