Throw in the sayote and pour in the evaporated milk, water and the remaining half of the ginger. Now, you have to let this simmer for a minute before throwing in the Knorr Chicken Cubes.
When the chicken and vegetables are cooked, finish the soup by topping it with dahon ng sili.
When you sip the hot soup of this White Tinola, you will be reminded of the warm hug of your mom.

name: Basil Cream Penne Recipe
description: This simple pasta dish uses the fresh taste and flavor of basil mixed with ham cooked in sweet and creamy coconut milk sauce, tossed with penne pasta noodles.
tips: You can use some of the pasta water to add a deeper flavor and texture to your dish. Just add it to the sauce while simmering to get the desired sauce consistency.

ingredients.item: (1 pack) Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay

instructions: Let's begin by cooking the pasta first according to package directions.
Next, get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and just saute the ham until slightly darker red in color.
Dissolve Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay in water then add this to the pan. Simmer until thick.
Reduce the heat to simmer and add the cream and cooked pasta. Continue to simmer until sauce thickens. Top with basil leaves.
Cook for another 3 minutes and mix continuously. You can add a sprinkle of cheese and enjoy a Pinoy style pasta anytime of the week.

name: Bulalo Steak in Kaldereta Sauce Recipe
description: Pinagsama ang dalawang paboritong ulam ng Pinoy Bulalo at Kaldereta sa isang malinamnam na ulam.

ingredients.item: beef shank (bulalo steak) cut into ¾-inch thick pieces
beef broth (from boiling the beef shank)

instructions: In a pot, put beef shanks, garlic, peppercorns, onion, bay leaves, and salt. Bring to a boil then lower the heat and simmer until fork-tender. Remove shanks from the pan and reserve the broth.
Roast the green, red, and yellow bell peppers. Peel and remove the seeds. Slice peppers in long strips. Set aside.

Prepare the sauce: Heat some oil then sauté onions and garlic. Add canned tomatoes and vinegar. Cook until almost all the liquid has evaporated add beef broth. Stir in carrots and bay leaves. Cook for a few minutes. Add olives, liver spread, cheese, and chili. Cook until sauce is thick and chunky.
Heat some butter in a pan. Then, add garlic. Add beef shanks and brown on both sides.
Transfer meat to plates and top with the kaldereta sauce. Serve with roasted bell peppers on the side.
Roasting tip: Put roasted peppers in a resealable plastic bag seal and set aside for a few minutes. The steam in the bag will make it easier to removed the charred skin.

name: Pork and Beans Recipe
description: This dish uses the rich taste of sautéed pork mixed with beans and carrots cooked in a sweet coconut milk infused pork sauce with added spice.
tips: When cooking with coconut milk, remember to monitor your heat. Avoid having the dish at high heat to prevent the dish from boiling. Keep the heat to a simmer to prevent the coconut milk from breaking.

ingredients.item: to 3 siling labuyo chopped (reduce to ½ or 1 sili if serving to kids or adults who don’t like spicy)
kilogram Baguio beans, washed (sliced into pieces barely ½-inch-wide)

instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Add some oil and sauté garlic and onion. Add siling labuyo and the lean ground pork, stirring as you lightly brown the meat.
Add the coconut milk and Knorr Pork Broth Cubes. Bring the mixture to a steady simmer. Add the diced carrots.
Once you see the oil separating from the milk, turn the flame to medium-low and add the Baguio beans.
Let simmer for 6 to 8 minutes, until the beans are tender yet still firm.
Season with salt and pepper and that's it! Pork and beans will always remind you of home. Simple and comforting.

name: Bilot Recipe
description: This simple snack recipe combines the flavors of sautéed pork mixed with carrots, potatoes and corn infused with Knorr flavors, topped with sweet peanut sauce
tips: It's tricky to get good quality galapong. Its better to buy malagkit grains and ask the vendor to ground it for you.

ingredients.item: kilogram giniling na malagkit, shaped into flat circles and boiled in water

instructions: Let's begin by making the pork filling. Simply mix ground pork, ground pepper and mashed Knorr Pork Cube. Mix until all ingredients are well combined.
Next, get large pan and make it nice and warm over medium-high heat. Add the butter and sauté the boiled carrots and potatoes, then add in the marinated pork. Sprinkle with ground pepper to season.
Add the corn kernels, soy sauce and Knorr Liquid Seasoning, mix together and continue to sauté until cooked.
Prepare the malagkit circles in a tray. Spoon pork mix into one side of the boiled malagkit and fold into a roll.

For the sauce: In a medium pan, combine water, peanut butter and Knorr Pork Cubes, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, cornstarch and sugar. Let it boil then pour over the bilot and let the fun times start again.

name: Binagoongang Manok Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Binagoongang Manok. Combines the rich flavors of the chicken, bagoong made special with Knorr Chicken Cubes.
tips: Bagoong contains high levels of essential fatty acids like DHA and polyunsaturated fatty acids, that improves brain function, improves the immune system and reduce heart attacks.
instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over high heat and pour in a little bit of oil. Throw in the tomatoes, onion and garlic and cook until you can smell the nice aroma from the vegetables. Drop in the bagoong and sugar before adding the chicken. Mix well and sauté for at least 2-3 minutes or until chicken color turns brown.
Pour in the water with the Knorr Chicken Cubes and bring this to a simmer over low heat for a good 15 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Just one more step and this mouth-watering Chicken Binagoongan is ready for serving. For that added spice, top your Chicken Binagoongan with a sprinkle of chilli. Finally, it’s time to eat!

name: Cheesy Creamy Beef Recipe
description: Combine the richness of beef sirloin with garlic, butter, and cheese, and enjoy a dish made more rewarding with Knorr. Prepare the extra rice!
tips: Research suggests that regular eating of pepper may be beneficial in promoting good heart health. Cayenne contains a compound called capsaicin that may reduce inflammation and can help protect against certain heart conditions and diseases.
instructions: Get your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Melt some butter and add a bit of oil to prevent butter from burning. Now, throw in the garlic and beef before adding the Knorr Beef Cubes. Just continue cooking for a minute or two.
For the next step, pour in the cream and cayenne then just give this 15-20 minutes to simmer.
Finally, top it with cheese and sprinkle with parsley and that’s our dish!

name: Coconut Chicken Kare Kare Recipe
description: Elevate your everyday ulam with this coconut chicken kare-kare recipe. Cook this delicious dish with Knorr today!
instructions: For the first step, you need to cook the chicken in a stockpot filled with 6 of cups water and Knorr Chicken Cube.

Next, get another pan and heat this to medium high. Pour a little bit of oil and throw in the onion, garlic and meat. Allow these to cook for a few minutes or until you can smell the lovely aroma from the vegetables. Pour in the Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Kare Kare and the Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix that have been dissolved in 3 cups of water.
You may now add the vegetables and allow these to simmer in low heat until the vegetables are cooked through.
With a large serving of rice, it’s nice and exciting to share something as creative as this with the family.

name: Crispy Shrimplets with Pipino-Pinakurat Sauce Recipe
description: This dish combines the great seafood taste of shrimp fried until crispy, with the sweet and refreshing flavors of cucumber, and the strong sour pinakurat sauce.
tips: To enhance the flavors of the shrimps, you can season the cornstarch with a little salt and pepper, and add some spices before coating the shrimps.
instructions: First, dredge the shrimp in cornstarch and make sure you have pre-heated oil ready for frying. Cook until the shrimps are crispy then drain on paper towels to blot off excess oil.
Get another pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Melt the margarine and Knorr Shrimp Cube together. Throw in the shrimps, toss and swirl until all shrimps are coated. And that’s it!
All we need to make is the pinakurat sauce. Combine the diced cucumber and sukang pinakurat. Then sprinkle with chopped spring onions.
All you need now is the company of your loved ones because something as delicious as this is best served with your family. Enjoy!

name: Fried Tilapia with Vegetable Curry Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich seafood flavor and crispy texture of tilapia with the flavorful and creamy vegetable curry sauce.
tips: When cooking with Coconut milk, monitor your temperature and do not let the liquids reaching boiling to prevent the coconut milk from breaking.
instructions: Begin by seasoning the tilapia with salt and pepper. Dredge this in flour and make sure you prepared a preheated pan with oil ready for frying. Fry tipalia until brown and crispy on the outside. Strain excess oil and set aside.

Next, get a medium sized pan, and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Melt the butter then add Knorr Fish Cubes and red curry paste. Cooking until all ingredients are well dissolved and mixed properly.
Pour in the water, sugar and coconut cream and bring to a boil. Lower the heat and drop in the onions, carrrots, potatoes, and bell pepper then simmer until vegetables are well cooked.
Finally, pour the sauce on top of the tilapia and that’s our dish! Make sure you have enough rice ready for you will definitely enjoying eating Fried Tilapia with Vegetable Curry!

name: Kare Kareng Hipon Recipe
description: This Filipino Classic dish uses the rich flavor of shrimps mixed with the fresh garden taste of vegetables cooked in the thick peanut sauce.
tips: Eating peanuts on a regular basis can greatly reduce the risk of colon cancer specially in women.
instructions: Let’s begin by mixing the rice flour with water and bring this to a boil. Slowly turn the heat to a simmer.
Drop in the Knorr Shrimp Cubes and peanut butter then stir gently.

Get a pan nice and pour in atsuete seeds and oil. Allow to sizzle until the seeds extract their color. They should turn dark. Now, get a strainer and discard the seeds. Next, into the pot of boiling rice flour goes the atsuete oil.

Gently add eggplant, sitaw, banana heart, pechay and the shrimps. Now let this simmer for 15 minutes and that’s our dish. With Kare Kareng Hipon, served with bagoong on the side, you need not feel guilty. Eat as much as you want!

name: Knorr Spiced Chicken Wings Recipe
description: This simple Chicken dish uses the rich flavors of chicken wings mixed with sweet and spicy marinate. Baked and topped with sesame seeds.
tips: Studies show that eating spicy and chili food help reduce inflammation and decrease the chances of heart disease. Eating chili can also stimulate weight loss and increase metabolism.

ingredients.item: Optional: Serve with singkamas/jicama, carrot and celery sticks on the side

instructions: This recipe is so simple and such a breeze to make. You’ll be surprised by how easy the process will be. First, you’ve got to flavour the wings by marinating it in a mixture of Knorr Liquid Seasoning, Knorr Chicken Cube, sugar, sili, onion, garlic and sesame oil for at least 30 minutes.
Transfer the wings in a baking pan and place these in the oven to cook for 30 minutes or until the chicken is done.
Give your chicken wings a nice finish by adding a sprinkle of sesame seeds and chopped spring onions on top.
Tasty and spicy, Knorr Spiced Chicken Wings is guaranteed to be a winner whatever the occasion.

name: Meaty Chon Diet Ala Fruit Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Meaty Chon Diet Ala Fruit | Knorr
instructions: First, marinate pork ribs and chicken thighs in Knorr Liquid Seasoning.
In a separate pot, dissolve Knorr Pork Cubes then use this to blanch sayote and potato and set aside.
In a pan, saute garlic and onion until fragrant.
Then add pork ribs, vegetable broth and patis.
When the pork ribs are almost done, add chicken thighs and sliced hotdog.
Add a bit more patis, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, and star anise and allow it to simmer.
Finally, add the sayote and the potatoes and cook until just perfectly done.

For the sauce: In a casserole, boil water then lower heat and add Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix, Knorr Pork cube, cheese and mushrooms. Simmer until mushrooms are cooked then finish with all-purpose cream
To finish-off, place pork ribs and chicken thighs in a serving dish, lay the fruit slices on the side, then pour the creamy sauce over.
Top this all off with hard-boiled quail eggs and grated cheese.
This is definitely one delicious kiddie delight, even adults cannot resist.
*Cooking Diva Tip:
Quick melt cheese is just so yummy when used in cooking.
But it can be a pain to grate of its soft texture.
For a quick fix, chill the cheese for about 30 minutes before grating.
Low temperatures will make the bar a bit firmer, making it easier to prepare.

name: Paksiw na Bulalo Steak Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich and flavorful taste of beef with the sweet and aromatic flavors of the paksiw sauce.
tips: To make the meat tender, monitor the heat of the liquid in the pot. Keep it to a simmer instead of boiling the meat.
instructions: There are 2 things you need to do to prepare this dish. First, make the Bulalo. Second, make the paksiw sauce.

Let’s begin by making our Bulalo. Get your pan nice and hot over medium heat and pour some oil and throw in the onion, garlic and pepper. Turn the heat up and gently add the sliced Bulalo steak and just sear or brown the meat on all sides.
When the meat are all brown, pour in the water and just bring this to a boil over high heat. Then, bring to a simmer and cook for 2 – 5 hours or until the meat is fork tender.

Now that the Bulalo is done, let’s make the paksiw sauce by pouring the lechon sauce, Knorr Beef Cubes, sugar, banana blossoms and bay leaf into the pot. Mix well to fully combine the ingredients and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Wait till you see the reaction on your family’s faces when they see plated Bulalo Steak with paksiw sauce on top. They will truly thank you for it!

name: Crispy Pancit Canton Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Crispy Pancit Canton made extra special with Knorr Chicken Cubes. Enjoy it with your family!
tips: Pancit dishes are often prepared for a lot Filipino celebrations because they symbolize longevity and good health according to ancient Filipino superstitions.

ingredients.item: tenga ng daga, soaked and cut to serving pieces

instructions: The steps may be a bit challenging but we assure you, it’s worth the wait. Begin by getting a shallow pan and fill it with about 3-4 cups cooking oil. Deep fry the Pancit Canton noodles and then place on a plate lined with paper towels to drain off excess oil. Then, transfer to a nice serving plate.
Now, dissolve Knorr Chicken Cube in two cups water then set aside.
Get another pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and sauté garlic, onions, chicken, fish, and shrimp balls.
In goes the carrots, cabbage, tengang daga, and fresh green peas. Gently pour dissolved Knorr Chicken Cubes.

Add the oyster sauce next with the five spice powder, sesame oil, cornstarch diluted in water and cook until sauce thickens. For that added creaminess, pour about ½ cup evaporated milk then simmer again for a minute.

Now that our sauce is done, you can turn the heat off and just pour the sauce on top of the fried pancit canton noodles. And that’s it. Garnish with boiled quail eggs and serve to your hungry family. It takes a bit of effort and creativity when you just want your family to taste the best there is. Expect hugs and kisses from them.

name: Easy Pork and Mushroom Recipe
description: Imagine pork and mushrooms with assorted fresh vegetables cooked in a wonderful sauce made with Knorr Pork Cube and a touch of Knorr Liquid Seasoning. What’s not to love and be excited about?

ingredients.item: wood ear mushroom or tenga ng daga
mixed vegetables (corn, carrots, and green peas)

instructions: Let’s begin by dissolving Knorr Pork Cube in 4 cups of water and bring this to a boil then simmer.
Next, throw in the wood ear mushroom and ginger and just let it rehydrate and simmer for a few minutes.
The next step is to gently place the ground pork next and again let this simmer until the pork is cooked through.
Give this a good seasoning of Knorr Liquid Seasoning and sesame oil. Mix well before adding tenga ng daga, mixed vegetable, togue, and tokwa.
One more step and this dish is done. You just need to thicken it with corn starch then drop in the egg. And that’s it!
You will see the smiles on your family’s faces when you serve this Pork and Mushroom Recipe. They will simply thank you for it.

name: Sinampalukang Molo Recipe
description: This soup dish combines the rich flavor of pork, combined with the crunch from the grated singkamas, cooked in a slightly sour savory tamarind broth.
tips: When making your individual molo dumplings, remember not to overfill the wrappers. You need to leave space for you to close the wrapper properly from all side to prevent them from breaking apart while cooking.
instructions: This molo soup is fuss free. You just need to combine and mix together in a bowl, the ground pork, 1 pc Knorr Pork Cube for flavouring, singkamas for crunch, sesame oil and a tablespoon of spring onions for that nice aroma and fresh flavour.
Wrap the pork mixture in the wonton wrappers and form into the desired shape you want. Set aside and chill.
You now need to make the soup to cook your molo in. Just bring water to a boil and drop in a piece of Knorr Pork Cube and Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Original.
Now that our soup is boiling, gently add the pieces of molo in and allow this to simmer for 10 minutes. And there you have it! Our Sinampalukang Molo.
For that added presentation, top your Sinampalukang Molo with chopped spring onions. When you sip into the soup, you will always be reminded of home.

name: Tokwa't Baboy Salad Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich flavors of pork with garden fresh lettuce leaves tossed in a heart healthy sweet and sour olive oil based dressing.
tips: Olive oil contains a large amounts of powerful antioxidants that help reduce the risk of chronic diseases and also fights inflammation.

ingredients.item: Romaine lettuce, cut into bite size pieces

instructions: Let’s begin by making our pork tenga tender. Boil the tenga with water and Knorr Pork Cubes. Just let this simmer for an hour until the tenga is soft. Remove and cut into dice.
In the meantime, get another pan nice and hot over high heat and fill it with oil. Fry the tokwa until crispy. Drain on top of a plate lined with paper towels.
Here’s something different, instead of just adding sliced onions, coat the onions with flour and fry them as well until golden brown.
Now that our salad components are ready, let’s prepare the dressing. Just mix the Knorr Liquid Seasoning, vinegar, sugar, sili, and olive oil in a blender and that’s it! Our dish is done!

Toss the tokwa, tenga and romaine lettuce, then top it with the fried onions. Drizzle some of that dressing over and be prepared to be overwhelmed because this dish will disappear in less than 5 minutes! It’s incredibly good!

name: Lumpia Kalabasa Recipe
description: This heart healthy and delicious meal uses the sweet and fruity flavors of your kalabasa, fried to create a contrasting crispy outer skin.
tips: If you are having problems with your lumpia staying sealed, you can use a little beaten egg to seal the wrapper instead of plain water. The small amount of egg to seal will not change the taste of the lumpia flavors.

ingredients.item: Knorr Shrimp Cube, dissolved in 1 tbsp hot water

instructions: This recipe is so easy to make. You just need to combine all the ingredients together and that’s the filling.
Next, by placing 2 tbsp of the kalabasa mixture in a lumpia wrapper and rolling it into your desired size, you now have a set ready to be cooked.
Fry in a very hot pan filled with oil. Cook until brown and that’s our dish! You can eat it as is or paired with your favourite dish. This Lumpia recipe tastes really good!

name: Pork Pata Caldereta Recipe
description: This dish uses the full flavor of pork pata combined with the carrots and potatoes cooked in a sweet and tangy tomato based sauce.
tips: To keep the pork pata tender, you can also boil the pata in water at over medium heat to simmer, before frying. While boiling, remember to remove the scum that rises to the top of the liquid.

ingredients.item: pcs. carrots, peeled and cut into cubes
pcs. potatoes, peeled and cut into cubes
pc. green bell peppers, seeds removed and cut into cubes

instructions: Let’s start by browning those pata chops in a very hot pan with oil over high heat. Then, set this aside once brown in color all over.
Throw in the onion and garlic next then pour in the water, Knorr Pork Cubes, bay leaves and black pepper. Just bring this to a boil.
Return the pata back into the water and allow it to simmer until tender.
Add the liver spread, tomato sauce, carrots, potatoes, bell peppers and chili (if desired) then let the mixture simmer until vegetables are tender.
Add sugar and grated cheese and stir until completely dissolved. And that's our dish!
Don’t wait too long before it gets to the table because smelling this Pork Pata Caldereta is enough to make anyone’s stomach hungry.

name: Chicken Peanut Skewers Recipe
description: With combined flavours of peanut butter, Knorr Chicken Cubes and Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay, your grilled chicken will simply taste marvelous!
tips: NOTE: NO PRODUCT DISPLAY. NO YIELD, NO PREP TIME/COOKING TIME

ingredients.item: (29g) pack Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix, dissolved in 1 cup water

instructions: Cooking your marinade is one way of having a really flavourful dish. First, you need to bring together the diluted Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay, Knorr Chicken Cube and the peanut butter in a saucepan set on medium heat. Allow this to simmer until the mixture is smooth and free of lumps and then cool this before tossing it in the chicken.

Now, you have two ways of marinating the chicken. First, you can thread the chicken breast cubes in a bbq stick then pour the marinade mixture over. The second option would be to marinate the chicken first in the mixture then threading it in bbq stick after. Whatever method you choose is fine as long as you leave it to flavour for at least an hour. Here’s a tip on how you can prevent your bbq stick from burning once it comes in contact with the grill: soak them in water for at least 1 hour before using them.
So, what are you waiting for? Grill those chicken breast cubes and wait until they are nice and cooked! Eat as is or with a bowl of rice. This is surely one delicious and easy to do recipe!
categories: KNORR COMPLETE RECIPE MIX GINATAANG GULAY

name: Creamy Chicken and Corn Cream Spaghetti Recipe
description: This pasta dish combines the rich taste of chicken mixed with creamy mushroom and corn white sauce infused with butter flavored garlic and onions.
tips: Mushrooms are a good source of fiber, vitamins and minerals, and it is also a rich source of antioxidants that help protect the body from heart diseases and cancer.

ingredients.item: (1 pack) Knorr Crab and Corn Real Chinese Soup

instructions: Start by dissolving the Knorr Chicken and Corn Real Chinese Soup in 1 cup of water. Mix this well until it’s free of lumps then set this aside.
Get a medium sized saucepot ready by turning the heat onto medium low. Pour the fresh milk and slow cook for a few minutes before adding the dissolved soup mixture. Simmer for at least 5 minutes.

Get another saucepan and melt the butter. Throw in the garlic and onions and cook until you can smell the lovely aroma from the cooked vegetables. Drop in the mushrooms and sauté for another minute. Pour in the soup mixture and cook this until the liquid thickens.
This sauce is done and ready to be poured over cooked spaghetti noodles. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese or any cheese that you prefer.

Go that extra mile by adding a sprinkle of chopped parsley on top to make your dish more appetizing and appealing. Your spaghetti now not only looks good but also tastes delicious. For sure, your family will give their seal of approval with two thumbs up.
categories: KNORR CRAB AND CORN REAL CHINESE SOUP

name: Cream Dory in Coconut Milk
description: This simple dish uses the fresh seafood flavor of Cream Dory combined with tomatoes and onions wrapped in lemongrass, topped with creamy coconut milk.
tips: When cooking with coconut milk, you need to monitor the heat and do not let the coconut milk liquid keep at a boiling temp for a long time, to prevent it from breaking. Keep the heat at a low-medium and keep the liquids only at a simmer.
instructions: Begin by marinating the Dory fillet in calamansi juice, salt and pepper then set this aside.
Wash the pechay leaves next and just let it dry.
Carefully wrap the fish with tomato and onions in pechay leaves then secure tightly using a strand of lemongrass.

Prepare a medium sized pot and dissolve the Knorr Ginataang Gulay Complete Recipe mix with water and just bring to a boil, then lower the heat to simmer. Throw in the lemongrass and sili then lower the heat and continue to simmer.

Gently place the wrapped fish one by one in the pot then cover let it cook for 10 minutes and that’s our dish! Your family will truly appreciate this simple, nutritious and delicious Tasty Cream Dory in Corn Sauce. You will definitely eat more than usual.

name: Delicious Yangtze Fish Salad Recipe
description: This heart healthy dish combines the rich seafood flavor of tilapia fish fillet infused with Knorr Sinigang na may Miso; served with Asian soy vegetable salad.
tips: Fry the fish for 3-5 minutes on each side and refrain from moving them too much. Once the side is cooked, you can easily flip it to the other side. If you feel that it still sticks to the pan, let it stay and fry a little longer on that side.

ingredients.item: kilogram sole fillet, cut into pieces
spring onions, cut into 2-inch long strips

instructions: First, prepare 2 shallow pans, one with beaten egg and the other Knorr Sinigang sa Miso with cornstarch. Dip the fish fillet in egg then dredge in Knorr Sinigang sa Miso with cornstarch. Once coated, deep fry it in hot oil. Strain excess oil and set aside.
For the next step, prepare a pot of boiling water over high heat and quickly blanch ginger and celery strips. Combine with spring onions and bean sprouts next.
Now, mix together the rest of the liquid ingredients and just toss with the vegetables or serve on the side.

Here’s how we can plate this dish, place the vegetables as a base then add the fillets on top of the vegetables and that’s it! Your family will definitely be impressed as you present this dish. It’s simple, healthy and delicious too! Serve it anytime!

name: Pork Spareribs Tausi Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich and enhanced flavor of pork with the soy based sauce mixed with tausi for added flavor and textures.
tips: Tausi or Black beans are full of antioxidants, fiber, protein and carbohydrates. Studies show that it has properties that are good for the heart and helps lower blood sugar.

ingredients.item: kilo Pork Spareribs, sliced into medium chunks
onions, cut into rings and sautéed until cooked

instructions: Let’s begin by marinating pork spareribs in Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Marinate for at least 1 hour before cooking.
Now, get your pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and sauté onions, garlic and tausi. Gently add the pork spareribs in and fry them until brown.
Next, pour the water in followed by the Knorr Pork Cubes then bring this to a boil for a much deeper flavour.
Give this a simmer until the meat is fork tender before transferring it into a serving dish.
Top your Pork Spareribs Tausi with fried onions and spring onions for that added crunch. Finally, you are done!
No need for Chinese take-out when you serve this to your family. They will truly adore you for making this for them!

name: Pork Tokwa in Hot and Sour Sauce Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Pork Tokwa in Hot and Sour Sauce | Knorr

ingredients.item: kilo pork (kasim or pigue), cut into bite sized pieces
tokwa, cut into bite sized pieces
red and green bell peppers, cut into thin strips

instructions: Let’s begin by combining the Pork and Marinade in a bowl and let these sit for at least 30 minutes.
tasty. Since tokwa is going to be served crispy, you need to coat it with cornstarch, because cornstarch gives a crispier texture and will help your tokwa not to stick to the pan.

Fry the tokwa in hot oil until golden brown then remove it immediately before frying the marinated pork slices after. Be sure to have a plate lined with paper towels ready so you can drain off the fried pork and tokwa of any excess oil from frying.
Let’s now move on to making the sauce. Grab a saucepan and make it nice and hot over medium high heat. Throw in the ginger slices and cook them until brown before removing them from the pan.

In the same pan, throw in the garlic, red and green bell peppers and sauté them before pouring all the remaining sauce ingredients in. Give this a few minutes to thicken then drop the fried tokwa and crispy pork in and simmer again for a good 3-5 minutes.
Enjoy this Pork Tokwa in Hot and Sour Sauce Recipe with a big bowl of rice because you will definitely eat more than usual.

name: Roasted Chicken with Dry Tinola Recipe
description: This fiesta and handaan recipe uses the rich and fresh flavors of chicken infused with ginger, chili and spices; stuffed with additional sweetness from papaya.
tips: Resting the meat after baking will make the meat juicier and tastier since the meat will have time to redistribute the juices to the insides of the meat, and it will not be released when it is immediately cut.

ingredients.item: fish sauce, plus a little more for basting

instructions: Begin by washing the chicken well and draining it of excess water. With the use of paper towels, pat the chicken dry.

Prepare a rub to flavour the chicken. In a bowl, with the use of your fingers or a fork, mash the Knorr Chicken Cubes and mix this with grated ginger, patis and chopped chilli leaves. Spread the mixture entirely in the interior of the whole chicken and leave in the chiller overnight to marinate.

Before baking in a preheated 350F oven, stuff the chicken with boiled papaya and cook for 70-90 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through. Don’t slice the chicken right away or all the juices will come out. Leave it for 15-20 minutes to rest.
With Roasted Chicken with Dry Tinola served as a weeknight dinner or as a lunch meal, the family will definitely feel mom’s unconditional love.
NOTE: NO YIELD INDICATED

name: Herb Roasted Chicken with Feta Cheese Recipe
description: This Greek inspired dish combines the rich flavor of roasted chicken mixed with oregano and lemon, served with sweet potatoes and feta cheese.
tips: Remember to baste the chicken at least every 20 minutes to prevent the meat from drying out and to make the chicken more flavorful.
instructions: Prepare to roast this whole chicken by first preheating your oven to 220 degrees Celsius or (428F).

The next step is to give that whole chicken a good sprinkle of salt, pepper and oregano and place this on top of a rack in a baking tray that has been drizzled with olive oil. Surround the sweet potatoes all over and drizzle some more of that olive oil.
For that freshness and tanginess, pour lemon juice over the chicken and sweet potatoes before adding in the smashed garlic and a tablespoon of Knorr Chicken Powder.

Since the oven is hot enough, place the chicken in and sear this for 15 minutes to give it a nice brown color. Bring down the temperature to 180 degrees Celsius (350F) and cook for 120 minutes until chicken is brown and tender. Don’t forget to baste the chicken frequently with the pan juices.
To complete our Greek inspired dish, transfer the chicken onto a nice platter and add feta cheese cubes around it. Place an extra serving of lemon wedge to give this dish a more rustic appeal.
Wait until your family tastes this delicious Herb Roasted Chicken with Feta, they will surely love you more for it!
NOTE: NO PRODUCT DISPLAY, NO PICTURE, NO YIELD, NO PREP TIME/COOKING TIME

name: Kaldereta Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Kaldereta made special with Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Kaldereta. Serve this healthy meal to your family.

ingredients.item: (45g) pack Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Kaldereta dissolved in 2 1/2cups water

instructions: Let's begin by frying the beef in a hot pot with a little bit of oil. Set this aside then throw in the garlic and onions. Return the fried meat back to the pot and add in the water. Bring to a boil, then simmer until meat becomes tender.
Mix in liver spread and Knorr Complete Recipe Matrix Kaldereta (mixed in water). Boil for 2 minutes.
Add in vegetables and simmer until sauce thickens. You can now enjoy Kaldereta any time you please. With Knorr Kaldereta Complete Recipe Mix, cooking becomes more easy.

name: Seafood Paella Recipe
description: Bring a taste of Spain to your table with Knorr's delicious seafood paella recipe. Make this traditionally complex dish easier with these cooking tips.

ingredients.item: uncooked Arborio rice or other short-grain rice

instructions: To make a flavourful paella make sure you start with a good broth. Here's how to prepare the broth. First, combine the first 4 ingredients in a saucepan and just bring to a simmer (do not boil). Keep warm over low heat.
Next is to prepare the herb blend by combining the parsley and next 4 ingredients (parsley through 2 garlic cloves) set this aside.
To prepare the Paella, trim the connective tissue from the monkfish and cut into 1-inch pieces. Next, peel and devein the shrimp but keep the tails intact.

Get a paellera or a large skillet and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour 1 tablespoon oil and add the fish and shrimp. Saute for 1 minute (the seafood mixture will not be cooked through). Remove seafood mixture form pan, and keep warm.

Throw in the onion and bell pepper to the pan, and saute for 5 minutes. Add the tomatoes, paprika, crushed red pepper, and 3 garlic cloves. Cook for 5 minutes before adding the rice. Cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the broth, herb blend, and peas. Bring to a low boil, and cook for 10 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add clams to the pan, nestling them into the rice mixture. Cook for 5 minutes or until shells open and discard any unopened shells.
Stir in the seafood mixture, and arrange shrimp, heads down, in rice mixture. Arrange pimento slices spoke-like on top of rice mixture. Cook for 5 minutes.

Sprinkle with lemon juice then remove from heat. Cover with a towel, and let stand for 10 minutes and that's it. You know for sure that your mom loves you when she serves you this Seafood Paella. Definitely a labor of love!

name: Warm Bacon Mushroom Vinaigrette Recipe
description: Upgrade your ordinary bowl of greens with this warm bacon mushroom vinaigrette recipe. Learn how to make this salad dressing with Knorr today.
instructions: Cut the bacon slices into ½ inch wide strips. Cook the bacon with 3 tbsp water in a medium skillet over medium heat, stirring often, until the bacon starts to crisp.
Add the mushrooms and cook, tossing occasionally, until tender, 5-6 minutes.
Add the sherry vinegar and ¼ cup water. Simmer until reduced by half, about 1 minute.
Stir in the vegetable oil and season with salt and pepper. Stir in the chopped parsley.
Enjoy!

name: Rellenong Sili Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich taste of ground pork mixed with sweet chorizo and green peas, stuffed and baked in bell peppers which add flavor to the dish.
tips: To reduce the baking time for the stuffed bell peppers, you can place the bell peppers in the microwave and heat for a few minutes, until soft. Do this before adding the pork mix stuffing. This will prevent the bell pepper from being soggy.

ingredients.item: large bell peppers, trimmed to form cups

instructions: Begin by grabbing a pan and getting it nice and hot over medium high heat. Throw in the onion and garlic and cook them until the vegetables give off a nice aroma.
Next, Add the Knorr Pork Cubes, mash them and mix them well before adding chorizo. Sauté this for 2 minutes.
Now, add the ground pork and sauté until cooked through. Gently place the green peas and mixed greens and season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning and black pepper.
Turn off the heat and pour the beaten eggs in. Stuff bell peppers with the pork mixture, cover the top with grated cheese and bake or toast until the cheese melts.
Serve Rellenong Sili to your family and see the smiles on their faces when you serve something as pretty and as delicious as this.

name: Chili Con Carne Recipe
description: This Mexican dish uses the combination of flavors from the beef, carrots and celery mixed with spices and red kidney beans, enhanced with Knorr Kaldereta.
tips: Red kidney beans does not only provide great flavor and added textures to the dish, but they are a good source of iron, phosphorus and potassium, and they are also an excellent low-fat source of protein and dietary fiber.

ingredients.item: pc. carrot cut into small cubes
red bell pepper, cut into small cubes

instructions: Here’s what you can do to make the most out of your spices. Toast the chilli powder, cumin and cinnamon in a pan for not more than a minute. You just want to bring out their essential oil. Remove and use it for later.
Let’s continue by getting your pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion and garlic. Sauté until you can smell the nice aroma from the cooked vegetables.

Add the ground beef next and just sauté until brown. You may now add the toasted spices, chili powder, cumin, and cinnamon followed by the Knorr Kaldereta Recipe Mix dissolved in water. Add the beans next and mix this well.
Bring this to the boil and simmer until the sauce is thick. Add the remaining vegetables, and after 2 minutes of simmering, this dish is done!
Get ready because this dish will take you all the way to Mexico and back home. Enjoy this with your friends and family so they can join you in your “travels” too!

name: Cocido Recipe
description: Slow-cook some beef brisket, chorizo, fresh vegetables, saba, and potatoes, toss in a Knorr Beef Cube, and delight in this easy cocido recipe.
tips: When boiling brisket, remember to remove the scum from the surface of the water every now and then, to ensure your soup will be nice and clear. This process is called skimming.

ingredients.item: pcs. potatoes, cut into large cubes
pcs. green beans, cut into 2 ½-inch lengths

instructions: Let’s begin by getting a nice pot and making it hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion and garlic. Toss in the chorizo next and just sauté them until you can smell the lovely aroma from the cooked meat and vegetables.
Add the water and beef brisket and just bring this to a boil before reducing to a simmer until beef is very tender.
Drop the Knorr Beef Cubes and gently place the potatoes, garbanzos, and saba next. Just give this a few minutes until the vegetables are cooked before adding the green beans and cabbage.
Simmer again for another 2 minutes, and with a dash of pepper, this dish is done!

name: Ginisang Repolyo Recipe
description: Stir-fried vegetables are nutritious yet easy to make. Try this ginisang reployo recipe with ground pork and shrimp for a satisfying but fast ulam.
instructions: Here’s a dish that proves that simplicity can pack a powerful punch of mouth-watering flavour too.
Begin by making your pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion and garlic and cook them until you can smell the lovely aroma from the cooked vegetables.
Now, add the pork and sauté until it is cooked through before you add the shrimp and bell pepper. Just give this a minute to cook.
Finally, place the cabbage in and sauté these for 2 minutes longer over high heat. With a sprinkle of Knorr Liquid Seasoning and pepper, this dish is done!
With or without rice, enjoy this delicious and nutritious Ginisang Repolyo anytime of the week.

name: Pancit Palabok Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Pancit Palabok. Made with our Knorr Pork and Shrimp Cubes to enhance the taste of this filipino comfort food.
tips: Annatto (Achuete) is not only used to give color to dishes but it is also said to be good for diabetes, diarrhea, fevers, fluid retention, heartburn, malaria, and hepatitis. They also use it as an antioxidant and bowel cleanser.

ingredients.item: shrimp, shelled and deveined (reserve shrimp heads for sauce base)
Toppings (optional): chopped spring onions, crushed chicharon, tinapa flakes, fried tofu cubes

instructions: First, begin by getting a pot and filling it with water. Over high heat, bring the water to a boil then reduce to a simmer. Drop in the bihon noodles and cook as you would cook pasta. Make sure the noodles are al dente. Discard the water and drain the noodles. Set aside.
Next, make achuete oil by combining 2 tbsp oil and achuete seeds in a pan. When it starts to sizzle and the seeds turn dark, remove seeds and reserve the oil.

In the same pan, throw in the garlic and sauté until brown. Add in the shrimp and the flour, and stir constantly to cook. Continue to cook until thick and you can smell the nutty aroma and the shrimp turns bright in color.
Slowly pour in the water next with the shrimp heads. Now, bring to a boil then add the Knorr Shrimp Cube and Knorr Pork Cube.
Remove the shrimp heads after simmering for 6-8 minutes, then season with fish sauce and pepper to make adjustments in flavour.

Place the Bihon noodles in a platter and pour the sauce over. Top with your choice of topping and that’s our dish! No need to buy instant pancit, for this Pancit Palabok is easy to make. Have it over merienda or dinner or any meal time, it will truly satisfy!

name: Pork and Beef Siomai Recipe
description: This classic Chinese dimsum recipe uses the combined rich flavors of beef and pork mixed with carrots, spring onions, spices infused with Knorr Pork flavors.

ingredients.item: chopped spring onions and carrots for topping
chopped siling labuyo or chilli sauce

instructions: Here’s a dish that’s guaranteed to make your day. Siomai is the ultimate comfort food eaten with or without rice.
Begin by combining ground pork and beef with onion, spring onions, carrots, Knorr Pork Cube, sesame oil, egg and pepper in a bowl. Mix them well until all ingredients are incorporated.

With the index finger and thumb touching together, place the wonton wrapper on top, to create a small cup shape. Place a spoonful of the mixture in the center and push the filling down to create a pouch then leave the top open. Do the same with the remaining mixture.
Give your siomai that resto look by topping them with spring onions and carrots. Cook in a steamer lined with wax paper (bake paper or aluminium foil will do) for 15-20 minutes.
Enjoy your Pork and Beef Siomai with a serving of Knorr Liquid Seasoning on the side. This will definitely make your day brighter!

name: Tantanmen Recipe
description: This asian noodle dish combines the savory and spicy sesame broth with added chili spices, mixed with sautéed pork, ginger flavor, served with ramen noodles.
tips: You can make your dish more personal by adding more toppings such as boiled bean sprouts, boiled pechay (bok choy), chili sauce/oil, cooked and sliced pork belly, nori, soft-boiled eggs. You can also adjust the spice level by adding more hot sauce to the broth.

ingredients.item: g. ramen noodles, boiled and drained
Other Toppings (optional): boiled bean sprouts, boiled pechay (bok choy), chili sauce/oil, cooked and sliced pork belly, nori, soft-boiled eggs.

instructions: You know what makes a good and delicious Ramen? It’s the broth!

Let’s begin by sautéing the onion, garlic and ginger in a pre-heated pot with a little bit of oil. Cook them until the vegetables give off a nice aroma. Now throw in the pork next and sauté until slightly toasted.
Add the rest of the ingredients and the Knorr Pork Cubes. Bring to a boil then simmer for 8-10 minutes.

Now that the broth is done, serve by placing the cooked noodles in a bowl, pour some of the broth over and top it with your preferred ingredients. Your Tantanmen is now ready to be devoured. Be careful because sipping into the hot soup will cause you extreme happiness.

name: Fish Pie Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Fish Pie made extra special with Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix. Enjoy it with your family!
tips: Studies show that Coconut milk contains lots of mineral and nutrients that helps in weight loss, reducing inflammation and reducing joint pains.

ingredients.item: Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay
floury potato, peeled, diced and boiled until tender

instructions: Begin by seasoning the fish with salt then dredge it in flour. Make sure you have a preheated pan with oil ready so you can deep fry the fish until crisp and brown. Drain on paper towels then set aside.
Get another pan ready and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Melt the butter with a bit of oil and sauté the onion and garlic in butter until they give off a lovely aroma.
Add Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay dissolved in water and just bring to a boil then reduce heat to a simmer until thick. Drop in the bay leaves and nutmeg.
Now, add all-purpose cream over low heat and mix well.

Prepare a baking dish and pour a little bit of the sauce at the bottom. Now, top with the fried fish fillet and boiled potatoes. Cover with the remaining sauce and add the cheddar cheese and breadcrumbs on top.
Bake in a preheated 400F oven until browned on top and the cheese is melted. Your family will definitely insist you make this more often at home. Don’t deny them this dish because it’s simply divine!

name: Bagoong Rice Recipe
description: This Asian classic rice recipe uses the rich seafood flavor of shrimp paste (bagoong) infused with Knorr Shrimp taste, topped with mangoes, egg and tomatoes.
tips: Bagoong contains high levels of essential fatty acids like DHA and polyunsaturated fatty acids, that improves brain function, improves the immune system and reduce heart attacks.

ingredients.item: Knorr Liquid Seasoning and pepper, to taste

instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the garlic and sauté until slightly toasted. Now, in goes the bagoong and the pounded Knorr Shrimp Cubes. Sauté this for another minute.
Gently add the cooked rice and mix well. With a few sprinkles of Knorr Liquid Seasoning and pepper, this dish is done!
When serving, don’t forget to just top it off with egg, green mango and tomatoes. With your favourite ulam, it will be hard to leave the dinner table. You will find yourself eating and eating!

name: Chicken Burger Recipe
description: This simple and healthy recipe combines the rich flavor of chicken with the spiced flavors of garlic, onions and cheese, infused with delicious seasoning.
tips: When cooking the burger patties, give each side at least 3 minutes to sear on both sides to get an even out crust. After that, you can flip the burgers are often as you want to make sure that the internal meat is cooked through.
instructions: This recipe can be easily prepared in an instant. Combine the ground chicken in a bowl together with the onions, garlic, breadcrumbs, thyme and cheese. Set this aside.

Instead of the usual salt as seasoning, you can add rich flavors just by dissolving 1 pc of Knorr Chicken cube in 50 ml water and combining it with the ground chicken, the outcome will be fantastic. Mix the burger meat and the seasoning until all ingredients are well incorporated.

Measure 3 spoonful scoops of the burger mixture, try to form a round shape then flatten Repeat this procedure until all the chicken mixture is finished. Allow these to set for at least 30 minutes in the chiller to retain their shape.
Just by cooking the chicken burgers 3-5 minutes per side, these homemade delicious patties should be ready to be devoured by the family.

name: Dinuguan na May Gata Recipe
description: This dish combines the sour and tangy flavors of pork cooked in the classic dinuguan style mixed with the sweet and light taste of coconut milk.
tips: In preparing this dish, do not use an aluminium bowl in mixing the pork blood, coconut milk and vinegar. It is because when aluminium and acid come in contact, it creates a chemical reaction and will make the food toxic.

ingredients.item: whole white onion, peeled and minced
sukang Iloco (you can use cane vinegar)
Knorr Pork broth (dilute 1 piece Knorr Pork Cube in 2 cups water)

instructions: Dinuguan need not be intimidating especially when you follow these easy steps. First, you just need to bring together the pork heart, pork liver, and pork intestine, add enough water to cover the meat in a large pot and bring them to a boil. Cook them until tender. Set aside the pork and discard the remaining stock used for boiling.
Next, you’ve got to slice the pork heart and pork liver into strips and set this aside as well.
Now using a mixing bowl, mix together the pork blood and coconut milk and add a little bit of vinegar. Set aside.
Get a pan and get it nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the garlic and onion and cook them until the garlic is slightly brown in color and onions are translucent.
Add the pork belly, sautéing them briefly before adding the pork heart and liver strips.

Now, pour the Knorr Pork broth, sukang Iloco, bay leaves and green finger chilli. Let this simmer until the pork belly is tender. When the liquid has reduced to ¾, add the pork blood with coconut milk and continue to cook until it thickens (if sauce becomes too thick, add more Knorr pork broth).
Get the most out of the flavour of Dinuguan sa Gata by adding a sprinkle of Knorr Liquid Seasoning, salt and pepper.
With or without puto, you will surely eat a lot and forget about your diet when your mom serves this at home.

name: Easy Ginataang Baboy at Langka Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich flavor of pork mixed with the sweet taste of langka, cooked in the sweet coconut milk sauce.
tips: When cooking with coconut milk, monitor the heat and keep it at medium-low setting or at simmer temp to prevent the coconut milk from curdling or breaking up.

ingredients.item: coconut cream (dilute 1 sachet of Knorr Ginataang Gulay with 1 ½ cups of hot water)

instructions: Begin by getting a pan and making it nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the garlic, onion and ginger. Cook them until the vegetables give off a nice aroma.
Add the pork next and sauté them until brown before adding the langka. Give this a good stir.
Add Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mixture with water, chillis and Knorr Pork Cube. Cover the pan and cook over low heat until the pork is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Finding this Easy Ginataang Baboy at Langka dish on your table is enough reason to relax because this dish truly soothes and satisfies without trying too hard.

name: Easy Knorr Porkchops Recipe
description: This simple dish is a classic comfort food. It uses the rich flavors of pork enhanced with the delicious flavors of the Knorr Pork marination.
tips: To prevent the pork chop from drying, after searing the pork chops in high heat until golden brown, you can finish the cooking process by placing them in the oven (400F) to gently bake the insides of the pork chops and keep its moisture.
instructions: Here’s one of the reasons why you should cook Easy Knorr Porkchops often. You just need to crush and dissolve the Knorr Pork Cubes in ½ cup olive oil and rub this to both sides of the pork slices.
Marinate and leave it for 30 minutes, just before pan-frying them until golden brown.
Make sure to have a plate lined with paper towels ready to drain off any excess oil from frying.

name: Easy Salpicao Recipe
description: This simple dish combines the rich flavor of beef tenderloin infused with the flavors of Knorr seasoning mixed with the spiced taste of garlic and chili.
tips: This recipe is best served with a lot of garlic, both in the marinate and as toppings. Garlic is often referred as a wonder drug because of it's medicinal properties, which include the prevention of a range of illnesses from common colds to heart attacks.

ingredients.item: beef tenderloin or sirloin, cut into strips

instructions: Let’s get started by making a really good marinade. Place the beef tenderloin strips, soy sauce, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, crushed Knorr Beef Cube and chopped garlic in a bowl. Mix this well and just leave it for 15 minutes until the cube dissolves and that the sauce seeps into the beef.
After 15-20 minutes, strain out the marinade and set the beef tenderloin strips aside.

Get your pan nice and hot at high heat. Pour the olive oil and throw in the crushed garlic then add the marinated beef. Cook the beef until light brown. Then, add chopped sili and sauté until done. And that’s it!
Feel free to eat a lot! We know you won’t be able to resist the goodness of this Salpicao recipe. What’s the added bonus? This dish is just so easy to make!

name: Italian Pasta Recipe
description: Say ciao with these Italian pasta recipes! Savor the taste of Italy with new ways to cook pasta with dishes that are easy to prep and easier to eat.
tips: NO DISH DISPLAY

ingredients.item: fusilli pasta (if not available, spaghetti can be used)

instructions: Let’s begin by dissolving a pack of Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Kaldereta in 1 cup water then set this aside.
Next, get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium high heat. Throw in the garlic and onions before adding the ground beef. Sauté until the meat is brown.
Pour in the dissolved Knorr Recipe Mix Kaldereta and tomatoes. Just let this simmer for 3-5 minutes.
Adding sugar, cilantro and milk gives this pasta sauce that added sweetness, creaminess and the freshest of flavours. Now, remove from the heat as soon as the sugar dissolves.
Now that our sauce is ready, cook the pasta according to package directions. Pour the sauce on top and that’s our dish!
Sometimes you need to bend the rules a little and create something new. Your family will truly appreciate this Italian Pasta. It’s delicious!

name: Mini Pizza Recipe
description: This simple kiddie snack recipe uses a simple homemade pizza dough topped with fresh flavors of mozzarella, ham, tomatoes and oregano.
tips: Par-baking ensures the dough will be fully cooked after the topping has been added. And should you decide not to use it right away, you can freeze them and just take it out of the freezer anytime you feel like baking mini pizzas.
instructions: Here’s a pizza dough recipe that will surely encourage you to make pizza more often because it’s not complicated to do and it does not contain yeast for the dough to rise.

Let’s get started by making the dough. In a pan, over low heat, pour in the milk and allow this to simmer for only 40 seconds. Drop in the Knorr Beef Cube and allow it to dissolve. Turn off the heat and just let it cool down for about 5 minutes.
Slowly mix in the flour, stirring well to prevent it from clumping together. Now, add the butter and the 1 tbsp cheese next.

Transfer the dough to a work surface that is lightly coated with flour and start kneading the dough until all ingredients are well incorporated. Divide it into 4 part and shape and roll it into 4-inch diameter disks. Par-baking ensures the dough will be fully cooked after the topping has been added. And should you decide not to use it right away, you can freeze them and just take it out of the freezer anytime you feel like baking mini pizzas.
Once done, place the mini doughs in a baking sheet and par-bake them in a pre-heated oven until it becomes slightly brown.

Now that our mini pizzas have been par-baked, cover them with the mozzarella cheese and arrange the ham, tomatoes, onions and olives around the top. Bake until the cheese is melted and the topping cooked.
Now you can enjoy pizza not only for merienda but as baon, as a snack or for breakfast too. Whatever time of day, this pizza is a welcome treat!

name: Pasta A La Romana Recipe
description: This classic pasta dish combines the rich flavor and texture of bacon bits mixed with sautéed onions, creamy milk and parmesan cheese.
tips: Since pasta is bland, cooking it in salted water adds flavoring to the noodles. Remember to keep a little of the pasta water before cooking, you can use it to add more body and texture to the sauce.
instructions: Begin by cooking your pasta according to package directions using salted water.
Now get your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some olive oil and throw in the bacon, then the onions. Sauté until the bacon starts to release its oil and turn darker in color.
Add the Knorr Pork Cube and the milk and just let this simmer for about 3-5 minutes. Simmer until fully dissolved.
Add the Knorr Pork Cube and the milk and just let this simmer for about 3-5 minutes. Simmer until fully dissolved.
Can’t wait to eat? Just add a sprinkle of flat leaf parsley and more cheese and you can eat as much as you want. This Pasta Romana recipe is just that good!

name: Pork and Mushroom Soup Recipe
description: This Chinese style soup recipe uses the rich taste of sautéed mushrooms mixed with pork liempo strips, combined with Knorr enriched soup flavors.
tips: You can add more flavor and a deeper texture to the mushroom sauce by adding butter when sautéing.

ingredients.item: tsps. ginger, grated around 1” thumb size
shiitake mushroom (if not available you can use any other fresh mushroom)
pork belly (liempo), boiled and thinly sliced
Knorr pork & Mushroon Real Chinese Soup

instructions: Prepare a deep casserole and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the ginger, fresh mushroom and pork. Sauté until you can smell the lovely aroma from the cooked vegetables and meat.
In goes the 3 cups water followed by 1 Knorr Pork Cube. Let it boil then lower the heat to a simmer before adding the 1 pack of Knorr Pork & Mushroom Real Chinese Soup .
Add the tengang daga next with the mixed vegetables, togue, and tokwa. And for that authentic Chinese soup style, add the beaten egg last.

Give this a nice seasoning of Knorr Liquid Seasoning and pepper and that’s our dish! Enjoy this soup with your loved ones! Make memories with them as you bond over the deliciousness that is this dish.

name: Quick Ginataang Talong Recipe
description: This simple dish uses the fresh taste and texture of eggplant sautéed with pork and onions, simmered in a creamy coconut milk based sauce topped with chili.
tips: When cooking this dish, after adding the Knorr Ginataang Gulay mix, do not let the dish boil, have it a constant simmer only. Boiling may cause the cream or coconut milk to break or curdle.

ingredients.item: Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix dissolved in 2 cup water

instructions: Let’s begin by getting your pan nice and hot and bring the heat to medium. Pour some oil and throw in the garlic and onion.
Now, turn the heat up and sauté the pork for 2 minutes. Reduce the heat to low and gently add the eggplant.
Next, you may drop the Knorr Pork Cube, followed by the dissolved Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix, before adding the chilli. Just simmer until the sauce barely thickens and this dish is done!
Make sure to have a plate of rice ready for this Quick Ginataang Talong Recipe is truly addicting.

name: Quick Herbed Pork Zucchini Melt Recipe
description: Knorr's Quick Herbed Pork Zucchini Melt using Knorr Pork Cube is an easy way to add a touch of class to every luncheon or dinner party.
instructions: In a bowl, combine olive oil, Knorr Pork Cube, oregano, thyme, and basil. Mix thoroughly so that Knorr Pork Cube is well diluted.
Add zucchini slices and pork and just store in the chiller overnight to marinate.
Wrap a zucchini slice around a mozzarella piece. Do the same with the rest of the pieces.
Arrange cucumber slices, zucchini wrap, and pork in a skewer.
Grill until pork is cooked. Let your family be delighted by this Quick Herbed Pork Zucchini Melt Recipe. It’s simply lovely!

name: Quick Lamb Tikka Kebabs Recipe
description: This quick lamb skewer recipe uses the sweet and tender flavors of lamb marinated in yoghurt, garlic, calamansi and spices, enhanced with Knorr beef flavors.
tips: Lamb is not only a rich source of high-quality protein, but it is also an outstanding source of many vitamins and minerals, including iron, zinc, and vitamin B12. Lamb is traditionally paired with mint jelly.

ingredients.item: tsps. chili paste or minced fresh chillis
Knorr Beef Cube, pounded and mashed

instructions: Mix together cumin powder, yoghurt, chili paste or fresh chillis, garlic, ginger, mace, garam masala powder, pounded Knorr Beef Cube, oil and calamansi juice.
Coat the lamb in the mixture and marinate for at least 4 hours.
Thread the meat onto skewers or bamboo sticks and grill. Don't forget to brush the meat with oil while grilling. Grill until the meat is fully cooked.

You know what else you can do? You can add sliced bell peppers, tomatoes and/or onions to the skewers for added flavor and color. Enjoy Quick Lamb Tikka Kebabs with a bowl of rice or bread and prepare to eat more than usual!

name: Roasted Chicken with Rosemary and Potatoes Recipe
description: This baked chicken recipe uses the rich flavor of chicken combined with rosemary and lemon, infused with Knorr seasoning; served with potatoes wedges.

ingredients.item: whole pc chicken, fat and excess skin trimmed

instructions: Don’t worry, despite this recipe calling for both oven-prep and chicken-prep, it’s going to be really easy to follow. So, begin by preheating the oven to 375F.
Let's start with the chicken rub mix. Make a mixture of rosemary, garlic, lemon zest, salt, pepper, olive oil and Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Mix well.
Pat-dry chicken pieces with a paper towel, then brush the rub mixture or massage onto the chicken surface, cavity and under the skin.
Toss the potatoes with some oil and remaining seasoning mixture then place them in a baking dish.
Put chicken over the potatoes then put inside the preheated oven. Bake for 40 minutes or until chicken is golden brown and juices run clear.
Enjoy this beautifully complex dish any time of the week. Your family will adore you for it!

name: This Sinigang na Tulingan Recipe Will Be Your New Favorite
description:
Skip the bangus and make a delicious fish sinigang using heart-healthy tulingan (bullet tuna) in under an hour using Knorr Sinigang na May Miso. 
               
               
               
              This sinigang is a healthy and delicious soup that’s full of good-for-you vegetables like mustasa. The tulingan also boosts a healthy dose of Omega 3 acids that make this dish not only delicious but also good for you.
tips: To make this sinigang na tulingan extra delicious, sauté the onions and tomatoes before adding the water and simmering. The caramelized flavors will deepen the taste of your sinigang.

ingredients.item: (25g) packs Knorr Sinigang na May Miso

instructions: Grab a medium-sized pot and fill it with water that’s been used to wash rice (hugas bigas). Bring this to a boil.
Lower the heat to a simmer and begin adding the onions and tomatoes. Let it simmer for a few minutes.
Next, gently add the tulingan into the pot along with siling pangsigang. Continue simmering until the tulingan is cooked.
Add Knorr Sinigang na May Miso and Knorr Fish Cube into the pot. Let it simmer and enjoy this delicious Sinigang na Tulingan in under an hour!
Serve warm and enjoy with piping hot bowls of rice.

name: Sour and Spicy Shrimp Soup Recipe
description: This Thai inspired dish uses the rich seafood taste of shrimps combined with the tangy flavors of Knorr Sinigang mixed with fresh spices and lemongrass.
tips: You can replace Galangal with ginger but there will be a slight difference in taste. Ginger offers a fresh, sweet-yet-spicy taste, while galangal's flavor is sharper, spicier, and slightly more peppery.

ingredients.item: (20g) pack Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original

instructions: Here’s a very simple sour and spicy soup you can whip up any time of the week. All you need to do is to get a pot and fill it with water. Over high heat, boil the water then drop in the shrimp and Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original.
Add the rest of the ingredients and let this simmer until shrimp is thoroughly cooked. Season with fish sauce and that’s our dish!
Who wouldn’t want to eat something as comforting as Sour and Spicy Shrimp? You will definitely crave for more when you try this.

name: Spicy Chicken Sandwich Recipe
description: What makes this homemade chicken burger hot, juicy and flavourful? Well, it’s simple: paprika, chilli flakes and Knorr Chicken Cubes.
tips: NOTE: NO PICTURE, NO YIELD, NO PREP TIME/ COOKING TIME
instructions: Slice chicken fillets to make thin slices then pound up to about ½ an inch thick.
Season chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder and Knorr Liquid Seasoning for at least 30 mins.
In a shallow bowl, combine flour, cornstarch and season with salt, pepper and garlic powder as well.
Combine breadcrumbs with chili powder and cayenne pepper.
Dredge marinated chicken in flour mixture then dip in beaten eggs then coat with the spiced breadcrumbs.
Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown. Drain oil.

Assemble sandwich by spreading mayonnaise on the buns. Put 3 pcs of lettuce leaves on the bottom bun, top with fried chicken, cheese slice then cover with the other bun. Add ketchup if preferred. Do the same to the other sandwich. Enjoy!

name: Vegetable Canneloni Recipe
description: This heart healthy pasta dish uses the fresh taste of sautéed vegetables rolled canneloni style using lasagna sheets, topped with cream sauce and cheese.
tips: Here’s a tip to avoid the noodles from sticking together: once the noodles boil, stir for the first two minutes. Then continue cooking until al dente.

ingredients.item: spinach leaves, blanched in boiling water
grated mozzarella / easy melt cheese for topping

instructions: Let’s begin by cooking our lasagne noodles according to package instructions. Make sure to use salted boiling water because it gives that added flavour to the noodles.

Get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some olive oil and throw in the onions and cook until you can smell the nice aroma from the cooked vegetables. Add the Knorr Chicken Cubes then dissolve this in olive oil.
Pour in the cream and gently place the blanched spinach leaves next and just simmer until the sauce is thick then set this aside.

Preheat the oven to 350°F and prepare the baking dish for your lasagna. Cover the bottom of a rectangular baking dish with cream sauce to prevent pasta from sticking then lay one lasagna sheet in the dish, fill with spinach leaves and roll the sheet to form a tube (like a canneloni). Place lasagne rolls at the end of the dish and repeat until all the noodles have been filled.
Now, pour the remaining sauce on top. You can spread stewed or cooked tomatoes over the cream sauce. The possibilities are endless!

Top your cannelloni with grated mozarella or easy melt cheese for topping and bake in oven for 5-10 minutes or until top is golden and that’s our dish! Here’s one of the reasons why you should serve Vegetable Canneloni at home: it’s not only delicious but it’s nutritious too! You will definitely eat more than usual!

name: Crispy Chicken Gata with Ampalaya
description: This dish combines the rich flavor is chicken fried to add a crispy texture mixed with the creamy ampalaya slices cooked in sweet coconut milk sauce.
tips: To remove or reduce the bitterness from the Ampalaya, you can soak the ampalaya slices in seasoned water with salt for at least 10 minutes. Remember to rinse the slices before cooking to remove excess salt.

ingredients.item: (1 pack) Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay
(1 pack) Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay

instructions: There are only 2 steps in making this unique and great tasting dish. First, you need to cook the chicken fillet and second, you need to create a sauce that will go with the chicken.

Let’s begin by making the batter. Place all the ingredients for the batter in a bowl and dip the breast fillets in before frying them in hot oil. Then, remove them from the oil and allow these to drain in a plate lined with paper towels.

Next, let’s cook the sauce. In a saucepan, turn your heat up to medium and pour some oil. Throw the onions and garlic in and sauté until the onion is translucent and the garlic is golden. Now, add the ampalaya with the water, Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay, sili sigang and a dash of pepper. Stir gently and allow to simmer until the ampalaya is cooked.
When you serve this Crispy Chicken with the sauce poured over, you won’t be able to stop yourself from crying tears of joy. It’s just that good!
categories: KNORR COMPLETE RECIPE MIX GINATAANG GULAY

name: Baked Chicken Gata Recipe
description: This simple dish uses the rich taste of chicken marinated in coconut milk. Roasted to give it a nice crisp skin while keeping the meat nice and juicy.
tips: Before starting your preparations, make sure that you pre heat your oven to 375F.

ingredients.item: Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay diluted in ½ cup water

instructions: All you need to do is to marinate the chicken in the diluted Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay and add salt and pepper for about an hour.
You can now roast it in the pre-heated oven at 180C until the chicken is cooked through.
Indulge in this yummy Baked Chicken gata with a serving of sweet bagoong and steamed pechay on the side. Your family will truly thank you for this delicious meal that you’ve prepared for them.
categories: KNORR COMPLETE RECIPE MIX GINATAANG GULAY

name: Curry Chicken Lumpia Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich flavors of chicken mixed with the sweet taste of coconut milk, onions and wansoy; wrapped and fried for that extra crispy texture.
tips: Make sure to sauté and cook the chicken filling before wrapping them in the lumpia wrappers. The lumpia wrapper is thin and will cook quickly when frying, sautéing the chicken will prevent it from being served raw.

ingredients.item: Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay

instructions: Begin by mixing the chicken with onion, wansoy, egg and flour. Then, flavour the mixture with pepper, Knorr Liquid Seasoning and Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay. Cook the mixture in a hot pan with a little bit of oil, and sauté this until the chicken is cooked through. Remove from heat and set aside to cool down.

When the mixture is cool enough to handle, divide this into 6 to 8 fillings. Place the filling in the lumpia wrapper while topping it with a piece of siling haba. Roll the wrapper and do the same for the rest before deep frying them in hot oil until brown.
You will surely eat more rice when you serve this hot and spicy Chicken Curry Lumpia. It sure has a unique and delicious kick to it!

name: Beef Pancit Bihon Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Beef Pancit Bihon with Knorr Beef Cube!

ingredients.item: g. beef sirloin, cut into thin strips

instructions: First, let’s make the beef stock! Start by dissolving the Knorr Beef Cube in 3 cups boiling water then set this aside.

Next, get your pan nice and hot over medium heat and pour some oil. Throw in the garlic and onions then add the beef sirloin. Stir fry until the color turns brown. Add the kinchay, cabbage and carrots and stir fry until the vegetables are half cooked.
Pour the Knorr Beef stock and Knorr Liquid Seasoning , then bring these to a boil for 5 minutes before adding the noodles. Allow to simmer and wait until the noodles are cooked.
Transfer to a platter and top with dahon ng sibuyas and calamansi on the side. And that’s our dish!
Mmmm, just by smelling Beef Pancit Bihon, you know it’s going to be delicious!

name: Fish Sinigang Recipe
description: This Nutribudget Fish Sinigang should be a staple in anyone’s kitchen. It's light, nutritious and delicious, specially when you use Knorr Sinigang Mix Original
tips: If you want more of that “asim kilig” goodness, try using 1 (40g) pack of Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original.
instructions: Get a pot and fill it with water, onions and tomatoes. Over high heat, boil for 5 minutes.
Gently place the fish in with the finger pepper, radish, eggplant and Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original. Mix well and allow to simmer until fish is cooked through.
Finally, add the kangkong leaves and after simmering for a minute, this dish is done. Imagine yourself eating Fish Sinigang with hot rice, ooohhh its pure heaven!

name: Chicken Pesto Cream Recipe
description: This heart healthy dish combines the rich flavors of chicken seasoned with Knorr flavors mixed with fresh taste of basil and nuts from the herb pesto sauce.
tips: Pesto is packed with antioxidants thanks to the ingredients like basil and garlic. These help you reduce chronic illnesses and help normalize your blood pressure.

ingredients.item: Knorr Ginataang Gulay Complete Recipe Mix

instructions: In a blender, combine basil, garlic, and pili nuts. Then, gradually add olive oil. Blend until smooth. Then, add parmesan cheese.
In a medium pan over medium heat, dissolve 1 pack Knorr Ginataang Gulay in 1/2 cupwater then simmer until thick.
Reduce heat. Combine the coconut cream and ½ cup of pesto and mix well.
Season both side of the chicken breast fillet with Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Then, pan-fry until cooked through.
Pour the sauce into a plate. Top this with pan-fried chicken breasts and garlic chips.
categories: KNORR GINATAANG GULAY COMPLETE RECIPE MIX

name: Pinais na Alimasag Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich seafood flavor of crabs combined with onions, coconut meat and creamy coconut sauce; stuffed and steamed in crab shells.
tips: When cooking with Coconut Milk, let the dish slowly simmer at low to medium heat, to ensure full flavors are extracted and infused in the meat. Do not let the dish boil, to prevent the sauce from breaking or curdling.
instructions: Begin by combining crabs and water in a pot. Bring to a boil until crabs are cooked (once shells change color).
Get another pot and combine Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix and water. Mix well, bring to a boil and simmer until thick.
Remove crabmeat from the shells and chop. Combine the crabmeat with ginger, onion, and buko meat in a bowl. Add half of the prepared gata sauce and mix well.

Fill the crab shells with the meat mixture and top with bell peppers. Wrap in banana leaves and place in a steamer for 10 minutes. And that’s our dish! When you serve this to your family, everyone will be in awe at how good this dish is. They will be busy eating and savouring the flavour of Pinais na Alimasag!

name: Classic Beef Kaldereta
description: Beef Caldereta is a Spanish inspired dish mixing flavors of beef and thick tangy tomato sauce, topped with potatoes and carrots for added flavors and textures
tips: Beef has a lot of healthy benefits. Beef is a good source of iron, zinc and B vitamins. Zinc helps boosts the immune system to combat bacteria and viruses.

ingredients.item: kilogram beef kaldereta cut or shortribs
potatoes, peeled and cut into cubes
carrots, peeled and cut into cubes
green bell pepper, deseeded and cubed
red bell pepper, deseeded and cubed

instructions: Begin by tenderizing the beef in water. Pour the water enough to cover the meat with the quartered onions. Simmer, covered, until beef is tender. Remove the scum that has formed on the surface. Once beef is tender, strain out from the broth and set aside beef and the broth.
Get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onions and garlic and sauté until light brown in color.
Add in the tenderized beef and saute for 1 minute.
Stir in the liver spread, tomato paste and bay leaves. Mix well.
Add 1-1/2 cups of the broth and Knorr Beef Cube. Simmer for 5 minutes before adding the potatoes and carrots. Continue to simmer until vegetables are tender and sauce has slightly thickened.

Lastly, add bell peppers. You may also add the olives and cheese at this point, if desired. And that's it! Classic Beef Kaldereta is best enjoyed with the company of loved ones because something as good as this is best shared with family.

name: Pininyahang Manok
description: This dish combines the rich flavors of chicken with smoothness of the cream infused with the sweetness from the pineapples
tips: When using cream or coconut milk, be careful not to let the liquids boil as the cream may curdle if the heat is too high.

ingredients.item: red and green bell peppers, deseeded and cubed
all purpose cream or coconut cream (optional)

instructions: First, get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onions and garlic. Saute until tender.
Add the chicken and cook until the color changes.
Drop in the Knorr Chicken Cube with the patis, the pineapple chunks with juice/syrup and water last. Give this a nice simmer of 3 minutes.
Next, add the potatoes, carrots and bell peppers. And cook them until the chicken and vegetables are tender. You may add the sugar if you want the dish to be a bit sweeter.

Reduce the heat to low before pouring in the all purpose cream or coconut cream. Be careful not to let this boil as the cream may curdle if the heat is too high. Add the malunggay leaves at this point. Cook for 1-2 minutes over low heat and that's it! With a big serving of warm rice, prepare to eat more than usual.

name: Oxtail Kare-Kare Recipe with Creamy Peanut Sauce
description: Kare-kare is a Filipino dish many associate with fiestas and family celebrations. It instantly makes any gathering feel complete once it’s served on the table. But with this kare-kare recipe, you don’t have to wait for a special occasion; you can celebrate small wins by cooking it at home anytime.
instructions: Tenderize the Oxtail Place the oxtail and quartered onions in a large pot. Pour in enough water to cover the meat fully. Bring to a rolling boil over high heat, then lower to a gentle simmer. Skim off any impurities that rise to the surface. Cover and cook until the oxtail is fork-tender, about 60–75 minutes. Strain the oxtail and reserve broth for later use. Tip: The oxtail is ready when a fork slides in easily and the meat begins to pull away from the bone.

Make the Achuete Oil Heat canola oil and achuete seeds in a small pan over low heat. Cook gently for about 3 minutes, or until the oil turns deep orange. Strain and discard the seeds.
