Return the infused oil to the pan. Tip: Keep the heat low to prevent burning the seeds, which can give the oil a bitter taste.

Sauté the Aromatics In the same pan with achuete oil, sauté chopped onions and garlic over medium heat until fragrant and lightly softened. Add the cooked oxtail and stir for 2–3 minutes. Tip: Let the oxtail sear lightly for deeper flavor before moving to the sauce stage.

Develop the Peanut Sauce Add peanut butter, 1½ cups reserved broth, and Knorr Beef Cubes. Stir continuously until the peanut butter dissolves into the liquid and forms a smooth sauce. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened.

Cook the Vegetables Add eggplants and sitaw to the sauce. Cook until just tender. Add pechay Tagalog or bok choy last and simmer for 1–2 minutes, just until wilted. Tip: For brighter color and longer shelf life, blanch the vegetables separately and arrange them around the kare-kare before serving.
Adjust and Serve Taste and adjust seasoning if needed. Transfer to a serving bowl and serve hot with bagoong on the side.

name: Lumpia Shanghai
description: This Filipino classic recipe combines the rich taste of pork with the flavors of carrots, onions, singkamas enriched with Knorr Pork, deep fried until crisp.
tips: When frying these lumpia shanghai, make sure the oil is of the right temperature before dropping the rolls, to prevent the rolls from being soggy and to keep the wrapper golden brown and crispy.
instructions: Begin by combining the ground pork, garlic, onions, carrots and singkamas in a bowl. Mix well.

Crumble the Knorr Pork Cube and drop into the mixture. Or, you may opt to dissolve the Pork Cube with some hot water. Add sugar, pepper and egg next. Mix until all ingredients are well incorporated. Season with a few drops of Knorr Liquid Seasoning.

Wrap the pork mixture into lumpia wrappers, seal using warm water, and fry them in hot oil until golden brown. Serving Lumpia Shanghai with chili sauce or vinegar will definitely make your day. It's a comfort food on its own.

name: Classic Lasagna Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Classic Lasagna made extra special with Knorr Beef Cubes. Enjoy it with your family!
tips: A nice tip to keep the layers of your lasagna from falling apart is to let it sit on the counter for at least 15 minutes after baking to let the dish rest.

ingredients.item: grated quick-melt cheese or mozzarella cheese (combination of both may be used)

instructions: Begin by cooking the lasagna noodles according to package directions then set this aside.

To make the sauce, get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onions and garlic. Add the ground beef next and just cook until the color turns light brown.

Pour in the tomato sauce, Knorr Beef Cube and banana ketchup. Mix this well before adding the pepper, bay leaves and oregano. Now continue to simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the beef is tender and sauce has thickened.
To make the white sauce, get a small sauce pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Throw in the butter and melt. Stir in the flour and cook until it becomes pasty.
Slowly whisk in the milk into the pan and season with nutmeg. Continue to cook until slightly thickened into a gravy-like consistency. If sauce has thickened too much, add more milk or water.

Now here comes the exciting part. Layer the lasagna noodles in a rectangular baking dish. Pour the meat sauce over the pasta while alternating it with the white sauce. Sprinkle some grated cheese over the white sauce and that's it. Just repeat the layering until the noodles have been used up and the dish is full.
Pop this in the preheated oven, bake for 15-20 minutes or until cheese melts before you can devour this gorgeous piece of heaven in a dish.

name: Lechon Belly Roll Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Lechon Belly Roll. Made more delicious with Knorr Pork Cubes and Knorr Liquid Seasoning.
tips: Turbo Broiled, Over Grilled or Deep Fried

ingredients.item: lemon grass stalks (bulb/white ends portion), pounded
sugar and black pepper to taste

instructions: Every good dish starts with a fabulous marinade. Begin by rubbing rock salt on the skin side of the pork belly. Massage until the salt dissolves.

Next, get a bowl and combine the garlic, shallots, peppercorns and crumbled Knorr Pork Cubes. Rub this mixture onto the meat-side of the belly then spread the mixture out. Line the lemongrass on the middle portion of the belly and roll to enclose the garlic mixture and lemongrass. Secure belly with roasting/trussing tie.

Let's now prepare the belly for roasting. Pat the skin of the pork dry before putting into the turbo broiler, oven or griller. Cook over medium-low heat for an hour then raise the temp to high for another 30 to 40 minutes or until the skin is crispy. You may also deep fry the pork belly in hot oil. Start with a temperature of over medium-low heat for 20 minutes then increase the heat again until the skin is brown and crispy.

Make sure that when you slice the pork belly roll, it has rested for at least 5 -10 minutes, to prevent the juices from spilling out. Best serve with the Knorr Liquid Seasoning-Vinegar Dip and a side of Atcharang Labanos, and you will definitely eat more than usual.
Combine all ingredients. Let set for at least 4 hours or longer. Serve on the side.

name: Classic Beef Morcon
description: Beef is rolled and stuffed with different meats and vegetables and is served with a rich thick tomato based sauce and flavored with Knorr Beef Cubes.
tips: Before cutting into the meat, remember to let the meat rest after searing. Meat resting is needed by the meat so that the juices and flavors of the meat redistribute within the meat and not just flow away, making the final dish moist and tender.

ingredients.item: kilogram beef, cut into thin slices (like tapa)
whole pickles, cut into thick strips
carrot, peeled and slice into thick strips

instructions: A good dish starts with a flavorful marinade. First, you need to combine calamansi juice and Knorr Liquid Seasoning, and fully coat and marinate the beef. Set this aside in the chiller for about 15-20 minutes.

Next, separate the beef from the marinade by draining on a strainer. Make sure to set the mixture aside because this will be part of the sauce ingredients. Reserve the marinate for the sauce prep later.

Once done, we can now prepare the stuffing by laying the beef on a baking tray and arranging the hotdog, eggs, pickles, and carrots on top. Roll the beef and secure with a roasting string or trussing it with toothpicks to prevent the filling from spilling out.

Next, get a pan and make it nice and hot. Pour some oil and over high heat, sear the beef pieces on all sides. Make sure you do not overcrowd the pan to prevent the meat from steaming. Sear until you get a nice brown color. After, transfer the seared beef to a plate and set aside.
Using the same pan, throw in the onions and sauté until tender before adding the diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, water, Knorr Beef Cube and the reserved marinade. Stir and mix well.
Now, place the seared rolled beef into the sauce. Drop in the bay leaves then simmer beef over medium-low heat, covered, until tender.

Once the beef is tender, remove from the sauce and transfer on a plate. Adjust the seasoning of the sauce by adding sugar and pepper. Continue to simmer the sauce until desired consistency is achieved.

Before slicing the beef into 1/2 inch pieces, make sure you remove all roasting ties or toothpicks. Arrange the sliced beef on a plate, pour the sauce over and there you have it. Your Classic Beef Morcon. This dish is all about love and effort! With those lovely colors and fillings, you know for sure it's a fantastic dish!

name: Lechon Paksiw Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Lechon Paksiw made extra special with Knorr Pork Cubes. Enjoy it with your family!
tips: To reduce the sour vinegar taste from the sauce, remember to bring the sauce to a boil but keep the pan or pot uncovered so that the aroma and strong flavors of the vinegar evaporates.
instructions: Get a large pot, and make it nice and warm over medium-high heat. Add all of the ingredients into the pot and let it boil, then lower the heat to slowly simmer.
Let it simmer for 20-30 minutes or until the and flavors are well incorporated and the sauce thickens.And that's it!
Give yourself a break and serve one of the most delicious dishes to your family. Because Lechon Paksiw is love!

name: Easy Pinoy Salted Egg Prawns
description: Dive into this rich and fragrant Singaporean inspired, Salted Egg Prawns; deep fried and coated with butter, salted egg, curry leaves and Knorr Shrimp Cube.
tips: Tips of how to clean shrimp: Use a small knife or a pairing knife, and may a small cut at the back of the shrimp all the way down to the tail. Use the tip of the knife to remove the vein from the backside of the shrimp. Rinse the shrimp with clean water after removing the vein.

ingredients.item: prawns, peeled w/ tails intact, butterflied

instructions: Begin by flavoring the prawns with salt and pepper before dredging it in cornstarch. Now, get a saucepan ready and make it nice and hot over medium to medium high heat. Pour cooking oil in and when hot enough, deep fry the prawns. Cook until the color changes. Remove and drain the prawns and allow to sit in a plate lined with paper towels to drain off excess oil. Set this aside.
Get a sauté pan ready and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Melt the butter and throw in the garlic, curry or chili leaves and chilies. Cook until the leaves are crispy.
Drop in the Knorr Shrimp Cube. Stir to dissolve then add the mashed salted egg yolks. Stir again and blend well.

Return the fried prawns into the pan, toss until they are evenly coated with the sauce. And that's it! All you need is a big serving of rice because this restaurant quality food is now ready to be enjoyed by the whole family. It's simply delicious!

name: Hot and Sour Chicken Soup Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Hot and Sour Chicken Soup made with Knorr Chicken Cube. Serve this to your family for a heartwarming meal.
tips: When cooking this dish, remember that after adding the vinegar, do not cover the pan or stir the mix. Let the dish continue to simmer uncovered so that the metallic taste and aroma coming from the raw vinegar can evaporate.

ingredients.item: medium red onion, peeled and finely sliced
1 pc siling labuyo, very finely chopped
spring onions, washed and finely chopped

instructions: Get a pot and make it nice and hot. Pour some oil and throw in the onions and chili. Saute for 2 minutes.
Pour in the water and drop Knorr Chicken Cube. Stir to dissolve before adding the vinegar and soy sauce. Adjust the seasoning if needed. Just allow to simmer for a few minutes.
Break the sotanghon noodles and stir into the soup.

Divide sliced chicken between 4 bowls and ladle the soup over. Sprinkle chopped spring onions and this dish is done. You know you'll have a great week ahead when you serve Hot and Sour Chicken Soup to your family! It's divine!

name: Chicken and Rice Soup Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Chicken and Rice Soup made extra special with Knorr Chicken Cubes. Enjoy it with your family!
tips: Green peas are a good source of vitamins C and E, zinc, and other antioxidants that strengthen your immune system.

ingredients.item: red onion, peeled and finely sliced
of fresh cilantro (wansoy), leave spicked and roughly chopped

instructions: Get a medium pot and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onions. Sauté for 3 minutes.
Stir in the rice and Knorr Chicken Cube, before gradually pouring in the water. Stir well and allow to simmer for 8 minutes.
Stir in the diced chicken and continue to simmer for another 10 minutes. Add peas in the last 2 minutes.

Ladle soup into bowls then top with a spoonful of cream, a few slices of onions and chopped cilantro leaves. And that's a warm bowl of love right there ready to be enjoyed by the company of loved ones.

name: Asian Chicken Soup
description: This ideal comfort soup combines the flavorful Knorr Chicken broth with garlic and sili labuyo, mixed with egg noodles, chicken breast and spinach.
tips: Siling labuyo has been considered a medicinal herbal plant used to treat arthritis, rheumatism, dyspepsia, flatulence and toothache.

ingredients.item: cooked boneless chicken breast, thinly sliced

instructions: Begin by preparing a pot filled with water. Bring this to a boil before adding the Knorr Chicken Cube.
Add chopped garlic and chili then bring to a boil. Break the noodles and simmer for 5 minutes more or until cooked through.
Stir in the chicken and soy sauce and continue to simmer for another 3 minutes.
Place and divide spinach in each bowl and ladle soup over. Now, that's what I call- home!

name: Crispy Sisig Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Crispy Sisig made extra special with Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Enjoy it with your family today!
tips: You can also use Tofu cubes instead of using Pork Belly for your sisig, to make a healthier version of this crispy dish.

ingredients.item: chicken liver, cut into small cubes

instructions: Let's begin by getting a pot and filling it with water then add salt, onion wedges and the pork belly or lechon kawali. Cook until tender. Drain from the water and set aside on a plate or tray to cool and air-dry.
Get a shallow pan and make it nice and hot. Pour enough oil and deep fry tenderized pork until crisp and golden brown. Let cool and chop coarsely.
Using another pan, throw in the garlic and liver. Saute until fully cooked.

Off heat, toss in the onions, chopped crispy pork and green chillies. Season with more Knorr Liquid Seasoning, calamansi juice and pepper. And that's it! Prepare to eat more than usual for you will find yourself falling in love with the goodness of this Crispy Sisig!

name: Pinoy Shawarma
description: This dish has a dynamic range of different flavors, from the well seasoned a beef sirloin, combined with the garlic-yoghurt sauce, and the fresh vegetables.
tips: Do not overcrowd the contents of your wrap. Add just enough filling that you can still roll the wrap easily. It will also make it easier to eat the individual wraps. Remember to seal one end of the wrap so that the filling will not fall off while eating.

ingredients.item: medium flour tortillas or pita bread
ripe tomatoes, deseeded and sliced thinly
cucumber, peeled, deseeded and sliced into thin sticks
Optional: 1 pc singkamas, sliced into thin strips
thinly sliced cabbage or iceberg lettuce or red cabbage

instructions: There are 3 steps in making this dish. First, you need to combine all the beef ingredients in a bowl. Mix well and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Second, prepare the sauce by combining all the sauce ingredients. Mix well and with the use of a funnel, transfer the mixture into a squeeze bottle and chill until ready to use.

Let's start assembling the wraps. Get a grill pan or a flat frying pan and make it nice and hot over high heat. Drain the beef from the marinade and grill until cooked through. Do this in batches so the pan will not be overcrowded. Set aside to cool slightly.
Once the beef is slightly cooled, chop into bite-sized pieces.

The last step is to assemble the wraps.Heat tortilla or pita bread on a flat pan until slightly toasted. Transfer on a plate then put some of the filling in the middle part of the bread starting with the lettuce/cabbage, chopped beef, sliced tomatoes, onions, cucumber and singkamas, if using. Drizzle some sauce over and top with grated cheese. Roll and wrap in foil. Do the same with the rest of the ingredients dividing the fillings into the breads. And that's our dish! Over good conversations on the table, a game of chess or simply hanging out in the kitchen, Pinoy Shawarma is just so delightful to eat!

name: Pork Steak Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Pork Steak made special with Knorr Pork Cubes. Prepare a perfect healthy meal for your family.
tips: To avoid drying the pork chops, try getting pork chops with bone in. The bones can help the meat from overcooking while the fats can enhance the flavor and moisture of the meat while cooking.

ingredients.item: Optional: Serve with steamed or sauteed kale, spinach or broccoli rabe on the side

instructions: Every flavorful dish begins with a good marinade. Combine calamansi juice and soy sauce. Soak the pork chops in and allow to marinate for at least 10-15 minutes.

Get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the garlic. Sauté until slightly brown. Remove and drain the pork chops from the marinade then pan-fry. Add in the marinade liquid, water and Knorr Pork Cube. Just let this boil before reducing to a simmer. Season well with pepper and cook over low heat until the pork chops are tender.
Add onion rings until softened. And that's our dish! With a serving of rice, you know you will have a great day when you try Porksteak. A comfort dish on its own!

name: Sweet and Sour Fish Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Sweet and Sour Fish. This well loved Chinese dish has a balance of sweetness and tangy flavors.
tips: How to make sure that the fish doesn't stick to the pan: 1. Make sure that your pan is hot enough. Use only Medium - High heat when searing2. Pat dry your fish before searing. After cleaning the fish, you can use a paper towel to dry out the excess water from the fish.3. Let it cook on one side well before moving it. Don't try to move it in the pan until it already time to turn.

ingredients.item: white fish fillet or whole fish (Cream Dory, Maya-maya, Lapu-lapu, Tilapia, etc)
small pc red bell pepper, deseeded and cubed
small pc green bell pepper, deseeded and cubed
Optional: Serve with steamed Bok-Choi on the side

instructions: First, we need to prepare the fish then second, the sauce. Begin by giving the fish and nice seasoning of salt and pepper. If using enoki mushrooms, season mushrooms as well.

Next, prepare 2 bowls for the beaten egg and the other one is for the cornstarch. Dip the fish in the beaten egg then dredge in cornstarch. Prepare a shallow pot with oil and make it nice and hot over medium high heat. Fry the fish in hot oil until nicely browned. Remove and drain on top of a plate lined with paper towel. Set aside. Do this to the seasoned enoki mushrooms as well.
For the sauce, get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Add oil, and sauté garlic and shallots until brown and aromatic.

Toss in the cubed red and green bell pepper, add the banana ketchup, pineapple tidbits, Knorr Chicken Cube, white vinegar and sugar. And let it simmer for 5 mins. You can add the dissolved cornstarch to thicken the sauce. Continue to simmer until all ingredients are fully mixed together.
You can now top the sauce to your fried fish to enjoy this delicious and heart healthy Sweet and Sour Fish. Best served with steamed Bok-Choi on the side.

name: Bibimbap Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Bibimbap made special with Knorr Beef Cubes. Serve this healthy meal to your family today.
tips: Bibimbap is one of the most famous Korean traditional foods. The word bibimbap means stirred or mixed rice.

ingredients.item: beef sirloin, sukiyaki-cut beef or thinly sliced

instructions: This recipe may take some effort but we promise you that it will be worth it! There are 3 steps in preparing Bibimbap. First, you need to make a marinade. Next, prepare the sauce and lastly, prepare the topping.
Let's begin by combining all the marinade ingredients, including the beef, in a bowl. Blend them well and store in the chiller to flavor the meat.
Next, combine all the sauce ingredients and mix well. Set aside in the chiller.
Lastly, prepare the toppings by sauteeing each ingredient with a little oil. Season with some salt and pepper then set aside.
Now, get a skillet and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Throw in the beef and cook until meat is slightly brown. Set aside.

Prepare a nice big bowl and arrange the Bibimbap over. Start by scooping out rice and placing it at the center of the bowl. Top the rice with the cooked beef and the sautéed vegetables. Pour the Bibimbap sauce over and that's it! Our dish is done! Impress your guests or loved ones when you serve Bibimbap at home. The taste is as lovely as it looks!

name: Meatballs Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Meatballs made extra special with Knorr Pork Cubes. Enjoy it with your family!
tips: You can put the prepared meat balls in the chiller (ref) for at least 30 mins after forming into balls to firm up, this prevents the meatballs from breaking up during cooking.
instructions: Making this dish is simple and easy. All you need to do is combine the ground pork, onions, garlic, flour, egg, Knorr Pork Cube and carrots in a bowl. Mix well making sure the Knorr Pork Cube is evenly distributed.

Season well with ground pepper and continue to blend. Allow to chill in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes to an hour to allow the mixture to firm up a bit before forming them into 1-1/2 to 2 inch balls. You can freeze the meatballs for later use or you can immediately cook them after shaping.
Now, get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium low heat. Pour some oil. Drop the meatballs in the hot oil and cook until it floats on top and the color is golden brown.

Remove the cooked meatballs and place them on top of a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil. Meatballs, as a dish, is so versatile. You can have them as an appetizer, as a snack or served as a main dish with Sweet Chili Sauce on the side. You will find yourself eating more than usual. It's just so good!

name: Chicken Quesadilla
description: This Mexican dish uses the rich taste of chicken sautéed with garlic and bell peppers infused with Knorr Chicken flavors; wrapped in tortilla with cheese.
tips: Bell peppers are rich in many vitamins and antioxidants, especially vitamin C and various carotenoids.

ingredients.item: small piece red bell pepper, deseeded and sliced into thin strips
small piece green bell pepper, deseeded and sliced sliced into thin strips
chicken breast fillet, sliced into thin strips
grated melting cheese (mozarella, quick-melt cheese, etc)

instructions: To make Quesadilla, let's begin by making the filling first. Get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some olive oil and throw in the garlic, onions and bell peppers. Sauté the vegetables for 1-2 minutes only to maintain the crispness.
Add the chicken strips and Knorr Chicken Cube. Toss to mix and dissolve the Knorr Chicken Cube.
Give this a nice seasoning by throwing in the spices. Turn off the heat as soon as the chicken is fully cooked.

To assemble the Quesadilla: Place a tortilla on a plate and sprinkle some grated cheese over. Add some chicken mixture then sprinkle more cheese. Top with another piece of flour tortilla. And that's it!

All you need to do next is to toast on a dry pan over medium heat until the cheese melts and the tortilla is brown. Do the same with the rest of the ingredients and slice into wedges. See how you will amaze your family when you serve Chicken Quesadilla with sour cream and hot sauce on the side! Mexican food never tasted this good!

name: Kimbap
description: This simple dish uses the rich taste of beef sirloin, combined with carrots, cucumber and scrambled egg strips, wrapped in rice and nori sheets.
tips: Nori can actually contain up to 10 times more calcium than milk, and they packed full of vitamins and folic acid.

ingredients.item: carrot, sliced into thin strips, sauteed with some oil
cucumber, peeled deseeded and cut into thin strips
egg, cooked scrambled, sliced into strips
soy sauce and wasabi for dipping

instructions: Let's begin by preparing the beef. First, you need to mash the Knorr Beef Cube with brown sugar, garlic, ginger and soy sauce. Then, stir in the spring onions before placing the beef in and marinating it for at least 10 minutes.
Prepare a wide pan and make it nice and hot. Cook the marinated beef in, then set this aside to cool.

To assemble the Kimbap, prepare a bamboo mat on top of a clean towel. Place a piece of nori over it and measure about a cup of rice to go on top. Spread the rice to the edge except for the top part. Leave 1 inch unfilled on the top edge.
Next, place some cooked beef, carrots, cucumber and egg strips in the center of each roll.

Now, roll the bamboo mat, making sure to push down to seal and pull-back every time you roll. Slice those rolls into 1 inch pieces. Repeat until you used up all the ingredients. When you serve Kimbap with soy sauce and wasabi on the side, you will find yourself lost in the goodness of this dish.

name: Hainanese Chicken Tinola Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Hainanese Chicken Tinola leveled up with Knorr Chicken Cube. Give this recipe a try now!
tips: After cooking the meat, add liquids to the roasting pan to deglaze (process of releasing the stuck particles and oils from the pan) to release all the chicken flavor from the pan. The leftover particles in the pan will add full flavor and richness to the rice.

ingredients.item: minced fresh ginger, plus 1 (2 inch knob), pounded
whole head of garlic, sliced in half crosswise
green papaya, sliced into wedges and steamed

instructions: Let's start by marinating the chicken to get full flavor. Get ready to marinate the chicken by removing the excess fat from the cavity and neck part. Pat dry with paper towels before rubbing it with a mixture of 2 tablespoons canola oil, minced ginger, minced garlic and fish sauce. Transfer to a food grade plastic sheet or container and leave to marinate in the refrigerator for 4 hours or overnight.

A traditional Hainanese is cooked by plunging the chicken in a boiling and flavourful broth. One of the things that will make you look forward to eating and making this dish is the different way it is prepared. You start by preheating your oven to 180 degrees Celsius.

Place onion slices and pounded ginger in a large roasting tin then add the remaining 2 tablespoons canola oil. Using your hands, mix the vegetables well and place the chicken on top. Add the whole head of garlic and roast in the oven for 75 to 90 minutes, or until the juices run clear and the chicken is cooked through. When the chicken is done, remove from the roasting tin and set aside to rest, reserving the juices and other ingredients in the tin to make the rice.

Make the sauces: While the chicken is roasting, you can go ahead and prepare the sauces. For the ginger sauce, grate ginger and garlic through a fine grater over a small bowl. Toss in the green onion, canola oil, and a splash of sesame oil with a pinch of salt. And that’s it. Adjust the seasoning if necessary. Set this aside and make the next sauce.

To make the sweet soy sauce, just combine the soy sauce and brown sugar in a small pot. Cook over medium heat for 5 to 7 minutes until mixture becomes slightly thickened. Sauce will thicken more once cooled. Transfer to a bowl and set aside.

Make the rice: Hainanese is not complete without the rice. So, to make the rice, add the Knorr Chicken Cube and water to the reserved roasting tin with the onions, garlic, ginger and any roasting juices and bring to a boil. Don’t forget to scrape the bottom of the roasting tin with a wooden spoon to make sure you pick up all the tasty chicken roasting juices. Mash the onions and roasted garlic too for maximum flavour!

Once boiling, strain the liquid through a fine sieve into a saucepan and place over medium heat. Add the rice and bring back to a boil. Cover and simmer over low heat for 8 minutes. After the 8th minute mark has passed, the liquid should have been nearly absorbed by the rice. Turn off the heat and cover with a tea towel and the saucepan lid. Set aside for 10 minutes to steam.

To serve: Here’s how you can enjoy a tasty Hainanese Chicken Tinola in style. Carve the chicken into pieces and place on a serving plate with a scoop of rice. Add the green papaya wedges and sprinkle over some cilantro leaves. Serve with ginger sauce, sweet soy sauce and chili sauce on the side. Well, if that will not make your heart palpitate, I don’t know what else will.

name: Monggo Patties with Lechon Sauce Vinegar Sauce and Aioli
description: This simple dish uses the fresh and healthy flavors of monggo served with three savory dips; garlic-lechon dip, vtnagy vinegar and aioli mayo dip.
tips: When boiling the monggo beans, make sure to remove the froth and beans floating on top to keep the dish clear of impurities and dirt.

ingredients.item: finely sliced tomato & red onion (sprinkled with pinch of salt)

instructions: Let's start by making the patties. To make the patties, you need to make the monggo seeds tender by washing them in water first to get rid of the unwanted dirt, then soak them in cold water to soften. Now, leave this for about 2 hours before boiling in 1 liter of water with 1 piece Knorr Pork Cube. Simmer over low heat for 1 hour or until the beans are tender.
When the beans are tender, drain them well and transfer to a food processor along with the onion, garlic, ketchup, rice flour, sugar, salt, pepper, and 1 egg. Mix until evenly chopped and combined.
Form the mixture into balls first then flatten to 2” wide patties. Place on a lined plate or baking tray and cover with plastic wrap. Store in the chiller for 30 minutes to set.

Get a small bowl and toss in the remaining eggs and beat. Prepare 2 more containers containing the flour and the breadcrumbs. Dust the patties with the flour first, dip in the beaten egg then coat with the breadcrumbs. Repeat until all the patties have been coated. Store them in a lined plate or baking tray in the chiller for another 30 minutes.

Get ready to fry by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour about ¼ inch high of cooking oil and add the patties a few at a time and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Remove the patties and drain on plate lined with paper towels.

Now, let's make the sauces: Monggo patties in itself is already delicious. How much more if you serve 3 types of sauces that will go well with it? Here’s how to make the first sauce, a Lechon sauce at that!
First, you need to preheat your oven to 180 degrees Celsius and place the chicken livers on a tray. Roast them for 15 minutes, then remove and allow to cool.
Get a saucepan hot over medium heat and throw in the onions. Fry them for 5 minutes or until translucent. Add the garlic next with the chicken livers and continue to fry for 3 minutes.

Pour the water into the pan and bring to a boil. Transfer to a blender or food processor and start pureeing until the mixture is smooth. Return the mixture into the saucepan and add the remaining ingredients. With the use of a hand whisk, combine everything. Bring the sauce to a boil then remove from heat.
Next, let's work on the vinegar sauce. All you need to do is just mix all the ingredients together in a small bowl and set aside. And that’s it!

Lastly, here’s a dip made with garlic, egg and oil. We call this aioli dip. You just need to chop and mash the garlic cloves and form them into a paste. Transfer the garlic paste to a small bowl and just stir in the remaining ingredients. Aioli dip is best served cold so make sure to store first in the chiller just before serving.

name: Kimchi Sinigang Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Kimchi Sinigang made special with Knorr Sinigang Mix. Prepare a perfect healthy meal for your family.
tips: Remember to remove the scum from the surface of the water every now and then, to ensure your soup will be nice and clear. This process is called skimming.

ingredients.item: (22g) pack Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original or Sinigang na may Gabi Mix
gabi (taro root), peeled and cut into large cubes
(100g) kangkong, leaves picked and soft stems cut intto 2-inch pieces

instructions: Fill a medium saucepan with 4 cups water and bring it to a boil over medium high heat. Add the Knorr Sinigang Mix and stir to combine. Lower the heat to simmer then add the pork belly, simmer while covered for 1 1/2 to 2 hours over low heat. Cook until the pork belly is tender but not falling apart. Remember to skim the top of the liquid to remove the scum and impurities that rise up. Remove the pork from the soup and pat dry to prepare for frying.

Get a medium saucepan nice and hot over medium-high heat. Pour oil until it reaches 5 centimeters up the sides. Gently add the pork belly and fry until golden brown and crisp. Remove the meat and place on a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil. Allow this to cool before chopping them into squares. Set this aside.
Meanwhile, strain the soup by using a fine mesh sieve and place the liquid into a clean saucepan or bowl. Add enough water so that it equals 4 cups again. Set this aside.

Get a large saucepan and heat 2 tablespoons of canola oil over medium heat. Throw in the onions and kimchi and cook for five minutes, stirring constantly. Carefully add the soup and gabi (taro root) to the kimchi and bring to a boil. Simmer for 15-20 minutes or until gabi is tender. You may mash half of the gabi to make the soup thicker.
Add the tomatoes and kangkong stalks, lower the heat, and simmer for 3 minutes more. Remove from heat and stir in the kangkong leaves.

Divide the soup into four bowls and top them each with a serving of pork and tofu. With a garnish of green onions, this dish is ready to be enjoyed and devoured. Make sure you have your loved ones beside you to catch you for you will be blown away by the goodness of this dish.

name: Green Laksa
description: This soup dish uses the fresh garden flavors of ginger, turmeric, and lemongrass combined with the creamy taste of Knorr Ginataang Mix, tossed in rice noodles.
tips: When cooking with coconut milk (gata), make sure that you don't let the soup to boil for a long time after adding the coconut milk, or else it might curdle and breakup during cooking.

ingredients.item: fresh ginger, peeled and roughly chopped
green bird’s eye chilis, stalks removed
coriander stalks, leaves reserved for garnish
fresh firm tofu, chopped into 2-centimeter squares

instructions: In order to make this delicious dish, we first begin by making a paste made with chilli, shallots, garlic, ginger, coriander stalk, lemongrass and fresh turmeric. Chop them first into pieces and pound them altogether with a mortar and pestle. Make sure it becomes paste-like in consistency before adding the coriander and cumin.
Next, get large saucepan and get it nice and hot over medium low heat. Add the vegetable oil and cook the spice paste for 10 minutes.

Pour the Knorr Ginataang Gulay to the boiling water and whisk with a fork to combine. Carefully pour mixture into the saucepan with the spice paste and add the kesum leaf branches. Over high heat, bring the laksa to a boil and then turn down the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.

Meanwhile, soften the vermicelli noodles by boiling some water, turn it off, then soak the noodles in for 3 minutes uncovered. Drain and divide the noodles between 4 serving bowls. Top each bowl with a handful of bean sprouts.

Add the prawns, fish balls and tofu to the laksa and cook for five more minutes. Ladle the soup into the serving bowls and sprinkle some fresh coriander leaves on top. With a light drizzle of lime on top, your Laksa is done! Give yourself a reward for this dish is fit for a king!

name: Classic Macaroni Salad Recipe With Chicken and Pineapple
description: Filipino celebrations are never complete without classic macaroni salad on the table. This fiesta-style version brings together macaroni, tender chicken, pineapple tidbits, and cheese in a rich, creamy dressing with that signature sweet touch. Follow this guide to learn how to make macaroni salad that tastes just as festive any time of the year.

ingredients.item: pineapple tidbits (drained and sliced with juice reserved)

instructions: Cook the Macaroni Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil. Add the macaroni and cook until tender but still slightly firm to the bite. Drain well. Tip: Transfer drained pasta to a bowl and cover. Dry pasta will lead to an oily salad.

Combine the Mix-Ins In a large mixing bowl, combine chicken, pineapple tidbits, cheese, and macaroni. Add carrots, onions, and pickle relish. Toss gently until evenly distributed. Tip: Use firm cheese like cheddar or processed cheese cubes. They hold their shape and add a creamy, slightly salty contrast to the sweet elements.

Prepare the Dressing Combine Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise with sugar, salt, and pepper. Mix well until seasonings are fully dissolved. Add mixture to the bowl with macaroni and fold gently until all ingredients are evenly coated. Scrape from the bottom of the bowl and lift the mixture over itself to combine without crushing the pasta. Tip: Fold using a spatula instead of stirring aggressively. This keeps the macaroni intact and prevents the salad from becoming dense.
Season and Chill Cover salad and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving to allow the flavors to develop fully.

name: Asian Grilled Chicken Sandwich
description: Grilled chicken, Asian seasonings and Lady’s Choice Chicken Spread. The perfect ingredients for a sandwich that will have them eating every last crumb.

ingredients.item: baguette, sliced into half lengthwise, toasted

instructions: Mix together sweet soy sauce and sesame oil.
Season chicken breast fillets with salt and pepper. Grill each piece while basting with the sweet soy sauce and sesame oil mixture.
Spread Lady's Choice Chicken Spread on one side of each bread.
Assemble lettuce, tomatoes, and grilled chicken on top of one bread then cover with the other.

name: Spiced Ham and Feta Sandwich
description: Lady’s Choice Ham Spread transforms an everyday ham and cheese sandwich into a great-tasting afternoon snack.

ingredients.item: focaccia, sliced into half lengthwise, toasted

instructions: Spread Lady's Choice Ham Spread on one side of each piece.
Arrange lolo rosso, spiced ham, tomato and feta cheese on one piece of bread then cover with the other.

name: Grilled Vegetables Sandwich
description: Who says veggies are boring? With Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise and some BBQ sauce, this grilled veggie sandwich gets pretty exciting.
instructions: Infuse herbs in olive oil by placing the mixture in a pot over low heat until aroma of the herbs can begins to smell. Put off the heat.
Season the vegetables with salt and pepper. Brush all sides with the infused oil then grill over high heat for less than a minute.
In a bowl, combine barbecue sauce, honey and Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise.
Spread the mayo mixture on one side of each piece of bread. Arrange greens on one piece, top with the grilled vegetables, and cover with the other piece of bread.

name: Creamy Adobong Baboy Recipe
description: This rich, creamy Pork Adobo with Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise will have everyone making a dash for the table. Just don’t forget to give Lola a head start!

ingredients.item: Lady's Choice mayonnaise to thicken sauce

instructions: Marinate pork in vinegar, soy sauce, 5 cloves of garlic, dahon ng laurel and ground pepper for at least 30 minutes or overnight.
Put marinated pork in a saucepan. Add ½ cup water. Bring to a boil without stirring. Simmer until meat becomes tender  (around 30-40 minutes). Separate meat from sauce.
In a separate frying pan, fry the pork until brown.
In the saucepan, sauté the remaining 5 cloves of garlic until golden brown. Add the browned pork and slowly add the sauce where meat was cooked.
Add 2 Tbsp of  Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise, mix and let simmer until the mayonnaise is dissolved.

name: Breakfast Sandwich
description: Prepare this quick and easy sandwich recipe for an American breakfast! Bacon, eggs and Lady’s Choice Bacon Spread make it a delightful on-the-road meal.
instructions: Spread Lady's Choice Bacon Spread on bread.
Top this with bacon and egg and cover with the other slice

name: Kiddie Chicken Nuggets Sandwich
description: Chicken Nuggets topped with Lady's Choice Chicken Spread makes for a great sandwich that is both fun and tasty.
instructions: Fry chicken nuggets until golden brown.
Spread Lady's Choice Chicken Spread on bread and assemble chicken nuggets and greens between 2 slices.

name: Easiest Chicken Mushroom Casserole Recipe on the Internet
description: Make this easy peasy chicken and mushroom casserole in just one hour using budget-friendly pantry staples.
tips: For a deeper flavor, use rehydrated dried mushrooms in place of the canned mushroom.

ingredients.item: to 10 pcs chicken thigh fillet (or 3/4 kilo chicken), cut into serving-size pieces

instructions: In a pan, melt butter and sauté garlic until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook until browned.
Add all-purpose cream and water into the pan. Cover and bring the sauce into a boil. Then lower heat and uncover. Let chicken and mushroom casserole simmer for 10 minutes.
Add mushrooms.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Finish off the chicken and mushroom casserole with Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise. Let simmer for 2 minutes.
Serve warm.

name: Chicken in Sweet Mayo
description: Tender chicken, condensed milk and Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise make for a sweet, savoury and totally satisfying dish.

ingredients.item: chicken breast fillets, cut into 8 slices
cornstarch (seasoned lightly with salt and pepper)

instructions: Season chicken with ¼ tsp salt and ¼ tsp ground pepper. Coat seasoned chicken with ¼ cup of Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise.
Roll chicken in lightly seasoned cornstarch, mix well and pan fry. Remove chicken from pan.
Blanch broccoli florets and carrots in boiling water for about 3 minutes. Remove and drain.
In the meantime, combine condensed milk and 5 Tbsp of Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise together. Mix very well. Add ¼ cup of water to thin the mixture.
In a frying pan, pour Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise and condensed milk mixture. Let boil quickly.
Put broccoli, carrots, chicken and cashew nuts into the pan. Turn off heat. Stir to mix well.

name: Fried Chicken Wings
description: Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise transforms regular chicken wings into delicious snack treat. Sneak some for yourself before serving them to guests!
tips: Best served with Mayo Garlic Dip!
instructions: Rub chicken wings with 1 tsp salt. Set aside.
Mix 1 cup of Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise with juice of 1 calamansi and add ¼ tsp salt and ¼ tsp ground pepper to taste.
In another dish, mix 2 cups of flour with ½ tsp salt and ½ tsp ground pepper.
Dip chicken wings in seasoned Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise then coat in seasoned flour.
Deep fry until golden brown.

name: Lapu-lapu Con Mayonesa
description: Make it fun. Make it festive. Make it a creative family feast full of taste and color with Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise!
instructions: Lightly season Lapu-Lapu with salt and pepper. Put 2 cuts on both sides of the Lapu-Lapu.
Steam Lapu-Lapu until cooked (approximately 25 minutes). Set aside at room temperature to cool down. Then, keep in a chiller for an hour.
Remove skin.
Mix 2 cups of Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise with salt and pepper. Spread on top of the fish.
Garnish fish alternately with red bell pepper, sweet pickle relish, eggs, celery and carrot. This dish is a feast not just for the palate but for the eyes as well.

name: Crispy Fried Pork Chop Recipe For Speedy Eating
description: Follow this easy crispy fried pork chop recipe for a delicious little fix.
tips: Best served with Mayo Garlic Dip!
instructions: Rub pork chops with 1 tsp salt. Set aside.
Mix the Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise with calamansi juice. Add salt and ground pepper to taste.
In another dish, mix the flour with salt and ground pepper.
Dip pork chops in the seasoned Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise then coat in the seasoned flour.
Deep fry the pork chops until golden brown.

name: Fried Tilapia
description: This fried tilapia recipe creates a pritong isda dish that even picky kids can’t resist. Make it extra irresistible with Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise.
tips: Best served with Mayo Garlic Dip!
instructions: Rub tilapia with 1 tsp salt. Set aside.
Mix 1 cup of Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise with juice of 1 calamansi and add ¼ tsp salt and ¼ tsp ground pepper to taste.
In another dish, mix 2 cups of flour with ½ tsp salt and ½ tsp ground pepper.
Dip tilapia in seasoned Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise then coat in seasoned flour.
Deep fry until golden brown.

name: Creamy Ginataang Gulay
description: Find out how to cook ginataang gulay with simple ingredients like kalabasa, sitaw and Lady's Choice Mayonnaise. Try this creamy recipe that kids will love.
instructions: Sauté the garlic and onion then add bagoong. Let simmer until oil comes out on the sides. Next, add the pork and fry.
Add the squash, stir and cook for 3 minutes. Then, add the okra and cook for 2 minutes. Next, put the sitaw, stir and cook for 3 minutes. Add water and gata and cook until vegetables are done.
Put 2 Tbsp of Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise. Mix well until the sauce becomes creamy. Taste and adjust seasonings. Allow flavours to settle and serve.

name: Lumpiang Shanghai
description: Just how good are crispy lumpiang shanghai rolls made with Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise? Check this recipe and those eager, excited faces should tell you!
tips: Best served with Sweet & Sour Sauce!
instructions: Combine ground pork, singkamas, carrots, green onions   and celery in a medium bowl. Then, add oyster sauce, salt   and pepper, sesame oil and 3 Tbsp of Lady’s Choice  Mayonnaise; mix well.
Spoon about 1 tablespoon of the mixture into each lumpia   wrapper. Roll tightly. Seal ends of the wrapper with water.
Deep fry until golden brown. Serve hot.

name: Spicy Seafood Mestiza
description: Everyone loves seafood and they’ll love it even more with this combination of squid, mushrooms and Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise
tips: You may also use 1 kilo of any white fish fillet or combine a half-kilo of squid with a half-kilo of clams for this recipe.

ingredients.item: siling pangsigang (green finger chillies), sliced diagonally
big can tinned whole button mushrooms
green bell pepper, cut into triangles

instructions: Clean squid, remove skin and ink, then slice into thick rings.
Using 2 Tbsp butter and 1 Tbsp cooking oil, fry garlic until golden brown, remove and set aside for garnishing.
Next, add the remaining 2 Tbsp butter and 1 Tbsp cooking oil to the pan and sauté the white onion. Then, add the siling pangsigang.
Add the halved button mushrooms.
Next, add the squid and cook for 10 minutes.
Add sesame oil and one chicken cube. Let it simmer.
Then, add the ½ cup of Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise for a more savoury and creamier taste. Add the green bell pepper and simmer for 2 minutes.

name: Peppered Pork Sandwich
description: Turn an ordinary day into a gourmet occasion. Check out this recipe for tender pork strips, crispy bell peppers, and savory Lady's Choice Ham Spread.
instructions: Saute bell peppers and pork strips until cooked and season according to taste.
Spread Lady's Choice Ham spread on bread and arrange greens and sauteed pork and pepper in between 2 slices.

name: Speedy Beef Sandwich
description: Beefy goodness in a lunch box! Kids will love this corned beef and Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise sandwich, perfect for lunch or as an after school snack.
instructions: Saute white onions and corned beef for 2 minutes.
Spread Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise on bread and assemble  the corned beef and lolo rosso in between 2 slices.

name: Tuna, Corn, Mushroom Sandwich
description: Talking with their mouths full? Not with this delectable sandwich. Crunchy corn, tuna, mushrooms and Lady’s Choice Tuna Spread will keep them busy eating.
instructions: In a bowl, combine tuna flakes, corn, mushroom, and Lady's Choice Tuna Spread. Mix well.
Arrange the mixture and greens in between the 2 slices of bread.

name: Asian Salad With Summer Vegetables in Sesame Mayo Dressing
description: This Asian salad brings together colorful vegetables and al dente macaroni in a creamy dressing with nutty sesame notes. Light yet satisfying, it’s a refreshing side dish you can assemble using pantry staples and leftover produce. Ideal for value seekers and smart pantry scavengers, it turns everyday ingredients into a vibrant, Asian-inspired go-to for quick, fuss-free meals.
instructions: Prepare the Sesame Mayo Dressing Combine Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, onion, garlic, and sesame oil in a large bowl. Whisk until smooth and evenly blended, with no streaks of oil remaining.

Coat the Macaroni Add the cooked salad macaroni to the bowl. Gently fold until every piece is coated with the dressing. Tip: Use a spatula and fold from the bottom up to prevent breaking the pasta and turning it mushy.

Add the Fresh Mix-Ins Add ham, tomatoes, cucumber, corn kernels, basil, and granola, if using. Fold gently until well distributed. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve immediately or chill briefly.

name: Seafood Casserole
description: Seafood goodness topped with scrambled eggs and Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise for a rich and creamy end dish that you can serve over lunch or dinner.

ingredients.item: Knorr Ginataang Gulay Complete Recipe Mix, prepared according to pack directions

instructions: Prepare scrambulicious egg by combining egg and Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise. Mix well until smooth and cook over low to medium heat until set. Set aside.
Saute onion, garlic, and ginger in oil. Add shrimp and squid and sauté until half cooked. Add fish and vegetables and mix well.

Add Knorr Ginataang Gulay Complete Recipe Mix and oregano, bring to a boil then reduce heat to simmer until seafood and vegetables are fully cooked. Over low heat, add Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise and cream. Season and adjust according to taste and consistency using slurry (cornstarch diluted in water) if preferred.
Transfer to a deep dish then top with scrambulicious egg and cheese. Bake in a 350F oven until browned on top.

name: Caesar Salad
description: Prepare a Caesar Salad with ease thanks to Lady's Choice Caesar Salad Dressing. Add a Filipino twist to the usual salad recipe.
instructions: In a bowl, toss romaine lettuce with Lady’s Choice Caesar Dressing and arrange on plate.
Top with egg, bacon, parmesan cheese, and croutons.

name: Grilled Chicken Inasal Sandwich
description: Enjoy all the flavor and goodness of Chicken Inasal on a bun with this recipe that's made even more special by Lady's Choice Chicken Spread.

ingredients.item: cooked chicken inasal, deboned and shredded

instructions: For the Chicken Inasal: You can use your leftover or make your own by marinating chicken in achuete oil, chopped ginger, lemongrass, garlic, and seasonings, and grilling it.
Spread Lady’s Choice Chicken Spread on tortilla wrapper. Assemble by placing tomatoes, onion, and cucumber on tortilla wrapper. Add shredded chicken then toast on a griddle or pan.

name: Curried Chicken Sandwich
description: Try our Curried Chicken Sandwich recipe with Lady's Choice Chicken Spread and treat yourself to a tasty sandwich wrap on the go.
instructions: Marinated chicken breast in curry powder, cumin and yogurt then season well. Pan-fry or grill until cooked then cut into small cubes.

Spread Lady’s Choice Chicken Spread on tortilla wrapper. Fill the bottom half of the wrapper with lolo rosso, chicken, tomatoes, and cucumber then fold the top half to cover. Toast on a d griddle or pan until lightly browned.

name: Spicy Buffalo Chicken Sandwich
description: Everyone's favorite spicy chicken recipe is now on a bun. Try this spicy chicken sandwich recipe with Lady's Choice Chicken spread and relish with your family

ingredients.item: chicken breast fillet (seasoned and dipped in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs)
burger bun, toasted and sliced lengthways

instructions: Deep-fry the breaded chicken fillet until crisp then toss with mixed melted butter, tabasco and sesame oil.
Spread Lady’s Choice Chicken Spread on bun then fill with lolo rosso, spicy buffalo chicken and cucumber.

name: Honey Lime Chicken Sandwich
description: Sweet with a kick of lemon. That's our Honey Lime Chicken recipe that's made with Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise.
instructions: Marinate chicken in lime juice, honey, and rosemary and season well. Pan-fry until cooked and slice into strips.
Spread Lady’s Choice Chicken Spread on ciabatta then fill with lolo rosso, mango, cucumber and chicken strips.

name: Crispy Chicken Sandwich
description: Prep this crispy chicken fillet sandwich for snacking or picnics. It's a simple recipe you can make extra special with creamy Lady's Choice Chicken Spread.

ingredients.item: As needed oil for deep frying

instructions: Dredge chicken fillet in flour, egg, then in breadcrumbs. Deep-fry until brown.
Spread Lady’s Choice Chicken spread on ciabatta. Then arrange lolo rosso, plum tomatoes, chicken fillet and cucumber on one slice of bread and cover with the other.

name: Grilled Fish and Dill Sandwich
description: Try this healthy snack that's both quick and easy to prepare and delivers a distinct taste that will surely make your kids asking for more!
instructions: Rub lemon juice and dill on well-seasoned fish fillet. Grill until cooked.
Spread Lady’s Choice Tuna Spread on foccacia slice, add fish, tomatoes and arugula, and cover with the other slice of bread.

name: Classic Fish Fillet Sandwich
description: Give your snacks a healthy twist with our fish fillet sandwich that's low on fat, rich in nutrients. Made even tastier with Lady's Choice Tuna Spread.

ingredients.item: fish fillet (cream dory, snapper, or tilapia), cleaned and seasoned
As needed oil for deep frying

instructions: Dredge fish in flour, shake, dip in egg, then coat with breadcrumbs. Deep-fry until crisp.
Spread Lady’s Choice Tuna Spread on bread slices. Fill with lettuce and fish fillet.

name: Shrimp Scampi Sandwich
description: Enjoy our special seafood in a bun sandwich recipe that's full of flavor surprises that can leave you going back for more.

ingredients.item: foccacia bread, toasted and sliced lengthways

instructions: Saute garlic in oil/butter. Add shrimp and sauté until cooked. Add lemon juice, parsley, and chili flakes.
Spread Lady’s Choice Tuna Spread on bread. Lay lettuce and fill with sautéed shrimp.

name: Try This Easy California Maki Sandwich Recipe
description: Craving for sushi? Follow our easy California Maki sandwich, made with mangoes and Lady’s Choice Tuna Spread.
tips: Add a teaspoon of light soy sauce and a pinch of wasabi to the sandwich spread for extra zing.
instructions: Spread Lady’s Choice Tuna Spread on bread evenly.
Top with iceberg lettuce, crabsticks, mangoes, cucumber, avocado and sprinkle with chopped nori.
Cover with the other slice of bread.

name: Banh Mi
description: Create authentic and filling Vietnamese banh mi sandwiches with this easy-to-follow recipe made extra yummy with Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise.

ingredients.item: baguette (6 inches in length, cut into half lengthwise), toasted
pickled carrots, sliced into thin strips
ground pork, sautéed in onion and garlic, seasoned to taste (you may also use fried tofu as substitute)
choice of ham, salami, bologna, or cooked chicken breast

instructions: Spread Lady’s Choice Ham Spread on baguette evenly. Layer each ingredient on top of the baguette.

name: Pulled Pork Sandwich
description: Classic sandwich ingredients prepared with a twist using Lady's Choice Bacon Spread. Give new life to your family's snack time.

ingredients.item: burger bun, sliced into half, toasted

instructions: Shred prepared pork barbecue (you may use your leftover). Mix together Lady’s Choice Bacon Spread and barbecue sauce.
Arrange the shredded pork barbecue on the first half of the bun. Top with pickles, tomatoes, and cucumber then cover with the other half of the bun.

name: Asian Tofu Sandwich
description: Eat without the guilt with our healthy Asian Ham and Tofu Sandwich that's made even tastier by Lady's Choice Ham Spread.

ingredients.item: mantou (Chinese steamed bun), toasted and sliced into half
block firm tofu, sliced lengthways into four equal parts and fried until crisp

instructions: Combine Lady’s Choice Bacon Spread and sesame oil in a bowl and mix well.
Spread mixture on mantou slice evenly then arrange tofu, tomatoes, cucumber, and alfalfa sprouts on top. Cover with the other half of bun. Repeat with the rest of the buns.

name: Tonkatsu Sandwich
description: Are your kids tired of your basic baon ideas? Surprise them with crunchy tonkatsu sandwiches. Add Lady's Choice Bacon Spread for extra flavor.

ingredients.item: as needed oil for deep frying

instructions: Dredge seasoned pork loin in flour. Shake off excess then dip in egg then coat with breadcrumbs evenly. Deep-fry until crisp.
In a bowl, mix together Lady’s Choice Bacon Spread, Worcestershire sauce, sesame oil, and sesame seeds.
Spread the mayo mixture on the 2 slices of bread. Place tonkatsu on one slice (mayonnaise-side up), top with cabbage and the other slice of bread.

name: Chicken Florentine
description: Try our restaurant style Chicken Florentine recipe that's made creamier and tastier with Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise.

ingredients.item: bunches spinach, removed from stem and chopped

instructions: Season chicken breast fillet then dredge in flour. Shake off excess flour and pan-fry until browned and cooked through.

Saute onion and garlic in oil. Over low heat, add cream and Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise. Mix well and let this simmer until thick. Add back the chicken. Add parsley and spinach and simmer for a minute. Season the sauce according to taste.
To serve, arrange spinach on a plate, top with sliced chicken then pour the sauce over.

name: Chicken Divan
description: Looking for a Chicken dish to serve on a weekend? Try our Chicken Divan recipe with Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise. Chicken and Brocolli goodness in one dish!

ingredients.item: kilogram chicken breast fillet, cut into cubes
Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup, prepared accdg. to pack directions

instructions: Saute onion and garlic in oil. Add chicken, mushroom, and broccoli and sauté until cooked. Add Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup and bring to boil then reduce heat to simmer.

Add Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, lemon juice, curry powder, and ½ cup of cheddar cheese. Stir until melted then season well according to taste and adjust consistency of the sauce with slurry (cornstarch diluted in cold water) if preferred.
Transfer to a deep dish then top with the remaining cheese. Bake in a 350F oven until browned on top.

name: Lady's Choice Bangus Sisig
description: Looking for a fish sisig recipe? Try this milkfish recipe with Lady's Choice Mayonnaise and discover how to make your sisig extra luscious in a snap.

ingredients.item: bangus fillet, cut into small cubes
as needed bird's eye chilli, sliced

instructions: In pan, sauté onion and ginger. Add fish and sauté until cooked. Add chilies and season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning according to taste.
Off the heat, add Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise and mix well. Top with spring onions then serve hot with calamansi.

name: Lady's Choice Pork Sisig
description: Learn how to cook sizzling pork sisig. Elevate this favorite Filipino dish with Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise. Try this easy-to-prepare recipe now.

ingredients.item: pig's mask or pork belly (trim excess fat if preferred), boiled in water with black peppercorns, bay leaf, onion and garlic until tender, drained
as needed fish sauce and black pepper
as needed bird's eye chilli, sliced

instructions: Season boiled meats then grill or cook in a 375F oven until crispy. Chop into small cubes.
In pan, sauté onion and ginger. Add chicken liver and sauté until cooked. Add the chopped meats, and chilies. Season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning according to taste.
Off the heat, add Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise and mix well. Serve hot with calamansi.

name: Tempura Salad With Wasabi-Mayo Dressing
description: Try our signature tempura salad that's topped with wasabi and Lady's Choice Mayonnaise for that rich and creamy taste.

ingredients.item: tempura batter mix (showa), prepared accdg. to pack directions
head iceberg or romaine lettuce, cut into bite-sized pieces
black and white sesame seeds, toasted

instructions: Pre-heat oil for deep-frying. Dip prawns in chilled tempura batter and deep-fry until crisp.
Combine wasabi powder, water, and vinegar in bowl. Mix well. Add Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise and sesame oil, season according to taste, and mix well.
Toss vegetables with the prepared dressing. Arrange on plate then top with the tempura and sesame seeds. You may drizzle additional dressing if preferred.

name: Classic Coleslaw
description: Take coleslaw from side dish to star with this recipe featuring Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise. Pair this recipe with fried chicken, tacos, and more.
instructions: Combine Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, lemon juice, and seasonings in a bowl.
Add cabbage, carrots, onion. Mix well. Chill before serving.

name: Roast Vegetable Salad
description: The perfect salad recipe for those who avoid eating fresh vegetables. Roasted but healthy and served better with Lady’s Choice Garlic Ranch Dressing!

ingredients.item: lollo rosso lettuce, cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Marinate eggplant, tomatoes, and zucchini in olive oil, basil, thyme, and oregano for at least 10 minutes then roast in a 375F oven just until cooked.
Toss all ingredients with Lady’s Choice Garlic Ranch Dressing, arrange on plate and top with feta cheese.

name: Resto-Inspired Mango and Kani Salad Recipe With Japanese-Style Mayonnaise
description: This kani salad recipe recreates the creamy, refreshing side dish often served in Japanese restaurants. Shredded kani (imitation crab), sweet ripe mangoes, and crisp vegetables come together in a rich umami-filled Japanese-style dressing. Follow this guide to bring that restaurant-style mango kani salad straight to your table.

ingredients.item: heads iceberg lettuce (cut into bite-sized pieces)
wonton wrapper, cut into strips and deep-fried

instructions: Toss the Salad Base In a large mixing bowl, combine lettuce, cabbage, mangoes, crabsticks, and cucumber. Toss to combine. Tip: Pat the lettuce completely dry before mixing to prevent a watery dressing. Toss gently to keep the mango cubes intact.
Add Dressing Drizzle Lady’s Choice Japanese-Style Mayonnaise over the mixture. Toss gently until all ingredients are evenly coated.

Add the Toppings Transfer salad to a serving platter or individual bowls. Top with nori strips, tobiko, and crispy fried wonton wrappers. Serve immediately. Tip: Tobiko is flying fish roe. It adds a subtle briny flavor and a delicate popping texture that balances the sweetness of the mango and the creaminess of the dressing.

name: Cobb Salad
description: A classic cobb salad recipe contains romaine lettuce, cherry tomatoes, bacon strips, and eggs. Amp the classic with Lady's Choice Garlic Ranch Dressing.

ingredients.item: heads romaine lettuce, cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.
Serve topped with bacon and gorgonzola cheese.

name: Chef's Salad
description: Improve a chef's salad recipe with Lady's Choice Thousand Island Dressing. Learn why its combo of greens, egg, and meat could be your healthiest meal yet.

ingredients.item: head iceberg lettuce, lollo rosso, or romaine, cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Toss greens with Lady’s Choice Thousand Island Dressing enough to coat. Arrange on a plate.
Top with the rest of the ingredients and serve chilled.

name: Seared Tuna and Vegetable Salad With Sweet Soy-Sesame Dressing
description: Our best tuna salad yet that you can easily prepare on your own. Add Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise and enjoy a healthy treat!

ingredients.item: lollo rosso lettuce, cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Combine Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, Bango Kecap Manis, and sesame oil in a bowl. Mix well and set aside.
Toss greens with the prepared dressing then assemble on plate.
Top with tomatoes, corn, radish, pomelo, and seared tuna.

name: Pastrami and Sausage Salad
description: Are you up for a salad adventure? Try this pastrami and sausage salad recipe. It's easy to make, especially when you add Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise.

ingredients.item: lollo rosso lettuce or iceberg lettuce, cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: In a bowl, combine Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, sesame oil, and sesame seeds. Set aside.
Arrange baguette slices on tray. Drizzle with olive oil, season, and add oregano. Toast in an oven until crisp.
Toss vegetables with the prepared dressings then arrange on plate. Add crostinis topped with pastrami, sausages, and feta cheese.

name: Mixed Fruits Salad in Mango-Mayo Dressing
description: How do you give life to a bowl of mixed fruits and vegetables? Add mayo dressing featuring Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise to amplify this salad's flavors.

ingredients.item: lollo rosso lettuce, cut into bite-sized pieces
head iceberg lettuce, cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: In a bowl, combine Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise with mango puree and honey. Mix well.
Toss the greens well with the dressing then arrange on plate.
Top with grapes, peaches, and apple and served chilled.

name: Grilled Chicken Salad With BBQ-Mayo Dressing
description: It's grilled. It's healthy. It's our grilled Chicken Salad made even tastier by our Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise.
instructions: Season chicken breast fillet with Knorr Liquid Seasoning then grill until cooked through.
Mix Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise Lite with barbecue sauce then toss with mixed greens.
Arrange greens on plate then top with tomatoes, cucumber, egg, walnuts, and the grilled chicken.

name: Creamy Beef Kaldereta
description: Did you know your spicy beef kaldereta is missing Lady's Choice Mayonnaise? Find out how this ingredient makes your caldereta recipe sweeter and creamier.

ingredients.item: kilogram beef brisket, cut into 2-inch cubes

instructions: In a pre-heated pan with oil, fry the beef over high heat just until browned. Do not overcrowd the pan. Set aside.
In the same pan, saute onions in oil over medium heat for a minute, add garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes then add back the browned beef brisket.
Add water, bay leaf, and pepper. Cover, bring to a boil, and simmer slowly for 2 ½ to 3 hours over low heat. Remaining broth should be around 2 cups.
Add tomato sauce, liver spread, soy sauce, brown sugar, and chili. Mix well then simmer for a minute.
Add bell peppers, potatoes, carrots, and green peas then simmer for 20 minutes or until sauce is thick and vegetables are cooked.
Add Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise, mix well, and serve.

name: Grilled Lapu-Lapu with Spicy Garlic Mayo
description: Give this grilled fish dish a new twist using our Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise. Serve with our signature spicy mayo garlic and enjoy newfound taste!
instructions: Make a slit along the back of the fish to create a pocket. Brush all parts evenly with calamansi juice and season well.
Stuff the fish with tomatoes and onions and brush both sides with oil. Grill until thoroughly cooked.
In a small bowl, mix together Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise, garlic, and hot sauce. Add more hot sauce if preferred. Season well and serve with grilled fish.

name: Creamy Baked Salmon
description: Try this simple and creamy baked salmon recipe. This juicy, creamy salmon is ready from start to finish in 30 minutes.

ingredients.item: olive or canola oil, for brushing
Any fresh herbs of your choice, chopped

instructions: Brush a baking pan with oil. Place the salmon fillets at the center and season well. Squeeze some lemon juice on top and leave the rinds on the baking pan.
In a small bowl, combine Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise and chopped herb of choice. Mix well and coat the sides and surface of the fish fillet with the mixture using a spoon or spatula.
Top the coated fish with grated cheese and breadcrumbs then bake in a pre-heated 400 F oven until cooked through.

name: Stuffed Chops with Sesame Mayo
description: Enjoy all the meaty goodness in every bite with our stuffed pork chops recipe that's made more flavorful by Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise.

ingredients.item: kilogram pork chops (make a slit per piece to create pockets)

instructions: Marinate pork chops in barbecue sauce, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, sesame oil, and honey for at least 1 hour.
In a pre-heated pan, saute onion and garlic then add Knorr Pork Cubes. Mash then mix well. Add raisins, and fresh button mushrooms. Saute for a minute or until raisins swell.
Stuff the pork pockets with the sautéed mushroom stuffing. Secure with toothpicks. Pan-grill, grill, or fry, until cooked.
Serve with sesame-mayo, toasted garlic, and sesame seeds (optional).

name: German Potato Salad
description: Potatoes can be made even tastier. Try it with this recipe and see your dish become the favorite item on the dining table!
instructions: Boil potatoes in salted water then simmer until tender. Drain and cut into 1 to 1 1/2 –inch cubes.
In a bowl, mix together Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise, mustard, dill, honey, paprika, and ham. Season to taste.
Add prepared dressing to the cooked potatoes just enough to coat. Serve chilled.

name: Easy Baked Mussels
description: Make a good impression by serving this mouth-watering appetizer that's delicious and creamy by Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise.

ingredients.item: any soft or quick melting cheese, grated

instructions: Combine mussels and water in a pot. Bring to the boil. Let the mussels cook until shells open. Drain and discard shells that did not open.
In a bowl, combine pesto sauce and Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise. Top this on mussels – about a teaspoon per shell.
Add grated cheese on each piece then bake or toast until the cheese melts.

name: Creamy Beef Stroganoff
description: Try our easy to prepare Beef Stroganoff recipe that's made creamier and more delicious by Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise.

ingredients.item: kilogram beef sirloin, sliced into 1/2-inch thick

instructions: Saute onions, garlic, and mushroom in oil until fragrant. Remove from pan.
In the same pan, brown beef slices over high heat. Add cream, beef cube, and the sautéed onion mixture then let simmer until beef is cooked.
Stir in Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise over low heat and mix well. Adjust seasonings and serve.

name: Spicy Buffalo Wings with Homemade Honey Mustard Dressing
description: Buffalo Wings taste good on their own but they're even better with Lady's Choice. Try our version of the recipe with our signature dressing.

ingredients.item: oil for deep frying, as needed

instructions: Poach chicken wings in seasoned water with garlic. Drain.
Season chicken wings then coat with flour, shake off excess, dip in egg then coat with breadcrumbs evenly.
In a bowl, mix together butter, tabasco sauce, sesame oil, and honey.
Deep-fry chicken wings until crisp then coat with the butter mixture. Serve with homemade Honey Mustard Dressing.
Combine Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise, mustard, honey, and lemon juice.

name: Creamy Lengua Estofado
description: Find out how to cook extra creamy lengua estofado. Ox tongue has never tasted better and richer than with Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise. Try it now!

ingredients.item: water to cover for first boil
potatoes, sliced into wedges and fried (optional)

instructions: Combine ox tongue and water in a pot and bring to the boil. Discard water.
Add water again to pot just to cover the ox tongue. Add calamansi juice and bring this to the boil. Reduce heat to simmer slowly or just until tender – about 2 ½ - 3 hours.
Drain the tongue from the liquid, let this cool. Remove the skin of the tongue with a knife then slice into 1/2-inch thick pieces crosswise.
In a separate pot, sauté onion and garlic in oil until fragrant. Add tomato paste and sauté for a minute. Add water bay leaves, vinegar, soy sauce, pepper, and ox tongue. Mix well.
Bring to the sauce to the boil then let this simmer until ox tongue is very tender.
Add green olives and simmer for another 6-8 minutes.
Add Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise, mix well and let simmer over very low heat until sauce is creamy thick. Adjust seasonings and serve.

name: Pork BBQ with Homemade Ranch Dressing
description: Try this dish with Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise on your next BBQ session and taste your next favorite recipe for anything that's grilled.
instructions: Combine barbecue sauce, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, calamansi juice, oil, and pepper in a bowl.
Marinate pork in the barbecue mixture overnight.
Grill over hot coals until cooked. Serve with homemade Ranch Dressing.
Combine Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise, fresh herbs, garlic, and shallots in a bowl. Serve chilled.

name: Creamy Stuffed Prawns
description: Upgrade a stuffed prawns recipe with Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise. Whether as an appetizer or ulam, make it memorable with this shrimp with mayo recipe.

ingredients.item: soft or any quick melting cheese, grated

instructions: Lay prawns on chopping board. Butterfly then remove the meat while keeping head and tail intact. Roughly chop meat, season, and set aside.
Place shells in boiling water until cooked and drain from liquid.
Saute onion and garlic in oil. Add mushrooms and chopped prawns. Saute until cooked then stir in Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise. Fill prawn shells with the sautéed mixture.
Top with cheese and breadcrumbs then bake or toast until the cheese melts. Serve with lemon wedges.

name: Waldorf Salad Recipe
description: Love a good Waldorf Salad? Make a quick and creamy version with this recipe full of apples, grapes, nuts, and Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise ingredients.

ingredients.item: to taste honey and lemon juice
head lollo rosso lettuce, washed and trimmed

instructions: Combine Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise with honey and lemon juice. Season to taste.
Add nuts, celery, grapes, raisins, and apple.
Serve on a bed of greens, chilled.

name: Easy Mayo Dips in 3 Ways
description: Make your fried chicken, fish and porkchops more special with 3 creamy dip choices made from Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise.

ingredients.item: of Lady's Choice real mayonnaise (8 tablespoons)
of Lady's Choice real mayonnaise (8 tablespoons)
of Lady's Choice real mayonnaise (8 tablespoons)

instructions: Add eight tablespoons of Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise into a glass bowl.
Add pickle relish to mayo.
Mix together until well combined.
Add eight tablespoons of Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise into a glass bowl.
Add banana catsup to mayo.
Mix together until well combined.
Add eight tablespoons of Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise into a glass bowl.
Add BBQ sauce to mayo.
Mix together until well combined.

name: Best Dips Made with Real Mayo
description: Experience restaurant-level snacking at home with our easy-to-prepare dips with Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise. Try our garlic mayo dip and more.

ingredients.item: of Lady's Choice real mayonnaise (4 tablespoons)
of Lady's Choice real mayonnaise (4 tablespoons)
of Lady's Choice real mayonnaise (4 tablespoons)

instructions: Add eight tablespoons of Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise into a glass bowl.
Finely chop the garlic and add to mayo.
Mix together until well combined.
Add eight tablespoons of Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise into a glass bowl.
Add oyster sauce to mayo.
Mix together until well combined.
Add eight tablespoon of Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise into a glass bowl.
Add honey, and sesame oil to mayo.
Mix together until well combined.

name: Quick Pinoy Bistek
description: Make your Pinoy Bistek more creamy and moisture by adding Lady’s Choice Real Mayo. A quick update to a classic dish!
instructions: Marinate beef slices in a mixture of liquid seasoning and calamansi juice for at least 30 minutes.
Brown the beef slices in pre-heated oil over high heat then set aside.
In the same pan, saute onions for a minute, add water, soy sauce, calamansi juice, sugar, and beef cube. Let this simmer for a minute.
Add Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise and mix well with the sauce.
Add back the browned beef slices. Let the sauce simmer until thick and serve.

name: Best Creamy Pinoy Spaghetti
description: Whip up a super creamy Pinoy-style spaghetti recipe with red sauce. Use Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise to cook this easy Filipino recipe now.

ingredients.item: red bell peppers, cored, seeded and finely chopped
jumbo hot dog rolls, sliced diagonally into rings

instructions: Cook the spaghetti according to package directions. Drain.
Sauté garlic, onions then add the ground beef. Cook over high heat until meat is no longer pink.
Bring to low heat. Add red bell peppers, carrot and bay leaf. Put salt and pepper.
Pour in 1 ½ cup of water and bring to the boil. Cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the mixture is almost dry and the vegetables are very tender.

Turn up the heat and add the sliced hotdogs, stirring for about a minute. Pour in the spaghetti sauce and bring to the boil. Adjust seasonings. Lower the heat, cover and simmer for another 5-7 minutes.
Add ¼ cup of Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise. Mix well until sauce becomes creamy.
Pour sauce on pasta and top with grated cheese.

name: Extra Creamy Egg Mayo Sandwich (5-Ingredient Recipe)
description: A classic egg mayo sandwich is a creamy, comforting treat made with chopped hard-boiled eggs and mayonnaise, tucked into soft bread. This recipe shows you how to make egg mayo sandwich filling with the right mayo-to-egg ratio and a smooth yet slightly chunky texture. It’s quick and reliable, perfect for baon, merienda, or easy meals at home.

ingredients.item: bunches curly leaf lettuce (washed and dried from excess water) [optional]

instructions: Make the Egg Mayo Spread Combine eggs and Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise in a bowl. Mix until smooth but still slightly chunky. Season with salt, pepper, and sugar according to taste. Tip: For proper seasoning balance, add mustard in small amounts if you want a gentle tang. A small pinch of sugar helps round out the richness without making the spread sweet.

Assemble the Sandwich Arrange 3 to 4 pieces of lettuce leaves on one slice of bread. Spread the egg mayo mixture evenly over the lettuce, then top with 1 to 2 slices of tomatoes. Cover with another slice of bread. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Serve chilled or at room temperature. Tip: Store any leftover egg sandwich spread in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2 days. Keep it sealed to prevent it from drying out.

name: Yummy Tuna Sandwich
description: Make a tuna sandwich healthier and creamier with Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise. Upgrade this classic merienda with this quick recipe.

ingredients.item: bunches curly leaf lettuce, washed and drained well

instructions: In a bowl, combine, tuna flakes, Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise and chopped onions. Season with salt, pepper and sugar according to taste.

You can take your sandwiches to the next level by filling them with 2-3 pcs of lettuce leaves, slices of tomatoes and cucumber and the prepared tuna spread mixture. Enjoy with a glass of milk and fruit slices!

name: Delicious Chicken Sandwich
