description: Try our easy-to-prepare delicious chicken sandwich recipe made creamy with Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise. It is heavy on taste but light on the stomach.

ingredients.item: bunches curly leaf lettuce, washed and drained well (optional)

instructions: In a bowl, combine shredded chicken and Lady’s Choice Chicken Spread.
For added veggie goodness, you can fill the sandwiches with 2-3 pcs of lettuce leaves, slices of tomatoes and cucumber and the prepared tuna spread. Enjoy with a glass of milk and fruit slices!

name: Sweet Chicken Macaroni Salad
description: All the macaroni salad goodness with a sweet twist. Creaminess and yumminess guaranteed with Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise.

ingredients.item: (700 ml) bottle Lady's Choice real mayonnaise

instructions: Combine Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise with condensed milk in a bowl. Mix well.
Add in cheese, carrots, onions, pickle relish, ham, pineapple tidbits, and chicken. Mix well.
Add in macaroni pasta. Mix well and serve chilled.

name: Monte Cristo Sandwich
description: A Monte Cristo sandwich can be a meal in itself. Check out this recipe and enjoy its cheesy, meaty goodness made special with Lady's Choice Ham Spread.
instructions: Spread Lady’s Choice Ham Spread on bread slices then layer cheese, and ham in between. Top with the last slice of bread.
In a shallow dish, mix together egg, milk, and nutmeg. Coat the sandwich with the mixture by dipping all sides.
Melt butter in a pan then add the sandwich. Turn to brown all sides. Dust with confectioner’s sugar before serving.

name: Embutido Recipe
description: Embutido is a go-to favorite, but what makes it yummier? Find out how and why you should add Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise to your meatloaf recipe.
instructions: Combine bread crumbs, milk, and Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise in a bowl. Set aside.
In a separate bowl, combine ground pork, vegetables, sweet pickle relish, tomato sauce, raisins, cheese, soy sauce or liquid seasoning, salt and pepper.
Add the bread crumb mixture to the ground pork mixture and combine thoroughly but do not overmix.
Divide meat mixture into two.
Place one portion of the meat mixture onto a piece of aluminum foil and flatten to form a rectangle roughly 9" by 6" in size.
Place ham, vienna sausage, and eggs alternately in the middle of the mixture
Tightly roll the foil to form a cylinder with the meat mixture and wrap ends firmly. Repeat with other half of the mixture.
Place in a steamer over medium heat and let cook for 1 hour. Alternatively, bake embutido placed on a wire rack in a baking dish with water, covered at 350 degrees Farenheit for 1 hour
With either method, cook for an hour or until an instant read thermometer reads 165 degrees farenheit.
Let cool, slowly unwrap from foil and serve.

name: Meaty Clubhouse Sandwich
description: Learn how to make a clubhouse sandwich. Satisfy cravings with Lady's Choice Ham Spread and enjoy an easy sandwich recipe with a meaty rich flavor.
instructions: Toast the bread slices. Lay 3 pieces of bread and spread a tablespoon of Lady’s Choice Ham Spread on one side of the 1st and 3rd slice, and a tablespoon on both sides of the 2nd slice of bread evenly.
Top the 1st slice (mayonnaise-side up) with lettuce, tomatoes, and bacon then cover with the 2nd slice. Top with lettuce, cucumber, ham, and egg then cover with the 3rd slice (mayonnaise-side down).
Press the sandwich lightly then slice into 4 triangular portions. Secure with toothpicks and serve.

name: BLT Sandwich
description: The classic sandwich recipe of Bacon, Lettuce and Tomatoes topped with cheese and mixed with Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise for a creamier experience with every bite!
instructions: Evenly spread Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise onto every slice of bread
Layer bacon, tomato, cheese and lettuce on 4 bread slices, then top with remaining bread.

name: Scrambled Eggs
description: Here's a hearty scrambled eggs with mayo recipe to kick off your day. Experience a simple egg recipe made creamy and fluffy with Lady's Choice Mayonnaise.

ingredients.item: a pinch of ground black pepper

instructions: Beat egg, salt, and pepper until frothy.
Add Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise and mix well.
Heat oil in a pan. Add the beaten eggs and keep on stirring until fluffy and cooked.

name: Creamy Pininyahang Manok
description: Looking for a simple and juicy chicken recipe? Learn to cook pininyahang manok! Make your kids love it more by adding creamy Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise.

ingredients.item: kilogram chicken, cut into serving-size pieces
small can pimiento strips, coarsely chopped
small can pineapple chunks, include juice (about 1 cup)

instructions: Sauté garlic and onion in oil. Add patis.
Next, add chicken pieces, lower heat and cook until meat changes color, about 10 minutes.
Next, add the pimiento, pineapple chunks and the juice, simmer for another 10 minutes.
Pour the milk and boil for 2 minutes. Add 1 tsp salt.
Next, put 1/2 cup of Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise, stir and mix well until dish becomes creamy. Cook for another 5 minutes. Serve.

name: Cheesy Bacon Sandwich Recipe
description: Everyone loves a good bacon sandwich. Give your version an upgrade with this delicious yet simple recipe using Lady's Choice Bacon Spread.

ingredients.item: mini ciabatta, sliced into half, toasted

instructions: Evenly spread Lady’s Choice Bacon Spread on 2 sliced of bread.
Layer bacon, tomato, cheese then top with arugula. Cover with the other slice of bread.

name: Creamy Bicol Express Recipe
description: Excite your taste buds with the perfect blend of spiciness and creaminess of our special Bicol Express with Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise!

ingredients.item: siling pangsigang (green finger peppers), seeded and sliced diagonally

instructions: Remove seeds of siling pangsigang, slice thinly and diagonally then soak in salted water for 30 minutes. Rinse well then strain. This process removes the spiciness of the sili.
In a saucepan, heat pork liempo and allow fat to come out. Add garlic, onion, and luya. Then, add alamang or bagoong. Fry a little.
Add 1½ cup water and cook until pork is tender.
Add the siling haba and the diced pineapple. Cook until almost dry. Add coconut cream and cook until a little dry.
Add 2 Tbsp of Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise and cook until sauce thickens.

name: Pastrami Sandwich
description: You can never go wrong with a pastrami sandwich. Try this recipe using Lady's Choice Ham Spread, which brings out the beefy flavors of this deli meat.
instructions: Evenly spread Lady’s Choice Ham Spread on 2 slices of bread.
Layer pastrami, tomato, cheese then top with arugula. Cover with the other slice of bread.

name: Menudo Recipe
description: Retire your old menudo recipe for this one. Check out this new recipe and make this classic Pinoy pork stew tastier with Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise.

ingredients.item: kilogram pork liver, cut into small cubes
pork kasim, cut into small cubes

instructions: Fry potatoes and carrot. Set aside.
Sauté garlic and onion; add toyo, then patis and simmer for   2 minutes. Add pork liver, stir and cook for about 5 minutes then  remove pork liver and set aside.
Next, add the pork and cook until pork changes in color.
Add the tomato sauce, water, dahon ng laurel and season  with salt and ground pepper. Bring to the boil and cook until  pork is tender, around 25-30 minutes.
Add the potatoes and carrot; allow this to cook for 5 minutes.
Add the green bell pepper, garbanzos and cooked  pork liver  (and raisins - optional).
Then, add 2 Tbsp of Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise. Mix well until  sauce becomes thick. Let stand for 5 minutes and serve.

name: Banana Pecan Bread
description: Our Banana Pecan Bread recipe makes for a tasteful and healthy snack. Simple preparation and made special by Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise.

ingredients.item: bananas, mashed well with a fork

instructions: Preheat oven at 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Grease a 9" by 5" loaf pan. Set aside.
Combine all the dry ingredients (flour, sugar, salt, and baking soda and chopped pecans) in a medium bowl until evenly distributed.
In a separate bowl, combine bananas, Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, melted butter, vanilla essence and milk until well incorporated.
Gently fold in wet ingredients into the dry ingredients until there is no trace of flour left.
Pour batter onto greased loaf pan. Batter will be thick. Bake for 1 hour or until toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Let cool for at least 15 minutes on a rack before removing from loaf pan. Serve warm or keep in airtight container after completely cooled.

name: Classic Chicken Afritada Recipe with A Creamy Twist
description: This recipe takes the Filipino favorite Chicken Afritada and adds an indulgent creamy twist to the classic using a simple ingredient – Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise. This simple, yet tasty addition, not only elevates the flavors of chicken afritada but brings the texture of the sauce to the next level with a velvety creaminess unlike anything you’ve ever tried before.

ingredients.item: salt and ground black pepper to taste

instructions: Cut chicken into 8 pieces (2 breasts, 2 legs, 2 thighs, 2 wings).
Brown chicken on all sides with 4 tablespoons cooking oil on medium heat. Remove chicken and set aside.
On the same pot, saute onions and garlic until fragrant. Stir in tomato sauce and chicken stock into the pot. Add chicken and bay leaves. Simmer for 30 to 40 mins.
Add in Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise until the mixture becomes smooth, creamy and velvety.
Add the potato, carrots, and bellpepper then simmer for another 5 minutes or until the vegetables are tender
Add the sugar, green peas, and fish sauce. Slowly stir in mayonnaise mixture. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Remove from heat and serve with steamed rice

name: Beef and Caramelized Apples Sandwich
description: Try this Beef and Caramelized Apple sandwich recipe for that perfect blend of sweet and savory in your sandwich.
instructions: For the apples: Saute apples with butter and brown sugar in a pan over medium heat until soft and caramelized. Set aside.
Cook corned beef on pan until dry. Set aside.
To assemble sandwich: Spread Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise on buns. Divide and arrange the corned beef, lettuce and apples on buns. Serve warm.

name: Extra Crispy Fried Chicken Fingers Recipe With Creamy Salted Egg Mayo Dip
description: Crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside – who could say no to chicken fingers like these? This recipe keeps the familiar crunch you love, then adds a bold twist with a creamy salted egg mayo dip that elevates every bite. Follow this fried chicken fingers recipe for a quick, satisfying treat.

ingredients.item: salted egg powder or mashed salted duck egg yolks

instructions: Prepare the Breading Stations In a small bowl, season the flour with salt and black pepper; set aside. In another bowl, beat the eggs until fully combined and slightly frothy, about 30 seconds. Place the panko breadcrumbs in a third bowl.

Bread the Chicken Dip each chicken strip into the seasoned flour, shaking off excess. Next, coat it in the beaten eggs. Finally, roll it in the breadcrumbs and press gently so the crumbs adhere well. Place the breaded chicken strips on a clean plate or wire rack. Repeat with the remaining strips. Tip: Use one hand for dry ingredients and one hand for wet ingredients to prevent clumping.

Fry Chicken Until Golden Heat oil in a deep pan or heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat. Deep-fry the chicken strips for 6 to 8 minutes or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer to a paper towel-lined tray or wire rack to drain excess oil. Fry in batches to avoid overcrowding the pan and to maintain oil temperature. Tip: Overcrowding the pan results in soggy coating instead of crisp, crunchy fingers.

Make the Salted Egg Dip In a bowl, combine salted egg powder or mashed salted duck egg yolks, Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, and sour cream. Mix until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Serve the fried chicken fingers warm with the salted egg dip on the side. Tip: Mash salted egg yolks thoroughly before mixing to avoid lumps and ensure a smooth, velvety dip.

name: Marble Potato Salad
description: An easy marble potato salad recipe made creamy with Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise including the ingredients and steps on how to cook it.

ingredients.item: ounce can pineapple chunks with juice (optional)

instructions: Boil the potatoes and carrots until cooked. Cut the carrots into cubes and the marble potatoes in half.
In another pot, boil the chicken breast in water seasoned with salt and pepper. Cook for 15 minutes or until done. Let it cool and cut into strips or cubes.

Once the vegetables and chicken have cooled, mix them together with Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, pineapple chunks with juice, sugar, and pickle relish in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.

name: Chicken Tenders with Honey Mayo Mustard Dressing
description: Try the classic chicken tenders with honey mayo mustard. Use Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise for your dip apart and make unforgettable chicken fingers.
instructions: Season chicken tenders with salt and pepper. Set aside.

Make breading station: In a shallow dish, mix flour, garlic and onion powders, salt, and pepper. In another shallow dish, lightly beat eggs. In another dish, place bread crumbs. With a clean dry hand, coat chicken tenders one at a time in the flour, egg, and, using the other hand, the bread crumbs dish. Set aside. Repeat with all tenders until each piece is coated.
Heat enough oil in a frying pan placed over medium heat. Once oil is hot, place chicken one at a time, turning over, in order to evenly brown all sides. Remove from oil and drain on paper towels.
For the honey mayo mustard dressing, combine all the ingredients and mix until the mixture is creamy.

name: Mayo Parmesan Crusted Salmon
description: A deliciously super easy salmon recipe that is sure to become a family favorite. Get your recipe today!
instructions: Preheat oven to 175 C.
Cut salmon fillet into four pieces. Rinse and pat dry using paper towels.
Grease baking sheet.
Lay the salmon fillets, skin down.
Combine all remaining ingredients and Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise and mix well. Slather entire mixture on top of fillet pieces.
Bake in preheated 175 C oven for 15 minutes or until done, depending on thickness.

name: Cheese Pimiento and Dip
description: Enjoy a classic pimiento dip with your favorite appetizers. Made creamy with Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise.

ingredients.item: crackers and assorted raw vegetables (such as carrot sticks, celery sticks, trimmed green beans, and bell pepper strips), to serve

instructions: Mix cheddar cheese, pimentos, and sugar with the Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise.
Set aside in a container or mason jar and serve with assorted crackers and raw vegetables.

name: Classic Deviled Eggs
description: So you want to know how to make creamy deviled eggs? Follow these quick and easy steps to make this classic finger food.
instructions: Peel off shell then slice each hard-boiled egg lengthwise. Carefully separate the yellow yolks from the egg whites and place the yolks in a mixing bowl. Mash the yolks together with a fork to remove clumps.
Add in the Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise and mustard. With a fork, whip the mixture together, removing as many small clumps as possible. Add in remaining ingredients, excluding the paprika.
Using a dessert decorator tool or pastry bag, pipe the yolk mixture into the hollowed egg whites.
Garnish the finished products with a hint of paprika

name: Spicy Mayo Dip
description: Add a spicy kick to your favorite appetizers! Try this spicy mayo recipe using Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix all the ingredients together.
Transfer into smaller bowls and serve with desired finger food.

name: Savory Umami Bomb Dip Recipe
description: A quick and easy savory dip made creamy with Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise for your favorite appetizers!
instructions: In a bowl, combine all ingredients.
Serve in smaller bowls with desired appetizers.

name: Creamy Pickle Dip
description: One of the best sandwich choices is a classic egg dip. Make it creamy by adding Lady’s Choice Ham Spread.
instructions: Chop hard-boiled eggs. Transfer to a bowl.
Mix in the rest of the ingredients. Top desired finger food with a dollop of the pickle mixture or serve separately.

name: Three-Cheese Mega Melt
description: Make this easy and delicious three-cheese dip recipe for a crowd! Serve with tortilla chips and you have a perfect appetizer for all your parties!
instructions: In an oven-safe bowl, mix all the ingredients before broiling the batch in a toaster oven until all the cheese has melted and the ham has just heated through.
Serve in small bowls with desired appetizers.

name: Barbecue Bacon Dip
description: Impress your family at barbecues and reunions. Try this irresistible BBQ bacon dip made deliciously tangy with Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise.

ingredients.item: red and green bell peppers, finely chopped

instructions: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and fry bacon until crispy. Place on paper towels to drain excess oil. Finely chop.
In a bowl, add Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, bacon bits, bell papers, and barbecue sauce.

name: Crispy Wonton Cheese Bombs
description: Try our Crispy Wonton Cheese Bombs recipe and taste all the cheesy and creamy goodness with Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the cream cheese, green onions, Sriracha sauce, and Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise.

Arrange the wonton wrappers on a flat surface. Using a teaspoon, get a dollop of the cream cheese mixture and put it in the middle of each wrapper. Dip your finger in a some water in a bowl and wipe the edges of the wrappers. Pull the edges together and twist to seal. Continue until all the wontons are filled and sealed.

Bring the oil to high heat. In batches, fry the wonton bombs until golden brown and crispy, about two minutes per batch (or less). Continue until all the wonton bombs are fried. Place them on paper towels to drain excess oil.
Serve immediately with Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise as a dip.

name: Chopped Egg Salad With Crackers
description: Your classic egg salad recipe turned into a dip with Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise that will surely leave everyone asking for more!

ingredients.item: strips of bacon, fried and chopped

instructions: In a large bowl, mix the hard-boiled eggs, Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, bacon, pickle relish, and sugar. Season with salt and pepper.
Chill in the refrigerator before serving. Serve with crackers.

name: Caramelized Onion and Bacon Dip
description: This caramelized onion and bacon dip has everything you want: creamy, sweet, salty, smoky, and flavorful. Make it now.

ingredients.item: white onions, peeled, halved and thinly sliced
vegetable sticks such as carrots, cucumbers, and bread sticks

instructions: Cook the bacon until the fat is rendered out. Drain bacon and set aside. Reserve the fat in the pan.

Heat oil in a skillet. Add onions and salt. Cook onions over low heat, stirring occasionally, until they are soft and golden in color. Add water if needed. Add the vinegar on the minute of cooking. Turn off the heat and let it cool.
In a large bowl, stir together the cream cheese, Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, bacon, and onions.

Add vegetable oil to the hot skillet with bacon fat. Toss in the shallots and cook until golden brown. Garnish dip with fried shallots. Serve with vegetable sticks such as carrots, cucumbers, and bread sticks.

name: Pinwheel Bites
description: Create a fun and exciting twist to your ham and cheese sandwich with Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise!
instructions: Flatten bread with a rolling pin. Spread Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise and place ham and cheese on the slice of bread.
Roll up each slice tightly and slice crosswise.
Pin with toothpicks to secure together.

name: Ham and Egg Salad Sandwich
description: Whip up a ham and egg salad sandwich made better with Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise that the whole family will surely love!
instructions: Peel hard-boiled eggs, then roughly chop. Transfer to a bowl.
Stir Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, garlic powder, and ham into the bowl with the chopped egg. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste. Keep chilled until ready to serve.

Cut pandesals in half. Toast if desired. Spread cheese spread on the cut side of a pandesal. Top with egg and ham mixture, cover with the other pandesal half. Repeat with remaining pandesals. Serve immediately.

name: Mac and Cheese
description: Surprise the family with a twist to your mac and cheese recipe by adding the creamy goodness of Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise!
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. Butter mini muffin pan.
In a large pot, boil water and prepare pasta according to box minus three minutes of recommended cooking time. Drain.
Transfer cooked pasta back in pot then add the eggs, carrots, Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, milk, cheddar cheese, salt, and pepper. Stir until pasta is well-coated.
Use a ¼ measuring cup to fill the muffin pan, heaping up the pasta. Sprinkle with a bit of parmesan cheese and a drizzle of oil. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until edges turn brown.

name: Double Potato Balls
description: Try this Double Potato Balls and garlic sauce recipe made creamy with Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise.
instructions: Boil potatoes and sweet potatoes in salted water until very soft. Drain then mash with a fork.

While potatoes are still warm, add butter, Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, salt, and pepper. Add minced green onions and grated carrots; mix until well-combined. Let cool for a few minutes then add egg yolk. Mix together. Refrigerate until firm.
Make the mashed potato balls: Get a spoonful of mashed potato and place a cube of cheese in the middle. Use your hands to form a ball. Repeat with remaining ingredients.
Place bread crumbs on a plate. Roll potato balls in crumbs until well-coated. Freeze crumb-coated balls for about 1 hour or until coating is quite firm.
Deep fry balls in hot oil until golden brown. Serve immediately with garlic sauce.

name: Sushi Sandwich Recipe
description: Make your sandwiches more exciting by transforming them into sushi rolls!

ingredients.item: white or whole wheat bread, crusts removed
small cucumber, peeled, cut into long strips
can tuna in oil, drained, flaked
to 3 iceberg lettuce leaves, washed, dried, finely shredded

instructions: Place bread on a flat surface. Use a rolling pin to flatten bread slightly. Spread corn over 4 slices, leaving a 2cm strip free of filling along one edge. Top with ham, carrots, and cucumber. Roll up to enclose filling. Cut each sandwich into 3 rounds.

Place tuna and Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise into a bowl. Mix carefully to combine. Arrange lettuce over the 4 remaining slices of bread, leaving a 2cm strip free of filling along one edge. Roll up to enclose filling. Cut each sandwich into 3 rounds.
Wrap all sandwiches in plastic wrap. Store in the fridge until ready to pack into lunch boxes.

name: Extra-Creamy Macaroni Salad Recipe With Ham and Cheese
description: This creamy macaroni salad recipe combines macaroni, ham, and cheese in a thick, extra-creamy mayonnaise dressing that coats every piece evenly. Each spoonful delivers a smooth, rich mouthfeel with a slightly sweet finish. Make it any time of the year when you want something indulgent and satisfyingly creamy without waiting for a special occasion.

ingredients.item: pineapple tidbits (drained well and juice reserved)
pineapple tidbits (drained well and juice reserved)

instructions: Cook the Macaroni Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil. Add the macaroni and cook until tender but still slightly firm to the bite. Drain well. Tip: Rinsing prevents carryover cooking and removes excess starch, keeping the pasta from turning mushy once mixed with the dressing.

Prepare the Dressing Combine Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, sugar, pineapple juice, pickle relish, onions, celery, and carrots in a large bowl. Mix until the sugar fully dissolves and the dressing looks smooth and creamy. Tip: Measure and prepare all ingredients before mixing so the process stays quick and organized.

Add the Mix-Ins Add the cooled macaroni, ham, cheese, pineapple tidbits, and raisins to the dressing. Fold gently until everything is evenly coated. Tip: Use a spatula and fold from the bottom up instead of stirring vigorously to keep the macaroni intact.
Season and Chill Season with salt and pepper to taste. Chill for at least 4 hours before serving.

name: Creamy Pork Kaldereta
description: Make it a meal to remember with this sweet, spicy and creamy Pork Kalderata, cooked with Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise and your special touch.

ingredients.item: pork bouillon cube, dissolved in 2 cups of water

instructions: Boil pork in the pork bouillon stock until tender, about 25-30 minutes. Remove pork, strain and set aside. Also set aside liquid where pork was cooked.
Fry potatoes and carrot, drain oil and set aside.
Sauté garlic and onions in oil in a casserole. Add the cooked pork and stir until meat turns brown.
Add tomato sauce and soy sauce. Next, add the liver spread and mix well and then add the liquid where pork was cooked. Simmer everything in medium-low fire for about 10 minutes.
Set the fire to medium heat. Then, add in potatoes, carrots, red and green bell peppers. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the red hot chili peppers and sweet pickles.
Next, add 3 Tbsp of Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise. Stir and blend well until creamy. Check seasonings and adjust according to preference. Add more peppers as desired. Let stand for 5 minutes and serve.

name: Easy Pinakbet Recipe (Ready in 30 Minutes)
description: This pinakbet recipe is a smart starting point for anyone learning to cook at home, especially solo dwellers or couples building a weekly meal plan. The dish brings together mixed vegetables and pork in a savory shrimp paste-based stew that stretches ingredients and pairs naturally with rice. This guide shows how to cook pinakbet step by step, so first-time cooks can achieve balanced flavors with confidence.
instructions: Cook the Pork Heat oil in a wide pan or wok over medium heat. Add pork belly and cook until lightly browned and slightly crisp, allowing some fat to render. Transfer pork to a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil. Set aside. Tip: Do not overcrowd the pan. Let the pork sit undisturbed for a minute before stirring to help it brown properly instead of steaming.
Sauté the Aromatics In the same pan, remove excess oil if necessary, leaving about 1 tablespoon. Sauté onion, ginger, and garlic until fragrant and the onion turns translucent.
Build the Flavor Base Add tomatoes and cook until softened. Stir in the shrimp paste or bagoong and mix until fully incorporated with the aromatics.

Cook the Squash Add squash, water, and Knorr Shrimp Cube. Stir gently, cover, and simmer over medium heat until the squash is tender but still holds its shape. Tip: The squash is ready when a fork easily pierces through but does not cause it to break apart.

Add the Remaining Vegetables and Serve Add sitaw, ampalaya, eggplant, and okra. Gently toss to coat with the sauce. Return the cooked pork to the pan. Cover and cook until vegetables are tender yet vibrant. Serve warm. Tip: Avoid over-stirring to keep the vegetables intact and prevent the okra from becoming overly slimy.

name: Meatless Monggo Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Meatless Monggo made with Knorr Pork Cube. Give this recipe a try. Monggugulat ka sa sarap!
tips: Mung beans not only provide full flavor but it also contain many healthy antioxidants, including phenolic acids, flavonoids, caffeic acid, cinnamic acid and more.

ingredients.item: green monggo, washed properly and drained
water or liquid where you cooked your monggo

instructions: In a large pot, cook monggo with water at medium heat until tender. Drain monggo from liquid. Set aside drained monggo and keep 500 ml of the boiling liquid.
In another pot, sauté onion and garlic in oil until fragrant. Add tomatoes and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add monggo and 2 cups water or the liquid from where monggo was boiled. Stir well. Bring to the boil.
Add Knorr Pork Cubes then let simmer for 5 minutes. You may add more water according to your desired consistency. Add malunggay leaves, stir and serve.

name: Meatless Pinakbet Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Meatless Pinakbet made special with Knorr Shrimp Cubes. Prepare a perfect healthy meal for your family.
tips: Amplaya (Bitter Gourd) helps reduce and control blood sugar, and decrease cholesterol levels.
instructions: Heat oil in pan and sauté onions, ginger and garlic. Add tomatoes and continue sautéing until soft then add shrimp paste.
Add squash, water and Knorr Shrimp Cube. Cover and let cook over medium heat for 8-10 minutes.
Add sitaw, ampalaya, eggplants and okra. Mix and cover. Let cook for another 5-8 minutes. Serve warm.

name: Fried Pork Chop
description: The secret to this dish is marinating the Pork chop in lots of garlic and Knorr Liquid Seasoning to bring out the right blend of flavors and texture.
tips: Bring your pork chops to room temp from refrigeration before frying, to ensure even cooking and to retain as much moisture during the cooking process.

ingredients.item: pork cutlets/chops, cut into pieces (fillet or bone-in)

instructions: Combine Knorr Liquid Seasoning, pepper, chopped garlic and oil to create our base marination. Mix it to the pork chop, rub in both side well. Marinate for at least 10 mins.

Heat oil in pan. While waiting for the pan to heat up, pat dry the pork chops to remove excess marination, to prevent it from burning and sticking to the pan. Fry meat pieces until golden brown. Drain excess oil. Serve.

name: Ginisang Sayote Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Ginisang Sayote with Knorr SavorRich Pork Liquid Seasoning! You will definitely eat more than usual.
tips: Sayote is a good source of zinc that help boost metabolism, Viatmins C for boost immunity, and folate for nerve development.

ingredients.item: large pc sayote, peeled, seeded and sliced into matchstick pieces
small pc carrot, peeled and sliced into matchsticks pieces

instructions: Heat wok for 1 minute over medium heat. Combine pork and 1/4 cup water in pre-heated wok. Boil pork in water until water dries up and pork becomes golden brown. Remove fried pork from wok. Set aside.
Using the same wok, add oil and sauté garlic and onions until garlic has slightly browned. Add the pre-boiled pork. Mix well.
Add sayote. Mix and simmer until half-cooked. About 5 minutes.
Add carrots, water and Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Mix well. Cover and allow to cook for 3 minutes. Serve while warm."

name: Pancit Bihon Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Pancit Bihon with Knorr Pork Cube! This Filipino classic stir-fry dish combines flavors of pork and chicken.
tips: Soaking liver and other meats in milk is said to be a technique to remove impurities from the meat, enhances the flavor and tenderize the liver.

ingredients.item: small pc carrot, cut into thin strips
water (may add more depending on the doneness of the noodles)
pinch ground black pepper and salt

instructions: Boil pork in 1/4 cup water for 10-15 minutes or until water dries up. Then add oil in pan then sauté pork until color turns brown.
Add onions and garlic in the pan and sauté until tender. Add chicken liver. Sauté until liver is fully cooked.
Add carrots, chicharo, cabbage and kintsay. Saute for 1 minute.
Add water, soy sauce and Knorr Pork Cubes. Mix well and let broth simmer. Season with pepper and salt according to taste.
Drain meat and vegetables from stock and transfer on a bowl. Set aside.

Add noodles in simmering stock and let cook until tender while stirring once in a while. Let noodles absorb the stock. Once noodles are tender transfer on serving platter then top with cooked meat and vegetables. Serve immediately while still warm.

name: Whole Fried Chicken
description: This simple dish uses the rich taste of chicken infused with Knorr Liquid seasoning flavors, covered in batter and breadcrumbs, fried and baked to perfection.
tips: To check for doneness, the safe internal cooking temperature for chicken should be at 165 ºF internal temp. Use a thermometer to check the thickest part of the chicken and avoid the bones to get an accurate reading.

ingredients.item: Oven tray with a wire rack

instructions: Put the chicken in a large dish and rub 2 tablespoons Knorr Liquid Seasoning all over it. Cover it with clingwrap and put it into the fridge for 1 hour.
Put the flour and eggs and salt into a large mixing bowl and beat together. Gradually whisk in the water, to make a smooth batter.
Prepare 2 more large mixing bowls. One containing another 200 grams of flour, and the third containing the finely ground breadcrumbs.

Take the chicken out of the fridge and put it in the bowl of flour. Spoon flour over it so it’s well covered, making sure to get in all of the nooks and crannies, then tap off the excess and put the chicken into the batter bowl. Spoon batter all over it, making sure it’s fully covered, then lift it out with tongs or two large forks and let the excess run off into the bowl. Once the batter has stopped running off, put the chicken into the bowl with breadcrumbs. Spoon bread crumbs all over it, turning it around in the bowl if you need to, to make sure it’s fully covered.
Then sit the chicken on a clean plate and put it into the freezer for 1 hour, while you heat the oil.

Fill a very large saucepan just half full of oil. The chicken needs to be fully submerged in the oil all at once, and you shouldn’t let the oil to come much more than halfway up the insides if the pan while cooking it. Preheat the oven to 200C/180C fan.

When the chicken has been in the freezer for one hour, and the oil has reached 180C, use tongs and a large slotted spoon to carefully lower the chicken into the hot oil. The chicken should be fully submerged in the hot oil. If it isn’t, use a heat-proof ladle to carefully spoon oil over the top of it to ensure it gets a nice even brown color all over.

Fry until the breadcrumbs are golden brown, about 10 minutes, and then carefully lift the chicken out of the oil and put it into an oven tray with a wire rack inside. Now put the chicken into the hot oven for 1 hour, or until the meat is fully cooked through.
Let it rest for 5 minutes after removing from the oven - then serve!

name: Fried Chicken Bouquet Recipe
description: Create healthy and delicious meal. Check out our easy to follow recipe for Fried Chicken Bouquet made special with Knorr SavorRich Liquid Chicken Seasoning.
tips: By placing the vegetable strips in ice bath water and keeping it in the chiller, the vegetable strips will start to curl up; and these make for a nice garnish and decor for your plating.

ingredients.item: large pieces (around 500 g) chicken breasts, cut into 4 pieces
Food grade paper or cellophane, to wrap

instructions: Put the Knorr Liquid Seasoning and soy milk into a large mixing bowl. Add in the chicken pieces and stir it all around. Cover the bowl and leave to marinate for one hour.

Using the Mandolin, cut the cucumber - dark green bits only, and carrots into small strips and put them into a large mixing bowl. Slice the spring onions as finely as you can, lengthways, and add them to the bowl. Put 3 large handfuls of ice into the bowl and then fill it up with water. Put the bowl into the fridge for 1 hour and the vegetable strips will curl up.
In a large saucepan, pour the oil, enough so that the oil doesn’t come more than half-way up the sides. Preheat the oven to 180C/160C fan.

Put the plain flour, corn flour and baking powder into another bowl, and mix together. Spoon in 3 tablespoons of the chicken marinade and mix it so that there are clumps. Dip each piece of chicken into the flour, so it gets well covered. Put onto a clean plate or tray and do the same to the other pieces of chicken, then repeat - so each chicken has been double-dipped.

When the oil has come to temperature, carefully lower a few pieces of chicken into the hot oil. Fry for 3-4 minutes, until they’re golden brown. Put the fried chicken into an oven tray that has a wire rack inside. Cook for 10 minutes, until cooked through. Then let the chicken cool for 10 minutes before you prepare the bouquet.

Lay out your paper or cellophane and arrange the lettuce leaves in an upside-down triangle in the middle. Lay the chicken pieces on top and decorate with the curled vegetables. Tie ribbon around the bottom of the bouquet and don’t forget to write the card!

name: Hearty Chop Suey Recipe for Easy Meal Prep
description: Chop suey brings together crisp, colorful vegetables in a light savory sauce, often mixed with chicken, shrimp, or liver. It fits busy weekdays and family gatherings alike since it cooks fast, stretches generously, and works well for make-ahead meal prep. Follow this chop suey recipe to create a hearty stir-fry that stays vibrant and satisfying even after reheating.
instructions: Prepare the Aromatics Heat a wok for 1 minute over medium heat. Add oil and sauté garlic and onions until fragrant and the garlic turns lightly golden. Tip: A wok distributes heat quickly and evenly, allowing the vegetables to stay crisp while locking in flavor without turning soggy.
Cook the Proteins Add chicken liver and cubed chicken fillet. Sauté until the chicken turns opaque white and firm, and the liver changes from deep red to light brown with no raw center.
Add Shrimp and Season Add shrimp and sauté for 2 minutes or until pink and slightly curled. Sprinkle ground black pepper and sauté for 1 minute.

Cook the Firm Vegetables Add sayote, cauliflower, carrots, water, and Knorr Shrimp Cube. Mix well. Cover and simmer until the sayote is almost tender, about 5 minutes. Tip: Start with the harder vegetables, then add the softer ones later so everything cooks evenly without turning mushy.
Add Mid-Texture Vegetables Add Baguio beans, celery stalks, and bell peppers. Mix well. Cover and cook for 3 minutes until slightly tender but still crisp.

Finish and Thicken Add celery leaves, cabbage, singkamas, oyster sauce, and dissolved cornstarch. Toss gently to coat everything evenly. Cover and cook for 1 minute until the sauce lightly thickens and turns glossy. Serve hot.

name: Sinangag Garlic Rice Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Sinangag with Knorr Chicken Broth Cube! Make this fried rice a staple of a Filipino breakfast option.
tips: Sinangag is best cooked with left over cooked rice. Just be sure to store the left over rice properly.

ingredients.item: Optional: 1 cup spinach, fresh or frozen

instructions: Heat wok for 1 minute over medium heat. Add oil into wok and saute garlic until slightly browned.
Saute spinach, if using. Stir in Knorr Chicken Cube and toss in rice and mix well. Break up clumps and cook for another 2-3 mins. Serve while warm.

name: Taco Cups
description: This simple dish uses the rich flavors of chicken breast marinated in Knorr Seasoning and mexican spices, served in mini homemade taco shells and guacamole.
tips: Avocados contain high levels of healthy, beneficial fats, which can help a person feel fuller between meals. They are a great source of vitamins C, E, K, and B6, as well as riboflavin, niacin, folate, pantothenic acid, magnesium, and potassium.

ingredients.item: large tomatoes deseeded and finely chopped

instructions: Preheat the oven to 170 C. Marinate the chicken in the Knorr Liquid Seasoning and cumin and paprika spices and set aside for 15 minutes.
Using a 10cm cutter, cut 3 rounds out of each tortilla and use them to line the 12 holes of the muffin tray. Bake in the oven for 10 minutes or until golden and crisp. Set aside.
Add 1 tablespoon of oil to a large pan over a high heat then add the chicken pieces. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring often, until golden brown and cooked through.
Mix all the guacamole ingredients together. Serve each cup with some chicken and dig into the toppings.

name: Zucchini Noodle Nests
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Zucchini Noodle Nests.

ingredients.item: zucchini spiralized or cut into thin strips
chicken thighs bones and skin removed
spring onions halved lengthwise then cut into 3

instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C.
Line a baking tray with greaseproof paper and set aside.

Put the spiralized zucchinis into a large bowl, add 1 tablespoon oil and the egg, then mix well. Using a fork, divide the zucchini into 4 piles on top of the baking tray and shape into nests, creating a hollow in the centre of each. Bake for 15-20 minutes until cooked through and crispy.
Cut the chicken into thin strips and place into a bowl with the Knorr Liquid Meat Seasoning. Mix well.

Place a large pan over a medium heat and add 1 tablespoon oil. Add the chicken and fry for a couple of minutes, then add in the vegetables, garlic and ginger. Continue to fry whilst moving about the pan continuously for a further couple of minutes then remove from the heat.
To assemble place a zucchini nest onto your serving plate. Top with some stir fried chicken and vegetables then sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Tortang Talong
description: This simple and heart healthy dish combines the fresh and light flavor of eggplant with the rich flavor of egg infused with savory chicken taste.
tips: Eggplant is a rich source of fiber which does not only benefit the digestive process, but it also helps to improve your heart health.
instructions: Let's start by preparing the eggplant by placing them in a medium pot, add water and bring to a boil. Continue until egg plant is soft and tender. Peel the skin and flatten the inner part using a fork. Set aside.
In a separate bowl, beat the eggs and add the crushed Knorr Chicken Cube. Mix until it is fully dissolved.
Get a medium-sized pan, make it nice and warm over medium heat. Dip the flattened eggplant into the egg mix, then place on the pan to fry. Heat until egg is set and fully cooked.
categories: PH COVID EASY PANTRY HACK LUNCH

name: Chicken Sandwich
description: This perfect kiddie baon meal is simple yet is very delicious. It combines the rich flavors of chicken spread mixed with the egg and tomatoes.
tips: You can also try using Malunggay flavored Pandesal to add more flavor and boost the healthy nutrients of the dish.
instructions: Let's start this simple perfect kiddie baon meal by preparing the pandesal, cut it in half way to give space for the chicken spread.
Spread a generous amount of Lady's Choice Chicken Spread then add a layer of sliced scrambled egg top it with a slice or two of tomatoes. And that's it.

name: Lugaw Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Lugaw made extra special with Knorr Chicken Cubes. Enjoy it with your family!
tips: Ginger is a natural medicine for nausea and vomiting caused by medicine sick effects, chemotherapy treatment, morning sickness and motion sickness.
instructions: Get a medium-size pot, make it nice and warm over high-medium heat, then add the oil and sauté onions and ginger until brown nd aromatic.
Add in the rice, water and Knorr Chicken Cubes and let it boil until rice is fully cooked. Gently stir occasionally to prevent the rice from sticking to the bottom.
Serve topped with sliced boiled egg. Enjoy!
categories: PH COVID EASY PANTRY HACK BREAKFAST

name: Egg Sandwich
description: This kiddie baon meal uses the fresh flavors of boiled egg mixed with the creamy mayonnaise, served in a Filipino classic Pandesal.
tips: Follow this process to properly cook hard boiled egg, place the egg in a medium sized pot filled with cold water. Over high heat, let the water boil, then immediately cover the pot with a tight fitting lid. Remove from heat then set the timer to 8-10 minutes. Try not to lift the lid. Once timer is done, remove eggs and transfer to an iced water pan to cool down.
instructions: Slice the eggs into small cubes and mix with the mayonnaise. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Spread generously on your Pandesal and Enjoy!

name: Hotdog Fried Rice Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Hotdog Fried Rice made extra special with Knorr Chicken Cubes. Enjoy it with your family!
tips: It is recommended that you use cold, leftover cooked rice. Rice left in the fridge overnight will be firmer, making it easier to cook and to separate. It will also prevent the fried rice to become mushy and lumpy.
instructions: Let's start by preparing the rice toppings. In medium pot, fry the chopped hotdogs, green peas, and carrots until soft and tender.
Mix in the egg and continue frying until it sets. Occasionally stir the egg to make sure that all sides cook evenly.
Add the rice into the pan. Remove all rice lumps. Add in the crushed Knorr Chicken Cubes and mix properly with the other ingredients.

name: Cheese Bacon Pandesal
description: This simple kiddie baon combines the rich and creamy flavor of the bacon spread, mixed egg and cheese, served in the Filipino favorite bread pandesal.
tips: You can also toast or dry-fry the pandesal to give it a different crunch and texture. You can do this before or after adding the spread and cheese. Depending on when you toast the bread, it will give different textures, but both are still very delicious.
instructions: This quick and simple delicious kiddie boan meal is very easy to prepare. Let's start by preparing the scrambled eggs. In a medium pan, fry the scrambled egg until set, then set aside to let it cool a bit before slicing.

Now we can start with the pandesal. Slice it lengthwise to create a space for the toppings and spread. Add a generous amount of Lady's Choice Bacon Spread on each side. Add the sliced scrambled eggs top it with slices of cheese. And that's it. Simple and delicious.

name: Ginisang Pechay at Tokwa Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Ginisang Pechay at Tokwa made extra special with Knorr Pork Cubes. Enjoy it with your family!
tips: Ang tokwa ay mura at maaring iluto sa iba’t-ibang klase ng simple at masarap na lutuing bahay.
instructions: Iprito ang tokwa sa mantika hanggang sa maging golden brown. Hiwain ng cubes ang tokwa at itabi.
Sa parehong kawali, igisa ang sibuyas at bawang hanggang sa lumambot. Idagdag ang pechay, tubig, pork cube at oyster sauce. Pakuluin ng bahagya at idagdag ang piniritong tokwa. Haluin.

name: Bulanglang
description: This classic vegetable soup, combines the fresh taste of different vegetables simmered in a clear broth, mixed with the crispy textures from your fried fish.
tips: Since we are using bagoong alamang in this recipe, you can add a little ginger to your dish to remove the fishy smell and taste (lansa), and this adds more nutrients to the soup.

ingredients.item: small fried bangus or galunggong sliced

instructions: You start by frying the fish in hot oil until it has a golden brown skin, then set it aside.

In a medium size pot, heat the pot and add in the oil. Sauté the garlic and onions, then add the bagoong alamang. Continue sautéing until you can smell all the aroma coming out of the vegetables and the alamang.

Add water to the pot, then add the Knorr Chicken cubes to dissolve. Throw in the Sweet potatoes and kalabasa and let the dish simmer until they are cooked and fork tender. You can now add the other vegetables, eggplant, ampalaya, ocra and string beans, then add your Saluyot leaves. Continue to simmer for an additional 5 mins.
Add the fried fish on top of the vegetables. Cover and simmer for an additional 2 mins.

name: Ginisang Carrots at Sayote
description: This heart health dish combines the fresh garden taste of carrots and sayote slices infused with rich pork flavors, topped with fried tofu for added textures.
tips: Sayote is a good source of zinc that help boost metabolism, Viatmins C for boost immunity, and folate for nerve development.
instructions: Let's start by getting a medium-sized pan nice and warm over high-medium heat. Add oil and sauté the garlic and onions until soft and brown.
Add the water, Knorr Pork Cube, sayote and carrots. Bring to a boil and continue to cook until vegetables are soft.
Add the fried tofu cubes before serving to give the dish more flavor and textures.

name: Miswa Egg Soup
description: Learn to cook a healthy and comforting dish in less than 30 minutes. Make this misua soup recipe with pechay, egg, and Knorr Chicken Cube.
tips: Mixing pechay to the dish makes this dish more heart healthy and it boosts the vitamins and minerals contents of the healthy soup. Pechay is full of cancer fighting compounds such as Vit C, beta carotene, and Vit E.
instructions: Get a medium pot, and make it nice and warm over high-medium heat. Add the oil and start by sautéing the garlic and onion until soft and brown.
Add the water and Knorr Chicken cube and bring it to a boil.
Lower the heat to simmer. Add the Misua noodles, then add the sliced pechay. When the noodles are soft, stir the mix then add the raw egg immediately to prevent the egg from building lumps.
Serve hot and Enjoy!

name: Ginisang Sayote with Sotanghon Recipe
description: Create healthy and delicious meal for family. Check out our easy to follow recipe for Ginisang Sayote with Sotanghon made special with Knorr Chicken Cubes.
tips: You just need to soak the Sotanghon noodles in hot water, no need to boil it, before using. It is recommended that you soak the noodles for at least 5 mins, in hot water, then drain, before adding to the dish.
instructions: Get a medium -sized pot, make it nice and warm over high-medium heat. Add the oil and sauté the onions and garlic until soft and brown.
Add the shredded chicken, sayote slices, water and Knorr Chicken Cubes. Let this boil until the chicken is cook and the sayote is soft.
Lower the heat and bring to a simmer. Add in the soaked sotanghon noodles, and simmer until cooked. Serve hot and Enjoy!

name: Paksiw na Bangus Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Paksiw na Bangus made extra special with Knorr Sinigang Mix. Enjoy it with your family!
tips: You need to remember to cook the vinegar until the sharpness and aroma of the vinegar is almost lost before serving. Let the dish release the vinegar aroma by simmering the dish at a low temp heat for around 15 minutes.
instructions: Heat a medium pan with water, vinegar, salt and whole peppercorn combined. Bring to a boil, uncovered.

Add the fish and let it simmer with the remaining vegetables, garlic, onion, sliced ginger, laurel leaves and eggplant. Mixed in the Knorr Siniggang Mix. Cover and let it simmer for around 15-20 mins.
Serve hot and enjoy this simple dish.

name: Ginisang Togue
description: This simple dish is packed with flavor and nutrients. Its has a right balance of crunchy textures from the togue and the crispy yet moist bites from the tofu.
tips: You can coat the tokwa with a little cornstarch before frying to make the outside extra crispy, and yet maintain the inside moist and tender.
instructions: This is very simple dish to make yet its delicious and full of nutrients. Start by making your pan nice and heated, add some oil, then fry your tokwa until its brown in all sides. Drain excess oil and set aside.

In the same pa, throw in the garlic and onions. Sauté the vegetables until its brown and soft. Then add your togue, Knorr Shrimp Cube and water. Let it simmer until well mixed and vegetables are cooked.
Remove from pan then top with cubed fried tokwa before serving.

name: Pancit Molo Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Pancit Molo made special with Knorr Chicken Cube. Prepare a perfect healthy meal for your family.
tips: Ang masabaw na miryenda o ulam ay maaaring dagdagan ng sariwang berdeng gulay tulad ng malunggay.
instructions: Igisa at tustahin ang bawang. Idagdag ang tubig at chicken cube. Pakuluin.
Idagdag ang pechay at isa-isang ilaglag ang molo wrapper para hindi magdikit dikit. Pakuluan ng 2 minuto.

name: Ginisang Sardinas at Ampalaya
description: This dish combines the fresh and slightly bitter taste of ampalaya with the savory and tangy taste of tomato based sardines, infused with garlic and onion
tips: To remove or lessen the bitter taste of ampalaya, you can try to soak the sliced ampalaya in salted water for at least 30 mins before use. Rinse it with cold water before adding to your dish to remove excess salt.
instructions: Get a medium pan, make it nice and warm over high-medium heat. Add a little oil and sauté garlic and onion until soft and aromatic.
Lower the heat to medium then add the sliced ampalaya, continue to cook until half cooked.
Add water and Knorr Chicken Cube, then continue to simmer for 2-3 minutes. Add the sardines and gently stir to combine.
Serve hot and enjoy!
categories: PH COVID EASY PANTRY HACK LUNCH

name: Laing
description: This dish perfectly combines the fresh and strong flavored gabi leaves, spicy kick of the sili, and the creamy and savory taste of coconut milk.
tips: Gabi leaves are very nutritious and packed with vitamins, and are very delicious when mixed with coconut milk, but it is also important to note that the raw leaves are poisonous before cooking. Make sure that we don't rush that cooking process, and that we cook the dried leaves properly.

ingredients.item: medium-sized ginger, peeled and sliced diagonally
Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix dissolved in 2 cups water

instructions: In a medium pot, start by making it nice and warm over high-medium heat, add the oil and sauté the garlic, onions and ginger slices. Stir occasionally, cook until soft and aromatic.
Lower the temp to medium-low heat. Add the dissolved Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix into the pot and bring to a simmer. Do not let the mix boil rapidly because it will cause the coconut milk to curdle.

Add dried gabi leaves and sili, and try to push down the leaves until all become moist. Do not stir the mix to prevent the leaves from breaking. Let the mix simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until leaves are soft.

name: Ginisang Ampalaya with Tinapa Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Ginisang Ampalaya with Tinapa made special with Knorr Chicken Cubes. Prepare this healthy meal today.
tips: Studies show that the leafy part of the Ampalaya is also packed with a lot of health benefits. Aside from lowering blood sugar, ampalaya leaves are also considered a good remedy for cough and can also fight fevers.
instructions: In a medium pan, get it nice and war over high-medium heat, add in the oil and sauté the onions and garlic until soft and brown.
Add in the ampalaya leaves, water, Knorr Chicken Cubes and deboned tinapa flakes. Let the dish simmer until all ingredients are fully cooked. It's that simple!

name: Malunggay Talong at Tanglad
description: This heart healthy dish combines the rich flavor of bangus with flavors from the eggplant, mixed with vegetable based soup.
tips: Malunggay leaves (Moringa Oleifera) is rich in essential vitamins and minerals. It is also rich in antioxidants which help in reducing the risks of heart disease and diabetes.

ingredients.item: tanglad puti at dulong parte lamang

instructions: Let start this dish by preparing our bangus. Cut a small bangus into sections that fry then until golden brown. Set aside.

Get a medium-sized pot, Add your water, Knorr Chicken cubes and tanglad cuts. Bring this to a boil, then add in the sliced eggplant. Lower the heat to simmer, and continue to simmer until eggplant is soft. Add the malunggay leaves.
Add the fried bangus cuts to the pot and let is simmer for an additional 1 minute. That’s it.

name: Ginisang Talong in Oyster Sauce
description: This dish is combines the fresh flavor of eggplant with garlic and onion flavors, mixed with the rich, sweet and caramel-like flavor of the oyster sauce.
tips: Oyster sauce is a good way to add rich flavor to your dish without adding lots of calories or fat. It is also cholesterol free. It can also help lower your blood pressure and increase blood circulation and oxygenation.

ingredients.item: small pieces talong sliced into rounds

instructions: Get a medium sized pot, and make it nice and warm. Add oil and sauté garlic and onion until brown and soft
Add in the eggplant and sauté until you get that slight brown outer crust.
Add the water, oyster sauce and crushed Knorr Pork cube, and continue to simmer for 2-3 minutes or until cube is fully dissolved.
Serve and Enjoy!

name: Gising Gising Recipe
description: Create healthy and delicious meal for family. Check out our easy to follow recipe for Gising Gising made special with Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix.
tips: When cooking with coconut milk, make sure that you do not let the mix boil because this will cause the mix to curdle and breakup. Set you heat to medium-low setting, just enough to make the mix simmer and slowly cook and release it's fresh flavors.
instructions: Get a medium-sized pot, make it nice and warm over high-medium heat. Add the oil and start by sautéing the garlic and onion until soft and slightly brown. Then add your sliced ginger and continue to sauté until you can smell the nice and fresh aromatics coming from the vegetables.
Dissolve the Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix into 1 cup of warm water, then add this to the pot. Lower the heat to simmer and stir until mix is completely dissolved.
Add in the sliced kangkong and sili, and continue to simmer until vegetables are soft. Add in the shredded tinapa. Season with salt and pepper. Serve and enjoy!

name: Mini Hotdog Sandwich Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Mini Hotdog Sandwich. A favorite family merienda made extra special with Lady's Choice Real mayonnaise.
tips: Ang almusal ang pinakamahalagang pagkain sa 56 isang araw. Ugaliing maghanda ng agahan para sa kalusugan ng inyong mga anak.
instructions: Hiwain ang hotdog sa dalawa. Hiwain ulit ng pahalang at iprito.

name: Traditional Friday-Favorite Ginisang Monggo Recipe (Filipino Mung Bean Stew)
description: This ginisang monggo recipe details how to cook mung beans simmered with garlic, onion, and tomato, then finished with your choice of protein. It’s a hearty stew that pairs well with fried or grilled Filipino dishes. Follow the steps so the mung beans turn soft and flavorful every time.
instructions: Clean and Soak the Monggo Rinse the monggo thoroughly under running water. Transfer beans to a bowl and fill with water. Soak for at least 1 hour. Remove any dirt, stones, or floating particles. Drain before using. Tip: Since mung beans are dried seeds, soaking helps them absorb water and soften faster. The longer you soak, the shorter the cooking time later.

Sauté the Aromatics Heat oil in a pot over medium heat. Sauté garlic until fragrant. Add onions and cook until soft and translucent. Stir in tomatoes and cook until they break down. Tip: Garlic, onion, and tomato contain natural sugars. Let them cook a little longer to deepen flavor through caramelization. This step builds the base of your monggo.
Brown the Pork Add pork strips and sauté until lightly browned and cooked through. Stir occasionally to cook the meat evenly.

Simmer the Monggo Drain the soaked monggo and add it to the pot. Pour in water and add Knorr Pork Cubes. Bring to a boil, then lower heat to simmer. Cook until the mung beans are soft and can be easily mashed with a spoon. This usually takes 35 to 45 minutes if soaked, or up to 1 hour if not soaked. Stir occasionally and add water as needed. Tip: If you prefer a thinner consistency, add more hot water. For a thicker stew, simmer longer until it reduces naturally.

Add the Vegetables Add ampalaya, if desired, and cook for about 2 minutes. Stir in malunggay leaves last and cook just until wilted. Tip: Always add leafy greens at the end. Overcooking can dull the color and texture. If you do not like ampalaya, use ampalaya leaves instead or simply add more malunggay.
Top and Serve Top monggo with crushed chicharon, if desired. Serve hot.

Serve hot and Enjoy!

name: Corned Beef Fried Rice
description: This perfect rice baon recipe mixes the savory taste of corned beef with the textures green peas and carrots, combined with the chicken flavor fried rice.
tips: Corned beef is packed with zinc and iron that helps in promoting good mental function, boosts energy and keeps us healthy and free from sickness.
instructions: Let's start by frying the corned beef. Get a large pan, big enough to fit our rice, make it nice and warm over high heat, add a little oil then fry the corned beef until 'dark and crispy. Set aside.
In a separate bowl, combine the beaten eggs and the crushed Knorr Chicken cube.
In a large pan, make it nice and warm over high-medium heat, add a little oil, then gradually pour in the egg mixture. Stir the egg and cut them into smaller pieces.

Add the corned beef, cold rice, carrots and green peas. Add the remaining Knorr Chicken cube and mix together with the rice. Stir until the rice, corned beef and egg mixture are well combined. Serve and Enjoy!
categories: PH COVID EASY PANTRY HACK BREAKFAST

name: Tokwa Sarciado
description: Make this budget-friendly tokwa recipe on busy weekdays! This tofu sarciado is simple, affordable, and bursting with flavor.
tips: Ang tokwa ay masarap at masustansiya na alternatibo sa karne dahil mayaman din ito sa protina.
instructions: Iprito ang tokwa sa mantika hanggang maging golden brown. Hiwain ng cubes at itabi.
Sa parehong kawali, igisa ang sibuyas, bawang at kamatis sa chicken cube at tubig.
Ilagay ang tokwa at itlog at haluing maigi.

name: Tokwa Arroz Caldo
description: This heart healthy dish combines the fresh flavor of garlic and ginger, mixed with sticky rice, topped with fried tofu for added flavor.
tips: Sticky rice health benefits include improved heart health, decreased inflammation and it boosts metabolism.
instructions: Let start by preparing the tofu. In a medium pot, make it nice and warm over high-medium heat, add oil and fry tofu until the skin becomes golden brown and firm. Once cooked, drain excess oil, slice into cubes and set aside.
In the same pot, add the garlic, onions and ginger, and sauté until soft and aromatic.

Add the rice, water and crushed Knorr Chicken cubes. Cover the pot and let the it boil. Occasionally stir just to prevent the rice from sticking to the bottom of the pot. Simmer until rice if fully cooked.
Serve hot topped with tofu cubes, and fried garlic.

name: Sardines Scrambled Egg Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Sardines Scrambled Egg made extra special with Knorr Chicken Cubes. Enjoy it with your family!
tips: Sardines is a good source of Omega-3 fatty acids that help prevent heart disease, reduce blood clots and lowers blood pressure.
instructions: Start by sautéing the onions with a little oil on a medium sized pan over high-medium heat.
Add the sardines, water and crushed Knorr Chicken Cubes. Lower the heat and bring to simmer until cube is completely dissolved.
Gradually add the egg mix to the pan. Start with 1/2 portion, wait until the egg sets before adding the remaining egg mix.
Serve hot and enjoy with rice or with your favorite bread.
categories: PH COVID EASY PANTRY HACK BREAKFAST

name: Meaty Spaghetree
description: This Christmas inspired pasta dish uses the rich flavor of ground pork combined with tomato sauce, onions, and garlic; twirled as mini kiddie Christmas tree.
tips: You can save and use some of the pasta water to add a deeper flavor and texture to your dish. Just add it to the sauce while simmering to get the desired sauce consistency.
instructions: Get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onions and garlic. Cook until light brown.
In goes the ground pork and cook until the color changes from pink to brown.
Add tomato paste and tomato sauce then sauté this for 2 minutes.
Now, cook the spaghetti noodles. Drain well and set aside when done.
Add sugar, pepper and water to the sauce and continue to simmer over medium-low heat for 15-20 minutes until sauce has slightly thickened.
Add Knorr Pork Cubes, stir well to dissolve and simmer for another 5 minutes.

To make the SpaghetTrees, you will need a tong and a big spoon. Using the tong, gently get a small portion of the cooked Spaghetti noodles. Twirl the tong until the noodles are entwined at the end of the tong. Use a big spoon to hold the noodles at the end of the tong. Transfer the noodles on a platter.
Top with your meaty Spaghetti sauce and sprinkle with grated cheese. Serve warm and enjoy!

name: Chicken Adobongga Recipe
description: Create Mommy Jolina's delicious and easy to follow healthy family recipe for Chicken Adobongga made special with Knorr Chicken Cube!
tips: Annatto (Achuete) is not only used to give color to dishes but it is also said to be good for diabetes, diarrhea, fevers, fluid retention, heartburn, malaria, and hepatitis. They also use it as an antioxidant and bowel cleanser.
instructions: First, heat oil in pan and sauté garlic and onions. Add all chicken and sear on all sides. You can sear chicken in batches to get a more even browning.

Pour in vinegar, soy sauce and water. Add bay leaves, pepper and atsuete oil. Bring to a boil then immediately lower the heat to let it simmer for 10 mins uncovered to cook off the vinegar taste and aroma. Try not to stir while simmering.
After 10 mins, add Knorr Chicken Cubes. Stir until completely dissolved. Continue to simmer for 10 mins or until sauce has thickened. Add sugar if preferred.
Serve warm and enjoy!

name: Lean Pork Siomai
description: This simple recipe combines the fresh flavors of vegetables, shrimp and the rich taste of ground pork mixed with Knorr seasoning flavor.
tips: You can also enjoy this recipe by deep frying the siomai. Get a medium pot, add 3-4 cups of oil and make it nice and warm over high heat, then fry the siomai for 5-7 minutes, or until it's golden brown in color.
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except for the wrappers, in a bowl until well blended. Chill covered for 15-30 minutes.
Wrap 1 tsp (avergae of 10 grams) pork mixture into wrappers then steam for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve warm.

name: Grilled Pork
description: This kid friendly baon recipe is very simple to make. It uses the savory and salty marination to add flavor to the pork cutlets.
tips: Before placing the pork in the marination, you can soak the pork cutlets in milk to tenderize the meat for about 1 hour. The milk enzymes will help break the protein, making the fibers and meat more tender.

ingredients.item: pork cutlets, skin and fat trimmed

instructions: Let's start by combining Knorr Liquid Seasoning and ground pepper in a small sealable bag or a bowl and place the pork cutlet to marinate. Keep in the marination for at least 20 minutes to get full flavor and taste.

Remove the pork cutlets from the marination, and place on a grill. Grill for 3-5 minutes per side, depending on the thickness of the cuts. Brush on the marination if the cuts become dry while grilling.
Serve hot and Enjoy!

name: Chicken Sisig Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Chicken Sisig made special with Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Prepare a perfect healthy meal for your family.
instructions: In a hot pan, toss together grilled chicken breast, liver, onions and sili sigang.
Season with calamansi juice, Knorr Liquid Seasoning and pepper. Toss well.
Off heat, gently stir in Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise. Serve.
To serve with egg: Transfer mixture into a hot sizzling plate. Break egg on top and stir while plate is still hot. Top with more Knorr Liquid Seasoning as desired.

name: Chicken Bacon Explosion
description: Take your Bacon, Lettuce, and Tomato sandwich up a notch. Add Lady's Choice Chicken Spread to your BLT recipe and relish the meaty explosion in every bite.
tips: Soak the lettuce leaves on cold water to maintain its crispiness.
instructions: Toast bread until lightly browned.
Put Lady's Choice Chicken Spread on the 2 slices of bread
Top the bread with 3-4 slices of bacon, 1-2 lettuce leaves, 1-2 slices of ripe tomatoes
Combine the two breads and serve.

name: Mega Melty Sandwich
description: Make grilled cheese with a meaty-sarap twist! Try the Lady’s Choice Mega Melty Sandwich! Its melty cheese and meaty flavors will surely delight kids. Make it for breakfast or as a baon snack using Lady’s Choice Ham Spread.
instructions: Spread butter on the side of the bread.
Toast sides of bread on a flat pan.
Spread Lady's Choice Ham Spread on 1 side of the bread.
Fill with 1-2 slices of ham and cheese.
Combine both slices of bread and continue to toast until cheese melted.
Serve while warm.

name: Chicken Lava Toast
description: Try a fun and delicious breakfast snack with a delightful twist, the Lady’s Choice Chicken Lava Toast. Keep your children’s breakfast sunny with fresh eggs and a meaty-linamnam helping of Lady’s Choice Chicken Spread.
instructions: Toast bread until lightly browned.
Spread Lady's Choice Chicken Spread on 1 side of the bread slices.
Arrange 1-2 slices of cheese on 1 side of the bread then sandwich with the other piece of bread.
Top the sandwich with a sunny side up egg. Serve immediately.

name: Bokchoy Curry
description: This creamy and sweet curry bokchoy dish combines your fresh vegetable taste with sweet pineapples, cooked in your creamy coconut milk sauce.
tips: Aside from being very delicious, eating bokchoy also has a lot of health benefits. Studies show that vegetables such as bokchoy help reduce the risk of developing cancer, and lower the risk of heart disease.
instructions: Wash bokchoy, cut the stalks in 1cm wide strips, cut leaves into wider strips. Clean peppers and oyster mushrooms and cut into strips.
Fry bokchoy stalks and peppers in a pan with hot oil, medium heat. Add and sauté oyster mushrooms. Add bokchoy leaves and fry briefly. Remove vegetables from the pan.

Pour 1 pack of Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix and 250mL water into the pan. Add curry spice seasoning and bring to a boil while stirring. Cook for a few minutes over medium heat. Add pineapple pieces and cooked vegetables and heat briefly in the sauce. Serve sprinkled with sesame seeds.

name: Spicy Monggo with Kale Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Spicy Monggo with Kale made special with Knorr Pork Cubes. Prepare a perfect healthy meal for your family.
tips: Kale is among the most nutrients-dense and vitamins-enriched foods on the planet. It is loaded with lots of antioxidants and is considered a super food.
instructions: Place the soaked monggo in a medium saucepan and cover with water. Simmer for 15-20 minutes until soft.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a big saucepan, add onion, garlic and ginger and cook for 7 minutes or until the onion has softened.
Add in the turmeric powder, cayenne pepper, tomatoes and tomato paste and cook for 5 minutes then add the sweet potatoes.
Add the monggo and cook for a another 5 minutes.
Dissolve the 2pcs of Knorr Pork Cubes in 1 liter boiling water, then add it to the pot. Add the kale and stir for 2 minutes. Half cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes.
Sprinkle the coriander and cashew on top and serve.

name: Mushroom Ramen Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Mushroom Ramen made special with Knorr Chicken Cubes. Serve this healthy meal to your family today.
tips: Try adding hard boiled egg to top this dish to add flavor and texture to your ramen. Just add egg in boiling water for 6-7 mins, then place in a bowl of ice water to prevent it from over cooking.
instructions: Prepare ramen noodles according to the instructions on the packet. Drain and set aside.
Peel the onion, garlic and ginger and finely chop. Peel carrots and cut into slices. Clean bokchoy and mushrooms and cut into slices or strips.
Fry vegetables in a wok or pot in hot oil, remove and set aside. Pour 1 liter of water into the wok and stir in 1 Knorr Chicken Cubes and bring to the boil.
Distribute the bouillon in bowls, add ramen noodles and vegetables. Garnish with calamansi slices.

name: Crunchy Hamwich
description: Make a healthy and meaty-sarap baon for your kids. Give them a ham sandwich with a fresh, crisp twist of apple slices. Try the Lady’s Choice Crunchy Hamwich!
instructions: Toast bread in toasted until lightly browned.
Spread Lady's Choice Ham spread on 1 side of the bread slice.
Arrange 1-2 slices of ham and cheese on 1 slice of bread then top with apple slices.
Sandwich with the other piece of bread. Serve.

name: Chunky Chicken Sandwich
description: Jazz up a tired chicken sandwich by adding Lady's Choice Chicken Spread, grapes, and almonds ingredients. Enjoy that meaty-linamnam flavor now!
instructions: Mix Lady's Choice Chicken Spread, shredded chicken, grapes, celery and almonds in a bowl. Mix well.
Slice croissants horizontally then fill with chicken mixture.
Serve.

name: Hamcheeza Sandwich
description: Upgrade a regular ham and cheese sandwich with Lady's Choice Ham Spread. Whip up this hamcheeza recipe and watch your kids find their new favorite snack.
instructions: Spread butter on the sides of the bread.
Toast sides of bread on a flat pan.
Spread Lady's Choice Ham Spread on 1 side of the bread. Fill with 1-2 slices of ham and cheese
Combine the 2 sides of the bread and continue to toast until cheese has melted.
Serve while warm.

name: Corned Chicken Macaroni Salad
description: Craving our classic Macaroni salad? Here’s a recipe that’ll make it even easier to prepare! Add a delicious and convenient twist by using Argentina Corned Chicken, paired with creamy Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise. Quick, easy, and perfect for the whole family.
instructions: In a bowl, combine Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise, pickle relish, celery, onions, salt and sugar. Mix well until well blended.
Gently fold in corned chicken, pineapple tidbits, cheese and cooked and drained macaroni. Blend well making sure pasta is well coated with mayonnaise mixture.
Chill for at least 2 hrs before serving.

name: Creamy Chicken Macaroni Salad
description: Learn how to make a creamy chicken macaroni salad with easy-to-find ingredients. A super delicious recipe that is perfect for special celebrations.
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Rinse under running water and drain well. Set aside.
Chop the ingredients (carrots, onions, pickle relish, pineapple, and chicken).
Combine the ingredients and fold-in with Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, then toss well. Season with sugar, salt, and pepper to taste.
Chill before serving.

name: Creamy Sweet Macaroni Salad
description: Enjoy this Filipino favorite: a creamy sweet macaroni salad recipe with fruit ingredients. Add this easy-to-prepare dessert to your next special occasion.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain well and set aside.
Chop the ingredients
Combine Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise with all the ingredients, condensed milk and all-purpose cream in a bowl. Mix well.
Serve chilled.

name: Simple Creamy Macaroni Salad
description: Laying off the meat? Whip up and enjoy this delicious meat-free Simple Creamy Macaroni Salad with Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise!

ingredients.item: pineapple tidbits, drained well; reserve juice
fine salt and ground white pepper to taste

instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Rinse under running water and drain well. Set aside. TIP: Drain pasta properly and cover while preparing other ingredients. Do not leave it exposed as this will dry the pasta.

Combine Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, sugar, pineapple juice, pickle relish, white onions, celery, and carrots in a bowl. Mix well until sugar has dissolved. TIP: Mix dressing ingredients and seasonings first to properly blend the mixture. Chunky ingredients like the pasta and fruits follow next.

Add in cooked macaroni, cheese, pineapple tidbits, and raisins. Mix well. Season with salt and pepper. Chill before serving. TIP: Chill salad for at least 4 hours before consumption. This will ensure the proper blending of flavors. When making a big batch, portion in small containers so you only bring out the batch you can consume in 1 eating occasion.
You can add shrimp or any seafood of choice.

name: Creamy Crabstick Sushi Bake Recipe for Your Next Family Gathering
description: For your next family gathering, turn to this sushi bake recipe that transforms Japanese flavors into a warm, scoopable tray layered with rice, creamy crab, and crisp seaweed. It’s easier to make than rolled sushi and even more fun to share. Enjoy a laidback bonding session as everyone gathers around and and builds their own wraps at the table.

ingredients.item: warm cooked Japanese, short grain, or Dinorado rice
warm cooked Japanese, short grain, or Dinorado rice

instructions: Prepare and Press the Rice Prepare a medium rectangular oven-proof dish. Press the warm cooked rice evenly into the dish, gently flattening it with the back of a spoon to create a compact base. Set aside. Tip: Lightly wet your spoon or hands with water to prevent the rice from sticking and to achieve a smooth, even layer.
Make the Crabstick Topping In a bowl, combine Lady's Choice Japanese-Style Mayonnaise and chopped crabsticks. Stir until evenly coated.
Layer the Mixture Spread the crab mixture evenly over the pressed rice, making sure it fully covers the surface from edge to edge. Sprinkle crumbled crispy seaweed on top.

Bake and Finish Preheat oven to 180°C. Bake sushi for 10–15 minutes or until the top is heated through and lightly golden. Remove from the oven and let cool slightly before serving with extra seaweed sheets for wrapping.

name: Creamy Adobo Sandwich Recipe
description: Try our easy to prepare adobo sandwich with a twist of Lady's Choice Mayonnaise to make it creamier

ingredients.item: leftover adobo shredded and bones removed

instructions: Combine mayonnaise and shredded adobo.
Fill in the pandesal.
Serve.

name: Crispy Tuna Melt Pie Recipe
description: Forget Jollibee's tuna pie. Make it at home with this recipe using Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise and other ingredients. Enjoy this creamy turnover.

ingredients.item: (180 grams) canned tuna in brine (well drained)

instructions: Combine all the filling ingredients. Mix well then set aside in chiller.
Combine all dry ingredients in a bowl. Add egg and half of the water. Mix until it forms into a dough. Chill covered in plastic film for at least 30 mins before rolling out.
Roll out dough until 1/4 inch thick. Cut out 12 rectangular pieces.

Put a scoopful of filling in the center of each rectangular dough. Brush the edges with water. Cover with another sheet and press the sides with a fork to seal. Fry in hot oil just until pies are nicely browned.
Fill in the filling in the pastry, arrange on a baking sheet and bake in a 375 deg preheated oven for 15-20 mins or until lightly browned. Let cook and serve.

name: Restaurant-Style Crispy Tofu Sisig Recipe With Creamy Sauce
description: For many Filipinos, tokwa sisig has become a go-to restaurant order when craving something savory but guilt-free. Instead of pork, tofu is made crispy and tossed with onions, chilies, and a creamy sauce, then served hot on a sizzling plate. Now you can cook this tofu sisig recipe at home and enjoy the same bold, satisfying flavors anytime.
