instructions: Fry the Tofu Heat a shallow pan over medium heat and add canola oil. Once the oil is hot, add tofu cubes. Increase to medium-high heat and fry until golden brown and crisp on all sides. Transfer to a wire rack or paper towels to drain excess oil. Tip: Pat the tofu dry before frying and avoid overcrowding the pan to keep the outside crisp while the inside stays tender.

Sauté the Aromatics Heat another pan over medium heat and add a small amount of oil. Sauté onions and garlic until fragrant and slightly softened. Add the fried tofu, bird’s eye chili, and long green chilies, then toss to combine.

Season and Add the Creamy Sauce Add Knorr Liquid Seasoning according to taste and mix well. Turn off the heat before stirring in Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise until evenly coated. Tip: Turning off the heat prevents the mayonnaise from separating and keeps the sauce smooth and creamy.
Serve the Tokwa Sisig Transfer tofu sisig to a serving plate. Top with a raw egg if desired and serve immediately with calamansi on the side.

name: Pineapple Cheese Sandwich
description: Enjoy the tangy combo of pineapple and cheese with this kid-friendly sandwich recipe. Use Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise to give it an extra creamy bite.
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl except for pandesal. Mix well.
Best to chill before filling into pandesal or sliced breads.

name: Crispy Chicken Burger
description: Taste this crispy chicken burger made delicious with Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise. Prepare and share this easy and crunchy recipe.
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Blend well and chill until ready to use.
Combine all batter ingredients together. Whisk well.
Slice each fillet thinly into 2. Pound with a mallet. Dredge in cornstarch then dip in batter then immediately fry in hot oil. Cook until lightly browned and crisp.
Spread generous spoonful of the dressing on the cut sides of the buns. Sandwich a pieces of fried fillet then top with shredded lettuce.

name: No-Bake Cookie Dough Ice Cream Sandwiches
description: Creamy Selecta Super Thick Vanilla sandwiched between homemade cookie dough? An easy, delicious no-bake dessert.

ingredients.item: Selecta Classic Super Thick Vanilla ice cream

instructions: Cream the butter, sugars, vanilla and salt together in a large bowl until light and fluffy. Add the flour, then fold in the chocolate chips or chopped chocolate. Divide the mixture in two.

Line a 8in x 8in square tin with cling film or baking/wax paper, leaving a small overhang and press one half of the cookie dough into the tin to cover the base. Remove the square of cookie dough and place into the fridge then line the tin once more with cling film, this time leaving a slightly larger overhang.

Press the second half of the cookie dough into the bottom of the tin and flatten with your hands. Scoop the ice cream on top of the cookie base and smooth out with the back of a spoon or palette knife, until smooth and flat. Chill in the fridge for at least 20 minutes.
Remove the cookie square from the fridge and place on top of the ice cream. Press down slightly and then place the whole thing into the freezer for at least 4 hours, or until frozen.

When ready to serve, remove the baking tin and turn the ice cream sandwich out onto a chopping board. Remove the cling film and with a hot blade, slice the sandwich into 9 equal squares. You can serve the sandwich at this point if you wish.

If using sprinkles and chocolate melt: dip each square into the melted milk chocolate, covering half of the sandwich, and then decorate with your choice of sprinkles—try to be quick at this point as the chocolate will set fairly quickly on the frozen sandwich. Serve straight away or place back into the freezer to serve later.

name: Mango Ice Cream Freakshake
description: Refreshing Selecta Super Thick Mango ice cream upgrades your mango float into an irresistible freakshake, with whipped cream and graham crumbs to boot.

ingredients.item: scoops Selecta Super Thick Classic Mango ice cream
Zest of 1/2 lime, lemon, or calamansi
all-purpose cream or instant whipping cream

instructions: Place the milk and Selecta Super Thick Mango ice cream into a blender and blend until smooth and thickened.
Place the mango, sugar and water into a small saucepan and slowly bring to the boil. Simmer for 10 minutes then add the lime zest and stir through.
Remove from the heat and pass through a strainer to remove any fibers then set aside.

Place your peeled mango ‘cheek’ onto a chopping board and thinly slice. Fan out the mango slices so that they form a long line with the slices overlapping each other. Remove the small slices from the ends if you’d like: they can be difficult to shape. Starting from one end, curl the mango slices toward the center, continuing to curl the slices until you get a rose.
In a bowl, whip the chilled cream into soft peaks and place into a piping bag. Alternatively, you can used instant canned whipped cream and skip this step.

To assemble the freakshake, dip the rim of your glass into the melted white chocolate, then into the crushed graham crackers. Using a spoon, drizzle the mango syrup into the inside of your glass, and then pour your milkshake into the glass.

Spoon the whipped cream on top of the milkshake then place the mango rose on top of the cream. Sprinkle with the remaining graham crackers and place your straw into the milkshake, threading it through the inside of your mango rose.

name: Ube Ice Cream Turon
description: Crunchy turon oozing with the richness of native Kinampay Ube, thanks to Selecta Super Thick Classic Ube Royale! Complete with jackfruit slices, coconut, and the taste of brown sugar, wrapped up in crispy turon.

ingredients.item: scoops of Selecta Super Thick Classic Ube Royale

instructions: In a bowl, mix the sliced banana / saba, desiccated coconut, and brown sugar together.
To enjoy the richness of native Kinampay Ube, add six scoops of Selecta Super Thick Classic Ube Royale. Once completely mixed, you can now freeze the mixture overnight.
Once completely frozen, slice the ice cream into 12 rectangles.
Get one slice of frozen ube and place two slices of jackfruit on top of it. Place these onto the bottom third of a turon wrapper.
In a separate small bowl, mix the icing sugar, flour, and water. This will be used later to seal the turon wrapper.

Dip the pastry brush in the mixed ingredients from Step 5 and apply it in the corners of the turon wrapper. Fold the wrapper once, then fold the sides to enclose it and roll. Repeat to make 11 more pieces of turon.
Deep fry the turon in oil until almost completely golden brown. Add caramel syrup and sugar almond slices to serve.

name: Brown Sugar Vanilla Milkshake
description: Go for a classic dessert drink with Selecta Super Thick Classic Vanilla with bananas and brown sugar syrup: the no-fail milkshake of your dreams.

ingredients.item: scoops Selecta Super Thick Classic Vanilla

instructions: To make the syrup, the brown sugar and water in a saucepan under low heat. Bring to a simmer and stir until all the sugar has been dissolved.
In a blender, mix Selecta Super Thick Classic Vanilla, milk, and bananas. Blend until fully combined and smooth.
To serve, drizzle the brown sugar syrup on the inside of a tall glass. Pour in the milkshake mixture to fill. For optional garnish, top with whipped cream and cookie crumbs to serve.

name: Mango Otap Float
description: Crispy otap, mango, and Selecta Super Thick Classic Vanilla bring a mix of textures to this creamy, comforting float.

ingredients.item: scoops Selecta Super Thick Classic Vanilla ice cream

instructions: Crush the otap cookies in a bowl. Slice the mango into small chunks.
In another small bowl, mix the cream and milk until combined.

To prepare the float, start with a layer of crushed otap in a glass. Drizzle with the milk mixture before adding a mango later. Add a scoop of Selecta Super Thick Classic Vanilla ice cream. Repeat the layers until the glass is filled, and top the last ice cream scoop with crushed otap.
Feel free to add other toppings or mix up the layers as you wish! Best served chilled.

name: Authentic Filipino Chicken Adobo Recipe With Deep Garlicky Flavor
description: Chicken adobo is often regarded as the national dish of the Philippines. It relies on the pairing of soy sauce and vinegar as its foundation. Chicken pieces simmer gently in this mixture until tender and richly coated in a garlicky reduction.
instructions: Sauté Aromatics Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat and sauté garlic and onions until fragrant and lightly softened. Do not let the garlic burn.

Sear Chicken Add chicken pieces to the pot and sear on all sides until the skin is lightly browned. Work in batches if needed to avoid overcrowding. Tip: Browning creates deeper flavor through caramelization and helps render excess fat from the skin.

Add Seasonings and Simmer Pour in vinegar, soy sauce, and water. Add bay leaves, peppercorns, and Knorr Chicken Cubes. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a gentle simmer. Do not cover the pan and let it cook for about 10 minutes, or until the chicken is nearly tender but not falling apart. Remove chicken pieces from the sauce. Tip: Keep the pot uncovered so the vinegar cooks off properly and mellows instead of tasting raw.

Fry Chicken Pieces In a frying pan over medium heat, fry the simmered chicken pieces until the exterior turns deeper brown and slightly crisp. Set aside. Tip: This second browning builds texture and intensifies flavor while helping the chicken hold up during the final simmer.

Simmer Adobo Sauce Until Thick Return the fried chicken pieces to the pot with the adobo sauce. Add brown sugar and simmer again until the sauce reduces and thickens enough to coat the chicken. Serve warm.

name: Pinoy Carbonara Recipe
description: This Pinoy-style pasta dish combines the smokey flavors of bacon, with the creamy mushroom sauce topped with crispy bacon and parmesan cheese.
tips: Bacon contains about 50% monounsaturated fats, specifically oleic acid, the same fatty acids that are found in olive oil which it is considered heart-healthy.

ingredients.item: strips bacon, cut into ½ cm slices
(68g) pack Knorr Cream of Mushroom dissolved in 3 cups water

instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain well and set aside.
In a pan, cook the bacon until crispy and set aside.
Using the same pan, add the butter and saute the garlic until light brown. Add sliced mushrooms and all purpose flour. Mix well.
Add dissolved Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup and allow to simmer until slightly thick.

You may add spinach leaves at this point. Add the all purpose cream. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Mix well. Do not simmer or boil as cream will curdle. Turn off the heat and toss in the cooked pasta.
Arrange the pasta in a plate then top with crispy bacon and Parmesan cheese.

name: Tinola Sa Gata Recipe
description: This Filipino Classic ginger-chicken broth soup mixed with coconut milk gives this classic dish its' sweetness and creamy texture.
tips: When cooking with coconut milk, do not let the mix boil or else the coconut milk might curdle and break up. Set the heat to medium or low and let the mix simmer to properly cook the coconut milk.

ingredients.item: sayote or ¼ pc. papaya, cut into wedges
(33 g) pack Knorr Complete Reicpe Mix Ginataang Gulay

instructions: First, get a pot and make it nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion and half of the ginger. Gently add the chicken and sauté for a good 1 minute.
Add the sayote or papaya in the pot and pour in the Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay which has already been dissolved in 2 cups water.
Throw in the remaining ginger and Knorr Chicken Broth Cube. Leave this to simmer for a minute.
When you can smell the wonderful aroma from the cooked chicken and vegetables, you can now place the dahon ng sili on top. Cook this further for another minute.
Discover a new taste that you’ll surely love when you add gata in Tinola. Your family will not only find it comforting but they will also take pleasure eating it.
categories: KNORR COMPLETE RECIPE MIX GINATAANG GULAY

name: Super Tender Beef Nilaga Recipe With Corn and Bok Choy
description: A staple in many Filipino homes, nilagang baka delivers comfort through a clear, savory broth and tender beef chunks. Corn, potatoes, and saba soak up the rich stock, adding natural sweetness and making each bowl even more satisfying. Make this beef nilaga recipe and bring a nourishing Filipino classic to your table.
instructions: Simmer the Beef Place beef shanks, water, onions, corn, and peppercorns in a large pot. Bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Skim off the gray scum that rises to the surface to keep the broth clear. Cover and lower heat to a gentle simmer. Cook until the beef is fork-tender, about 1 hour. Tip: Insert a fork into the meat and twist gently. The beef should yield easily without resistance.

Add the Root Vegetables Add the potatoes and saba bananas. Cover and simmer until the potatoes are tender but still hold their shape, about 15 minutes. Tip: Pierce the center of a potato with a knife. It should slide in smoothly without crumbling the edges.
Season the Broth Add Knorr Beef Cubes and stir until fully dissolved. Taste the broth and adjust seasoning if needed.

Finish with the Greens Add cabbage, pechay, bok choy, and squash blossoms, if using. Simmer just until the vegetables are tender and vibrant. Turn off the heat and serve hot. Tip: Avoid overcooking the greens. They should stay bright and slightly crisp for better texture.

name: Shrimp Sinigang Recipe
description: Craving something sour and savory? Try this shrimp sinigang recipe and enjoy the tangy flavors of this classic Filipino dish. Get the recipe from Knorr!
tips: Tamarind or sampaloc contains antioxidants that help control and reduce inflammation in the body.

ingredients.item: g. fresh medium shrimps, with head, shell and tail intact
(20g) pack Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original

instructions: Begin by using the water from when you washed your rice and pour this into the pot together with the onions and tomatoes. Bring this to a simmer for about 8 minutes.

Throw in the shrimp, long green chilli, radish, eggplant and okra and let this simmer until cooked through. Make sure that you have removed the black veins from the back of the shrimp with the help of a sharp pairing knife and that you have washed the head in cold running water because this is where the shrimp feces comes out.

Long beans, kangkong stalks and leaves are added at the last minute before pouring in the Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original. Give this a gentle stir and allow to simmer for a few minutes. If you want more of that “asim kilig” goodness, try using 1 (40g) pack of Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original.
With a bowl of patis and calamansi, and steaming hot rice, what more can your family ask for.

name: CREAMY SOPAS HACK WITH KNORR CREAM OF MUSHROOM SOUP
description: Some dishes just remind us of our truly Pinoy childhood. Have you been craving for that same warmth? You need not look far – you can cook up comfort in your kitchen with our rich macaroni soup recipe. Follow this easy and delicious recipe for the ultimate comfort dish, which we fondly call chicken sopas for the soul. Let this creamy macaroni soup transport you to good ol’ memories and your best days spent at home. It’s made even more special with Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup, which enhance the taste of this rainy season specialty.
tips: Level-up your macaroni soup with highly nutritious greens like malunggay leaves, spinach, or kale leaves. You can even add sprouts for extra crunch or garnish this creamy chicken sopas recipe with flavorful microgreens like cilantro.

ingredients.item: Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup dissolved in 1 litre of water

instructions: Cook elbow macaroni according to package directions. Set aside.
In a pot, sauté onions garlic and celery in hot oil until tender.
Add chicken breast and cook until color changes. Season with salt.
Add carrots, ham and dissolved Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup. Allow to simmer for 5 mins.
Add cabbage and corn. Season with pepper. Simmer for another 2-3 mins. then stir in evaporated milk if adding. Serve while hot.

name: Bicol Express Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Bicol Express. This dish balances the flavors of pork and spicy chilies made special with Knorr Pork Cubes.
tips: Lower down the heat after adding the coconut milk mixture, and do not let the mix boil because this might curdle and break up the cream.

ingredients.item: (40 g) pack Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix dissolved in 1-½ cups water

instructions: In a medium sized pot, get it nice and hot on medium-high heat. When hot enough, pour in a little oil and throw in the onions, garlic, ginger and shrimp paste.
Mash the shrimp paste and sauté the vegetables until you can smell the lovely aroma from the combined ingredients.
It’s time to add the pork. Allow the pork to cook for just a minute together with the aromatics (onions, garlic and ginger) to remove the gamey taste of the meat.

You may now pour the dissolved Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay and bring this to a boil. Adjust your heat to low and cook this to simmer before adding the chilies. Stir once in a while then finish by cooking the pork until tender.
Serve this dish hot but make sure you have enough rice for your family because they will definitely crave for more.

name: Spicy Bicol Express Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Spicy Bicol Express made special with Knorr Ginataang Gulay. Prepare a perfect healthy meal for your family.
tips: "Chili peppers are good for you. They are high in vitamins, a good source of beta carotene, calcium, and potassium, and may help reduce cholesterol. They also have medicinal properties.Ingesting Chili peppers can help heal ulcer by stimulating the stomach to create mucosa which lines the stomach and acts as a protective layer. Chili can also kill bacteria found responsible for causing ulcer. "

ingredients.item: (45 g) Knorr Ginataang Gulay Complete Recipe Mix dissolved in 2 cups water

instructions: This recipe is very simple and cooks in an instant. All you need to do is to remove the stems from the sili, slice it lengthwise and cut it into half-inch pieces. Remember to wash your hands after handling the sili because the seeds can cause a burning sensation.

Then, grab a medium-sized pot and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Now, you have to combine the Knorr Ginataang Gulay Complete Recipe Mix and ground pork. Bring these to a boil and then simmer for 10 minutes or until ground pork is cooked.
Now, throw in the sliced chillies and cook until soft. If using malunggay, add those at this point. And then, you can turn off the heat when the sauce thickens.
The spiciness from the sili will definitely make you crave for not just more water but also more of this Spicy Bicol Express Recipe!
categories: KNORR GINATAANG GULAY SITAW AND KALABASA COMPLETE RECIPE MIX

name: Sinigang na Baboy
description: This sinigang na baboy recipe uses the rich flavors of pork ribs and tamarind to create a lip-smacking experience. Try this classic take for your next meal.
tips: Tamarind contains lots of antioxidants and anti-inflammatory properties that help reduce the risks of heart disease, cancer and diabetes.

ingredients.item: pork spare rib cut into chunks
(20g) pack Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original

instructions: Begin by washing pork spare ribs in cold running water to remove any visible impurities. Then, place pork ribs submerge in a medium pot with a liter of water. Bring to a boil without covering the pot and allow the scum to float to the surface. Meticulously remove the scums from the surface of the water using a slotted spoon or a spatula. Scums are impurities found in meat.

After the broth clears up, turn you heat to medium setting, then it’s time toss in your onions and tomatoes to add flavor to the broth. Cover your pot and let it simmer to fully cook your meat. Use a fork to pierce the meat so that the flavors would also enter the meaty parts of the spare ribs, You also do this so you can tell if it’s already set and tender.

You can already add your vegetables. Start by adding the sitaw, kangkong stalks and talong into the pot and cook until these turn dark green. If you decide to use labanos and okra, you can also add those at this point. This should take roughly around 2-3 minutes.
Add in your siling sigang, kangkong leaves and the Knorr Sinigang sa Sampaloc Mix. Stir and let it simmer. It should be done in about 2-3 minutes.

All done! Transfer your Sinigang to a serving bowl. This is a happy treat that warms, soothes and satisfies everyone in the family! Remember to prepare extra servings of rice to enjoy the extra asim kilig taste of this Filipino classic soup. Enjoy!

name: Perfect Ulam Idea: Pork Menudo
description: If you're looking for an easy and delicious ulam recipe, try this Pork Menudo recipe that's ready in under an hour.
tips: Don’t have tomato sauce at home? You can use Filipino spaghetti instead. Make sure to omit the additional sugar.

ingredients.item: potatoes, medium sized, cut in cubes
carrot, medium sized, cut in cubes
pork kasim, cut into small cubes
pork liempo, cut into small cubes
pork liver, cut in small cubes
cubed red and green bell pepper

instructions: Heat up a pan over medium heat. Add 1 tablespoon of oil and sauté onion and garlic until fragrant.
Add the remaining oil and let it heat up before adding the pork kasim and pork liempo.
Fry until lightly browned and then add the pork liver. Cook for about 2 minutes.
Add the Knorr Pork Cubes into the pot and stir well until completely dissolved. Then add the tomato sauce, water, sugar, and black pepper. Mix well.
Add the carrots and potatoes into the pan. Cook over low heat until the meat and vegetables are cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Add raisins, bell pepper, and bok choy, if using. Let the pork menudo cook for 2 more minutes. Take off the heat and prepare to serve.

name: Ginisang Pork Monggo Recipe
description: Enjoy this ginisang monggo recipe any day. Try this nutri-sarap version, loaded with Knorr Pork Cubes, ampalaya, and malunggay leaves.
tips: Monggo beans possess enzymes, nutrients and antioxidants that are good for maintaining good heart and liver health. It's loaded with fiber and very low in calories.
instructions: Cooking is all about love and patience. There are certain dishes that need more attention than others, no matter how simple they are. But in the end, you can be sure that the reward is worth it. Monggo is one of those dishes that needs certain preparation before it is fully enjoyed by the family.

Since monggo is a seed, you need to wash the seeds first in water to get rid of the unwanted dirt they might have collected. And since monggo is a kind of dried bean, you need to soak monggo in water to soften them because seeds absorb water. You can soak monggo for a minimum of 1 hour but the longer you soak them, the less time you need to cook them. Make sure to remove the floating particles on top. You don’t want any dirt on your dish.

Once your beans are soft enough you can start sautéing the garlic, onions and tomatoes in a saucepan for about 2 minutes or more. Here’s a technique that most people do not know. Since your “aromatics” which are also known as your sautéing vegetables contain sugar, the longer you cook them, the more you develop flavour from caramelization.

The next step is the easiest because you just need to throw in the pork strips and saute until nicely browned. Drain the beans from the soaking water the add into your pot. Pour in 4 cups water, and the Knorr Pork Cube. Let this simmer until the beans can easily be mashed. Just a tip, if you want a thinner soup consistency, you may add more water. On the other hand, if you want a thicker soup consistency, simply lessen the amount of water or you may continue cooking until the sauce thickens.
We’re almost there! You just need to add in the ampalaya and cook this for 2 minutes more before adding in the malunggay.

What a reward this dish brings to the table for Ginisang Monggo is a healthy and delicious meal waiting to be enjoyed by the whole family. TIP: Monggo is best topped with chicharon and paired with any fried dish like fish or liempo. Tip: If you're not a fan of ampalaya, use ampalaya leaves instead or just add more malunggay leaves.

name: Chicken Curry Recipe
description: Enjoy Indian-inspired flavors by cooking this chicken curry recipe. This ulam is a terrific option for those who love a little kick in their meals.
tips: When cooking this dish, after adding the Knorr Ginataang Gulay mix, do not let the dish boil, have it a constant simmer only. Boiling may cause the cream or coconut milk to break or curdle.

ingredients.item: kilogram chicken cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: In a medium-sized pot over medium heat, pour the oil. Saute the garlic until browned. Add the onions and ginger. Saute the chicken pieces and let brown on all sides.

Add the Knorr Chicken Cube and curry powder. Saute for a few minutes, add the Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix and water. Add the potatoes and the carrots. Let it simmer for 15 minutes covered. Then let it simmer again for 10 minutes until the sauce is thick. Season with salt and pepper.
categories: PH COVID EASY PANTRY HACK DINNER

name: Sinigang na Maya Maya sa Miso Recipe
description: Miso-based sour soup has unique blend of savory taste of Miso mixed with the sour flavours of sinigang.
tips: Before cooking the Fish, make sure that you clean and remove the scales. The scales may contribute to the "very fishy" taste, "malansa" to the soup.

ingredients.item: rice washing, or use regular water
Knorr Sinigang na may Miso Mix

instructions: In a large pot, start by using the water from when you washed your rice and pour this into the pot together with the onions and tomatoes. Bring this slowly to a boil then lower the heat to simmer for 10 minutes.

Since fish cooks easily, drop the fish carefully and bring this mixture into a gentle boil. Make sure you remove the scales of the fish because the scales may contribute to the “malansa” taste of the Maya Maya. Next, throw in the chili and pour the Knorr Sinigang na may Miso Mix and the mustard leaves. Stir and simmer. It should be done in a minute. You may season according to your preference.
With enough rice, patis, calamansi or chili, Sinigang sa Miso is going to make you the hero of your home.
categories: KNORR SINIGANG NA MAY MISO MIX

name: Pork Siomai Recipe
description: This small bite sized dish contains a large amounts of flavor and texture that can be paired with your other main dishes, or it can be served as a great snack.
tips: You can serve steamed, baked, or fried.

ingredients.item: Knorr Pork or Beef Cube, mashed
chopped spring onions and carrots for topping

instructions: This is such an easy recipe and it’s very delicious too. All you need to do is combine the ground pork or beef, onion, spring onions, carrots, singkamas, Knorr Pork Cubes or Knorr Beef Cubes, sesame oil, egg and pepper in a bowl. Mix this well and prepare to assemble.

With the index finger and thumb touching together, place the wonton wrapper on top. Place a spoonful of the mixture in the center and push the filling down to create a pouch then leave the top open. Do the same with the remaining mixture.
Cook in a steamer lined with wax paper (bake paper or aluminium foil will do) for 20-30 minutes or until cooked through.
Now, here comes the best part! When you allow the siomai to cool down, deep-fry in pre-heated oil until crisp and brown.
Serve this with your favourite condiment and enjoy merienda with friends and family!
categories: KNORR PORK CUBE OR KNORR BEEF CUBE

name: Ginataang Gulay Recipe
description: The dish combines the sweetness and creaminess of the coconut milk with the fresh flavors and textures of your vegetables.
tips: Based on studies, Coconut milk contains lots of mineral and nutrients that helps in weight loss, reducing inflammation and reducing joint pains.

ingredients.item: (29 g) pack Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix, dissolved in 1 cup water
small small green siling haba, sliced

instructions: Begin by getting your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onion and garlic. Cook until the onion is soft and the garlic is golden brown.
Gently add the kalabasa and sitaw and pour in the dissolved Knorr Complete Recipe Mix and siling haba. Stir well and cover until the vegetables are half cooked.
Throw in the malunggay leaves and shrimps and then continue to simmer until kalabasa and shrimps are fully cooked. And there you have it!
Ginataang Gulay is the perfect complement to any of your favourite dishes. You can simply have it as is. Like home, it’s a comfort dish!

name: Classic Ginataang Sitaw at Kalabasa Recipe Made Easier
description: Ginataang sitaw and kalabasa is a classic Pinoy dish that’s sure to be in everyone’s list of top 10 favorite gulay ulam. This recipe takes the classic and makes it easier to make on those busy days using Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix.
tips: For an extra boost of nutrients and flavor, add a bunch of malunggay into the mix.

ingredients.item: 45g Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix, dissolved in 1 ½ cup of water

instructions: Make sure to have all your ingredients prepped and ready for cooking as this dish comes together quickly.
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat and add the onions and garlic. Sauté until fragrant.
Add the chopped kalabasa and sauté for a minute.
Next, add the dissolved Ginataang Gulay Recipe MIx into the pot and let simmer for 3-5 minutes.
Add the sitaw (string beans) into the pot and let simmer until the vegetables are cooked through.
Add the shrimp and let it simmer until it changes color. Make sure to watch the pot so as not to overcook the shrimp.
Remove from the heat and serve on its own or with your favorite ulam.
categories: PH COVID EASY PANTRY HACK LUNCH

name: Fully Loaded Pancit Canton Recipe Perfect for Any Celebration
description: Pinoy celebrations are never complete without a generous platter of noodles at the center. This pancit canton recipe brings that festive spirit to your table, combining tender noodles with savory meats, seafood, and fresh vegetables. Each strand absorbs a well-seasoned sauce that makes it worthy of both everyday wins and major milestones.

ingredients.item: small piece carrot (cut into thin strips)
cabbage or small bok choy (sliced into thick strips)

instructions: Simmer the Pork Place pork and ¼ cup water in a wok or large pan over medium heat. Boil for 10–15 minutes or until the water evaporates and the pork becomes tender.
Brown the Pork Pour in oil and sauté the pork until lightly browned and slightly crisp on the edges.
Sauté Aromatics Add onions and garlic. Cook until soft and fragrant.
Cook Liver and Shrimp Add chicken liver and sauté until fully cooked and no longer pink inside. Add shrimp and cook until they turn pink and curl slightly.
Add the Vegetables Once the shrimp changes color, add carrots, sitsaro, cabbage or bok choy, bean sprouts, and kinchay. Sauté for 1 minute to keep the vegetables crisp.
Prepare the Sauce Add 2 cups water, Knorr Shrimp Cube, and soy sauce. Simmer until the cube dissolves completely. Season with black pepper.

Separate Meat and Vegetables Remove the meat and vegetables from the pan. Drain in a strainer or colander, then set aside in a bowl. Tip: This step ensures the noodles cook directly in the stock, helping them absorb flavor while keeping the vegetables firm.

Cook the Noodles With the stock still simmering, add the pancit canton noodles. Stir occasionally to help the noodles absorb the broth evenly. Tip: Move the noodles around gently so they soak up all the flavor. If the liquid dries up before the noodles are tender, add a small amount of water.

Assemble and Serve Transfer the cooked noodles to a serving platter. Arrange the cooked meats and vegetables on top. Serve hot with calamansi on the side. Tip: Add shrimp balls, fish balls, quail eggs, or shredded chicken for extra texture and flavor.

name: Chicken and Pork Adobo Recipe
description: This Filipino Classic dish has the right balance of sweet and spiced flavors coming from the spiced soy-vinegar mix and the rich flavors of chicken and pork.
tips: After adding the vinegar, let the mix to boil and do not cover your pot, or you will end up with a raw vinegar taste.
instructions: Begin by choosing a pot that’s big enough to fit the chicken and pork adobo. Bring the pot to medium high heat and sauté the garlic and onions in hot oil.

Add the chicken pieces into the pot and sear on all sides. Searing means to brown the meat in high heat. This adds flavour and color to the meat. Make sure that the meat pieces are not wet or you will not achieve the desired color you are looking for. You can do this in batches so you do not overcrowd the pot because the juices from the meat will run out and thus prevent the browning effect of the meat. Add the pork and sear as well.

The next step is to pour the vinegar, soy sauce, bay leaves, pepper, water, Knorr Chicken Cube. Bring this up to a boil over high heat then lower the fire to a simmer. Do not cover your pot or you will end up with a raw vinegar taste. This will take about 20 minutes.

For a more flavour-filled adobo, remove the chicken and pork pieces from the pot and fry this separately in another pan for about 2-3 minutes. When done, throw in the fried meat pieces into the pot, add the sugar and simmer for another 6 minutes or until the sauce has reached a syrup-like consistency. To add fiber into your dish, add sliced Bok-Choi last and cook for 2 minutes.
This all-time classic dish is now ready to be enjoyed by the whole family with a bowl of steaming rice.

name: Korean Fried Chicken Recipe
description: Take your chicken to Korea with this special but easy recipe. Impress your family by cooking Korean fried chicken with ease using Knorr Liquid Seasoning.
tips: You can use flour to cover the marinated chicken before frying to remove excess water from the meat, and in turn, it reduces the amount of oil splatter when frying.

ingredients.item: kilogram assorted chicken pieces (thigh, wings, drumstick)
calamansi juice or 1-10g pack Knorr Sinigang Mix Original

instructions: Start by adding the chicken to the brine mixture. In a large bowl, simmer water and salt, simmer until salt dissolves. then submerge chicken in brine water with salt for 3-6 hours. Keep in chiller while brining.
Remove the chicken in brining liquid and let it drip dry.
Sprinkle all-purpose flour on the chicken pieces., to remove excess brine water.
Prepare batter: In a bowl, mix the kamote starch and cornstarch. Mix a little bit of ice cold water enough to make a paste-like consistency.
Fry chicken: Heat your oil and fry your chicken for about 3-4 minutes per side, until nicely browned. Fish out and set aside. Let it cool.

Let's now make the glaze. In a medium pot, mix together the fish sauce, Knorr seasoning, grated ginger, honey, calamansi juice (or Knorr Sinigang Mix), and bring to a boil, let it cool and set it aside.
Toss the fried hicken in the prepared glaze. Sprinkle sesame seeds.
categories: " SPICY GREEN BEANS SALAD SERVED WITH A DELICIOUS HARISSA AND HELLMANN'S MAYONNAISE DRESSING"

name: Sizzling Beef Bulgogi Recipe
description: Create healthy and delicious meal for family. Check out our easy to follow recipe for Sizzling Beef Bulgogi made special with Knorr Beef Cubes.
tips: Sesame oil is sensitive to heating, so use it as a finishing oil to give your dish it's authentic asian flavor and aroma.
instructions: Combine hot water, Knorr Beef Cubes, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, garlic, leeks, orange soda and ginger to make your marinade. Marinade the beef for at least an hour.

To cook, you may cook on a hot pan/wok by stir-frying the beef with some of the marinade. On a sizzling plate, add butter, togue and the beef. Drizzle with sesame oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Serve while sizzling. On a grill, preheat grill then cook beef slices. Transfer onto a plate then drizzle with sesame oil and sesame seeds.

name: Chicken Katsudon
description: This simple dish uses the flavors of fried chicken cutlets, mixed with sweet flavors of onions, scrambled eggs, topped with leeks and nori, served oven rice.
tips: Kastudon is a popular Japanese dish, the term itself is derived from two Japanese words, "Tonkatsu" ("Ton" meaning pork, and "katsu" meaning cutlet) and "donburi" meaning large bowl.

ingredients.item: all-purpose flour, seasoned with salt and pepper

instructions: Dredge chicken fillets in flour, pressing lightly to for flour to adhere. Shake off excess flour.
Dip the pieces in beaten egg, then roll in breadcrumbs.
In a pan suitable for deep frying, heat oil over medium heat. Deep fry breaded chicken and cook about 2 minutes or until golden brown in color.
Drain chicken pieces in paper towels to remove excess oil. Set aside.
For the sauce, in a medium pan, make it nice and hot over med - high heat, add oil then sauté onions and ginger until you can smell the great aroma.
Add the water, sake, mirin, Knorr Chicken Cubes, Knorr Liquid seasoning, and continue to simmer the sauce until all is dissolved and well combined.

Using another pan, add oil and sauté white onions until soft and brown. slice then add the fried chicken pieces on top of the caramelized onions. Add Katsudon sauce enough to cover the chicken pieces.
Cover the chicken and the onions with the beaten eggs, continue to heat and wait until the egg have set.
Serve chicken on top of steamed rice. Drizzle with a little more Katsudon Sauce. Garnish with leeks, spring onions, nori and pepper flakes, if desired.
in a medium pan, make it nice and hot over med - high heat, add oil then sauté onions and ginger until you can smell the great aroma.
Pour in sake, then add in ginger and leeks.
Add one-fourth of a Knorr Chicken Cube and keep stirrring until it dissolves properly.
Add Knorr Liquid Seasoning, water and mirin.
Simmer until sauce is reduce in half. Serve with fried chicken fillet.

name: Chicken Pad Thai
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Chicken Pad Thai.

ingredients.item: chicken thigh, cut into thin strips
shrimps, peeled with tail intact, deveined (optional)
rice noodles, cooked according to package directions
garlic peanuts (or garlic and peanuts), roughly chopped

instructions: Combine all ingredients for the sauce and bring to a simmer
In a bowl, add eggs, fish sauce, leeks
In a wok, cook egg until crispy
Set aside and cut into strips
In a wok, add oil, saute onions, garlic, shrimp
Then add your cooked rice noodles and sauce
Cook together with tongs or fork so you don't break the noodles
To plate, transfer on a serving dish. Top with shredded egg omelette, peanuts and coriander leaves.

name: Tom Yum Soup Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Tom Yum Soup made extra special with Knorr Pork Cubes. Enjoy it with your family!
tips: When cooking with coconut milk (gata), make sure that you don't let the soup to boil after adding the coconut milk, or else it might curdle and breakup during cooking.

ingredients.item: inch knob pc ginger / turmeric thinly sliced
gata (Use ½ pack Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix dissolved in ½ cup water or evaporated milk)

instructions: In a large pot, sauté onions, garlic, lemongrass and bayleaf until you smell the fresh spiced aroma. Then add the siling labuyo.
Add water, ginger, crushed Knorr Pork Cubes and Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to simmer. Add the calamansi juice, and continue to simmer at low heat.
Add the tomatoes and mushroom, and continue to simmer for 3 minutes. Check seasoning, add salt and pepper if needed.
Pour the Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix dissolved in water, then let it simmer over low heat until thick before stirring in the cream. Add the cubed tofu and continue to simmer for 2 minutes
Serve and enjoy this spicy and flavorful Thai dish.

name: Chicken Embutido Recipe
description: This simple pinoy style dish uses the rich chicken flavor combined with fresh vegetables, rolled and steamed to perfection
tips: Make sure that you let the steamed embutido cool down a bit after cooking, before you decide to slice it, or else it might crumble into pieces when sliced.
instructions: You will have no worries preparing this dish because it’s as easy as pie. All you need to do is, first, prepare a steamer by filling it with water half way into the pan. Let the water boil.

In a large bowl, place all the ingredients for the embutido- ground chicken, raisins, onions, sausage, carrot and pickles. Add mashed Knorr Chicken Cube, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, egg and flour. Mix well.
Divide the mixture into 4 - 5 portions. Wrap each portion in a piece of aluminum foil by rolling into a log. Secure the ends by crimping and folding.
Place the rolled embutido into a steaming basket then steam for 40 minutes or until fully cooked. Insert a pairing knife to check if mixture is cooked.

To make the sauce, get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour oil and throw in the garlic. Cook until slightly brown. Pour the tomato sauce, water and Knorr Chicken Cube. Let simmer and season to taste.
Unwrap embutido and slice diagonally. You may also pan-fry the embutido before slicing to get a nice brown color.
Chicken Embutido, served with sauce on top or on the side, is just so satisfying to eat that you can have this any day, any time of the week.

name: Bistek Tagalog Recipe
description: This dish combines the rich taste of marinated beef with the soy-based sauce combined with the tangy taste of calamansi.
tips: When marinating the meat, its best that you do it longer, recommended 1-3 hours before cooking, so that the flavors and spices penetrate the insides of the meat.

ingredients.item: beef sirloin slices, ¼” thick, pounded

instructions: Let’s begin by mashing the Knorr Beef Cube with a mortar and pestle. Pound it well and then slowly drizzle 3 tbsp of olive oil. Mix this well. Massage this mixture onto the beef slices.
For the next step, cover the beef in breadcrumbs.
Now, get your pan nice and hot over medium high heat. Pour some oil and pan-fry the beef slices. Set this aside.
You can now remove the excess oil from the pan.

Let’s now make the sauce: Add the Knorr Liquid Seasoning, calamansi juice, water and sugar in a bowl. Season this with black pepper and adjust the seasoning of sauce as desired. Thicken the sauce with diluted cornstarch and drizzle the sauce on top of the fried beef and top with glazed onion rings. That’s our dish!

Your family will always find comfort in Bisteak Tagalog! This is home! May this recipe allow you to create more memories with your loved ones as you enjoy the company of one another while eating this dish.

name: Pork Humba Recipe
description: Try this pork humba recipe for your next Sunday family lunch. Expect praises for its unique sauce with pineapple juice, black beans, and Knorr Pork Cube.
tips: To keep the meat tender, cook in low heat from start to finish. Its also recommended that for the last 5-10 mins of simmering, keep it uncovered to remove the sour and tangy taste of vinegar.

ingredients.item: Optional: Serve with steamed Bok-Choi or Spinach

instructions: Get your pan nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and sauté the onion, garlic until brown and soft, then add the cubed pork.
Add Knorr Pork Cubes and black beans. Sauté for a minute.
Pour the vinegar and let this simmer before adding the pineapple juice, water, brown sugar, soy sauce, chillies and banana blossoms.
Cook this covered at low heat until pork is tender and sauce has thickened. Taste and check the seasoning.
With hot rice, you’ll find yourself eating more than usual. So, what are you waiting for? Give this recipe a try!

name: Pork Adobo by Mommy Jolina
description: Mommy Jolina's Pork Adobo is a staple in their family's Christmas celebration. With her secret ingredient Knorr Pork Cubes, you can enjoy this simple but special Noche Buena favorite too!
instructions: In a large sauce pan, saute garlic in cooking oil until golden brown.
Add the pork, pepper corn, and Knorr Pork Cubes. Stir continuously until the fat melts.
Pour in the soy sauce, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, sesame oil, bay leaves, and water. Bring to a boil without stirring. (Mix-in the vinegar only when the mixture starts boiling).
Once boiling, stir everything. cover and reduce heat to low fire.
Once no more water is present and the meat is already tender, add sugar and patis while stirring until the fat comes out of the meat.

name: Chicken Adobo sa Gata by Chef Vanjo
description: By adding coconut milk, it creates a new layer of sweetness and flavors, combined with the spices and rich taste of slow cooked marinated adobo chicken.
tips: Aside from adding fresh and spiced flavors, Bay Leaf is also a rich source of Vitamin A, Vitamin C, Iron, Calcium and Potassium. Studies show that it might also help reduce and treat migraines.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan.
Crush the garlic, then sauté until it starts to brown.
Fry the chicken for 1 to 1 ½ minutes per side.
Pour soy sauce and vinegar. Cover the pan. Let boil. Flip the chicken pieces afterwards. Continue cooking for 5 minutes.
Add whole peppercorn and bay leaves.
Combine Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix and 2 cups water. Stir. Pour into mixture. Stir and let the mixture boil.
Add Knorr Chicken Cube. Stir and cover the pan. Adjust heat to low. Cook for 20 minutes.
Remove the cover and continue to cook until sauce reduces to desired amount.
Serve with warm rice. Share and enjoy!

name: Creamy Spaghetti by Mommy Jolina
description: This dish uses the unique combination of creamed mushroom mixed with a tangy taste of ketchup, combined with the flavors of ground pork and beef.
tips: Mushrooms are not only rich in flavors, but they are also good sources of protein and antioxidants. It helps maintain a healthy immune system, boost your bone health and helps reduce the risk of neurological illness in the future.

ingredients.item: Cream of Mushroom (Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup, mixed with water)

instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions. Set aside.
In a large sauce pan, sauté garlic until golden brown. Add the onion.
Add the ground pork and beef. Add the Knorr Pork Cubes, salt and pepper, and sugar. Mix well, then reduce to medium heat.
Cover until it simmers, while stirring constantly. Cook until the fat of the meat melts for about 30-45 minutes.
Add the tomato sauce, cream of mushroom mixed with water, all-purpose cream, and banana ketchup while stirring continuously. Reduce to low heat until the sauce thickens.

name: Meaty Spaghetti by Chef Vanjo
description: This simple pinoy-sytle dish combines the rich flavors of pork and hotdog with the rich taste of tomato sauce. This will surely be the kids snack option.
tips: Save some of the pasta water, and eventually add it to your sauce. This will add a little more flavor and thickness to the sauce.
instructions: Make the sauce by heating oil in a cooking pot. Sauté onion and garlic until its soft and tender.
Add ground pork. Cook until light brown. Add ground pork. Cook until light brown.
Pour tomato sauce into the pot and then add water. Stir. Let boil.
Add Knorr Pork Cube. Stir and cover the pot. Cook for 30 minutes between low to medium heat.
Put-in hotdogs. Cook for 5 minutes.
Season with sugar, ground black pepper, and salt.
Prepare the spaghetti by following the package instructions.
Arrange the cooked spaghetti in a serving plate. Top with meaty spaghetti sauce and shredded cheese.
Serve. Share and enjoy!

name: Beef Mechado by Mommy Sunshine
description: This simple dish uses the rich flavors of beef infused with the sweet caramelized onions and garlic, mixed with tomato sauce served with potatoes, carrots
tips: When sautéing onions, wait for it to soften and turn slightly brown in color. This will give of a slightly sweeter flavor and aroma.
instructions: In a large pot, sauté garlic and onion in a pan until soft and transparent in color. Fry the beef, cook until outside becomes brown.

Add 1.5 L water and tomato sauce. Lower the heat to medium and simmer until the meat is fork-tender. This step might take around 30 mins depending on the quality of the meat. Remember to remove any scum that rises to the top of the liquid.
Add laurel leaves, soy sauce, potatoes, carrots, green peas, corn, and Knorr Beef Cubes.
Add in pepper, sugar, and bell pepper. Cover and simmer for a few minutes.
Add soy sauce, sugar, and pepper according to taste.

name: Sinigang na Baboy by Mommy Beauty
description: This dish is truly a Filipino classic, using the sour and tangy taste of the tamarind soup, mixed with the rich taste of pork combined with fresh vegetables.
tips: Try to remove the scum from the initial pork liquid before the liquid reaches the boiling point, or else it might end up melting and blending with the rest of the liquids.

ingredients.item: Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Original Mix 44g

instructions: Boil the pork ribs in 8 cups of water for 15-20 minutes. Add salt. Remember to remove the scum that lift to the surface.
Add in tomatoes and onions. Let it simmer until tomatoes are soft and tender. Crush the tomatoes to release more flavors. Add 2 cups of water while the pork meat continues to soften.
Add in the siling pansigang & 1 pack of Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Original Mix.
Add okra, gabi, and kangkong. Continue to simmer for 2 minutes.
Serve and enjoy.

name: Chicken Curry by Mommy Melai
description: This dish combines the rich flavors of chicken with the sweet and spiced savory flavors of your curry mixed with carrots and potatoes for added texture.
tips: When cooking with curry, it's better to cook the dish at a slower pace. Make sure that you set the temp to low - medium heat, and let the curry extract and release the flavors from the spices into the dish.

ingredients.item: Knorr Sinigang Ginataang Gulay Mix (40 g)

instructions: Brown the carrots and potatoes then set aside.
Sautee ginger, onion, and garlic.
Add the chicken meat. Sautee until golden brown.
Add the curry powder, Knorr Chicken Cubes, and ground pepper. Stir well.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes in low heat.
Combine Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix with 1 1/2 cups water. Stir. Pour mixture into the pot.
Add carrot, and potato. Bring to a boil in low heat.
Add salt to taste.
Add bell pepper.
Cover and simmer for 5 minutes, until the sauce thickens.

name: Pork Humba by Mommy Melai
description: This dish uses the rich flavors of the pork marinated in a sweet marinate, mixed with the soy-vinegar sauce blend topped with fried banana and black beans.
tips: We use softdrinks / soda to marinate and tenderize our meat, due to the high level of acidity, and it also give the meat the added sweetness and flavor.
instructions: Fry the pork until the outsides are brown, and drain the excess oil.
In a medium pot, add the fried pork in a mixture of water and clear softdrinks. Let it boil.
Add in salt, sugar, pepper, vinegar, soy sauce. Then add in Knorr Pork Cubes.
Continue simmering until the pork gets fork-tender.
Put fried banana and black beans.

name: Pork Humba by Chef Vanjo
description: This sweet-savory dish combines the rich flavors of slowly cooked pork belly, soy-vinegar marination sauce, sweet spiced flavors of pineapples.
tips: Humba, originated in the Visayas islands, is derived from a Chinese dish. It refers to slow-cooked highly spiced pork belly.
instructions: Pour water in a cooking pot. Let boil. Add the pork pata cuts. Scoop out the scums that will eventually float. Cover and boil in medium heat for 40 to 60 minutes. You can add more water if needed.
Remove the pata from the cooking pot and set it aside. Discard the water.
Pour oil into a clean cooking pot. Once the oil gets hot, sauté garlic and onion.
Add the boiled pata. Stir and cook for 1 minute. Pour the soy sauce and pineapple juice into the pot. Let boil.
Add Knorr Pork Cubes. Stir.
Add the dried bay leaves, cracked peppercorns, dried banana blossoms, and salted black beans (tausi). Stir. Cover and continue to cook between low to medium heat until the liquid reduces to half.
Add the vinegar. Stir then add brown sugar. Continue to cook for 5 minutes uncovered.
Transfer to a serving bowl or plate. Serve. Share and enjoy!

name: Sinigang na Hipon by Chef Vanjo
description: This dish uses the natural flavors of shrimp, gently cooked in a clear tamarind broth soup mixed with fresh vegetables and aromatics.

ingredients.item: Knorr Sinigang Sa Sampalok mix 44 g

instructions: Boil water in a cooking pot. Add onion, tomato, and radish. Cover and continue to boil for 8 minutes.
Add shrimp. Cook for 1 minute.
Add Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix. Stir until it dilutes completely. Cover and cook for 3 minutes.
Add kangkong leaves. Turn off heat. Let it stay covered for 1 minute.
Season with fish salt and ground black pepper.
Add kangkong leaves. Turn off heat. Let it stay covered for 1 minute.
Transfer to a serving bowl. Serve warm with rice.

name: Pork Menudo by Chef Vanjo
description: This dish combines the rich flavors of pork with the fresh and thick flavor of your tomato sauce mixed with different textures from the potatoes and carrots.
tips: Don't rush cooking this dish. Let the dish simmer for a long time to tenderize the meat and develop more taste.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Once the oil gets hot, sautee garlic and onion until onion softens. Add pork. Sauté until light brown.
Pour tomato sauce, water, and soy sauce into the pot. Stir. Let boil.
Add dried bay leaves and Knorr Pork Cube. Stir. Cover the pot and lower heat to simmer for 45 to 60 minutes, or until the pork becomes tender.
Put the hotdogs into the pot. Cook for 1 minute. Add potato and carrots. Cook for 5 minutes or until potatoes are fork tender.
Season with salt and ground black pepper. Stir and cook for 3 minutes.
Transfer to a serving plate. Serve. Share and enjoy!"

name: Meaty Spaghetti
description: This simple dish will surely be a hit with the family. It combines the flavors of ground pork with the rich flavor of tomatoes and cheese.
tips: Using a little pasta water in your sauce can make it smooth and it adds body to the sauce.

ingredients.item: Knorr pork or beef broth cubes

instructions: First, cook the spaghetti noodles according to package directions. Drain well and set aside. Leave some pasta water for later use.
Next, get a pan and make it nice and hot over medium heat. Pour some oil and throw in the onions and garlic. Cook until light brown. Then add the ground pork and cook until the color changes.
Add Knorr Pork Cubes, stir well to dissolve before adding the tomato paste and tomato sauce. Just sauté this for 2 minutes.

Now, add sugar, pepper and water and continue to simmer over medium-low heat for 15-20 minutes until sauce has slightly thickened. Give this a nice seasoning of salt. You can add more sugar if preferred. You can also use the remaining pasta water to add starch and body to the sauce.
Now comes the best part! Get a big platter ready for your cooked spaghetti noodles and pour the sauce on top with a sprinkle of grated cheese. And that’s our dish!
There’s always a party when there’s meaty spaghetti. Have this any day of the week and you’ll surely have a treat!

name: Air Fried Sinigang Fried Chicken
description: Level up your favorite fried chicken with the asim-kilig deliciousness of Knorr Sinigang

ingredients.item: chicken leg / drumstick washed and patted dry
(20g) pack Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original

instructions: Begin by marinating chicken in Knorr Sinigang Sa sampalok Mix Original and fish sauce for at least 30 minutes.

Arrange the marinated chicken in the air-fryer basket. Do not overcrowd the basket to make sure all pieces will be crispy and will brown nicely. This will also make frying faster because the heat will be able to move around better.

Drizzle some oil on the chicken and turn on air-fryer at 180C. Cook for 30-40 minutes. Turn chicken pieces half-way thru the cooking time. Place on paper towel to remove excess oil. And that's our dish. Once you try this recipe, it will surely become one of your favorite dishes. It’s amazingly delicious!

name: Air Fried Siomai Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Air Fried Siomai made special with Knorr Pork or Beef Cubes. Serve this healthy meal to your family.

ingredients.item: Knorr Pork or Beef Cube mashed
chopped spring onions and carrots for topping

instructions: This is such an easy recipe and it’s very delicious too. All you need to do is combine the ground pork or beef, onion, spring onions, carrots, singkamas, Knorr Pork Cubes or Knorr Beef Cubes, sesame oil, egg and pepper in a bowl. Mix this well and prepare to assemble.

With the index finger and thumb touching together, place the wonton wrapper on top. Place a spoonful of the mixture in the center and push the filling down to create a pouch then leave the top open. Do the same with the remaining mixture.
Cook in a steamer lined with wax paper (bake paper or aluminum foil will do) for 20-30 minutes or until cooked through.
Now, here comes the best part! After allowing the siomai, air-fry the siomai by brushing the surfaces with some oil then air-fry for 10-15 mins at 180C.
Serve this with your favorite condiment and enjoy merienda with friends and family!

name: Utan Bisaya Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Utan Bisaya, Laswa, Lay-Uy or Bulanglang in other region made special with Knorr Shrimp Cubes.

ingredients.item: sml pc ginger, peeled and sliced thinly
red onions, peeled and sliced thinly

instructions: Boil water and Knorr Shrimp Cube in a pot.
Add gabi, ginger, tomatoes, onions and bundled tanglad. Allow to boil then reduce heat to a simmer. Cook for 3 minutes.
Add kalabasa and okra and let cook until gabi and kalabasa are tender.
Add and cook alugbati, malunggay and leeks for another 1 min. Remove from heat.

name: Law-Uy Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Law-Uy (Bulanglang) made extra special with Knorr Pork Cubes. Enjoy it with your family!

ingredients.item: sml pc ginger, peeled and sliced thinly
red onions, peeled and sliced thinly

instructions: Boil water and Knorr Shrimp Cube in a pot.
Add gabi, ginger, tomatoes, onions and bundled tanglad. Allow to boil then reduce heat to a simmer. Cook for 3 minutes.
Add kalabasa and okra and let cook until gabi and kalabasa are tender.
Add and cook alugbati, malunggay and leeks for another 1 min. Remove from heat.

name: Kani Sushi Recipe
description: Love crabsticks? Make them shine with Lady's Choice Mayonnaise to your kani sushi. Try this kani mayo maki version and watch everyone ask for your recipe.
instructions: Sushi Rice: Wash rice with water 3 times. Drain then add 1 cup water. Cook until soft. While rice is cooking, combine vinegar, sugar and salt. Mix well until sugar is dissolved. Once rice is cooked and while still hot, fluff rice using a wooden or plastic spoon. Do not use metal spoon. Drizzle vinegar mixture over the rice while continue fluffing gently. Set aside to cool completely.
Mix Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise and wasabi in a small bowl. If you have a piping bag or squeeze bottle, transfer mayo mixture for easier dispensing.

To assemble the sushi, lay Nori sheet on top of sushi mat then with clean hands, scoop about a handful of rice. Wet hands and finger with clean water so the rice wont stick to your hands/fingers. Spread and press rice on the Nori sheet. Leave about half an inch on the top portion of the sheet.
Arrange the kani sticks horizontally on the lower edge of the sheet. Squeeze mayo mixture along the kani sticks.
Start rolling the mat over the kani sticks. Make sure to roll tightly. Slice into 1 inch pieces. Do the same with rest of the ingredients. Serve with wasabi and Japanese soy sauce on the side.
If you have remaining kani sticks and mayo mixture, shred kani sticks then mix with mayo. Top this on the slice sushi.

name: Ultra Creamy Spaghetti Carbonara Recipe
description: Make this non-traditional yet oh so creamy carbonara using easy-to-find and budget-friendly ingredients.
tips: Don’t rinse your spaghetti carbonara noodles. The starches on the pasta helps the sauce stick.
instructions: Cook spaghetti noodles according to package directions.
While the spaghetti is cooking, in a separate pan, fry bacon until crisp. This will take about 5 minutes.
In the same pan, add chopped garlic and cook over medium heat until fragrant. Make sure not to burn the garlic.
Take the pan out of the heat and stir in Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, parmesan cheese, and pepper. Stir well to ensure no lumps.
Add cooked spaghetti and toss in the carbonara sauce until fully coated.
Season the spaghetti carbonara to taste. Serve warm.

name: Simple Yet Flavorful Chicken Sinigang Recipe
description: Enjoy some asim-kilig goodness with our simple yet flavorful Chicken Sinigang Recipe.
tips: Siguradong asim-kilig na paborito ng pamilya ang Chicken Sinigang!

ingredients.item: Knorr Sinigang sa Samploc with gabi
fish sauce and ground white pepper to taste

instructions: Saute garlic, onion and crushed ginger in a pot.
Add in the chicken pieces once the onion has softened. Saute until the chicken pieces turn light brown.
Add some water, and let it boil.
Put in the radish into the pot. Add the Knorr Sinigang sa Samploc with Gabi shortly after.
Cover the pot, and let it simmer over low heat for around 35 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, long green pepper, and string beans to the pot.
Season with ground white pepper and fish sauce. Let it boil for about 8 minutes.
Add the spinach (or kangkong), and cover. Let the residual heat cook the spinach.

name: Pork Liempo Ramen Recipe
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Pork Liempo Ramen made special with Knorr Pork Cubes. Prepare a perfect healthy meal for your family.

ingredients.item: water, for boiling the the ramen

instructions: Let's start with the Tamago marinate. In a medium pot, combine the Knorr Liquid Seasoning, lemongrass, brown sugar, garlic, sake and mirin, and let it simmer until the sugar is dissolved.
Stain the marinate to remove the large particles and place the liquid in tall container to cool to room temperature.

We can now prepare the Japanese style eggs. Fill a saucepan with water enough to fully cover the eggs and let it boil. Once boiling, lower the heat to medium-high heat, then gently lower each eggs into the pot, be careful not to crack the shells.
As soon as you lower the eggs, set the timer to 6 1/2 minutes, this makes the egg have the white set while the yolk is still a bit runny. The water should still be bubbling but not rolling boil.

Once the time is up, remove the eggs from the pot and immediately place them in an ice bath to stop the cooking process and to cool down the egg. Place it in the bowl of ice water for at least 3 minutes.

Place the peeled eggs in a large container then slowly add the marinate to cover the entire egg. Let the eggs marinate for at least 2 hours, but you can keep them in the marinate fo 8-12 hours for more flavor.
Remove the eggs from the marinate and keep them in an air tight container for storing. The marinated eggs can last for 4 days in the chiller.
Get a large pot, add water and bring this to a boil. Add chicken bones and pork bones, and let it boil for at least 10 mins. Remove all scum from the surface.
Drain the water and wash the bones with cold running water to remove all blood and remaining guts and dirt from the bones.

In a large pot, add the cleaned bones, 8 cups of water, onions, leeks and crushed Knorr Pork Cubes, and bring this back to a boil. Gently scoop any scum that resurfaces in this second boiling procedure. Do not stir the broth to avoid making the broth cloudy.
Lower the heat to simmer while still continuing to remove any scum. Continue to simmer the broth for 2 hours with the lid on.
Strain the broth to remove all the big particles like bones and vegetable, and retain only the broth liquid.
Let's now we can prepare the pork liempo. Get a medium pan, heat the oil over high heat, and sear the pork fat side down, until the liempo has a nice brown color.

While waiting for the liempo to brown, in a medium size pot, prepare the liempo marinate, combine Knorr Liquid Seasoning, Mirin, sake, brown sugar, lemongrass and garlic. Add the seared liempo to the marinate, and let the mix boil. Remember to remove scum from the surface. Continue to simmer for 30 mins, or until the sauce thickens turning the liempo every now and then.
Let the marinate pork liempo cool down before slicing. Keep some of the liempo thick sauce for the final ramen bowl.

Heat griddle pan, remove meat from the marinade ( reserve the marinade). Grill meat until golden in color and grill marks appear on the meat surface, about 3 to 4 seconds each side, depending on the thickness of the meat.
Put grilled meat in a pot and pour in stock. Let it simmer to extract the flavor of the grilled pork into the stock, about 10 to minutes or until ready to use the stock.
Remove meat from the stock, and slice about 1 inch thick. Set aside
In a skillet, heat the reserved liempo marinade and simmer until the sauce is reduced in half. Set aside.
In a pot, bring water to a boil and cook ramen noodles for about 3 minutes. Remove from heat and drain. Set aside.

We can now build our ramen. We start by cooking our ramen noodles in boiling water for 4 mins, then place in a bowl dividing it into 4 equal portions. In each bowl, add our liempo thick sauce, and cover the noodles with our ramen. Top with sliced liempo, Ajitsuke Tamago cut in half, chopped spring onion and sesame seeds."
In a bowl, add about 2 tablespoons of the tare sauce then pour in the ramen stock until the bowl is half full.
Fill the rest of the bowl with cooked ramen noodles.
Top with pork slices and sliced egg. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and spring onions. Serve.

name: Roast Chicken with Apple and Cinnamon Glaze Recipe
description:
Roast chicken is everywhere! You can find them in long-time lechon manok stalls crowded with patrons or have your senses assaulted while you try to do your grocery shopping. Wherever you choose to get your inihaw, the only thing that differs is the roast chicken recipe used. Otherwise, the cooking method and our eating habits remain the same. 
               
               
               
              Eaten with rice, a side of atchara, and maybe some dipping sauce, it’s safe to say we enjoy our chicken roast à la BASIC. Nothing wrong with sticking to the classics. However, mix it up a little now and then. Roasting has always been a healthy way of cooking chicken, but when you switch to skin-off fillet pieces, you up the ante. 
               
               
               
              Since nobody enjoys flavorless chicken, we’ve got a restaurant-worthy recipe that even the kids will enjoy.
instructions: Make the glaze by combining butter, cinnamon, lemon zest, honey, apple juice, and cane vinegar in a saucepan over high, bringing it to a boil.
Reduce the heat once simmering and sauce thickens.
Brush the glaze over the apples and set this aside.
Reserve leftover cinnamon glaze for later use.
Take the mashed Knorr Chicken Cube and rub it all over the chicken with rosemary, pepper, and thyme.
Transfer the chicken pieces and glazed apples into a baking dish. Drizzle a little bit of oil over it.
Bake in a preheated oven for 375F or until the meat cooks through.
Plate and pour reserved glaze on top.
There are countless ways you can thaw out frozen poultry. As a rule of thumb, never leave the meat in a 40F environment when defrosting to avoid the growth of bacteria.
Before cooking, defrost chicken in the fridge for 24 hours.
Submerge the entire bag of frozen chicken in tap water. Thawing time will depend on the size of the chicken. For best results, change the water every half hour.
Thaw in the microwave, but make sure to cook immediately after.

It develops stronger bones and muscles. Your body requires amino acids for stronger muscles, especially when you age. Fortunately, chicken is chock-full of this stuff. Since studies show that high protein intake is essential in maintaining body mineral density, eating chicken can help promote healthier bones and stronger muscles. Regular chicken consumption also reduces the risk of injuries and decreases the possibility of diseases like osteoporosis.

It is loaded with vitamins and minerals. Compared to pork, oven-roasted chicken does not contain a lot of fat. But aside from the high protein content, lean chicken cuts also contain: • Zinc • Copper • Iron • Vitamin B12 • Tryptophan • Choline

It helps in weight management. Weight gain is often the cause of binge eating. But did you know that consuming 25-30 grams of lean protein per meal can help you feel fuller? Protein-rich meals are heavier on the stomach, even when you consume less. Eating moderate amounts of roast chicken can help you sustain a healthy weight and enjoy its benefits.

It boosts your mood. The same amino acids that help strengthen bones and muscles contain tryptophan which boosts serotonin levels in the brain. Although the tryptophan in chicken isn’t enough to give you an instant buzz of euphoria, you can pair it with other ingredients, such as spinach, salmon, and cheese, to push that effect.

name: Simple Hainanese Chicken Rice
description:
Hainanese chicken rice is to Singapore as adobo is to the Philippines. Considered the Lion City’s national dish, it has become such a staple that one hawker has even earned a Michelin star for producing a perfect version of this dish. 
               
               
               
              Born from economic necessity, immigrants from China's Hainan province created this dish to extend the flavor of the chicken. The stock-infused rice, in a way, added weight to the meal despite miniscule portions of chicken. Made originally by members of the servant class, it's no longer surprising these days to see this poached chicken dish in posh restaurant menus. 
               
               
               
              The beauty of this dish is that you can enjoy it at home or in a restaurant. If you want to try the former, here's a step-by-step recipe for newbies and experienced cooks.

ingredients.item: kg. whole chicken, excess fat trimmed
long grain white rice, rinsed and drained

instructions: Begin by preparing the marinade for the chicken. In a blender, process half of the rice wine, half of the ginger and spring onions, as well as the soy sauce. Rub this mixture inside the chicken cavity. You can use a mortar and pestle in place of a blender. Make sure to mash until all ingredients are well combined. Chill in the fridge to allow the chicken to absorb the marinade.

Heat 8 cups of water in a large pot, bringing it to a boil. Add Knorr Chicken Cube bouillon and half of the spring onions, rice wine, and ginger. Stir well and ensure cubes dissolve fully. To keep the skin of the chicken intact, slowly dip half the bird into the pot. Use a ladle to baste the bird with stock. Do this a few times until the skin visibily tightens before fully submerging the chicken into the liquid. Turn off the heat, cover, and let stand for 30-45 minutes.

Take the chicken out after 30-45 minutes and bring the stock back to a boil. Turn off the heat and slowly add the poultry back in. Cover and let stand for another 30 minutes. Remove the chicken, leaving it to cool. Set the remaining stock aside. This gentle poaching method is a technique employed in many hawker stalls across Singapore. It ensures the skin remains undamaged while sealing in the meat's moisture. Boost its meaty flavor further by combining soy sauce and sesame oil to rub over the chicken before it is sliced and served. A dish worthy of showing off, make this Hainanese recipe even more authentic by preparing some rice and following a Hainanese ginger sauce recipe.
Heat up the oil in a large skillet or wok on medium to high heat
To this, add some chopped up chicken fat, garlic, salt, and ginger. Sautee for about 10 minutes or until aromatic.
Set aside a quarter of the fried garlic mixture.
Add the rice to the remainder of the fried garlic, stir and cook for 3 minutes.
Transfer the garlic oil infused rice to a rice cooker.
Use poaching broth instead of water to cook the grains.
Set the appliance to cook the rice until tender.
Plate with slices of poached chicken and dipping sauces on the side.
In a large heat proof bowl, combine spring onions, sea salt, ginger, and sesame oil. Set this aside.
Heat oil in a pan until it is close to smoking point.
Add the oil into the bowl where the rest of the ingredients are. Stir thoroughly and allow to cool.
Season with extra salt.

name: Creamy Deviled Eggs Recipe for Your Next House Party
description:
Deviled eggs are an appetizer commonly seen at many parties and events. Ancient Romans served seasoned boiled eggs to start feasts and large gatherings. Offering canapes while entertaining guests was supposedly a common practice for wealthy Romans at the time. 
               
               
               
              However, a recipe from 13th-century Spain is the one that closely resembles deviled eggs of modern times. Copies of the earlier recipe show ingredients like onion juice, pepper, and cilantro mashed into boiled egg yolks. It also had a fermented sauce called murri, salt, and oil. The mix was stuffed into hollowed egg whites. However, the Spanish instructions called for the split eggs to be held back together with a pepper-topped toothpick instead of today's halved look. 
               
               
               
              It was in the late 1800s when American deviled eggs made their appearance in local news. In 1896, cookbooks recommended adding mayonnaise to the formula. The classic recipe is the one that stuck. Since then, this quintessential appetizer-snack has experienced only minor changes. 
               
               
               
              Entrées may not be standards in the Filipino party menu, but there is no reason they shouldn’t be. One of the simplest morsels to prepare for your next handaan is deviled eggs. This beginner deviled eggs recipe can turn any affair into an egg-citing one!
instructions: Peel off shell then slice each hard-boiled egg lengthwise. Carefully separate the yellow yolks from the egg whites and place the yolks in a mixing bowl. Mash the yolks together with a fork to remove clumps.
Add in the Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise and mustard. With a fork, whip the mixture together, removing as many small clumps as possible. Add in remaining ingredients, excluding the paprika.
Using a dessert decorator tool or pastry bag, pipe the yolk mixture into the hollowed egg whites.
Garnish the finished products with a hint of paprika

name: Mango Milkshake Recipe with Three Toppings
description:
Philippine mangoes are said to be the finest in the world and are one of the sweetest fruits you’ll find in the country. There are countless ways to enjoy one of the sweetest fruits grown in many backyards, and these can extend to milkshakes, too. 
               
               
               
               
               
               
               
              Sipping a refreshing drink is the perfect way to beat the tropical heat, and it can stir up excitement when toppings are involved. Here’s the ultimate mango milkshake recipe that will let you experience that fruity, creamy goodness.

ingredients.item: scoops Selecta Super Thick Classic Mango ice cream
Zest of 1/2 lime, lemon, or calamansi
all-purpose cream or instant whipping cream

instructions: Place the milk and Selecta Super Thick Mango ice cream into a blender, and blend until smooth and thickened.
Place the mango, sugar and water into a small saucepan and slowly bring to the boil. Simmer for 10 minutes then add the lime zest and stir through.
Remove from the heat and pass through a strainer to remove any fibers then set aside.

Place your peeled mango ‘cheek’ onto a chopping board and thinly slice. Fan out the mango slices so that they form a long line with the slices overlapping each other. Remove the small slices from the ends if you’d like: they can be difficult to shape. Starting from one end, curl the mango slices toward the center, continuing to curl the slices until you get a rose.
In a bowl, whip the chilled cream into soft peaks and place into a piping bag. Alternatively, you can used instant canned whipped cream and skip this step.

To assemble the freakshake, dip the rim of your glass into the melted white chocolate, then into the crushed graham crackers. Using a spoon, drizzle the mango syrup into the inside of your glass, and then pour your milkshake into the glass.

Spoon the whipped cream on top of the milkshake then place the mango rose on top of the cream. Sprinkle with the remaining graham crackers and place your straw into the milkshake, threading it through the inside of your mango rose.

name: Easy Pumpkin Soup for Creamy Kalabasa Soup Lovers
description:
Often made with a combination of pumpkin or squash varieties, aromatics, butter, milk or cream, spices, and garnished with greens or seeds, we aren’t surprised that most cooks get intimidated by any pumpkin soup recipe. But today, we’ll share the creamiest kalabasa soup recipe – and it’s not complicated at all! 
               
               
               
              In fact, you can quickly prepare a bowl of creamy pumpkin soup with only a few key ingredients that are easy to stock. All you’ll need are fresh pumpkins, cream, Knorr Beef Cubes, and Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay, and you’re good to go.
tips: Keep your veggies and aromatics simple. Add the basics, like cinnamon, garlic, onion, pepper, and get creative when you become more comfortable whipping up a batch of creamy kalabasa soup. For an extra dose of nutrition (and to plate the dish at home like those pumpkin soups served in fancy restaurants), garnish yours with parsley, cilantro, toasted seeds, and a dash of cream.

ingredients.item: pc. pumpkin, small, cut into cubes
(33g) pack Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Ginataang Gulay

instructions: Heat a medium-sized pot over medium heat. Pour in oil and sauté onions and garlic until fragrant.
Add the pumpkin and let it sweat for one minute over high heat. Pour just enough water to submerge the pumpkin into the pot and bring to a boil.
Add Knorr Beef Cubes, and let simmer for about 20 minutes until the pumpkin is tender.
Using an immersion blender, puree the mixture until smooth. Alternatively, you transfer the mixture into a heatproof blender to puree until smooth. Then, put the mixture back into the pot.
Add Knorr Cream of Pumpkin Soup and stir well. Simmer for one minute.
Turn the heat off and pour the cream into the soup. Season with cinnamon and pepper to taste and stir.

name: Modern Filipino Chicken Adobo With Spinach
description: This modern chicken adobo keeps the classic soy sauce and vinegar base but adds spinach for a fresh vegetable boost.
