The spinach cooks right into the sauce, adding color and balance while soaking up all that savory goodness. It’s an easy way to cook chicken adobo with vegetables and bring a wholesome twist to this Filipino favorite.
instructions: Sauté the Aromatics Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Sauté garlic until fragrant, then add onions and cook until soft and translucent.

Sear the Chicken Add chicken and sear it on all sides until the skin starts to brown. Tip: Let the chicken sit undisturbed for a few minutes before turning so it browns properly instead of steaming. Avoid overcrowding the pan for better color.
Add the Adobo Base Pour in the vinegar, soy sauce, and water. Add bay leaves, peppercorns, and Knorr Chicken Cubes.

Simmer the Chicken Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium-low. Do not cover the pan. Simmer for 10 minutes. Tip: The sauce should be slightly reduced but still loose at this stage, since it will continue to thicken later when the chicken is returned to the pan.
Brown the Chicken Further Remove the chicken pieces and place them in a separate hot pan. Fry until the skin turns deep golden brown and lightly crisp, turning once to brown the other side.

Finish with Spinach Place the fried chicken pieces back into the first pan. Add the spinach and sugar and let simmer for another 10 minutes or until the sauce has thickened. Serve warm. Tip: Add the spinach only at the end so it just wilts into the sauce and stays vibrant instead of turning overcooked and dull.

name: Birthday Cake Made Easy: The Ultimate Guide for Newbies
description:
No birthday party is complete without a birthday cake. And while you can order this celebratory treat from any old bakeshop, we still think the best kind is homemade. For many people, baking is a relaxing hobby that allows them to perfect their skills and express their love for friends and family—but if you’re a newbie, no-bake recipes are the perfect starting point. 
               
               
               
              Today, we’ll teach you the basics of making a homemade cake for birthdays and beyond. We’ll also share our best no-bake take on birthday cake—all you need to do is combine the ingredients and chill them in the fridge.

ingredients.item: Selecta Super Thick Classic Chocolate ice cream, enough to make one layer

instructions: Make the pie crust by combining crushed cookies, melted butter, and powdered sugar.
Stir with a fork until mixture starts to clump. Look for the texture of wet sand, add a little more melted butter if crumbs are not clumping.
Press the crumb mixture into a pie pan, making sure you have an even layer. Freeze for 30 minutes.
While the crust is setting, mix powdered sugar, cream, and vanilla in a bowl until stiff peaks are formed.
Assemble by arranging cut slices of banana on top of the ready crust.
To this, add softened Selecta Super Thick Classic Chocolate ice cream Make sure the ice cream is soft enough to spread but not melted. Now add another layer of banana slices.
Chill for another 15 minutes.
Frost this with the whipped cream. Instead of dolloping the cream freehand, you can transfer it into piping bags to create a smooth and tidy decorative top layer.
Chill until ready to serve.

name: Sweet, Sour, and Savory Macaroni Salad Recipe
description:
Who can resist a well-made macaroni salad loaded with only the good stuff? Filipinos of all ages are very fond of this particular salad, so much so that it makes a habitual appearance in any celebration, whether it be a baptism, a birthday party, or even a wedding reception. Christmas, including the many joyous days that come between it and New Year’s Day, is never complete without a big bowl of macaroni salad! 
               
               
               
              This liking for a seemingly simple salad is not by mere accident. There are many reasons to prove this salad’s worth: First, it’s so easy to make! It can be done in mere minutes without even breaking a sweat. Even the simplest chicken macaroni salad recipe can be prepared by a toddler with minimal supervision. 
               
               
               
              Second, it’s quite affordable to put together as well. Compared to other popular salads, this one only requires a few staples already sitting in your pantry. No need for a special trip to the specialty shop to score hard-to-find ingredients. And lastly, this salad offers infinite satisfaction that tickles all the senses. Taste, texture, color? Check, check, check!

ingredients.item: pineapple tidbits, drained well; reserve juice
fine salt and ground white pepper to taste

instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Rinse under running water and drain well. Set aside.
Combine Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise, sugar, pineapple juice, pickle relish, white onions, celery, and carrots in a bowl. Mix well until sugar has dissolved.
Add in cooked macaroni, ham, cheese, pineapple tidbits and raisins. Mix well. Season with salt and pepper. Chill before serving.

name: Mixed Fruit Salad with Mango Mayo Dressing for Your Kids' School Lunchbox
description:
Getting children to eat healthy and nutritious food can be challenging. With so many readily available snacks loaded with processed sugars and MSG, all wrapped up in colorful packaging it’s no wonder why kids are ignoring veggie-filled meals and fruit salad cups in their lunchboxes. 
               
               
               
              Even with access to wholesome yogurt drinks and cereals as baon, kids are still reaching for extremely unhealthy treats. To get this sorted, parents should level up their arsenal of tactics to get their little ones to try out salad.

ingredients.item: lollo rosso lettuce, cut into bite-sized pieces
head iceberg lettuce, cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: In a bowl, combine Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise with mango puree and honey. Mix well.
Toss the greens well with the dressing then arrange on plate.
Top with grapes, peaches, and apple and served chilled.

name: Extra Crispy Korean Fried Chicken​ for Your Date Night
description:
Date nights are always special, but you can take them further by making extra crispy Korean fried chicken for dinner. The sweetness and crunch will lead to enjoyment and laughter and help the two of you make warm memories around the dinner table. 
               
               
               
              We have a recipe that isn’t hard to follow, even if you’re not a kitchen expert. Once you have all the ingredients, grab your trusty cooking equipment and you are set.

ingredients.item: kilogram assorted chicken pieces (thigh, wings, drumstick)

instructions: In a large bowl, make the brine by mixing 2L water and rock salt, then placing it on the stove and simmering until the salt dissolves.
Remove it from the stove. When it has cooled, submerge the chicken fully in the brine and place the bowl for 3-6 hours in the refrigerator.
Remove the chicken from the brine and place it on a rack so it can drip dry.
Sprinkle the all-purpose flour on the chicken pieces.
Prepare the batter by combining the kamote starch and cornstarch in a bowl. Slowly add ice-cold water while mixing, until it has a paste-like consistency.
Heat the oil, then add the chicken. Fry for about 3-4 minutes per side, until nicely browned. As each piece is done, remove it and let it cool.

Make the glaze by mixing the fish sauce, Knorr seasoning, grated ginger, honey, calamansi juice in a medium pot, and place it on the stove at medium heat. When it starts to boil, set it aside and let it cool.
Toss the fried chicken in the glaze. Place on a serving plate and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Easy Pasta Recipes That Can Save Your Wallet at the End of Month
description:
It’s nearing the end of the month, and easy pasta recipes save the day once more. For sure, you’re all too familiar with this situation. (Don’t worry! You’re not alone.) A few more days are left before you get your next paycheck, so you’re keeping a tight grip on your budget. So, here you are searching for yummy solutions to keep your hunger pangs at bay. You scour your pantry and fridge to check what you can prep with whatever’s left. And you see it: an unopened pack of pasta sitting prettily in one corner. 
               
               
               
              Comfort is instantly guaranteed in a bowl of freshly cooked al dente noodles coated in an umami-filled sauce and topped with even more savory add-ins. But what can be more satisfying than preparing all that without spending too much? Yes, it’s possible! And here are a couple of quick and easy pasta recipes with a few ingredients that show how it’s done, starting with the Creamy Mustard Pasta recipe!

ingredients.item: Knorr Royal Pasta noodles, cooked according to package directions
any type of pasta, cooked al dente

instructions: Heat a pan over medium-high heat. Pour in oil. Saute onion and garlic until softened.
Add ground beef and Knorr Beef Broth Cubes. Cook, mixing continuously, until the meat is golden brown.
Add Knorr Liquid Seasoning and cook for another 2 minutes or until the sauce is absorbed by the beef.
Add all-purpose cream and Dijon mustard. Lower heat to keep the cream from curdling.
Toss in the cooked pasta. Sprinkle grated cheese on top and serve immediately.
Heat a pan over medium heat. Pour in olive oil. Add garlic and cook until brown.
Add chorizo and carrots; cook for 2 minutes.

Toss in the cooked pasta, making sure it gets coated with the oil. Sprinkle with Knorr Liquid Seasoning and serve immediately. You can also use extra-virgin olive oil for this recipe. This type of oil contains large amounts of antioxidants that are heart healthy and reduce the risk of chronic disease.

name: How to Make an Ice Cream Sandwich from Scratch
description:
Many Filipinos spend hot afternoons in the tropics waiting for the relief of a cool breeze and the telltale jingle of manong sorbetero’s bell as he approaches. Everyone swarms his colorful cart waiting for their turn to get a cone stacked with at least three different ice cream flavors. If you are lucky, you might spy a pack of buns that he uses to make a Pinoy version of an ice cream sandwich. 
               
               
               
              History traces the ice cream sandwich to a New York vendor in the early 1900s. Like many great ideas, it has spawned numerous iterations since its invention. Ice cream cookies, for example, have become a standard for this dessert/snack. 
               
               
               
              Are you ready to make your own ice cream sandwich? Read on for some cool new ideas.

ingredients.item: Selecta Classic Super Thick Vanilla ice cream

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, cream butter, sugar, salt, and vanilla until light and fluffy.
Add the flour, folding in the chocolate chips right after.
Divide this mixture in two.
Take an 8in x 8in square baking tin. Line it with wax paper or cling film, leaving a small overhang. In the pan, press half the cookie dough until base is fully covered.
Remove the cookie dough and chill in the fridge.
Repeat the process with the remaining half of the dough. Leave a larger cling film overhang this time.
Scoop softened Selecta Classic Super Thick Vanilla ice cream. Use the back of the spoon or palette knife to smoothen, chill for at least 20 minutes.
Add the other cookie square on top of the ice cream half. Press down gently and freeze the whole thing for at least 4 hours.
Transfer the sandwich from the tin to a chopping board. Remove the film and use a hot blade to cut the sandwiches into 9 equal-sized squares.

To decorate, take each sandwich and dip it into melted chocolate. Cover half and garnish with nuts, sprinkles, marshmallows, etc. Be quick when decorating since chocolate tends to set rapidly on the ice cream sandwich.
Serve immediately or wrap securely in baking paper or cling film before returning to the freezer.

name: Protein Rich Lasagna Recipe for Healthier Muscles
description:
Need a lasagna recipe that’s healthy, delicious, and fun to put together? This beefy lasagna dish combines, the meaty flavor of ground beef, and the rich taste of tomato sauce. Add some melted cheese on top and you’ve got a winner! 
               
               
               
              Beef is rich in proteins and amino acids the body needs for growth, cognitive functions, and muscle development. Lycopene in tomato sauce is a powerful antioxidant that can lower the risk of certain types of cancer. Ready to get these benefits? This beef lasagna recipe consists of several steps, but we promise the hard work is well worth it.

ingredients.item: grated quick-melt cheese or mozzarella cheese (combination of both may be used)

instructions: Cook the lasagna noodles according to package directions.
Set aside.
Stary by heating oil in a pan over medium high heat.
Sautee onions and garlic until aromatic
Add the ground beef, cook until browned
Pour in the tomato sauce by combining Knorr Beef Cube, tomato sauce, and banana ketchup.
Stir before adding in the bay leaves, pepper, and oregano.
Allow this to simmer for 10-15 minutes or until sauce has thickened.
Set aside.
Melt butter in a hot pan over medium heat
Strin the flour, cook until consistency is pasty.
Gradually whisk in the milk, season with nutmeg.
Cook until thickened to the consistency of gravy. Thin with milk or water if needed.
Spread enough meat sauce to cover the bottom of a rectangular baking pan.
Begin layering the lasagna noodles, meat sauce, and white sauce.
Repeat until you have enough layers to fill the pan.
Bake in a preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until cheese has melted.
To keep lasagna layers intact, allow the dish to sit on a counter for 15 minutes.

name: Shawarma Philippines: How to Make Beef Shawarma
description:
When midnight munchies hit, what better way to answer than with a fresh shawarma wrap? 
               
               
               
              Try this recipe, and learn how to make shawarma sauce from scratch too!

ingredients.item: medium flour tortillas or pita bread
ripe tomatoes, deseeded and sliced thinly
cucumber, peeled, deseeded and sliced into thin sticks
Optional: 1 pc singkamas, sliced into thin strips
thinly sliced cabbage or iceberg lettuce or red cabbage

instructions: First, you need to combine all the beef ingredients in a bowl. Mix well and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Second, prepare the sauce by combining all the sauce ingredients. Mix well. Use a funnel to transfer the mixture into a squeeze bottle and chill until ready to use.

Let’s start assembling the wraps–get a grill pan or a flat frying pan and make it nice and hot over high heat. Drain the beef from the marinade and grill until cooked through. Do this in batches so the pan won’t be overcrowded. Set aside to cool slightly.
Once the beef is slightly cooled, chop it into bite-sized pieces.

Grab your tortilla or pita bread and heat it on a flat pan until slightly toasted. Then, transfer it onto a plate and then start to assemble. Start by putting lettuce/cabbage, chopped beef, sliced tomatoes, onions, cucumber, and singkamas in the middle of the bread. Drizzle some sauce and top it off with grated cheese. Roll and wrap in foil.
Do the same with the rest of the ingredients, dividing the fillings into each bread.

name: 30-Minute Pancit Malabon Recipe With Pork, Shrimp, and Squid
description: Need a noodle dish that can turn a last-minute gathering into something festive? Pancit Malabon delivers with thick rice noodles coated in a rich, seafood-flavored annatto sauce and finished with pork, shrimp, squid, and crunchy toppings. This recipe keeps all those rich flavors but comes together in about 30 minutes, making it a practical choice when you want something impressive without hours of prep.
instructions: Cook the Noodles Cook rice noodles according to package directions. Once cooked al dente, drain and set aside. Tip: Al dente noodles should still feel slightly firm to the touch, not mushy.

Make the Achuete Oil In a small pan, heat oil and achuete seeds to extract the color. Once the seeds turn dark, remove them from the pan and discard. Set the achuete oil aside. Tip: Achuete oil can be made ahead and stored in a clean, covered container in the refrigerator for a few days.
Sauté the Garlic Heat the achuete oil in a large pan over medium heat. Sauté garlic until brown.
Make the Roux Reduce heat and add flour, making sure to mix well until you get a thick paste. Tip: The flour helps thicken the sauce so it coats the noodles well.
Build the Sauce Base Add reserved shrimp heads and water. Bring to a boil. Add Knorr Pork Cube and Knorr Shrimp Cube. Stir until the cubes are dissolved.
Reduce the heat and add in the flour, making sure to mix well until you get a thick paste.
Simmer for 6 to 8 minutes before taking out the shrimp heads.
Next, place the shrimp, squid, and pork belly. Simmer until cooked.
Place the noodles into a serving dish. Pour the sauce over it and arrange the seafood and meat on top.
Serve topped with crushed chicharon, tinapa flakes, spring onions, slices of hard-boiled eggs, and calamansi.

name: 30-Minute Lamb Tikka Kebab Recipe
description:
Often, busy lives get in the way of preparing nutritious meals, but this should not be the case. Quick meals do not equate to fast food. While it is great to have these options, they aren’t exactly the healthiest. You can make healthy cuisine in as short as 30 minutes. Believe it or not, a kebab recipe is one of them. 
               
               
               
              Originating from the Middle East, kebabs have spawned many variations over the years. Kebab skewers consist of cut-up or ground meat and will sometimes include vegetables. Traditionally cooked over a spit, some in an oven, pan, or stovetop. Beef, chicken, fish, goat, shrimp, and the occasional pork are common ingredients, but if you want the flavors of a classic kebab, go for mutton or lamb. Read on to learn how to make kebabs at home.

ingredients.item: Knorr Beef Cube, pounded and mashed

instructions: Combine cumin powder, chili paste, yogurt, mace, ginger, Knorr Beef Cube, garam masala, calamansi juice, and oil in a bowl.
Marinate the lamb in the mixture for at least 4 hours, make sure that all parts are fully coated.
Take some bamboo sticks or metal skewers, thread the meat onto it.
Brush the meat with a little bit of oil while grilling.
Grill until meat is cooked through.

name: A Special Mango Float Recipe with Otap for Hot Weather
description:
Philippine mangoes are like no other. Fortunately, mango season means you can indulge in the national fruit as much as you want and in as many ways as possible. Perfectly ripened, this yellow fruit is eaten ripe or included in desserts. One of the most popular ways to enjoy it as panghimagas is with a mango float recipe. 
               
               
               
              A no-bake dessert, the mango float graces many handaan tables. Easy to make from scratch, with accessible ingredients. Here we will teach you a new way to prepare this popular dessert. We also revisit the classic recipe used by business-minded mamas.

ingredients.item: scoops Selecta Super Thick Classic Vanilla ice cream

instructions: In a bowl, crush the cookies and slice the mango into bite-sized chunks.
Mix the milk and cream in a smaller bowl until ingredients are well combined.
Assemble by alternating layers of crushed otap cookies, a drizzle of the milk mixture, mangoes, and a scoop of Selecta Super Thick Classic Vanilla ice cream in a glass.
Repeat the layering until the glass is filled, with the last layer being a scoop of ice cream garnished with crushed otap.
Serve immediately!

name: Beef Bulgogi Recipe for a Korean-Inspired Dinner
description:
K-Drama fans will tell you that beef bulgogi is one of the easiest Korean dishes. Like our local tapa, bulgogi consists of thin, marinated beef slices. Rib eye is often used, but if you want a more economical alternative, you can go for thinly sliced sirloin cuts. 
               
               
               
              The beef bulgogi marinade tastes sweet and savory and is seasoned with typical Korean ingredients. It enhances the beef sirloin’s naturally meaty and umami flavor. And because the word “bulgogi” means “fire meat,” the traditional way to cook this Korean dish is to grill the meat. But modern adaptations have it cooked on stainless steel skillets or cast-iron pans, giving it the same caramelized edges. 
               
               
               
              Ready to make this Korean dish at home? Grab your apron and get started.
instructions: Season the beef slices using Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Put them in the chiller for 10 minutes to let the meat absorb the flavor.
In a bowl, combine all the remaining ingredients. Mix well.
After 10 minutes, cook the sirloin on a well-oiled grill pan for 6 to 8 seconds per side.
Next, transfer the meat into a bowl, and pour in the soy sauce mixture.
Let the beef strips sit for several minutes to absorb the sauce.
Garnish with sesame seeds and eat the beef strips by wrapping them in lettuce leaves.

name: Pork Taco Recipe to Hype Up Your Tuesday Night
description:
Tacos are traditional Mexican food. A typical taco recipe consists of wheat or corn-based tortillas as the crust and is topped with different kinds of meat filling like goat, beef, pork, fish, shrimp, and chicken. 
               
               
               
              Incredibly versatile, the beauty of Mexican tacos lies in the distinctive flavors in every variation. Take, for example, the incredibly underrated pork taco a.k.a. tacos al pastor. This recipe, divided into four sections to make prep work more manageable, teaches you how to make it all from scratch.
instructions: Make the marinade by combining all ingredients (except the pork) in a bowl. Mix well until the Knorr Pork Cube is dissolved.
Take a sharp knife and slice the pork thinly.
Transfer the pork to a container and pour the marinade mixture over it.
Cover and let the pork marinate in the refrigerator overnight.
Once ready, cook the marinated pork on a stovetop griddle.
In a pan, heat oil and sauté onions and garlic.
Set aside and let cool.
Transfer avocadoes, jalapeños, onions, garlic, and water into a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Season with salt and pepper.
Pour into a bowl or into a container.
Mix all ingredients in a bowl.
Set aside and chill.
Take a large bowl and combine all ingredients. Mix well.
Let dough rest for 30 minutes.
Dust a surface (countertop or table) with some flour. Knead the dough and flatten it with a rolling pin.
Make small tortillas by cutting the dough with a cookie cutter.
Cook the corn tortilla on a griddle, toasting both sides lightly.

name: Make Mom Proud with This Fruity Sinigang na Baboy Recipe
description:
Every person enjoys sinigang na baboy differently. Some cooks swap pork for beef, bangus, salmon, or shrimp. Despite the available protein alternatives, pork still ranks as one of the favorites. 
               
               
               
              A staple Filipino food, sinigang has a tart base. And although numerous souring agents like bayabas kamias, pinya, and balimbing can be used, sampaloc still reigns supreme. 
               
               
               
              But did you know that strawberries can be used to make sinigang sour? How intriguing it must be, especially for asim kilig fans. This new twist to the beloved pork sinigang dish will surprise your family — and your kids will appreciate the pop of color. Our strawberry recipe still has the same delicious and comforting essence of the classic sinigang, but with added sweetness that cuts through the pork belly fat. Gear up and let’s cook!

ingredients.item: Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original
labanos, peeled and thinly sliced diagonally

instructions: In a large pot, boil pork in water.
Remove the white, pork scum that comes to the surface of the water once it starts boiling. Continue until the broth becomes clear.
Cover the pot and let the meat simmer until it becomes tender.
Add Knorr Sinigang sa Sampaloc Mix Original into the simmering pork. Stir well.
Season with patis and pepper.
Toss in the labanos slices, simmering until the vegetable is cooked through.
Add the tomato, eggplants, and strawberries into the pot.
Simmer for 3 more minutes before adding the kangkong leaves and siling haba.
Cover the pot and switch off the heat.
Transfer the soup to a bowl and garnish with additional strawberries.
Serve hot and enjoy this fruity and tangy dish.

name: A Pork Ribs Recipe with a Chinese Twist
description:
Weekend gatherings with the family call for dishes you don't regularly serve. However, many designated cooks choose to relax on their day off than spend time preparing complex meals. Thus, finding fuss-free and delicious food to make is an absolute must! Before you scoff and think it impossible, how about checking this 2-step pork ribs recipe first? 
               
               
               
              The best part? You don't need to stand in front of a grill to make this. This recipe is best marinated ahead of time. Then, you can pop it in the oven, set the timer, and walk away. It's as simple as that! Now you have time to catch up with the fam, watch your favorite show, or get a home mani-pedi service.
instructions: Combine pork, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, char siu sauce, thyme, rosemary, and pepper. Marinate in the refrigerator for at least one hour or overnight.
When ready, coat ribs with melted butter and sesame oil. Bake in a preheated 250°F (120°C) oven for 2 hours or until the meat starts to fall off the bone.

name: Kare-Kare Made Lighter with Shrimp
description:
Kare-kare is a beloved Filipino stew featuring a hearty, peanut-based sauce and various meat cuts. The usual assortment includes oxtail, beef tripe, pork knuckles, and more. While each of these brings exciting textures to the dish, they can also feel heavy on the tummy. Therefore most Pinoys reserve this saucy ulam for big occasions, like fiestas and birthdays. 
               
               
               
              Are you looking for ways to make it light enough for simple dinners at home? Make a seafood kare-kare instead. This recipe replaces the usual meats with shrimp to make this ultra-rich dish healthier. Now, you can enjoy this slightly indulgent treat beyond a feast. Kare-kare for a simple weekday meal, anyone?
instructions: Add Knorr Shrimp Cubes and peanut butter. Stir gently.
In a separate pan, toss atsuete seeds in oil. Allow to sizzle until the seeds turn dark and extract their color. Use a strainer to discard the seeds. Add atsuete oil into your pot.
Add eggplant, sitaw, banana heart, pechay, and shrimp. Let simmer for at least 15 minutes or until the veggies and shrimp are tender. Serve with bagoong on the side.
In a large pot, mix rice flour and water; bring to a boil. Once it starts to boil, slowly lower the heat until it's simmering.

name: Loaded Clubhouse Sandwich for the Whole Family
description:
The Pinoy idea of lunch or dinner often involves rice and ulam. Except not everyone has the time to prepare it daily. So, what's a good option that can still satisfy the Filipino palate? Enter the clubhouse sandwich, a filling treat that brings back childhood memories of going on picnics or out-of-town trips. 
               
               
               
              Don't be intimidated to recreate this towering sandwich at home. Despite its massive appearance, this clubhouse sandwich recipe is incredibly uncomplicated. A club contains layers of veg, meat, tasty spread, and almost anything in your fridge. Plus, you only need 10 minutes tops for its prep. Want to get started? Read on for an easy step-by-step guide.
instructions: Spread 1 tablespoon Lady’s Choice Ham Spread on one side of 2 pcs toasted bread. Evenly spread on both sides of the last bread slice.

On the first bread slice, stack lettuce, tomatoes, and bacon. Cover this with the bread with Lady’s Choice Ham Spread on both sides. Top with lettuce, cucumber, ham, and egg, then cover with the last bread slice.
Press down lightly on the sandwich, then slice into 4 triangular portions. Use toothpicks to secure.

name: Budget-friendly Nilaga Recipe Using Corned Beef
description:
All over the world, canned goods are a cupboard staple. Practical and convenient, every tin of sardines, soup, or corned beef can feed hungry bellies instantly. But over time, simply heating canned beef can be unexciting. The challenge is finding an interesting corned beef recipe to replace your go-to. 
               
               
               
              After cooking your fair share of corned beef with egg, it’s time to try something new and comforting. A recipe that fits the budget but is still hearty and delicious, like corned beef nilaga, fits the bill. If this is your first time hearing this dish, then you’re in luck. Grab your favorite beef hash brand and try this recipe yourself.
tips: To make the dish more filling, use chunky-style corned beef and add pre-boiled potatoes and carrots.
instructions: Begin by heating a pan over medium heat. Add oil and sauté garlic and onions until lightly browned.
Add corned beef and continue sautéing until aromatic.
Pour in water. Add Knorr Beef Cubes and stir until completely dissolved.
Add peppercorns. Bring mixture to a boil. Add cabbage, reduce heat, and simmer until vegetables are cooked. Serve hot.

name: Milky Chicken Sopas with Corn and Potatoes
description: Rainy weather and milky chicken sopas are a perfect match. When the skies turn gloomy, nothing spells comfort like this chicken macaroni soup filled with corn, potatoes, carrots, and other vegetables. It’s also the kind of cozy dish that lets you use leftover ingredients or pantry staples, allowing you to pull together a warm bowl with very little effort.
instructions: Sauté the Aromatics Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Sauté onions and garlic until soft. Add celery and continue sautéing for 1 minute.

Cook the Chicken Add chicken and sauté until the cubes turn white. Add Knorr Chicken Broth Cubes and mix until dissolved. Tip: You can crush the broth cubes before adding them so they dissolve faster and coat the chicken more evenly.
Simmer the Macaroni Pour in water and bring mixture to a boil. Add macaroni and cook halfway through.

Add the Vegetables Add potatoes and carrots. Continue to cook until the macaroni and vegetables are tender. Tip: The vegetables are ready when you can easily pierce them with a fork, and the macaroni should be tender but not mushy.

Finish the Chicken Sopas Add evaporated milk and simmer. Add corn and pechay. Continue to simmer for 2 minutes. Season with pepper to taste. Serve hot. Tip: Use coconut milk in place of evaporated milk to make this dairy-free. You can also add hotdogs to make it even heartier.

name: Shiitake Mushroom-Loaded Japchae
description:
Japchae is one of the most beloved dishes in Korean cuisine. It's known for its springy noodles (called “dangmyeon”), ultra-savory sauce, and an assortment of toppings. These often include shiitake mushrooms, which bring a ton of flavor with their natural, meaty umami. Pro tip: Use this humble fungus as a meat substitute in vegan recipes — that's how umami-packed it is! 
               
               
               
              You can serve japchae as a side dish (or “banchan”), but it's also satisfying as a main course. Since this noodle dish holds up well and can be consumed hot or cold, you can bring it to potluck parties or holiday reunions. The best part is it comes together in just 20 minutes.
tips: Want to make this vegetarian? Remove the beef strips and add more mushrooms into the mix.

ingredients.item: sweet potato noodles, soaked in hot water until al dent

instructions: Place a pan over medium heat. Add oil and sauté onions and garlic until aromatic. Add light soy sauce, sesame oil, brown sugar, and Knorr Beef Cubes; stir until dissolved.
Add carrots, beef, and mushrooms. Sauté until the beef is cooked through.
Toss in cooked noodles and spinach. Stir until the noodles are coated in sauce, the spinach is wilted, and all ingredients are well-combined. Season to taste.
Serve on a platter and top with toasted sesame seeds.

name: Pinoy Spaghetti Sauce Made Creamy With Mayonnaise
description:
Pinoy spaghetti is always a hit at every birthday party, Noche Buena, and potluck dinner. Kids and kids-at-heart can’t get enough of the sweetish spaghetti sauce loaded with ground beef and hotdogs. It’s not like any other spaghetti in the world because it’s a dish that brings back memories with family and friends. 
               
               
               
              But did you know that this party favorite can get even better? Here’s the trick to take it up a notch: add mayonnaise to the sauce. Unusual? Definitely. But the mayo makes the sauce extra smooth and creamy. Here’s the new spaghetti sauce recipe to replace your current go-to!
tips: Instead of plain water, use pasta boiling water to make your sauce thick and glossy. Try serving this sauce with other noodles like macaroni or fettuccine as well.

ingredients.item: red bell peppers, cored, seeded, and chopped finely
jumbo hotdogs, sliced diagonally into rings

instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
Heat a pan and add cooking oil. Sauté garlic and onions, then add ground beef. Cook over high heat until meat is no longer pink.
Lower heat, then add bell peppers, carrots, and bay leaf. Season with salt and pepper.
Pour water into the pan and bring to a boil. Cover with a lid and let simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the mixture is almost dry and the vegetables are tender.
Turn up the heat and add hotdogs. Stir for 1 minute. Add spaghetti sauce and bring to a boil. Adjust seasonings to taste. Lower heat, cover, and simmer for another 5-7 minutes.
Add Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise. Stir well until the spaghetti sauce becomes creamy and the color turns lighter.
Transfer cooked spaghetti to a plate and pour the sauce on top. Garnish with grated cheese.

name: Maya-Maya Fish Sinigang for the Rainy Season
description: Experience the tangy-savory blend of Sinigang na Maya-Maya soup, perfectly balanced with umami-rich miso flavor. A must-try dish! #FilipinoCuisine
tips: Have the maya-maya’s scales completely removed because they can give your soup an off-putting fishy aftertaste.

ingredients.item: Knorr Sinigang na may Miso Mix

instructions: How to Cook Maya-Maya Fish Sinigang or Soup. In a large pot, combine rice washing, onions, and tomatoes. Bring to a boil, then lower heat to simmer for 10 minutes.
Add radish and okra. Simmer just until tender.
Add maya-maya carefully and bring mixture to a gentle boil. Add chilies, Knorr Sinigang na may Miso Mixes, and mustard leaves. Cook for 1 minute. Season to taste.
Serve hot with rice and a dipping sauce of patis, calamansi, and chili.

name: 20-Min Sushi Bake With 5 Ingredients
description:
Sushi bake went viral in the summer of 2020, especially among Filipinos. Like dalgona coffee and ube cheese pandesal from the same era, it was a source of instant comfort for everyone stuck at home. So much so that several local businesses started cropping up to serve the demand for this Japanese-inspired casserole. Years later, it's proven to be more than just a trend: It's now the go-to order of many sushi lovers. 
               
               
               
              This dish is a deconstructed sushi roll baked on a tray. It has layers of rice, mayo, and some meat or seafood, eaten with seaweed. It looks impressive, but it's uncomplicated to make at home. So, drop the takeout menu and try making it yourself!
tips: Mix rice vinegar into your cooked rice to recreate authentic sushi rice. You can also dip it in soy sauce and wasabi for extra umami and spice.

ingredients.item: warm cooked rice (Japanese, short-grain, or Dinorado)

instructions: Press rice in a medium square oven-proof dish. Set aside.
In a bowl, combine Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise and soy sauce. Mix in crabsticks.
Layer crab mixture over rice.
Crumble some crispy seaweed over the crab mixture. Bake for 10-15 mins or until the top is lightly browned. Let cool slightly, then serve with crispy seaweed for wrapping.

name: An Easy Lasagna Recipe to Master
description:
Lasagna is a centerpiece dish, with its enticing layers of flat pasta, meaty red sauce, creamy béchamel, and decadent cheese. This Italian specialty is known to be quite labor-intensive, but it doesn't have to be. If you're a busy home cook with no time to spare, this easy lasagna recipe is for you. It has all the components of your favorite multi-layered pasta but comes together in just one hour. 
               
               
               
              The secret is in flavor enhancers like beef cubes that speed up the cooking process without sacrificing taste. This recipe also calls for ultra-melty cheeses like mozzarella and lasagna sheets you can prep ahead for maximum efficiency. Ready? Time to cook!
tips: Garnish with fresh basil leaves for a pop of color and add chili flakes to your sauce if you like it spicy.

ingredients.item: grated quick-melt or mozzarella cheese (or both)

instructions: Prepare lasagna noodles according to package directions. Set aside.
Make the meat sauce. Pour oil into a pan over medium-high heat. Add onions and garlic; cook until aromatic. Add ground beef and cook until lightly browned.
Add tomato sauce, Knorr Beef Cube, and banana ketchup; mix well. Add pepper, bay leaves, and oregano. Simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the beef is tender and the sauce has thickened. Set aside.
Make the white sauce: Heat a small saucepan over medium flame. Add butter and melt. Stir in flour and cook until it becomes pasty.
Slowly whisk milk into pan and season with nutmeg. Continue to cook until slightly thickened into a gravy-like consistency. If the sauce has thickened too much, add more milk or water to thin it out.

To assemble, layer lasagna noodles in a rectangular baking dish. Pour some meat sauce over the pasta, followed by some white sauce. Sprinkle some cheese over this layer. Continue layering, ending with cheese on top.
Bake in a preheated oven for 15-20 minutes or until the cheese is melted. Serve hot.

name: A Ginataang Gulay Recipe to Pair with Grilled Dishes
description:
Every hero needs a sidekick: Batman has Robin, Darna has Ding. Your inihaw na baboy has this ginataang gulay. Meaty dishes need a refreshing side to counter all that heaviness. What fits the bill? A gulay recipe featuring produce of varying shapes, colors, and textures. 
               
               
               
              Your cooking method also shouldn’t require much effort – you don’t want to take your eyes off those coals. Steaming, stir-frying, and simmering are reliable techniques that don’t call for babysitting. Take this Filipino gulay recipe, for example. You only go through three steps: add ingredients to the pot, pour in a sauce, and leave them to cook until tender. It can’t get any easier.
tips: Add extra linamnam by sauteing a tablespoon of bagoong with the onion and garlic.

ingredients.item: Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix, dissolved in 1 cup water

instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium flame. Sauté onion and garlic until tender and fragrant.
Add kalabasa and sitaw; stir. Add dissolved Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix and siling haba. Mix well, cover, and simmer until the vegetables are half-cooked.
Add malunggay leaves and shrimp. Continue simmering until completely cooked. Serve hot.

name: Easy Chicken Karaage, Japanese Restaurant-Style
description:
Nearly every country has its version of fried chicken. Taiwan is known for its XXL chicken chops, Thailand has the Hat Yai fried chicken, and the Philippines takes pride in Chickenjoy. Puerto Rico joins with chicharron de pollo. And who doesn't know about America's buffalo wings? But don't forget Japan, the land of deep-fried, golden chicken karaage. 
               
               
               
              Many overlook these chicken cutlets, especially when served beside sushi, ramen, and tempura. What's so special about these bites anyway? Maybe if you study how to make chicken karaage, you'll learn to appreciate the dish more. Try this recipe inspired by versions from Japanese restaurants and see for yourself!

ingredients.item: chicken breast fillets, cut into 3-inch pieces

instructions: Combine chicken, sake, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, garlic, and ginger in a bowl. Mix well and refrigerate for 1 hour.

Meanwhile, make the dip: Combine all ingredients in a bowl; set aside. To make the gravy, melt butter in a pan. Whisk in flour and pour in stock. Add Knorr Liquid Seasoning and pepper. Simmer until thick.
Take chicken out of the fridge and drain any liquid. In a shallow dish, mix flour and cornstarch. Roll chicken in the mixture until coated on all sides.
Heat oil in a deep pot over high flame. Deep-fry chicken in batches until golden. Drain on a paper towel-lined plate to remove excess oil. Serve hot with mayo dip or gravy on the side.

name: Creamy Caldereta, a Classic Pinoy Ulam for Lunch
description:
Caldereta is a beloved Pinoy ulam that takes inspiration from Spanish cuisine. Its traditional recipe features goat meat as the star ingredient, but variations using beef, pork, and chicken have become more popular. The hearty stew has a tomato-based sauce made richer with liver paste. It's also packed with vegetables like potatoes, carrots, and bell peppers. 
               
               
               
              Most home cooks put their twist on the dish. Some add cheese for umami, while others mix in peanut butter for a nutty take. Olives and kinchay also make it to the list sometimes. This caldereta recipe uses mayonnaise to give the sauce an indulgently creamy texture. Don't knock it until you've tried it!
tips: Top your caldereta with grated cheese to make it even creamier.

ingredients.item: pork bouillon cube, dissolved in 2 cups water

instructions: Bring pork broth to a boil. Add kasim and cook until tender, about 25-30 minutes. Remove pork, strain, and set aside. Save broth in a separate container.
Heat oil in a pot. Sauté garlic and onions. Add pork and stir until the meat develops a brown crust.
Add tomato sauce and soy sauce; stir. Add liver spread and mix until dissolved. Add reserved broth. Simmer over medium-low heat for about 10 minutes.
Increase heat to medium. Add potatoes, carrots, and bell peppers. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add chilies and pickles.
Add Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise. Stir and blend well until the sauce is creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot with steamed rice.

name: 150 Pesos Budget Ulam Pinoy Recipe: Pork Giniling | Recipedia
description: You can count on ground pork when you want an easy ulam recipe. Try this budget meal ulam, pork giniling. It’s a great, easy to cook ulam idea ready in 20 mins!
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium flame. Sauté onions and garlic until fragrant.
Crumble Knorr Pork Cube into the pan and mix until dissolved. Add ground pork and cook until lightly browned.
Add carrots, green peas, raisins, and pineapple tidbits. Sauté over high heat until meat and vegetables are cooked and tender.
Season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning and ground black pepper to taste. Serve hot.

name: Unique Fried Chicken Recipe Made for Every Pinoy Handaan
description:
There is no such thing as a small Pinoy handaan. Every celebration becomes a big event once family, friends, and neighbors get wind of it. And as the designated cook, you’re tasked to look for ideas to make the event extra special. 
               
               
               
              What’s a Filipino party without lumpiang shanghai, spaghetti, pork barbecue, and fried chicken? But cooking all these dishes at once can be a major challenge. Why not streamline your selection and choose fuss-free recipes? Start with this flavorful crispy chicken that skips the deep-frying step. How is that possible? Here's a guide to making this Pinoy handaan food alternative.

ingredients.item: chicken drumsticks, washed and patted dry
(20-g) pack Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Original

instructions: Combine chicken, Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Original, and fish sauce. Marinate for at least 30 minutes or 1 day before the Pinoy birthday handaan.
Arrange drumsticks in an air-fryer basket to avoid overcrowding. Drizzle or spray some oil on the chicken, if desired.
Air-fry chicken at 180°C for 30-40 minutes. Turn pieces halfway through cooking. Drain on paper towels to remove excess oils. Serve immediately.

name: Pancit Molo Recipe Using Only 5 Ingredients
description:
Have you ever cooked fried fish or pork chops and thought something was missing? Apart from the usual ensalada pairing, soups come a close second. While there are numerous recipes to choose from, nothing compares to the simplicity of pancit molo. 
               
               
               
              Every pancit molo recipe differs depending on the home cook preparing it. What doesn’t change is its versatility and its straightforward cooking method. With only a handful of ingredients and two simple steps, anyone can learn how to cook pancit molo at home. Here’s what you need to start.
tips: Make the soup healthier by adding malunggay leaves that are rich in calcium, iron, protein, and amino acids.
instructions: Heat oil in a pot and sauté garlic until browned or fragrant. Add water and stir in Knorr Chicken Cube. Bring to a boil.
Add pechay, then drop molo wrappers one at a time. Boil for 2 more minutes. Serve hot.

name: Easy Baked Mussels with a Creamy Pesto Topping
description:
An appetizer is like the protagonist’s best friend in a teleserye. It’s there to hype up the main star. But sometimes, appetizers can steal the show and become the one dish that gets emptied the fastest. Such will be the case when you serve these baked mussels with pesto sauce. The melted cheese on top makes this dish a showstopper! 
               
               
               
              Want to give it a new screen name? A fancy-sounding option is mussels au gratin, perfect if you're preparing this for a romantic date. Or you can stick with baked tahong and keep your guests guessing your new secret ingredient. Whatever you choose, don't be surprised to receive a round of applause after the meal.
tips: To check for freshness, tap any open shell; if it doesn’t close, the mussel is dead and not safe to cook.
instructions: Add mussels and water to a pot. Bring to a boil and cook until shells open. Drain and discard mussels that remain closed.
Combine pesto sauce and Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise in a bowl. Top each mussel with a teaspoon of this mixture.
Add grated cheese on top. Bake or toast until the cheese is melted. Serve immediately.

name: A Native Filipino Merienda With a Frozen Ube Surprise
description:
This is nothing like the native Filipino merienda you know. Unlike ordinary saba-stuffed turon, this recipe combines bananas, desiccated coconut, and ube ice cream for a unique filling. The usual process requires frying right after rolling; this one needs some time in the freezer. The classic comes coated with melted brown sugar; this variation calls for a drizzle of caramel syrup. 
               
               
               
              The result? A hot-and-cold sweet snack promising a surprise in every bite. There’s nothing like it on any list of typical Pinoy merienda. You can also think of this recipe as deep-fried halo-halo. Take it up a notch by adding macapuno strings, nata de coco, garbanzos, and even leche flan. Ready?

ingredients.item: scoops Selecta Super Thick Ube Royale Ice Cream

instructions: Combine banana, desiccated coconut, and brown sugar in a bowl.
Add Selecta Super Thick Ube Royale Ice Cream and mix well. Transfer to a rectangular dish and spread evenly. Set aside in the freezer overnight.
Mix icing sugar, flour, and water to make a mixture for sealing. Set aside.
Once ready, take out the frozen filling and slice into 12 small rectangles.
Place a turon wrapper on a flat surface. Arrange 1 frozen filling and 2 jackfruit slices on top.
Wet corners with the prepared mixture. Fold sides, roll into a log, and seal edges. Repeat with remaining ingredients.
Heat oil in a pan. Deep-fry turon until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.
Serve turon drizzled with caramel syrup and topped with almond flake.

name: Fried Pork Chops With an Easy Mushroom Cream Sauce
description:
Flavorful sauces can turn ordinary dishes into a gourmet feast. For fried pork chops, that means ditching ketchup in favor of a homemade, mushroom-based cream sauce. This provides a luscious, silky contrast to the fried meat and prevents this classic ulam from drying out. 
               
               
               
              But first, you need to marinate your chops in a blend of seasonings and pineapple juice. The latter is a must because it contains enzymes that tenderize tough meats. And since pork chops tend to be leaner with less fat, adding moisture keeps them juicy. Ready to level up your simple fried pork chop recipe? You’ll love this one!

ingredients.item: (70-g) pack Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup

instructions: Dissolve ½ pack of Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup in water. Set aside.
Combine pork chops, soy sauce, garlic, ginger, pineapple juice, and the remaining Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup in a bowl. Marinate for at least 3 minutes.
Heat oil in a pan over medium flame. Pan-fry pork chops. Drain on paper towels and set aside.
In another pan, add remaining marinade and dissolved Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup. Bring mixture to a boil, then add pork chops.
Reduce heat and simmer for 10-12 minutes. Garnish with parsley. Serve immediately.

name: Pancit Bihon Upgraded With Stir-fried Beef Sirloin
description:
Pancit bihon is one of the unofficial national dishes served in nearly every Filipino celebration. You'll be hard-pressed to find a birthday party, baptism, graduation, or wedding where these noodles are absent. Although the go-to ingredient in a traditional pancit bihon recipe is chicken, there are other meat options to try. 
               
               
               
              Some use pork, while others prefer shrimp. Beef rarely makes the cut due to its price tag. Many people also feel intimidated by the protein because it can turn out tough and chewy. But not anymore! This recipe proves why beef should be your top choice when making pancit. Check out this guide to learn more.

ingredients.item: beef sirloin, cut into thin strips

instructions: Make the beef stock: Bring water to a boil. Add Knorr Beef Cube and stir until dissolved. Set aside.

Heat oil in a pan over medium flame. Sauté garlic and onions until fragrant. Add beef sirloin and stir-fry until lightly browned. Add kinchay, cabbage, and carrots. Stir-fry until veggies are half-cooked.
Pour in prepared beef stock and add Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Simmer for 5 minutes. Add bihon noodles and simmer until cooked.
Transfer to a platter and garnish with spring onions. Serve hot with calamansi on the side.

name: 10-Minute California Maki Sandwich for a Quick Lunch
description:
Lunchtime is the highlight of most workdays. This midday break is crucial since it restarts your mind from tired to wired. So, even if you must attend an urgent lunch meeting, don't even think of skipping lunch! Do yourself a favor and whip up a quick California maki sandwich to lift your weary heart. 
               
               
               
              This sushi-inspired treat is easy to make at home. It uses the same ingredients as the classic California maki recipe, except you don't need to cook rice. Don’t forget to add Lady's Choice Tuna Spread for extra flavor. Ready to learn how to prep this fool-proof California roll sandwich?
tips: Add a teaspoon of light soy sauce and a pinch of wasabi to the sandwich spread for extra zing.
instructions: Spread Lady’s Choice Tuna Spread on one side of the toasted bread.
Add lettuce, crabsticks, mangoes, cucumber, and avocado.
Top with chopped nori. Cover with the other toasted bread.

name: Spicy Buffalo a la Frankie's Chicken Wings
description:
Got a serious Frankie's chicken wings habit? Don't we all? The New York-inspired restaurant is the place to get your fill of flavorful wings. If you love their crunchy, saucy offerings, then you probably order them regularly. As delicious as they are, those costs stack up – even when treating yourself is always worth it. 
               
               
               
              The good news: you can easily recreate their classic buffalo wings at home with this budget-friendly recipe. Enjoy them hot out of the fryer every time. Don't forget to pair them with a creamy dip for maximum enjoyment!
tips: Double-fry your wings before coating them in the sauce for an extra crispy bite.
instructions: Poach chicken wings in seasoned water with garlic. Drain.
Season chicken wings, then coat in flour, shaking off any excess. Dip in egg, then evenly coat with breadcrumbs. Set aside.
Make the spicy buffalo sauce: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Mix well.
Deep-fry chicken wings until crispy. Toss in prepared spicy buffalo sauce.
Make the honey-mustard dip: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Season to taste. Serve with chicken wings.

name: Japanese Ramen Recipe Made from Scratch
description:
Aside from sushi, ramen is another Japanese dish that excites many Filipino diners. However, everyone knows that well-made Japanese ramen doesn’t come cheap. Once your bowl features fresh ramen noodles, authentic hours-long broths, and premium toppings, its price skyrockets. Eating at a restaurant every week is out of the question. 
               
               
               
              Sure, you can rely on the instant variety, but it's never the same. The tasty solution? Make it yourself! Even if you're working with a budget, you can still produce great-tasting ramen at home with store-bought noodles. The trick is to prepare an umami-rich broth that’s comforting and delicious. Here’s a Japanese ramen recipe you can recreate from your kitchen.
instructions: Make the broth: Combine pork, kombu, water, Knorr Pork Cubes, ginger, garlic, and sake in a pot. Bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer until the meat is fork-tender.
Add sesame oil and season to taste. Remove from heat once the broth is fragrant.
Assemble the ramen: Divide noodles into bowls. Pour in hot broth. Garnish with pork, nori, eggs, spring onions, and chili oil. Serve immediately.

name: Authentic Seafood Paella for Holiday Celebrations
description:
Something about serving a generous platter of seafood paella makes a meal instantly festive. One glance at the mound of golden rice grains heaped with seafood can make mouths water. Scrape the bottom of the pan to get the crispy socarrat crust and squeeze lemon juice all over – it is an absolute showstopper. 
               
               
               
              Yes, cooking authentic paella is a bit tedious. And with its list of premium ingredients, the dish can be pricey, too. But the result is nothing short of impressive. If you’re thinking of ways to show how much you care for your loved ones, look no further. Learn how to cook seafood paella for your next feast with this step-by-step guide.

ingredients.item: white-flesh fish fillet, cleaned and sliced into 1-inch pieces
jumbo shrimp (about 16 pcs), peeled and deveined with tails intact
uncooked arborio or any short-grain rice

instructions: Make the broth: Combine all ingredients in a pot. Bring to a simmer but do not boil. Keep warm over low heat.
Make the herb blend: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Set aside.
Make the paella: Heat oil in a paellera or large skillet over medium flame. Sauté fish and shrimp for 1 minute; do not cook seafood through. Remove from the pan and keep warm.
Sauté onion and bell pepper for 5 minutes. Add tomatoes, paprika, red pepper, and garlic. Cook for another 5 minutes. Add rice and stir for 1 minute.
Add warm broth, herb blend, and frozen peas. Bring to a boil, then cook for 10 minutes, stirring frequently.
Gently nestle clams into the rice mixture. Cook for 5 minutes or until the clams open. Discard any unopened shells.
Stir in seafood mixture. Arrange shrimp and pimiento slices on top of the rice. Cook for another 5 minutes.
Sprinkle lemon juice and remove from heat. Cover with a clean towel and let stand for 10 minutes. Serve hot.

name: Linamnam-Sarap Fried Chicken
description: Want to make your fried chicken extra malinamnam? Follow this easy Knorr recipe and impress your loved ones with an ultra-flavorful ulam.
tips: Pat dry chicken before adding marinadeMarinate for as long as possible, the longer you Marinate, the flavorful it isFry skin side down firstMake sure the oil is hot

ingredients.item: pack Knorr cream of Mushroom, dissolved in 1 - 1/2 cup water

instructions: Combine 12ml pack of Knorr Liquid seasoning, garlic, and pepper then rub onto chicken. Marinate in chiller for at least 30 minutes.
Mix flour, cornstarch, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Coat marinated chicken with flour mixture, one piece at a time.
Pat loose breading then fry in hot oil until golden brown. Drain oil and serve

For Mushroom Gravy: Saute garlic in melted butter and oil until lightly toasted. Pour in dissolved Knorr of Mushroom. Mix well and allow to simmer until thickened. Season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Serve while warm.

name: Banana Bread Loaded With Pecan Nuts for an After-School Merienda
description:
Banana bread is a terrific recipe for anyone looking to give baking a shot. Unlike other pastries, the classic loaf does not require technical skills. Best of all, the ingredients to make this potassium-packed merienda are readily available in groceries. If you’re aiming for coffee shop quality bread, consider adding pecan nuts, chocolate morsels, or cream cheese icing. 
               
               
               
              This banana bread with pecans owes its moistness to a surprising pantry staple. Curious to see what this ingredient is? Check out this easy-to-follow recipe.
instructions: Preheat oven to 356°F (180°C). Grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan and set aside.
Combine all dry ingredients in a medium bowl.
In another bowl, combine bananas, Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, butter, vanilla, and milk until well combined.
Gently fold wet ingredients into the dry ingredients until no trace of flour is visible. The batter should look thick.
Pour batter onto the greased pan. Bake for 1 hour or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool on a wire rack for at least 15 minutes before taking out of the pan. Serve warm or store in an airtight container after cooling completely.

name: Pork Chao Fan When You Crave Fast-Food
description:
If there's one guaranteed crowd-pleaser across all Asian cuisines, it's fried rice. Indonesians have nasi goreng. Filipinos have sinangag, the garlicky “si” in breakfast silogs. And the Chinese have Yangzhou chao fan, a.k.a. the golden standard of comforting rice dishes. 
               
               
               
              In the local fast-food scene, Chowking is known for its wok-fried pork chao fan, often enjoyed with fried chicken or dim sum. It’s crave-worthy and convenient. But the best part is you can make it yourself with pantry staples. Do you have leftover rice, butter, and umami-packed pork cubes? You're already halfway there. Learn how to cook chao fan faster than you can say “let's get takeout.”

ingredients.item: cold day-old rice, clumps broken apart

instructions: Heat oil in a pan and cook eggs. Set aside.
In the same pan, add butter and sauté onions and garlic.
Add ground pork and cook until lightly browned.
Add Knorr Pork Cube, pepper, and oyster sauce. Mix well.
Add rice and carrots. Toss and mix well. Cook for 3-5 minutes.
Add cooked eggs and break into pieces. Toss well.
Add peas and green onions. Serve warm.

name: How To Cook Dinakdakan
description: In the mood for some Ilocano flavors? Try our easy guides on how to cook Dinakdakan.
instructions: Combine pork belly, garlic, and peppercorns in a pot. Fill with enough water to cover the meat. Bring to a boil over high flame. Lower heat and simmer until the pork is tender.
Drain pork from liquid and let cool. Rub rock salt on pork.
Deep-fry pork in hot oil until golden brown and crispy. Cut into bite-sized pieces. Set aside.
In another pan, heat 2 tbsp oil and sauté onion, garlic, and ginger. Turn off heat. Add cubed pork and toss. Season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning.
Add Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise and toss to combine. Garnish with chilies. Serve immediately.

name: All-Time Favorite Pinoy Fried Chicken
description:
How many fried chicken recipes have you already tried? You’re here because those previous pursuits most likely failed you. So, look no further! Here is the ultimate fried chicken that triumphs over all other versions. 
               
               
               
              The secret is in the fried chicken marinade, which combines key Pinoy pantry staples – garlic, pepper, calamansi, and Knorr Liquid Seasoning. The fourth ingredient sets this recipe apart! A single Swak Sarap sachet (only PHP6 SRP!) of it already lends the dish unbelievable linamnam that penetrates all the way inside the meat. No need for soy sauce, patis, or any other flavoring anymore. Crispy, golden, delicious – and budget-friendly. What’s not to love?
tips: Instead of paper towels, use a wire rack to remove excess oil from your crispy fried chicken and to keep them crisp.
instructions: Combine garlic, pepper, calamansi juice, and Knorr Liquid Seasoning in a bowl. Rub mixture onto chicken pieces. Marinate in the chiller for at least 30 minutes.
Mix flour, cornstarch, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Coat chicken in flour mixture, shaking off any excess.
Deep-fry chicken in hot oil until golden brown. Drain to remove excess oil. Serve immediately.

name: The Ultimate Peanut Butter Chocolate Milkshake
description:
Who doesn’t love chocolate? It’s a flavor enjoyed around the world! And in the Philippines, you can find all sorts of cakes, pastries, and drinks featuring milk, white, and dark varieties. It’s also very easy to come up with a choco-based treat when the craving hits. You can prepare champorado, graham balls, or a classic chocolate milkshake. 
               
               
               
              Pro tip: instead of making a chocolate milkshake using cocoa powder, go for ice cream for a thicker base. From here, you can play around with add-ins. Eventually, even the biggest chocoholic needs variations! Try pairing chocolate with mint, orange, and coffee. Or start with this peanut butter and chocolate milkshake recipe.

ingredients.item: scoops Selecta Super Thick Chocolate Ice Cream

instructions: In a blender, combine Seleta Super Thick Chocolate Ice Cream, milk, nuts, and peanut butter. Blend until smooth.
Smear peanut butter on the sides of a tall glass. Pour in milkshake.
Garnish with whipped cream, extra peanut butter, chocolate syrup, and nuts. Serve immediately.

name: Banana Split Milkshake, an Indulgent Weekend Treat
description:
The banana split is a nostalgic American treat that taps into everyone’s inner child. It’s the perfect overloaded sundae, with at least three scoops of ice cream (all different flavors!) and lots of whipped cream nestled between sliced bananas. As if that wasn't enough, various syrups, colorful sprinkles, and cherries go on top for pizzaz. It’s a dessert that makes you happy just by looking at it! 
               
               
               
              If you ever thought, “I wish I could eat this all in one go,” then you need to try this banana split recipe. It’s a milkshake with those iconic qualities but in a more convenient package. Toss the spoon and bring out the curly straws!
tips: Top with crushed nuts and mini marshmallows for added texture.

ingredients.item: scoop Selecta Super Thick Vanilla Ice Cream
scoop Selecta Super Thick Chocolate Ice Cream
scoop Selecta Super Thick Strawberry Ice Cream

instructions: In a blender, combine ¼ cup milk, Selecta Super Thick Vanilla Ice Cream, and 1 banana. Blend until smooth, then set aside.
Repeat step 1 for Selecta Super Thick Chocolate Ice Cream and Selecta Thick Strawberry Ice Cream.
Assemble your milkshake: Layer the flavors in a tall glass. Garnish with whipped cream, candy sprinkles, and a cherry. Serve immediately.

name: Old-Fashioned Strawberry Milkshake Recipe
description:
The Philippine weather and the country’s abundance of tropical fruits make shakes a favorite for many. There’s always a kiosk selling refreshing slushy beverages everywhere you look! But why bother stepping out if you can make one yourself using simple pantry ingredients? Take this three-ingredient strawberry milkshake, for example. 
               
               
               
               
               
               
               
              Save yourself from the long queues and artificial flavorings with this homemade strawberry milkshake recipe. The best part is you can make it year-round, even when berries are out of season. Noticed that your loved ones are feeling down after a long day at work or school? Brighten their moods with this cooling pick-me-up!
tips: As a bonus, drizzle store-bought strawberry milkshake syrup over the cream.

ingredients.item: scoops Selecta Super Thick Strawberry Ice Cream

instructions: In a blender, combine Selecta Super Thick Strawberry Ice Cream, milk, and vanilla. Blend until smooth.
Pour milkshake into a tall glass. Garnish with whipped cream and a fresh strawberry, if desired. Serve immediately.

name: Ate Rica’s Bacsilog Recipe at Home | Recipedia
description: The best way to eat your bacon is bacsilog, the Ate Rica way. What makes this bacsilog stand out from other bacon silogs is not some kind of special bacon, it’s the addicting creamy sauce slathered on top. The secret to this bacsilog sauce – Knorr Liquid Seasoning. A tablespoon of this flavor-packed ingredient adds a depth of umami flavors to the creamy and cheesy sauce, taking it to the next level. Combine this with evaporated milk and a quick-melting cheese of your choice and you have bacsilog that’s so easy to make, you can have it any time a craving strikes.
tips: Level up this bacsilog even more by frying your rice in the bacon drippings with garlic.

ingredients.item: pinch of finely ground black pepper
bacon, cut into 1-inch pcs and cooked until crisp

instructions: To make the cheesy bacsilog sauce, combine the evaporated milk, butter or margarine, cheese, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, and black pepper in a small saucepan.
Cook over low heat, mixing continuously, until the cheese melts and the mixture is thick.
Assemble your bacsilog by grabbing some bowls and filling them with a serving of rice, bacon, and egg.
Drizzle each bowl with the bacsilog cheese sauce.
Enjoy your bacsilog as is or add extra Knorr Liquid Seasoning for a deeper, umami-taste.

name: Homemade Chicharon Bulaklak to Enjoy With Friends
description:
Who can resist freshly cooked chicharon bulaklak? That crunch, the tender fat, the hot oil that gushes out of each bite? It’s everything Filipino revelers look for in their bar chow – a deep-fried golden floret that goes well with ice-cold beverages. 
               
               
               
              But what is chicharon bulaklak, really? Despite being called ruffle fat, this part of the pig is more tissue than fat. (But that doesn’t mean you can overindulge!) It’s also not the bituka but the mesentery that keeps the small intestines in place. 
               
               
               
              Like other offal, this organ meat requires thorough cleaning before consumption. Learn how to cook chicharon bulaklak with this step-by-step guide.
tips: For crunchier results, dry the ruffle fat on a tray or even chill it for two hours before frying.

ingredients.item: chicharon bulaklak (pork ruffle fat), cleaned and cut into small pieces

instructions: Boil ruffle fat in water for 10 minutes to remove odor and impurities. Remove from pot and rinse under running water. Drain.
Combine pork, peppercorns, garlic, bay leaves, salt, and Knorr Pork Cubes in a pan. Add enough water just to cover meat.
Cook for 30-40 minutes or until almost dry. Remove from pan.
Heat oil for deep-frying. Cook chicharon in batches until golden and crisp. Drain on paper towels. Serve hot with spiced vinegar.

name: Crispy Ebi Tempura With a Surprise Crabmeat Filling
description:
For many, ebi tempura was their introduction to Japanese cuisine. But did you know that tempura in its original form came from Portuguese sailors? They brought peixinhos da horta (fried green beans) to Japan, and locals innovated to create modern-day tempura. They lightened the batter for a crispier coat and experimented with different fillings, like prawns. 
               
               
               
              That's proof that classic recipes are a great place to start flexing your culinary creativity. Want to make your prawn tempura with a twist? Stuff them with crabmeat before frying! Then go for a bright wasabi-mayo dip instead of the usual tensuyu to balance out the richness.
tips: To avoid soggy tempura, chill your battered prawns before frying and preheat your oil before starting.

ingredients.item: tiger prawns, peeled with tails intact

instructions: Devein prawns by making a slit along their bottom sides to create pockets.
Combine pesto, Knorr Shrimp Cube, and crabmeat in a bowl; mix well. Take tablespoonfuls of the mixture and insert into prawn pockets. Press well.
Coat prawns in flour, shaking off any excess. Chill for at least 15 minutes.
Make the tempura batter: Mix flour, cold water, and egg until smooth. Dip stuffed prawns in the batter. Repeat until all prawns are coated.
Deep-fry prawns until crisp and brown. Drain prawns on a plate lined with paper towels.
Make the mayo-wasabi sauce: Combine all ingredients in a bowl; mix well. Serve tempura with sauce on the side.

name: A Vegetable Cannelloni for Meatless Mondays
description:
Pasta is the default dish for any get-together. Dishes like Pinoy spaghetti, baked macaroni, or creamy carbonara are common buffet-table sights. On rare occasions, a tray of lasagna makes an appearance. However, its laborious reputation causes exclusion from most menus. So instead of the layered dish, why not prepare equally impressive baked cannelloni? 
               
               
               
              Fillings like minced meat or spinach and cheese are a no-fail. You can skip dried cannelloni pasta and just repurpose your lasagna sheets to make tubes. It's a widely accepted trick that many professionals prefer. Are you ready to try this fuss-free cannelloni recipe?
tips: Once noodles boil, stir for 2 minutes to keep them from sticking, then cook until al dente.

ingredients.item: spinach leaves, blanched in boiling water
grated mozzarella or quick-melting cheese, for topping

instructions: Cook lasagna sheets according to package directions.
Heat oil in a pan. Sauté onions until fragrant. Add Knorr Chicken Cubes and mix until dissolved.
Pour in cream and gently add spinach. Simmer until thick. Set aside.
Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).

Spread some cream sauce in a rectangular baking pan. Lay a lasagna sheet on a flat surface, fill with spinach mixture, and roll to form a tube. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Arrange rolls in the pan and cover with remaining cream sauce. Top with tomatoes, if desired.
Finish with grated cheese. Bake in the preheated oven for 5-10 minutes or until top is golden.

name: Crunchy Calamares Recipe in 15 Minutes
description:
There's no denying that deep-fried food is heaven-sent on any given day. Who can resist their fantastic crunch and flavor? Why do you think so many Filipino street food go through the fryer? French fries, fish balls, dynamite, and siomai are dependable picks. But what can outshine all these is a good calamares recipe. 
               
               
               
              With the help of some pantry staples and easy cooking techniques, you can already make restaurant-quality golden squid rings. Master this Pinoy-style calamares recipe to achieve a crisp coating and avoid rubbery results. The best part is it only takes 15 minutes to replicate. Next time the craving hits, bring out this recipe and get cooking.

ingredients.item: medium squid, cleaned, peeled, and sliced into rings

instructions: Make the sriracha mayo: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Mix well and chill for 10-15 minutes.
Mix Knorr Chicken Cube and eggs until well combined. Add squid and season with pepper.
Heat oil in a deep-frying pan over medium flame.

Dredge squid in cornstarch, shaking off any excess. Cook squid in batches, dropping one ring at a time. Fry until golden brown, then drain on a paper towel or wire rack. Serve immediately with sriracha mayo.

name: K-Drama-Inspired Folded Tuna Kimbap Recipe for Bento Lunches
description: Folded tuna kimbap gained attention in the K-drama Extraordinary Attorney Woo, where it offered a quicker way to enjoy the Korean rice roll. Instead of rolling with a bamboo mat, the nori sheet folds into sections that hold the fillings together. It’s a practical option for meal preppers and bento lunches because it’s easy to assemble and pack.

ingredients.item: tuna flakes in brine or oil (drained well)

instructions: Prepare the Rice Mixture Combine cooked rice and sesame oil in a bowl. Mix well until the rice is evenly coated, then set aside. Tip: Short-grain or sushi rice works best because its natural stickiness helps the rice hold together when folding the kimbap.
Make the Tuna Filling Combine drained tuna, chopped onion, and mayonnaise in a bowl. Mix until creamy and evenly combined, then set aside.

Cook the Eggs Heat canola oil in a pan over medium heat. Fry the eggs sunny-side-up style, then set aside. Tip: Eggs can also be lightly scrambled if you prefer smaller pieces that are easier to fold into the kimbap.
Sauté the Kimchi In the same pan, sauté the chopped kimchi with sugar over medium heat until lightly toasted and aromatic. Remove from the pan and set aside.

Prepare the Nori Sheet Place one nori sheet on a clean surface. Using scissors or a knife, cut the sheet vertically from the bottom edge up to the center. Tip: Keep hands dry when handling nori so the sheet stays crisp and easy to fold.

Assemble the Kimbap Press a thin layer of rice onto the two lower quadrants of the nori sheet. Place lettuce and a portion of the tuna mixture on the upper left quadrant. On the upper right quadrant, place fried egg and sautéed kimchi.

Fold and Serve Fold the lower left quadrant over the tuna filling, then fold upward over the egg section, and finally down onto the last rice quadrant to seal. Pat gently to secure the shape, then slice in half. Repeat with the remaining ingredients and serve immediately.

name: Pork Menudo, an Affordable Handaan Recipe
description:
Pork menudo sets itself apart from similar ulam (like caldereta or afritada) through its meat and mix-ins. The classic pork menudo ingredients include tomato sauce, cubed pork cuts (including fatty pork shoulder, belly, and liver – a crucial component!), aromatics, and hearty veggies. You can even add hot dogs, bell peppers, and raisins for extra oomph. 
               
               
               
              You'll often find menudo on the menu at eateries because of its affordability. It’s also popular for potlucks and celebrations for the same reason – plus, it’s easy to make in big batches. It’s rich, comforting, and a perfect pair for rice. Here's how to cook pork menudo for your next handaan.

ingredients.item: cubed red and green bell pepper

instructions: Heat oil in a pot over medium flame. Sauté onions and garlic until lightly browned and aromatic.
Add pork kasim and liempo and sauté until lightly browned. Add liver and cook for 2 minutes.
Add Knorr Pork Cubes and stir until dissolved. Add tomato sauce, water, sugar, and pepper. Mix well.
Add potatoes and carrots. Lower heat and simmer until the meat and potatoes are completely cooked and the sauce is thick.
Add raisins, bell peppers, and pechay. Cook for 2 more minutes. Serve warm.

name: Classic Potato Salad Recipe for Christmas Parties
description:
With the holidays in full swing, you’re most likely deep in party planning. Need some help putting together a merry menu lineup? Make sure you include dependable mains, like roast chicken, caldereta, or embutido. Then, don’t forget about the sides to match those! If you want something quick and budget-friendly, why not give this classic potato salad recipe a try? 
               
               
               
              The best potato salad recipe does not have to be complicated. You only need less than an hour to whip this up – and you can even do it days in advance. Did you know that creamy salads taste better a few days after prep? 
               
               
               
              Here’s what you’ll need to make this easy potato salad recipe for your parties.
tips: Garnish your chicken potato salad recipe with hard-boiled eggs, bacon bits, parsley, and green onions.

ingredients.item: salt and peppersalt and pepper, to taste

instructions: Boil potatoes and carrots until cooked. Let cool, then slice potatoes in half and carrots into cubes. Set aside.
Season chicken with salt and pepper. Boil for 15 minutes or until completely cooked. Let cool, then slice chicken into strips or cubes.
Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Toss well, then chill before serving.

name: Budget-Friendly Pata Tim Perfect for Pasko
description:
Pata tim is a braised Filipino dish with Chinese influences. It’s comparable to other classic ulam, like Visayan humba or paksiw na pata, but it leans more on Oriental flavors from spices and seasonings. It gets its name from its star ingredient: pork hock. 
               
               
               
              Traditionally, the hock is cooked and served whole in a sweet-and-savory sauce. However, this technique makes it harder to achieve an even cook. In this pata tim recipe, you'll need to slice the meat into ready-to-serve chunks, so each section is saucy, fork-tender, and flavorful. Make this succulent dish for Media Noche and greet the new year with a full, happy belly.
tips: Use a pressure cooker to speed up cooking time without compromising the pork’s texture.

ingredients.item: pork pata, sliced into serving pieces

instructions: Combine pork pata, soy sauce, water, star anise, and brown sugar in a pot. Bring to a boil, then lower heat to simmer. Cook until the pork is fork-tender and the sauce is thick.
Add pechay and simmer for 1 minute. Add more water if the sauce becomes too thick. Finish with Knorr Liquid Seasoning to taste. Serve warm.

name: A Bopis Recipe to Champion Nose-to-Tail Cooking
description:
Filipinos have been champions of “nose-to-tail eating” long before it became a global food trend. Restaurateur Fergus Henderson first coined the term in his book, The Whole Beast, which centers on the concept of using every part of the pig.
