In Filipino cuisine, you'll find a variety of sisig, dinuguan, and bopis recipes that call for offcuts, including the heart, lungs, and liver. 
               
               
               
              Besides being considered comfort food among locals, these dishes form an integral part of regional food identities. They exemplify sustainable cooking and encourage kitchen innovation. Want to be more adventurous with your home-cooked meals? Make bopis from scratch with this easy recipe!
tips: Your go-to butcher or grocery may not have these cuts readily available, so be sure to call ahead to check on their stocks.

ingredients.item: set (about 1½ kg) pork lungs and heart, washed and cleaned well

instructions: Submerge pork lungs and heart in water. Boil for 30-40 minutes. If desired, boil twice to get rid of the scum and funky smell.
Drain from water and let cool. Once cooled, dice pork meat into even pieces. Set aside.
In another pot or wok, combine atsuete and cooking oil to make atsuete oil. Strain seeds and discard.
In the atsuete oil, sauté onions and garlic until fragrant and softened.
Add chopped pork meat. Mix well.
Add vinegar, salt, bay leaves, Knorr Pork Cubes, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, and pepper. Let simmer for 10 minutes or until the vinegar has cooked down.
Add water and simmer for 20-30 minutes to allow flavors to absorb.
Season to taste. Add more vinegar or liquid seasoning as desired.
Add bell peppers and siling labuyo. Cook for another 5-10 minutes. Serve warm.

name: A Holly, Jolly Baked Mac Recipe
description:
Tis the season to be jolly! And what better way to make kids feel merry than treating them to their favorites? That might involve surprising them with new toys, bringing them to a Santa meet and greet, or watching an ice show together. And don’t forget about the dishes closest to their hearts! Make this Christmas extra memorable by preparing this ultra-cheesy baked mac recipe for them. 
               
               
               
              This one’s special because you need to use two types of cheese – cheddar for the sauce and mozzarella for the topping. You’ll also add all-purpose cream and Knorr Beef Cubes to the base to make it more irresistible. Expect only the biggest smiles once your kids get to try this!
tips: You can add some grated Parmesan on top to make it even cheesier.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium-high flame. Sauté onion and garlic until fragrant. Add ground beef and cook until lightly browned. Add Knorr Beef Cube and stir. Once beef is cooked, add liver spread.
Add spaghetti sauce and bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer until thick.
Add cheddar cheese and cream. Stir until melted and combined.
Toss in cooked macaroni. Mix well and season with pepper.
Transfer mixture to a baking dish. Top with mozzarella. Bake in a preheated oven or toaster oven until the cheese is melted.

name: Holiday Filipino Spaghetti With a Milky Twist
description:
What makes the holidays unforgettable? Sure, the shared memories with loved ones make it sweeter. But the real answer is the food you enjoy together! And a Pinoy holiday party is not complete without a huge serving of Filipino spaghetti — a classic dish with a striking red and sweetish sauce. 
               
               
               
              The Filipino-style spaghetti sauce is perfect as it is, hands down. However, there are some ways to add spark to your beloved spag without compromising its homey taste. You can use Knorr Pork Cubes to amp the meaty flavor and evaporated milk for a creamier finish. Try this version and make it a new holiday must-eat!
tips: Add banana ketchup if you like your spaghetti on the sweeter side.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium flame. Sauté onions and garlic until tender.
Add ground pork and cook until lightly browned.
Add tomato sauce, evaporated milk, Knorr Pork Cubes, and dried basil. Simmer until well combined.
Arrange spaghetti noodles on a serving plate. Pour sauce and sprinkle cheese on top. Serve immediately.

name: Quick Pork Caldereta to Greet Holiday Balikbayans
description:
Are you expecting relatives or friends from abroad to come home for the holidays? Of course, they wouldn’t want to miss the months-long Christmas festivities in the Philippines! No one would pass on the chance to partake in feasts featuring the local dishes they sorely missed. Think binagoongan, laing, and pork caldereta, then biko, halo-halo, and puto bumbong for dessert. 
               
               
               
              Don’t feel stressed about preparing these dishes during this hectic season. There are many tricks to make kitchen work a breeze the days. Take this pork caldereta recipe, for example! It promises the same nostalgic taste of home sans the tedious process of the beef version. Want to give it a try?

ingredients.item: carrots, peeled and cut into cubes
potatoes, peeled and cut into cubes
green bell pepper, deseeded and cut into cubes

instructions: Heat oil in a pot over high flame. Sear pork pata chops until browned. Set aside.
In the same pot, combine onions, garlic, water, Knorr Pork Cubes, bay leaves, and pepper. Bring to a boil.
Return pork to the pot and simmer until tender.
Add butter, liver spread, tomato sauce, carrots, potatoes, bell peppers, and chili. Let mixture simmer until the vegetables are tender.
Add sugar and cheese; stir until completely dissolved. Serve hot.

name: A Chicken Pastel Recipe to Serve at Reunions
description:
Savory pies are not a huge part of Filipino cuisine, but there’s always room in there for chicken pastel! This classic dish features a hearty mix of chicken, chorizo, potatoes, carrots, and peas in a warm, creamy sauce. All of that is tucked under a golden, buttery, and flaky crust to make an awe-inspiring masterpiece. It’s the perfect potluck dish to bring to reunions if you want to show off your cooking skills. 
               
               
               
              In reality, this chicken pastel recipe is effortless to cook. It requires minimal prep and zero technical baking skills. No need to make the crust yourself; just source pre-made puff pastry, and you’re good to go. Ready to learn how to cook chicken pastel?

ingredients.item: (33-g) Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix, prepared according to package directions
puff pastry, rolled into a ½-inch-thick sheet

instructions: Heat oil in a pot. Sauté onion and garlic until fragrant.
Add chicken and chorizo. Sauté for 1 minute.
Add carrot and potatoes. Sauté for another minute. Add dissolved Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix.
Add green peas, oregano, and spinach, if using. Simmer until sauce is thick.
Lower heat, then pour in cream. Stir well to avoid curdling.
Transfer mixture to a baking dish. Brush edges of the dish with beaten egg. Cover with rolled puff pastry and seal edges using a fork. Brush dough with remaining egg.
Bake in a preheated 375°F (190°C) oven for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm.

name: Make This Party Classic: Steamed Lapu-Lapu Fish con Mayonesa Recipe
description: Eat the rainbow with this party classic lapu-lapu fish con mayonesa using creamy Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise.
tips: To remove any fishy taste or smell, stuff the lapu-lapu with herbs and spices before steaming.
instructions: Lightly season lapu-lapu with salt and pepper.
Steam lapu-lapu until fully cooked, around 20-25 minutes depending on the size of the fish. Set aside and let it cool to room temperature. Afterwards, place in the chiller to cool down for an hour.
Take the lapu-lapu out of the chiller and peel the skin off. Then, place on a serving platter and set aside.
In a medium bowl, season Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise with salt and pepper. Spread this on top of the fish evenly.
Working in layers to create a rainbow effect, arrange bell peppers, sweet pickle relish, eggs, celery, and carrots on top of the lapu-lapu.

name: Feta Cheese and Spiced Ham Sandwich for Picnics
description:
Picnics are one of the most inexpensive bonding activities to enjoy with family and friends. Part of the fun is deciding on the location and the food. You want something easy to transport and quick to prep – like sandwiches! While you can turn to classics, like egg or chicken salad, why not try a new recipe with spiced ham and feta cheese? 
               
               
               
              Consider this version adult ham and cheese. It calls for focaccia and lollo rosso lettuce, which add pizzazz to the recipe. The classic is reliable, but it never hurts to introduce loved ones to fresh flavors! They might end up with a new go-to sandwich by the end of your get-together.

ingredients.item: focaccia, sliced in half lengthwise and toasted

instructions: Spread Lady’s Choice Ham Spread on each piece of bread.
Arrange lettuce, ham, tomato, and cheese on one piece of bread and cover with the other. Serve warm or cold.

name: Shrimp Scampi Sandwich for a Light Weekend Treat
description:
Shrimp scampi is a classic Italian-American dish popularized in the ’70s by early Italian immigrants. “Scampi” is a type of small lobster, otherwise known as langoustine. Since it's the most accessible crustacean, shrimp became a common alternative. Thus, the name was born. Today, shrimp scampi recipes range from pasta to appetizers and even sandwiches. 
               
               
               
              This dish in all its varieties is well-loved by home cooks for its simplicity and bright, refreshing flavors. Its central ingredient, shrimp, is a hearty and nutrient-rich protein that doesn't feel as heavy as other meats. These qualities make it perfect for light meals or an energizing merienda.

ingredients.item: focaccia bread, toasted and sliced lengthwise

instructions: Heat oil or butter in a pan. Sauté garlic until fragrant. Add shrimp and sauté until cooked.
Add lemon juice, parsley, and chili flakes. Season with salt and pepper. Remove from heat.
Spread Lady’s Choice Tuna Spread on a bread slice. Lay lettuce and fill with cooked shrimp. Cover with the other bread slice. Serve immediately.

name: A 30-Min Hot Pot Recipe If You're Staying Home
description:
The rain cancelled your plans, so now you’re stuck at home. Instead of wallowing in your misfortune, why not turn things around and prep this hot pot recipe? With it, you get to cheer up spirits and enjoy a satisfying meal without breaking a sweat. 
               
               
               
              You only need 30 minutes max to put this together. A third of that you spend gathering ingredients and slicing them effortlessly. The rest of the time, you can sit back and wait as your stock boils and cooks your meats, balls, and veggies. And don’t even feel pressured to follow the ingredient list here. Add other seasonings to your base and fill it with what’s in your fridge or freezer. Quick and effortless!
tips: You can also use Knorr Beef Cubes, Knorr Pork Cubes, or a combination of Knorr Fish and Shrimp Cubes for your soup base.

ingredients.item: assorted hot pot or shabu-shabu balls
leeks, cut into 2-inch pcs from the white end

instructions: Make the stock: Combine all ingredients in a big pot. Simmer for 15-20 minutes.
Add meats, balls, vegetables, and noodles to the stock. Boil until cooked. Serve immediately.

name: Quick Picadillo Recipe for Every Day
description:
Are you a busy Pinoy with barely enough time to cook for yourself? Master this picadillo recipe to enjoy tasty meals even on your most hectic days! Picadillo is a Spanish-inspired dish with sautéed ground meat as its main ingredient. Many Latin American cuisines have their takes, with some cooking it with annatto oil while others add olives and capers. 
               
               
               
              Traditional Filipino picadillo recipes feature ground beef, tomatoes, potatoes, carrots, green peas, and other pantry staples on the roster. They come together in a single pan and don't require fancy techniques or precision. Super easy and ideal for quick, casual lunches at home!
tips: Use ground pork or chicken as healthier, more affordable alternatives to ground beef.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Sauté onions and garlic until fragrant.
Add ground beef and Knorr Beef Cube. Cook until color changes.
Stir in crushed tomatoes, tomato sauce, and water. Allow to simmer.
Season with sugar and pepper. Add salt, if needed. Simmer for 15-20 minutes.
Add potatoes, carrots, and raisins. Cook until vegetables are tender.
Remove from heat. Stir in frozen peas. Serve warm.

name: Creamy Chicken Alfredo Pasta for Kids of All Ages
description:
Pasta dishes are one of the quickest meals you can make for hungry kiddos. Besides the sweetish Pinoy spaghetti, kids also love creamy white sauces. You can always rely on a bacon carbonara recipe, but if you want to offer something new, try this creamy chicken Alfredo. 
               
               
               
              Italian restaurateur Alfredo di Lelio created this pasta recipe to help his wife regain her appetite after giving birth. It uses butter, cream, and cheese – ingredients that appeal to kids of all ages! But unlike carbonara, which features pork, a chicken Alfredo pasta recipe contains breast fillets. Excited to give it a try? Learn how to cook chicken Alfredo pasta in 30 minutes or less!
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Reserve 1 cup pasta water. Set aside.
Heat butter in a pan. Add chicken and garlic. Sear chicken until cooked.
Add Knorr Chicken Cube and pepper. Pour in cream and reserved pasta water. Let simmer.
Stir in cooked pasta, cheese, and Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise. Toss to combine. Garnish with parsley and serve immediately.

name: Brown Butter Salted Caramel to Drizzle Over Ice Cream
description:
In France, brown butter is called beurre noisette, which literally translates to “hazelnut sauce.” It’s a common ingredient in savory food like pasta, roasted veggies, and fish. But sweet applications are plentiful, too: for example, it's what gives authentic financiers their next-level buttery taste. Since browning butter and adding salt to caramel are both French culinary innovations, it makes sense to put them together. 
               
               
               
              Bored with all the usual salted caramel recipes? Change it up by adding browned butter to the mix. It will give your sauce a deeper, more indulgent flavor with a butterscotch-like nuttiness. P.S. Make a big batch – you'll want it on everything!
instructions: Melt butter in a small saucepan over medium flame. Continue stirring until frothy and brown bits form on the side and at the bottom. Once it starts to smell nutty, remove from heat and transfer to a bowl. Set aside to cool.
Combine sugar and water in another saucepan. Cook over medium flame until the sugar is melted. Wait until the color turns to amber before stirring. Reduce heat to low, stirring gently.
Add cooled browned butter to the melted sugar mixture. Mix well.
With a whisk ready, carefully pour in cream. Whisk fast to blend and thicken. Remove from heat. Stir in salt until dissolved. Let cool.
Drizzle over scoops of Selecta Super Thick Vanilla Ice Cream.

name: Beef Short Ribs Pochero, a Recipe to Master
description:
Have you already mastered the basic Filipino dishes, like adobo and sinigang? Then it’s time to maximize your newfound confidence and move on to more special dishes! These are the type of recipes moms, titas, and lolas reserve for big celebrations because of their lengthy list of ingredients and complex cooking methods. A prime example is beef short ribs pochero. 
               
               
               
              It’s a dish many compared to the classic nilaga. While the ingredients for this beef short ribs recipe bares striking similarities, its taste is quite different. The pochero features a unique blend of flavors, thanks to the sweetness of the saba and the sourness of the tomato sauce. Ready to give it a try?
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium flame. Fry banana and chorizo separately. Set aside.
In the same pan, sauté garlic and tomatoes until fragrant.
Add beef and cook for 1 minute. Add tomato sauce, peppercorns, and water. Bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer until the beef is tender.
Add Knorr Beef Cubes and simmer for 1 minute.
Add potatoes and garbanzos. Simmer until cooked.
Add cabbage and long beans. Simmer for 2 minutes. Add bok choy and cook for 1 minute. Serve hot with fish sauce on the side.

name: Pork Dumpling Recipe for Steaming or Frying
description:
There’s a scene in the hit novel-turned-movie Crazy Rich Asians that revolved around pork dumplings. In it, protagonists Nick and Rachel sit around a table with some key relatives preparing a well-guarded dumpling recipe. “You put the baby in bed. You tuck, tuck, tuck. Same on the other side. You give him a kiss goodnight,” explains the dashing bachelor to his girlfriend, unsuccessful with her initial attempts. 
               
               
               
              This clip highlights the intangible values of bonding together as a family and making traditions out of homemade food. Try this recipe so you can follow suit and achieve the same with your loved ones. Learning how to make dumplings can’t get any more rewarding!
tips: Try this cooking method: arrange dumplings in a flat pan, drizzle oil and some water, cover, and cook until steamed and the bottoms are crisp.

ingredients.item: Knorr Pork Cube, dissolved in 2 tbsp warmed sesame oil
Shaoxing, Chinese, or any cooking wine
store-bought, frozen, and round dumpling or siomai wrappers
store-bought chili-garlic sauce or 1 pc siling labuyo, chopped

instructions: Combine all ingredients, except for the wrappers, in a bowl. Mix well. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.

To wrap a dumpling, scoop 1 tablespoon pork mixture onto the center of a wrapper. Dip fingers in water, then wet the edges of the wrapper. Fold and seal by making pleats or pressing with the tines of a fork. Repeat with remaining ingredients.
Make the chili-mansi dipping sauce: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Mix well.
Steam dumplings for 10 minutes. Serve immediately with dipping sauce on the side.

name: Chicken a la King to Pair With Rice or Pasta
description:
Pinoys love creamy comfort food. There’s sopas for rainy days, carbonara for potlucks, and chicken a la king for when you’re feeling indulgent. Despite its regal name, it’s a humble dish using everyday ingredients. In fact, most traditional versions are just chicken and mushrooms in a white sauce. 
               
               
               
              In the ’60s, American home cooks started adding colorful veggies to liven it up – and the version stuck. Classic chicken a la king recipes also featured egg yolks and roux as thickeners. This one uses mayonnaise to achieve the same effect with less fuss. Try it out! It is so versatile that you can enjoy it with every carb imaginable.
tips: Add grated cheese to make it extra creamy and savory!

ingredients.item: diced red and green bell peppers

instructions: Heat oil and butter in a pan. Sauté onions and garlic until tender.
Add chicken and cook until slightly browned.
Stir in mushrooms and bell peppers. Sauté for 2-3 minutes.
Add Knorr Chicken Cube, ground pepper, and flour. Mix well.
Pour in cream and water. Let simmer until the sauce has slightly thickened. Adjust seasoning to taste.
Remove from heat. Stir in Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise to thicken the sauce. Serve hot.

name: Easy Garlic Butter Shrimp to Welcome the New Year
description:
The holiday season is the perfect excuse to indulge in sumptuous dishes and sinful treats. But after weeks of preparing and consuming hearty, meaty, and fatty food, you'll want to dial it back. Aside from the umay factor sinking in, you’ll soon realize that cooking complex recipes can tire you out. Why not take it easy and welcome the year with a no-brainer dish like garlic butter shrimp? 
               
               
               
              This healthier alternative to red meat only takes about half an hour to cook. Even if you roll out of bed late, you can still have something fresh to feed the fam. Here’s what you’ll need to cook this simple garlic butter shrimp recipe without breaking a sweat.
instructions: Heat pan and melt butter. Add oil and sauté garlic until lightly browned.
Add shrimp and sauté until partially cooked.
Add soda, carrots, and Knorr Shrimp Cube. Simmer for 3 minutes.
Add young corn and snap peas; cook for 2 minutes. Sprinkle chopped parsley and season with pepper. Serve hot.

name: Lechon Paksiw for the Day After Christmas
description:
Every family has a go-to menu for Christmas. The list usually includes classics like kare-kare, morcon, and macaroni salad. For some people, lechon is non-negotiable. A whole roast pig should take center stage at the handaan. 
               
               
               
               
               
               
               
              But even this crowd favorite can end up with sizeable leftovers. Though reheating day-old lechon is an option, getting its skin crisp again is nearly impossible. The next best option? Turn your roasted pig into lechon paksiw! 
               
               
               
              If you're worried about making this sweet, sticky, and tangy dish for the first time, worry not! All lechon paksiw ingredients are already in your pantry. And you can get this recipe done in two steps and one pot.
tips: Keep the pot uncovered while boiling to reduce that strong vinegar taste or aroma.
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a pot over medium-high heat. Bring to a boil.
Lower heat and simmer for 20-30 minutes or until the sauce is thick. Serve hot.

name: 30-Minute Holiday Chicken Macaroni Salad
description:
You can’t let the season pass without making macaroni salad! Try a loaded sweet-savory chicken macaroni salad for a twist on the classic. It uses surprising ingredients like condensed milk and pineapple tidbits, but everything is just right for the Filipino palate. Before you know it, you’ll be scarfing this down for merienda every day until New Year. 
               
               
               
              This chicken macaroni salad recipe works as a refreshing side for inihaw or on its own as a cold pasta. Bookmark this recipe and save it for the summer, too – it’s perfect for beachside picnics. A tip for the parents out there: this also makes for a well-balanced and energizing baon, full of protein, fat, and carbs.
instructions: Combine Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise and condensed milk in a bowl. Mix until smooth.
Add cheese, carrots, onions, pickle relish, ham, pineapple tidbits, and chicken.
Add cooked macaroni and mix well. Chill until ready to serve.

name: Beef Morcon to Celebrate the New Year
description:
Welcome to the new year! Keep the holiday festivities going with a celebratory Filipino-style morcon. This beef roll gets its name from a type of Spanish chorizo, but it uses a different set of ingredients and follows a distinct cooking method. This morcon recipe keeps it traditional: it starts with a layer of thinly cut beef, then eggs, hot dogs, carrots, and pickles go on top. 
               
               
               
              Everything is rolled and seared until the meat develops a flavorful brown crust. It comes with a slightly tangy, umami-filled tomato sauce for balance. With all the textures and flavors in this dish, your taste buds are in for a treat. Think of it as starting the year with more fireworks!
tips: Marinate your beef for longer to effectively tenderize it.

ingredients.item: beef, cut thinly into one big piece
whole pickles, sliced into thick strips
carrot, peeled and sliced into thick strips

instructions: Prepare beef: combine calamansi juice and Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Fully coat and marinate beef in the mixture. Refrigerate for 15-20 minutes.
Once ready, separate beef from the marinade using a strainer. Reserve marinade for sauce preparation.
Add stuffing: lay beef on a baking tray. Arrange hot dogs, eggs, pickles, and carrots on top. Roll beef and secure with a roasting string or toothpicks.
Heat oil in a pan over high flame. Sear beef on all sides until a brown crust is formed. Avoid overcrowding the pan to prevent the meat from steaming. Transfer beef to a separate plate and set aside.
In the same pan, sauté onions until tender. Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, water, Knorr Beef Cube, and reserved marinade. Mix well.
Place beef in the sauce. Add bay leaves. Lower heat, cover, and simmer until the beef is tender. Remove from the sauce and transfer to a clean cutting board.
Adjust seasoning of the sauce with sugar and pepper. Continue simmering until the desired consistency is achieved.
Remove roasting ties or toothpicks before slicing the beef roll into ½-inch-thick pieces. Arrange beef on a platter and pour sauce on top. Serve hot.

name: Inihaw na Tuna Belly for Semana Santa
description:
If you want to host a memorable salu-salo, then go for kamayan. Can't decide on what ulam to serve first? Start simple with grilled tuna belly, a guaranteed crowd-pleaser. 
               
               
               
              Filipinos will tell you that food tastes better when you eat with your bare hands. Kamayan is also sometimes called a “boodle fight,” especially if you lay food on top of a long table lined with fragrant banana leaves. The phrase comes from the military tradition of soldiers feasting and “fighting” for each bite. Various grilled items appear on the menu, including liempo, chicken inasal, and tuna belly – all paired with steamed rice, atchara, ensalada, and fresh fruits.
instructions: Wash tuna belly under cool running water. Pat dry with paper towels. Set aside.
Combine Knorr Liquid Seasoning, calamansi juice, pepper, oil, brown sugar, and garlic in a bowl. Mix well. Marinate tuna in the mixture for at least 4 hours.
Once ready, grill tuna over charcoal, basting with the marinade. Serve hot.

name: Garlic Pepper Beef, an Easy Back-to-School Baon
description:
Are you a parent who wants to help your kid fight the back-to-school blues? Start with their baon – it’s hard to sulk when you have a tasty meal. Take cues from everyone’s favorite happy bee and make a kid-friendly garlic pepper beef. As convenient as it is to go for takeout, it’s much healthier and more sustainable to go homemade. 
               
               
               
              This Jollibee-inspired garlic pepper beef recipe is ready in 25 minutes, prep and cook time included. That’s even faster than typical delivery, and you don’t need to pay additional fees! You can even make multiple servings at once to enjoy throughout the week. This dish is sweet, savory, and saucy: a winning combo that’s perfect for lunch. It’s a sulit dish you can include in your list of 1 week baon ideas.
tips: Make extra gravy to ladle over your rice or potatoes.
instructions: Combine beef, soy sauce, brown sugar, and pepper in a bowl. Marinate for 10 minutes. Discard excess marinade.
Heat oil in a pan. Stir-fry beef until lightly caramelized. Transfer to a serving plate. Set aside.
In the same pan, add butter and sauté garlic until lightly browned. Add mushrooms, flour, and Knorr Beef Cube. Cook for 1 minute, then add water. Mix well and simmer until smooth and thick.
Pour sauce over the cooked beef. Top with toasted garlic. Serve warm.

name: Resto-Style Beef Pares Recipe
description:
Nothing pulls you out of a slump like a big, warm bowl of beef pares. This humble stew is the savior of late-night partygoers, cash-strapped office workers, and anyone needing a dose of comfort. Since it’s a staple of local karinderyas and Filipino restaurants, you might think learning how to cook beef pares at home isn’t worth the effort. 
               
               
               
              But wait until you see how easy it is to perfect a classic beef pares recipe, like the one below. It calls for Knorr Beef Cubes, spices, and flavorful sauces to make an inexpensive cut of meat taste premium. This comes together in just over an hour – most of which is for simmering the beef until fork-tender. So worth it!
tips: Garnish with fried garlic bits for crunch.
instructions: Add beef and stir-fry until its color changes.
Stir in Knorr Beef Cube, star anise, chili garlic sauce, brown sugar, and black pepper. Mix well.
Add soy sauce and water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until the beef is tender.
Add onion leeks. Adjust seasoning to taste.
Stir in dissolved cornstarch and simmer until the sauce is thick.
Remove from heat and add sesame oil. Serve warm with garlic rice.
Heat oil in a pot. Sauté onions and garlic until soft and fragrant.

name: Crispy Tofu Sisig with Okra and Mushroom
description: Are you looking for an alternative to the usual fatty pork sisig? Try this vegetarian-friendly version of the classic Kapampangan dish, featuring good-for-you ingredients. Plus, it uses nutritious pantry staples, including Knorr Liquid Seasoning, to make the recipe more malinamnam without the unwanted calories. Pair this tofu sisig with garlic rice for lunch or dinner, or serve it on its own for a late-night treat.
tips: For a healthier tofu sisig, air-fry the main ingredients at 200°C for 16 minutes. Do this in batches to avoid overcrowding the basket. Spray or drizzle some oil over the pieces just before frying. Shake the pieces halfway through cooking time to flip pieces and avoid sticking or clumping.

ingredients.item: 300 g oyster mushroom, cut into bite-sized pieces
200 g okra, sliced into ¼-inch pieces

instructions: Make the dressing: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Mix well. Transfer to a squeeze bottle, if desired. Set aside in the chiller.
Dry tofu using paper towels. Set aside.
Combine flour, cornstarch, and salt in a bowl. Mix well.
Coat tofu with 1/3 of the flour mixture. Toss well, removing excess flour.
Deep-fry tofu in hot oil until lightly browned. Cook in batches to avoid overcrowding the pan. Drain excess oil on paper towels. Set aside.

Drizzle half of the beaten egg over the mushrooms. Toss to coat, then dredge with another 1/3 of the flour mixture. Deep-fry in hot oil until golden brown and crisp. Cook again in batches. Drain excess oil on paper towels. Set aside.
Drizzle the remaining beaten egg over the sliced okra. Coat with remaining flour mixture. Deep-fry in hot oil until lightly browned and crisp on the edges. Drain oil, then set aside.
In another pan, heat 2 tbsp oil (from frying). Sauté onions, bell peppers, and chilies for 2 minutes. Toss in tofu, mushrooms, and okra. Mix gently to avoid crushing the mushrooms.
Drizzle about ¾ of the prepared dressing over the vegetables and mix.
Transfer mixture to a serving plate. Drizzle remaining dressing and garnish with spring onions. Serve immediately.

name: 20-Minute Nasi Goreng (Indonesian Fried Rice)
description:
Meet sinangag’s distant cousin — nasi goreng! These rice dishes deliver different flavor profiles, made distinct by their contrasting colors. Indonesian fried rice has a deep brown hue with a smoky aroma that lures you to take a spoonful immediately. At first, you’ll taste the sweetness from kecap manis (sweetened soy sauce). Then comes a kick of umami from terasi (fermented shrimp paste), which raises your eyebrow and entices you to scarf down the whole bowl. 
               
               
               
              Some ingredients of authentic nasi goreng might be hard to find locally. Instead, follow this nasi goreng recipe with easy-to-find components for your next mealtime!
tips: Sauté candlenut and bagoong with the onion and garlic to make your nasi goreng more aromatic.

ingredients.item: sweet soy sauce (Bango Kecap Manis or ¼ cup soy sauce reduced with 2 tbsp sugar)

instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium flame. Sauté onion and garlic until fragrant.
Add chicken and Knorr Shrimp Cube. Cook until the meat changes color.
Stir in chili paste, sweet soy sauce, and chilies. Sauté for a few seconds.
Add cooked rice and mix well to combine.
Add carrots and cabbage. Cook for another 3 to 5 minutes.
Transfer mixture to a serving platter. Top with egg and cilantro leaves. Serve immediately with a slice of lime.

name: Rice Cooker Chicken Biryani Recipe
description:
Whipping up ulam after ulam has therapeutic effects, but washing dirty dishes is the antithesis of calming. On some days, you just want to kick back and enjoy good food without the fuss. And if you think about easy recipes, chicken biryani would be far from mind. Not anymore! This one-pot wonder takes less than an hour to cook in a rice cooker. Yup, you can even complete your chores or catch up on a TV series while your meal cooks on its own. 
               
               
               
              Traditional chicken biryani recipes require stir-frying the chicken and spices before slow cooking. That’s still possible in your rice cooker! Ready to see how the magic works? Get those chicken biryani ingredients ready!
tips: Add a few drops of lemon juice to prevent the rice from clumping.

ingredients.item: chicken breast fillets, cut into cubes

instructions: Heat oil in your rice cooker pot. Sauté chicken until it turns brown on both sides.
Stir in onions, ginger, garam masala, cumin, and turmeric. Cook until the onions are soft.
Add garlic, tomatoes, sultanas, rice, and Knorr Chicken Cubes. Stir until the cubes dissolve.
Pour in water, then switch the setting to cook.
Once the rice is fully cooked, fluff it using a fork. Top with cilantro leaves, almond slices, and lime wedges. Serve warm.

name: Easy Relyenong Bangus Recipe for Meat-Free Meals
description:
Filipinos love serving stuffed proteins for parties. No handaan is complete without beef morcon, pork hamonado, or embutido. For chicken, it’s usually a choice between cordon bleu or galantina. And to cater to those looking for lighter options, relyenong bangus completes the lineup. What do these dishes have in common besides their festive flavors? Most people think they require much time and effort to prepare, reserving them only for special occasions. 
               
               
               
              But not anymore! This relyenong bangus recipe proves how easy it is to cook party-ready food sans the daylong prep. You won’t need more than two hours to get this from the kitchen to your dining table. Super quick!
tips: Got leftover filling? Roll it in a piece of foil or lumpia wrappers and fry like shanghai.

ingredients.item: large whole bangus, cleaned, scaled, and gutted (with belly kept intact)
canola oil, plus more for frying

instructions: Gently break the spine of the fish by lifting it. Through the neck, slowly insert a long thin spatula between the flesh and the skin. Carefully move the spatula around the fish to detach the flesh from the skin. Next, gently push out the flesh from the tail while pulling the meat from the neck area. Be careful not to detach the head from the skin. Small tears are okay.
Combine bangus meat, calamansi juice, and Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Place water in a pot over medium heat. Add marinated meat and cook until easy to flake. Remove from heat, let cool, pick out the bones, and shred the flesh.
Heat ¼ cup oil in a pan. Sauté onions and garlic. Add shredded fish meat, Knorr Pork Cube, carrots, peas, and raisins; mix well. Season with oyster sauce and pepper. Cook for another 10 minutes.
Transfer mixture to a bowl and let cool.
Sprinkle flour over the mixture and add beaten egg. Toss gently.
Stuff mixture into the bangus, filling all the way to the tail. Make sure not to pack it too tight because the filling will slightly expand when cooked.
Dredge fish in seasoned flour. Deep-fry in hot oil until golden brown. Slice and serve hot.

name: Pork Belly Hamonado for Filipino Fiestas
description:
What food do you associate with fiestas? For many, it’s lechon, whether a whole pig, belly rolls, or kawali. Others prefer sizzling sisig, crispy pata, and inihaw na liempo. Typically, pork reigns supreme, stealing the spotlight from other meats, seafood, and carbs on the table. But these dishes also have a drawback – they take hours to prep and a couple more to cook. Not hamonado! 
               
               
               
              This pork hamonado recipe takes only 50 minutes (max!) to finish. Most of that time is for simmering the meat, so you can just leave it alone and move on to other dishes. Once done, expect soft pork slices enrobed in a glistening sweetish pineapple sauce – a party of flavors!

ingredients.item: pineapple juice or syrup (from the canned chunks)

instructions: Heat oil in a pot. Sear pork on all sides until browned. Set aside.

In the same pot, sauté onions and garlic. Add pork, soy sauce, Knorr Pork Cubes, sugar, and pineapple juice or syrup. Pour in enough water to cover the meat. Cook until the pork is tender and the sauce has slightly thickened.
Add pineapple chunks. Season with salt and pepper according to taste.
Let pork cool slightly, then slice it into ½-inch-thick pieces. Arrange on a platter, then pour sauce over pork slices. Serve hot.

name: Abot-Kayang Chicken Caldereta Recipe
description:
Chicken caldereta is a dish that packs heaps of flavor and nostalgia. Who can resist tender chicken infused with aromatics and a velvety tomato sauce (thanks to the addition of liver spread!)? One whiff of this Filipino-Spanish stew can transport you back to stress-free times. Is there a better way to reward yourself after a productive day? 
               
               
               
              You don’t need much effort to cook this festive ulam at home. Even beginner cooks can try this recipe with minimal supervision. Plus, most chicken caldereta ingredients, like the cut-ups and Knorr Chicken Cube, won’t hurt your budget. Others are likely in your pantry already. So, gather them today and start cooking!

ingredients.item: small red bell pepper, deseeded and sliced
small green bell pepper, deseeded and sliced

instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Sauté garlic and onions until softened. Add chicken and cook until its color changes.
Add chorizo, liver spread, laurel leaf, tomato sauce, Knorr Chicken Cube, sugar, pepper, and water. Bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Add potatoes, carrots, and bell peppers. Cook until the potatoes are tender. Serve warm.

name: Fresh Lumpia With Ubod and Pork Giniling
description:
Fresh lumpia should be tasty even without the sauce. This recipe is for a classic lumpiang ubod, a veggie-filled delicacy from Negros. It has all the typical components, like ubod (heart of palm), carrots, and Baguio beans, thinly sliced into crunchy matchsticks. 
               
               
               
              But it also has one surprise ingredient that sets it apart: Knorr Shrimp Cubes. While most fresh lumpia recipes only use fish sauce, this addition takes the linamnam factor to a new level. If you’ve never learned how to make fresh lumpia, this is the version to try. The sweet-savory dipping sauce gives the lumpia some oomph, but it’s already pretty satisfying without it.
tips: Top the sauce with ground, unsalted peanuts and more chopped garlic.

ingredients.item: medium carrot, cut into matchstick pieces
Baguio beans, cut into thin diagonal pieces
fresh ubod, cut into matchstick pieces, washed, and drained

instructions: Make the filling: Heat oil in a pan. Sauté onions and garlic. Add pork and cook until its color changes. Add Knorr Shrimp Cube and season with pepper.
Stir in vegetables and fish sauce. Mix well. Cook, covered, for 5-8 minutes. Transfer to a colander to drain excess liquid, then let cool.
Make the sauce: Combine all ingredients in a saucepot. Mix well and simmer over low heat until thick. Set aside.

Assemble the lumpia: Lay a wrapper on a plate. Place a lettuce leaf in the center. Top with 2 tablespoons of filling. Fold the lower end over, then roll the wrapper with the filling. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Serve with sauce on top or the side.

name: Beef Shawarma Rice With Creamy Garlic Sauce
description:
The ’90s brought many inventions and trends that have now become old-school favorites. One example is shawarma, a Middle Eastern street food featuring layers of flavor-packed meat in a pillowy pita. This grab-and-go wrap has everything you need: carbs, proteins, veggies, and sauces. But if you want to take that further with something heartier, you can always go for a plate of shawarma rice! 
               
               
               
              Are you wondering how to make shawarma rice without a rotisserie oven? The simple solution is to cook the beef as you would make tapa. This recipe suits the Filipino palate while keeping a unique Mediterranean flair. Ready to learn how to cook shawarma rice at home?

ingredients.item: ripe tomatoes, deseeded and sliced thinly
cucumber, peeled, deseeded, and sliced into thin sticks

instructions: Prepare the beef: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Marinate beef for at least 30 minutes.
Make the garlic sauce: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Chill until ready to serve.

Make the shawarma rice: Heat oil in a pan and sauté garlic until fragrant but not toasted. Dissolve Knorr Chicken Cube, then add kasubha and cooked rice. Gently toss until the rice is coated with the kasubha color.
Grill beef over charcoal or in a pan. Once cooked, roughly chop into smaller pieces.
To assemble, place rice in a bowl. Top with beef, onions, tomatoes, and cucumber. Drizzle garlic sauce all over. Serve immediately.

name: An Easy Onigiri Recipe With Leftover Tuna
description:
Rice balls are a common feature in Japanese school lunch boxes. Moms love preparing them because of their affordability and effortless procedure. Plus, kids can’t get enough of them, especially if you shape them into cute cartoon characters. Want to give ‘em a try? Follow this onigiri recipe! 
               
               
               
              Making onigiri from scratch takes no time. You can even enlist your kids or other family members to help out. The best part? Its components are already in your pantry or fridge! You can even use leftovers to make this handy treat. Got extra canned tuna from making sandwiches or corn kernels after preparing soup? Add them to the filling. Go local with adobo, tapa, or longganisa!

ingredients.item: cooked Japanese or dinorado rice (soft and sticky)
(180 g) cans tuna flakes in brine or oil, drained
nori or seaweed sheets, cut in half lengthwise

instructions: Fluff rice with a wooden spoon immediately after cooking. Combine rice, vinegar, sugar, and salt in a bowl. Mix well, making sure not to mash the mixture. Set aside to cool slightly.
Combine tuna with Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside.

To assemble, wet your hands, scoop a portion of rice, and form it into a ball. Flatten it slightly in your palm, making a well in the center. Fill with a tablespoon of tuna mixture. Fold rice from the sides to cover the filling. Shape into a triangle.
Wrap the bottom of the onigiri with a piece of nori. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Serve immediately or wrap in foil until ready to consume.

name: 30-Minute Falafel Recipe With Garlic Mayo
description:
Can fried food be healthy? Certainly – with some easy tweaks and fun twists. One prime example is falafel, a wondrous golden ball filled with ground chickpeas or garbanzos. Just one serving of falafel already fills up a quarter of the daily recommended fiber intake. But what makes falafel recipes so globally beloved is their taste. The crispy outside excites your palate, and the fresh, herby flavor inside lures you to reach for a second. 
               
               
               
              The traditional way to make falafel is by soaking the legumes overnight. Thanks to the invention of canned chickpeas, you only need 30 minutes to serve these one-biters. Ready to explore the flavor of Middle Eastern cuisine?

ingredients.item: canned chickpeas or garbanzos, drained and skins removed
a pinch of ground black pepper

instructions: Mash chickpeas in a food processor or using a masher. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well.
Take a portion of the mixture and roll it into a 2-inch ball. Press it down like a patty to help keep its shape while frying. Repeat with the remaining mixture.
Pan-fry or air-fry falafel balls until golden brown. Set aside.
Make the roasted garlic mayo sauce: Drizzle olive oil on the cut side of the garlic. Wrap the head in foil, then cook in a toaster or air-fryer until the cloves are soft, about 8-10 minutes.

Peel off the roasted garlic cloves and mash them in a bowl. Once cooled, mix in Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise. Season with salt and pepper. Serve sauce drizzled over the falafel in a sandwich or salad.

name: Ensaladang Talong to Pair With Fried Food
description:
Ensaladang talong is a salad of roasted eggplant, tomatoes, and onions drizzled with a bright, tangy dressing. If it sounds simple, that’s because it is – but the flavor it packs is far from it. You get smokiness from the eggplants, sweetness from the tomatoes, and mild spice from the raw red onions. The sour-savory dressing ties everything together and makes it perfect for fried or grilled mains. 
               
               
               
              This salad is also a winner for those who love textures. Besides the juicy tomatoes and crisp onions, you get silky, buttery eggplant flesh – altogether, they refresh the palate between bites. Is your mouth watering? Here’s how to make ensaladang talong in 20 minutes.
instructions: Grill eggplants over hot coals or an open-flame stove until the skins are charred. Alternatively, you can also boil them until tender. Peel off the skin and chop eggplants into small pieces.
Combine eggplant, tomatoes, and onions in a bowl. Set aside.
In another bowl, combine vinegar, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, sugar, and pepper. Mix well until the sugar is dissolved. Pour mixture over the eggplant salad; toss to combine. Serve immediately.

name: Classic Sarciadong Isda for Everyday Ulam
description:
Are you tired of eating plain fried fish for your daily meals? Make your ulam more exciting by transforming it into the classic sarciadong isda. Sarciado comes from the Spanish-inspired word “sarsa,” or sauce. Thus, the cooking style pertains to enrobing food in a thick, flavorful mixture, typically made of fresh vegetables and beaten eggs. 
               
               
               
              It can’t get any simpler than this sarciadong isda recipe! Start by sautéing garlic, onions, and tomatoes – the holy trinity of Pinoy cooking. You’d want to simmer the sauce until almost mushy to bring out the linamnam. What comes next? Pour in water, season, thicken, add your fish, and serve with a smile. No sweat!
instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Sauté garlic, onions, and tomatoes until soft.
Add Knorr Chicken Cube and water. Simmer until the tomatoes are almost mushy.
Add fried fish and cook for 2 minutes. Flip fish and cook for 2 more minutes.
Gently pour in beaten egg over the fish. Simmer until the eggs are cooked. Serve hot.

name: Air-fryer Chicken Relleno for Your Next Handaan
description:
Classic handaan dishes require unlimited hours (even days!) and multiple appliances to prep. Think beef caldereta that takes forever to tenderize or pork sisig that goes from simmering pot to griller to frying pan. Skip all that hassle and turn to this fuss-free yet celebratory air-fryer chicken relleno! You can get this party dish done in about one hour using a single piece of equipment. Yes, consider it a kitchen miracle! 
               
               
               
              Look at the list of ingredients, too. Don’t be surprised to see Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise there! Basting your rellenong manok with mayo gives it a smooth, shiny, golden coating. Your guests will love the result, for sure! Ready to give it a go?
tips: No air-fryer? Use an oven preheated to 350°F (180°C) and place the chicken in a greased baking pan.
instructions: Make the marinade: Combine all ingredients in a bowl; mix until the granules are dissolved. Add deboned chicken and marinate for 10-15 minutes. Spoon some mixture into the cavity also.
Make the stuffing: Combine all ingredients, except eggs, in a bowl. Set aside.
Make the basting mixture: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Set aside.
Preheat air-fryer to 390°F (200°C).

Remove chicken from the marinade. Spoon prepared stuffing into the cavity, placing eggs at the center. Make sure to fill every space to keep the chicken from deflating while cooking. Secure openings with kitchen twine or toothpicks.

Transfer chicken to the air-fryer basket. Brush the surface with the basting mixture. Cover chicken with foil, then cook for 45-50 minutes. To check if it’s done, insert a small paring knife into the thickest part of the meat. If the juices run clear or white and not red or pink, the chicken is ready. Let rest for 20-30 minutes before slicing.

Make the gravy: Melt butter in a saucepan. Stir in flour to make a paste. Add Knorr Chicken Cube and stir until dissolved. Add water, then whisk until smooth. Season with pepper and simmer for 2-3 minutes. Serve warm on the side of the chicken relleno.

name: Summer Pako Salad With a Unique Tamarind Dressing
description:
Summer is never complete without beach trips. And in every outing, the food you prepare is central to the day’s enjoyment. Are you looking for ways to level up the usual spread of adobo, inihaw na baboy, and chicken barbecue? Introduce a simple yet refreshing pako salad to balance out your menu. 
               
               
               
              Pinoy ensaladas are a terrific way to reduce the umay factor an all-meat lineup brings. So for your next excursion, skip the meticulous salads, snazzy toppings, and creamy dressings. Go for something light and bright, like this pako salad recipe with a unique tamarind vinaigrette. Plus, it’s easy to customize and takes no time to prep! Ready to master how to make pako salad?

ingredients.item: fresh pako (fiddlehead fern), cut into 2-inch pcs

instructions: Make the tamarind vinaigrette: Combine vinegar, garlic, honey, and Knorr Sinigang sa Samaplok Mix in a bowl; stir well. Slowly whisk in oil. Set aside.
Arrange pako, salted eggs, tomatoes, and dilis on a serving platter. Drizzle tamarind vinaigrette on top. Toss to combine. Serve immediately.

name: Kinilaw na Isda With a Sinigang Twist for Summer
description:
Living in the tropics comes with several perks. There’s warm weather, beaches within driving range, and fresh seafood. And because the summer months are here, many people are busy planning trips. Whatever happens, don’t forget about your menu! Besides cooking tuna belly and inihaw na pusit beachside, how about adding kinilaw na isda to the spread? 
               
               
               
              Kinilaw, which resembles ceviche, is light, refreshing, and a terrific dish to start a meal. The good news? It takes minimal effort to whip up! If you’re preparing this appetizer on the spot, make sure to handle your raw ingredients properly. Read on for the complete guide to ace your version on your next vacation.

ingredients.item: fresh tanigue, sliced into ¾-inch-thick cubes
cane vinegar or coconut vinegar, divided

instructions: Combine tanigue and 1 cup vinegar in a bowl. Mix well, then discard any excess liquid.
Mix the remaining vinegar, onion, ginger, and chilies in another bowl. Add tanigue 3-5 minutes before serving.
Season with Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix. Adjust spices to taste. Serve immediately.

name: Panda Express-Inspired Orange Chicken Recipe
description:
Are you craving fast-food fried chicken with a sweet and sour twist? Then you have to try the orange chicken of Panda Express fame. An executive chef from the chain – himself inspired by flavors from Hunan, China – first developed the dish in the ‘80s. Almost 40 years later, it has remained an icon of American-Chinese cuisine and has even gained fans around the world. 
               
               
               
              This orange chicken recipe is known for its juicy, boneless meat, crisp coating, and orange-infused sticky glaze. Chef Wang of Panda Express shares that it “hits all the senses and taste buds in your mouth.” Others describe the sauce as a “yin and yang” of flavors. Curious now?
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Toss pieces in beaten egg.
Make the breading: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl or zip-top bag. Mix well.
Add chicken into the flour mixture one piece at a time; coat well. Deep-fry in hot oil until golden brown. Set aside.
Make the orange sauce: Combine all ingredients in a pot. Mix well. Heat over medium flame and simmer, stirring continuously, until thick.
Toss chicken pieces in the orange sauce. Serve immediately.

name: Pancit Miki Bihon for Fiesta Salu-Salos
description:
Fiestas are a significant component of Filipino culture. On this day (or throughout the week!), locals celebrate and thank the town’s patron saint for a year of blessings. The festivities typically start in the morning with games and parades, then extend beyond midnight with performances and contests. But for many households, the real highlight is the salu-salo featuring hearty and indulgent dishes like lechon, caldereta, and miki bihon. 
               
               
               
              Pancit is the ultimate fiesta food. It cooks in minutes and easily feeds an entire barangay. No one can say no to a plate of miki bihon guisado overflowing with colorful veggies and proteins – it’s a party in the tummy!

ingredients.item: pork belly, skin removed and sliced thinly
chicken liver, sliced into bite-sized pieces
medium shrimp, peeled and sliced horizontally

instructions: Heat oil in a wok. Sauté onions and garlic until fragrant. Add pork and cook until browned.
Sauté liver and shrimp until fully cooked.
Add carrots, water, Knorr Shrimp Cubes, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and pepper. Let simmer.
Add noodles and partially cook. Stir in cabbage and kinchay.
Continue simmering until the liquid is reduced and the noodles are tender. Add more water if needed. Transfer to a platter or a bilao. Serve with calamansi and Knorr Liquid Seasoning on the side.

name: Resto-Style Sweet and Sour Pork in 30 Minutes
description:
Nothing beats the tummy-rumbling aroma that hits your nose as you enter a Chinese restaurant. You just know the food will be A+ even before glancing at the menu. And although everyone has their go-to order, sweet and sour pork is always a must. Who can resist these golden morsels soaked in that sticky reddish sauce? 
               
               
               
              But if you’re stuck at home and craving the Cantonese dish, give this sweet and sour pork recipe a go! You’ll be surprised by how easy this classic is to recreate! You’ll only need 30 minutes max – way quicker than having it delivered. That also means you won’t get soggy meat with a thinned-out sauce anymore. 
               
               
               
              Ready to learn how to cook sweet and sour pork?

ingredients.item: pork (liempo, kasim, or pigue), cut into 1-inch cubes
small red bell pepper, deseeded and cubed
small green bell pepper, deseeded and cubed

instructions: Season pork with salt and pepper. Add egg and cornstarch; mix to coat.
Heat oil in a pan. Fry pork one at a time until golden brown. Set aside.
Make the sweet and sour sauce: Heat oil in a saucepan over medium flame. Sauté garlic and shallots until fragrant.
Add bell peppers, banana ketchup, pineapple tidbits, Knorr Chicken Cube, white vinegar, and sugar. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add dissolved cornstarch and stir well. Simmer until the sauce is thick.
Toss fried pork in the sauce until well coated. Serve immediately.

name: Chicken Quesadilla with Spicy Garlic Mayo Dip By Khimberly Dancel
description:
Can’t get enough of Mexican flavors? Try this quesadilla recipe by TikTok star Khimberly Dancel. Besides helping you maximize your leftover ulam, this step-by-step guide will teach you to prepare every component at home. Yes, including the tortillas that are easier to make than most people think. Then, you’ll transform last night’s fried chicken into a hearty filling and whip up the most refreshing tomato and onion salsa. Lastly, you’ll round out the treat with a spicy garlic mayo for dipping and drizzling. 
               
               
               
              The best part? You can breeze through all that in just an hour and a half. Make it one weekend and enjoy authentic chicken quesadillas with your loved ones.
instructions: Make the tortilla: Mix water and sugar in a bowl. Add yeast, cover, and let stand for 5 minutes.
Combine flour, Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, salt, and oil in another bowl. Add yeast mixture carefully. Mix and knead dough until soft and elastic, about 10 to 15 minutes. Let rest for 45 minutes.
Meanwhile, mix chicken, garlic powder, salt, pepper, paprika, and lemon juice in a bowl. Marinate for 30 minutes. Once ready, heat oil in a pan and sauté chicken until light brown. Set aside.
Make the tomato salsa: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Mix well, then set aside.
Make the spicy garlic mayo: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Mix well, then set aside.
Once the dough is ready, divide it into portions and roll it into thin circles. Cook in a pan until light brown, about 2 minutes per side.

Assemble the quesadillas: Lay a tortilla on a flat surface. Top with cheese, chicken, lettuce, tomato salsa, and spicy garlic mayo. Cover with another tortilla, then slice into triangles. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Serve immediately.

name: Garlic Parmesan Chicken Tenders by Mama YUM
description:
Adults and kids love deep-fried chicken tenders! Who can resist juicy meat coated with a crunchy golden breading? Some love this treat simply paired with sweetish ketchup or barbecue sauce. But if you want to take it to the next level, try enrobing each strip in a mix of garlic, Parmesan, and mayonnaise. 
               
               
               
              Go through this garlic Parmesan chicken recipe by Mama YUM in three major parts. To start, season the chicken with Knorr Liquid Seasoning and dried thyme. Next, you’ll need to prep a coating with all-purpose flour, cornstarch, and paprika. And last bit is the cheesy sauce with oregano, basil, and bell peppers. The result? Ultra-flavorful chicken like no other!
tips: Prepare this chicken tender recipe in advance. Coat the strips in flour, then store them in the freezer. To cook, deep-fry frozen tenders over medium-high heat for 5-7 minutes.
instructions: Combine chicken, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, thyme, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Mix well. Set aside.
Make the coating: Mix all ingredients in a bowl.
Coat tenders in the flour mixture. Deep-fry chicken in batches until golden brown, about 2 to 3 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Set aside.
Make the sauce: Mix all ingredients in a bowl.
Coat cooked chicken in the prepared sauce. Serve hot.

name: Sinigang Paella Recipe by JM Granado
description:
Are you planning to surprise your guests with an innovative dish they’ve never tried? Why not start with familiar flavors? Give the classic sinigang a revamp by transforming it into a Spanish-inspired, all-in-one masterpiece. This paella recipe by digital creator JM Granado features the same comforting goodness of the sour soup infused into the rice base. 
               
               
               
              Think of it as a reconstructed seafood paella loaded with shrimp, tuna belly, and a handful of veggies. So instead of preparing the rice and ulam separately, you cook them together to come up with a showstopping creation. Expect oohs and aahs once you bring this sinigang paella to the table! Ready to give it a shot?
instructions: Make the sinigang: Heat oil in a pot over medium flame. Sauté onion, garlic, and tomato. Add water and Knorr Sinigang Original Mix. Bring to a boil.
Add shrimp, tuna belly, and chilies. Season with fish sauce. Simmer until the liquid has slightly reduced. Once ready, separate proteins from the sinigang stock. Set aside.
Make the paella: Heat oil in a paellera pan over medium flame. Sauté onion, garlic, and tomato. Add paella rice and stir well.
Pour in prepared sinigang stock and cook until the rice is tender.
Remove pan from heat. Top rice with shrimp, tuna, kangkong, okra, and eggplant. Serve hot.

name: Meaty Sinigang Fried Rice By Alexis Manuel Deocaris of ForkSpoonManila
description:
How do you like your sinigang? Do you prefer the traditional way with chunks of meat and sliced veggies swimming in a sour soup? Or are you partial to creative reimaginations of the classic ulam? If you conform with the latter, this recipe by Alexis Manuel Deocaris of ForkSpoonManila is right up your alley! 
               
               
               
              This sinigang recipe is nothing like you’ve had (or cooked!) before. Have you ever prepared the dish without sabaw? Now’s your chance! It still calls for the usual sinigang ingredients but infuses them into fried rice. The result is fantastic. And it comes with the right level of asim and linamnam thanks to the Knorr Sinigang Mix. Try it today!

ingredients.item: string Beans, cut into small pieces
small eggplant, cut into small pieces
small green finger chilli, sliced thinly

instructions: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a medium pan over medium-high flame. Add pork and stir-fry until brown.
Add 1 tbsp Knorr Sinigang Original Mix and mix. Add garlic, onion, and tomatoes; sauté until tender. Remove pork and vegetables from the pan.
In the same pan, heat the remaining oil. Stir-fry okra, string beans, eggplant, and chili until tender.
Add rice and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add remaining Knorr Sinigang Original Mix; stir well.
Add cooked pork, reserved vegetables, and kangkong. Mix well. Season with fish sauce and pepper. Serve hot.

name: Sisig Fried Rice by PEPPER.PH
description:
What do you prepare when guests come over without notice? If you’re like any hospitable Pinoy, you’d want to serve them the specialty of the house. Even if you’ve already cooked the day’s ulam, you’ll still likely switch on the stove and cook something to wow them. What dish can you whip up in mere minutes but still offer undeniable linamnam? Sisig, perhaps? 
               
               
               
              Don’t worry! This recipe won’t require you to boil, grill, or fry pork innards within an hour – you can do that over the weekend. Instead, you’ll use up leftovers or frozen portions and transform them into a hearty all-in-one dish. Learn how to cook sisig fried rice with this guide from Recipedia and PEPPER.PH.

ingredients.item: (280-g) pack frozen or ready to cook pork sisig
green finger chillies, deseeded and sliced thinly

instructions: Heat sisig in a pan over medium-low flame until crisp. Drain on paper towels and set aside. Keep excess rendered fat in the pan. Add canola oil, if needed.
Add Knorr Pork Cube and mix with a wooden spoon until fully dissolved into the oil. Add onions and chilies; sauté until translucent.
Increase heat to medium. Add rice and toss to coat until slightly toasted. Add crispy sisig and stir well. Remove from heat.
In another pan, fry eggs until the bottoms are crispy. Set aside.
In a bowl, combine mayonnaise, calamansi juice, and garlic. Season with salt. Mix well.
Transfer sisig fried rice to a serving platter. Top with fried eggs. Finish with a drizzle of the prepared sauce. Garnish with red onions and chilies, if desired. Serve hot.

name: Garlic Parmesan Chicken Tenders By When In Manila
description:
Next time you crave garlic Parmesan chicken, skip takeaway and go the homemade route. You’ll be surprised by how effortless it is to make. Plus, you’ll feel extra satisfied after cooking the well-loved dish yourself and making your family try your version. 
               
               
               
              Don’t be surprised if they think you bought these chicken tenders from a restaurant. They’re that good! The secret to success? Follow this foolproof chicken Parmesan recipe by When in Manila to a tee. Dredge the strips in the flour mixture until fully coated. Don’t rush this step, or you’ll end up with crustless meat! And toss them generously in the garlicky and cheesy sauce for maximum impact. Ready?

ingredients.item: chicken breast fillet, sliced into strips

instructions: Make the marinade: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Add chicken and marinate for 30 minutes.
Make the coating: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Dredge chicken strips in the flour mixture. Deep-fry until golden brown, then drain on paper towels. Set aside.
Make the sauce: Combine all ingredients in a bowl; mix well. Coat chicken tenders in prepared sauce. Serve immediately.

name: Super Easy Bicol Express Recipe (With Beginner-Friendly Shortcut)
description: Cooking Bicol express at home doesn’t have to feel intimidating, especially for beginner cooks. This fuss-free version uses a simple shortcut to build the rich coconut sauce faster, so you can focus on getting the flavors right without complicated prep. Now, you can enjoy this spicy favorite more often and start playing around with your own twists as your kitchen confidence grows.
instructions: Sauté the Aromatics Heat oil in a pot over medium heat. Sauté onions, garlic, and bagoong until fragrant.
Cook the Pork Add pork and cook for 1 minute. Tip: The pork is ready for the next step once the slices lose their pink color and start to turn lightly opaque on the surface.

Simmer the Sauce In a bowl, dissolve Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix in water. Pour mixture into the pot and bring it to a boil. Lower heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Tip: Reduce the heat after adding the coconut-based mixture to help keep the sauce smooth and prevent it from splitting.
Finish with Chilies Add chilies and stir. Simmer until the pork is tender. Serve hot.

name: Sloppy Joe Pizzettas for Kids of All Ages
description:
Are you looking for an easy-to-cook merienda to serve kids of all ages? Say hello to sloppy joe pizzettas! These filling treats take very little effort to make. You’ll only need a few pantry staples and about half an hour to get them ready. Perfect for after-school snacks or late-night munchies! 
               
               
               
              Go ahead and play around with the toppings. You can even make shapes and smileys out of the tiny bits. Better yet, invite guests, the young or young at heart, and let them build their mini pizzas. Make an afternoon of it! Place the components in individual containers, arrange them on the counter, and get everyone busy. It’s going to be a fun-filled day!

ingredients.item: red bell pepper, chopped into small pieces
green bell pepper, chopped into small pieces

instructions: Add Knorr Liquid Seasoning and tomato sauce. Simmer until thick, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Assemble your pizzettas: Lay a pizza crust on a flat surface. Add a generous amount of the beef mixture and top it with grated cheese. Repeat with remaining ingredients.
Bake in a preheated oven or toaster oven until the cheese melts. Serve hot.
Heat oil in a pan over medium flame. Sauté bell peppers, corn kernels, and ground beef.

name: Bok Choy and Mushroom Curry for a Meatless Meal
description:
Bok choy is a type of Chinese cabbage with thick, crunchy stems and vibrant green leaves. It’s a close cousin of horseradish, which explains its mild peppery taste. It’s also quite similar to wasabi. But like other leafy veggies, it’s incredibly versatile and nutritious: a one-cup serving already covers 75% of your daily vitamin C needs. 
               
               
               
              While you can eat the veg raw, it’s even tastier in saucy stir-fries, soups, and stews, like in this bok choy recipe. It combines crisp greens with umami-filled mushrooms, ginataang gulay mix, and curry powder to make a flavorful all-veggie dish. Perfect for meatless Mondays (and every other day of the week)!

ingredients.item: baby bok choy, rinsed and dried

instructions: Cut bok choy stalks into 1-centimeter-wide strips. The leaves can be slightly wider. Slice peppers and mushrooms into strips.
Heat oil in a pan over medium flame. Fry bok choy stalks and peppers for 1 minute. Add mushrooms and sauté. Lastly, add bok choy leaves and fry briefly. Remove vegetables from the pan.
Pour Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix and water into the pan. Sprinkle in curry powder. Bring to a boil while stirring. Cook for a few minutes over medium heat until thick.
Add pineapple chunks and cooked vegetables; toss to combine.
Garnish with sesame seeds and serve hot.

name: A Tom Yum Soup Recipe for a Taste of Thailand
description:
Cooking international dishes for the first time can be nerve-racking. Will the finished dish taste like the classic version? Did you source the proper ingredients to pay homage to an original? Don’t fuss over these questions! Trying out new recipes calls for a bit of flexibility. You might have to replace a component with something more familiar. Or, you’ll need to adjust measurements to your liking. Take this tom yum soup, for example. 
               
               
               
              Find it too spicy? Add more gata! Craving proteins like in authentic tom yum soup recipes? Toss in chicken or squid rings. This simplified version of the classic Thai dish allows you to be extra playful. Welcome all possibilities!

ingredients.item: (1-inch) piece ginger or turmeric, sliced thinly
Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix, dissolved in 1/2 cup water or evaporated milk

instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large pot over high flame. Sauté onions, garlic, lemongrass, and bay leaves until fragrant. Add siling labuyo and stir.
Add water, ginger, Knorr Pork Cube, and Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Bring to a boil, then lower heat to simmer. Add calamansi juice and continue simmering.
Add tomatoes and mushrooms; simmer for 3 minutes. Pour in dissolved Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix; simmer until the soup thickens. Add tofu; simmer for 2 minutes. Serve hot.

name: 30-Minute Pasta Vongole for Busy Weeknights
description:
Who has the time and energy to cook a full meal after a gruelling day? Sure, it would be nice to treat yourself to chicken caldereta, beef pares, or lechon paksiw with stir-fried vegetables and steamed rice. But slaving in the kitchen after everything you endured at work or school doesn’t feel right. Now, before you grab your phone and have food delivered, why not check your pantry for the ingredients of this vongole pasta? 
               
               
               
              Pasta alla vongole, meaning “with clams,” is a straightforward Italian dish you can get from the stove to the table in 30 minutes, tops. Minimum effort, maximum results! Ready for a bowl of ultimate comfort? Follow this three-step guide to start.

ingredients.item: (400-g) pack spaghetti, cooked according to package directions

instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium flame. Sauté garlic until toasted. Add chilies and Knorr Shrimp Cube; mix well.
Add wine, if using, to deglaze the pan. Add clams and sauté until the shells open.
Add spaghetti and parsley; toss to combine. Serve hot with lemon on the side.

name: Versatile Kimchi Rice for Seoul Searching
description:
Are you ready to spice up your fried rice game? Make bokkeum-bap or Korean-style stir-fries. You have endless options, but none are as beloved or easy to make as kimchi rice. It only needs over-ripened kimchi (for the best flavor!) and day-old carbs. The rest is up to you. 
               
               
               
              Typical add-ons include smoky meats and pantry goods like bacon, Spam, and canned tuna. You can also make it extra nutritious with veggies or more umami-rich with Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Most versions add a fried egg on top – a simple trick to transform this side dish into a complete meal. This kimchi fried rice recipe teaches you how to nail the basics, so you can keep experimenting later. Try it!
tips: Top your rice with a fried egg for an easy protein boost.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium flame. Sauté onions and garlic.
Add kimchi and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add rice and sauté for 5 minutes.
Season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning and chili powder. Serve hot.

name: Road Trip-Ready Spam Musubi
description:
Three things make long drives worth it: good company, music, and snacks. For your next road trip, don’t settle for whatever you can scrounge up at the first convenience store. Pack homemade Spam musubi for the whole barkada! 
               
               
               
              Musubi is another word for onigiri: a rice ball with savory fillings. Despite its Japanese origins, the handheld snack is a purely Hawaiian creation, as beloved as loco moco and poke bowls. Typical Spam musubi recipes consist of teriyaki-glazed meat and rice wrapped in nori. This version makes it more interesting with kimchi, hot sauce, and Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise. It’s the perfect grab-and-go snack to have in the car.

ingredients.item: Spam or any luncheon meat, sliced into 6-8 pieces

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan. Fry Spam or luncheon meat until browned and crispy. Drain excess oil. Set aside.

Prepare the rice: Heat remaining oil in a pan over medium-high flame. Add kimchi and fry for 3 minutes. Mix in rice. Remove from heat and set aside to cool. Divide rice into 6-8 portions depending on the number of Spam slices you have.
Make the Spam musubi sauce: Mix Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise and hot sauce in a bowl.
Assemble the musubi: Line a clean, empty Spam can with plastic wrap. Press a portion of rice into the can and pack it down gently. Spread spicy mayo over the rice, then top with luncheon meat.
Gather the ends of the plastic wrap and gently pull the musubi out of the can. Peel the plastic off. Wrap musubi in a nori sheet seam-side down. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Serve immediately.

name: Arroz Valenciana, an Easy Fiesta Handa
description:
Arroz Valenciana is a regular in fiesta handaans. It’s impossible not to be enthralled by its yellowish hue and colorful assortment of toppings. Doesn't this celebratory rice dish remind you of the classic paella? 
               
               
               
              But compared to traditional Spanish recipes, learning to cook arroz Valenciana is less complicated. For this, you won’t need special cookware or pricey, hard-to-find components. Arroz Valenciana ingredients include coconut milk instead of stock and chicken fillets to replace the usual seafood. For the rice, you can go for a mix of malagkit and your everyday sinandomeng. Pasok sa budget but still so festive!

ingredients.item: malagkit rice, washed thrice and drained
sinandomeng or Dinorado rice, washed thrice and drained
(41-g) pack Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix, dissolved in 1 cup water
Knorr Chicken Cubes, dissolved in 3 cups water
medium red bell pepper, cut into strips

instructions: Heat oil in a pot. Sauté garlic, onions, and tomatoes until fragrant and tender. Add chicken and chorizo; cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add washed rice, tomato paste, saffron, paprika, dissolved Knorr Ginataang Gulay Mix, and Knorr Chicken Cubes. Mix well, then let simmer.
Season according to taste, then cover pot until the rice is cooked and tender. Once done, transfer to a platter. Top with bell peppers, raisins, peas, and eggs. Serve immediately.

name: Festive Sotanghon Guisado With Chicken
description:
Preparing a delectable feast during fiesta season is integral to Filipino culture. For many, it is a chance to give thanks for a bountiful harvest and the blessings of the past year. It is also the time to invite guests and make them try new recipes you’ve discovered. Want to introduce something new to the typical handaan spread of caldereta, pork barbecue, and lumpiang Shanghai? Skip the canton and bihon this year and go for an equally delicious yet more pocket-friendly sotanghon guisado! 
               
               
               
              Like most noodle recipes, sotanghon guisado is easy to follow and calls for pantry staples only. If you’re preparing the dish for the first time, follow this guide for party success.

ingredients.item: sotanghon noodles, soaked in water for 15 minutes and drained

instructions: Combine Knorr Chicken Cubes, water, chicken, onions, and celery in a pot. Simmer for 30-40 minutes. Strain chicken and other vegetables. Reserve broth and set aside.
Shred chicken and set aside. Discard bones.
Combine oil and achuete seeds in a pan. Heat until the color is extracted. Strain seeds and discard. Keep oil in the pan, then sauté garlic until slightly toasted.
Add shredded chicken and noodles; toss to combine. Add reserved chicken broth and simmer until the noodles are tender.
Add carrots and season with pepper. Adjust flavor to taste. Transfer to a platter and garnish with green onions. Serve with calamansi on the side.

name: Inihaw na Bangus for Summer Outings
description:
It's the season of barkada beach trips, sunny picnics, and all-you-can-eat seafood feasts. Are you looking for a dish that captures the signature flavors of summer? You can’t go wrong with a classic inihaw na bangus, a staple ulam of boodle fights and ihaw-ihaw parties. 
               
               
               
              This inihaw na bangus recipe consists of marinated milkfish and a vibrant, ultra-savory filling of veggies, tofu, citrus, and Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Have you never tried stuffing a fish before? Now is the time to learn! Don’t worry about doing it perfectly. Once the bangus hits the grill, all that matters is that it cooks through, crisps up, and develops just enough smokiness.

ingredients.item: whole bangus (milkfish), cleaned and sliced along the back for stuffing

instructions: Marinate fish with Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Set aside.
Make the stuffing: Combine tofu cubes, onions, tomatoes, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, calamansi juice, brown sugar, and black pepper in a bowl. Stuff mixture into the cleaned and sliced fish.
Secure fish with twine or wrap it in banana leaves. Grill over hot coals. Serve immediately.

name: French Fries With Chili Honey Mayo Dip
description:
Can’t get enough of french fries? Just wait until you start enjoying them with a homemade, sweet ‘n’ spicy mayonnaise dip. This simple mixture of chili powder, honey, and Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise makes everyone’s favorite crispy merienda even more satisfying. 
               
               
               
              This versatile french fry dip also works for potato chips, chicken nuggets, tempura, and other deep-fried goodies. Do you prefer healthier dippers? No problem! Pair this with sliced veggies and whole wheat crackers for a nutritious treat. You can even use it in other forms: turn it into an easy salad dressing (just add water!) or add it to eggs for a fluffier scramble. It’s your new staple condiment!
instructions: Combine Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise and honey in a bowl; mix well. Add chili powder and stir well.
Serve dip chilled or at room temperature with crispy french fries.

name: 20-Minute Adobong Kangkong Recipe
description:
