Do you love classic Filipino adobo but want to limit your meat intake? Go for a vegetarian version instead. Like the classic, you have endless varieties to choose from. Adobong kangkong is one; it uses nutritious, fiber-rich water spinach as its main ingredient. 
               
               
               
              This leafy green cooks quickly and absorbs flavors like a champ. And don’t worry; you’ll still get that comforting, home-cooked adobo taste even without the meat. Plus, kangkong happens to be one of the most affordable veggies you can work with! Grab a bundle when you head to the market and try out this adobong kangkong recipe. It only takes 20 minutes max – perfect for weeknight dinners!

ingredients.item: bunches kangkong, leaves and soft stems picked

instructions: Heat oil in a pot over medium-high flame. Sauté garlic until lightly browned.
Add water, Knorr Chicken Cube, vinegar, and Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Simmer until the vinegar aroma is neutralized.
Add kangkong pieces and cook until wilted. Simmer for 2-3 minutes. If needed, take vegetables off the heat to prevent overcooking.
Transfer adobong kangkong to a serving platter. Serve warm.

name: 15-Minute Mango and Kani Salad
description:
Many Filipinos dream of flying to Japan, walking the busy streets of Tokyo, and eating authentic Japanese dishes. The next best thing if you’re still saving up for that ticket? Cook an oishii feast at home! Fry up some ebi tempura, prep California maki, and make ramen from scratch – they’re easier than you think. And don’t forget to build a kani salad to round out the meal! 
               
               
               
              You want something light and fresh to balance out your menu. With sweet mangoes, crunchy vegetables, and crabsticks, this salad is a perfect choice. The best part? It takes 15 minutes max to whip up. Try this kani salad recipe and transport your taste buds to the Land of the Rising Sun.

ingredients.item: iceberg lettuce, cut into bite-sized pieces
wonton wrappers, cut into strips and deep-fried

instructions: Make the Thousand Island dressing: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve.
Combine lettuce, cabbage, mangoes, crabsticks, and cucumber in a bowl. Drizzle prepared dressing on top and toss to combine.
Top salad with tobiko, nori strips, and fried wonton. Serve immediately.

name: Special Chinese Sticky Rice to Make for Mom
description:
Looking for something to gift mom you can make from scratch? Skip the usual frosted cake and overloaded pasta this year. Surprise her with something unexpected by preparing this fuss-free, ultra-hearty casserole. Even with beginner-level cooking skills, you can whip up this special Chinese sticky rice, aka kiampong. 
               
               
               
              Not too familiar with this easy-to-cook dish? Think of it as an Oriental version of paella, featuring glutinous rice as its base and Chinese sausages, shiitake mushrooms, and roasted peanuts for topping. The best part about this all-in kiampong recipe: it takes less than an hour to finish. Just toss everything in a rice cooker, and it’s ready!

ingredients.item: glutinous rice, washed until the water is clear and soaked for at least 30 minutes

instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Sauté garlic and ginger until fragrant. Add pork and cook until brown.
Add sausage and mushrooms. Sauté for 2-3 minutes
Add soy sauce, vinegar, Knorr Pork Cube, and sugar. Simmer without stirring for 2-3 minutes. Stir in washed and drained rice. Mix well.
Transfer mixture to a rice cooker. Add water and season with salt and pepper. Switch to cook mode.
Once ready, transfer cooked rice to a platter. Top with mustard leaves and roasted peanuts. Serve immediately.

name: Festive Crispy Pata With Garlic Bagoong Rice
description:
You’ve likely encountered celebratory stuffed meats already: a whole roasted lechon with truffle rice or a paella-filled rolled belly. Others aren’t too surprised by a lechon manok packed with bringhe or sisig rice anymore. But have you heard about crispy pata overloaded with garlicky bagoong rice? 
               
               
               
              This is no ordinary crispy pata recipe! It’s as gratifying as the usual deep-fried hunk of meat, but the surprise stuffing doubles the fun and flavor. Get ready to be the talk of the town once you serve this dish at your next fiesta handaan. Surely, no other household would think of combining crispy pork hocks and super malinamnam carbs in one showstopping creation.
instructions: Combine pork pata, peppercorns, onions, garlic, and star anise in a large pot. Fill with enough water to cover the meat. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Lower heat and simmer until tender, about 1 to 1.5 hours.
Drain pork and season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning.
Combine rice, bagoong, and garlic in a bowl. Stuff the mixture into the pork. Secure sides and seal filling with cooking twine.
Heat oil in a large frying pan. Deep-fry pork until brown and crispy. Drain on paper towels. Serve immediately.

name: Burger Steak Recipe With Creamy Gravy
description:
Do you love the comfort of your fast-food favorites but want to make healthier choices? Try recreating your go-to orders at home! The task is easier than you think, and this burger steak recipe proves it. You can whip up four juicy patties to wow the family in under an hour. They’d swear they were eating takeout – minus the excess calories! 
               
               
               
              This recipe even teaches you how to make gravy for burger steak to make your meal extra indulgent and restaurant-worthy. Feel free to leave it out if you’d prefer to have your patties in a bun, as in a classic cheeseburger. Add a fried egg for a Hawaiian-inspired loco moco, or serve with potatoes like the Germans do with their Hamburg steaks.
tips: Cook the gravy in the same pan as your burger patties to use up the caramelized brown bits.
instructions: Combine all the burger patty ingredients in a bowl and mix well. To check the flavor of the mixture, fry a small amount in a pan for tasting. Adjust seasoning accordingly.
Form even golf ball-sized portions from the mixture, then flatten each into patties. Chill for at least 10 minutes.
Once the burger patties are firm; fry, grill, or bake patties to your preferred doneness. Alternatively, store them in the fridge or freezer for later use.
Heat oil in a pan over medium flame. Sauté onions and garlic until fragrant.
Add cream, water, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, and Knorr Chicken Cube. Mix well and season to taste.
Serve the burger steak with the gravy on top or on the side.

name: Resto-Style Yang Chow on a Budget
description:
Most Chinese restaurants, from high-end establishments to fast-food joints, offer different versions of fried rice. But what remains a staple on menus, alongside sweet and sour pork, siomai, and salt and pepper squid, is yang chow. You’ll rarely see a table without it, and no diner is too shy to bring home leftovers to enjoy the next day. 
               
               
               
              The good news? You don’t need to head out anymore to have your fill of this hearty stir-fry. Follow this guide to making resto-style yang chow fried rice in under 30 minutes and with pantry usuals. It’s so satisfying that you won’t need to pair it with any other ulam. Next time you’re craving this all-in-one dish, try this recipe.

ingredients.item: chopped spring onion and toasted garlic

instructions: Heat a wok or big, shallow pan over medium flame. Add oil and sauté garlic until fragrant.
Mix in the Knorr Shrimp Cube. Add chorizo or ham and sauté for 1 minute.
Slowly add rice, carrots, green peas, and Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Stir for at least 2 minutes.
Fold in the cooked eggs. Turn off heat and drizzle sesame oil on top. Toss well.
Transfer to a platter. Top with spring onions and toasted garlic. Serve immediately.

name: Grab-and-Go Crispy Chicken Burger in 30 Minutes
description:
Are your loved ones craving chicken burgers after seeing trending posts on TikTok? Surprise them by preparing the treat at home – quicker than heading to the nearest drive-through or having some delivered. For this, you only need 30 minutes to dredge, dip, fry, and build your sandwich. Nothing could be easier! 
               
               
               
              Because this chicken burger recipe is so simple, you can even prepare it in the morning and pack it for your family’s baon. The best part? The fillet will stay crispy even if they wait until lunchtime to take a bite. The secret is in the batter – a unique blend of dry ingredients, seasonings, and spices that can rival fast-food versions. Ready to give it a try?
instructions: Make the dressing: Combine all ingredients in a bowl; mix well. Chill until ready to use.
Make the batter: Combine all ingredients in a bowl; whisk well. Set aside.
Prepare the chicken: Slice each fillet into two. Pound with a mallet. Dredge in cornstarch, then dip in prepared batter. Fry in hot oil until lightly browned and crisp. Drain on paper towels.

Assemble the burger: Spread prepared dressing on the insides of the burger buns. Top a bottom half with shredded lettuce and a crispy chicken fillet. Cover with the top bun. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Serve immediately.

name: 20-Minute Super Garlicky Beef Salpicao With Buttery Steak Rice
description: Beef salpicao is a familiar sight on the hot tapas menus of many Spanish restaurants, often with a price to match. Fortunately, this beef salpicao recipe lets you bring those bold, garlicky flavors home in just 20 minutes. Paired with buttery steak rice cooked in beef fat, it transforms into a full meal that feels indulgent yet surprisingly easy to pull off.
instructions: Prepare the Salpicao Combine beef sirloin, chopped garlic, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, and black pepper in a bowl. Marinate for 10 to 15 minutes to allow the flavors to penetrate the beef.
Toast the Garlic Heat a pan over medium heat. Add oil or butter, then sauté the sliced garlic until lightly toasted and fragrant.
Sear the Beef Separate the beef from the marinade and add the meat to the pan. Reserve the marinade and set it aside. Cook the beef for 2 to 3 minutes, turning occasionally so all sides brown evenly.

Finish the Salpicao Pour the reserved marinade into the pan and add chilies. Toss everything together until the sauce slightly thickens and coats the beef. Transfer the salpicao to a serving plate. Tip: For tender beef, cook just until the cubes are browned outside but still juicy inside. Overcooking can make sirloin tough.
Make the Steak Rice In the same pan, toast the beef fat trimmings until brown and crisp, allowing the rendered fat to coat the pan.

Toss the Steak Rice Add butter and day-old rice to the pan. Toss to coat the grains in the beef fat and butter. Season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning and black pepper to taste. Serve the salpicao with the steak rice immediately.

name: Crab and Corn Chopseuy Hack You Should Try
description: Elevate your ordinary Chopseuy recipe with Knorr Crab & Corn Soup.

ingredients.item: small sized carrots peeled thinly sliced
red and green bell peppers deseeded and sliced
Knorr crab and corn soup dissolved in 2 cups of water

instructions: Saute the garlic until it turns brown. Then add the onion.
Add the carrots, broccoli and cauliflower. Fry the vegetables for about a minute.
Pour in the soy sauce and water to the veggies. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add in the baguio beans and bell peppers. Shortly after, include the cabbage into the mix. Continue cooking for 1 minute.
Distribute the vegetables carefully into the pot, and some oysters sauce.
Slowly pour in the Knorr Crab and Corn soup dissolved in water into the mixture. Mix everything together.
Transfer into a serving dish and enjoy!

name: Sweet & Sour Sampalok Wings Recipe
description: A sweet and sour twist to the classic chicken wings, this recipe takes your chicken wing game to the next level with the use of Knorr Sinigang Sa Sampaloc Classic Mix. The wings owe their complex flavors from the seasoning at every step. From the sampalok rub down to the homemade sweet & spicy sauce, this easy chicken wing recipe guarantees an explosion of flavors with every bite. Make this for special occasions or for everyday meals.
tips: Use a meat thermometer to know if your chicken wings are done. When pierced at the thickest part of the meat, the thermometer should register 165F. If you don’t have a thermometer, a simple trick to know if the chicken is done is if the juices run clear when you pierce the chicken.
instructions: Rub the chicken wings with garlic, salt, and pepper. Let it sit for a few minutes for the chicken wings to absorb the flavor.
Poach the chicken wings: Place seasoned chicken wings inside a pot and add enough water to cover the chicken wings by 1 inch.
Place the pot over medium heat and bring to a boil and then lower the heat to bring the water to a simmer and cook until the chicken wings are done.
Remove the chicken from the liquid and allow it to drain. Pat the chicken dry with a paper towel after.
Rub Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original on the chicken for some added flavor.
Rub Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original on the chicken for some added flavor.
Get three shallow dishes and fill one with flour, one with eggs, and the other with breadcrumbs.
Coat your chicken with flour, shaking off any excess and then dip in the beaten eggs before finally coating it with breadcrumbs. Set aside.
Heat oil in a large saucepan or deep fryer to 375F. Fry chicken wings in hot oil until golden brown and crispy.
Place your chicken wings on a wire rack to get rid of excess oil.
Combine the melted butter, tabasco sauce, sesame oil, and honey in a saucepan and heat until combined and thickened.
Place your chicken wings in a bowl. Then, drizzle the sauce over the chicken wings and toss to coat.

name: Umami-Rich Pork BBQ Recipe
description: It’s time to fire up the grill and gather the family together to make this Pork BBQ recipe that gets its umami kick from a flavorful marinade made with Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Marinating your Pork BBQ not only enhances the flavors of the meat but locks in extra moisture to prevent it from drying out when grilling. Plan ahead and make this ahead of time because of the overnight marinating time.
tips: Try piercing the pork kasim with a fork before adding the marinade to tenderize your meat and allow the flavors to penetrate deeper.

ingredients.item: pork kasim (Pork Butt), sliced into thin strips

instructions: Arrange the pork kasim in a bowl or a heavy-duty food safe plastic container.

In a bowl, whisk all the other ingredients together and pour on top of the pork kasim. Ensure that the pork pieces are well covered by the marinade. Seal the container and leave inside the refrigerator to marinate overnight.

While the meat is marinating, soak your barbeque sticks in water overnight to prepare them for grilling the next day or if you’re pressed for time, soak them in water for at least 30 minutes before grilling.
Take your marinated pork kasim out of the refrigerator and proceed to skewer the meat on the barbeque sticks. Set aside.
Prepare your grill and make sure that it’s nice and hot before you begin grilling your barbeque.
Place the barbecue skewers on the grill until cooked to your desired doneness.
Serve the Pork BBQ warm with your favorite dipping sauce and steaming hot rice.

name: Pork & Shrimp Siomai Recipe To Satisfy Your Cravings
description: Pork & Shrimp siomai is a delicious dumpling that’s perfect as an appetizer, snack, or even as a satisfying ulam served with rice. Finally use your air-fryer and satisfy your Chinese food cravings anytime with this easy and flavorful recipe that can be enjoyed either steamed or air-fried.
tips: For an eco-friendly steamer liner, you can use fresh napa cabbage to line your steamer basket.

ingredients.item: chopped spring onions and carrots for garnish

instructions: Mix the ground pork, shrimp, onion, spring onions, carrots, singkamas, crumbled Knorr Pork Cubes, sesame oil, egg, and pepper in a bowl.
Put your index finger and thumb together to create a flat base for your wonton topper to rest on.
Place a spoonful of the filling on the center of the wonton wrapper.
Push the filling down inside the circle formed by your index finger and thumb to create that siomai-shaped pouch. Leave the top open and set aside.
Continue making the rest of your siomai using the same technique.
Cook the prepared siomai in a steamer lined with wax paper. (Baking paper or aluminum foil are also good substitutes.) Steam for 20-30 minutes or until cooked through.
You can enjoy your steamed siomai or take the extra step of frying them in an air-fryer to get that extra-crisp texture minus the oil.
To air-fry the siomai, brush the outside of the siomai with oil and place in your air-fryer to cook for 10-15 minutes at 180C/350F.
Serve with siomai dipping sauce and chili garlic paste.

name: Healthier Seafood Laksa Recipe
description: Who doesn’t love a good laksa? We took it upon ourselves to develop a healthier Seafood Laksa that’s inspired by one of the more popular Singaporean restaurants in Manila. (Hint: They used to have a branch in Alabang and Rockwell) We used simpler and healthier ingredients, most of which are pantry essentials, except for the Laksa paste that’s widely available online. In this recipe, we use white fish filets that are baked and not fried. We also add plenty of vegetables to make it hefty and nutritious. Light coconut milk combined with Knorr Fish Cubes makes a great soup base that’s guilt-free and satisfying. With minimal ingredients and prep time, this recipe is perfect for making a dinner date at home, so much more special.
tips: Adding the bean sprouts at the last few minutes of cooking the laksa warms them up while helping them remain crisp.

ingredients.item: canola oil or any neutral oil

instructions: In a large pot or wok, heat the oil over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook for about 5 minutes or until soft and almost translucent.
Add the laksa paste. Stir and continue to cook for about 5 minutes, making sure to stir occasionally.
Add water, crumbled Knorr Fish Broth Cube, coconut milk, brown sugar, and fish sauce. Heat gently and cook until simmering.
Add the bell pepper and green beans, and cook for 5 minutes.
While the vegetables are heating, cook the vermicelli noodles by soaking them in boiling water until soft and then drain.

Add in the fish and cook for 2-4 minutes or until it starts to slightly fall apart. Then, add your prawns and cook for an extra minute. The prawns should start changing color and your fish will be cooked.
Add the bean sprouts and cook for 1 more minute and then take off the heat.
Divide the cooked noodles between individual bows and scoop the seafood and vegetables on top. Then, gently pour the soup on top.
Finish off the laksa by garnishing with the chopped cilantro and lime wedges.
Now it’s time to enjoy this warm, delicious, and healthy meal that’ll satisfy all your laksa cravings.

name: Foodhack: A Healthier KFC’s Double Down Burger Recipe
description: We’ve all heard the news – the KFC Double Down Burger is coming back! This bunless burger with a cult following has a whopping 540 calories. It’s an indulgent dish that’s worth the hype, but for some, not the calories. That’s why we decided to create a healthier version of KFC’s Double Down Burger – still satisfying but with fewer calories. Instead of deep frying the chicken breasts, we pan-sear them instead. Instead of full-fat cheese, we use low-fat. The end product is a Double Down Burger that’s healthier than the original but just as satisfying.
tips: For an even healthier version, simply roast the chicken breast in the oven instead of dredging with flour and pan searing beforehand. For a more indulgent version, add a slice of Canadian or American bacon in between.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°F or 400°F.
Season both sides of the chicken breasts with salt, and pepper.
In a shallow bowl, mix together the flour and paprika.
Dredge each chicken breast in the flour mixture, shaking off any excess.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken breasts until golden brown and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes per side.
Transfer the chicken to a baking sheet and place a slice of cheese on each chicken breast.
Bake in the preheated oven for 3-5 minutes, or until the cheese is melted. Take out chicken out of the oven and prepare to assemble.
To assemble the burger, place a lettuce leaf on top of one chicken breast, followed by two slices of tomato.
On the other chicken breast, spread 2 teaspoons of Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise. Place it on top of the other chicken breast, mayo side down.
Serve immediately and enjoy this delicious, yet healthy, version of KFC’s Double Down Burger.

name: Sinigang Flavored Mojos Hack
description: Skip the lines and make your own flavored mojos at home. This is a simple recipe that uses pantry staples as well as Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix for a lip-smacking snack. We made this recipe even easier and healthier by using an air-fryer to get that crispy mojo goodness minus the excess oil. Eat on its own or take it a step further by making a homemade garlic mayo dip for some creaminess to balance out the tart umami flavors.
tips: Make your own chicken breading at home by mixing a cup of flour and a finely crushed cube of Knorr Chicken Broth.

ingredients.item: (22g) pack Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original
garlic clove, minced or ran through a press

instructions: Preheat air fryer to 180°C
Microwave the sliced potatoes for 5 minutes or until cooked through the center.
In a bowl, combine the dry ingredients.
Toss the potato slices in the bowl and toss until every surface is covered. The potatoes will be hot at this point so take extra caution when tossing.
Line up the potatoes in your air-fryer basket, making sure that no potatoes overlap, and spray oil on them.
Air-fry for 15 minutes or until golden brown and crispy.
Place a pack of Sinigang Mix Sa Sampalok in a bowl and toss the mojos to coat. Make sure to shake off the excess powder from the mojos.
In a small bowl, mix all the ingredients together.
Enjoy this lip-smacking healthier snack minus the grease and long lines.

name: Easy Garlic Mayo Chicken Wrap Recipe
description: You can eat healthy, save time, and enjoy your meal all at the same time. This easy garlic mayo chicken wrap recipe checks all these boxes and more. Filled with fresh vegetables and chicken breast that’s bursting with umami flavors, this recipe is bound to be a staple on busy weeknights. Did we mention that you can prepare this ahead of time too?
tips: Make this meal-prep friendly by cooking the meat and preparing the vegetables and garlic mayo ahead of time. When it’s time to eat, all you need to do is assemble it and you have a meal that’s ready in 5 minutes!

ingredients.item: chicken breast fillet, thawed and cut into cubes
(10 gram) pack Knorr sinigang original mix

instructions: Season the chicken breast with Knorr Sinigang Original Mix, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, and ground black pepper. Set aside.
Place a pan over medium heat and drizzle with a bit of oil. Add your onions and in your chicken breast and cook them until the chicken is light brown in color. Set aside.
Make your garlic mayo sauce by whisking all the ingredients in a bowl. Set aside.
It’s time to assemble. Practice mise en place and prepare all your ingredients for filling the tortilla/pita by placing them all in front of you.
Heat up a clean skillet over high heat and quickly toast your pita or tortilla bread on both sides. This should take only a minute or two.
If using pita, make a slit on the side using a sharp knife to create a pocket where you can place your fillings.
Place 2 tablespoons of the chicken mixture, tomatoes, cucumber, and grated cheese inside the pita or on top of the tortilla.
If using a tortilla, roll the tortilla by folding in the sides and rolling it up from the bottom.
Finish the wrap by drizzling with garlic mayo on top.

name: TikTok Viral Korean Overnight Egg Sandwich
description: Make the classic egg sandwich extra special with this TikTok Viral Korean Overnight Egg Sandwich Recipe. This recipe is inspired by the popular Korean side dish, Mayak eggs, made with overnight-marinated soft boiled eggs. Here, we make the wait shorter by giving you the option to marinate for only 6 hours. The strong sweet, sour, and salty flavors of the egg is perfectly balanced by the creamy texture of Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise. Add them to your favorite bread and you’ll have a delicious and filling snack you can eat while binging on your favorite KDrama.
tips: Cut off the edges of your white bread to create a nice clean look for your sandwich.
instructions: Place the 6 eggs in an airtight container making sure that there’s room for the marinade.
In a bowl, mix the white vinegar, soy sauce, water, and honey together. Once mixed, pour this on top of the eggs and allow to marinate in the refrigerator for 6-12 hours overnight.
In a bowl, add Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, garlic, spring onions, sesame seeds, nori flakes, and ½ tbsp of the marinade. Mix until well combined. Taste and season with salt as needed.
Remove eggs from marinade and roughly chop.
Add chopped eggs into the mayonnaise mixture and mix until incorporated.
Prepare to assemble by getting your white bread and topping it with the egg and mayo mixture. Top off with another piece white bread and you have yourself a satisfying snack inspired by Tiktok.

name: Easy Weeknight Korean Fried Chicken Wings
description: You can never have enough fried chicken recipes in your arsenal, especially ones that pack in the flavor and are easy to make. This recipe is everything you’re looking for in Korean fried chicken – it’s crispy, flavorful, and best of all, it’s ready to eat in less than an hour. Serve with rice, your favorite Korean side dishes, and you’ll be eating like your oppas in no time.
tips: Cover the bowl with a plate when tossing the chicken wings to save time and avoid accidental messes.
instructions: Separate the drummettes from the wingette and tips of your chicken wings. Set aside.

In a bowl, add the ginger, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, and black pepper and mix well. Pour this marinade on top of the chicken wings to infuse with flavors from the inside out. Let it sit for 10-15 minutes.
In a shallow bowl, mix the all-purpose flour and the cornstarch. Dredge your marinated wings in this mixture. Place the wings inside the chiller as you prepare the sauce.

Make sauce: In a saucepan, mix garlic, oyster sauce, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, chili sauce, white sugar, and sesame oil. Place on medium heat and bring it up to a simmer. Add your prepared cornstarch slurry to the mix and bring to a boil while you mix continuously.
Set aside the sauce and grab your chicken wings from the chiller. Let rest at room temperature for a few minutes.

Heat oil in a large saucepan or deep fryer to 375F. Gently slide the chicken wings inside, being careful not to overcrowd the pan. Cook until the chicken wings are golden brown or until the juices run clear.
Place your chicken wings on a wire rack to get rid of excess oil.
Place your chicken wings in a bowl. Drizzle the sauce in and toss the chicken to coat.
Garnish with sesame seeds and spring onions to make your Korean Fried Chicken Wings Instagram-ready!

name: Make This Easy Crustless Quiche in Your Air-Fryer
description:
Bring out the mimosas and make this delicious quiche for brunch without breaking a sweat. Save your time and effort with this crustless quiche recipe that comes together in less than an hour with only 15 minutes hands-on time. 
               
               
               
              This recipe uses mayonnaise in place of heavy cream to create a quiche that’s creamier and more flavorful without breaking the bank.
tips: You can adapt this recipe to suit whatever is in your pantry. Feel free to replace the bacon with crumbled sausage and the bell peppers with mushrooms. The possibilities are endless.
instructions: Preheat the oven or air-fryer to 180C.
Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well.
Pour into a greased 8x8 rectangular baking dish or any dish that would fit in your air-fryer, if using an air-fryer.
Bake the quiche in the oven or air-fryer for 20-30 minutes, until the quiche has a slight jiggle to it. The eggs will continue to cook after you take it out of the oven.
Serve on its own or with a salad and a slice of bread.

name: Feel Like a Million Bucks with This Baked Spaghetti Recipe
description: Million Dollar Spaghetti is an easy way to elevate your pasta dishes into something special. It’s similar to lasagna in taste but without the time-consuming assembly lasagna requires. It’s also a freezer-friendly meal that you can prepare ahead of time and whip out whenever you don’t have the energy to cook or if you have last minute guests.
tips: Make two batches of this freezer-friendly dish so you can enjoy one and freeze the other for future meals.

ingredients.item: pasta water, reserved from cooking noodles or plain water

instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Reserve 3 cups of pasta water.
Dissolve Knorr Cream of Mushroom in the reserved 3 cups of pasta water.
Bring to a simmer over medium high heat and allow to simmer for 3 minutes.
Add cream and mix well. Once cream has been incorporated, turn off heat and set the sauce aside.
Sauté ground meats in a saucepan over medium heat until color changes. Discard most of the oil from the pan.
Add onions and garlic into the pan and sauté for 3-5 minutes or until the onion is translucent.
Add the Knorr cubes and mix well until the cubes are dissolved. Season the mix with ground pepper.
Add tomato paste, tomato sauce, and sugar into the pan. Mix well and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Then, turn off the heat and set sauce aside.
Preheat the oven to 180C.
Toss the cooked pasta in the pan with the white sauce and then transfer into a 9x13 rectangular oven-safe dish.
Sprinkle half of the grated cheese over the pasta and spoon the meat sauce on top. Make sure to spread it evenly.
Finish off with the remaining grated cheese.
Bake pasta in a preheated oven for 15-20 minutes or until cheese has melted and has begun to brown.
Remove from oven and allow to sit for 10 minutes before serving. Enjoy!

name: Easy Spinach Cheese Pizza Recipe
description: Making homemade pizza can be a fun activity for the weekend but if you’re intimidated at the thought of making pizza crust, this recipe is for you. We make it easy by replacing homemade pizza crust with a store-bought one that’s easy and delicious too. Inspired by an infamous pizza brand’s spinach dip pizza, this recipe uses pantry staples and the creamiest Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise to make this recipe a great alternative to ordering out. Try this recipe and invite your friends over for a pizza party!
tips: Feeling fancy? Elevate this dish by replacing half of the cream cheese with ricotta for a creamier and more indulgent pizza.
instructions: In a dry pan over low heat, cook spinach until wilted. Remove from pan and roughly chop the spinach. Set aside.
In the same pan, melt butter and sauté garlic and onions until onions are translucent.
Add chopped spinach back into the pan and crumble in ½ Knorr Chicken Cube.
Add the flour into the pan and mix well.
Stir in all-purpose cream and let simmer for 1 minute.
Lower the heat and add cream cheese. Stir until most of the cream cheese has dissolved. You will have a few lumps and that’s okay.
Remove from heat and allow the mixture to cool. Once cooled, stir in Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise. Mix well.
Take out your frozen crust and spread ⅓ of the spinach mixture on top.
Finish with ⅓ of the grated cheese and repeat the same procedure with the other two pizza crusts.
Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 10-15 minutes or until the crust is golden and cheese is starting to brown.
Let the pizza rest for 5 minutes before slicing.

name: Make the Viral Swedish Meatball Sisig at Home
description: Satisfy your curiosity and your cravings by making this Swedish Meatball Sisig inspired by the popular Swedish furniture brand. With a handful of ingredients, you can make this dish with a delicious fusion of flavors even better at home. Part of what makes sisig so iconic, even non-traditional versions of it, are the addicting crispy bits. Meatballs don’t usually crisp up well so we included a few options on how you can add that crunch while still using those yummy Swedish meatballs as your base.
tips: Use pork belly for an added crunch and meatiness to this recipe but if you’re pressed for time, adding more chicharon bits at the end is a great substitute. You can also use tofu in place of pork belly for a healthier, yet still crunchy, alternative.

ingredients.item: to taste Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili
leftover chopped pork belly or pork

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the meatballs to the pan, making sure to crumble them.
Season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning and Calamansi. Cook until desired doneness. Set aside.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil over medium heat.
Sauté the onions, garlic, and siling labuyo (adjust according to your preference) in the pan. Cook until onions are translucent.
Add meatballs to the pan, making sure to toss well with the other ingredients.
Season to taste with Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili and set aside.
Take another pan and heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add pork belly to the pan and cook until crispy.
Drain pork belly and add into the meatball sisig mix for an added crunch.
Gently stir in Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise and feel free to season more with Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili.
Top with chicharon bits and serve with calamansi.

name: Warm & Comforting Pork Congee Recipe for Rainy Days
description: Try this easy and delicious 30-min pork congee recipe on those cold and rainy days. Here, we don’t waste time making something simmer for hours. Instead, we use Knorr Pork Cube to shorten your cook time. One Knorr Pork Cube packs in the richness of 1 kilo of pork taste so despite the ease of this recipe,, this congee still has the rich porky flavor we all love. Who has time to cook on rainy days when all you want to do is lay in bed? This rice porridge recipe is the perfect one-pot meal that will nourish and fill up your family’s tummies with nostalgic Filipino flavors.
tips: Pork Conggee is a great dish to infuse with whatever flavors you like. Be creative and serve with toppings of your choice. Top it with crumbled chicharon to add a crunch texture and to make it extra indulgent.
instructions: In a bowl, combine all the ingredients for the ground pork mixture. Set aside in the chiller.
Wash the malagkit rice two times and drain well.
In a large pot, add malagkit rice, Knorr Pork Cube and water.
Bring to a boil over high heat and then reduce heat to simmer. Cook until rice is tender while mixing occasionally to prevent the bottom from burning. Add water if the mixture thickens too much.
Once porridge is cooked, take your ground pork mixture out of the chiller and drop it into the pot one teaspoon at a time.
Continue to simmer until pork meatballs are fully cooked.
Remove from heat and serve warm.
Top each bowl with chopped spring onions for garnish. You can also serve with other garnishes and sides such as calamansi, fried garlic, egg, or even Knorr Liquid Seasoning Original.

name: Classic Beef Mami Recipe
description: Throw away those instant packets and make this delicious beef mami from scratch in less than an hour. Don’t get us wrong, there's a place for instant beef mami but nothing beats the deep flavors and melt-in-your-mouth beef in this recipe.
tips: Use a combination of beef ribs or buto-buto, beef cubes or camto, and Knorr Beef Cubes for a rich and savory beef flavor in your beef mami.

ingredients.item: beef cube or canto, cut into small cubes
egg noodles, cooked according to package instructions

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add garlic and cook until golden brown. Add onions and cook until onions are soft, making sure to move them around to prevent burning.
Add the beef ribs, beef cubes, water, Knorr Beef Cubes, pepper, and star anise (if using) into the pot. Let it boil and skim off the foam on the surface of the broth.
Reduce heat to a simmer and cover. Cook until the beef is fork tender.
Separate the beef pieces from the broth using a strainer. Slice big pieces of beef into smaller pieces. Set aside.
Prepare the egg noodles according to package instructions and divide into serving bowls.
Top noodles with beef pieces, chopped spring onions, and hot broth. Serve immediately.

name: Ribeye Steak Recipe with Creamy Mushroom Sauce
description: Finally learn how to cook ribeye steak at home with this delicious and easy-to-follow pan-seared steak recipe. Topped with a creamy mushroom sauce, this recipe takes your regular dinner and turns it into a night of celebration. Grab some wine, make your favorite sides, and let's get cooking.
tips: The best way to know the doneness of your steak is checking the internal temperature. Check the temperature by poking your meat thermometer in the thickest part of the steak. Medium-rare would read at 130°F-135°F, Medium at 135°F-145°F, and Medium-Well at 145°F-155°F.
instructions: Dissolve Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup in water. Set aside.
Heat butter in a pan over medium heat. Let butter melt and sauté garlic in butter until fragrant.
Add Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup mix to the pan. Let simmer and wait for it to thicken. Thin the sauce by adding more water if it’s thicker than desired. Set aside.
Prep the steak for pan-searing by blotting the ribeye with paper towels. A dry surface equals a better crust on your steak.
Season your steak with salt and pepper. Set aside.
Heat a grill pan until smoking.
Add your seasoned ribeye steak to your very hot pan. You may need to cook in batches to not overcrowd the pan.

Cook 1 side for 2 minutes. Flip and then cook the other side for another 2 minutes. Depending on the thickness of your steak, this will yield a ribeye that’s medium doneness. You can adjust the cooking time depending on how thick the steak is and your preferred doneness.
Serve immediately with the mushroom sauce on the side.
categories: HOW TO COOK A RIBEYE STEAK ON THE GRILL
HOW TO COOK RIBEYE STEAK IN A PAN

name: Filipino-Style Burger Recipe: Longganisa Burger with Egg
description: Make this quick and easy, yet satisfying, longganisa burger at home. With only a handful of ingredients, you can make this Filipino-style burger in only 35 minutes. It’s easy enough to serve on busy days but also great for hosting a party at home with minimal prep. You can choose what type of longganisa to use depending on your mood. Use garlicky Lucban longganisa or the ever-popular Vigan longganisa. Whatever you choose, make sure to not skip the creamy garlic mayo sauce that packs a punch of flavor and adds creaminess to this burger.
tips: Toast your burger buns in mayonnaise or butter before assembly to prevent them from getting soggy when topped with the sauce, burger, and eggs.
instructions: Heat oil over medium-low heat. Add the chopped garlic in warm, not hot, oil to make sure it doesn’t burn. Cook garlic while stirring occasionally for 7 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove garlic from oil using a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Allow to cool before adding to a bowl and mixing with Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise.
In a hot pan, make sunny side up eggs. Set aside for assembly later.
Remove longganisa from casings and mix together in a bowl. Divide meat into four equal parts and form into burger patties.
In a hot pan, fry longganisa patties until cooked through. Set aside.
To assemble, spread toasted garlic-mayo mixture onto sliced sides of buns.
Place cooked longganisa patties on the buns and then top with the sunny side eggs. Finish by topping with the other side of the buns.
Serve immediately with extra toasted garlic-mayo on the side. Feel free to add shredded cabbage, tomatoes, and onions. Personalize this Filipino-style burger to your liking!
categories: HOW TO MAKE BURGER PATTY FILIPINO STYLE

name: Easy Canned Fish Yaki Onigiri Recipe
description: Take the Tik Tok tinned fish trend to the next level by learning how to make yaki onigiri using canned tuna or salmon as your filling. This recipe gives you flexibility in your fillings as well as in what kind of rice to use. You can use traditional Japanese rice or local short-grained rice dinorado, depending on what’s accessible to you. The beauty of this Yaki Onigiri recipe is once you learn how to make it, the possibilities are quite endless when it comes to the fillings that you can use. Think of this recipe as a tutorial to get the technique right so that you can be creative later on.
tips: Serve this Yaki Onigiri as is or with a small piece of seaweed at the bottom for added flavor and a decorative touch.

ingredients.item: Japanese rice or short grain rice (Dinurado)
tuna in oil or canned salmon, drained well

instructions: Cook your rice in a rice cooker until tender. Once cooked, transfer rice on a bowl. Sprinkle sesame seeds on top and mix to incorporate.
Combine all filling ingredients in a bowl. Mix well.
Fill a bowl with potable water. You will use this to wet your hands.
Wet your hands and scoop about ½ cup of rice mixture.
Make an indent at the center of the mixture and spoon 1 tablespoon of filling inside. Fold the rice over the filling and shape into a rice ball.
To make triangle shaped onigiri, use your hands to form them into a triangle. Set aside and continue making until the rice and filling mixtures are used up.
Heat a non-stick pan with a drizzle of oil over medium heat. Place onigiris on the pan, being careful not to crowd the pan.
Toast the onigiris on both sides. Finish the onigiris by brushing the surfaces with Knorr Liquid Seasoning Original on both sides.
categories: HOW TO MAKE GRILLED RICE BALLS

name: Very Strawberry Donut Ice Cream Sandwich
description: Satisfy your sweet tooth with a strawberry donut ice cream sandwich made with Selecta Super Thick ice cream. The ultimate dessert dream.
instructions: Get your favorite sugar-glazed donut and slice it crosswise.
On one side, cover the hole with a strawberry slice and add a scoop os Selecta Super Thick Vanilla ice cream.
Cover the ice cream with the other half of the donut to make a sandwich. Get the remaining strawberry pieces and press them into the sides of the donut sandwich ice cream scoop.
Top the donut ice cream sandwich with a dollop of whipped cream, some pretzel sticks, and HERSHEY’S Strawberry syrup to serve.

name: Chopsuey hack with crab and corn soup
description: Bring out the seafood flavor in your Chopsuey by using Knorr Crab & Corn Soup that is made with REAL Crab & Corn that can ultimately level up your veggie dish.

ingredients.item: small-sized sayote, peeled, deseeded and sliced
red and green bell pepper, deseeded and sliced
Knorr crab and corn soup, dissolved in 2 cups water
pack of Knorr Crab & Corn Soup

instructions: Sauté onions and garlic in hot oil until lightly browned.
Sauté chicken breast and chicken liver until cooked.
Add sayote and cook for 2mins.
Add in the rest of the vegetables except for the cabbage. Mix well.
Pour in dissolved Knorr Crab and Corn Soup. Allow to simmer. Cover and cook vegetables for 8 mins.
Lastly add cabbage and season with fine ground pepper. Continue to cook for another 3 mins. Serve immediately.

name: Healthy & Juicy Air Fryer Chicken Breast
description: Chicken breast often gets a bad rep, especially when it’s boneless and skinless like what we use in this recipe. It’s dubbed bland, dry, and hard to flavor but we’re here to change that. Chicken breast can be flavorful and juicy by just adding an extra step before cooking – brining. Brining keeps your chicken breast moist and adds extra flavor to the meat. In this recipe, we use Knorr Chicken cube to amp up the flavor, making it taste like it’s been cooked in chicken stock for hours, minus the dryness. We make it extra easy by using an air fryer for even cooking and browning of the chicken breast.
tips: Spray your air fryer basket with non-stick spray to prevent your chicken from sticking to it. If you don’t have non-stick spray, brushing the basket with oil can help. Just make sure it’s an oil with a high smoke point such as canola or peanut oil.

ingredients.item: whole boneless and skinless chicken breasts (4 pcs if sliced in half)

instructions: Make the brine by adding the water, Knorr Chicken Cube, thyme, and garlic into a pot. Bring to a boil and allow to boil for 3 minutes. Set aside and let it cool completely.
Once brine has cooled down, transfer to a container with a cover. Make sure it’s big enough for the brine and the chicken pieces.
Submerge the chicken in the brine and allow to brine in the chiller for at least two hours up to overnight.
Remove chicken breast from brine and pat dry. Add oil and season with italian seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.

Add seasoned chicken into the air fryer basket and air fry on medium heat for 10 minutes. Flip the chicken and cook again for another 10 minutes. Make sure to check on your chicken as cook time will vary depending on your air fryer and the size of your chicken breast.
Once cooked, let rest for a few minutes before slicing. Serve alongside your favorite chicken sides, bonus if it’s air fried vegetables!
categories: COOKING CHICKEN BREAST IN AIR FRYER

name: Korean Spicy Noodles with a Filipino Twist
description: Korean pop culture has infiltrated our shores and it shows no signs of slowing down. Whether you’re a KDrama or KPop fan, there’s one thing all of us can agree on – Korean food is amazing. With mouthwatering flavors and fun flavor experiences, we’re lovers of Korean cuisine. One of our favorites is Korean Spicy Noodles. While we love it on its own like most of you do, we wanted to challenge ourselves by infusing a Filipino twist to it using the breakfast staple, tapa with a little atchara on the side. We love how the flavors of these iconic foods create a dish that’s addictingly sweet, spicy, salty, and creamy all at the same time. Try this recipe next time you’re binging on your favorite KDramas.
tips: Hints & Comments:Instead of using scrambled eggs, you can make soft boiled eggs instead to top your noodles with.

ingredients.item: store-bought tapa, cut into bite sized pieces
Shin Ramyun Stir Fry (Korean spicy stir-fry noodles)

instructions: Slice store-bought tapa into bite-sized pieces and cook according to package instructions. Set aside.
Make sunny side up eggs according to your desired doneness. Set aside.
Cook Shin Ramuyun Stir Fry according to package directions and divide into two bowls.
Top with tapa, sunny side up egg, and atsara.
Finish by drizzling Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise on top for that rich creamy taste and enjoy!

name: Savory Japanese Soufflé Pancakes
description: These fluffy Japanese soufflé pancakes are everything you imagined them to be, and more! Light and airy, these pancakes are perfect for when you want to elevate (literally!) your pancake game at home. Usually topped with something sweet like whipped cream and fruits, this recipe puts a spin on this trending food by adding a savory twist to it. Instead of chocolate sauce, we top this fluffy pancake with a rich mushroom bechamel and crumbled bacon for that savory-sweet combination.
tips: If you want cleaner sides on your Japanese pancakes, you can use ring molds to make sure the pancakes stay tall and fluffy. Make sure to spray the sides with non-stick spray or oil to prevent the batter from sticking.
instructions: Cook bacon in a saucepan over medium heat until the fat is rendered and the bacon crisp. Drain bacon from oil and set bacon aside.
In the same pot, add butter and sauté garlic and mushrooms for a few seconds.
Stir in flour, making sure to whisk well and then add in the milk. Keep whisking so that your sauce will not split. Allow the mixture to simmer.
Add cream cheese and mix well. Season with nutmeg if using and remove from heat. Set aside.
Prepare the pancake mix following package directions but with less water and using 4 egg yolks. Mix well.
In a separate bowl, add cream of tartar and egg whites. Whip into stiff peaks. You can use a hand mixer or do it by hand. Be prepared to put in some elbow grease if whisking by hand.
Fold the egg white mixture into the pancake mixture. Set aside.
Preheat your pan or griddle and add butter until melted at the lowest heat setting.
Scoop your Japanese pancake batter into mounds in the pan. The secret to making tall souffle pancakes is to do it step by step or layer by layer.
After you added your first pancake mound in the pan, cover the pan and cook for 4-5 minutes. After that, add more pancake batter on top and proceed to do the same.
Add the last mound of batter on your pancake once you get the desired height and proceed to flip gently. Cover, and steam the pancake again for 5-6 minutes.
Make sure to not overcrowd the pan and cook by batches.
To serve, stack 2 pancakes together and scoop some of the bechamel sauce on top. Finish by sprinkling crisp bacon on top. Serve immediate and enjoy!
categories: HOW TO MAKE JAPANESE SOUFFLE PANCAKES
HOW TO MAKE FLUFFY JAPANESE SOUFFLE PANCAKES

name: Make Taco Tuesdays Special with Beef Birria Tacos
description: Take Taco Tuesday to the next level by making these easy birria tacos at home. Birria is a Mexican dish that’s usually made by braising meat, usually goat or beef, in a pot full of spices for 3-4 hours or longer to tenderize the meat and infuse it with the rich flavor we’ve all come to love. This recipe takes a similar approach in tenderizing the meat by simmering until tender but takes it to the next level by using Knorr Beef Cubes. Beef cubes help you get that full-bodied flavor of beef minus the meat. Pack your birria tacos with flavor without breaking the bank by using this special ingredient.
instructions: Heat oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the beef and sear on all sides. Do this in batches to not overcrowd the pot.
Once done, put all the seared beef pieces back in the pot and add all the ingredients for the birria. For the water, add just enough that it covers the meat.
Bring to a boil and then reduce to a simmer. Cover the pot and allow it to cook until the beef pieces are tender. Depending on your meat, this can take as little as two hours to as long as 4 hours.
Once the beef is tender, strain the beef from the braising sauce, making sure to set aside the broth for later use.
Shred the beef pieces and set aside.
Brush flour tortillas using the braising sauce and toast on a dry pan over medium heat.
Fill half of the tortilla with shredded beef, a few cilantro leaves, and cheese.
Fold the tortilla and proceed to toast a bit more. Take out of the pan and do the rest with your remaining birria and tortillas.
Serve tacos with the braising sauce as the dip.

name: Hack the TikTok Famous Pink Sauce Recipe at Home
description: Hack the Tik Tok famous pink sauce by making this recipe at home. With a few pantry staples and dragon fruit powder for that iconic pink hue, you can have this sauce ready in less than 10 minutes. In terms of flavor, pink sauce tastes like ranch with a hint of fruity sweetness. Use it on wherever you use ranch -- burgers, fries, salads, or even pastas. This pink sauce recipe is versatile and can get your dishes Instagram-ready in no time.
tips: Make sure to store your pink sauce in an air-tight bowl with plastic wrap pressed against the sauce to prevent oxidation.
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl and chill for 30 minutes before serving.
Serve with fries, fried chicken, salads, and even pastas!

name: No-Bake Cookie Dough Ice Cream Sandwiches
description: Try out our No-Bake Cookie Dough Ice Cream Sandwiches!

ingredients.item: selecta classic super thick vanilla ice cream

instructions: Cream the butter, sugars, vanilla and salt together in a large bowl until light and fluffy. Add the flour, then fold in the chocolate chips or chopped chocolate. Divide the mixture in two.

Line a 8in x 8in square tin with cling film or baking/wax paper, leaving a small overhang and press one half of the cookie dough into the tin to cover the base. Remove the square of cookie dough and place into the fridge then line the tin once more with cling film, this time leaving a slightly larger overhang.

Press the second half of the cookie dough into the bottom of the tin and flatten with your hands. Scoop the ice cream on top of the cookie base and smooth out with the back of a spoon or palette knife, until smooth and flat. Chill in the fridge for at least 20 minutes.
Remove the cookie square from the fridge and place on top of the ice cream. Press down slightly and then place the whole thing into the freezer for at least 4 hours, or until frozen.

When ready to serve, remove the baking tin and turn the ice cream sandwich out onto a chopping board. Remove the cling film and with a hot blade, slice the sandwich into 9 equal squares. You can serve the sandwich at this point if you wish.

If using sprinkles and chocolate melt: dip each square into the melted milk chocolate, covering half of the sandwich, and then decorate with your choice of sprinkles—try to be quick at this point as the chocolate will set fairly quickly on the frozen sandwich. Serve straight away or place back into the freezer to serve later.

name: Easy Cookie Ice Cream Sandwich
description: Treat yourself to a mouthwatering cookie ice cream sandwich with the creamy goodness of Selecta Classic Super Thick Vanilla ice cream.

ingredients.item: selecta super thick vanilla ice cream

instructions: On one cookie, place a scoop of Selecta Super Thick vanilla ice cream.
Add some chocolate chips onto the scoop as well as a drizzle of HERSHEY’S Chocolate Shell Topping.
Top the scoop with another cookie to close the cookie sandwich. Press marshmallows into the side of the cookie sandwich for some extra fun. Now your sandwich is ready to serve!

name: Donut Ala-Mode
description: Try our Ice Cream Donut!
instructions: Get your favorite donuts from your nearest grocery or bakery. Slice each bun in half.
Scoop up some Selecta Super Thick ice cream, or any of your favorite flavors!

Fill the donut sandwich with your ice cream scoop and any other ingredients you wish. You can put syrup, sprinkles, or other toppings inside the sandwich or on top of the donut. Either way, your Selecta donut ala mode is already sure to be a hit!

name: Brownie A La Mode
description: Brownie ala mode from Wall's!

ingredients.item: selecta super thick vanilla ice cream

instructions: Prepare your White King brownies according to pack, or buy your favorite brownies!
When the brownies are ready, let them cool for a bit before scooping some Selecta Super Thick ice cream over 2-3 brownies.
Top the brownies with your ice cream scoop and any other ingredients you wish. Whether it’s sprinkles or syrup or chocolate chips, your Selecta brownie ala mode is already sure to be a hit!

name: Pandesal A La Mode
description: You can’t go wrong with pandesal ala mode! Level up this Pinoy staple with Selecta Super Thick ice cream.

ingredients.item: selecta super thick ube royale ice cream

instructions: Get your pandesal at your nearest grocery or bakery. Slice each bun in half.
Scoop up some Selecta Super Thick Ube Royale ice cream, or any of your favorite flavors!
Fill the pandesal sandwich with your ice cream scoop and any other ingredients you wish. Whether it’s banana chips or salted egg, your Selecta pandesal ala mode is already sure to be a hit!

name: Ensaymada A La Mode
description: Discover the delightful fusion of Ensaymada A La Mode with the creaminess of Selecta Super Thick ice cream. Pure Filipino delight.

ingredients.item: selecta super thick ube royale ice cream

instructions: Get your pre-made ensaymada at your nearest grocery or bakery.
Scoop up some Selecta Super Thick Ube Royale ice cream!
Top the cheesy ensaymada with your ice cream scoop and any other ingredients you wish. Whether it’s banana chips or salted egg, your Selecta ensaymada ala mode is already sure to be a hit!

name: Cupcake A La Mode
description: Experience the joy of Cupcake A la mode with the creamy goodness of Selecta Classic Super Thick ice cream.
instructions: Get your favorite cupcakes from your nearest grocery or bakery.
Scoop up some Selecta Super Thick ice cream, or any of your favorite flavors! We recommend Ube Royale if you have a cheese cupcake, or Mango and Strawberry for vanilla cupcakes.
Top the cupcake with your ice cream scoop and any other ingredients you wish. Whether it’s sprinkles or syrup or chocolate chips, your Selecta cupcake ala mode is already sure to be a hit!

name: Mamon A La Mode
description: Savor the perfect blend of warm mamon and cool Selecta Super Thick ice cream. Mamon a la mode is a Pinoy favorite that never disappoints.
instructions: Get your favorite mamon from your nearest grocery or bakery.
Scoop up some Selecta Super Thick ice cream, or any of your favorite flavors!

Top the mamon with your ice cream scoop and any other ingredients you wish. You can even stick some wafers into the mamon for a fun look! Whether it’s sprinkles or syrup or chocolate chips, your Selecta mamon ala mode is already sure to be a hit!

name: Choco Lava Cake A La Mode
description: Melt-in-the-mouth choco lava cake gets even better with Selecta Super Thick ice cream. You can't go wrong with this delightful treat: choco lava cake A la mode!
instructions: Get your pre-made choco lava cake at your nearest grocery or bakery.
Scoop up some Selecta Super Thick ice cream in your favorite flavors!
Top the cakes with your ice cream scoop and any other ingredients you wish. Whether it’s syrup or banana chips, your Selecta choco lava cake ala mode is already sure to be a hit!

name: Pancake ala-mode
description: You can’t go wrong with pancake ala mode! Level up these sweet treats with Selecta Super Thick ice cream.

ingredients.item: selecta super thick mango ice cream

instructions: Make your favorite White King hotcakes according to the pack, or get your favorite pancakes ready!
Chop fruit toppings into cubes for later.
While letting the pancakes cool, scoop up some Selecta Super Thick ice cream, or any of your favorite flavors!
Top the pancakes with Selecta Super Thick Mango ice cream, mango cubes, and drizzle everything with some maple syrup.
Whatever Super Thick flavor you use and toppings you add, your Selecta pancake ala mode is already a hit!

name: S'more A La Mode
description: Indulge in creamy goodness! Our S'more A La Mode combines brownies, grahams, marshmallows, and Selecta Classic Super Thick Vanilla ice cream for a tasty treat!

ingredients.item: scoop selecta super thick classic vanilla ice cream

instructions: Scoop Selecta Super Thick Classic Vanilla ice cream into a glass.
Add the brownie cubes, then the crushed grahams, before adding another scoop of ice cream.

To prepare the mallows, place 1.2 cup of mini mallows in a bake-safe pan and bake at 190 degrees Celsius for 10 minutes, or use a culinary torch to brown the mallows. Use the mallows as topping for the sundae.
Drizzle the s'mores sundae with chocolate syrup to serve.

name: Mango Ice-Cream Freakshake
description: Refreshing Selecta Super Thick Mango ice cream upgrades your mango float into an irresistible freakshake, with whipped cream and graham crumbs to boot.

ingredients.item: scoop selecta super thick classic mango ice cream

instructions: Place the milk and Selecta Super Thick Mango ice cream into a blender and blend until smooth and thickened.
Place the mango, sugar and water into a small saucepan and slowly bring to the boil. Simmer for 10 minutes then add the lime zest and stir through.
Remove from the heat and pass through a strainer to remove any fibers then set aside.

Place your peeled mango ‘cheek’ onto a chopping board and thinly slice. Fan out the mango slices so that they form a long line with the slices overlapping each other. Remove the small slices from the ends if you’d like: they can be difficult to shape. Starting from one end, curl the mango slices toward the center, continuing to curl the slices until you get a rose.
In a bowl, whip the chilled cream into soft peaks and place into a piping bag. Alternatively, you can used instant canned whipped cream and skip this step.

To assemble the freakshake, dip the rim of your glass into the melted white chocolate, then into the crushed graham crackers. Using a spoon, drizzle the mango syrup into the inside of your glass, and then pour your milkshake into the glass.

Spoon the whipped cream on top of the milkshake then place the mango rose on top of the cream. Sprinkle with the remaining graham crackers and place your straw into the milkshake, threading it through the inside of your mango rose.

name: Mango Otap Float
description: Treat yourself to a Mango Otap Float – a heavenly combination of crispy otap, luscious mango, and Selecta Super Thick Classic Vanilla. Pure comfort in a glass.

ingredients.item: scoop selecta super thick classic vanilla ice cream

instructions: Crush the otap cookies in a bowl. Slice the mango into small chunks.
In another small bowl, mix the cream and milk until combined.

To prepare the float, start with a layer of crushed otap in a glass. Drizzle with the milk mixture before adding a mango later. Add a scoop of Selecta Super Thick Classic Vanilla ice cream. Repeat the layers until the glass is filled, and top the last ice cream scoop with crushed otap.
Feel free to add other toppings or mix up the layers as you wish! Best served chilled.

name: Brown Sugar Vanilla Milkshake
description: Craving the perfect milkshake? Our Vanilla Milkshake with Selecta Super Thick Classic Vanilla, bananas, and brown sugar syrup is the no-fail choice.

ingredients.item: scoops selecta super thick classic vanilla

instructions: To make the syrup, the brown sugar and water in a saucepan under low heat. Bring to a simmer and stir until all the sugar has been dissolved.
In a blender, mix Selecta Super Thick Classic Vanilla, milk, and bananas. Blend until fully combined and smooth.
To serve, drizzle the brown sugar syrup on the inside of a tall glass. Pour in the milkshake mixture to fill. For optional garnish, top with whipped cream and cookie crumbs to serve.

name: Super Graham Pops
description: Indulge in the sheer excitement of Graham Pops, where graham crackers meet the creamy indulgence of Selecta Super Thick ice cream.
instructions: Prepare glass with around Get one graham cracker square and layer a pretzel stick over the middle.
Add one scoop of your favorite Selecta Super Thick ice cream on top of the graham cracker and pretzel stick. Press another graham square over the scoop.
Holding this by the pretzel stick, dip the graham pop into HERSHEY’S Chocolate Shell Topping. Set the pop aside on a separate plate or wax paper.
Before the choco shell hardens, top the graham pop with any garnishings you wish: From sprinkles, to cereal, or anything you want!
Repeat the steps to make more graham pops!

name: Ube Ice Cream Turon
description: Satisfy your sweet cravings with crunchy and tasty turon, oozing with the richness of native Kinampay Ube, thanks to Selecta Super Thick Classic Ube Royale!

ingredients.item: scoops selecta super thick classic ube royale

instructions: In a bowl, mix the sliced banana / saba, desiccated coconut, and brown sugar together.
To enjoy the richness of native Kinampay Ube, add six scoops of Selecta Super Thick Classic Ube Royale. Once completely mixed, you can now freeze the mixture overnight.
Once completely frozen, slice the ice cream into 12 rectangles.
Get one slice of frozen ube and place two slices of jackfruit on top of it. Place these onto the bottom third of a turon wrapper.
In a separate small bowl, mix the icing sugar, flour, and water. This will be used later to seal the turon wrapper.

Dip the pastry brush in the mixed ingredients from Step 5 and apply it in the corners of the turon wrapper. Fold the wrapper once, then fold the sides to enclose it and roll. Repeat to make 11 more pieces of turon.
Deep fry the turon in oil until almost completely golden brown. Add caramel syrup to serve.

name: 35-Minute Misua with Meatball Recipe (Almondigas Soup)
description: Misua with meatballs, also known as almondigas soup, is a classic Filipino soup that evokes childhood memories of suspended classes watching the news (or cartoons if you’re lucky) on the TV. Made with only a handful of ingredients, this soup is rich in the pork flavors we Filipinos love all thanks to Knorr Pork Cubes. One pork cube is flavor-packed and infuses flavor into your misua soup that’s equivalent to 1 kilogram of pork. Not only do you save time, but you stay within budget with this hearty, healthy, and easy misua with meatballs recipe. Try this recipe out today!
instructions: In a big bowl, add ground pork, whole egg, spring onions, 1 piece Knorr Pork Cube, white pepper, and flour. Mix it well.
Scoop 1 tablespoonful of the meatball mixture and roll into balls. Set aside.
Set a heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat. Once heated, add oil and garlic and sauté for a few seconds.
Add water and remaining Knorr Pork Cube. Bring mixture to a boil.
Once boiling, add prepared meatballs. You’ll know the meatballs are cooked when they float on the surface.
Once the meatballs are cooked, add the misua into the pot.
Remove from heat and allow the residual heat in the soup to cook the misua noodles.
Season according to taste and top with some spring onions for garnish. Now you’re ready to enjoy your misua with meatballs.
categories: HOW TO MAKE MISUA SOUP WITH MEATBALLS
HOW TO MAKE MISUA WITH MEATBALLS

name: Try This Beef Taco Recipe With A Filipino Kaldereta Twist
description: Take a break from the usual beef tacos by making this Kaldereta beef taco recipe. We use the usual beef taco ingredients but add a Filipino twist to it using Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Kaldereta. It infuses the ground beef with the rich and complex flavors of Kaldereta minus the hours of simmering the meat. This dish comes together in less than an hour and is perfect for changing up Taco Tuesdays.
tips: If you find yourself scrambling for what to eat during busy weeknights, you can transform this beef taco recipe into a delicious 5-minute meal. Simply prep the components ahead of time, we suggest during the weekend, and store separately in the refrigerator. When you’re ready to eat, take them out and assemble them.

ingredients.item: 45 g Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Kaldereta, dissolved in 1 cup water
small lettuce or red cabbage, sliced

instructions: Set a pan over medium high heat.
Add the oil, onions, and garlic to the pan. Sauté until the onion starts to turn translucent and the garlic starts browning.
Add the ground beef, dissolved Knorr Complete Recipe Mix Kaldereta, Knorr Beef Cubes, and bell peppers. Allow the beef to absorb the liquid and cook until the meat and vegetables are cooked through.
Season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning to taste.
Grab a taco shell and add ground beef at the bottom.
Add equal amounts of white onions, singkamas, and lettuce/cabbage to the taco shell.
Finish off with a sprinkling of grated cheese.
Enjoy this unique beef taco recipe with a Filipino twist!

name: The Easiest Chinese Stir Fry Vegetables Recipe
description: Stir fried mixed vegetables prepped, cooked, and served in about 30 minutes? We’ve got you covered with the easiest Chinese vegetatable stir fry recipe you’ll find online! This healthy dish is perfect for picky eaters in the mood for healthier fare — it’s brimming with veggies and you can choose to serve it with shrimp, pork, or beef stock. Our vegetable stir fry recipe isn’t only beginner-friendly; it’s also versatile on the flavor front! Here’s how you can get your Asian vegetable stir fry started in the kitchen.
tips: While green cabbage provides you with fibrous goodness, did you know that red or purple cabbage has 10 times more vitamins? It’s packed with vitamin C, antioxidants, and cancer-fighting flavonoids. So when you can, go for purple cabbage. Your body will thank you. For those who are on a keto diet or are just trying to load on protein, consider adding pre-boiled and peeled quail eggs to your stir fry vegetables.

ingredients.item: chicken liver, sliced into bite-sized pieces
cauliflowers florets, cut into bite-sized pieces
Knorr Shrimp, Beef, or Pork Cube
baguio beans, cut into bite-sized pieces
red and green bell peppers, sliced

instructions: Heat a wok or pan for 1 minute over medium heat.
Add oil to wok. Sauté garlic and onions until slightly browned.
In the same wok, add your choice of meat (shrimp, chicken, or chicken liver) and sauté for 2 minutes. Add ground black pepper then sauté for another minute.
Add carrots, cauliflower, sayote, water, and Knorr Shrimp, Beef, or Pork Cube, depending on the flavor profile you’re craving. Mix well, cover, and let simmer for 5 minutes or until sayote is cooked.
Add bell pepper, Baguio beans, and celery stalks. Mix well, cover, and let simmer for 3 minutes.
Add celery leaves, cabbage, dissolved cornstarch, singkamas, and oyster sauce. Mix well. Cover and let simmer again for 1 minute or until sauce thickens. Serve.

name: On-the-Go Bites with These Customizable Burrito Recipes
description: In the Filipino setting, some of the heartiest meals are best enjoyed by hand. Plus, it helps to have a versatile dish that you can enjoy on the go — like a filling burrito. But there are so many kinds of burritos out there. Where do we start? What if we tell you, we have a chicken burrito recipe, a beef burrito recipe, and a breakfast burrito recipe rolled into one right here? The only way to know is to read til the end! Mix and match our cooking steps and methods, and choose which burrito recipe works well for you.
tips: We all have busy days, so advance food prep helps heaps. Slice or chop vegetables prior to cooking and assembly, and store in the refrigerator for faster kitchen preparation. You can do the same with your garlic sauce — make it in your free time and keep it handy for when you’ll need it. You can use homemade garlic sauce for other dishes, too.

ingredients.item: pinch salt and ground black pepper
lollo rosso lettuce, sliced into thin strips
medium-sized white onion, sliced into thin strips
ripe tomatoes, deseeded and sliced into thin strips
cucumber, peeled, deseeded and sliced into thin strips
iceberg lettuce or lollo rosso lettuce, sliced into thin strips

instructions: Marinate chicken breast in a mixture of curry powder, cumin, yogurt, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Mix well and leave to soak for about 15 minutes.
While letting the chicken soak in marinade, thinly slice lolo rosso lettuce, tomatoes, and cucumber. Set aside.
Pan-fry marinated chicken breast until cooked, then cut into small cubes. A healthier alternative: grill your marinated chicken breast instead of frying.

To assemble, spread Lady’s Choice Chicken Spread on tortilla wrapper. Fill the bottom half of the wrapper with cubed chicken and sliced lolo rosso lettuce, tomatoes, and cucumber. Fold the top half to seal the burrito.
Toast assembled creamy curry chicken burrito on a pan or griddle until lightly crisped or browned. Serve as is or with garlic sauce.

Marinate beef in a mixture of soy sauce, calamansi juice, brown sugar, chopped garlic, ground black pepper, and Knorr Beef Cube dissolved in hot water. Mix well and leave to soak for about 15 minutes.
While letting the beef soak in marinade, slice the vegetables and set aside. Then, heat a grill pan or a flat frying pan over high heat.
Drain the marinade and grill the beef in batches until cooked through.
Chop beef into bite-sized pieces once slightly cooled.

To assemble, heat tortilla on a flat pan until slightly toasted. Transfer on a plate, then fill the middle part with vegetables and beef. Drizzle with garlic sauce and grated cheese. Roll and wrap with foil before serving.
Combine Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, yogurt, garlic powder, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Mix well.
Transfer mixture in a squeeze bottle with a funnel.
Chill and set aside until ready to use.

name: Adobo Flavored Cookies? Yes, It's Possible!
Moist Chocolate Cake Recipe with a Surprise Ingredient!
description:
There are many simple moist chocolate cake recipes out there claiming to be the best, but one proves to be the most intriguing. Have you ever heard of chocolate mayonnaise cake? Yes, mayo in your chocolate cake! It might sound absurd if you’ve never tried it, but it’s a tried-and-tested baking method that has been passed on from one generation to the next. 
               
               
               
              Why put mayonnaise in chocolate cake in the first place? It’s hailed as a secret ingredient that makes the decadent dessert extra rich and moist! 
               
               
               
              Historically, super moist old fashioned chocolate mayo cakes originated from a shortage of eggs, dairy, and sugar in World War II. Mayonnaise was used as a replacement ingredient, then eventually evolved into a kitchen hack that made it to any respectable list of chocolate moist cake ingredients. If you’re still having a hard time imagining the flavors playing well together, then try it for yourself. Here’s how to make moist chocolate cake with mayonnaise as a star ingredient.
tips: For toppings, go colorful and healthy with fresh fruits like strawberries, blueberries, bananas, and peaches. You know what they say, the more colors on your plate, the healthier it is. Who knew that applied to dessert, too?
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°C. Grease and flour two 9-inch round cake pans. Set aside.
In a medium bowl, combine flour, cocoa, baking soda, and baking powder. Set aside.
In a large bowl, beat eggs, sugar, and vanilla on high speed for 3 minutes or until the mixture is light and fluffy. Add Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise and mix at low speed until combined.

Divide the flour into four portions and the water into three portions. Add the first portion of flour into the wet ingredients and mix. Then add the first portion of water and mix. Continue until all the flour and water portions are used up. Make sure to mix until no flour streaks remain.
Divide the batter into two and pour into the prepared pans.
Bake for 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cakes comes out clean. Take out the cake and cool for 10 minutes on a wire rack.
Remove the cake from the pans and cool completely.
Decorate the cake with desired frosting and toppings. Chill for another 20 to 30 minutes. Slice and serve.
Chop chocolate and place in a heat-proof bowl.
On a small saucepan, heat up the cream until simmering. Make sure to watch the cream and don’t let it boil.
Pour warm cream on top of the chopped chocolate and let it sit for 3-5 minutes.
Using a rubber spatula, mix the chocolate and cream together until you get a smooth ganache.
Allow to cool at room temperature, making sure to cover with cling wrap touching the surface of the ganache.
Once cooled, frost your cooled moist chocolate mayo cakes with this rich and delicious chocolate ganache.
categories: HOW TO MAKE MOIST CHOCOLATE CAKE
SUPER MOIST OLD FASHIONED CHOCOLATE MAYO CAKE

name: Easy Fried Ham and Cheese Bread Roll Sandwich
description: Nothing wrong with the classic ham and cheese sandwich, but you can always zhush it up with minimal effort. Let’s take this classic and transform it into a rock ‘n’ roll party for the palate. Our ham and cheese roll recipe takes an extra step: frying — wait, it gets better — in Japanese panko or flaky breadcrumbs! You will never crave store-bought fried ham and cheese bread roll sandwiches again because nothing beats making them from scratch at home, where you can customize flavors and add your all-time fave sandwich ingredients into the mix.
tips: If you’re having trouble keeping your ham and cheese rolls from unfurling, don’t forget pop in your sandwiches in the freezer for a few minutes to allow the breading to set. For more flavor, after frying, top your fried sandwich rolls with a generous sprinkling of Japanese furikake.

ingredients.item: as needed canola oil for fying

instructions: Press bread slices as flat as you can with a rolling pin or heavy bottle.
Spread a tablespoon Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise on each piece of flattened sliced bread.
Top each piece of bread with a slice of ham and cheese. Roll tightly and secure with a toothpick so sandwich won’t unroll.
Dredge sandwich rolls in flour. Lightly tap off excess flour.
Dip each roll in beaten eggs, then into breadcrumbs. Optional: Freeze sandwich rolls to allow breading to set.
Heat oil in pan. Once oil is hot, fry breaded sandwich rolls until golden brown.
Drain excess oil and allow to cool before serving. Enjoy alone or serve with drinks for the ultimate merienda!
categories: BREAD ROLL WITH HAM AND CHEESE AND BREADCRUMBS
DEEP FRIED HAM AND CHEESE ROLL

name: Your Favorite Molo Soup Recipe — The Classic Way
description:
Ahh, the wonder that is Ilonggo cuisine. Iloilo is known for many specialties both savory and sweet, from hearty batchoy to chewy baye baye. But Molo district offers its distinct fare, molo soup (also called pancit molo). A broth-based noodle dish with meat-filled dumplings or wonton, molo soup traces its origins to the Philippines’ Spanish occupation. Much like how Parian and Binondo in Manila were developed into Chinatowns, Molo was Iloilo’s designated Chinese settlement. 
               
               
               
              We have this mingling of cultures to thank for the soupy comfort food that is pancit molo. In this molo soup recipe, we walk you through how to cook molo soup as well as the molo soup ingredients you’ll need to make dumplings from scratch.
tips: Are you a fan of aromatic Asian flavors? You can also add a teaspoon of sesame oil into your dumpling filling. This will not only make your dumplings aromatic, but also more namit. That means delicious in Hiligaynon.
instructions: Start by making the dumplings. Dissolve 1 Knorr Shrimp Broth Cube in beaten egg. Combine egg and broth cube mixture with pork, cornstarch, and singkamas in a bowl. Mix well.
Wrap a teaspoon of mixture into molo wrapper. Seal by brushing the edges with water. Repeat until mixture is finished.
Prepare and heat a pan over medium heat. Sauté onion and garlic in oil.
Add water and remaining Knorr Shrimp Broth Cube in the pan and bring to a boil. Mix until cube is dissolved.
Lower the heat. Drop molo dumplings into the pan and simmer for 2 minutes.

Cut extra molo wrappers into thin strips for noodles. Add strips of molo wrappers to soup. Add salt and pepper to taste. Simmer for another minute, then serve with a sprinkling of spring onions and fried garlic.

name: Easy Veggie Sinigang Recipe Hack
description: Create this delicious, nutritious, and affordable veggie sinigang dish that will make your family eat heartily!

ingredients.item: fish sauce and ground white pepper to taste

instructions: Get a mediuem pot, add oil. Saute onions and tomatoes.
Pour water and add Knorr Sinigang Sa Sampalok Mix. Over high heat, boil for 5 minutes.
