Add radish and simmer until almost tender. Add okra, eggplant, and sitaw. Mix well and allow to simmer.
Add the kangkong leaves and after simmering for a minute. Add siling pangsigang (optional). Serve while hot.

name: The Easiest Miso Soup Recipe On The Internet
description: This miso soup recipe is a healthy and comforting way to get warm during the colder rainy days. It’s perfect for days when you’re craving something satisfying but don’t want to spend hours in the kitchen. This Japanese soup comes together in just 20 minutes or maybe even less if you’ve already cubed your tofu. With only 5 ingredients, you would think this miso soup recipe would be bland and tasteless but it has a rich depth of flavor thanks to the flavor-packed ingredient, miso. There are several types of miso but this recipe uses white miso. It’s more delicate and less pungent than its darker counterparts and is perfect for dishes like this. Try this recipe today and make your new favorite soup to prepare in a jiffy!
tips: Don’t throw away your leftover miso after one use. Miso, because it’s fermented, usually lasts a long time. White miso has a shelf life of about 9 months so simply store it in an airtight container in the fridge and you’ll have a handy ingredient to use in making miso soup anytime you want.

ingredients.item: green portion of green onions, sliced

instructions: In a pot, bring water and Knorr Chicken Cube to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer.
Scoop out 1 cup of the chicken stock into a bowl and stir in the miso paste.
Pour the miso and stock mixture back into the pot.
Add cubed tofu and sliced green onions into the pot.
Gently simmer for 2 minutes and serve.
Enjoy your warm bowls of miso soup made with the simplest ingredients!

name: Make Rainy Days Extra Special with This French Onion Soup
description: This French onion soup recipe is deceptively delicious. Ready in less than an hour with only 9 ingredients, this dish is perfect for making rainy days at home extra special. Instead of spending hours preparing food, you get to spend more time lounging around while still getting to enjoy a rich and flavorful French onion soup. The difference between regular onion soup and French onion soup is the onions used. Regular onion soup uses a mix of different onions while French onion soup recipes usually use only yellow/white onions cooked in a rich beef broth. This recipe takes it to another level by using 3 pcs of Knorr Beef Cubes which is equivalent to 3 kilos of beef in terms of flavor. That’s all the richness of beef minus the meat and with all the savings which means you can make this a regular date night staple. Try this next time you’re stuck at home because of the rain and watch it transform your meal from boring to scrumptious!
tips: Experiment with this French onion soup recipe by changing up the cheese you use to top it with. Use Gruyere for a rich and nutty flavor or use a combination of three cheeses (Swiss, Parmesan, and Mozzarella) for a more complex textural and flavor combination.

ingredients.item: 3/4 inch thick baguette, buttered and toasted

instructions: In a pan over medium-low heat, add onions, garlic, and butter.
Allow the butter to melt and watch the onions begin sweating.
Add brown sugar one teaspoon at a time and stir frequently to ensure even cooking and prevent onions from burning.
Continue stirring and adding brown sugar until all the brown sugar is used up.
Cook until all the onions are soft and are caramelized with a deep brown color. Set aside.
In a pot, add water, Knorr Beef Cubes, and Worcestershire sauce. Bring to a boil.
Add in caramelized onions to the pot and turn down heat. Simmer for 3-5 minutes.
Take off the heat and set aside.
To serve, ladle soup in oven safe bowls.
Top the bowls with toasted baguette and sliced cheese.
Broil in the oven or oven toaster until the cheese melts.
Serve immediately and enjoy this rich French onion soup.

name: Make This Creamy Broccoli Cheddar Soup With Hidden Veggies!
description: This delicious broccoli cheddar soup is oh-so-creamy and delicious that even the pickiest eaters will be asking for seconds. The secret to this delicious broccoli soup is Knorr Chicken & Corn Soup Mix that adds depth of flavor into this vegetarian-friendly dish. With 6 cups of colorful good-for-you vegetables, this creamy broccoli soup not only nourishes the soul with its creamy texture but also the body with a ton of micronutrients. Make this next time you’re pressed for time and want something healthy to feed your family.
tips: If you don’t have an immersion blender, feel free to use a regular blender for blending the soup together. Just make sure to allow the mixture to cool to room temperature before blending to avoid any accidents.

ingredients.item: fresh or frozen broccoli, roughly chopped
60g Knorr Chicken & Corn Soup, dissolved in 3 ½ cups of water

instructions: In a pot over medium heat, sauté onions in melted butter.
Once the onions start turning translucent, add broccoli, carrots, paprika, and black pepper. Sauté for 5-6 minutes.
Pour the dissolved Knorr Chicken & Corn Soup in the pot. Bring the mixture into a boil and let it boil for 5 minutes.
Remove pot from heat and using an immersion blender, blend the soup until you get the desired consistency. We recommend blending it all together if serving this broccoli cheddar soup to picky eaters.
If the broccoli cheddar soup becomes too thick when blended together, you can add a bit of chicken broth made with Knorr Chicken Cube dissolved in water.
Return to heat and add cheese. Simmer until the cheese melts.
Serve while warm to enjoy the creamy and cheesy goodness of this broccoli cheddar soup.

name: How to Cook Ginataang Alimasag in Just 20 Minutes!
description:
There is something singularly delectable about crab meat. Perhaps it is its natural linamnam, both sweet and a tad fishy. In the Philippines, especially in the Bicol region, one of the best preparations of this tasty crustacean is Ginataang Alimasag or crab in coconut milk. 
               
               
               
              Before we teach you how to cook Ginataang Alimasag, let’s make sure you get the right kind of crab. In Philippine waters, there is an abundance of alimango (giant mud crabs, which often reside near mangroves, or where seawater and freshwater mingle) and alimasag (flower crab or blue swimmer crab, found in the ocean). To avoid getting lost in the terminologies, just remember that the alimasag is smaller than the alimango, is usually speckled, and is bluish in color when uncooked. Alimasag do not have the alimango’s signature bulbous claw. Let this not fool you, though; alimasag meat, while tricky to pick off its smaller shelled body, brims with flavor. Sometimes, it even borders on buttery! 
               
               
               
              This Ginataang Alimasag recipe is so beginner-friendly, you can whip it up in less than 30 minutes. Your quick gata fix, thanks to Knorr Ginataang Gulay Complete Recipe Mix. If you’re hungry for more veg, you can always make it a Ginataang Alimasag at Kalabasa dish. Time to get cooking!
tips: While the Ginataang Alimasag recipe tastes absolutely delicious as is, if you do choose to add kalabasa and sitaw, toss them into the pan or wok right after mixing in the Knorr Ginataang Gulay Complete Recipe Mix and siling labuyo. Continue to cook the dish for an extra 15 minutes to soften the veggies. There you have it — Ginataang Alimasag na may kalabasa at sitaw.

ingredients.item: Knorr Ginataang Gulay Complete Recipe Mix, dissolved in 2 ½ cups of water

instructions: Heat oil in a pan or wok. Sauté garlic, onions, and ginger.
Add alimasag. Cover pan or wok and leave alimasag to steam for about 10 minutes or until the crabs turn a bright orange.

Add dissolved Knorr Ginataang Gulay Complete Recipe Mix to the pan or wok. If you want your Ginataang Alimasag to have a spicy kick, add siling labuyo. Allow to boil then reduce heat to simmer until the sauce slightly thickens. Serve with rice.

name: Liempo-fied Ginataang Puso ng Saging for Kitchen Newbies
description:
While the banana gets more love on the fruit front, Asians know full well that there are other parts of the banana tree that are just as delicious…and nutritious! For example, there’s puso ng saging or the banana blossom, which is often cooked like a vegetable and takes on the flavor profile of whatever it’s prepared with. Luckily for you, we’ve got a Ginataang Puso ng Saging recipe that can easily win over foodies’ hearts. 
               
               
               
              Rich in soluble and insoluble fiber, antioxidants, and minerals, banana blossoms are a great addition to any diet. When cooked with coconut milk, the ingredient becomes a creamy delight that pairs well with meat. Plus, Ginataang Puso ng Saging calories fit well into stricter meal plans; while it will still depend on how much you consume, you’re assured that you aren’t eating empty calories. 
               
               
               
              Learn how to cook Ginataang Puso ng Saging, or rather, a more succulent version of it. You might be surprised to find out that Ginataang Puso ng Saging ingredients include more than just banana blossoms. Here’s what you’ll need.
tips: Play around with your protein! Pescetarian? Substitute pork with shrimp. Vegetarian? Try adding tofu instead! Vegan? All good — this Ginataang Puso ng Saging recipe tastes just as good with banana blossom alone.

ingredients.item: pork liempo, cut into thin strips
Knorr Ginataang Gulay Complete Recipe Mix, dissolved in 1 ½ cups of water

instructions: Sprinkle rock salt over the puso ng saging or banana blossom then gently massage. This will draw out the sap of the puso ng saging. Rinse several times over cool running water to wash off the salt and the sticky sap. Keep submerged in cool water until ready to use.
In a pan, heat oil then add pork slices. Cook until lightly browned.
Add garlic, onions, and ginger until soft and fragrant.
Add drained puso ng saging and Knorr Pork Cube. Sauté until cube dissolves. Continue to cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in dissolved Knorr Ginataang Gulay Complete Recipe Mix and allow to simmer until sauce has slightly thickened and the puso ng saging is cooked.
Add chilies. Serve while warm.
categories: HOW TO COOK GINATAANG PUSO NG SAGING

name: Try This Fail-safe Creamy Tuna Pesto Pasta Recipe
description:
Craving pasta but not in the mood for red sauce? No sweat. Keep this handy dandy creamy Tuna Pesto Pasta recipe on standby for when cravings hit, or if you want a fail-safe pasta party dish that’s big on flavor and nutritional value! Between the basil leaves-and-pine nuts sauce combo and juicy tuna (we love a protein fix!), you can’t go wrong with our recipe. 
               
               
               
              No time to lose. Start practicing how to cook the best tuna pesto pasta.
tips: It doesn’t take much to elevate this dish. To make your creamy Tuna Pesto Pasta even creamier, top your preparation with a poached egg, let the egg break, and mix it all on your plate while your pasta is still hot. The yolk will not only make this Tuna Pesto Pasta recipe richer; it will add healthy fat content to your meal, too!

ingredients.item: canned button mushrooms, drained and sliced

instructions: Combine fresh basil leaves and pine nuts with 6 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 2 tsp minced garlic, and ½ cup grated Parmesan cheese in a food processor or blender.
Secure. Mix until a thick paste is formed.
Transfer to a container, then season with salt and pepper to taste. Set aside for later.
Cook pasta according to package directions. Set aside.
Heat olive oil in a pan, then sauté garlic and onions until softened.
Add mushrooms and sauté for 3 minutes.
Add tuna (no need to drain), Knorr Chicken Cube, basil pesto sauce and ¼ tsp of pepper. Mix well.
Toss in cooked pasta. Make sure pasta is evenly coated with pesto sauce.
Sprinkle ¼ cup Parmesan cheese over pasta before serving.

name: Guaranteed Busog With This All-American Seafood Boil Recipe
description:
Yes, the Philippines is an archipelago. And yes, ours is a country rich in seafood. While this may make you think that the Seafood Boil is a Pinoy creation, it’s actually not — although, we have our own seafood stews to be proud of. The Seafood Boil concept actually traces its origins to classic cookouts in the U.S.’s southern states. In Louisiana and other Gulf Coast states, the best Seafood Boil recipes abound. But today, we’ll start with the basics. 
               
               
               
              Gather these Seafood Boil ingredients and bust out your pick of the most flavorful Seafood Boil sauce recipes out there. It’s time you introduce this seafood bonanza to your friends and family, if you haven’t already. We’re pretty sure they’ll salivate over these tasty treasures from the sea.
tips: Did you know that chefs are among the best researchers and experimentalists there are? How else would they create such reliable recipes? So, here’s a tip (and maybe some homework, too). Know your seafood! Make sure you learn how to spot fresh seafood, from mussels and shrimp to different kinds of crab. Read up on fish, too. While that’s not necessarily included in our list of Seafood Boil ingredients, this comes in handy for other recipes. Good luck!

ingredients.item: sweet corn on the cob, cut into 4 pcs

instructions: Toss together crumbled Knorr Shrimp Cube, salt, crushed ginger, and garlic in a small bowl. Set aside.
Arrange all main ingredients in a deep pot starting with potatoes at the bottom followed by corn, mussels, alimasag, and shrimp. Sprinkle some of the Knorr Shrimp Cube mixture in between the layers.
Pour lemon lime soda into the pot and cover. Turn on the heat and allow to simmer for 20 to 25 minutes or until all seafood is cooked.
Serve with homemade garlic butter sauce or tartar sauce, which you can whip up from scratch, too. Just mix Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, lemon juice, mustard, and pickle relish in a bowl. Enjoy.

name: This Sipo Egg Recipe Is The Best Way to Eat Your Veggies
description: Sipo egg is a Kapampangan dish made with a colorful medley of vegetables and quail eggs that’s made oh so creamy and delicious with the use of Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup. It’s a delicious way to eat more veggies while getting a dose of protein with those yummy quail eggs. This Sipo egg recipe teaches you how to cook Sipo egg in only 30 minutes with very minimal prep, all thanks to the use of frozen vegetables. Using frozen vegetables as part of your Sipo egg ingredients is a great way to get all the nutrients you need minus the prep time. Most frozen vegetables are flash frozen at the peak of freshness and retain a good amount of their nutrients, perfect for when you want to whip up something healthy quickly.
tips: For an even creamier Sipo egg, you can replace the all-purpose cream with heavy cream.

ingredients.item: singkamas (jicama), cubed to be the same size as frozen vegetables
Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup, dissolved in 2 cups water
dozen quail eggs, boiled and peeled

instructions: Prepare your ingredients and set them aside.
Heat oil and butter in a pot over medium heat.
Add frozen vegetables and singkamas into the pot. Cook until frozen vegetables are cooked through.
Add to the pot the dissolved Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup to make your Sipo egg creamy. Allow to simmer for 3-5 minutes.
Gently stir in the quail eggs and all-purpose cream, if desired.
Serve this delicious Sipo egg warm.

name: Easy & Delicious Ginisang Baguio Beans With Pork Recipe
description: Baguio beans are staples in the Filipino diet that are also so good for you. Baguio beans are a great source of fiber as well as vitamin C, folate, calcium, and iron. It’s springy texture and ability to absorb good flavors makes it a welcome addition to any dinner table. This baguio beans recipe is our take on ginisang baguio beans with pork but made extra delicious and umami-filled with Knorr Liquid Seasoning. This ginisang baguio beans recipe is ready in only 30 minutes so you can have a complete dish ready to pair with rice, even on your busiest of days. This easy, healthy, and filling baguio beans recipe will definitely make it to your weekly meal plan!
tips: Make this baguio beans dish come together faster by preparing the ingredients ahead of time and setting them aside in the refrigerator or freezer so that it’s ready to sauté at mealtimes.
instructions: Prepare your ingredients and set them aside where you can reach them once you fire up the pan to make this baguio beans recipe. This dish comes together quickly so this step is a must!
Heat up your pan or wok over medium heat. Once ready, add oil and sauté the chopped garlic cloves until fragrant.
Add the ground pork into the pan and season well with Knorr Liquid Seasoning.
Cook the pork for about 5-7 minutes or until browning.
Add the baguio beans and cook for an additional 4 minutes.
Finish the ginisang baguio beans recipe with black pepper and sugar.
Enjoy this delicious baguio beans dish as is or take it up a notch by garnishing with garlic chips on top!
categories: GINISANG BAGUIO BEANS WITH PORK RECIPE

name: Ain’t No Roast Chicken Like This Pinoy Lechon Manok Recipe
description: Whose tummy doesn’t rumble at the sight of perfectly marinated and roasted lechon manok? The aroma alone is enough to get even the pickiest of eaters drooling at the mouth. It’s one of those dishes that Filipinos really simot sa sobrang sarap! This beginner-friendly lechon manok recipe walks you through all the steps to whipping up homemade lechon manok, from mixing the marinade to the actual roasting. The next time you need a recipe for lechon manok, you know where to go. Better yet, bookmark this dish for when you want to impress in the kitchen.
tips: While you can marinate your chicken for as quick as four hours, we highly recommend leaving it in the marinade for 24 hours. Marinating your chicken overnight allows flavor to really seep into the meat, making for a tastier treat.
instructions: Sprinkle rock salt over chicken and rub thoroughly to clean chicken skin. Rinse over cool running water. Drain excess water.
To make the marinade, combine Knorr Liquid Seasoning, calamansi juice, brown sugar, lemon lime soda, and ground pepper in a bowl or a zipper bag big enough to fit the entire chicken.
Leave chicken in marinade for 4-24 hours.
After marinating chicken, preheat oven, turbo broiler, or air fryer at 175 degrees celsius.
Drain chicken from marinade and stuff chicken cavity with onions, garlic, and pounded lemongrass.
Set on a baking tray and roast for 45-60 minutes or until fully cooked. Serve while warm.

name: K-BBQ All You Can at Home With This Pork Samgyupsal Recipe
description:
Hallyu fanatics, holler! The Korean wave is flowing stronger than ever — it’s on our social media feeds, streaming services, and our playlists. It’s about time it reaches your kitchen, too. Here’s a quick pork samgyupsal recipe that will make you feel like you’re living your K-drama dreams. Imagine coming home from work, ramyeon piping hot and samgyupsal on the grill. 
               
               
               
              We’re throwing in a samgyupsal dipping sauce recipe and a samgyupsal marinade recipe that don’t require complicated kitchen prep, too. This might be the easiest Korean samgyupsal recipe out there — everything done and ready to be devoured in 35 minutes! Let’s get started.
tips: Store gochujang at home for when your Korean cravings hit. You’ll thank us later. It’s flavoring that completely transforms any dish’s flavor profile. You can even mix it with Knorr Liquid Seasoning anytime you want to give your sawsawan a Korean edge.

ingredients.item: kilogram pork samgyupsal or thin liempo cut

instructions: Marinate pork in Knorr Liquid Seasoning for 5-10 minutes.
Combine all dipping sauce ingredients in a bowl. Set aside.
Grill pork until fully cooked or until desired doneness is achieved. Dip in the sauce and enjoy with lettuce or other preferred side dishes.

name: Ang Pinakamasarap Na Pinoy Christmas Ham Ever!
description:
There’s just something about the combination of December holidays and hamon that makes a Christmas celebration truly Pinoy. No Noche Buena spread is complete without Christmas ham. In fact, learning how to cook Christmas ham in the Philippines is a love language that will win hearts no matter the season or occasion. 
               
               
               
              Luckily for you, we have the perfect Christmas ham recipe that’s easy to follow. The result? Succulent Filipino Christmas ham that’s sweet, salty, and fragrant at the same time. You have the bay leaves, sugar, and Knorr Pork Cube to thank for that. It will take some practice, though, so better start warming up the kitchen!
tips: When talking about the best Filipino ham recipes for Christmas, people often ask: what’s better — boneless or bone-in? If you don’t mind carving your meat from the bone after it’s done cooking, we highly recommend going for bone-in ham. This tends to be more packed with flavor and it makes for beautiful plating to boot. Yours will be a Noche Buena spread to remember, for sure.

ingredients.item: kilograms whole pork kasim (shoulder) or pique (ham), skin removed

instructions: Combine all brine ingredients in a pot. Simmer for 5-10 minutes. Allow to cool completely.
Submerge whole pork meat in cooled brine. Keep chilled for 3-4 days to cure.
After 4 days of curing, remove brined pork and transfer to a roasting tray or pan with a rack. Preheat over to 300 degrees celsius.
Roast pork for 1 ½ hours. Cover with foil if parts darken too fast while cooking.
Once fully cooked and tender, brush pork with pineapple glaze then put back in the oven for another 15-20 minutes.
To make pineapple glaze, combine all glaze ingredients in a saucepot. Allow to boil then reduce heat to simmer. Mix lightly until slightly thick.
Let meat rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing. Serve with more pineapple glaze on the side.
categories: HOW TO COOK CHRISTMAS HAM PHILIPPINES
HOW TO DO A CHRISTMAS HAM

name: This Papaya Salad Recipe Makes Going Vegan Easy & Delicious
description: Going vegan has never tasted this good with this delicious and easy-to-prepare thai papaya salad recipe! This vegan salad recipe is made with green papaya that’s rich in Vitamins C, B, and E as well as potassium, fiber, and magnesium. It’s a nutrient-packed salad that balances the freshness of the vegetables with the flavor-packed sauce that gets its oomph from Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Make this papaya salad to celebrate World Vegan Day!
tips: This papaya salad recipe juliennes the cucumber and carrot for a textural contrast but if you’re pressed for time, you can simply grate all the vegetables and it’ll still be a great vegan salad!

ingredients.item: carrot, peeled, and sliced into sticks
cucumber, peeled, deseeded, and sliced into sticks

instructions: Combine all the papaya salad dressing ingredients in a small bowl and mix well until the sugar is dissolved. Set aside in the chiller.
In a big bowl, toss the green papaya, carrots, and cucumber together.
Grab the papaya salad dressing from the chiller and drizzle on top of the tossed salad components. Top with mint leaves and chopped cashew nuts.
Serve this Thai papaya salad cold and enjoy!

name: Make This Polonchay Soup That Tastes Too Good to Be Healthy
description: Polonchay soup is a vibrant green chinese soup that’s made with, you’ve guessed it, Chinese spinach. It’s a healthy dish that’s served in most Chinese restaurants in the Philippines. While not as popular as other Chinese dishes, polonchay soup is a delicious egg drop soup that makes it easy to eat your greens. Ready in only 25 minutes, this Chinese spinach soup tastes like it’s been simmering for hours all thanks to the complex flavors in Knorr Nido Oriental Soup Mix. It’s the perfect dish to serve up on those cold rainy days when you want to just lie under the covers and sleep. It’s a low prep high reward soup that we’re sure your family will be asking you to make over and over again.
tips: Take away the extra step of needing a blender and use an immersion blender instead. With an immersion blender, you don’t have to wait for the polonchay and water to cool down. Instead, simply use it to blend the mix in your pot and there you have it, an easy way to blend your polonchay soup.

ingredients.item: polonchay (chinese spinach), washed, dried, and roughly chopped
Knorr Nido Oriental Soup, dissolved in 300 ml water

instructions: Boil the chopped polonchay in 2 cups water for 2-3 minutes or until the polonchay is wilted.
Allow the polonchay and water to cool a bit and then transfer into a blender. Pulse until you get your desired consistency.
Combine the blended polonchay and dissolved Knorr Nido Oriental soup in a pot. Bring to a simmer and allow to simmer for 5 minutes or until polonchay soup is slightly thickened.
Add beaten egg into soup and stir gently. Continue to simmer for another 2-3 minutes.
Serve this polonchay soup warm.

name: Cozy Up This Rainy Season With This Creamy Asparagus Soup
description: There’s no doubt about it, rainy days call for warm bowls of soup! If you find yourself making the same ol’ soups day in and day out, you’ve come to the right place. This creamy asparagus soup recipe will take ordinary rainy days and make them special! Be warned, you’ll find yourself wishing for more rainy days just so you can make this delicious asparagus soup more often.
tips: Feel free to add chopped mushroom into the asparagus soup to make the flavors more complex and to add a textural contrast to your soup.

ingredients.item: fresh asparagus spears or canned asparagus, roughly chopped
Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup, dissolved in 3 cups of water

instructions: If using canned asparagus, drain and wash the asparagus under cold water for a fresher flavor.
In a pot, boil asparagus spears for 2-3 minutes. Allow it to cool and then transfer to a blender along with the water used for boiling.
Pulse the asparagus spears in the blender until you achieve the desired consistency. Set aside.
In another pot, combine the dissolved Knorr Cream of Mushroom soup and asparagus puréé. Bring over medium high heat and simmer for 6-8 minutes.
Remove pot from heat and stir in cream, if using.
Transfer your warm asparagus soup into bowls and top off with chopped parsley as garnish.

name: How to Make Lasagna Roll-ups That’ll Rock Any Party
description:
Everybody loves a good lasagna — you know, the kind that’s creamy and meaty at the same time. It’s certainly a pasta dish that’s a favorite among many age groups, and we’re pretty sure yours is going to be a hit whether you prepare it for a children’s party or that barkada night you’ve been planning for a while now. We know a great way to upgrade this comfort dish: lasagna rolls! Instead of going for the classic lasagna’s pasta layers, opt for baked lasagna roll-ups instead. They’re easier to make, less messy to eat, and portions are more controlled since a single serving is easier to make out. 
               
               
               
              Follow our lasagna rolls recipe and you’ll learn how to make easy lasagna roll-ups in no time!
tips: For a creamier version of lasagna roll-ups, add some ricotta cheese into the mix and watch your dish melt into cheesy perfection.

ingredients.item: mozzarella cheese or any melting cheese

instructions: Cook lasagna sheets according to package directions. Drain the water, cover lasagna sheets, and set aside.
In a pot, sauté onions and garlic in hot oil.
Add ground beef and cook until color changes. Add Knorr Beef Cube and pasta sauce. Allow to simmer for 10-15 minutes. Adjust seasoning according to taste. Set aside.
In a bowl, combine all cheese filling ingredients. Mix well.

To assemble, scoop about 2-3 tablespoons of meat sauce on one end of a lasagna sheet then top with a tablespoon of cheese filling. Roll lasagna sheet and set on a greased baking pan. Do the same with the rest of the lasagna sheets, meat sauce, and cheese filling.

Once all lasagna sheets are filled and rolled, spread excess meat sauce and/or cheese filling over rolled lasagna. Sprinkle grated melting cheese on top then bake for 20-30 minutes at 350 degrees celsius or until cheese has melted and browned.
Allow to cool slightly then serve.

name: This Shawarma Sauce Is So Good You'll Eat it WIth Everything
description: Stop what you’re doing and make this shawarma sauce in 10 minutes or less! High on flavor and ease, this shawarma sauce recipe owes its strong flavor to garlic powder and creaminess to Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise. Lather it on your favorite shawarma recipe or be creative and use it wherever you like – this shawarma sauce is that addicting. Bonus points for being a one-bowl dip! Less dishes and more flavor, what’s not to love about this recipe?
tips: Use full-fat greek yogurt instead of regular yogurt for a thicker and protein-rich shawarma sauce.
instructions: Combine all of the shawarma sauce ingredients together in a bowl except for salt and pepper.
Whisk until smooth.
Whisk until smooth.

name: Forget About Feta: Try This Kesong Puti Fried Egg Instead
description:
Forget about the Tiktok viral feta fried eggs making rounds online. This Filipino version using Kesong Puti is a delicious and versatile alternative. Go the viral route and use your crispy egg to top off smashed avocados on tortilla or do something different. This recipe takes on the viral version but uses sliced bread instead of tortilla and is topped with a drizzle of Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili to take your avocado toast to the next level. 
               
               
               
              Stick to the recipe or adjust to your own tastes. Whatever you choose to do, we guarantee that once you start making eggs with kesong puti, you’ll forget about those viral feta fried eggs.

ingredients.item: to taste Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili

instructions: Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and add your oil.
Crumble your kesong puti on the pan, ensuring that the outer circle of the pan is covered.
Let the kesong puti melt for a bit, mixing occasionally to prevent it from burning.
Gently crack your eggs in the center of the pan and let cook to your desired doneness.
While the egg is cooking, toast your bread slices and smash half an avocado on top of each piece.
Drizzle a bit of lemon juice and olive oil on the smashed avocado.
Once the eggs are done, place it on top of the smashed avocados. It should have crispy sides from the melted kesong puti.
Garnish with alfalfa sprouts, parsley, and finish off with Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili for that burst of spicy umami flavors.
Serve warm and enjoy this delicious kesong puti fried egg recipe on top of smashed avocado toast!

name: This Elote Recipe Teaches You The Best Way to Eat Your Corn
description: You haven’t really lived unless you’ve had elote. Elote is a Mexican dish that consists of grilled corn on the cob that’s slathered with mayonnaise, chili, lime juice, and cotija cheese. Elote is a Mexican style corn on the cob that tickles your taste buds with a burst of sweet, salty, tangy, and spicy flavors all in one bite. In this recipe, we use Kesong Puti instead of cotija cheese because aside from its wide availability in the Philippines, its sharp saltiness and creamy texture goes really well with Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise. If you’ve been used to having boiled corn with salted butter, get ready to have your life changed with this elote recipe.

ingredients.item: chilli powder, add more if desired

instructions: Prepare a charcoal grill and place your corn, still in their husks, on top.b
Grill the corn for about 16-20 minutes or until the husks are dark and brittle.
While your corn is grilling, prepare the other ingredients.
In a bowl, combine Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, lime juice, chili powder, and salt. This will be the sauce that will be slathered on the corn once it comes off the grill.
In another bowl, mix the kesong puti and cilantro.
Once your corn is cooked, take off from the grill and remove the husks.
Working with one corn at a time, slather the corn with the mayonnaise mixture using a pastry brush or a butter knife.
Over a wide plate, sprinkle the kesong puti mixture on corn that’s been slathered with the mayonnaise mixture.
Once done, place on the serving plate and continue with the same process until all the corn is done.
Serve the elote warm and enjoy!
categories: MEXICAN STYLE CORN ON THE COB

name: Quick & Easy Macaroni Fruit Salad Recipe for a Truly Pinoy Pasko!
description:
Think of dessert for Noche Buena and any Paskong Pinoy get-together, and one of the first treats that come to mind is the macaroni fruit salad. Colorful, creamy, easy-to-make, and brimming with varying culinary textures, this macaroni fruit salad recipe is certainly a sweet party on the palate. And it’ll only take you 15 minutes to put together! 
               
               
               
              If you’re still wondering how to make macaroni fruit salad with generous servings of Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise, fruit cocktail, and other Filipino gelatinous delights, look no further. Here’s a handy list of macaroni fruit salad ingredients, plus what you’ll do with them — so that you can whip up the best holiday dessert there is. Low on effort, high on Pinoy foodie approval ratings! What’s not to love?
tips: Filipino macaroni fruit salad with mayonnaise is creamy as is, so just know that all-purpose cream makes it even creamier and a tad soupy. If you dislike this dripping consistency, go easy on the all-purpose cream or remove it from your macaroni fruit salad ingredients list.We’d also recommend making this three-step Macaroni Fruit Salad in advance and just keep it chilling in the refrigerator for whenever you’re in the mood for cool dessert. Yum!
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain well and set aside to cool.
Combine cooked macaroni with Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, condensed milk, all-purpose cream, cheese, fruit cocktali, nata de coco, and kaong in a bowl. Mix well.
Serve chilled.
categories: HOW TO MAKE MACARONI FRUIT SALAD
FILIPINO MACARONI FRUIT SALAD WITH MAYONNAISE
HOW TO COOK MACARONI SALAD WITH FRUIT COCKTAIL

name: Elevate Your Appetizer Menu With Egg and Bacon Canapes!
description:
So you’re throwing a party. New Year’s Eve? Christmas? A birthday? Whatever the occasion, it’s time to level up your appetizer game. We know it’s tempting to simply whip up a classic egg canape recipe for hors d’oeuvres, but why not take easy canapes up a notch? How about canapes with egg and bacon? 
               
               
               
              Follow this step-by-step guide to making egg and bacon canapes, then wait and see. Guests will soon be asking for your canape recipe, so keep this handy!
tips: Another option is to cook the bacon just until it’s well done but still soft enough to roll and bend. You can then roll a larger piece of bacon and skewer that onto each canape with parsley and a flat egg slice. We guarantee that all options are delicious — your choice, really! It’s a matter of visual presentation.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Arrange bacon slices in a single layer. Bake for 12 to 20 minutes until crispy. Remove bacon from the oven and drain on a paper towel-lined plate to remove excess oil. Slice bacon into smaller pieces once cooled.

Boil eggs for 10 minutes in a medium-sized saucepan. Remove from heat and transfer the eggs to a bowl filled with ice water. Let cool for a minute or two. Peel the eggs, then slice into smaller, flat pieces.
Whisk Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, salt, and pepper in a bowl until smooth. Set aside.
Cut out rounds from bread slices using a 1 ½-inch cookie cutter. Toast the bread rounds in a toaster or in the oven for 2 to 4 minutes or until crisp and golden brown.

Arrange the toasted bread rounds on a serving platter. Spoon a small amount of the mayonnaise mixture onto each round. Top with a piece of sliced egg, bacon, and parsley, and skewer with a decorative toothpick for festive feels. Serve and enjoy!

name: Hack Pizza Chain's Kung Pao Chicken & Peanut Sauce Pasta
description: This recipe takes a local pizza chain’s popular kung pao chicken and peanut sauce pasta and makes a healthier, and dare we say, better version using Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili for that spicy umami kick. The secret to the layers of flavor in this dish isn’t just in the ingredients but also in the method – every single layer of this dish is seasoned. From the marinated chicken breast strips to the silky peanut butter sauce, this dish will get you high praises when served.
tips: Save some of your pasta water. In case your peanut sauce gets too thick, pasta water can be used to loosen up the sauce while giving it a silky texture.

ingredients.item: boneless chicken breast, sliced into strips
whole wheat pasta, cooked according to package directions
head broccoli, chopped into small pieces

instructions: In a bowl, mix Knorr Liquid Seasoning chili with cornstarch. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Set aside and leave to marinate for at least 15-20 minutes.
In a medium sized bowl, combine all the peanut sauce ingredients. Mix well and set aside.
Make sure you have all the ingredients ready and within arms reach before you fire up the pan and sauté this Kung Pao Chicken & Peanut Sauce Pasta together. It comes together quickly!
Heat a large wok over medium-high heat and add onion and garlic until fragrant and translucent.
Add the mushrooms and broccoli into the wok. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the marinated chicken and stir-fry until cooked.
Add the peanuts and the peanut sauce mixture into the pan and mix until the sauce thickens.
Add the pasta into the wok and toss in the peanut sauce until it’s well-coated.
Garnish with the chopped green onions. Enjoy!

name: Save Time & Meal Prep This Lumpia for World Vegetarian Day!
description:
If you’ve been trying to figure out how to eat more vegetables while saving time and still enjoy what you eat, we’ve got the recipe that’s perfect for you – lumpia gulay a.k.a vegetable lumpia. While not as popular as lumpia shanghai, vegetable lumpia is a delicious vegetarian alternative that’s crispy and delicious. This recipe uses Knorr Liquid Seasoning to flavor the vegetables making it rich in umami-flavors while staying vegan-friendly. 
               
               
               
              Lumpia isn’t the fastest dish to make, but with a little planning and meal prep, you can have this crispy and ready to eat in less than 10 minutes! Double (or triple!) this recipe and freeze some of your rolled lumpia gulay in an airtight container and you’ll have vegetable lumpia that’s ready to fry whenever a craving strikes, a tita comes over, or for celebrating World Vegetarian Day!
instructions: Finely chop all your vegetables.
Combine the mushrooms, cabbage, carrots, and water chestnuts in one bowl and the other vegetables in another.
Set a pot over medium heat and add 1 tablespoon of oil. Add your chopped mushrooms, cabbage, carrots, and water chestnuts. Cook until the vegetables lose some of their water and set aside..
We cook these vegetable lumpia ingredients with a higher water content so that our vegetable lumpia stays crisp when fried.
Once the cooked vegetables are cool, combine them with the other ingredients in a large bowl.
Add Knorr Liquid Seasoning Original, salt, ground pepper, and chili flakes if using.
Mix it all together and prepare for assembly.
Get your lumpia wrapper and separate them. Stack the separated lumpia wrappers on a plate.
Whisk your egg with 1 tablespoon of water and place it on the table where you will be wrapping your vegetable lumpia.
Prepare the container for your wrapped vegetable lumpia and prepare the area where you will do your wrapping. Any plate will do.

Get a lumpia wrapper and add about 2 heaping tablespoons onto the wrapper and begin rolling. Seal the lumpia by patting the egg mixture with your finger on the edge of the lumpia wrapper before sealing. Only use water to make this vegan-friendly.
Make sure that the edges are tightly sealed and the vegetable lumpia is rolled tightly so that no vegetables spill from the side when frying.
If cooking immediately, heat oil in a heavy-bottom pan and fry your lumpia until golden brown.

If freezing, get an airtight container and stack your lumpia on top of each other. To prevent them from sticking to each other, you can space them out a bit and add parchment paper before stacking the other vegetable lumpia pieces on top.
Frozen lumpia will last in the freezer for 1 month.
To cook your frozen lumpia, simply heat up oil in a heavy bottom pot and add your frozen (no need to defrost!) lumpia straight from the freezer. Cook until golden brown and enjoy!

name: Hack this Viral 10-Minute No-Cook Chopped Italian Sandwich Recipe
description: No time? No problem. No-cook recipes save the day when you simply can’t spare a few hours to prepare tasty morsels in the kitchen. Take this easy Cold Sandwich recipe, for example. It’s been making rounds on social media for good reason – for minimal effort, you get a taste of Italy! We’ve hacked this viral sandwich so you can finally stop drooling over your screens and make it for yourself. It’s a simple Cold Sandwich Recipe with ingredients and a procedure you can follow step-by-step. Ours is one of the best Cold Sandwich Recipes out there — and it’s certified beginner-friendly.
tips: Pressed for time? Why not prepare your palaman the night before (or days before) so you can simply add it to toasted bread the next day.
instructions: Layer lettuce, cold cuts, Provolone cheese, tomato, red onion banana pepper on chopping board. Chop finely and place mixture in a bowl.
Add Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, balsamic vinegar, Italian dressing, and Italian seasoning to the mixture and toss well.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Use as filling for your choice of bread. For a classic Italian sub feel, go for sliced baguette or Italian roll. Enjoy.
categories: COLD SANDWICH RECIPES WITH INGREDIENTS AND PROCEDURE
EASY COLD SANDWICH RECIPE AND PROCEDURE

name: 3 Budget-Friendly Palaman Ideas For An Exciting Merienda!
description:
There’s something timeless and reliable about Filipino palaman options. They’re no-nonsense, easy to prepare, and they usually make the tastiest budget-friendly sandwiches that satisfy even the pickiest of eaters. For many people, palaman sa tinapay or palaman sa pandesal is comfort food. Others consider it a baon staple. 
               
               
               
              Check out these three palaman ideas that you could easily add to your list of affordable lunch recipes. Scratch that — these sandwich spreads aren’t just great for lunch. They’re undeniably good any time of the day! Learn how to whip up a quick batch of Chicken & Egg Palaman, Bacon Hotdog Palaman, and Tuna Sardines Palaman.
tips: Can’t finish all the palaman you prepared? Simply store in an airtight container inside the refrigerator to prolong shelf life. These easy-to-make sandwich spreads are great for storing if you want a variety of baon all throughout the week.

ingredients.item: eggs, boiled then mashed or finely chopped
hotdog, cooked then mashed or finely chopped

instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine mashed or finely chopped boiled eggs and Lady’s Choice Chicken Spread.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve your simple palaman sa pandesal or on any choice of bread.
In a mixing bowl, combine mashed or finely chopped cooked hotdogs and Lady’s Choice Bacon Spread.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve your palaman sa pandesal or on any choice of bread.
In a mixing bowl, combine mashed or finely chopped sardines and Lady’s Choice Tuna Spread.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve your palaman sa pandesal or on any choice of bread.

name: A Beginner-Friendly Pancit Guisado Recipe for Any Party You’ll Throw
description:
It can’t be denied — Pancit Guisado is the star of many Filipino spreads and special occasions! For birthdays, the dish symbolizes long life. On other holidays like All Saints Day, specialties like Pancit Guisado are prepared not only for the living to enjoy, but to offer to dearly departed ones. You’ll often see the dish displayed at home altars or by the graves of friends and family who have passed away. It’s a Filipino tradition that honors those who have gone before us. 
               
               
               
              Whatever the gathering, it’s handy to know how to cook a mean Pancit Bihon Guisado that’s bound to keep your guests coming back for second servings! Here’s an ingredients list plus easy-to-follow steps. 
               
               
               
              Fun fact before we get cooking: Pansit Guisado calories vary from 160 calories to 250, depending on the size of your serving bowl. How much you enjoy is totally up to you, but we won’t judge if you overindulge just a little. After all, Pansit Guisado includes all the food groups! Such a healthy, delicious treat.

ingredients.item: cabbage or baby pak choi, sliced into thick strips

instructions: In a pan, boil pork in ¼ cup water for 10-15 minutes or until the water dries up.
Pour oil into the pan and sauté pork until it browns.
Throw in onions and garlic, and cook until tender.
Add chicken liver and sauté until fully cooked.
Add shrimp. When the shrimp changes color, add the carrots, chicharo, cabbage or pak choi, bean sprouts, and kintsay. Sauté for another minute.
Take the meat and vegetables out of the pan. Drain them in a strainer or colander. Set aside.
Now onto the stock. Pour remaining water, Knorr Shrimp Cube, and soy sauce into the empty pan. Allow to simmer until the cube is dissolved. Season with pepper.
With the stock still simmering, drop the noodles in. Stir every once in a while. If the noodles have absorbed all the liquid and it’s still not yet tender, add water.
Once the noodles are tender, transfer them onto a serving platter and arrange the cooked meat and vegetables on top. Serve with some calamansi and soy sauce on the side. Enjoy.

name: Filipino-Style Ensaladang Mangga With Salted Egg Recipe You Should Try
description:
Picture this: You had a long day, so you decided to have something simple for dinner. Maybe you’d like to have some fried fish like galunggong or good ol’ fried chicken. While there is beauty in simplicity, you feel that it’s not enough. Lo and behold! We have a quick and easy recipe to add some flavor to your evening: ensaladang mangga with salted egg! 
               
               
               
              Our special ensaladang mangga recipe is made with Knorr Shrimp Cube to take the shrimpy flavor of this Pinoy favorite side dish to the next level. Preparing this dish is so easy that you can make it in less than 10 minutes, making it perfect for busy evenings or when you’re craving some green mango. Feel free to add more mangoes if you have a hearty appetite!
tips: It’s best to use carabao mango for ensaladang mangga. This is a nutritional powerhouse, packed with Vitamin A and C.

ingredients.item: medium fresh green mango, peeled and sliced into cubes
medium red or white onion, cubed

instructions: In a bowl, combine the mangoes, tomatoes, salted egg, and onion. You can skip the salted egg if you prefer.
In a separate bowl or saucer, crush the Knorr Shrimp Cube and add it to the shrimp paste. Mix both ingredients well.
Pour the calamansi juice and then the shrimp paste with Knorr Shimp Cube.
Toss the ingredients until they are well blended.
Top with more shrimp paste if you want.
Serve with your favorite fried or grilled dish.
Share and enjoy or indulge to your heart’s content.
categories: ENSALADANG MANGGA WITH SALTED EGG RECIPE

name: Easy Peasy 5-Step Adobong Labong Recipe
description:
Every Pinoy home has their own special adobo recipe, but have you ever tried cooking yours with bamboo shoots A.K.A labong? This healthy ingredient adds an earthy flavor to your average adobo. And guess what? Our recipe only has five easy steps! 
               
               
               
              If you haven’t tried cooking with bamboo shots yet, our guide on how to cook labong is the perfect place to start. You can find canned bamboo shoots in the market, so you don’t have to clean and boil bamboo yourself. Plus, our adobong labong recipe uses Knorr Pork Cubes/ Knorr Beef Cubes for some added linamnam to your meal. Read on to learn more about this quick dinner fix recipe.
tips: For best results, use a tender cut of beef or pork like tenderloin. This would make your dish healthier.

ingredients.item: to 2 1/2 cups bamboo shoots, cut into 1 to 2 inches in length
Knorr Pork Cube/ Knorr Beef Cube

instructions: In a wok, pour cooking oil and let it heat up. Boil Knorr Pork Cube/ Knorr Beef Cube in one cup of water in a separate pot.
Saute the onion and garlic. Add pork or beef, then cook for five minutes.
Pour in the pork or beef broth made with the Knorr Pork Cube/ Knorr Beef Cube. Cover and let the dish simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.
Add the shrimp, bamboo shoots, salt, and ground pepper. Allow it to simmer for five minutes.
Pour in the vinegar and boil the dish. Once it boil, let it simmer for 3 to 5 minutes.
Transfer to a serving plate and enjoy!

name: Your New Meal Prep Partner: Our Spanish-Style Bangus Recipe
description:
Let’s be honest: no matter how much of a self-confessed foodie or wiz in a kitchen you are, there are times when you don’t have the energy to whip up a delicious meal. Don’t worry, because we get you! 
               
               
               
              Our simplified Spanish-style bangus recipe can be stored in the refrigerator for up to a month! It contains every spicy lover’s favorite, Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili, to add a little spice to your life. This is the perfect spicy little dish for your lazy nights or meal prep needs!
tips: You may add red chilis to make the dish spicier, but this might not be best if serving to children.
instructions: Prepare and wash the milkfish. Remove their fins and innards, and then cut them into serving portions.
In a large bowl, pour the ½ cup of water, ½ cup of salt, and then the milkfish slices. Let them soak in the brine for 30 minutes.
While waiting for the milkfish slices, peel and slice your carrots however you like.
Prepare the pressure cooker. Add a layer of sliced carrots at the bottom, and then add the bay leaves, garlic, and whole peppercorns. Add a layer of milkfish slices after.
Create a new layer of the seasonings, then add another set of portions of milkfish. Add the olives, pickles, and the Knorr Seasoning Chili. Add the 1 ½ tbsp of salt after.
Pour the olive oil until the entire pot is covered. Lastly, add a half cup of water.
Cover the pressure cooker and let the dish cook. Once the pressure cooker whistles, lower its heat setting. Allow the dish to cook for an hour in low heat.
After an hour, carefully remove the pressure before removing the cover.
Transfer the Spanish-style bangus into jars for storage and add some to a plate with white rice for immediate consumption. Enjoy!
categories: HOW TO COOK SPANISH STYLE BANGUS

name: Easy Baby Potato Side Dish to Try this Festive Season
description:
The countdown to the holidays has already begun, and everyone’s calendars are getting packed. If, like us, you’re a certified Korean food fanatic, you probably can’t get enough of yummy Korean side dishes. 
               
               
               
              That’s why you should give our easy baby potato side dish recipe A.K.A Gamja Gorim a try for your next festive get-together. The perfect blend of salty and sweet, this easy-to-eat banchan (side dish) is absolutely irresistible. Prepared with Knorr Liquid Seasoning for that dash of umami flavor, this baby potato recipe will be a total hit at your next potluck party!
tips: Feel free to adjust the sauce portions according to your personal preferences. However, be careful not to undercook or overcook the baby potatoes.
instructions: Trim any broken edges or rotten spots from the baby potatoes. Wash and rinse them thoroughly in cold water to remove any dirt. Strain after.
Pour the cooking oil into a thick skillet over medium heat. Add the baby potatoes shortly after.
Cover the skilled for 20 minutes or until the potatoes are fully cooked. Shake and move the skillet every five minutes, so they cook evenly and don’t burn.
Change the heat setting to low, and add the Knorr Liquid Seasoning, rice syrup, and minced garlic. Stir the ingredients together with a wooden spoon.
Turn up the heat setting to medium. Keep stirring for 5 minutes or until the sauce is reduced and the baby potatoes turn wrinkly and shiny.
Remove from the heat and mix in the sesame oil. Sprinkle the sesame seeds on top.
Transfer to a serving bowl and consume with rice. Refrigerate the leftovers once the dish cools so they’ll last up to four days.

name: This 'Pato'tim Recipe Will Have Your Guests Begging For More
description:
Yes, you’ve read that right – Patotim is the best duck dish you’ll ever try and you can make it in the comforts of your home with a few time consuming, yet very simple and hands-off, steps! Similar to the more popular patatim (braised ham hock), Patotim is a Chinese-inspired dish that makes use of whole duck that’s fried, boiled, and then braised for a period of time to create a melt-in-your-mouth dish that will wow your friends and family at your next Christmas party. 
               
               
               
              Be warned, this indulgent dish is so rich in sweet, salty, and umami flavors that you will be asked to make this over and over again. It’s just that good!
tips: To prevent your duck from sticking onto your stainless steel pot when frying, try heating up your pot for 5-8 minutes before adding in your oil. Just make sure to watch it heat up and use a heavy-bottomed pot to prevent burning.

ingredients.item: bok choy, ends trimmed and leaves separated
cauliflower head, sliced into small florets
baguio beans ends trimmed and sliced in half

instructions: Prepare your duck for frying by patting the duck dry with paper towels.
Rub salt on the duck, making sure to get it on every surface. Then, let the duck rest for 8 minutes.
Heat a pot that’s large enough to fit your whole duck over medium high heat. Add oil and sear your whole duck for 3 minutes on each side.
Remove the duck from the pot and set aside as you prepare the other ingredients for the Patotim.
Using the same pot with the oil rendered from frying the duck, sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant and translucent.
Add soy sauce, Knorr Liquid Seasoning Original, pineapple juice, and lemon lime soda into the pot. Cover and bring the liquid into a boil.
Once boiling, add dried bay leaves, pepper, and Knorr Chicken Cube. Stir until the Knorr Chicken cube is dissolved.
Add the duck into the pan and cover. Let it boil for 30 minutes on each side. This long period of boiling helps you get that melt-in-your-mouth meat that patotim is known for.
While the patotim is boiling, prepare to steam your vegetables.
Using a large steam basket, steam your vegetables for 5 minutes. You can steam them all together or in batches depending on how large the basket is. Set aside once done.
Once the 1 hour of boiling the duck is up, add pinoy-style tomato sauce onto the pot. Stir well but be careful not to break apart the duck.
Bring the heat down to a simmer and let the mixture cook until the sauce thickens to your desired consistency.
To serve your patotim, get a large platter and carefully transfer the duck onto it.
Carefully add your steamed vegetables onto the large platter surrounding the duck.
Finish off your patotim by drizzling the patotim sauce on top of the duck and on the steamed vegetables.
categories: HOW TO SLOW COOKED BEEF RECIPE

name: Stop Deep Frying Your Chimichangas - Air-Fry Them Instead!
description: Get a head start with your New Year’s resolutions by making these delicious and healthified chimichangas for your New Year’s Eve spread. Chimichangas are usually deep-fried to get that crispy exterior but for this recipe, we’re air-frying them for less effort and less calories so we can spend more time celebrating the start of a new year. For an extra creamy filling, we add Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise into the mix. It’s the perfect healthyish treat to kick off healthier eating habits this coming new year.
tips: If you don’t have an air fryer, you can still make these healthified chimichangas! Use a regular oven and bake for 400°F for 20-25 minutes or until the chimichangas are golden brown.

ingredients.item: 400 grams black beans, drained and rinsed

instructions: In a large bowl, combine chicken breast, black beans, tomatoes, spices, cheese, Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, and white onions in a bowl.
Prepare your tortillas for the chimichanga by laying them on a flat surface for filling.
Place ½ cup of the chimichanga filling in the middle of each tortilla.
Fold the sides over the filling and proceed to roll like a burrito.
Preheat your air fryer to 375°F.
Brush the chimichangas lightly with oil and bake for 20-25 minutes until the outside is golden and crispy.
Serve the chimichangas warm with a side of guacamole, salsa, cilantro, sour cream, and your choice of salad greens for a healthier New Year’s Eve dinner.

name: Slather This Creamy Cajun Sauce on Everything - It's That Good
description: This creamy cajun sauce recipe is so good you’ll want to lather it on everything – fried chicken, fries, chips, and even bread. You can even try it on barbecue or use it as a salad dressing if you’re feeling a little adventurous. This creamy cajun sauce is sure to spice up and elevate any dish you add it to – perfect for adding to your New Year’s Eve spread. The secret is in the blend of spices and creamy Lady’s Choice – this combination makes for an addicting and versatile sauce, a crowd pleaser for sure!
instructions: Add all ingredients in a bowl. Mix well.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving to give time for the flavors of the creamy cajun sauce to combine and deepen.
Store in an airtight container and refrigerate for up to a week.

name: Try This Baked Spaghetti with Chorizo de Bilbao Recipe
description:
You’ve probably nailed your classic spaghetti by now, but do you want to take your dish to the next level? You can add some Spanish flavor to this timeless pasta by making Baked Spaghetti with Chorizo de Bilbao! 
               
               
               
              This super easy and cheesy recipe uses Knorr Cream of Mushroom, and we know what you’re thinking: yes, you can use this for more than preparing soup. Read on to add a dash of España to your next holiday gathering.
tips: You can use plain water for the white sauce, but pasta water brings more flavor to the dish, so don’t throw it away.

ingredients.item: pasta water, reserved from cooking the spaghetti noodles

instructions: Cook pasta noodles according to the package instructions. Reserve 3 cups of pasta water after.
Dissolve the Knorr Cream of Mushroom in the reserved 3 cups of pasta water.
Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat, and allow it to simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the cream and mix well. Once the cream has been incorporated, turn off the heat and set aside the sauce.
Saute the ground pork, beef, and chorizo de bilbao in a saucepan over medium heat until the color changes. Discard most of the oil from the pan.
Add onions and garlic to the pan and saute for 3-5 minutes or until the onion becomes translucent.
Add the Knorr Beef Cube and Knorr Pork Cube and mix well until the cubes have dissolved. Season the mixture with ground pepper.
Add the tomato paste, tomato sauce, Spanish paprika, green olives, and sugar to the pan. Mix well and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Then, turn off the heat and set the sauce aside.
Preheat the oven to 180C.
Toss the cooked pasta in the pan with the white sauce and then transfer it into a 9x13 rectangular oven-safe dish.
Grate half of the pack of cheese and sprinkle it over the pasta. Spoon the meat sauce on top, and ensure everything is spread evenly.
Top off the pasta with the remaining grated cheese.
Bake the pasta in the oven for 15-20 minutes or until the cheese has begun to brown.
Remove the dish from the oven and allow it to sit for 10 minutes before serving. Enjoy!

name: Your Next Potluck Dish: Creamy Chicken Macaroni Salad with Cheese Pimiento
description:
You know Christmas is around the corner when your calendar is booked with gatherings left and right. But what if you’re invited to a potluck party? Well, you can never go wrong with a classic dish everyone loves: Creamy Chicken Macaroni Salad with Cheese Pimiento! 
               
               
               
              Our macaroni salad recipe uses Lady’s Choice Real Mayonaisse to turn ordinary meals into extraordinary moments. This delish and rich dish can be enjoyed as a hearty merienda or filling dinner (or lunch). It’ll be a sure hit staple in your holiday recipe arsenal. So deck the halls with creamy macaroni!
tips: You can add green bell peppers and raisins to give this macaroni recipe an extra kick of flavor.
instructions: Cook macaroni according to the package instructions. Rinse under running water and drain well. Set aside for later.
Chop the carrots, onions, pickle relish and shredded chicken.
Combine the chopped ingredients with the pimiento peppers and shredded cheese. Fold-in the mixture with the Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, and toss well. Season with sugar, salt, and pepper to taste.
Chill before serving.

name: Must-Try Paskong Pancit Canton with Nutty Twist
description: No celebration is complete without the classic crowd favorite Pancit Canton. This year, take the familiar flavors up a notch by adding peanut butter into the mix.
tips: Make sure to serve this dish warm for the best Paskong Pancit Canton experience.

ingredients.item: pork liempo, boiled until tender and sliced

instructions: Get a wok or a large shallow pan and heat it up over medium heat.
Add three tablespoons of oil and sauté the garlic and onions until fragrant.
Add pre-boiled pork, and chicken liver into the pan. Stir fry until the pork is browned.
Add kinchay, Knorr Pork Cube, cabbage, carrots, and black pepper into the pan. Stir until the vegetables are cooked halfway.
Add water and reserved pork cooking liquid into the pan. Bring to a boil and let the mixture boil for 2 minutes.
Strain out the meat and vegetables from the broth and set aside.
Lower the heat and add to the mixture peanut butter, oystersauce, chili garlic, char siu sauce, and brown sugar. Mix well and allow to reduce until slightly thickened.
Add the meat and noodles into the pan and cook until the noodles are soft. Take off the heat and set aside.
In a separate pan, heat 6 tablespoons of oil and add spring onions. Sauté for 2 minutes and then add Knorr Liquid Seasoning Original. Mix well and toss with the cooked pancit.

name: Add a K-Twist to Your Christmas with This Korean-Style Adobo
description: Take the Korean fever to the next level this Christmas season with this fresh take on adobo with K-flavors. This recipe takes the classic adobo that we all love but adds a delicious twist to it just in time for the holidays. This dish is perfect for families and friends looking to add a fresh take to the usual handaan. This dish uses both chicken and pork as the main protein so it’s perfect for those looking for variety. The secret ingredient that ties it all together is popular Korean ingredients Gochujang and Gochugaru. These, combined with classic adobo ingredients plus Knorr Chicken Cube makes for an extra special adobo that everyone will be raving about.
tips: Searing meat is an easy way to add flavor to your food. To sear, get your pan nice and hot. Place down your meat and allow it to sear for a few seconds to a minute. When ready to flip, the meat will release easily from the pan.
instructions: Start by choosing a large heavy-bottomed pot that will fit all the meat needed for this adobo recipe.
Heat the pot over medium-high heat and add oil. Then, add garlic and onions and sauté until fragrant.
Add the chicken and pork pieces in batches and sear the meat. This helps improve the flavor and adds color to the meat.

Once all the meat has been seared, place them all back into the pot and add vinegar, soy sauce, bay leaves, pepper, water, gochujang, gochugaru, and Knorr Chicken Cube. Bring the mixture to a boil, uncovered, to prevent the strong vinegar taste.
Once boiling, lower heat to a simmer and let it simmer for a few minutes.
For an adobo that’s richer in flavor, pan-fry the chicken and pork pieces in a separate pan for 2-3 minutes.
After frying, put the meat back into the pot and add sugar. Simmer for 6 min or until the sauce has reached a syrup-like consistency.
For added fiber, add thinly sliced bok choy and cook for 2 more minutes.
Transfer to a serving dish and top with sliced leeks and toasted sesame seeds.

name: Kimchi Fried Rice Minus the Kimchi? Yes, It's Possible!
Unbelievably Creamy Garlic Penne Pasta Sans the Cream
description: Start the New Year right with this delicious white sauce pasta recipe. It’s so creamy that your guests won’t believe you when you tell them that this garlic penne has no cream in it. The silky smooth sauce owes its creaminess to the flour that’s cooked over medium heat in butter. This combination is also called a roux and is used in cooking to add flavor and make sauces thicker. In this creamy recipe, this roux is made with Knorr Chicken Cube for an extra layer of flavor and is finished with milk to create an indulgent sauce that will leave you wanting for more. Easy, budget-friendly, and delicious, this garlic penne pasta will be the star of your New Year’s Eve dinner!
tips: Mix and cook the butter and flour combination until it’s brown in color for a richer and more deeply-flavored sauce.
instructions: Cook penne pasta according to package directions. Drain the pasta, making sure to set aside 1 cup of the pasta water along with the pasta.
Heat a pan over medium heat. Add oil and butter.
Add garlic into the pan and sauté until soft.
Crumble Knorr Chicken Cube and add into the pan. Add flour and mix well until the cube is dissolved. You can use a whisk to make this easier.
Add pasta water and full cream milk. Whisk and reduce heat to low.
Add quick melt cheese and ½ cup of the grated parmesan cheese, pepper, and parsley. Stir until the cheese melts.
Toss in penne pasta and mix until combined.
Take off the heat and served topped with more grated parmesan cheese, if using.
categories: HOW TO MAKE WHITE SAUCE PASTA
FUSILLI PASTA RECIPE IN WHITE SAUCE
HOW TO MAKE WHITE PASTA SAUCE WITHOUT CREAM
HOW TO COOK PENNE PASTA WITH WHITE SAUCE

name: Ridiculously Easy Steamed Pompano Recipe You Should Try
description:
As the old saying goes, ‘There are many fish in the sea.’ One of the most common ones you’ll see in the market is the good ol’ pompano. There are plenty of ways to cook this fish, but what if you’re pressed for time? Well, you can still enjoy this fish with a whole lot of flavor (and a healthy twist) with our steamed pompano recipe! 
               
               
               
              Our guide on how to cook steamed pompano takes just 20 minutes to prepare, making it the perfect go-to dish for busy evenings. It’s made with everyone’s favorite Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili for a little spicy kick! Plus, this steamed pompano is super healthy, so you won’t feel guilty for indulging in this quick fix. Give this ridiculously easy steamed pompano recipe a try, and you’ll surely keep coming back for more.
tips: If you want to spice up your life, you may add chili flakes or red chili to the final product.
instructions: Stuff the head and belly of the pompano fish with the ginger, garlic and leeks. Rub salt all over the fish.
Set the stuffed fish on a dish that can fit in a steamer.
Steam the fish on high for 10 to 15 minutes.
You can prepare the sauce while the fish is being cooked. In a separate pan, saute the garlic until toasted, then add ginger, Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili, and brown sugar.
Mix the sauce well until the sugar has dissolved.
Pour the sauce over the steamed pompano before serving. Garnish with the sliced leeks.
Serve the dish while warm.
categories: HOW TO COOK STEAMED POMPANO FISH

name: Go Japanese With This Tempura Batter and Tempura Sauce Recipe
description:
Are you craving some Japanese food, but are on a tight budget? Well, you can make some classic tempura from scratch with our guide on how to make tempura sauce and tempura batter! 
               
               
               
              Our quick and easy tempura batter and tempura sauce recipe uses Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili to spice up your evening. You can follow this tempura batter recipe at home, so that you can coat your veggies, chicken, or seafood for a little Japanese kick. Basically, you can tempura-fy most food found in your fridge. How awesome is that, right? Read on to go Japanese today!
tips: You can use the batter to make homemade onion rings if you’re feeling snackish.
instructions: Stir the cornstarch and all-purpose flour in a bowl.
Add the egg yolk, then slowly whisk in ice-cold water until the batter becomes thick and flowy. Keep the mixture cold.
For the tempura sauce, dissolve the sugar in hot water. Add the Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili.
Mix the ingredients well and stir in the grated ginger.
Serve the sauce with the cooked tempura.

name: Spice Things Up With This Mapo Tofu Recipe
description:
The modest tofu is an MVP in the Asian pantry for various reasons. It’s affordable, accessible, and easy to cook. While you’ve probably nailed classic Pinoy staples like crispy tofu sisig and kangkong at tokwa already, why not give your tofu a Chinese twist? Lo and behold: we humbly present our super quick and easy mapo tofu recipe. 
               
               
               
              Our mapo tofu recipe uses Knorr Chicken Cube for an added perfect chicken linamnam. If you’re a lover of all things spicy, you should definitely add this to your list of easy recipes. You can enjoy this with other Chinese food or plain white rice (because rice is life, right?) 
               
              If you’re ready to spice things up, read on to learn how to make this dish yourself.
tips: You can blanch the tofu in salted water for about a minute to firm up the tofu before adding it to the sauce. This will lightly season the tofu as well.

ingredients.item: soft tofu, cut into ½ inch cubes

instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Saute the garlic, the white parts of the spring onion, and dried chili flakes. Cook for 30 seconds or until fragrant.
Add the ground chicken to the pan and cook for about 2 minutes while breaking up the chicken with a spatula.
Add the doubanjiang and fry for another minute. Then add the Knorr Chicken Cube, water, oyster sauce, sugar, and ground Sichuan pepper. Stir to combine and cook for 2 minutes.
Add cornstarch slurry and stir the mixture continuously until thickened.
Gently add in your tofu and cook for about 2 minutes until the tofu is heated through. Season the dish with salt to taste, if needed, and finish with sesame oil.
Transfer the dish to a serving bowl and garnish with the green ends of the spring onions. Enjoy!

name: This Kung Pao Chicken Will Knock Your Socks Off
description:
Say goodbye to those take out boxes and finally learn how to make delicious Kung Pao Chicken just in time for the Chinese New Year Celebrations. This flavor-packed recipe is deceptively simple. Using only a handful of pantry staples, including umami-rich Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili, this Kung Pao Chicken recipe proves that simple can be delicious and festive. 
               
               
               
              Serve this with your usual Chinese New Year dishes for a big celebration or keep it simple and serve it with rice and vegetables for a flavorful dinner at home.
tips: If you want your dish to be less spicy, wash the red chiles or substitute with 1 tsp dried chili flakes.

ingredients.item: kilogram skinless chicken breast fillet, cut into chunks

instructions: Combine all the marinade ingredients in a bowl large enough to fit all the chicken pieces.
Add the chicken pieces into the bowl and toss to coat. Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Add cooking white wine, Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili, sesame oil, cornstarch slurry, brown sugar, and white vinegar in a medium bowl. Mix well.
Into the same bowl, add garlic, water chestnuts, peanuts, chiles, and spring onions. Toss to coat.
Transfer sauce mixture into a medium skillet and heat slowly over medium heat until aromatic. Set aside.
In a separate pan, cook the marinated chicken pieces over medium high heat. Stir a few times until chicken is cooked and the juices run clear..
Get the kung pao sauce with water chestnut that you’ve set aside and add it into the pan where the chicken is cooking. Mix well.
Reduce heat to low and let simmer until the sauce thickens.
Serve warm with sides and hot bowls of rice.

name: Indulge in the Classic Italian-style Spaghetti and Meatballs Recipe
description:
Are you in the mood for some Italian tonight? You don’t have to go out or fly to Italy to enjoy some delicious Italian-style pasta. You can have a taste of Italia right in your very own home. And nothing says Italian food quite like classic spaghetti and meatballs. 
               
               
               
              Our spaghetti meatballs recipe uses Knorr Beef Cube to enhance your dish’s meaty flavor. Perfect for dinners at home or your next big party, this simple spaghetti and meatballs recipe will be an instant favorite among your family and friends. You can practice mastering this recipe just in time for National Spaghetti Day (January 4).
tips: Classic spaghetti meatballs are best served with garlic bread.

ingredients.item: to taste salt and black pepper

instructions: In a mixing bowl, prepare the meatballs by combining the ground pork and ground beef. Add the bread crumbs, egg, salt, Parmesan cheese, and ground pepper. Mix all the ingredients until they are well-blended.
Scoop around 3 tbsp of the meatball mixture. Place a cheddar cheese cube in the middle, then roll it into a ball. Repeat until you use up all the meatball mixture.
Heat the olive oil in a pan. Fry the meatballs until they turn golden brown. Remove and set aside once done.
Prepare the meaty marinara sauce by sauteing the onion and garlic on the remaining olive oil used to fry the meatballs.
Add the stewed tomato and tomato sauce to the pan, and stir. Cover and cook the sauce between low to medium heat setting for about 20 minutes.
Add the Knorr Beef Cube to the pan and stir. Put the fresh basil in the pan, and cook for 5 minutes.
Put the meatballs back into the pan. Cover and cook for 10 minutes.
Season the meatballs with salt and pepper. Set aside after.
In a separate pot, cook the spaghetti as instructed.
Arrange the cooked spaghetti in a serving plate or bowl. Top with sauce and meatballs. Add more Parmesan cheese if desired. Serve, and enjoy!
categories: HOW MANY CALORIES IS A BOWL OF SPAGHETTI AND MEATBALLS

name: Spice It Up With This Budget-Friendly Korean Spicy Ramen Recipe
description:
There’s nothing quite like enjoying some Korean comfort food after a long day. But what if it’s petsa de peligro or you’re running on a tight budget? Don’t worry because we have the perfect recipe that won’t break the bank: our Korean spicy ramen noodles recipe! 
               
               
               
              Our spicy ramen recipe uses Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise to add a creamy and delicious twist to your basic Korean spicy ramen. This is a fantastic budget-friendly meal you can prepare this International Hot & Spicy Food Day (January 16) and beyond.
tips: If the spicy ramen noodles are too much to handle, drink some milk instead of water.
instructions: In a serving bowl, mix the Korean spicy ramen seasoning packets, eggs, minced garlic and Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise. Mix everything well.
Bring the water to a boil in a saucepan and add the Korean instant noodles. Cook the noodles for about 2 minutes.
Pour the water from the saucepan and add the milk.
Add the seasoning mixture once the milk starts bubbling. Mix everything well for 30 seconds.
While the broth is bubbling, turn off the heat and add the cheese to the spicy ramen.
Once the cheese has melted, garnish with scallions and serve while it’s hot!
categories: HOW TO MAKE CHEESY SPICY RAMEN NOODLES

name: Get Popping With This Easy Taiwanese Popcorn Chicken Recipe
description:
Let’s face it: who doesn’t like fried chicken, right? It’s a comfort food staple in every household. But what if you want to live a healthier lifestyle? Should you give up fried chicken altogether? No, you don’t have to! Our Taiwanese popcorn chicken recipe is much more nutritious than your regular fried chicken and has a Taiwanese twist! 
               
               
               
              Our easy homemade popcorn chicken recipe uses Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili, adding a spicy kick to this Taiwanese night market favorite. While you can still fry your chicken in a regular cooking pan, we used an air fryer to make the dish healthier and easier to prepare.
tips: This dish goes well with rice, but if you’re living healthy, you can try pairing it with a salad, brown rice, or quinoa. If you’re pressed for time, use store-bought breading mix and five-spice powder instead for the chicken breading.
instructions: Cut the chicken thighs into one-inch cubes and pat dry.
Combine the five spice powder, onion powder, garlic powder, white pepper, salt, and Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili in a bowl, and mix well.
Marinade the chicken thighs in the spice mix for at least 30 minutes.
Prepare the air fryer by pre-heating it to 400 F for 7 minutes. Combine the potato and cornstarch while the air fryer is heating up. Lightly dredge the thigh pieces in the starch mix.
Spray the air fryer with the neutral oil. Place the chicken thighs and ensure there’s space between every piece. Spray the top of each piece lightly. Cook the chicken at 400 F for 6 minutes.
Lower the temperature to 375 F and shake the basket up. Cook the chicken thighs for another 4-5 minutes.
For your last batch, spray the Thai basil with some neutral oil, and add in for the last 4 minutes to make it crispy.

name: Bread Never Tasted This Good - Try This Pizza Roll Recipe
description: Celebrate National Pizza Day by making this easy and delicious budget-friendly pizza roll from pantry-staple white bread. Making pizza rolls is easy and requires only a handful of ingredients, most of which are herbs like basil and oregano. To make, white bread is stuffed with a delicious mix of cheese, herbs, and pizza toppings and is deep fried to perfection. It’s perfect as is but we take it to the next level by making a creamy and tangy pizza roll dip using Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise and cream cheese. This combination is so good you might not eat bread the same way again.
tips: If you want to make this recipe even easier, swap out homemade pizza sauce with a store bought one.
instructions: Heat the oil in the saucepan over medium heat.
