Add minced garlic to the pan and sauté until fragrant.
Add the tomato sauce to the pan and stir.
Add in the herbs and the chili flakes, if using.
Taste the pizza rolls sauce and season with salt and pepper.
Let the mixture simmer for 10-15 minutes to give the sauce time to thicken and the flavors to develop.
Take the pizza sauce off the pan once you’ve reached your desired consistency. Set aside for assembly.
Trim off the crusts of the white bread.
Using a rolling pin or a wine bottle, flatten each piece of bread.
In a bowl, combine the pizza sauce, cheeses, pepperoni, oregano, and garlic powder. This will be your pizza roll filling.
Set up your station by putting everything in place from left to right starting with the pizza filling, then the flattened bread, and last a shallow bowl to put the rolls in.
Get one piece of bread and put 1 heaping tablespoon of pizza roll filling on top.
Roll the bread like you would a lumpia (spring roll) and press the sides to seal it. Repeat until the ingredients have been used up.
Prepare to deep fry by again putting everything in place.

Get three bowls and in one bowl, mix together the milk and eggs. In the second bowl, add the flour, and in the third bowl, add the breadcrumbs. Place this next together along with the prepared pizza bread rolls.
In a deep pan or frying pan, heat oil to 350°F.
Dip each bread roll into the flour mixture, shaking off any extra flour.
Next, dip in the milk and egg mixture, making sure it’s evenly covered.
Finally, roll the coated pizza bread rolls in breadcrumbs. Press gently to make sure the crumbs stick to the bread roll.
Add the pizza bread roll gently into the hot oil and deep fry for 2-3 minutes per side or until golden brown. Don’t overcrowd the pot and fry in batches.
Once done, place the bread rolls in a strainer to allow excess oil to drip off or on a plate with paper towels. Serve hot with the creamy pizza roll sauce.
Combine all of the ingredients in a bowl and refrigerate until ready to serve.
categories: HOW TO MAKE PIZZA ROLLS USING BREAD

name: Make it A Valentines to Remember with Cacio e Pepe Arancini
description:
Skip the fancy restaurants and make your valentine a dinner to remember with these cacio e pepe arancini. Cacio e pepe is a classic Italian pasta dish made with the simplest of ingredients including pecorino romano and freshly ground black pepper. Arancini is also an Italian dish made from creamy risotto that’s breaded and deep fried. 
               
               
               
              This recipe takes a page from both and creates arancini that’s rich with the flavors of cacio e pepe, a match made in heaven just like you and your valentine. We take this to the next level with a homemade truffle mayo that’s made extra creamy and delicious with Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise. This dish calls for a few special ingredients like risotto and truffle oil and takes a few hours to make with cooling time but it’s all worth it. One bite of these your date will be begging for your hand and more cacio e pepe arancini this Valentines day!
tips: Add lemon zest into your risotto for an extra layer of flavor.

ingredients.item: shallot, very finely, pounded to a paste
to taste freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Heat a pan over low heat and add the olive oil followed by the shallot paste. Gently sauté for 10 minutes.
In a medium saucepan, bring 8 ½ cups of water into a simmer. This will be the stock for the risotto.
In the pan with shallots, add white wine and leave it to cook for 3-4 minutes before adding the rice. Stir for a few minutes to coat the rice with the white wine mixture.

Once the rice turns opaque, start adding your stock water to the pan one ladle at a time. Stir frequently, every 30 seconds or so, and keep adding water until the risotto rice is cooked al dente. This will take around 15 to 20 minutes. Don’t overmix and overcook into a gooey mess. You’ll know your risotto is cooked just right when you run your spoon over it and it slowly flows back to fill the space.
Remove the pan from the heat and add the butter, pepper, and Pecorino Romano. Stir, taste, and adjust the seasoning if necessary. Allow it to cool and mix in an egg.

Get a baking sheet that fits your refrigerator and spread risotto in an even layer. Press some plastic wrap on top and let it cool in the fridge for a few hours. If you’re pressed for time, keeping it in the freezer will help it cool fast. Just don’t forget about it or you’ll have frozen cacio e pepe risotto.
While the cacio e pepe risotto is cooling, prepare the truffle mayo. In a small bowl, add Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise.
Slowly drizzle the truffle oil, one tablespoon at a time into the bowl as you whisk vigorously to incorporate.
Add truffle salt and black pepper. Mix well.
Taste and adjust the seasoning to suit your liking.

Get some rice and make a disc in your hand. Place a cube of mozzarella in the middle and create a ball with the cheese inside. Make sure that the rice covers the mozzarella so it doesn’t ooze out while frying.
Roll the shaped cacio e pepe arancini in flour, then dip in the egg mixture, before finally coating in breadcrumbs. Set this aside and repeat the process until all the rice is used up.
Heat oil in a deep pot until hot. Add the arancini and turn often to brown the sides equally. Cook for about 3-4 minutes for a gooey and cheesy center. Set aside on a paper towel to drain excess oil.
To serve, scoop a dollop of your truffle mayo and place one ball on top. Repeat this for all cacio e pepe arancini and top with freshly grated pecorino romano.
categories: CACIO E PEPE RECIPE FRESH PASTA
HOW TO MAKE CACIO E PEPE

name: DIY Heart Calzones: Cute & Easy Chow for Valentine's Day!
description: Valentine’s Day is when we pull out all the stops for our significant other – enormous flowers, jewelry, and fancy dinners in the city. But, not everyone is into grandiose celebrations. Some prefer a simple yet romantic dinner at home with music in the background. For these lowkey Valentine’s Day celebrations, this DIY Heart-Shaped Calzone recipe is perfect. It’s cute and easy to make so you can spend more time cuddling on the couch. Because it’s lowkey, we’re not making calzone dough from scratch. Instead, we’re using frozen pizza dough and cutting them into small hearts for some much needed V-Day cuteness. For the filling, we keep it simple with the classic chicken and mushroom calzone combo with an extra dose of umami all thanks to Knorr Liquid Seasoning Original. To take it up a notch, we serve this dish up with a creamy and oh so tangy garlic mayo dip because we still want to be a little extra for Valentine’s Day.
tips: Make this ahead of time by freezing the assembled heart-shaped calzones. To bake, preheat your oven to 400F and add 10-15 minutes to your bake time.
instructions: Heat a pan with olive oil over medium heat. Add the onions and garlic until fragrant and translucent. This will take around 2 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook for 5-7 minutes or until the liquid evaporates and they begin to brown.
Add chicken and Knorr Liquid Seasoning in the pan and cook for about 2-3 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Remove from heat and set aside to cool.
Preheat the oven to 400F.
Dust with all-purpose flour the surface where you will roll out your pizza dough on.
Roll out your pizza dough and using a large heart shaped cutter, begin to cut out heart shaped pieces of dough. You should have enough for 8 pieces. Set aside.
In a medium sized bowl, combine the filling with mozzarella cheese.
Place 4 heart-shaped dough on a baking tray lined with parchment paper.
Distribute the calzone filling with cheese evenly between the 4 heart-shaped dough.
Place the remaining 4 hearts on top of the filling and use a fork to seal the edges.
Brush the top of the heart-shaped calzones with the beaten egg.
Bake the calzones for 15-18 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.
In a small bowl, combine all the ingredients together and mix well.
Serve the garlic mayo on the side of your heart-shaped calzones and enjoy!

name: Follow This Simple Chicken Pastel Recipe
description:
The holidays are in full swing, and like us, you’re probably whipping up festive dishes left and right. While there’s nothing wrong with going the usual pasta route, why not try some comfort food you can prepare during the holidays and beyond? We humbly recommend our easy chicken pastel recipe. 
               
               
               
              Our list of chicken pastel ingredients includes Knorr Chicken Cube to take your creamy chicken pastel to more flavorful heights. Upon following this guide on how to cook chicken pastel, you’ll be confident in preparing this dish in no time.
tips: Enjoy this dish with a slice of bread instead of rice to keep your meal light.
instructions: Combine the chicken, soy sauce, and lime in a large bowl. Marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a cooking pot. Saute the onion and garlic.
Once the onion is soft and translucent, add the chorizo. Saute for 1 minute.
Put the chicken in a pot. Saute the mixture until browned.
Add water and let it boil.
Add Knorr Chicken Cube to the pot, stir and cover. Continue to cook for about 20 minutes.
Put the sliced hot dogs in the pot. Cook over medium heat until the liquid is reduced to half.
Add the potato and carrot into the pot. Next add in the all-purpose cream. Mix well, cover and cook for around 8 minutes.
Stir-in the mushrooms and bell peppers. Stir and cook for 3 minutes.
Season with ground black pepper and salt.
Transfer to a serving plate and serve with white rice. Enjoy!

name: Embrace The Flavors Of Ilocos With Our Ilocano Dinakdakan Recipe
description:
Nothing beats enjoying some Pinoy comfort food at the end of a tiring day. Who doesn’t like cracking open a cold bottle of beer with friends and family, right? There’s nothing wrong with going for some good ol’ sisig as pulutan, but why add some Ilocano flavors to your bar chow? Try our Dinakdakan Ilocano Style Recipe! 
               
               
               
              Our guide on how to cook Dinakdakan Ilocano style is made with Knorr Pork Cube. The flavor of one pork cube is equivalent to 1 kilo of pork so this tiny addition helps elevate the flavor of the meat even more. Aside from the pig parts, most of our recipe’s ingredients can already be found in your everyday pantry. So don’t blame us if your loved ones become hooked on Dinakdakan Ilocano! ;)
tips: If you don’t have a grill, you can opt to pan fry the pig parts instead.
instructions: Pour 8 cups of water into a cooking pot. Let it boil, and then add salt and pepper. Add in the pig ears and face, as well as the Knorr Pork Cube.
Set the heat for the cooking pot to low and continue to boil for about 50 to 60 minutes or until the meat is fork tender. Strain and set aside.
Boil the pig brains using a strainer and cook for about 10 minutes or until it turns white. Remove the cooked pig brains from the heat and set aside.
Heat the grill. Grill the pig ear and face for about 4 to 6 minutes per side. Wait until the pork turns a bit crispy, but not burnt.
Remove the grilled pig parts from the grill. Let it cool down a bit, and then chop into bite-sized pieces.
In a mixing bowl, combine the pig brains and vinegar. Season with salt and pepper. Add the chili, onion and salt, and then include the chopped pig parts in the mixture.
Transfer to a serving plate, and enjoy.
categories: HOW TO MAKE DINAKDAKAN ILOCANO STYLE
HOW TO COOK DINAKDAKAN ILOCANO STYLE

name: Get Rolling Japanese-Style With Our California Roll Sushi Recipe
description:
Is it just us or does it seem like everyone’s been traveling to Japan lately? While you can jump on the revenge travel hype, you can also create a piece of Japan right in your very own home. We invite you to get rolling with our California Roll Sushi recipe. 
               
               
               
              Our list of California Roll ingredients includes Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili and Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise to add a punch of flavor to this Japanese favorite. You won’t need to head to Japan or your favorite Japanese resto with our guide on how to make California Roll Sushi.
tips: Make sure you cut the sushi roll with a sharp knife so it doesn’t fall apart easily.

ingredients.item: cucumber, hot house seeds removed with a spoon and julienned
For dipping Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili

instructions: Wash the rice, and cook as you normally would in a rice cooker.
In a separate bowl, combine the vinegar, sugar and salt.
Once the rice is cooked, place it in a small bowl.

Pour the vinegar mixture over the cooked rice. While mixing the rice, use a fan to help it cool down. This makes the rice appear shiny without turning mushy. Set the rice aside and cover the bowl with a damp cloth.
Prepare to roll. Lay the sushi mat on the table. Cut the nori in half and lay the nori on the mat’s bottom part.
Lightly wet your fingers and add a small amount of rice onto the mat. Spread the rice all throughout the nori. Sprinkle the masago and spread it evenly. Flip the rice and masago mixture.
With the rice and masago faced down already, arrange the mango strips, kani and cucumber at the bottom part of the nori. Add a small drop of Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, too.

To roll, tuck your thumbs under the bamboo and use them to lift the mat and rice over the filling, while using your other fingers to hold it in place. Use the mat to continue rolling until you reach the end of the nori.
Press the mat so the roll sticks together. Slowly peel away the mat, and use a sharp knife to cut the sushi roll.
Once cut into pieces, add a small drop of Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise on top of the California Roll, and dip it in Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili. Enjoy!
categories: HOW TO MAKE CALIFORNIA ROLL SUSHI

name: Fire Up Your Tastebuds and Make This Spicy Tonkatsu Sauce
description:
This spicy tonkatsu sauce will take your Japanese food game to the next level with only a few ingredients and 5-minutes hands-on time. Rich in umami, this versatile sauce is handy to have in your back pocket because you can use it for more than just tonkatsu. Double, or triple, the recipe and use it for dumplings, fried chicken, french fries, and whatever else your tastebuds fancy. 
               
               
               
              This tonkatsu sauce is made extra special and spicy with the use of Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili. It has all the umami flavors of the original with an extra spicy kick – perfect for dipping your crispy tonkatsu in.
tips: For the best flavor, make the sauce the night before you plan on using it.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk all the ingredients together.
Let sit for a minimum of 30 minutes for the flavors to develop.
Enjoy this tonkatsu sauce on top of your favorite tonkatsu or your choice of fried food or dumplings.
categories: HOW TO MAKE JAPANESE TONKATSU SAUCE

name: Try Our 4 All-Time-Favorite Open-Faced Sandwich Recipes
description: Sandwiches are some of the quickest and easiest meals to prepare. With only a few ingredients and a few minutes of prep, you can have a complete meal that’s both delicious and nutritious. Open-faced sandwiches take your usual sandwich and make it a little more special by packing on the flavor with more space for a variety of ingredients minus the extra bread. Figuring out what to make can be a bit overwhelming given the variety of choices so we’re here to make your life easier (and more delicious!). We’ve handpicked 4 of our all-time favorite hot open-faced sandwiches for you to try the next time you’re looking for a delicious meal that’s instagram-worthy and healthyish at the same time.
tips: Lightly toasting your bread before adding any toppings will prevent your bread from getting soggy.

ingredients.item: sourdough bread, sliced at 1 inch thickness
turkey or chicken ham, thinly sliced
to taste Knorr Liquid Seasoning Original (optional)
sourdough bread, sliced at 1 inch thickness
hard boiled eggs, cut into small cubes

instructions: Preheat the oven to broil.
Arrange your bread on a baking sheet
Spread Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise on the sourdough bread.
Slice or fold the slices of turkey or chicken ham on top of the bread neatly,
Put the apple slices on top of the ham followed by the sliced brie.
Place in the oven and broil for about 2 minutes or until the cheese has softened
Top with arugula or spinach.
Finish with a drizzle of honey and salt and pepper to taste.
Slice your croissant in half.
Smear Lady’s Choice Sandwich Spread on the croissant.
Top with american cheese slices and toast in an oven toaster for 2-3 minutes or until the cheese has started to melt.
Take the croissant out of the toaster and top with lettuce leaves.
Season the sliced tomatoes with salt and add on top of your open-faced sandwich.
Next, add the crispy bacon on top to help it remain crisp and delicious,
Season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning Original, if using.
Heat a pan over medium heat and add pesto.
Crack your eggs over the pan and cook to your desired doneness.
Set aside.
Toast the bread in the same pan drizzled with a little olive oil over medium high heat.
Take off the heat and smear Lady’s Choice Bacon Spread on the bread.
Arrange sliced avocado on top of the bread and season with salt, pepper, and a little lemon juice.
Put one egg on top of each open-faced sandwich and finish off with the crumbled kesong puti.
In a medium bowl, mix the chopped hard boiled eggs. Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, and Lady’s Choice Tuna Spread together.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Set aside.
Toast the bread for 1 minute.
Season the sliced tomatoes with salt and set aside.
Get your toasted bread and layer the egg salad mixture, tomatoes, and shredded cheese on top.
Broil for 3-4 minutes or until the cheese has melted.
Enjoy this delicious twist on an open-faced egg salad.
categories: SMALL OPEN FACED SANDWICHES SERVED AS APPETIZER
OPEN FACED SANDWICH INGREDIENTS AND PROCEDURE

name: This Might Be The Best Rellenong Pusit Recipe Online
description: This stuffed squid recipe is not the grilled pusit of your childhood. It just might be better. This recipe takes party-favorite pusit and elevates it to a flavorful and indulgent dish by infusing it with Knorr Liquid Seasoning Original and stuffing it with a fragrant pork and vegetable mixture. This stuffed squid is then pan-fried to get a crispy crunch exterior that makes it a cut above every other stuffed squid (rellenong squid) you’ve ever tried.
tips: Dredging the squid in flour before egg ensures that the egg has something to cling to instead of just sliding off the squid.
instructions: In a large bowl, add pusit (squid) and Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Set aside and let marinate for 30 minutes.
Heat a pan over medium heat and add 1 tbsp oil.
Sauté garlic and onion until fragrant. Add celery, tomato and carrots. Cook for 3-4 minutes.
Add the pork and cook until browned.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Let the pork mixture cool for a bit before stuffing the meat inside the squid.
Once filled, close the opening of the squid using toothpicks to prevent the stuffing from oozing out when cooking.
Prepare to dredge the stuffed squid.
Coat the stuffed squid in flour and shake off excess.
Then, dip the coated stuffed squid in egg before dipping in the flour once again.
In a large pan, add oil and bring up the heat to medium high.
Pan fry the stuffed squid, cooking each side for about 4-6 minutes.
Transfer the stuffed squid into a serving dish lined with paper towels to absorb the excess oil and enjoy!

name: Make This Lent-Friendly Ginataang Tilapia for Holy Week
description: Finally learn how to make Ginataang Tilapia just in time for holy week. It’s a healthy and delicious meat-free meal that’s perfect for celebrating the end of Lent. We made it a little bit easier by using Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix so you don’t have to make your own coconut milk. One pack gives your Ginataang Tilapia a creamy and delicious tropical flavor minus all the effort. This Ginataang Tilapia is so easy and delicious that you’ll be eating it way past the Lenten season.
tips: Squeeze half a lime onto your dish right before serving to brighten up the flavors of your Ginataang Tilapia.

ingredients.item: 33 grams Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix, dissolved in 1 ½ cups of water

instructions: Heat oil in a pot over medium high heat.
Add garlic, onion, and ginger into the pot. Sauté until fragrant.
Add fish sauce and saute for 30 seconds more.
Add dissolved Knorr Ginataang Gulay Recipe Mix, bird’s eye chili, and tilapia. Cover and simmer for 12 minutes.
Add green finger chili and season with ground pepper to taste. Stir and cook for 3 minutes.
Add pechay. Cook and cover for 2 minutes.
Serve this ginataang tilapia with rice.

name: Say Hello to The Best Lumpia In Town: Lumpiang Sariwa
description: Say goodbye to your favorite crispy lumpia. This meat-free and lent-friendly Lumpiang Sariwa will be the mainstay of your dinner table during holy week and beyond. With a few simple ingredients and Knorr Shrimp and Pork Cubes, this fresh lumpia recipe has all the meaty flavors minus the meat. Crispy tofu is added inside for some textural contrast alongside other delicious vegetables for a Lumpiang Sariwa that’s unlike anything else you’ve ever tried. The best part about this lumpia is that there’s no frying in hot oil involved. Instead of a crispy exterior, this lumpia is enclosed in a soft crépe-like wrapper that makes eating your vegetables so much easier.
tips: Make this meal prep ready by preparing the filling ahead of time.

ingredients.item: large firm tofu, drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan over medium heat. Cook cubed tofu until crispy. Set aside.
Next, heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan and sauté garlic and online until fragrant.
Add ½ cup water, Knorr Shrimp Cube, and sweet potato into the pot. Cook for 6 minutes or until the sweet potatoes are soft.
Add carrots, cabbage, string beans, and cilantro into the pot. Cook for 5 more minutes then take off the heat. Set aside.
In a medium bowl, whisk the eggs until broken apart.
Add milk to the eggs and whisk to combine.
Slowly add the oil to the mix while whisking.
Add the flour and salt. Mix well and set aside.
Heat up a wide non-stick pan over medium heat. Spread a thin layer of butter or oil. You can use an oil spray if that’s available to you.
Pour a little less than half a cup of Lumpiang Sariwa Wrapper batter into the pan. Tilt to spread the batter around.
Let it cook for 1-2 minutes or until the top is dry.
Using a spatula, remove the cooked Lumpiang Sariwa wrapper and place on a flat plate. Repeat until there’s no more batter.
Add water into a sauce pan. Bring to a boil. Add Knorr Pork Cube, brown sugar, and soy sauce. Mix until the pork cube is dissolved.
Add the cornstarch diluted in water into the pot and mix well. Simmer until the Lumpiang Sariwa sauce is thick but still pourable. Set aside.
Gather all the components of the Lumpiang Sariwa (filling, wrapper, sauce, toppings) and lay them out in your workspace.
Get a wrapper and place it on a flat plate. Put a lettuce leaf on top. Make sure that a small part of the lettuce leaf goes beyond the edge of the wrapper for a cleaner presentation.
Next, spoon some filling on top of the lettuce.
To roll, fold the bottom half of the wrapper to the middle before proceeding to roll on the sides. Place on the serving plate with the seam side down.
Repeat until there’s no more filling/wrappers left.
Drizzle the sauce on top and garnish with crushed peanuts and minced garlic.
categories: HOW TO MAKE LUMPIANG SARIWA SAUCE

name: Easy Lumpiang Togue Recipe to Try this Good Friday!
description:
Like most people, you probably don’t eat meat during Fridays this Lenten season. However, abstaining from eating meat can leave one always hungry. Well, we’ve got an easy-peasy yet filling solution to satisfy you this Good Friday and beyond. We recommend trying our Lumpiang Togue recipe. 
               
               
               
              Our list of Lumpiang Togue ingredients includes Knorr Chicken Cube to add a punch of flavor to this vegetarian dish. Once you’re done following our guide on how to cook Lumpiang Togue, you can confidently serve it anytime, anywhere.
tips: You can fry the Lumpiang Togue right after preparing them, or keep them chilled in the refrigerator for later use.

ingredients.item: red onion, peeled and sliced thinly
medium carrot, peeled and cut into thin strips
medium singkamas, peeled and cut into strips
dried shrimp fry (alamang) or to taste

instructions: Heat oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and onion, and saute them until fragrant. Add the carrots, then shortly after, the singkamas, Baguio beans, cabbage, and finally, the togue (bean sprouts).
Toss in the alamang and Knorr Chicken Cube in the wok, and season with salt and pepper. Add some fish sauce, mix well, then remove from the heat. Set aside to cool completely.
Separate the lumpia wrappers and keep them covered with a damp cloth. Lay one wrapper on a cutting board.
Place one tablespoon of the togue (bean sprouts) filling in the lumpia wrapper center. Wet the edge with water before rolling. Repeat until all the remaining wrappers and fillings are used up.
Heat enough oil in a deep frying pan. Fry lumpia until browned on all sides. Drain on paper towels. Serve with soy sauce-garlic dipping sauce.
To make the soy sauce-garlic dipping sauce, mix the soy sauce, crushed garlic, vinegar, salt, and sugar in a small bowl.

name: Easy 30-Minute Adobong Pusit Recipe
description: Adobo has been one of the most popular Filipino dishes in recent years because of how easy it is to prepare and how well it keeps. While you can adobo-fy almost anything from pork to sitaw, adobong pusit stands out as a seafood variation that brings deep umami to your table. If you’re cooking for yourself or for two, this easy 30-minute recipe is a great place to start.

ingredients.item: kilogram medium squid (cleaned and sliced into ½-inch rings with squid ink reserved)

instructions: Sauté the Aromatics Heat cooking oil in a wok or pot over medium heat. Sauté the garlic and onions until fragrant and the onions turn translucent.
Cook the Squid Add the sliced squid, reserved squid ink, and water. Bring to a boil and cook until the squid just turns opaque, about 2 minutes.
Season the Adobo Base Add soy sauce, vinegar, and Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Season lightly with salt and pepper.
Simmer the Sauce Allow the sauce to simmer for 2 to 3 minutes until slightly thickened and well blended. Transfer to a serving bowl and serve hot.

name: Feel Like Royalty With Our Chicken Ala King Recipe
description:
Are you in the mood for something creamy and comforting? Give your favorite fried dish a break, and try our Chicken Ala King recipe! Contrary to what its name might suggest, you don’t need to be kitchen royalty to prepare Chicken Ala King. 
               
               
               
              Our guide on how to cook Chicken Ala King features Knorr Chicken and Corn to add some creamy goodness to your food. Feel free to make more Chicken Ala King sauce if you love pouring it over hot, steamy rice like us.
tips: Chicken Ala King is best paired with warm biscuits or bread, but if rice is life, go ahead and pour the sauce over some piping hot rice as well.

ingredients.item: red onion, peeled and sliced thinly
small green bell pepper, finely diced
small red bell pepper, finely diced
Knorr Chicken and Corn soup, dissolved in 2 and ½ cups of water
store-bought chicken tonkatsu (or 20 pcs cooked chicken nuggets)

instructions: Melt butter with canola oil in a small saucepan.
Saute the green and red bell peppers until fragrant and slightly tender.
Pour in the dissolved Knorr Chicken and Corn soup mixture. Mix well, and allow to simmer until thickened.
Pour the sauce over cooked tonkatsu or chicken nuggets with rice or your favorite side dish.
categories: HOW TO COOK CHICKEN ALA KING

name: This Omurice Recipe Will Change The Way You Cook Your Eggs
description: Never run out of ideas on what to eat for breakfast, lunch, or dinner with delicious Japanese omelette – Omurice! This recipe teaches you how to make omurice with the simplest of ingredients. You don’t need any special trips to the Japanese supermarket because you probably have everything you need sitting in your pantry. Just make sure to have a non-stick pan to make your life easier and Knorr Liquid Seasoning Original for a boost of umami-rich flavors everyone loves.
tips: Having a non-stick pan is essential in making omurice but if you don’t have one, a well-seasoned wok or cast iron pan that’s been preheated is a great option too.
instructions: In a hot pan, heat up oil and sauté onions and cubed chicken until browned.
Add frozen mixed vegetables and season with salt and pepper.
Next, add the day-old rice. Make sure to press down on the rice and break the large clumps.
Add banana ketchup and Knorr Liquid Seasoning to the fried rice mixture. Mix well and set aside.
Whisk 1 egg with 1 tablespoon milk in a bowl. Set Aside.
Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat. Lightly brush with oil, making sure that the pan is coated well to ensure that the Japanese omelet won’t stick.
Pour egg and milk mixture in to the pan and tilt to coat the entire surface.
Cook the egg until the bottom has set but the top is still a bit runny or soft.
Sprinkle half of the grated cheese and add half of the rice in the middle of the pan.
Using a silicone spatula, gently fold the sides of the omelet over the rice one at a time.
Slide off the pan and onto a plate. Try to roll the omelet to get the top side or seam side be at the bottom of the plate for better presentation.
Repeat with the rest of the ingredients. This recipe makes 2 omurice.
Drizzle with more ketchup as garnish and serve immediately.

name: Try This Traditional Shepherd’s Pie Recipe
description:
And just like that, it’s Saint Patrick’s Day! Aside from wearing green and enjoying Irish drinks, why not enjoy a classic Irish staple you can prepare at home? For your consideration, we present our simple Shepherd’s Pie recipe. 
               
               
               
              Contrary to what some Pinoys may think, making Shepherd’s Pie is easy peasy. Plus, our Shepherd’s Pie ingredients include Knorr Beef Cube to enhance the meaty flavors of this dish. Read on to learn how to enjoy this Irish food favorite!
tips: Serve the Shepherd’s Pie with roasted vegetables for some variety.
instructions: Boil potatoes in water until tender. Drain from boiling water afterward.
Mash potatoes with salt and butter in a bowl. Set aside.
Cook ground beef in a pan until its color changes and the fat is rendered. Take off some fat if it’s too much, but leave about 2 tbsp.
Add onions and sauté with beef until they become soft.
Add the Knorr Beef Cube and stir in the flour.
Add water and mix well until the sauce has slightly thickened.
Add the frozen vegetables, Worcestershire sauce, and ground black pepper. Let the dish simmer for 2 to 3 minutes.
To arrange the pie, transfer the meat mixture onto a deep oven-safe dish.
Spoon mashed potatoes over the meat mixture and spread until the meat is fully covered.
Top with grated cheese, then bake until the cheese has melted. Serve and enjoy!

name: 25-Minute Binagoongang Talong Recipe
description:
There’s nothing quite like the classic bagoong. It has a distinct level of savor and umami taste, which can comfort the soul. Aside from enjoying bagoong with mangoes or vegetables, you can also whip up some binagoongang talong. 
               
               
               
              Our guide on how to cook binagoongang baboy with talong contains Knorr Shrimp Cube to bring out the shrimpy flavor of the bagoong. Bookmark this binagoongang baboy talong recipe if you’re craving some bagoong goodness.
tips: This binagoongang talong recipe is best served with steaming white rice.
instructions: In a cooking pot, heat the oil. Fry the eggplant for about a minute and a half per side. Remove from the pan and set aside after.
Using the remaining oil, sauté the garlic until it turns light brown. Add the onion and tomato, and sauté the ingredients until the onion softens.
Add pork and chili pepper to the cooking pot. Cook until the pork turns light brown.
Add the bagoong alamang and Knorr Shrimp cube. Cook for one minute.
Pour water and vinegar into the pot, and let it boil. Continue to cook afterward for 3 to 5 minutes.
Add the fried eggplant into the pot. Stir and cook for one and a half minutes.
Season with ground black pepper and sugar. Transfer to a serving bowl and enjoy!
categories: HOW TO COOK BINAGOONGANG BABOY WITH TALONG
HOW TO COOK BINAGOONGANG TALONG AT BABOY

name: Easy Ginataang Puso ng Saging Recipe
description:
Are you looking for an easy peasy side dish that’s packed with flavor? Why not make some ginataang puso ng saging? Puso ng saging or banana heart is a stellar meat alternative that should be on your radar when you’re in the mood for something healthy. 
               
               
               
              Our easy ginataang puso ng saging recipe utilizes Knorr Pork Cube to really bring out the dish’s flavor. It’s so easy to make that we won’t be surprised if it becomes your gata go-to dish.
tips: After slicing and salting the banana heart, keep it in a bowl of cold water until you use it to prevent discoloration.

ingredients.item: thai chili peppers, stemmed and minced

instructions: Peel and discard the banana heart’s fibrous skin layers until you reach the softer, lighter core.
Trim off the banana heart’s stem and discard. Cut it into half and slice thinly.
Place the shredded banana heart and rock salt in a large bowl. Let it stand for 10 to 15 minutes. Using your hands, squeeze it to release the bitter sap. Rinse well with cold water and drain.
Heat oil in a wide pan over medium heat. Add garlic and onions, and cook well until softened.
Add pork and Knorr Pork Cube into the pan. Stir occasionally until it turns light brown.
Add fish sauce and continue to cook for about a minute or two.
Add the banana heart. Cook and stir occasionally for about 3 to 5 minutes or until it releases liquid.
Add coconut milk and Thai chili peppers.
Lower heat, cover the pan and continue to cook for 15 minutes or until the vegetable is tender, the pork is cooked and the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot.

name: Quick Ginisang Sardinas with Talbos ng Sayote Recipe
description:
Who says you have to eat unhealthily when you’re on a tight budget? Ginisang Sardinas with Talbos ng Sayote is a budget-friendly and easy-to-prepare dish with a punch of flavor and is rich in nutrients. 
               
               
               
              Our Ginisang Sardinas with Talbos ng Sayote recipe uses Knorr Liquid Seasoning to give it an umami flavor. Simple yet flavorful, this talbos ng sayote recipe is a great go-to when you’re trying to save.
tips: You may season this dish with more fish sauce and pepper to suit your taste.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Sauté the garlic and onions until the onion becomes translucent.
Add the sardines and break it into chunky bits.
Add the water, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, and juice from the calamansi, and bring it to a boil.
Add the talbos ng sayote. Cover and let the dish simmer until the vegetable has wilted.
Stir and season with fish sauce, if needed. Serve with steaming hot rice.
categories: PAANO MAGLUTO NG TALBOS NG SAYOTE

name: Simple Pinoy Corn Dog Recipe
description:
Everyone knows that corn dogs are a distinctly American snack, but did you know that there’s such a thing as a Pinoy corn dog? Yes, you can add a Filipino twist to the corn dog batter. 
               
               
               
              Our list of Pinoy corn dog ingredients includes Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise to add more flavor to the Pinoy corn dog. Best enjoyed as a snack or baon, this is a simple recipe you wouldn’t want to miss.
tips: Don’t overcrowd the pan to maintain the oil temperature for better crispness.
instructions: Combine the dry ingredients, all-purpose flour, brown sugar, salt, and baking powder, in a mixing bowl.
Add the egg and evaporated milk. Combine by whisking together until the batter has reached the desired consistency.
Transfer the batter to a slim container. Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
While waiting, cut the hot dogs in half and cook them in a pan with some water. Let them cook on medium heat by rolling them occasionally until evenly cooked.
Remove from the heat and let it cool down once the water evaporates and the hot dogs are thoroughly cooked.
Skew each hotdog with a stick (or bamboo skewer), then dip the hotdog in the chilled batter and dredge into the breadcrumbs. Repeat the process until all hotdogs are coated.

Heat cooking oil in a deep pan or pot. Fry the coated hotdogs in batches over medium-high heat until they turn golden brown and crispy on the outside. Spin them regularly to ensure they’re evenly cooked.
Remove from the heat and place on a frying rack to drain the excess oil. A plate with paper towels can work also.
Spread some Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise on top and serve warm. Enjoy!

name: Adobong Puso ng Saging Recipe
description:
Every Pinoy household has its own special adobo recipe. While you’re probably familiar with adobong manok and/or baboy, did you know you can make some adobo with puso ng saging or banana heart? 
               
               
               
              Our adobong puso ng saging recipe utilizes Knorr Liquid Seasoning to make your dish tasty and sumptuous. This is a healthy dish that can make everyone’s hearts go boom boom!
tips: The key to making this dish is ensuring the banana heart is thoroughly cleaned.

ingredients.item: to taste freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Clean the banana heart thoroughly and remove the outer layer. Slice into wedges and boil until tender. This would take 30 minutes or less.
Dry the banana heart, and once it’s cool enough to handle, slice it into smaller pieces. Set aside.
Add oil in a wok and fry the pork pieces until they turn brown.
Add the shallots and stir fry for two minutes. Add the banana hearts and stir fry again for two minutes.
Add soy sauce, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, and vinegar. Let it simmer for 5 minutes on medium heat. Add a bit of water if it dries out.
Season with salt and pepper, then serve while it’s hot.
categories: HOW TO COOK ADOBONG PUSO NG SAGING
ADOBONG PUSO NG SAGING WITH SOTANGHON
ADOBONG PUSO NG SAGING WITH PORK

name: Fish Cake Recipe for Easter
description:
Happy Easter, everyone! And what better way to celebrate the end of Lent than a healthy yet delicious recipe? This Easter, you should consider preparing our fish cake recipe. 
               
               
               
              Our guide on how to cook fish cake uses Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise to add some creamy goodness to your dish. Not only is this fish cake packed with flavor, but it’s also good for your health. So why not give it a try?
tips: You can serve this dish with salad greens instead of hot rice to keep it healthy.

ingredients.item: avocado oil (or more as needed, divided)
to serve hot rice and butter

instructions: Gently mix together all the mango salsa ingredients in a small bowl. Cover and place in the refrigerator until ready to serve.
Preheat the oven to 450°. Place salmon, skin side down, on a rimmed baking sheet. Drizzle with 1 tbsp of avocado oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.
Bake the salmon in the oven for 10-15 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly. Flip the fillet over and scrape off the skin, then discard.
Place the skinned salmon in a large bowl and crumble it with your fingers. Add the remaining ingredients except the avocado oil. Mix well with your hands.
Form the ingredients into patties about 2 or 2 ½ inches across. This should form 12-14 patties. If the pattie doesn’t hold, add more mayonnaise.
Preheat a large cast iron skillet over medium heat. Add 2 tbsp of avocado oil and wait for it to get hot.
Fry half of the patties until deep golden on each side and cooked through, above 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove to a paper towel-lined plate. Add more oil, if necessary, and fry the remaining patties.
Serve immediately with mango salsa and hot rice.

name: Easy Beef Biryani Recipe
description:
And so it’s Eid al-Fitr! There’s nothing like celebrating this Muslim holiday by serving an intensely flavorful Pakistani staple — beef biryani! You don’t need to fly to Pakistan to enjoy this beef biryani recipe. All the ingredients can be found in your local supermarket. 
               
               
               
              Our beef biryani ingredients include Knorr Beef Cube to maximize its beefy goodness. Your family and friends will surely keep coming back for more of this Pakistani classic.
tips: There are pre-made Biryani spice mixes in Indian restaurants.

ingredients.item: white onions, fried until crispy, oil reserved

instructions: Make the spice mix in a large bowl: ground ginger, garlic powder, turmeric, chili powder, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, ground nutmeg, and ground star anise.
Crush the fried onions, and add it together with yogurt, mint, cilantro, and green chili to the mix —season with salt to taste.
Add the beef and Knorr Beef Cube, and mix thoroughly. Let it stand overnight.
Transfer the marinated beef to a stockpot and add enough water to cover the meat. Bring to a boil, then simmer until tender, adding more water as needed.
Meanwhile, heat the oil flavored from the fried onions in a large sauté pan. Add the rice and stir-fry.
Add the milk colored by the kasubha to the rice. Season to taste.
Transfer to a plate and top with beef and its sauce. Enjoy!

name: 25-Minute Tausug Beef Kulma Recipe
description:
Want to commemorate Eid al-Fitr by honoring Mindanaoan households? You should give our quick Tausug Beef Kulma recipe a try. Beef Kulma usually takes over 2 hours to make, but we have a 25-minute hack that packs a lot of flavor. 
               
               
               
              Beef Kulma is essentially a crossover between kare-kare and traditional curry, and our Beef Kulma recipe uses Knorr Beef Cube to bring out the dish’s flavors even more. This is so easy to make it might become a staple in your household.
tips: Feel free to garnish this dish with cilantro (wansoy) before serving.

ingredients.item: beef sirloin, cut into small pieces

instructions: Season beef with salt and pepper. In a large pan, heat oil over high heat. Once it’s hot, sear the beef until browned on one side, about 1 ½ minutes, and set aside.
Add oil to the same pan over medium heat. Add half the green and red chilies and lemongrass. Cook, stirring frequently, until they soften.
Add the curry powder, instant kare-kare mix, Knorr Beef Cube, peanut butter, and tomato paste. Cook until toasted.
Add the beef stock, stir, and cook until the kare-kare mix is dissolved and the peanut butter and tomato paste are well incorporated.
Once boiling, reduce heat to low and bring the mixture to a simmer. Cook until thickened, which is about 10 minutes.
Add cooked beef and coconut milk, saving some milk for garnish, if desired, to the sauce. Garnish with the remaining chilies and serve.

name: Easy Peasy Tamagoyaki (Japanese Rolled Omelette) Recipe
description:
If you’ve been in a Japanese omelette craze lately, you’ve come to the right place. This recipe teaches you how to make tamagoyaki in a few easy steps using only pantry staples. Tamagoyaki literally means grilled or fried egg and is made by rolling together thin layers of egg in a tamagoyaki pan. A tamagoyaki pan is a non-stick rectangular shaped pan that makes cooking this delicious Japanese dish easier. Don’t fret if you don’t have one though, you can easily make this dish using a regular round pan with our step by step instructions. It won’t have the perfect shape that tamagoyaki is known for but it’ll taste the same. 
               
               
               
              This tamagoyaki recipe forgoes the specialty ingredients and focuses on keeping it simple while you learn the technique. Instead of dashi, we use Knorr Chicken Cube dissolved in water for an umami-rich taste minus a trip to the Japanese supermarket. Try this recipe today and watch it become a weekly staple in your household.
tips: It’s easy to make this dish in a round pan but this tamagoyaki recipe calls for a smaller sized one. If your pan is 12 inches or larger, double the recipe for best results.

ingredients.item: to taste Knorr Liquid Seasoning Original

instructions: Dissolve Knorr Chicken Cube in warm water and set aside.
Beat the eggs in a large bowl, making sure not to overbeat. Set aside.
In a smaller bowl, combine 2 tablespoons of the dissolved Knorr Chicken Cube with sugar, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and salt.
Gently incorporate the seasoning mixture into the eggs by whisking lightly.
Transfer the egg mixture into a spouted measuring cup or pitcher to make it easier to pour slowly into the pan. Set aside.
Heat the frying pan over medium heat.
Fold a paper towel into a small square and dip it in the oil. It’s best if you use chopsticks or a small tong when doing this.
Next, apply a thin layer of oil to the pan using the paper towel dipped in oil.
Pour a thin layer of the egg mixture into the pan, tilting in all directions to cover the pan fully.
Once the bottom of the egg has set and the top is still soft, roll the egg into a log from one end of the pan to another. Use chopsticks or a spatula to gently do this.
Move the rolled egg onto one side of the pan and coat the other parts of the pain in oil once again.
Pour another thin layer of egg onto the pan, repeating the same tilting process as before. Make sure to lift the rolled omelet off the pan to get the egg mixture underneath it.
Once the bottom of the egg has set and the top is still soft, start rolling the previously rolled egg onto the other side to form an even bigger log.
Repeat this process until the egg mixture is used up.
You can already serve this tamagoyaki but if you want that iconic shape, use a bamboo sushi mat to roll it into your desired shape while warm. Let it stand for a little over 5 minutes before slicing.
Slice the tamagoyaki into circles that are around 1 inch thick. Place on a serving dish and serve with Knorr Liquid Seasoning on the side.
If storing for later use, place in an airtight container and freeze for up to two weeks. Defrost in the refrigerator overnight or for a few minutes in a microwave when ready to eat.

name: Must-Try Enoki Mushroom Recipe With Ginger Scallion Sauce
description:
Enoki mushrooms are typically served as appetizers wrapped in bacon or as welcome additions in warm bowls of soup. These dainty mushrooms usually take a backseat to other ingredients but in this recipe, we’re giving enoki mushrooms the center stage. These delicious mushrooms, flavored with a simple ginger scallion sauce, create the perfect dish that gives main character energy to enoki mushrooms. 
               
               
               
              This dish comes together in only 20 minutes and is perfect for busy weeknights where you’re looking to indulge in something delicious but don’t really have the time for it.
tips: Be gentle when handling enoki mushrooms. They can easily fall apart or get mushed.
instructions: Cut off around 1 inch of the enoki mushroom root.
Using your fingers, gently separate the enoki mushroom into bite-sized pieces. Gently rinse under cold water and drain.
Prepare to blanch the mushrooms by bringing water inside a pot to a boil.
Prepare ice cold water in a separate bowl.
Blanch the enoki mushrooms in the boiling water for 1 minute. Strain the mushrooms and place in the ice bath for a few seconds. Drain out the water and place in a shallow serving bowl. Set aside.
Prepare the sauce by heating up the neutral oil and sautéing the scallion and ginger for 2-3 minutes or until fragrant.
Add the sesame oil and crumbled Knorr Chicken Cube.
Take off the heat and pour on top of the enoki mushroom.
Serve and enjoy this lightly seasoned enoki mushroom.
categories: WHAT TO COOK WITH ENOKI MUSHROOMS

name: Fire Up The Grill and Finally Learn How To Cook Baby Back Ribs
description: Contrary to popular belief, you do not need an oven to make baby back ribs. This easy-to-follow recipe teaches you how to cook baby back ribs on the grill and how to make an easy, yet flavorful, baby back ribs marinade that’ll take your cooking to the next level. These ribs are marinated overnight in a delicious combination of pantry staples including Knorr Chicken Cubes and Knorr Liquid Seasoning for flavors that penetrate all the way to the bone. Try this next time you’re looking to change up your menu for something special and delicious.
tips: If you’re in a time crunch, you can opt to marinate for 4 hours but the best flavors come from an overnight marination.

ingredients.item: Knorr Chicken Cube, dissolved in 1 liter of water

instructions: Prepare the ribs by removing the thin membrane from it. Discard.
Combine ¾ cup dissolved Knorr Chicken Broth with the rest of the baby back ribs marinade ingredients. Set aside remaining chicken broth for use in other recipes.
Place baby back ribs in a shallow baking dish and pour around ⅔ of the marinade on top. Coat the ribs well. Cover and let it marinate overnight, making sure to flip the ribs occasionally,
Drain ribs and discard marinade.
Combine the baby back ribs rub ingredients in a shallow bowl. Rub this mixture all over the ribs.
Prepare the grill by oiling the rack and heating up the coals.
Grill the ribs for around 30 minutes on each side. If you have a grill cover, cover the ribs while cooking. Baste the ribs with the leftover marinade as you cook.
Continue cooking until the ribs are tender.
Serve with your favorite sides and enjoy!
categories: HOW TO COOK BABY BACK RIBS
HOW TO COOK BABY BACK RIBS WITHOUT OVEN

name: Skip Taco Tuesday, Make This Ground Beef Quesadilla Instead
description: Skip your favorite tacos and try something new for dinner by making this flavorful ground beef & cheese quesadilla. This recipe uses only a handful of ingredients and can go from pan to plate in 30 minutes or less. While Mexican food is usually rich in flavor, this beef & cheese quesadilla recipe takes it to the next level with one simple yet game changing ingredient – Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise. A thin smear of this creamy & tangy mayo elevates the flavors of the ground beef resulting in an irresistible dish that usually serves four people but might just end up serving two. If you love flavorful food that’s oozing with cheese, we suggest doubling or tripling this recipe. We won’t be surprised if taco Tuesday becomes a thing of the past and gets replaced with beef and quesadilla weekdays instead.
tips: To make this beef & cheese quesadilla even tastier, prepare a guacamole dip and serve it alongside this dish.
instructions: Heat up oil in a pan over medium high heat.
Sauté onions and garlic until fragrant and translucent. This will take about 3-4 minutes.
Add the diced red bell pepper and continue to sauté for 1-2 minutes.
Add the ground beef and let it cook until lightly browned.
Add taco seasoning and ½ Knorr Beef Cube into the pan. Mix until the beef cube is dissolved.
Add in salsa and mix well.
Once the beef mixture is cooked, set aside.
Heat another pan over medium high heat and make sure this pan can fit whatever size of tortilla you’ll be using.
Prepare to cook the quesadilla by setting all your beef & cheese quesadilla components in place – cheese, ground beef mixture, tortilla, serving dish.
Place the tortilla on the pan and smear a thin layer of Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise on top.
Next, sprinkle it with cheese, add a few tablespoons of the ground beef mixture, and then sprinkle it with more cheese. Finish it off by adding another tortilla on top.
Let the tortilla cook for a bit and once the bottom is browned and the cheese is starting to melt, carefully flip the tortilla to heat up the other side.
Repeat the same process with the rest of the ground beef mixture until there’s none left.
Serve warm and sliced into triangles.
categories: HOW TO MAKE A CHEESE QUESADILLA
EASY BEEF AND CHEESE QUESADILLA RECIPE

name: Stay Energized During Ramadan with This Chicken Tocino Recipe
description: This easy and flavorful chicken Tocino recipe will have you feeling satisfied and energized in only 30 minutes. Made with the simplest ingredients and minimal prep time, this chicken Tocino is perfect for ramadan. There’s no need to slave away in the kitchen to make a delicious dish that everyone in the family will surely enjoy. Serve with rice and a side of vegetables and you have yourself a complete meal that’s perfect for starting the day or breaking the fast at the end of the day. We won’t be surprised if this chicken Tocino recipe becomes a staple in your weekly meal plans even after ramadan is over.

ingredients.item: few drops red food colouring, optional

instructions: Slice the chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces and set aside.
In a shallow container, mix all the chicken Tocino marinade ingredients together.

Add the chicken thighs into the marinade and coat well. Cover and let it marinate overnight. If you’re pressed for time, you can marinate the Tocino for at least 1 hour but it’s best to let it sit longer for the flavors to penetrate the chicken.
When ready to cook, take the marinated chicken out of the refrigerator and bring to room temperature.
Place the chicken pieces in a pan and add 1 cup of water. Bring the water to a simmer and let it simmer for 15 minutes uncovered or until most of the liquid has evaporated.
Add the oil and cook the chicken Tocino until the liquid in the pan is thick and syrupy while the chicken should be slightly charred.
Serve immediately with rice, a side of vegetables, and egg for a filling meal that’ll energize you throughout the day.

name: This Easter Egg Salad Recipe Is Perfect for Little Helpers
description:
Don’t throw away your beautifully decorated Easter eggs! Make them into egg salad instead. This egg salad recipe is so easy that even the youngest ones can help make them. Think of this as the perfect activity to transition kids into after all the Easter festivities. After all, what kid doesn’t like helping out in the kitchen? Plus, they get to learn life skills too! Let the kids peel, mash, mix, and season the egg salad and watch as this egg salad recipe becomes their new favorite snack to make and eat. A win-win especially for parents looking to add more delicious whole foods in their kids meals. 
               
               
               
              Eat this egg salad on its own, on a salad, in a sandwich, or as a wrap with your choice of toppings. This versatile recipe is great for anytime of the day.
tips: If you’re adding this egg salad recipe to an avocado toast, make sure to brown the toast well to prevent the bread from getting soggy.
instructions: Peel off the shell from the leftover easter eggs and place eggs in a large bowl.

Chop or mash the eggs to your desired chunkiness. If doing this activity with kids, it would be easier to let them mash the eggs themselves in their own smaller bowls. Just make sure to slice the egg lengthwise so they have an easier time handling the eggs.
Add the chopped/mashed eggs to one large bowl along with the rest of the egg salad ingredients. Mix well.
Taste and season according to your preference.
Serve the egg salad on its own, with a side of lettuce, on top of sliced breast, or in a wrap. The possibilities are endless.

name: Celebrate Eid al-Fitr with This Beef Biryani Recipe
description:
If you’ve been wanting to make beef biryani but are intimidated by it, don’t be! In simplest terms, beef biryani is a delicious beef curry that’s layered with fragrant basmati rice. While made with a few specialty ingredients and numerous steps, this beef biryani hack is easier to make than the ones cooked in traditional vessels. Plus, all your effort will be rewarded by a rich and fragrant dish that’s perfect for celebrating Eid with your family. 
               
               
               
              Intensely flavored with a fragrant mix of spices, this beef biryani recipe adds another layer of flavor by incorporating Knorr Beef Cubes into the mix. Knorr Beef Cubes add meaty flavors that are equivalent to 1 kilo of beef so it’s a great way to make dishes like beef biryani even more flavorful without adding more meat.
tips: The key to delicious biryani is melt- in-your mouth beef. Simmer the beef for as long as possible and if you find the pot drying up as you simmer, feel free to add a bit of water into the mix. You can also use a pressure cooker to tenderize the meat.

ingredients.item: Knorr Beef Cube dissolved in 3 cups of water

instructions: Slice the onion in half. Slice half of the onion into thin slices and set aside.

Cut the other half of the onion into quarters. Add this into a food processor along with the garlic, ginger, and cilantro. Add a tablespoon of water and puree until smooth. You can also do this with a mortar and pestle to create a paste.

Add ½ tbsp of butter and ½ tbsp of oil into an ovenproof pot. Add the sliced onions set aside earlier and under low heat, caramelize for 15 minutes. Mix occasionally to prevent the onions from sticking to the bottom of the pan.
Add the almonds and raisins into the pan and sauté until softened, around 3-4 minutes. Take the mixture out of the pan and set aside.
Using the same pan, add the remaining butter and oil over medium high heat.

Add the beef cubes into the pan and brown them on all sides. This should take about 6-8 minutes. You can do this in batches for a more even browning. Once all pieces have been browned, set aside on a plate.
Onto the same pot, add cumin, coriander, fenugreek, and turmeric. Mix and let it cook for about 30 seconds.
Add the pureed mixture in the pot and stir until fragrant. This should take about 2-3 minutes.
Add the yogurt and water into the pot and mix until smooth.
Add the browned beef cubes into the pot and let it simmer with the mixture for an hour. This helps tenderize the meat.
While the beef is tenderizing, prepare the basmati rice.
Wash and rinse the rice until the water turns clear. This prevents the rice from becoming too sticky.

Heat beef stock made from Knorr Beef Cubes in a small pot and bring to a low simmer. Add the washed rice and simmer for 5-10 minutes. This step partially cooks the rice while adding a rich layer of flavor to the beef biryani.
Drain the liquid from the rice and set aside.

Once the beef is done simmering, take it off the heat and spoon the par cooked rice on top. Make a small well in the center of the rice and finish it off by sprinkling the caramelized onions, almonds, and raisins on top.
Cover the pot tightly with two layers of foil and cover with a tight lid.
Bake the beef biryani in a preheated oven at 180 C for about 30-40 minutes.
Serve warm and enjoy!

name: Make Flavorful Beef Kulma From Scratch to Celebrate Eid al Fitr
description:
It’s time to put the spotlight on Mindanaoan cuisine. With flavorful dishes that are unique to the region, it’s surprising why we don’t see more of this cuisine on our party tables. Beef Kulma is a Tausug recipe that’s usually made for special occasions. It’s a type of beef curry that strongly resembles internationally known beef korma and is made by simmering tender beef in curry spices, coconut milk, peanut butter, and tomato sauce. 
               
               
               
              For those celebrating Eid al Fitr, this is the perfect dish to serve to your friends and family.
tips: Pounding the lemongrass releases its flavors and aroma.

ingredients.item: beef for stewing (chuck or short rib)

instructions: In a large shallow dish, mix curry powder, paprika, cinnamon, and calamansi juice.
Add the beef pieces into the bowl and mix until covered with the marinade. Let sit for 30 minutes for the flavors to penetrate the beef.
In a large pot, heat oil over medium heat. Searthe beef pieces in batches until browned on all sides. Take the beef out of the pot and set aside.
WIth the oil still in the pot, sauté garlic and onions until the garlic turns golden brown and the onions are somewhat translucent.
Add the beef back into the pot along with coconut milk, Knorr Beef Cube, water, and bay leaves. Bring to a boil and then lower heat to a simmer. Let it simmer for an hour.
Add the peanut butter, tomato paste, and bird’s eye chili into the pot. Mix well and let it simmer for another 45 minutes.
Finish off with coconut cream and let simmer for another 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Sere warm and enjoy this flavorful bowl of beef kulma

name: Souper Lucky Knorr Dragon Soup for Chinese New Year
description: Be #SouperSwerteSaKnorr in 2024. Enjoy the delicious and souper lucky Knorr Dragon Soup using Knorr Chinese Style Soups. Enjoy every spoonful of Knorr's Crab & Corn Soup or Chicken & Corn Soup or Nido Oriental Soup. These are made with lucky REAL ingredients and are easy to prepare for your Chinese New Year Feast!

ingredients.item: Knorr Nido Soup or Knorr Crab & Corn or Knorr Chicken & Corn Soup
tomato catsup or fresh ripe tomatoes

instructions: Pour content into a saucepan with 800ml (4 tazos) water. Mix well.
Bring to boil while stirring continuously.
Partially cover and simmer for 5 minutes with occasional stirring.
Add one beaten fresh egg and stir gently with fork until egg is dispersed.
To transform it into a Lucky Dragon soup, add tomato catsup or fresh ripe tomatoes, tsp chili powder, and soy sauce! Enjoy!

name: 20-Minute Viral One-Pot Lasagna Soup Recipe
description:
Who doesn’t love whipping up one pot meal recipes? If you’re on the hunt for ridiculously easy Italian soup recipes, you’ve come to the right place. This 20-minute one-pot lasagna soup recipe went viral on TikTok in 2023. It’s a quick fix for busy nights or when you’re in the mood for some Italian goodness. 
               
               
               
              This easy Italian chicken soup recipe features Knorr Beef Cube to add additional beefy flavor to this savory comfort food. This lasagna soup is perfect for cool evenings or cozy bonding moments with your loved ones.
tips: Enjoy this dish with a slice of bread like a classic Italian pasta dish.
instructions: Saute the onion and garlic in olive oil until it becomes fragrant. Add the ground beef and Italian sausage. Sprinkle the Italian seasoning, salt and pepper.
Once the meat is browned, add the water, Knorr Beef cube, tomato paste, marinara sauce, and heavy cream. Let the mixture come to a boil.
Once the pot is boiling, break up the lasagna noodles into smaller pieces, and add them to the pot. Once the pasta is cooked, add the cheese and basil.
Stir everything until the cheese melts, and enjoy!

name: 5-Minute Viral Avocado Toast With Egg Recipe
description:
Avocado toast has become a popular mainstay in everyone’s breakfast/brunch options. Why? Because it’s totally good for you! High in nutritional benefits, it’s no wonder why celebrities love this dish, but did you know you can prepare a simple avocado toast with egg in five minutes? 
               
               
               
              Inspired by the TikTok viral recipe, our 5-minute avocado and egg toast is made with everyone’s favorite Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise for some creamy goodness. We won’t blame you if this recipe becomes a mainstay in your go-to breakfast options.
tips: You can spice up this avocado toast with egg recipe with some hot sauce or add some sweetness with honey.

ingredients.item: hard boiled eggs, cooled and peeled

instructions: Boil the eggs and then add them to an ice water bath to cool completely. Once cool, peel them and set aside.
Put a little bit of Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise in each slice of bread.
In a hot pan, place the bread slices with the mayo side down and allow them to crisp up.
Once nice and sizzled, remove the bread slices from the heat.
In a separate bowl, mix the avocado, a touch of salt, and lemon juice.
Spread the avocado mash onto the toast and gently grate the eggs on top.
Add some pepper to taste and enjoy.
categories: AVOCADO TOAST WITH EGG AND TOMATO

name: Easy Viral Shrimp Fried Rice Recipe
description:
Craving for that easy shrimp fried rice recipe that went viral? It’s no coincidence you’ve found one of our shrimp and rice recipes because this guide is for you! You don’t need to order takeout or eat out for shrimp dishes with rice by following this simple guide. 
               
               
               
              Our guide on how to make Chinese shrimp fried rice uses Knorr Liquid Seasoning for a dash of umami flavor. All you need is 30 minutes, and you’re ready to go!
tips: If you have time to spare, marinate the shrimp for at least 10 minutes. Combine it with salt, pepper, and some Knorr Liquid Seasoning.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil on a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the shrimp and cook for around 4 minutes or until they turn orange.
Flip the shrimp over and cook for a few more minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Crack two eggs into a small bowl and beat them together. Beat the last egg in a separate bowl.
Heat a large saute pan or a walk with half a tablespoon of the vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, add the two beaten eggs and scramble them for around 30 seconds until they’re fluffy and no longer runny.
Transfer the eggs to a dish and turn off the heat. Wipe off the pan or wok with a damp kitchen towel.
Drizzle the remaining one and a half tablespoons of oil in the pan or wok over medium-high heat. Add the ginger, and cook for another minute.
Add the mixed vegetables, scallions, and salt and cook for another two minutes.
Add the cooked rice into the pan or wok and cook for a few minutes until the rice is heated. If there are large clumps of rice, break them apart with the back of your spatula.
Pour the single beaten egg over the rice and stir to coat the rice with the egg. Cook for another minute.
Add the Knorr Liquid Seasoning and sesame oil, and stir.
Add the cooked shrimp and egg to the pan and stir again. Turn off the heat.
Serve immediately.
categories: HOW TO MAKE CHINESE SHRIMP FRIED RICE
CHINESE FRIED RICE RECIPE WITH SHRIMP
BETTER THAN TAKEOUT SHRIMP FRIED RICE

name: Viral Spicy Rigatoni Pasta Recipe
description:
Looking for a new pasta dish to try? Well, this viral spicy rigatoni pasta recipe aka Pasta Alla Vodka pasta might just be what you’re looking for. Simple yet packed with flavor, this supermodel-approved Vodka pasta recipe is very easy to prepare. 
               
               
               
              Our take on this rigatoni pasta recipe uses Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise to give the Italian vodka pasta some creamy flavor. It’s definitely one of the rigatoni pasta recipes you wouldn’t want to miss.
tips: You can skip the vodka if you want this recipe to be kid-friendly.
instructions: Boil the pasta. Add the olive oil and saute the onions in a large pot.
Once the onions start to burn down, add the minced garlic.
Mix in the tomato paste and stir until well incorporated. Stir in the pepper flakes.
Deglaze the pan with the 3 ounces of vodka and mix well.
Once the vodka has reduced, add ¼ cup of pasta water to 1 cup of heavy cream, and add to the pot. Add in the Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise and mix well until incorporated.
Add the drained pasta to the sauce and mix well.
Top with fresh minced basil leaves and season with salt and pepper to taste.
categories: RIGATONI PASTA RECIPES WITH RICOTTA CHEESE

name: Spoil Your Parents with A Quick & Easy Creamy Chicken Piccata
description: This impressive and indulgent chicken piccata takes only 35 minutes to make with only a handful of ingredients, perfect for busy bees looking to spoil their parents!
tips: If you don’t have a meat mallet, use a sturdy rolling pin instead to pound your chicken.

ingredients.item: pasta, cooked according to package directions, saving ¼-½ cup of pasta water
Knorr Chicken cube, dissolved in 1 cup water
pasta, cooked according to package directions, saving ¼-½ cup of pasta water

instructions: Doing this one piece at a time, cover the chicken breast in cling wrap and use a kitchen mallet to flatten the chicken to about ¼ inch in thickness. This step ensures that the chicken picatta will cook evenly. Set aside the chicken breasts once done.
In a large bowl, add Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, the egg, minced garlic, 1 ½ tbsp flour, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Add the chicken breasts into the bowl and mix, making sure that all the chicken pieces are coated. Set aside.
In a separate bowl, mix together grated parmesan cheese, 1 cup flour, salt, and pepper. Lightly dredge the coated chicken breasts in this mixture and tap any excess off. Set aside.
Heat up oil and butter in a medium sized frying pan.
Once oil is hot, add in the chicken breasts and fry for about 3-4 minutes per side or until the chicken is cooked. Make sure to not overcrowd the pan by cooking in batches.
Once all the chicken is cooked, set aside and drain the oil from the frying pan. You will use the same pan to make the chicken picatta sauce.
Add the ingredients of the chicken picatta sauce into the pan.
Mix and let the mixture come to a boil. Bring down the heat to a simmer and let the mixture simmer for 3-4 minutes.
Taste and season with salt and pepper according to taste.
Scoop about ¼ cup of sauce and set aside.
In the same pan, add in your cooked pasta and mix in with the sauce. Add in ¼ to ½ cup of pasta water into the mix for a silky sauce.
Place the pasta on a serving platter and add the crispy chicken on top.
Finish the dish off by drizzling the chicken piccata sauce on top.

name: Try Tiyula Itum, A Filipino Beef Soup Made With Burnt Coconut
description:
Have you ever cooked with burnt coconut meat? If not, today is the day to start cooking with this delicious ingredient. Burnt coconut meat is commonly used in Southern Philippines to add a distinct flavor to traditional dishes like in Tausug cuisine’s iconic dish – Tiyula Itum. Burning coconut seems intimidating but we have a simple way you can do it in the comforts of your own kitchen. No special equipment needed! 
               
               
               
              Tiyula Itum is a black soup that’s usually made with either beef or goat meat. It’s served during special occasions such as weddings or birthdays. It’s a unique dish that takes a bit of effort to make but is well worth it. You’ll be rewarded with diverse flavors that meld together into a rich and delicious soup that’ll surely make you want to explore more of Philippine’s Southern cuisine. This recipe uses Knorr Beef Cubes to add an even meatier taste to this dish! 
               
               
               
              Make this to celebrate a special occasion like Eid al-Adha or make this anytime and enjoy the flavors of Tiyula Itum.
tips: You can make two kinds of burnt coconut meat. A deep black one for color and a milder black-brown for flavor. This ensures you get that iconic dark color of Tiyula Itum with a milder taste.

ingredients.item: fresh turmeric, ½ thumb-sized, sliced thinly
Knorr Beef Cubes, dissolved in 4 cups of water

instructions: In a pan over high heat, toast the coconut meat. Stir it frequently until it reaches a dark brown-black color. Avoid burning it too much and turning the meat pitch black as this will have a carbonized taste to it.
Let the burnt coconut meat cool and grind into a powder using a food processor or high speed blender. Set aside.
Season beef brisket with salt and pepper.
Heat a pot over medium heat and add oil. Sear the beef brisket on all sides making sure to do this step in batches to get a nice brown color on the meat. Set the meat aside.
In the same pot, sauté onion, garlic, ginger, turmeric, siling labuyo, and the burnt coconut meat previously set aside. Sauté for about 2-3 minutes or until fragrant,
Add the beef, lemongrass, and dissolved Knorr Beef Cubes into the pot.
Bring the mixture into a boil and lower down to a simmer. Let the Tiyula Itum simmer for 1 hour 30 minutes or longer, depending on how tender the beef is.
Remember that Tiyula Itum is a beef soup so don’t let the water reduce too much. Add water as you see fit.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve warm and enjoy this delicious Tausug black beef soup!

name: This Carne Asada Fries Recipe Will Make You Swear Off Nachos
description:
This recipe teaches you how to make the best loaded fries from scratch topped with a juicy yet fuss-free carne asada. While this recipe requires quite a number of steps, it’s well worth the effort especially for celebrating the man of the house on Father’s Day. Plus, we’ve included a few tricks up our sleeve to make marinating your carne asada easier with only 2 simple yet flavorful ingredients! We also use Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise to top off this indulgent Carne Asada Fries for that creamy finish. It’s a flavorful dish that will definitely knock dad’s socks off! 
               
               
               
              What are you waiting for? Let’s get cooking!
tips: Guacamole can brown quite easily if prepared earlier. Store leftover or prepared guacamole with parchment paper or cling wrap against the surface to prevent oxidation.

ingredients.item: large potatoes, sliced into fry strips

instructions: In a small bowl, mash Knorr Beef Cube with olive oil until it forms a paste.
Rub this paste all over the flank steak and marinate for at least 4 hours inside the fridge. For best flavor, marinate overnight.
When ready to cook, fire up the grill and cook the carne asada for 6-10 minutes on each side. You can also use a cast iron pan over the stovetop for this step.
Let the steak rest for 5-10 minutes and then slice into bite-sized pieces. Set aside.
Preheat oven to 230°C
In a large bowl, toss the sliced potatoes with oil, salt, paprika, and garlic powder, if using.
Place fries in a baking sheet and bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden and crispy, flipping the fries halfway through. Make sure to leave ample space in between the fries to ensure they crisp up.
Take out fries from the oven and place bite-sized carne asada on top.
Finish off with the mozzarella and cheddar evenly on top. Place back in the oven and using the broil function, broil for 2-3 minutes or until the cheese has melted.
In a bowl, mash avocado with a fork. Mash it well for a creamy consistency with a few chunks left.
Add the juice of the calamansi, garlic, and onion into the bowl. Mix well. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Add dollops of the guacamole on top of the carne asada fries.
Sprinkle the chopped tomatoes on top of the bed of fries.
Finish off your carne asada by adding dollops of Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise on top for a creamy and tangy finish.
Serve warm and let dad enjoy his special treat!
categories: HOW TO MAKE CARNE ASADA FRIES

name: Cozy Up On Cold Rainy Nights With This Hototay Soup Recipe
description: Hototay soup is a Chinese-Filipino soup that’s hearty, comforting, and oh so good for your body. Chock-full of vegetables and a variety of meat, this simple soup is thickened using eggs. While regular hototay soup recipes are already flavorful, this recipe takes it to the next level by using Knorr Chicken Cubes. One chicken cube adds flavor equivalent to 1 kilogram of meat so you can expect a good balance of flavors in one bowl. While hototay soup ingredients can seem a bit overwhelming, don’t fret! It’s a simple dish to make that takes less than an hour to come together.
tips: Add sesame oil into your hototay soup for an extra dose of nuttiness and flavor.

ingredients.item: Knorr Chicken Cube, dissolved in 6 cups water

instructions: In a large stock pot, add oil and brown all the pork and chicken pieces on all sides. Make sure to do this in batches to avoid overcrowding the pot. Once done, add all the meat pieces back into the pot.
Add the chicken broth made from Knorr Chicken Cube into the pot. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to a simmer.
Simmer for 20-30 minutes or until the chicken is tender.
Take out the meat and separate the chicken. Proceed to flake the chicken using a fork.
Take out broth and run it through a fine mesh sieve to remove impurities from the broth.
In the same pot, add 1 tbsp of oil and sauté garlic and onions.
Add into the pot the meat and the broth. Bring to a boil and then lower heat to a simmer.
Add carrots, cabbage, and shiitake mushrooms into the pot. Let simmer for 3-4 minutes.
Add the chicharo and let it simmer for 2 more minutes.
Take off the heat and add an egg into the pot. Mix well and serve warm.
Add some cilantro for garnish, if using.

name: Easy Japanese Okonomiyaki Recipe
description:
Looking a quick dinner idea that’s anything but boring? You should give our easy Japanese okonomiyaki recipe a try. You might be wondering, what is okonomiyaki? It’s a popular pan-fried dish made of cabbage and batter. Super simple to prepare, it can elevate any weeknight with its yummy flavors. 
               
               
               
              Our list of okonomiyaki ingredients uses Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise to add some creamy goodness to the dish. Ready in a flash, this is a healthy and delicious dish you can customize to your personal taste.
tips: Make sure you shred the cabbage finely. If the cabbage is too chunky, the okonomiyaki won’t hold together.

ingredients.item: for brushing extra virgin olive oil

instructions: Combine the cabbage, scallions, panko, and salt in a large bowl. Gently mix in the eggs.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Brush the skillet with olive oil, and use a ¼ measuring cup to scoop the cabbage mixture into the skillet.
Gently flatten the mixture with a spatula so it’ss about ½ inch thick. Cook three minutes per side or until browned, turning the heat low as needed.
Repeat with the remaining mixture, wiping out the skillet and brushing more oil as needed.
Drizzle the mixture with the okonomiyaki sauce and thin strips of squeezed Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise.
Top with sesame seeds, pickled ginger and nori. Serve hot.

name: 15-Minute Tuna Carbonara Recipe with Mushroom
description:
In the mood for some pasta? Keep it light and simple with our ridiculously easy 15-minute tuna carbonara with mushroom recipe. Our tuna carbonara recipe is perfect for busy nights when you want to eat something filling without breaking the bank. 
               
               
               
              Most of our tuna carbonara ingredients are probably in your pantry already! Made with Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup mix, our guide on how to cook tuna carbonara will surely be a hit in your household.
tips: You can add other types of cheese if you’re in the mood for a cheese pasta meal.
instructions: Heat the cooking oil and butter in pan. Saute onion and garlic. Add bell peppers, mushrooms, and tuna. Season to taste.
In a separate bowl, mix the ½ cup of water with one pack of Knorr Cream of Mushroom soup. Add the mixture to the pan and bring to a boil.
Once it boils, lower it down to a simmer. Add the cream.
Add the lemon zest and season with salt, pepper, and Knorr Liquid Seasoning.
