Plate the noodles and top with the cooked sauce. Sprinkle cheese and garnish with lemon wedges.
Top with sesame seeds, pickled ginger and nori. Serve hot.

name: Easy Chinese Chicken Feet Recipe
description:
Do you love ordering chicken feet at Chinese restaurants? It might not be for everyone, but for fans, it’s a delectable Chinese dish you crave. Why go out when you prepare Chinese chicken feet in the comforts of your home? 
               
               
               
              Our easy Chinese feet dim sum recipe features Knorr Liquid Seasoning to give the dish an umami kick. It’s a great main dish or finger food during gatherings with friends and family.
tips: Add a can of beer to the sauce to make the chicken feet more flavorful.
instructions: Cut off all the nails from the chicken feet and scrub the chicken clean with water.
Add ginger, green onion, Chinese cooking wine, and water in a pot. The chicken should be fully covered in water. Bring it to a simmer, and let it cook for 3 minutes.
Once the grime comes out, drain and rinse clean.
Season the chicken with soy sauce, oyster sauce, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, garlic, green onion, Sichuan peppercorn, star anise, sugar, and 4 cups of water.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and let it cook for an hour.
After 1 hour, the chicken should be ready to eat, rest it in the fridge for 1 to 2 hours or enjoy it immediately.
categories: CHINESE CHICKEN FEET DIM SUM RECIPE

name: 15-Minute Saucy Sizzling Hotdog Recipe
description:
There’s nothing like enjoying quick and easy hotdog as ulam or merienda. While you can have this as a sandwich or with rice, why not take it to the next level by preparing a saucy, sizzling hotdog dish? 
               
               
               
              Our sizzling hotdog recipe uses Knorr Liquid Seasoning for some umami goodness. This works well as a snack, main dish, or finger food. It’s an easy dish you can serve when you have small gatherings at your place.
tips: Saute the onions and bell peppers briefly so they stay brightly colored and crisp.
instructions: Mix the Knorr Liquid Seasoning, banana ketchup, and hot sauce in a bowl. Set aside.
Saute the hotdog in oil in a pan for 1 minute. Add onion and bell pepper, and saute for another 2 minutes.
Pour the sauce mixture, mix the hotdog, then add margarine.
Pour the hotdog into a sizzling plate and garnish with siling haba.
categories: SIZZLING HOTDOG RECIPE WITH OYSTER SAUCE
SIZZLING HOTDOG RECIPE HOW TO COOK

name: Skip the Meat and Make Heart-Healthy Adobong Isda Instead
description: Adobong Isda is a variation of the more popular chicken and pork adobo. There are a variety of ways to make this dish but this recipe is our favorite way to cook it – with Knorr Liquid Seasoning for a rich umami taste. It’s an easy dish to make in only 30 minutes plus it’s heart healthy too!
tips: Don’t cover the adobo with a lid when boiling. Letting it boil reduces the metallic taste of the white vinegar.
instructions: In a large heavy-bottomed shallow pot, add all the fish adobo ingredients except for the fish.
Lay out the fish flat on the pot making sure that no two fish pieces are on top of each other. This helps the adobo flavors really seep into the fish.
Bring the adobo mixture into a boil over medium heat.
Add sugar, if using.
Lower heat and let the adobong isda simmer for 12 minutes.

Turn over the fish and let the mixture simmer for another 12 minutes, making sure the pot doesn’t dry out completely. To prevent drying out, feel free to add a few tablespoons of water every now and then.
Once cooked, transfer to a serving plate and serve with rice! Now you can add fish adobo to your weekly meal plans.
categories: ADOBONG ISDA INGREDIENTS ADOBONG ISDA RECIPE AND PROCEDURE

name: Try This Meatless Sopas Recipe That's Packed With Flavor
description: Sopas is an iconic Filipino soup that deserves center stage. While everyone raves about adobo and sinigang, all of us who wake up to rainy days and canceled classes know that sopas is Filipino comfort food at its finest. Different families have different sopas ingredients and ways of cooking sopas but most usually revert to some kind of milk, macaroni noodles, and meat. This recipe teaches you how to make creamy and delicious sopas without the meat but with all the flavor thanks to a combination of Knorr Chicken Cube and Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup.
tips: Serve the sopas and macaroni noodles separately to prevent the noodles from soaking up all the soup. This helps with keeping the sopas fresh when there’s leftovers and prevents the noodles from getting soggy.

ingredients.item: large celery, diced with leaves removed
Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup dissolved in 1 liter of water
elbow macaroni, cooked according to package instructions

instructions: In a medium pot over medium high heat, sauté onions, garlic, celery, and mushrooms.
Add carrots and crumbled Knorr Chicken Cube into the same pot and sauté for 2 more minutes.
Add Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup and let simmer for 5 minutes.
Add cabbage and corn. Season with salt and pepper and let the sopas simmer for 2 more minutes.
Mix in evaporated milk for extra creaminess.
Take off the heat and add in the macaroni noodles. Serve warm and enjoy!
categories: HOW TO COOK SOPAS STEP BY STEP

name: The Best Umami-Rich Java Rice Recipe On The Internet
description: Forget takeout, make your own java rice from scratch with this easy to follow 15-minute recipe. Using Knorr Liquid Seasoning Original to finish off the rice, this java rice recipe is unlike anything you’ve ever tried before. Of course it has the orange hue java rice is known for but with a deep umami flavor that’ll make this your favorite way to make rice from now on. Pair it with your favorite grilled Filipino food and you have yourself a special Filipino meal.
tips: If using rice that’s freshly made, place it in the fridge first to cool before adding it into the pan with the other java rice ingredients.
instructions: In a large bowl, break apart the clumps of rice by pressing on it with a spatula.
Heat oil in a large pan or wok over medium high heat.
Add butter and let it melt for a few seconds.
Add onion and garlic cloves. Sauté until fragrant.
Add annatto and turmeric powder. Mix for 20-30 seconds.
Add rice and mix well to fully coat and season.
Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add Knorr Liquid Seasoning Original and mix to distribute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the java rice warm with your favorite grilled food.
categories: HOW TO MAKE JAVA RICE IN RICE COOKER

name: Crispy Fried Okra Recipe with A Creamy Umami Dipping Sauce
description: Try making the best okra of your life with a handful of ingredients in just 15 minutes with this easy-to-follow recipe. If you’ve had only okra in stews and soups, have you really lived? Fried okra is a common dish in cajun cuisine but we added our own Pinoy spin to it by simplifying the coating and using cornstarch for that extra crunch. We also made a creamy umami dipping sauce using Pinoy favorite Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili mixed with creamy Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise as the perfect complement to this okra recipe. Make this as an appetizer for your Filipino-themed parties or as a regular snack. You won’t regret it!
tips: To make this recipe even faster and easier, prep your okras beforehand. Slice and freeze your okras ahead of time and follow the recipe. You’ll have a crispy snack in no time.

ingredients.item: okra, sliced into ¼ inch circles
oil, enough to deep fry in

instructions: In a medium-sized bowl, beat the egg and season with salt and pepper.
In a separate bowl, combine sliced okra and flour. Shake off excess flour.
Add floured okra into the bowl with the egg and mix to coat the okra well.
Add the coated okra to a shallow bowl with cornstarch seasoned with salt and pepper. Set aside.
Heat oil enough to deep fry the okras in a wok or a frying pan.
Once the oil is hot, deep fry the okras until golden brown. Make sure to shake off the excess cornstarch before deep frying.
Drain oil on paper towels.
Mix the creamy umami dipping sauce for the okra in a small bowl.
Serve with the crispy fried okra and enjoy this delicious appetizer.

name: Quick and Easy Buffalo Chicken Dip Recipe
description:
There are times when you crave comfort food, but eating out all the time is too expensive. What if we tell you that you can prepare a quick and easy buffalo chicken dip without breaking the bank? 
               
               
               
              Our buffalo chicken dip recipe is super simple to prepare and features everyone’s favorite Lady’s Choice Real Chicken Spread for creamy goodness. It will be a total winner at your next party or gathering.
tips: Transfer the dip to a shallow airtight container and store in the refrigerator for about a week.

ingredients.item: chicken chunks from a can, drained

instructions: In a skillet over medium heat, heat the chicken chunks and hot pepper sauce for about 3 to 5 minutes.
Stir in cream cheese, ranch dressing, and Lady’s Choice Real Chicken Spread. Cook and stir well until blended and warm, which should be around 3 to 5 minutes.
Mix in half of the cheddar cheese, and transfer the mixture into a slow cooker. Sprinkle the remaining cheese on top of the mixture.
Cover and cook on low heat for around 35 minutes. Wait until the dip is hot and bubbly.
Serve with celery sticks and enjoy!
categories: BUFFALO CHICKEN DIP WITH CREAM CHEESE
BUFFALO WING DIP WITH CANNED CHICKEN
BUFFALO CHICKEN DIP INGREDIENTS AND PROCEDURE

name: 10-Minute Poached Egg Recipe
description:
How do you like your eggs in the morning? Take a break from your usual and try some Turkish eggs! Turkish eggs are basically poached eggs served over a scrumptious bed of garlicky yogurt and warmed olive oil. 
               
               
               
              Our poached egg recipe can be prepared in just 10 minutes and features Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise for some added creamy goodness. This Turkish egg recipe will surely be a welcome addition to your egg recipe arsenal.
tips: Serve with your favorite rustic bread for a Mediterranean flair.
instructions: Whisk together the Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, garlic and salt.
Poach each egg in boiling water, about 3 to 5 minutes.
Make the warmed olive oil sauce while the second egg is being cooked. Heat the olive oil with pepper flakes.
Transfer the poached egg to the prepared yogurt bowls and drizzled with the olive oil sauce.

name: Easy Pastina Recipe
description:
Is Italian cuisine your comfort food? Well, you can eat like an Italian at home by preparing some Pastina soup. Pastina is Italian for small pasta, and this dish feels like a warm hug in a bowl. 
               
               
               
              Our Pastina pasta is super easy to prepare, and features Knorr Chicken Cube for some added flavor. This is a comforting quick fix you wouldn’t want to miss.
tips: To achieve perfect consistency, stir the pastina gently but frequently.
instructions: Boil the Knorr Chicken Cube in the water in a medium-sized pot on high heat.
Add the pastina and butter to the chicken stock and immediately turn the heat down to low.
Continuously stir the pastina until the pasta becomes plump and absorbs most of the liquid.
Take the pastina off the heat and season with salt and cheese to the taste.
Drizzle with some extra cheese and drizzle with olive oil. Top with bacon bits.

name: Coronation Chicken in Two Ways: Chicken Sandwich and Chicken Salad
description:
Who says eating like royalty has to cost a ton? If you’re feeling fancy, why not try some Coronation chicken? Named after the late Queen Elizabeth II, coronation chicken is super easy to prepare and can be instantly enjoyed in two ways: as a chicken sandwich and chicken salad. 
               
               
               
              Our chicken sandwich recipe/chicken salad recipe features Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise from some creamy goodness. This is an awesome go-to quick fix when you have leftover chicken and want to change things up.
tips: You can store the coronation chicken mixture in your refrigerator for a maximum of three days.
instructions: Mix the Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, curry powder, cinnamon, chutney and sultanas, and season with black pepper.
Add the shredded chicken and stir to coat in the sauce.
Stir in 2 tbsp of water to loosen the mixture as needed.
Season and serve with salad greens if you wish to enjoy it as a salad. If you want to make it a sandwich, place the coronation chicken and salad greens in between two loaves of bread.

name: 10-Minute Savory Overnight Oats Topped With Crispy Bacon
description: Finally learn how to make overnight oats with this quick and healthy recipe with a savory twist. Skip the peanut butter and banana combo and make these overnight oats with umami-rich Knorr Chicken Cube and Knorr Liquid Seasoning instead. These flavor bombs combined with heart-healthy oats makes for a satisfying breakfast that you’ll definitely end up making over and over again.
tips: Use cream cheese with chives or other herbs to amp up the flavor of these overnight oats.

ingredients.item: Knorr Chicken Cube dissolved in 1 ½ cups of warm water
poached eggs, or eggs cooked according to your preference
bacon, cooked according to your preference
to taste Knorr Liquid Seasoning Original or chili

instructions: In a bowl, combine oatmeal and chicken broth. Mix well and divide into two containers. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
After leaving the oats to soak overnight, take them out of the fridge.
Divide the cream cheese into two and mix into the overnight oats.
Add the eggs, bacon, and microgreens on top of the oats.
Finish off with a splash of Knorr Liquid Seasoning Original or Chili.
Enjoy this easy and delicious savory overnight oats.
categories: HOW LONG DO OVERNIGHT OATS LAST

name: Make This Gyudon Recipe Using Only Pantry Staples
description: Ever want to recreate a Japanese recipe at home only to find out you have none of the Japanese ingredients the recipe calls for? You won’t have that problem with this easy-to-follow gyudon recipe. We skipped out on all the special ingredients and we teach you how to make delicious beef gyudon at home using only pantry staples. Now you can have gyudon whenever a craving strikes, even at midnight!
tips: Use fatty beef slices for a juicier and more flavorful gyudon.

ingredients.item: Knorr Beef Cube dissolved in 1 cup water

instructions: In a pan over low heat, add oil and sliced onions. Cook for 5-6 minutes, making sure to stir often.
Add the beef and all the gyudon sauce ingredients into the pan.
Bring up the heat to medium and cover the pan. Let the beef brown, making sure to skim off the scum that comes up to the surface.
Bring the heat down to a simmer and continue cooking for 4-5 minutes, covered.
Once done, divide the cooked rice into 4 bowls. Drizzle some of the sauce on top.
Put the beef and onions on top of the rice along with the remaining sauce.
Serve warm and enjoy this fuss-free beef gyudon!

name: Restaurant Style Sweet Sesame Shrimp With Broccoli Recipe
description: This easy yet oh so delicious shrimp with broccoli recipe will have you and your family swearing off restaurants for good. Imagine succulent shrimp stir-fried with garlic and broccoli, tossed in a sweet and salty sauce served with bowls of rice. Dinner can’t get any better than this! The best part is that it takes only a few minutes to get that harmony of flavors all thanks to secret ingredient Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili. Try this recipe today!
tips: The best way to cook juicy shrimp that’s not rubbery is to watch out for changes in color. Once the shrimp changes into a bright pink or orange hue, the shrimp is already cooked and can be taken out of the pan.
instructions: Place the cleaned and deveined shrimp into a large bowl and set aside
In another bowl, mix together all the shrimp with broccoli sauce ingredients except for the cornstarch.
Divide the mixture in half and pour half of it on the bowl with the shrimp to marinate. Marinate in the fridge for 15 minutes, 30 minutes max.
Mix in the cornstarch with the other half. Set aside.
Heat a large pan over medium heat and add the oil. Once hot, add the broccoli until it’s tender. This should take around 4-6 minutes depending on how hot the pan is.
Remove the broccoli from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add the marinated shrimp and cook on one side for 2 minutes before flipping and stir-frying. Cook only until the shrimp changes color. Remove the shrimp from the pan and set aside.
Add the sauce into the pan and let simmer for 1 minute.
Stir-fry everything together to coat the broccoli and shrimp. Cook for 1-2 minutes or until the sauce is thick and glossy.
Remove from heat and sprinkle with sesame seeds on top, if using. Serve with warm bowls of rice and enjoy!
categories: HOW TO COOK BROCCOLI WITH SHRIMP

name: Simple Chicken Alexander Recipe
description:
Want to elevate your leftover chicken? You should give Chicken Alexander a try. Chicken Alexander is a creamy casserole dish from the UK. Don’t let its fancy name fool you because it’s super easy to prepare at home. 
               
               
               
              Our Chicken Alexander recipe uses Knorr Chicken Cube and Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup to take the chicken’s flavor to the next level. Plus, most of the ingredients for our Chicken Alexander Sauce recipe are probably in your pantry anyway, so this is a dish you can prepare anytime.
tips: Add some grated cheese on top if you want to make your Chicken Alexander cheesy.
instructions: Add the extra virgin olive oil and 2 tbsp of butter in a skillet over medium heat. After about 2 minutes, saute the onions, garlic, and green bell peppers.
Add the rest of the ingredients, except for the ones for the topping. Blend the liquids well into the mixture.
Preheat the oven to 350F. Place everything from the skillet in an oven-proof baking pan.
Put the mashed potatoes on top of the mixture. Spread the potatoes evenly as a top layer, using a spatula, covering the chicken mixture.
Sprinkle some chopped green peppers and carrots. Drizzle some melted butter all over. Top with the bread crumbs.
Bake at 350 F for around 12 minutes. Serve warm.

name: Easy Suam na Mais Recipe
description:
In the mood to take your favorite Knorr Crab & Corn Soup to the next level? Give this soup staple a uniquely Pinoy upgrade with Suam na Mais. 
               
               
               
              Our Suam na Mais recipe uses the beloved Knorr Crab & Corn soup as its base. You can enjoy this dish on its own on a cool evening or as a hearty side dish. The choice is yours.
tips: This soup tastes great with rice and some fried ulam.
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a pot, and saute the garlic and onion.
Once the onion softens, add the white corn and cook for 3 minutes.
Put the chicken into the pot and saute for a minute.
Combine Knorr Crab and Corn Soup with water and mix well. Pour the mixture into the pot and let it boil while stirring lightly.
Continue cooking in low to medium for 3 minutes while stirring.
Season with ground white pepper and fish sauce.
Serve warm. Garnish with parsley or scallions, if desired.
categories: PAANO MAGLUTO NG SUAM NA MAIS
HOW TO COOK SUAM NA MAIS
HOW TO MAKE SUAM NA MAIS

name: Pork Giniling Recipe with Oyster Sauce
description:
While it’s fun to experiment with new recipes every now and then, sometimes, we all crave for something familiar and feels like home. Our pork giniling recipe with oyster sauce is simple yet packed with so much flavor. It’s a Pinoy classic that never goes out of style. 
               
               
               
              Our list of pork giniling ingredients includes Knorr Liquid Seasoning for a little umami kick. Perfect with rice or as pulutan, this pork giniling recipe is a must-try for every Filipino household.
tips: Store cut potatoes in water to prevent them from turning brown.
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a pan, and pan-fry the diced potato until it turns light brown. Remove the potatoes from the pan and set aside.
Saute the onion, garlic, and tomato with the leftover oil.
Add ground pork once the onion softens. Cook while stirring for about 2 minutes.
Pour the Knorr Liquid Seasoning into the pan and add water. Adjust the heat to low, and cook uncovered until the liquid reduces to half.
Add oyster sauce and cook for 5 minutes.
Put the fried potato back into the pan and continue cooking for 3 minutes.
Season with ground black pepper and enjoy.
categories: PORK GINILING RECIPE WITH OYSTER SAUCE
PORK GINILING RECIPE WITH SOY SAUCE
HOW TO COOK PORK GINILING WITH PATATAS

name: Crispy Cheese Dog Bread Roll Recipe — The Best Snack Ever
description:
This crispy cheese dog bread roll recipe will change the way you eat merienda for the rest of your life. It’s made with kid-favorite hot dogs but taken to the next level. Ordinary hot dogs are elevated into cheese dogs adding melty cheese into the mix. Unlike the more popular pigs in a blanket, this cheese dog bread roll is wrapped in bread. It is then coated 
               
              in Panko breadcrumbs, deep-fried to perfection and is served with a creamy dip made with Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise. It’s definitely an indulgent yet easy-to-make dish that will change the way you eat merienda.
tips: Make it a party and provide three dipping sauces! Include yellow mustard and ketchup for variety.

ingredients.item: Knorr Liquid Seasoning Original or Chili

instructions: Slice the hot dogs into four pieces. First slicing half crosswise and then lengthwise. Set aside.
To make the hot dog bread roll into a cheese dog, slice quick melt cheese into strips. Set aside.
Slice off the crust of the white bread and using a rolling pin or wine bottle, flatten the bread until thin. Set aside.
Get a piece of flattened bread and place a hotdog slice and a piece of cheese on top of it.
Roll the bread into a log and press on the sides to seal the hot dog and cheese inside. Set aside.
In a shallow bowl, whisk together egg and milk. Lightly season with salt and pepper.
In another shallow bowl, add panko and lightly season with salt and pepper.
Dip the hot dog bread roll in the milk and egg mixture and then coat with breadcrumbs. Set aside and repeat with the rest of the rolls.
Place the bread rolls in a baking sheet and place in the freezer for 5 minutes. Make sure the cheese dog bread rolls are in a single layer and are not touching each other.
While the cheese dog bread rolls are in the freezer, prepare a heavy-bottomed pan or wok and heat about 2 inches of oil inside for frying.
Once the oil is hot, take out the frozen cheese dog bread rolls from the freezer and fry until golden with the seam side down. Make sure to fry in batches to not overcrowd the pan.
Remove from the pan and drain the oil on a strainer or paper towels.
Make the dipping sauce by combining all the ingredients in a small bowl.
Serve warm and enjoy these delicious crunchy cheese dog bread rolls with your family!
categories: BREAD ROLL WITH HOTDOG AND CHEESE
HOW TO MAKE HOT DOG CHEESE ROLL

name: Make it A Fancy Friend Date With This No-Cook Antipasto
description:
You don’t have to cook up a storm to make a memorable meal for your friends this International Day of Friendship. Instead, whip up this antipasto platter using Italian cured meats and cheeses you can easily buy from the deli. 
               
               
               
              If you’re like most people, you might be wondering what an antipasto is and what the difference is with the more popular charcuterie boards. In the purest sense of the words, antipasto comes from Italy and translates to food eaten before a meal. It’s like an appetizer that’s composed of Italian meats, cheeses, and appetizers unique to regions in Italy. Charcuterie refers to a specific way of curing meat in France and by that definition, is all meat. However, as food continues to evolve, charcuterie boards and antipasto tend to be interchangeable, at least in terms of how people make it at home. For this particular recipe, our antipasto platter takes a page from Italy and focuses on Italian meats, cheeses, and vegetables. We also included an olive tapenade dip that’s made extra creamy and flavorful with Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise.
tips: You can ask the deli to pre-slice your cheeses into a specific shape. You can ask for the soft cheeses to be whole or in wedges, harder cheeses to be cubed, and other ones to be whole so that you can crumble them at home yourself.

ingredients.item: for garnish fresh parsley and sliced olives
or 300 grams fruit of your choice, like grapes, oranges, kiwis, or strawberries
large crusty bread cut into small squares or triangles

instructions: Add all the ingredients in a food processor except for the mayo. Pulse until combined, making sure that bits and pieces of the olives are still whole and are not a homogeneous paste.
Add to a serving bowl and mix in the mayo. Garnish with fresh parsley and sliced olives on top, if desired. Set aside.
Arrange your antipasto in a platter making sure to vary the sizes and cuts of cheeses as well as the manner of laying out the meats.
Serve with the prepared olive mayo tapenade and enjoy this delicious antipasto platter with friends.

name: Alcohol-Free Crostini di Fegatini -- Your New Favorite Appetizer
description:
Make this delicious antipasto using easy-to-find and affordable ingredients in your pantry. While there are several ways to make crostini di fegatini (chicken liver crostini), most recipes use a sweet wine called Vin Santo to cook the chicken livers in. For ease and affordability, this recipe is alcohol-free and cooks the chicken livers in Knorr Chicken Cube dissolved in water instead for an extra meaty taste. It is then finished off with a hearty dollop of Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise for extra creaminess and tang. 
               
               
               
               
              While this recipe is not a traditional Crostini di Fegatini recipe, it’s one that’ll definitely please your taste buds and make it into your top list of favorite appetizers.
tips: For a smoother consistency, feel free to add some water into the mix when blending the liver paté. Just make sure to add it half a tablespoon at a time to prevent it from being runny.

ingredients.item: Knorr Chicken Cube dissolved in ½ cup water

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Line a baking tray with parchment or baking paper.
Place the sliced bread on top and brush lightly on both sides with olive oil.
Bake for 11-13 minutes or until golden. Set aside.
Heat up oil and melt 1 ½ tbsp butter in a pan over medium low heat.
Sauté the onion until soft and translucent.
Add the anchovies and capers. Sauté until the anchovies melt and incorporate into the oils.
Add the chicken liver and sauté until browned on all sides.
Add the chicken broth made from Knorr Chicken cube into the pan. Reduce heat to low and cover the pan. Let it simmer for 25-30 minutes. Feel free to add some water if the mixture gets too dry.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and add the remaining tablespoon of butter.
Let the mixture cool before placing it inside a food processor or high powered blender. Blend until you get your desired consistency. Some prefer their Crostini Fegatini creamy while others chunky.
Transfer it into a bowl and add Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise for that creamy touch. Set aside.
Place on top of the crostini and serve immediately.
Enjoy this Crostini di Fegatini on its own or serve with an antipasto platter.

name: Make the Ultimate Rainy Day Indulgence -- Batangas Lomi
description: Satisfy your cravings for rich and meaty batangas lomi while staying in the comforts of your own home. Batangas, while known for its beautiful beaches, is more popularly known to foodies as the home of indulgent and rainy day fave Batangas Lomi. We teach you how to make this classic dish with a special ingredient for increasing meatiness – Knorr Pork Cube. One cube contains flavor equivalent to 1 kilogram of pork so it makes soups, like this lomi Batangas, extra flavorful minus the hours of simmering.
tips: For best results, serve lomi batangas piping hot.

ingredients.item: pork belly, chopped into bite sized pieces
Knorr Pork Cubes, dissolved in 8 cups of water
cassava or tapioca starch dissolved in ⅓ cup water

instructions: Heat oil over medium heat. Add the onions and sauté until soft and fragrant.
Add the pork belly and cook until browned on all sides.
Next, add the kikiam and fish balls. Sauté for 2-3 minutes or until kikiam is brown.
Set aside some pork belly, fish balls, and kikiams for toppings.
Add the pork and chicken livers to the pot. Cook until browned.
Add Knorr Pork Cubes dissolved in water into the pot along with the soy sauce. Bring to a simmer.
Add the noodles into the pot and let it simmer for 4-5 minutes or until cooked through.
Add the dissolved starch with water into the pot and simmer until thick and glossy.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle batangas lomi into individual serving bowls and top with the reserved toppings as well as crumbled chicharon and eggs.
Finish off with Knorr Liquid Seasoning Original if desired.

name: The Only Stovetop Beef Pot Roast Recipe You Need
description: Making beef pot roast seems complicated but in reality, it’s a relatively hands-off process that involves letting the beef simmer in a wine-based sauce for hours as you sit back and drink some of the wine that wasn’t used in cooking. The only heavy work, if you can even call it that, is searing the beef in a dutch oven or heavy-bottomed pot until it develops a brown crust. Make this whenever you have people coming over and want to make a meal that’ll impress. Make sure to use Knorr Beef Cubes for that extra deep and meaty flavor.
tips: Water is the enemy of a good sear. Make sure your beef is dry by patting it with paper towels and leaving it in the fridge uncovered for 20-30 minutes.

ingredients.item: Knorr Beef Cubes, dissolved in 4 cups water
large carrots, sliced into thick circles

instructions: Pat the beef chuck dry and season with salt and pepper.
Heat 3 tbsp oil in a large dutch oven or heavy-bottom pot over medium heat.
Sear the beef chuck for about 4-5 minutes on each side until browned. Take off the heat and set aside.
Add remaining oil into the pot and sauté garlic and onions until lightly browned. Remove onions and garlic from the pot and set aside.
Remove pot from heat and add wine. Bring back to the stove over medium heat. Scrape the bottom of the pot to remove the bits and pieces of beef stuck on it.

Add the beef chuck into the pot followed by the Knorr Beef Cube dissolved in water. Put enough water to cover ¾ of the beef chuck in liquid. How much liquid you use will depend on the size of your pot.
Add in the browned onions, garlic, carrots, and bay leaves into the pot.
Increase heat and bring to a boil. Once boiling, sprinkle the thyme and add the fresh rosemary on top.
Reduce heat to low and let it simmer for 2-3 hours or until the beef is tender, making sure to check in every now and then to make sure the liquid hasn’t dried up.
Add the baby potatoes and cook covered for 30 more minutes.
Take out the rosemary and bay leaf. Season beef pot roast with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve on a large platter and enjoy this stovetop beef pot roast.
categories: BEEF POT ROAST IN OVEN WITH VEGETABLES
