HOW TO COOK ROAST BEEF IN INSTANT POT

name: Mimiyuuuh’s Quick-and-Cheesy Volcano Omurice
description: Looking for a fast and tasty meal? Check out Mimiyuuuh's Quick-and-Cheesy Volcano Omurice made with Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Simple, delicious, and exciting recipe - perfect for busy people on-the-go! Watch it on Knorr Kitchen Secrets Episode 1: 10-Minute Meal Challenge #IfYouKnowYouKnorr #KnorrKitchenSecrets
instructions: MARINATE THE CHICKEN. Marinate the boneless chicken quarter leg in Knorr Liquid Seasoning and ground black pepper.
COAT AND COOK. Dredge chicken in flour, dip in egg, and coat in panko. Deep fry on medium heat till golden brown and cripsy.

FRY THE EGG. Heat oil in a pan. Cook seasoned, beaten egg until set, swirling for a thin layer. Add cheese as needed. Place on rice with chopped katsu, drizzle with Knorr Liquid Seasoning, and top with onion leeks.

name: 5 Easy Steps to Create Bicolano-Style Pancit Bato
description: In this recipe, we explore not just the rich and unique flavors of Pancit Bato - a delightful dish from Bicol - but also its deeply rooted heritage. We'll guide you step by step on how to cook it using our secret ingredients, such as Knorr Chicken Cube and Knorr Liquid Seasoning, which give an extra punch of flavor that will transport your taste buds straight to the streets of Camarines Sur.
tips: Pancit Bato tastes best when served fresh!
instructions: Boil water in a large pot, add pancit bato noodles and cook until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large pan, sauté onions and garlic. Add chicken and shrimp, cooking until they turn brown.
Add Knorr Chicken Cubes to the mixture, followed by the vegetables. Cook for around 5 minutes.
Toss in pancit bato noodles. Season with Knorr Liquid Seasoning or Bango Soy Sauce, salt, and pepper.
Serve hot and enjoy your delicious Pancit Bato!

name: Indulge in this Delightful Creamy Cucumber Salad Recipe
description:
Are you looking for a refreshing salad to beat the summer heat wave? Our creamy cucumber salad recipe is not only delicious and refreshing but also remarkably easy to make. In case you're wondering 'What's in it?' It's a delicious concoction of fresh cucumbers mixed with Lady's Choice Mayonnaise which gives the salad its delightfully creamy texture.  
               
               
              Not just any ordinary cucumber salad, this Pipino Salad is perfect for those wanting a refreshing break from the heat.
tips: Chilling the salad allows the flavors to meld together.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise, salt and pepper to create your creamy cucumber salad dressing.
Add the sliced cucumbers and onions into the bowl.
Toss the mixture until all slices are evenly coated with the dressing.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour before serving.
Serve your creamy cucumber salad and enjoy!

name: Dinner Date Idea: Delicious Chicken Parmigiana Recipe
description:
Looking for a perfect dish to spice up your date nights or celebrate special occasions? Well, you're in luck! Our easy Chicken Parmigiana recipe is just the ticket. This classic Italian dish is a surefire way to impress that special someone.  
               
               
              The secret to our divine Chicken Parmigiana? Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise. It lends a creamy twist to this beloved pasta dish, while also making it incredibly easy to prepare. Perfect for serving over pasta or as a sandwich!
tips: Leftovers make a fabulous sandwich filling for next day's lunch!
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F) and line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper. Dredge them in flour, then dip into the egg, and finally coat with breadcrumbs.
Heat some oil in a pan over medium heat. Cook the chicken until golden brown on both sides.
Place the fried chicken breasts onto the prepared baking tray. Top each one with marinara sauce, mozzarella cheese, and a dollop of Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise.
Bake for about 20 minutes or until cheese is melted and golden brown. Serve hot with pasta or as a sandwich!

name: Whip Up a Quick Feast: No-Bake Macaroni Recipe That's Deliciously Satisfying!
description:
Who wouldn't love delightful comfort food that doesn't require hours in the kitchen? Yes, we're talking about no bake macaroni, Filipino style! The ultimate dish on busy days. Perfect for the family, this dish offers an enticing combination of creamy sauce and savory beef, all without turning on the oven. 
               
               
              The magic behind our no-bake macaroni is Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise which gives it a rich and flavorful twist. Dont forget the Knorr Beef Cube that adds an irresistible meaty taste. With this recipe, you'll have this meal ready in no time!
instructions: Boil some salted water in a large pot.
Cook the macaroni as per package instructions until they are al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a pot, melt the Knorr Beef Cube in some water to extract its flavors.
Stir in Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, milk, cheese, salt, and pepper. Cook until it has a smooth consistency.
Add the cooked macaroni into the sauce and mix well. Let it simmer for a few minutes until flavours are well combined.
Serve hot with grated cheese on top and enjoy!

name: An Easy-to-Make Twist on the Classic: The Chicken Feet Adobo Recipe
description:
Chicken feet adobo is the twist you never knew you needed in your traditional Filipino adobo. This dish transforms ordinary chicken feet into a rich, comforting main course, bursting with savory, umami flavor.  
               
               
              The secret to our unique twist? Knorr Liquid Seasoning. It brings an extra depth of savoriness that makes this Chicken Feet Adobo truly special. Perfect for those seeking adventure in their home-cooked meals!
tips: This dish is best enjoyed when left to sit overnight as it allows flavors to fully develop.

ingredients.item: water or enough to cover the chicken feet

instructions: Clean and prepare chicken feet by cutting off claws.
In a large pot or pan, sauté garlic and onion until fragrant.
Add chicken feet to the pot and cook until lightly browned.
Add bay leaves, vinegar, soy sauce, whole black peppercorns, and Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Bring to a boil without stirring.
Lower heat, cover, and simmer for approximately 30-35 minutes or until the chicken feet are tender and the sauce has thickened.

name: Feast on the Delicious Authentic Chicken Shawarma Recipe with Garlic Sauce
description:
Chicken shawarma is a beloved treasure originating from the Mediterranean. Known for its savory flavors and healthy ingredients, our authentic chicken shawarma recipe will offer you a taste of this classic dish right in your kitchen. 
               
               
              The secret? Our flavorful garlic sauce made with Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise that adds an unforgettable creamy element to the meal.
tips: Leftover garlic sauce can be refrigerated and used as a spread for sandwiches or as a dipping sauce.
instructions: Start off by marinating the chicken slices. In a bowl, combine the cumin, turmeric, coriander, cinnamon powders, lemon juice along with salt and pepper.
Add in the chicken slices into the mix ensuring every piece is well-coated with the marinade. Let this sit for at least 2 hours, or overnight.
Heat a grill pan over medium heat and cook the chicken slices until they are cooked through and have lovely charred marks on both sides.
While the chicken is cooking, make the garlic sauce by mixing Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise along with minced garlic until well combined.
Serve your deliciously authentic chicken shawarma slices drenched in your homemade garlic sauce. Enjoy!

name: Meet Your New Late Night Snack – Mouth-Watering Sandwich Recipe!
description:
When the late-night cravings kick in, there's nothing quite like a multi-decker sandwich to satiate your hunger. We've perfected the ultimate triple-decker sandwich recipe guaranteed to hit the spot.  
               
               
              Imagine biting into three layers of deliciousness: crispy lettuce and tomato, savory ham, and fluffy scrambled egg. But what really sets this sandwich apart is the use of Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise which binds the ingredients together while imparting a creamy indulgence.
tips: Prepare your ingredients in advance for a quicker assembly process.
instructions: Start by lightly toasting the bread.
Spread a generous amount of Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise on one side of each slice.
On the first slice, layer ham followed by lettuce and tomato.

Top with the second slice of bread, followed by scrambled eggs, lettuce and tomato. To make your scrambled eggs: Crack the eggs into a bowl. Add salt and pepper according to your taste. If you like your eggs softer, add milk. Using a fork or a whisk, beat the eggs until the yolks and whites are fully combined. Heat up your pan over medium heat and add butter. Once the butter is melted and pan is heated, pour in the beaten eggs. Let it cook undisturbed for few seconds until it starts to set around the edges. Stir gently with a spatula, pushing from the edges towards the center. Continue cooking—stirring occasionally—until the eggs are mostly cooked but still slightly runny.
Close the sandwich with the third slice of bread. Cut into manageable pieces and serve immediately.

name: Gabbi & Khalil’s One-Pot Saucy Sarap Adobo
description: Delicious dish but less hassle in the kitchen? Try Gabbi & Khalil’s One-Pot Saucy Sarap Adobo made with Knorr Chicken Cubes. Simple, delicious, and exciting recipe – perfect to save time on dish prep! Watch it on Knorr Kitchen Secrets Episode 2: One-Pot Meal Challenge! #IfYouKnowYouKnorr #KnorrKitchenSecrets
instructions: MARINATE THE CHICKEN. Marinate the chicken in soy sauce, vinegar, onion, and garlic.
SEAR TE CHICKEN. Heat oil in rice cooker and sear chicken. Set aside.

COMBINE OTHER INGREDIENTS. Pour in the remaining marinade, water, Knorr Chicken Cubes, black peppercorns, sugar, and washed rice, and search chicken on top. Close rice cooker and cook until done. Serve with garnish of green onions and fried garlic.

name: Small Laude’s Sulit Sarap Spicy Bacsilog
description: Want to spice up your feast on a budget? Check-out Small’s Sulit Sarap Spicy Bacsilog, made with Knorr Liquid Seasoning – Chili. Simple, delicious, and exciting recipe – perfect for those looking for delicious meals on a budget! Watch it on Knorr Kitchen Secrets Episode 3: ~₱100 Peso Meal Challenge! #IfYouKnowYouKnorr #KnorrKitchenSecrets
instructions: COOK THE EGG. In a pan, add ample amount of oil, heat on medium and fry an egg to your liking. Set egg aside.
FRY THE GARLIC. Chop your garlic into small bits. Fry your chopped garlic and crisp up to your liking. Set aside.

COOK THE BACON and ADD THE SAUCE. In the same pan, add bacon and cook for 1-2 minutes on medium heat (avoid cooking for a long time as it may cause the bacon to shrink significantly). Set aside. Add cheese spread to the pan and add water gradually to thin it out. Add Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Set aside. Plate the egg and cheesy bacon with the rice and garlic toppings and drizzle more Knorr Liquid Seasoning as needed.

name: Nana Silayro’s 5-Ingredient Creamy Mushroom Balls
description: Easy and delicious fix for midnight cravings? Try Nana’s 5-Ingredient Creamy Mushroom Balls, made with Knorr Cream of Mushroom Soup – perfect to indulge even with limited ingredients! Watch it on Knorr Kitchen Secrets Episode 4: 5-Ingredient Meal Challenge! #IfYouKnowYouKnorr #KnorrKitchenSecrets
instructions: COOK THE BASE. Saute the mushroom and rice in oil. Add diluted Knorr Mushroom Soup. Add hot water until you reach your desired cook on rice. Chill in the fridge until it becomes shapeable.
SHAPE AND COAT. Shape the cooled rice into balls. Optionally, you can add a cube of mozzarella inside. Dust with flour, breadcrumbs. If revised, dust with breadcrumbs only.
COOK THE BACON and ADD THE SAUCE. Cook your shaped mushroom balls by deep frying or using an airfyer until golden brown. Serve with ketchup or marinara.

name: Chef Obang’s P100 Vegnigang
description: A tasty vegetable twist on a budget? Chef Obang proves this with P100 Vegnigang using Knorr Sinigang sa Samplalok Mix Gabi! Join the Knorr SPINigang Challenge now! #SPINigangChallenge

ingredients.item: Knorr Sinigang sa Sampaloc Mix Original (22g)
small red onion peeled; cut into quartered
small piece radish; peeled and sliced into rounds

instructions: In a medium pot over medium heat, add the cooking oil.
Add onion and tomatoes and sauté until translucent and add the tomatoes softened.
Pour in water and add the Knorr Sinigang Mix. Stir to dissolve.
Add the Knorr Pork Cube
Bring to a boil.
Add the radish and simmer until almost tender.
Add okra, eggplant, string beans and let it simmer until tender.
Add the kangkong leaves and let it softened
Add siling haba (green chilis).
Add some salt and pepper to taste.
Serve while hot.

name: Franzie’s Spicy Watermelon Sinigang
description: A familiar bold twist on Sinigang using watermelon? Franzie boasts her Spicy Watermelon Sinigang using Knorr Sinigang na Sampalok Mix! Join the Knorr SPINigang Challenge now! #SPINigangChallenge

ingredients.item: Knorr Sinigang sa Sampaloc Mix Original (22g)

instructions: Scoop the meat out of the watermelon and chop the vegetables.
Saute the onions, tomatoes, pork belly, and add in water in the pot.
Pour Knorr sinigang ( sampalok) pouring inside the pot ( SInigang sampalok mix) , lastly adding the chili oil.
adding in the watermelon and veggies. Cooking again for 7 mins

name: Mitchelle Ngo’s Kimchi Sinigang
description: A hearty cuisine fusion between Pinoy and Korean flavors? Mitchelle Ngo dares you to try her Kimchi Sinigang using Knorr Sinigang na Sampalok Mix! Join the Knorr SPINigang Challenge now! #SPINigangChallenge

ingredients.item: Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original (22g)
(100g) kangkong, leaves picked and soft stems cut into 2-inch pieces

instructions: Add Knorr Sinigang Mix to a pot of boiling water.
Throw in the shrimp, and remove after the shrimp is cooked halfway to avoid overcooking later.
To the boiling Sinigang Broth, add in Kimchi, Gochujang, onions, tomato, radish, and mushrooms.
Let this simmer until the vegetables have softened.
Add Sitaw, Kangkong, more Kimchi, and tofu. Add the Pre-boiled Shrimp back in and simmer until cooked.
Serve and enjoy!

name: Pepper PH’s One-Pan Sinigang Paella
description: A tasty Sinigang dish without soup? Pepper PH goes full exploration with One-Pan Sinigang Paella using Knorr Sinigang na Sampalok Mix! Join the Knorr SPINigang Challenge now! #SPINigangChallenge

ingredients.item: Kurobuta pork belly, sliced into 1”-1½ ” thick
okra, top removed and sliced in half
water, separated to 2 cups and ¾ cups
⅛ cup Knorr Sinigang Mix Original

instructions: In a pan, add 1/2 tbsp of neutral oil and sear the pork belly on all sides until golden brown. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add the onion and tomatoes. Saute for 2-3 minutes until tomatoes are slightly softer and the onions are almost translucent.
In a separate bowl, add hot water and Knorr Sinigang Mix Original. Mix until fully dissolved.
In the pan, increase the heat and bring to a boil. Return the pork belly, decrease heat and bring to a steady simmer, cover and continue to cook for 30-45 minutes.

Once the pork belly is almost fully tender, add the the radish, okra, and eggplant. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. Add rice, 1/4 cup of more water and mix until rice is fully distributed amongst the vegetables and meat. Bring it back to a boil and then decrease heat and bring to a steady simmer. Add green beans on top, cover with a lid and cook for 10 mins. Remove the lid, increase heat to medium high and cook for another 2 minutes for the rice to crisp up in the bottom. Serve immediately.

name: Vegetable Stir-Fry
description: This Vegetable Stir-Fry recipe is leveled-up by the linamnam sarap of a Knorr Liquid Seasoning based stir-fry topping. Pop, Patak, Sarap!
instructions: Saute onions and garlic in hot oil.
Add carrots, cauliflower and young corn. Add water and allow to simmer for 3 minutes.
Add cabbage, chicharo and bell peppers.
Season with salt, pepper and oyster sauce. Mix well.
Add Knorr Liquid Seasoning and continue to cook for another 2 minutes. Serve while warm.

name: Grilled Tuna Panga
description: This Tuna Panga recipe is leveled-up by the linamnam sarap of a Knorr Liquid Seasoning based marinade & dip. Pop, Patak, Sarap!
instructions: In a bowl, combine all marinade ingredients. Place Tuna Panga in a food pan, or deep tray. Drizzle marinade all over the Tuna Panga, making sure it is well coated.
Cover in plastic wrap, then marinate in the chiller overnight.
Preheat the griller. Combine all basting sauce ingredients, and have this ready beside the griller.

Once the griller is smoking, add the tuna skin side down first. Brush a generous amount of the basting sauce on top of the fish, then grill for 5-8 minutes. Continue to baste from time to time. Turn the tuna over, and baste again. Continue to grill for another 5-8 minutes.
Combine all sauce ingredients.
Garnish grilled tuna with spring onions, and serve with dipping sauce.

name: Chili Siomai Rice
description: This Chili Siomai Rice recipe is leveled-up by the anghang sarap of a Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili based rice topping. Pop, Patak, Sarap!
instructions: Steam Siomai for 2-3 minutes.
Deep-Fry Siomai for 5-7 minutes.
Mix squeezed calamansi juice, crispy garlic and Knorr Chili Liquid Seasoning to taste for the dip.
Put Siomai on top of your rice and top with Knorr Chili Liquid Seasoning to taste.

name: Liver Lover? Easy Adobong Atay ng Manok Recipe
True Tuguegarao Special: Try this easy Pancit Batil Patong Recipe
description: When it comes to authentic Filipino cuisine, Pancit Batil Patong has its own special place. This noodle dish hails from the bustling city of Tuguegarao, known for its rich flavors and use of local ingredients. What sets this recipe apart? It's all about the Knorr Liquid Seasoning that elevates this dish in just minutes! The secret ingredient to our hearty Pancit Batil Patong recipe is none other than the Knorr Pork Cube which lends a savory twist, making this an ultimate comfort food.
tips: Leftover Pancit Batil Patong can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

ingredients.item: Carabao Meat or any meat of your choice

instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in a bit of oil.
Add the meat, Knorr Pork Cube, and stir-fry until brown.
Toss in the vegetables and continue stirring for a few minutes.
Place the pancit noodles into the pan along with Knorr Liquid Seasoning. Mix well until everything is combined.
Serve hot topped with a fried egg, chopped onions, and enjoy!

name: Easy, Guilt-Free Indulgence: Sinigang na Salmon Belly sa Miso
description: Craving for an easy and healthy indulgence? Try our Sinigang na Salmon Belly sa Miso recipe. It's a flavorful Filipino dish that is sure to comfort your soul and delight your taste buds. Our secret? Knorr Sinigang sa may Miso. This product not only makes the cooking process easier, but also enhances the savory flavors of salmon belly and miso.
tips: For added flavor, you can put some crushed ginger with onion and tomato at the start of cooking.

ingredients.item: Kangkong leaves or any green leafy vegetables of choice

instructions: Pour water into a pot and bring it to a boil.
Once the water is boiling, add onions and tomatoes. Cook until slightly softened.
Add in the salmon belly pieces. Let it simmer for about 15 minutes until the fish is cooked.
Pour in Knorr Sinigang sa may Miso. Stir well to dissolve the mix and let it simmer for a few more minutes.
Add in kangkong leaves and green chili peppers. Adjust seasoning if needed by adding salt.
Turn off heat, cover pot and let rest for a few minutes before serving. Enjoy your easy, simple and smart sinigang na salmon belly, perfect for dinner!

name: A twist to the OG: Easy Sinigang na Bangus sa Bayabas Recipe
description: Sinigang, a staple in any Filipino kitchen, gets a nutritious twist in our Sinigang na Bangus sa Bayabas recipe. Ever wondered how to cook bangus sinigang sa bayabas? It's simpler than you think! The secret to our healthy alternative is the Knorr Shrimp Cube that infuses this dish with robust flavors while keeping it light and hearty. This recipe is perfect for those seeking a comforting yet health-conscious meal.
tips: Leftover soup tastes even better the next day after flavors have melded together!

ingredients.item: guava, washed and sliced in half
kangkong, leaves separated from the stems
to taste Patis, salt, and pepper

instructions: Prepare all your ingredients.
In a large pot, boil guava in two liters of water.
Once the guava is tender, mash the halves and strain. Discard the seeds, returning the juice back to the pot.
Add garlic, onion, tomatoes, and Knorr Shrimp Cube. Let it simmer until vegetables are tender.
Add bangus to the pot and let it cook for about 15 minutes.
Season with fish sauce, salt, and pepper according to taste. Add water spinach leaves last then turn off heat.

name: Morning Cravings Satisfied! Easy Classic Bangsilog
description: Craving for Bangsilog? This delightful dish consists of fried rice (sinangag), fried bangus (milkfish), and a sunny-side-up egg, hence the term "Bangsilog". You can prepare this exciting meal in just 15 minutes! What's more, our Bangsilog recipe is incredibly simple, smart, and packed with flavor thanks to a secret ingredient - Knorr Liquid Seasoning.
tips: Marinate the milkfish overnight for maximum flavor.

ingredients.item: bangus, deboned and marinated in Knorr Liquid Seasoning

instructions: Fry garlic until golden brown then add cooked rice. Mix well until it becomes fragrant.
Fry the marinated milkfish in a separate pan.
After frying the milkfish, cook sunny-side-up eggs in the same pan.
Arrange the cooked ingredients on a plate and serve hot!

name: Easy but Delicious Party Staple: Fettuccine Carbonara
description: Ever wondered how to make a restaurant-quality fettuccine carbonara at home? It's easier than you think and the result is heavenly. This Italian-inspired dish comprised of cooked fettuccine tossed in a creamy sauce, amplified by the unique taste of Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, can be prepared in less than 20 minutes. Yes, you read it correctly! Our easy recipe for fettuccine carbonara is perfect for dinner parties or gatherings with friends and family where you want to serve something rich, flavorful, and impressive.
tips: The dish is best served immediately after preparing while it's still hot and creamy.

ingredients.item: to taste freshly ground pepper, salt

instructions: Boil water with some salt in a large pot.
Cook the fettuccine as per the instructions until they are al dente. Remember to reserve some of the pasta water for later.
While the pasta is cooking, fry the pancetta in a large skillet over medium heat until it's crispy.
In a separate bowl, whisk together egg yolks, Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, and cheese. Then add some black pepper.
Combine drained pasta and egg mixture with pancetta. Mix well to allow the heat from the pasta to cook the eggs slightly and create a creamy sauce. If needed, add reserved pasta water.
Serve your delicious fettuccine carbonara with additional grated cheese on top!

name: Crispy Sour Cream French Fries with Tangy Cream Dip Recipe
description: Sour cream french fries make a satisfying snack for anyone craving something crispy and creamy. In this recipe, you’ll cook the potatoes until golden, then prepare a sour cream-and-mayonnaise blend to pair with the hot fries. With only five ingredients and less than 30 minutes of prep, it’s an easy way to turn simple fried potatoes into something more indulgent.
instructions: Preheat the Oil Heat oil in a large pot or deep fryer over medium-high heat until hot enough for frying. To check if the oil is ready, dip the end of a wooden spoon into the oil. If small bubbles form steadily around it, the oil is hot enough for frying. Tip: Use a neutral oil with a high smoke point such as canola, vegetable, or sunflower oil for clean flavor and even browning.
Prepare the Sour Cream Dip While the oil heats, mix Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise and sour cream in a bowl. Season with salt and stir until smooth and fully combined. Set aside until ready to use.

Fry the Potatoes Carefully add the potato sticks to the hot oil. Fry until golden brown and crispy, then drain on kitchen towels to remove excess oil. Tip: Avoid overcrowding the pot. Fry in batches if needed to keep the temperature steady and achieve crispier fries.

Serve the Sour Cream French Fries Transfer the french fries to a serving platter. Serve the prepared dip in a separate bowl or drizzle it over the fries right before serving. Tip: Leftover sour cream dip will keep in the refrigerator for up to one week when stored in an airtight container.

name: Tinola with a Twist: Easy Pork Tinola Recipe
description: Fancy a fresh take on a classic Filipino dish? Our "Pork Tinola Recipe" is just what you need! In less than 30 minutes, you can prepare this beloved traditional soup with a twist. If you're wondering, 'What's the twist in this Tinola?' It's using pork instead of the usual chicken. The secret ingredient to our flavorful Pork Tinola recipe is Knorr Beef Cube, which gives the broth an extra depth of flavor. This recipe is perfect for those seeking an easy yet smart way to spice up their dinner menu.
tips: Remember not to overcook your greens to retain their nutritional value!
instructions: Sauté garlic and onion in a pot until golden brown.
Add the pork and sauté until it turns light brown.
Pour in the water and drop the Knorr Beef Cube. Let it simmer until the pork is tender.
Add green papaya slices, and cook until soft.
Season with fish sauce, salt, and pepper. Stir well.
Lastly, add spinach or malunggay leaves. Simmer for another minute then turn off the heat. Serve hot!

name: Easy and Kid-Friendly Sinigang na Hotdog Recipe
description: Sinigang na hotdog might sound unusual, but it's a delightful twist on a classic Filipino dish that your kids will surely love. The secret to our fun and kid-friendly recipe is the Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix Original which gives this dish its tangy and savory flavor. In less than 30 minutes, you can serve this warm bowl of sinigang na hotdog. It’s filled with nutritious veggies like tomatoes, okra, and onions that your kids won't even notice they're eating!
tips: Make sure all the veggies are cut into bite-sized pieces so that they're easier for your children to eat.
instructions: Boil water in a pot.
Once boiling , add the onions and tomatoes.
After five minutes, add the hotdogs, and okra.
Mix in the Knorr Sinigang sa Sampalok Mix.
Let it simmer for 15 minutes or until all the ingredients are cooked.
Serve hot and enjoy!

name: Easy and Hearty Pancit Langlang Recipe
description: Pancit Miki and Pancit Sotanghon are not just noodles; they're a lifestyle choice for those who truly understand Filipino cuisine. But, have you ever thought of combining the two to create a delectable dish like Pancit Langlang? It's simpler than it sounds! The secret to this recipe is the addition of Knorr Chicken Cube and Knorr Liquid Seasoning, which amplifies the already delightful taste. A straightforward, savvy way to satiate your Filipino food cravings!
tips: Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to a day; just reheat before eating.

ingredients.item: string beans cut into small pieces

instructions: Boil the chicken in a pot. After boiling, remove the chicken and set it aside.
In the same pot, add the Knorr Chicken Cube and Knorr Liquid Seasoning.
Add Pancit Miki and Pancit Sotanghon to the broth. Let it simmer until noodles are cooked.
Stir in the cooked chicken, carrots, and string beans. Cook until vegetables are tender.
Serve hot and enjoy!

name: Easy High-Protein Meal: Creamy Scrambled Egg and Cheese
description: Are you in for a protein-packed breakfast? Then, we've got you covered! In less than 15 minutes, you can whip up our Creamy Scrambled Eggs with Cheese recipe. Yes, scrambled eggs can be simple yet indulgent! The secret to our creamy scrambled egg recipe is Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise which enhances the dish's flavor making it an easy way to start your day. Our scrambled eggs recipe is a smart choice for those wanting to up their protein intake.
tips: Leftover scrambled eggs can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.
instructions: Whisk the eggs in a bowl.
Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat.
Pour the whisked eggs into the pan, stirring constantly until almost set.
Add Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise and the grated cheese, continuing to stir until creamy and cooked to your liking.
Season with salt and pepper according to taste, then serve hot. Enjoy!

name: Palaman with a Kick: Deliciously Easy Curry Egg Salad
description: Eggs are incredibly versatile and delicious, but have you ever tried giving them an exotic twist? With our curried egg salad recipe, you can savor egg salad with a kick in just 15 minutes! This isn't your traditional egg salad; it's a delightful blend of creamy eggs and aromatic curry spices. The highlight of our curried egg salad is Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise. It gives this dish a smooth, rich taste that complements the zestiness of the curry perfectly. Our curried egg salad recipe is perfect for those craving a quick yet exciting meal!
tips: Curried egg salad can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to three days.
instructions: Peel and chop the hard-boiled eggs.
In a large bowl, combine chopped eggs, Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise, curry powder, Dijon mustard. Mix well until everything is combined and nicely coated.
Season the mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the curried egg salad over bread with your choice of garnish. Enjoy!

name: Snack Attack! Easy Waffle Corn Dog
description: Waffle corn dogs? Absolutely! This delicious twist on the classic corn dog will be your next favorite brunch snack. Using a waffle maker, these hotdogs are enveloped in a scrumptious waffle batter. As for the secret ingredient? Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise which provides a creamy texture that truly elevates this dish. It's not just about indulgence, it also serves as a healthier alternative to traditional corn dogs.
tips: Leftover waffle dogs can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 2 days. Reheat in a toaster oven for best results.
instructions: Preheat your waffle maker and skewer each hotdog.
In a bowl mix pancake mix, egg, Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise and enough milk to form a thick batter.
Dip each skewered hotdog into the batter, ensuring it's fully coated.
Place each battered hotdog in the waffle maker and cook until golden brown.
Serve your delicious waffle dogs with your favorite dipping sauce and enjoy!

name: Easy and Delicious Tuna Pizza Pandesal Recipe
description: Are you in the mood for pizza but want something a bit more nutritious and easy to prepare? If so, our Tuna Pizza Pandesal using the humble oven toaster just might be your new favorite recipe. The star of this show is Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise which transforms the tuna into a creamy and incredibly flavorful topping. This recipe is a delightful twist on traditional pizza that's not only delicious but also boasts the added benefits of omega-3 fatty acids from the tuna.
tips: Make sure not to over toast the bread, it should be just right - crispy on outside and soft inside.
instructions: Preheat your oven toaster.
Mix together tuna flakes, bell peppers, onions, and Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise.
Spread the mixture onto each pandesal half.
Top with grated cheese.
Toast them in your oven toaster until cheese is melted and bubbly.

name: No-Brainer Sinigang na Itlog Recipe
description: Healthy eating has never been this effortless with our Sinigang na Itlog recipe. In less than 30 minutes, you can prepare a hot bowl of Sinigang that's packed with nutritious ingredients. This is a unique twist to the classic sinigang dish, using eggs as the main protein. The secret to our tasty Sinigang na Itlog recipe is Knorr Sinigang Sa Sampalok Original, which gives an authentic sour flavor that complements the freshness of eggplant, tomato, and kangkong.
tips: For a spicier kick, add chopped chili peppers.
instructions: Boil some water in a pot. Add the Knorr Sinigang Sa Sampalok Original.
Add the tomatoes and eggplant. Let it simmer until softened.
Gently add hard boiled eggs. Cook until preferred doneness is achieved.
Add kangkong leaves and okra. Simmer for another two minutes.
Serve hot and enjoy!

name: All-around Delicious Cucumber Salad Prepared in 3 Ways
description:
Cucumbers are always a refreshing idea, but did you know that you can prepare them in three unique and delicious ways? Yes, you read that right. Introducing our Cucumber Salad Prepared in 3 Ways recipe, featuring chili cucumber salad, creamy cucumber salad, and sweet Asian cucumber salad. 
               
               
               
              The secret to our versatile cucumber salad recipe lies in the use of Knorr Liquid Seasoning, Lady’s Choice Mayonnaise, and Bango Soy Sauce, each adding a distinct flavor to the dish. Our cucumber salad recipe is a great quick fix for those craving a refreshing and nutritious meal.
tips: Leftover cucumber salad can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days. Serve chilled for the best taste.
instructions: In a bowl, combine Knorr Liquid Seasoning, sesame oil, and rice vinegar.
Add the sliced cucumbers and red chili. Toss to coat evenly.
Serve immediately or chill in the refrigerator for 10 minutes before serving.
In a bowl, mix Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, sour cream, and fresh dill.
Add the sliced cucumbers and toss to coat evenly.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve immediately.
In a bowl, combine Bango Soy Sauce, honey, and rice vinegar.
Add the sliced cucumbers and toss to coat evenly.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve immediately.

name: Quick and Creamy Ramen Carbonara Noodles Recipe
description:
Ramen noodles are always a comforting choice, but did you know that you can transform them into a creamy, indulgent dish in less than 15 minutes? Yes, you read that right. Introducing our Creamy Ramen Carbonara Noodles recipe, a delightful fusion of Korean carbonara noodles and classic ramen. 
               
               
               
              The secret to our creamy ramen recipe is Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, which adds a rich and delicious twist. Our Carbonara instant noodles recipe is a great quick fix for those craving a unique and satisfying meal.
tips: Leftover creamy ramen can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days. Reheat gently to avoid curdling.
instructions: Boil water in a large pot and cook the ramen noodles according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a separate pan, sauté the minced garlic until fragrant.
In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, Lady’s Choice Real Mayonnaise, heavy cream, and grated parmesan cheese.
Add the cooked ramen noodles to the pan with garlic. Pour the egg mixture over the noodles and stir continuously until the sauce thickens and coats the noodles.
Add the cooked bacon bits and season with salt and pepper to taste. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.

name: Tanghulu Recipe, but make it spicy!
description:
Tanghulu, a popular Chinese street food, gets a spicy twist in this unique recipe. If you've ever wondered how to make tanghulu, you're in for a treat. This recipe combines the sweetness of traditional tanghulu with a spicy kick, making it a delightful fusion of flavors. 
               
               
               
              The secret to our spicy tanghulu recipe is Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili, which adds a surprising yet delicious heat to the candied fruit. Whether you're making strawberry tanghulu, pear tanghulu, or tanghulu grapes, this homemade tanghulu recipe is sure to impress.
tips: Leftover tanghulu can be stored in an airtight container at room temperature for up to two days.
instructions: Wash and dry the fruit thoroughly. Skewer the strawberries, pear slices, and grapes.
In a saucepan, combine sugar and water. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves.
Once the sugar mixture reaches a hard crack stage (around 300°F or 150°C), add Knorr Liquid Seasoning Chili and stir well.
Quickly dip each skewer of fruit into the hot sugar mixture, ensuring an even coating. Allow the excess to drip off.
Place the coated fruit skewers on a parchment-lined baking sheet to cool and harden.

name: Christmas Pancit Canton by Franzie
description: Create this heartwarming Christmas Pancit Canton by Franzie! Your classic shrimp-sarap flavorful Pancit Canton, topped with crunchy deep-fried shrimp, elevating your Christmas handaan!
instructions: Prep the veggies. In a bowl, add in the condiments (soy sauce, sweet chili sauce, sugar, oyster sauce)
Sauté the vegies then add water, add in the shrimp cubes and the canton. Pour in the cornstarch slurry and mix until the noodles are cook
Prep the tempura batter and clean the shrimp
Fry the shrimp until golden. Garnish it on top together with the kinchay"

name: Ham & Cheese Lumpia by Abi Marquez
description: Create this exciting Christmas lumpia recipe by the Lumpia Queen herself!

ingredients.item: Quezo de Bola, cut into 1/2 cm thick matchsticks

instructions: **Prepare the Filling:** In a large bowl, mix together the ground pork, red onion, garlic, carrots, kinchay, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, salt, black pepper, cornstarch, and ham until well combined.

**Assemble the Lumpia:** Place a lumpia wrapper on a flat surface. Spoon 1 1/2 tbsp of filling onto the wrapper, place a stick of Quezo de Bola on top, then roll up tightly. Dab a bit of water on the edges to seal the lumpia.
**Fry the Lumpia:** Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry the lumpia for about 5 minutes or until golden brown.
**Drain Excess Oil:** After frying, let the lumpia drain by standing them vertically if possible. This allows excess oil to drip down from both ends, ensuring a cleaner and lighter bite.
**Serve:** Enjoy your Lumpiang Shanghai with banana ketchup or your favorite dipping sauce.

name: Christmas Sinigang na Lechon by Masarap Ba
description: Sawa na ba sa paulit-ulit na lechon at paksiw na handa kada pasko? Ibahin naman ang recipe, at gawing Christmas Sinigang na Lechon! Gawing indulgent, at asim-kilig ang handaan ngayong pasko!

ingredients.item: leftover lechon, cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Sauté onions in hot oil
Add left over lechon and sauté for 3 mins
Add patis to taste
Add tomatoes and gabi. Cover pot and let simmer.
Pour in hot water and bring to a boil until gabi is tender
Adde okra, talong, sili and sitaw.
Cover and let boil for around 2 mins
Add kangkong
Mix in 1 pack of Knorr Sinigang sa Sampaloc Mix.
May add more patis if needed.
Let simmer for 2 mins
Serve and enjoy

name: Christmas Pork Humba by Lyca Salazar
description: Create this Christmas special of Lyca Salazar- ang Christmas Pork Humba na ispesyal sa Salazar family tuwing pasko!

ingredients.item: tausi (fermented black beans) or patis (fish sauce)

instructions: ⁠Sa isang Kawali, isang kutsa ang karne
⁠Igisa ang Bawang at sibuyas
Idagdag ang lemon soda asin paminta , laurel , Toyo , Pineaaple Juice at KNORR PORK CUBES
⁠Hayaan kumulo sa mababang apoy hanggang sa ang karne ay lumambot
⁠Idagdag Ang Banana Bloosoms at Black beans at haluin mabuti
Hayaan itong kumulo sa loob ng 5-10 minuto hanggang maluto
Serve and enjoy

name: Christmas Kaldereta by Shine Dee
description: Hindi kumpleto ang pasko nina Shine Dee pag wala ang Christmas Kaldareta sa handaan! Create this Christmas Special recipe, at gawing buong-buo ang pasko!
instructions: Sauté the onions and garlic in oil.
Add the chopped pork.
Then add the tomato sauce, soy sauce, liver spread, pickle relish, and water.
Once it boils, add the Knorr pork cube.
When the pork is tender, add the potatoes.
Add the bell pepper once the potatoes are tender.
Add Cheese and let it simmer for a minute
Serve and enjoy

name: Classic Chicken BBQ Inasal with Smoky Glaze by Chef JP Anglo
description: Create this Classic Chicken BBQ Inasal with Smoky Glaze- ang bumubuo ng pasko ni Chef JP!

ingredients.item: small pc red onion, peeled, chopped
Knorr chicken powder or 2 pc Knorr Chicken Cube

instructions: Prepare the marinade: Combine all marinade ingredients in a bowl. Mix well. Chill covered until ready to use.

Prepare the anatto oil: Place all ingredients in a saucepot over low heat and allow to simmer for 30 minutes. Strain the oil into a container to cool down. Discard the cooked seeds and garlic. Set aside.
Prepare basting mixture: Get ½ cup of the marinade and combine with 25 grams of panutsa. Mix well until combined.

Prepare the lemongrass for brushing by making long incisions along the bottom part of the lemongrass stalks. Trim a small portion of the leaves and tie 2 stalks together. This will serve as a basting brush while cooking the chicken. Set aside.
Marinate the chicken with remaining marinade overnight in the chiller.

To cook: Pre-heat grill over medium heat. Drain chicken from marinade and grill chicken skin side up. Using the lemongrass brush, baste the chicken with the basting mixture alternating with the anatto oil each time you flip the chicken. Grill until fully cooked then serve while warm.

name: Christmas Adobo Pineapple and Christmas Ham
description: Alam nating lahat na staple ang Adobo pag pasko- Pero paano pa ito gawing espesyal? Gawin ang recipe ni Ninong Ry na Christmas Adobo Pineapple and Christmas Ham!

ingredients.item: pinoy style christmas ham, cut into 1 inch cubes
fresh pineapple (peeled and eyes removed), as needed

instructions: Heat oil in a pan and brown the chicken. Set aside.
In the same pan, sauté the garlic until browned. Add in the chicken and sear.
Add Knorr Liquid Seasoning, soy sauce, and vinegar, let the acid cook-off.
Add in the Knorr Chicken Cubes
Mix in the pineapple chunks, black pepper, bay leaves, ham, and pineapple juice.
Let it simmer for about 20 minutes.
Remove the cover and reduce until you reach the desired consistency. Season to taste.

name: Spaghetti with Hotdogs and Quezo de Bola
description: Alam nating lahat na staple ang Spaghetti pag pasko- Pero paano pa ito gawing espesyal? Gawin ang recipe ni Abi Marquez na Spaghetti with Hotdogs and Quezo de Bola!

ingredients.item: or More store-bought spaghetti sauce, Filipino Style
patis or fish sauce to taste
Keso de Bola, grated for topping

instructions: In a pan, sauté the garlic and onion until aromatic.
Add the ground pork and cook until browned. Season with fish sauce and black pepper to taste.
Stir in the sliced hotdogs and cook for about 3 minutes.
Pour in the spaghetti sauce and banana ketchup. Add the Knorr Pork Cubes and season with sugar. Adjust the salt, pepper, and fish sauce to your taste.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti noodles according to package directions, adding salt to the boiling water.
To serve, place a portion of pasta on a plate, generously top with sauce, and sprinkle with grated keso de bola. Enjoy!

name: Tuna Carbonara
description: Try Bethany's family's special carbonara - ang bumubuo ng pasko ng Pamilyang Talbot!
instructions: bring 2 quarts of water to a boil in a large pot
add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water
once boiling, add 3/4 lb spaghetti and cook for 10-12 minutes
while the pasta is cooking, peel and finely chop the onion and garlic
in a large pan, heat cooking oil over medium heat
add the chopped onion and garlic then sauté for about 2-3 minutes
add the 6 oz tuna to the pan with the onions and garlic
crumble the Knorr beef cube into the pan and stir until the cube dissolves and the mixture is well combined
add the 15 oz all-purpose cream to the pan and stir to combine
let the sauce simmer for 3-5 minutes
once the sauce is ready, add the pasta to the pan with the creamy tuna sauce
you can add some parmesan cheese on top of the final dish

name: Chicken Pastel

ingredients.item: Boneless quarter leg, chopped menudo cut - 1 kg
Canned whole button mushroom, halved - 2 small cans
cornstarch and water mixture - as needed

instructions: Saute in an ample amount of oil, onion and garlic. Cook for 1-2 mins. Add chicken and Knorr chicken cubes, cook for another 5 minutes.
Add potatoes, carrots, celery, chorizo bilbao and cook for another 10 minutes.

Add bell peppers and quail eggs then add evaporated milk. Thicken the mixture using cornstarch and water mixture. Simmer for 5 minutes and turn off the fire and add all purpose cream. Adjust seasoning with patis and black pepper.

name: Cajun Fries With Lady’s Choice Spicy Mayo
instructions: Cut fries, lengthwise, as thin or thick as you prefer. You want them to be as long as possible. Soak in ice and salt in the chiller for at least 30 minutes.
Drain fries from water. Pat dry with paper towels then toss with the cornstarch.
Set oil in a pot over medium heat. Fry in batches for 10-12 minutes. Drain fries from oil and continue to cook the remaining pieces.
Once all the potatoes have been fried, increase heat on the oil to medium high and flash fry the potatoes, again in batches, for 2-3 minutes until ends are crisped. Drain oil.

Toss double-fried fries with the Cajun seasoning and sprinkle with chopped parsley. Serve with Lady’s Choice Spicy Mayo and enjoy! Note: You may use your favorite store-bought frozen fries and just follow cooking directions.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Spread about 2-3 tablespoons of Lady’s Choice Cheddar Cheese Mayo on 4 pcs of bread. Cover with the other piece.
Spread butter on the outer sides of the sandwiches then place onto a flat pan or griddle. Toast on both sides. Serve and enjoy!

name: Greek Salad With Roasted Garlic Dressing

ingredients.item: lettuce leaves cut into bite-sized pieces
cucumber, washed, seeds removed and cut into 1/2" cubes
small pc red onion, sliced thinly

instructions: Assemble salad in a bowl by placing lettuce leaves in first then top with cucumber, tomatoes, onions and olives.
Drizzle Lady’s Choice Roasted Garlic Mayo over the salad then last top with crumbled Feta cheese. Serve and enjoy!

name: Crispy and Juicy Chicken Karaage Recipe With Japanese-Style Mayo
description: If Japanese street food keeps appearing on your feed, it’s likely you’ve paused at those crispy, golden bites served hot in cozy izakayas and night markets. They’re known as chicken karaage, juicy thigh pieces marinated in soy, sake, and ginger before frying until crisp outside yet juicy inside. Follow this recipe to recreate authentic Japanese fried chicken with a light, crunchy finish and simple mayo dipping sauce.
instructions: Prepare the Marinade Combine Japanese soy sauce, sake, mirin, and ginger (with its juice) in a bowl. Mix well until combined.

Marinate the Chicken Pat the chicken pieces dry using paper towels to remove excess moisture. Add the chicken to the marinade and toss to coat evenly. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 1 hour. Tip: Drying the chicken first helps the marinade cling better and improves crispness during frying.

Heat the Oil Pour enough oil into a deep pot so the chicken pieces will be fully submerged. Heat over medium heat. Tip: Use neutral oils with a high smoke point such as canola, vegetable, or sunflower oil. Dip a wooden chopstick into the oil; it’s ready if small steady bubbles form around it.

Coat with Cornstarch Remove chicken from the marinade and lightly shake off excess liquid. Place in a bowl and sprinkle cornstarch over the pieces. Toss gently until all sides are coated. Tip: Coat just before frying to prevent the cornstarch from becoming soggy.

First Fry the Chicken Carefully drop the coated chicken pieces into the hot oil. Do not overcrowd the pot. Fry in batches for 3–5 minutes, or until lightly golden but not deeply browned. Remove and drain on a wire rack or paper towels. Let rest for 3–5 minutes.

Double Fry the Chicken Increase the heat to high. Return the chicken to the oil in batches and fry again for 30 seconds to 1 minute, or until golden brown and crisp. Drain well. Tip: The second fry removes excess moisture and creates a light, crunchy exterior while keeping the inside juicy.

Plate and Serve Serve chicken karaage hot over shredded lettuce with Lady’s Choice Japanese-Style Mayo on the side. Tip: You can also serve chicken karaage with Lady’s Choice Spicy Mayo, Roasted Garlic Mayo, or Cheddar Cheese Mayo to change the flavor profile.
Serve over shredded lettuce with Lady’s Choice Roasted Garlic Mayo on the side. Enjoy! Note: You may use your favorite store-bought frozen karaage and follow cooking directions on pack.

name: Quarter Pounder Cheeseburger

ingredients.item: store-bought frozen quarter pounder beef burger Patties

instructions: Fry burger patties on a flat pan or griddle until fully cooked. Transfer on a plate and allow to rest for 2 minutes.
Assemble burger by placing the lettuce on top of the bottom bun then the tomato slice.
Top cooked burger patty over tomato then spread about 1-2 tablespoons of Lady’s Choice Cheddar Cheese Mayo. Cover with the top bun and serve! *Note: Steam burger buns to warm and soften.

name: One-Pot and Only Spicy Chicken Rice by Ciara and Brent
description: Create this One-Pot and Only Spicy Chicken Rice by Ciara and Brent that helped them realize that cooking is a green flag! Cook for your special someone this Valentines!

ingredients.item: mixed vegetables (store-bought or prepared at home by combining corn kernels, carrot cubes, and green peas)
Optional garnish: chopped cilantro or green onions

instructions: Prepare the Chicken and Vegetables: In a bowl, combine chicken thighs and legs with Knorr Liquid Seasoning, ketchup, paprika, chili powder, minced garlic, salt, brown sugar, and pepper. Massage the marinade into the chicken and set aside while prepping the vegetables.

Cook the Chicken: Heat cooking oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the marinated chicken thighs and legs and sear until lightly browned on all sides. Remove and set aside. In the same pot, sauté onion, garlic, and minced red chilies until fragrant. Add tomato paste and toast for 2-3 minutes until it darkens slightly and develops a richer flavor.

Cook the Rice and Assemble: Add rice, ketchup, water, and Knorr Chicken Cube to the pot. Stir well and bring to a boil. Return the chicken to the pot and cook the rice and chicken until the water is almost dried out. Add the mixed vegetables and simmer until the rice is fully cooked and the vegetables are tender, which is around 10 minutes. Turn off the heat, fluff the rice with a fork, and garnish with chopped cilantro or green onions if desired before serving.

name: Asim-Kilig Corned Beef Sinigang by Renee and Kevin
description: Create this Asim-Kilig Corned Beef Sinigang by Renee and Kevin that helped them realize that cooking is a green flag! Cook for your special someone this Valentines!

ingredients.item: corned beef, drained - preferably a brand with bigger chunks vs. sabog yung strands
Knorr Sinigang mix Sampalok Mix (40 g) fish sauce (patis), to taste

instructions: SAUTE INGREDIENTS In a large pot, brown the corned beef over medium heat. Remove and set aside. In the same pot, sauté the onion and tomatoes over medium heat until softened.
CREATE THE SINIGANG BASE Add water to the pot with the sautéed ingredients. Bring to a boil. Stir in the Knorr Sinigang Mix Sampalok and fish sauce. Adjust seasoning to taste.

ADD VEGETABLES AND CORNED BEEF Add the eggplant, okra, sitaw, and green chili and simmer for another 5 minutes. Return the corned beef to the pot, and let it heat through for 2 minutes. Add the kangkong leaves, turn off the heat, and cover for 2 minutes. Serve with rice and enjoy!

name: Nutty and Nice Peanut Noodle by Andrea and Jomari
description: Create this Nutty and Nice Peanut Noodle by Andrea and Jomari that helped them realize that cooking is a green flag! Cook for your special someone this Valentines!
instructions: Cook the Pasta In a pot of boiling water with salt, cook spaghetti noodles until 1 minute away from al dente. Reserve ½ cup of pasta water before draining.

Prepare the Sauce and Pork In a bowl, combine chunky peanut butter, Knorr Liquid Seasoning, oyster sauce, chili oil, chili flakes, garlic, vinegar, sugar, Knorr Pork cube, and pasta water. Whisk until smooth and adjust the season to taste. In a large pan with hot oil, cook ground pork over medium heat until browned and cooked through. Pour the prepared sauce into the pan with the pork, stirring to coat evenly. Simmer for 1-2 minutes.

Combine and Serve Add the hot noodles to the pan with the pork and sauce mixture. Toss until well combined, adding more pasta water as needed for desired consistency. Garnish with chopped green onions and chili flakes according to preference. Enjoy!

name: Creamy Mayo Ramen
description: The comforting instant ramen, now elevated with a twist! Make your ramen extra special and creamy with Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise.
instructions: Add boiling water into noodles. Allow noodles to cook.
In a separate bowl, add seasoning packet, eggyolk and mayonnaise. Mix well.
Once noodles are tender, add some of the noodle water into the mayonnaise-eggyolk mixture and mix well.
Pour mayonnaise-eggyolk mixture with the noodles. Mix well and top with sliced leeks. Enjoy while warm.

name: Marry Me Pasta and Chicken
description: Create this Marry Me Pasta and Chicken - A Simple, Delicious, and Exciting recipe, perfect for date nights when you need something easy yet thrilling to spice up your date!

ingredients.item: sugar, salt and pepper to taste

instructions: In a pot, heat olive oil and saute garlic until fragrant and lightly toasted. Add onions and continue to saute for another 2-3 minutes.

Add Italian herb seasoning, canned tomatoes, Knorr Chicken Cube, water, white wine & chili flakes, if adding. Allow to simmer until wine is cooked off. Reduce heat and continue to cook for 20-40 minutes over very low heat, stirring frequently.
Adjust sugar, salt and pepper according to preference. Set aside and keep warm.

To make chicken parmigiana: Slice chicken breast into thin wide pieces. You may pound chicken to achieve preferred thickness. Season both sides of all chicken pieces with Italian Herb Seasoning, salt and pepper. Dredge each pc in flour then into beaten eggs then coat with breadcrumbs until all chicken pieces are breaded. Pan fry in hot oil until golden brown. Once all chicken pieces are cooked, arrange on a serving plate then spoon sauce on the middle part of the chicken cut lets. Sprinkle grated mozzarella then bake in oven or airfryer until cheese melts. Sprinkle grated Parmesan cheese just before serving. Enjoy!
To make Tomato Cream Pasta: Add all-purpose cream to the prepared pasta sauce. Top over cooked pasta and sprinkle Parmesan cheese just before serving. Enjoy!

name: Kimchi Sinigang Hotpot
description: Create this Kimchi Sinigang Hotpot - A Simple, Delicious, and Exciting recipe, perfect for when you're craving for Sinigang this rainy season!

ingredients.item: (11-g) pack Knorr Sinigang Sa Sampalok mix Original

instructions: Dissolve sinigang mix in hot water. Set aside.
In a clay pot or shallow pot, put pork slices, red onions, tomatoes, kimchi, gochujang and sugar. Pour in sinigang stock, cover and allow to simmer until pork is cooked. Mix well.
Add in tofu and leeks. Cover and continue to simmer for another 3 minutes. Serve hot with rice.

name: Kanto Style Fried Chicken
description: Create this Kanto-Style Fried Chicken - A Simple, Delicious, and Exciting recipe!
instructions: Combine Knorr Liquid seasoning, garlic, calamansi juice and pepper then marinate chicken in chiller for at least 15 minutes.
Mix flour, cornstarch, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
After marinating, drain chicken from marinade then toss in flour mixture, one piece at a time, making sure the chicken is coated well. Deep fry until golden brown and fully cooked, about 8 minutes.

name: Chicken Pastil - Rice Cooker Edition
description: Create this Chicken Pastil, Rice Cooker Edition - A Simple, Delicious, and Exciting recipe!
instructions: In the rice cooker pot, combine chicken, laurel leaves, peppercorn, Knorr Chicken Cube and water enough to cover the chicken. Cover and allow to cook.
Once chicken is fully cooked, drain chicken from boiling water then shred using 2 forks. Set aside.

In the same rice cooker pot, saute garlic and onions in hot oil then add shredded chicken. Make sure that the rice cooker setting is on cook mode. Add soy sauce, chicken cube and turmeric powder. Mix well. Pour in vinegar and allow to cook until dry. Adjust seasoning according to taste. Serve with hot rice.

name: Adobo Ramen
description: null
instructions: In a bowl, combine soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, onions and crushed peppercorns. Marinate chicken for at least 10 minutes.

In a pan, heat oil and pan-fry marinated chicken until caramelized. Add marinade, bay leaves, half chicken cube and ½ cup water. Allow to simmer until chicken is fully cooked and sauce is syrupy. Set aside.
Prepare ramen according to package directions with the addition of half chicken cube. Once cooked, divide into 3 bowls.
Top with chicken adobo, sliced eggs, leeks, garlic and adobo sauce. Serve hot.

name: Creamy Pork Gata Ramen
description: null
instructions: In a small pan, combine soy sauce, sugar, garlic, leeks, ginger, half piece Knorr Pork Cube and water. Add pork liempo and allow to boil. Reduce heat to simmer and continue to cook until pork is tender. Drain pork from braising liquid. You may use pork as is or pan-fry a little bit for some caramelization.

Boil water as per package instructions, add half Knorr Pork Cube, coconut milk, peanut spread and ramen seasoning packet. Allow to boil before adding noodles. Cook until desired doneness. Divide into 3 bowls.
Top with braised pork, sliced eggs, leeks, crunchy garlic and nori. Serve hot.

name: Chicken Mami
description: null

ingredients.item: fresh egg noodles or 300 grams dry egg noddles, blanched in hot water

instructions: Toast cut side of the garlic, onions and ginger in a dry pot. Add water, Knorr Chicken Cubes, fish sauce and ground black pepper. Allow to simmer for 10 minutes. After 15 minutes, add chicken breast fillet and continue to cook for another 15 minutes.
Strain out aromatics and chicken pieces from the soup. Discard aromatics. Shred chicken into flakes. Set aside. Continue to keep soup hot.
Divide blanched noodles into 3 bowls. Top with chicken flakes, carrot strips, Baguio pechay, eggs and toasted garlic. Pour in hot soup. Serve hot and enjoy!

name: Beef Hinalang
description: This recipe from Mindanao combines beef and chili peppers in a meaty-sarap soup. Brighten up your dining table by learning how to cook Beef Hinalang!
instructions: In a pot, heat oil and sauté onion, garlic, and ginger until the aromatics soften.
Add the thinly sliced beef and sauté until the beef is medium brown.
Mix in the vinegar and soy sauce, then bring to a boil.
Add in the Knorr Beef Cube, stir until incorporated.
Pour the water in and let the mixture come back up to a boil. Continue to boil on low to medium heat until the beef gets tender (around 30 minutes), adding more water if needed.
Mix in the chopped Thai chili peppers and green onions. Season with ground black pepper to taste and let cook for 2 more minutes. Serve while hot.

name: Chicken Afritada
description: This classic Chicken Afritada recipe highlights the rich flavors of chicken, bell peppers, potatoes, and carrots in a meaty-sarap tomato-based sauce.

ingredients.item: lb. chicken, cut into serving pieces

instructions: In a pan, heat oil and sauté garlic and onion until softened.
Sear the chicken until lightly browned on both sides.
Add in the tomato sauce, water, bay leaves and let boil.
Add in the Knorr Chicken Cube, stir until dissolved, and cover. Cook on low to medium heat until chicken is tender (around 30 minutes).
Add in the potatoes, carrots, red bell pepper, and green bell pepper.
Season with salt and pepper and stir.
Boil until potatoes and carrots soften, around 12 minutes. Adjust seasoning as needed and serve hot.

name: Chicken Pastil
description: Popular as an affordable dish among Muslim households, Pastil is a rice dish with dry shredded chicken. Make this classic Mindanaon dish!
instructions: Place chicken breast fillets in a pot with laurel leaves & black peppercorns. Cover with enough water to cover. Allow to boil. Reduce heat to simmer until fully cooked. Drain chicken pieces from boiling liquid. Reserve ½ cup of the boiling liquid. Allow to cool slightly and shred chicken pieces. Set aside.
In a pan, heat oil and saute garlic and onions until soft.

Add shredded chicken. Mix well then add vinegar, Knorr Liquid Seasoning and turmeric powder. Toss well. Add some of the reserved boiling liquid to moisten chicken. Adjust seasoning according to taste.
Cook chicken until desired doneness- you may cook longer to toast the chicken or serve it abit moist. Serve with hot rice.

name: Roasted Apple Chicken with Cinnamon Glaze Recipe COPY
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Roasted Apple Chicken with Cinnamon Glaze | Knorr
instructions: Begin by preparing the glaze. First, combine the butter, honey, cinnamon, lemon zest, cane vinegar and apple juice in a saucepan. Bring this to a boil over high heat before cooking it to a simmer over low heat, until the sauce is thick. Brush the apples with this mixture and set this aside. Reserve the remaining cinnamon glaze for later use.
Now, it’s time to flavour the chicken by rubbing it with the mashed Knorr Chicken Broth Cubes together with the pepper, rosemary, and thyme.

In a baking dish, arrange the chicken pieces and glazed apples with a drizzle of oil on top. Bake this in a 375F oven until the chicken is cooked through. Transfer to a serving plate with more cinnamon glaze on top.
Your family will surely be delighted and will definitely thank you for it when they see something as fancy as this being prepared for them with love.

name: Roasted Apple Chicken with Cinnamon Glaze Recipe COPY
description: Create our delicious and easy to follow recipe for Roasted Apple Chicken with Cinnamon Glaze | Knorr
instructions: Begin by preparing the glaze. First, combine the butter, honey, cinnamon, lemon zest, cane vinegar and apple juice in a saucepan. In a baking dish, arrange the chicken pieces and glazed apples with a drizzle of oil on top. Bake this in a 375F oven until the chicken is cooked through. Transfer to a serving plate with more cinnamon glaze on top.
Your family will surely be delighted and will definitely thank you for it when they see something as fancy as this being prepared for them with love.

name: Baked Parmesan Crusted Fish
description: Create a Baked Parmesan Crusted Fish dish perfect for celebrations and gatherings with this easy-to-follow recipe made creamy with Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise.

ingredients.item: cream dory fillet or any white, Neutral tasting, flasky fish

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 F (175 C).

Wash the (defrosted) Cream Dory fillets and pat dry with paper towels. Lay the fillets in a small shallow baking dish. Pour the olive oil and spread it on the fish. Bake it for 15-20 mins or until fish is flaky. Be careful not to overcook the fish.
While fish is baking, prepare the parmesan mixture. In a bowl, combine mayonnaise, parmesan cheese, thyme, and half of the rosemary. Mix them together.

When fish is cooked, take out the fish from the oven. If the fish has become watery, scoop out the excess water but try to leave the olive oil. Evenly spread the mayo mixture on top then sprinkle the remaining half teaspoon of rosemary on top. Return to oven and bake for another 10 mins.
Once the parmesan mixture has set, broil the fish for another 2-3 minutes to brown the top. Keep the oven door ajar while broiling and watch closely to avoid burning.
Squeeze a wedge of lemon on top. Serve hot with the remaining lemon wedges on the side.

name: Pimiento Cheese Dip
description: Create a festive celebration Pimiento Cheese Dip with this easy-to-follow recipe made extra rich with Lady's Choice Real Mayonnaise.

ingredients.item: (6-ounce) jar pimientos, or 3/4 cup roasted red peppers
extra - sharp cheddar cheese (about 3 cups), freshly grated
salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Drain the pimientos, reserving the juice. Cut in large dice if not already diced.

Mix the cheese, cream cheese, mayonnaise, garlic powder and cayenne until ingredients are well combined and mixture is whipped. With a spatula, fold in pimientos. If needed, add juice from pimientos, a teaspoon at a time, to reach the desired creamy consistency. Mixture should not be stiff.
Taste and add salt and pepper if needed. Cover and refrigerate until serving. Keeps well up to 1 week.

name: Creamy Crab and Corn Soup w/ Sotanghon
description: This creamy soup brings together the sweetness of corn and the richness of crab from Knorr Crab and Corn soup! With freshness from cilantro, this bowl creates a cozy meal that the whole family will love.

ingredients.item: Knorr crab and corn soup 55 g
onion leeks, white and green parts, sliced diagonally

instructions: Dissolve soup mix in 700 ml water. Allow to simmer for 5 minutes.
Pour in beaten egg, and gently stir. Add milk and soaked sotanghon noodles. Let simmer for another 2-3 minutes.
Garnish with wansoy stalks and sliced leeks before serving. Serve while warm. Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Crab and Corn Ramen
description: Upgrade your ramen with this creamy, cheesy and refreshing recipe made with Knorr Crab and Corn Soup! Your new go to comfort meal!

ingredients.item: Knorr crab and corn soup 55 g
Lady's Choice cheddar cheese mayo, to taste
optional: sliced onion leeks for garnish

instructions: Boil half the water then cook ramen noodles halfway & add all soup packets.
Dissolve soup mix with the remaining water then pour in with the ramen noodles. Allow to simmer then slowly pour in beaten egg. Gently sir. Continue to simmer for another 3 minutes.
Transfer onto a serving bowl/s. Drizzle with Lady’s Choice Cheddar Cheese Mayo on top. Serve while warm.

name: Spicy Egg Drop Tofu Soup
description: This spicy egg drop tofu soup combines soft tofu, silky egg ribbons, and a kick of spiciness. Find out how to use Knorr Nido Oriental Style Soup to create this dish in less than 15 minutes!

ingredients.item: Knorr Nido Oriental Style soup 53 g
gochujang (may be lessened to make less spicy)
Optional: bok choy, Chinese cabbage, or spinach

instructions: Dissolve soup mix in water. Allow to simmer for 3 minutes.
Add gochujang paste and mix well, then slowly pour in beaten egg. Gently stir. Add tofu cubes and bok choy. Continue to simmer for another 3 minutes.
Transfer onto a serving bowl/s. Drizzle with some sesame oil, and garnish with spring onions. Serve while warm.
